Et nanleetan na kabuasan tan labi sikara so nabagbag: natawtaw ira lawas ya andi bengatla a mangimano.
¿Agta say lubir na tolda ra naguyor ed dalem da? Ompatey ira, tan andian na kakabatan.
Tawag ka natan; ¿wala so bengatla ya onebat ed sika? Tan ¿siopa ed saray santo so pawilan mo?
Ta say kasnokan pateyen to so maatiw a too, tan say inkaimon pateyen to so mureng.
Anengneng ko so maatiw ya onlalamot: balet tampol inayew ko so panagayaman to.
Saray anak to arawi ra manlapu ed katalkan, tan natalapos ira ed wangalan, angapo met diman so bengatla na mangilaban ed sikara:
A say inani kanen na narasan, tan sikato so alaen da ni a manlapu ed saray sabit; et say kalot nipatit nipaakar ed kayarian da.
Ta say pamairap ag ompaway a manlapu ed dabok, angan say gonigon ag onbosilak ed dalin;
Balet say too nianak ed gonigon, singa saray kidkidiam ontekiab ira a mamatagey.
Balet nipaakar ed siak, anapen ko so Dios, tan dia ed Dios imatalek ko so sengegan ko;
Sikato a mangawa na baleg a bengabengatla tan ag natokor, makapakelaw a bengabengatla ya andi bilang:
Sikato a mangiter na uran ed tapew na dalin, tan mangibaki danudanum ed tapew na saray uma;
Dia ed ontan ya ipasen to ed tagey iramay abeba, tan saraman so managogol sikara so nipatagey ed katalkan.
Bagbagen to so saray gagaem na kasiliban, dia ed ontan a saray lima ra agda nasumpal so kanonotan da.
Erelen to so saray mangakabat ed dili a kasiliban da; tan say simbawa na saray marumsis niyakar ya andi kakanaan.
Miromog ira ed kabilungetan ed panaon na agew, tan mankarapas ira ed pegley agew a singa dia ed labi.
Balet ilaban to a manlapu ed kampilan so sangi ra, angan say naokolan a manlapu ed lima na makapanyari.
Dia ed ontan say duka walaan na ilalo, tan say karelmengan itonda to so sangi to.
Nia, mapalar so too a banoen na Dios: kanian agmo modmoraen so pananusa na Makapanyarinamin.
Ta mangawa na sugat, tan berberan to; manugat, et saray lima to manambal.
Ilaban to ka ed anem ira a gonigon; on, dia ed pitora angapo so mauges a maniwit ed sika.
Dia ed eras dondonen to ka a manlapu ed patey; tan dia ed bakal a manlapu ed pakayari na kampilan.
Niyamot ka a manlapu ed panusa na dila; agka antakot ed kabagbag sano onsabi.
Et kabagbag tan gawat onele' ka; agka met antakot ed saray munanakap na dalin.
Ta misiglaot ka ed saray bato na uma; et saray munanakap na uma mipakna ra ed sika.
Ed naamtaan mo a say toldam wala ed kareenan; et dalawen mo so pokokan mo, tan agka onkulang a balot.
Naamtaan mo met so binim a sikato so baleg, tan say simit mo singa say dika na dalin.
Onla ka ed lubok mo ed nagnap a taon, singa say tinanay a trigo onsabi ed panaon to.
Nia so saya, sikato so inosisa mi, sikato so ontan; sikato so denglen mo, tan sikato so amtaen mo nipaakar ed kaabigan mo.
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
¡O no komon ta say kapasoot ko sikato lambengat so nasimbang, tan amin a kasegsegangan ko nigaton ed simbangan!
Ta natan sikato so ambelat nen say buer na saray kadayatan: kanian saray salitak sikara so marlas.
Ta saray pana na Makapanyarinamin wala ra ed loob ko, say samal da inomen na espirituk: saray katakotan ed Dios inmoksoy ira sumpa ed siak.
¿Manngakngak ta so asno ed takel sano walaan na dika? Odino ¿manengak ta so baka ed tagey na tagano to?
¿Nayari ta a say andi taway kanen ya andi asin? Odino ¿wala ta so bengatla a taway ed kalaniog na iknol?
Say kamarerwak onaleg a maniwit ed sikara; sikara so singa makasingla a kanen ed siak.
¡O komon ta nagegemtan ko so kerewen ko; et say Dios yaboloy to komon ed siak so bengatla a panpilpilalekan ko!
¡Komon ta kaliktan na Dios a tapiaken toak; ya unaten to so lima to, tan isian toak!
Et sikato komon a siansia ni so kaligliwak, on, manliket ak komon dia ed irap ya ag mangyagel, ta agko inburi so saray salita na Santo.
¿Anto ta so biskeg ko, pian manalagar ak? tan ¿anto ta so angaan ko, pian mantepel ak?
¿Say biskeg ko sikato ta so biskeg na saray bato? Odino ¿say laman ko sikato ta so gansa?
¿Aliwa ta ya angapo so tulong ed siak, tan say kakabatan nitainan a sigpot a manlapu ed siak?
Say nalelemay ipatnagan komon na abig na linawa na kaaro to; ompan ikaindan to so takot ed Makapanyarinamin.
Saray agagik nanagamil ira a masasaol a singa kolos, singa say banawang na kolokolos ya onlabas;
A sikara so andeket nisengeg ed hielo, tan ed sikara say nieve onamot:
Ed panaon a sikara so ompetang, natunaw ira; no ampetang, naupot ira ed pasen da.
Saray managbanyaga a manakar ed dalan da onsipa ra; ontatdang ira ed lawak, tan natawtaw ira.
Saray managbanyaga na Tema ninmengneng ira, saray olop na Saba inalagar da' ra.
Abaingan ira lapu ed nanilalo ra nen saman; sinmabirad' man, tan agotgot ira.
Ta natan sikayo so angapo; nanengneng yo so makapakebiew, tan antakot kayo.
¿Inkuan ko ta, Iter yo ed siac? Odino, ¿Mangyapay kayo na tokdol nipaakar ed siak ed kayarian yo?
Odino, ¿Ilaban yoak a manlapu ed lima na manamairap? Odino, ¿Dondonen yoak a manlapu ed lima na saray manangapos?
Ibangat yoak, et mandeen ak; tan ipatalos yo ed siak so alingoan ko.
¿Alay biskeg na saray salita na inkatunong! Balet say pangibano yo, ¿anto so banoen to?
¿Nonoten yo ya ibano so salsalita, bangta saray bitla na sakey ya andi ilalo sikara so singa dagem?
On, labay yo a panpapalaranan so saray ulila, tan gawaen yo ya anapan so kaaro yo.
Natan sirin napaliket kayo komon ya onnengneng ed siak; ta petepeteg ya agak mantila ed arap yo.
Ompawil kayo, pikasik ed sikayo, angapo komon so ag onkatunongan; on, ompawil kayo lamet say sengegan ko sikato so matunong.
¿Wala ta so ag onkatunongan ed dilak? ¿Ag ta nayari pakananam ko ya ibiig so makaderal a bengabengatla?
¿Angapo ta so panaon na panagbetang na too ed tapew na dalin? Tan ¿aliwa ta a saray agew to singa saray agew na miópupa?
Singa aripen a maposapos a panpilalekan to so sirum, tan singa miópupa a manalagar na upa to:
Dia ed ontan nagawa ak a mangayarian ed saray bulan na kasegsegangan, tan saray makapaingongot a labi atoro ed siak.
Sano ondokol ak, kuan ko, ¿Kapigan so ibangon ko tan say labi kapigan onla? Et napno ak na alalimporas anga ed manliwawa so agew.
Say lam an ko akawesan ed bigibigis tan linalinang na dabok; say baog ko manpigdan, tan onterak lamet.
Saray agew ko sikara so marlas nen sikoan na umaabel, tan naopot ira ya andi ilalo.
¡O nonoten mo a say bilay ko sikato so sakey a sibok: say matak ag la makanengneng a maong!
Say mata na makanengneng ed siak ag toak la nanengneng: saray matam wala ra naani ed tapew ko, balet andi ak la.
Singa say lurem naopot tan nabalang, ontan so onlasor ed Sheol ag la onsegep.
Ag la ompawil ed abung to, angan say pasen to agto a nabirbir.
Kanian agko pokpokan so sangik; mansalita ak dia ed kapopotgan na espirituk; mantagleey ak dia ed kapaitan na kamarerwak.
¿Dayat ak ta, odino tongol ak ta na dayat, pian mangipasen ka na bantay ed siak?
Sano kuan ko, Say dokolan ko ligliwaen toak, say tandakan ko palemewen to so tagleey ko;
Samanla taktakoten moak ed saray kogkugip, tan kebiewen moak ed saray pasingawey:
Dia ed ontan say kamarerwak pilien to so pamalekne, tan say patey a lalo nen saray pukel ko.
Kagulak so bilay ko; agko labay so manbilay a siansia: paulian moak a bokor; ta saray agew ko sikara so apa.
¿Anto ta so too, pian sikato so itandorom, tan ipasen mo so kanonotan mo ed sikato.
Tan sikato so dalawen mo a kinabuasan, tan sikato so salien mo ed balang sankasigmat?
¿Kaunongan kabayag so agmo inengneng ed siak, odino paulian moak komon a bokor anga ed naakmon ko so ilol ko?
No nankasalanan ak, ¿anto so gawaen ko ed sika, O sika managbantay ed totoo? ¿Akin ya inpasen moak a singa tanda nipaakar ed sika, dia ed ontan a sakey ak ya awit ed siak lanlamang?
Et ¿akin ya agmo paandien so inpakaloksok, tan ekalen mo so kaugsan ko? Ta natan ondokol ak ed dabok; et anapen moak naani a maseeseet, balet andi ak la.
Diad saman inmebat si Bildad a Suhita, tan inkuan to,
¿Kaunongan kabayag a salitaen mo so saraya a bengatla? Tan ¿kaunongan kabayag a saray salita na sangim sikara so singa makapanyari a dagem?
¿Say Dios pikeweten to ta so maptek? Odino ¿say Makapanyarinamin pikeweten to so inkatunong?
Odino saray anak mo nankasalanan ira sumpa ed sikato, tan inyawat to ra ed lima na inpakalokso ra;
No anapen mo a maseeseet so Dios, tan gawaen mo so panpikasim ed Makapanyarinamin;
No malinis tan matunong ka; petepeteg natan onliing nipaakar ed sika, tan gawaen to so panagayaman na inkatunong mo a maaliguas.
Et angan say sengeg mo sikato so melag, angan ontan say unor ya angaan mo namunat a balbaleg.
Ta balitaen mo, pikasik ed sika, ed inmuna a taon, tan itokoy mo so inkasika ed naosisa na saray atateng da
(Ta sikatayo lambengat so nen karoman, tan angapo so amta tayo, lapud' no saray agew tayo ed tapew na dalin sikara so anino);
¿Agda ta ibangat ed sika, tan ibaga ed sika, tan bitlaen da so salsalita a nanlapu ed puso ra?
¿Nayarian ta na balbalino so ombaleg ya andi pitek? Nayarian ta na dampig so ontobo ya andi damim?
Leleg ya wala ni dia ed kalambotan to, tan ag nalenes, namagaan ya ununa nen bengatla ya arum a dika.
Ontan so dalan na saray amin a mangilingoan ed Dios; et say ilalo na too ya andian na Dios natawtaw:
A say katalkan to nisian, tan say ilalo to sikato so abel na genggeng.
Onsaral ed tapew na abung to, balet ag mansiansia: onegna a malet diman, balet ag manbayag.
Sikato malambot ed arap na banwa, tan saray tagasling to onkayat ed panagtanamanan to.
Saray lamot to manlulubiran ed liberliber na bato a losbo, nengnengen to so pasen na batobato.
No nabagbag manlapu ed pasento, sirin sikato iburi to, a kuan to, ag taka anengneng.
Nia, say a sikato so liket na dalan to; et manlapu ed dalin ontobo so saray arum.
Nia, say Dios agto ibantak so naskey a too, agto met pasekderen so saray managgawa na manges.
Panoen to ni so sangim ed elek, tan saray bibil mo ed paneyag.
Saray mangula ed sika nakawesan ira ed baing; et say tolda na marelmetig angapo la naani.
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
Ed tua amtak a sikato so ontan; balet ¿panon so pakapantunong na too ed Dios?
No kaliktan to so misupiatan ed sikato, agto nayari onebat ed sikato na sakey ed sanlibo.
Sikato makabat ed puso, tan makapanyari ed biskeg: ¿Siopa ta so amaawet na inkasikato sumpa ed sikato, tan inmaliguas?
Sikato a manenyeg ed saray palandey, tan sikato so agda amta, no pigaren tora ed sanok to;
A yegyegen to so dalin ed pasen to, tan saray seklang to mantenyeg;
Ya igangan to so banwa, tan sikato so ag ombutay, tan tatakan to so saray bitewen;
A bokbokor to a mangibuskag ed saray tawen, tan manakar ed tapew na saray palong na dayat;
A mangawa na Osa, Orion, tan saray Pleyade, tan saray silir na abalaten;
A mangawa na baleg a bengabengatla ya ag natokor, on, makapakelaw a bengabengatla ya andi bilang.
Nia, manakar ed abay ko, tan sikato so agko nanengneng: onlabas met, balet sikato so agko nalikas.
Nia, samsamen to so dinegkeman, ¿siopa so makabaat ed sikato? ¿Siopa so mangikuan ed sikato, ¿Anto so gawaen mo?
Say Dios agto isuner so sanok to; saray katulongan nen Rahab ontonda ra ed leksab to.
¿Ag lalo ya agak onebat ed sikato, tan pilien ko so saray salitak a mankatunongan ed sikato.
Ed sikato, angan matunong ak, manwari agak onebat; manpikasi ak ed okom ko.
No tinmawag ak, tan inebatan toak, angan ontan agko sisiaen a dinmengel ed voces ko.
Ta buyaken toak ed sakey a bagyo, tan parakelen to so saray sugat ko ya andi sengeg.
Ag toak itepel ya onlinawa ak, no ag ingen panoen toak ed kapaitan.
No salitaen tayo so nipaakar ed biskeg, nia ¡sikato makapanyari ¡ No nipaakar ed inkatunong, ¿Siopa kuanto, so mangigeter na ipatnag ko?
Angan matunongak, say dili a sangik dusaen toak: angan naskey ak, paletan to a marumsis ak.
Naskey ak; agko pablien so inkasiak; modmoraen ko so bilay ko.
Sikato ya amin sakey; kanian kuan ko, bagbagen to so naskey tan say marelmeng.
No say lewet mamatey a tampol, ludlureyen to so panalsali ed maalas.
Say dalin niiter ed lima na marelmeng; sakbongan to so saray lupa na saray okom to; no sikato so aliwa, ¿Siopa sirin?
Bang saray agew ko sikara so marlas nen say manangitolor na sulat: ombatik ira, agda nanengneng so maong.
Onlabas ira a singa saray marlas a sakayan; singa say agila a degkeman to so erel.
No kuan ko, Lingoanan ko so tagleey ko, ekalen ko so maermen a lupak tan siak naani maong a ligsa;
Antakot ak ed saray amin ya sinagem ko, amtak ya ag moak ibilang a maalas.
Nadusa ak; ¿Akin sirin a man kimey ak na maapa?
No urasan ko so inkasiak ed danum na nieve, tan gawaen ko so saray limak a malinlinis:
Angan ontan ilebleb moak ed banawang, tan saray dili a kawes ko gulaen da ak.
Ta sikato aliwa a sakey a too, a singa siak, pian sikato so ebatan ko, tan onloob kami a bansag ed pangokoman.
Angapo so okom ed nanleetan mi, a makapangigaton na lima to ed tapew mi a nanpadpara.
Yarawi to komon so tayokor to manlapu ed siak, tan say kakebiewan ed sikato ag toak komon taktakoten:
Sirin mansalita ak, tan agak antakot ed sikato; ta aliwa ak ya ontan ed inkasiak.
Say kamarerwak sikato so mapaga ed bilay ko; bulusan ko so pantagleey ko; mansalita ak ed kapaitan na kamareruak.
Ikuan ko ed Dios, Ag moak dusaen; ipatnag mo ed siak, akin a misupiatan ka ed siak.
¿Maong ta ed sika a mangapos ka, a modmoraen mo so gawa na saray limam, tan palaboan mo so simbawa na marelmeng?
¿Walaan ka ta na saray mata a laman? Odino ¿onnengneng ka ta a singa inengneng na too?
¿Saray agew mo ta singa saray agew na too, no saray taon mo ta singa saray agew na too,
Pian opapeten mo so unong na inkauges ko, tan osisaen mo so unong ed kasalanan ko,
Angan amtam ya agak marelmeng, tan angapo so makapangilaban manlapu ed limam?
Saray limam nilimpek da ak tan inerengam da ak pati manliberliber; angan ontan bagbagen moak.
Nonoten mo, kerewen ko ed sika, ya inerengan moak a singa langa; et ¿yakar moak ed dabok lamet?
¿Ag moak ta inibung a singa gatas, tan inpankulaba moak a singa keso?
Kinawesan moak ed baog tan laman, tan tinognop moak ed saray pokel tan saray ulat.
Initdan moak m bilay tan maong a linawa; tan say kararalaw mo inpansiansia to so espirituk.
Angan ontan saray a a bengatla inyamot mo ed pusom; amtak a saya wala ed sika:
No man kasalanan ak, sirin tandaan moak, tan ag moak ibilang a maalas manlapu ed inkauges ko.
No marelmengak; ¿abagey ak la! Tan no matunong ak, angan ontan agko itangay so olok, bangta napno ak ed kababaingan, tan onnengneng ak ed kairapan ko.
Et no say olok ontangwa, anupan moak a singa leon; tan ompatnag ka lamet a makapakelaw ed siak.
Pasimbaloen mo so saray panagtasim sumpa ed siak, tan parakelen mo so kasanokan mo ed siak: Panomanoman tan panbabakal wala ra ed siak.
¿Akin sirin ya inpaway moak ed eges? Inyawat ko so kamarerwak, tan angapo so mata ya akanengneng ed siak.
Singa ak nen saman so singa andi ak komon; niyakar ak komon manlapu ed eges anga ed lubok.
¿Saray agew ko aliwa ta a daiset? tonda ka sirin, tan paulian moak a bokor, pian makapanligliwa ak komon na daiset,
Arapen na yakar kod' man ed agko pakapawilan, salanti ed dalin na kabilungetan tan ed anino na patey;
Say dalin ambilunget a singa pegley labi, say dalin, na anino na patey, andian na bengatla ya oksoy, tan diman say liwawa sikato so singa pegley labi.
Diad saman inmebat si Zofar a Namatita, tan inkuan to,
¿Say karaklan na salsalita ag kasi naebatan? Tan ¿say too a masalita napatunong kasi?
¿Saray pasirayew mo pareenan da kasi so saray totoo? Tan ¿sano manlurey ka, angapo kasi so too a mamabaing ed sika?
Ta kuan mo, Say bangat ko sikato so malinis, tan malinis ak ed saray matam.
Balet ¿Oh no say Dios mansalita komon, tan lukasan to so saray bibil to sumpa ed sika.
Tan pian ipatnag to ed sika so saray maamot a kakabatan! Ta sikato matodio ed pakatalos. Amtaen mo sirin a say Dios anapen to ed sika so memelag nen say petek na karelmengan mo.
¿Ed panamegley na panosisa naromog mo ta so Dios? ¿Naromog mo ta so Makapanyarinamin anga ed inkayadyari?
Sikato so atagey a singa tawen; ¿Anto so nagawaan mo? Araldalem nen Sheol; ¿anto so naamtaan mo.
Say sukat to sikato so andukey nen say dalin. Tan maawang nen say dayat,
On onlabas, tan mangikaput, tan manawag ed kaokom, ¿siopa so makabaat ed sikato?
Ta amta to so matila a totoo: nanengneng to so karelmengan met, angan sikato so agto ni isipen.
Balet say maapa a too sikato so andian na pakatalos, on, say too nianak a singa kilaw na asno ed takel.
No panpeteken mo so pusom, tan yunat mo so saray limam ya arap ed sikato;
No say karelmengan wala ed limam, sikato so yarawim. Tan agmo panayamen so inkapikewet ed saray toldam.
Petepeteg sirin ya itangoam so lupam ya andi tilol; on, masekder ka naani, tan agka antakot;
Ta nalingoanan mo so kasegsegangan mo; sikato so nanonotan mo a singa saray danum a linmabas.
Tan say bilay mo sikato naani maliwawa nen say pegley agew; angan wala so bilunget, sikato naani singa say kabuasan.
Et sika naani matalek, lapu ed wala so ilalo; on, osisaen mo so liberliber mo, tan manpainawa ka ed katalkan.
Ontan met ondokol ka, tan angapo so manaktakot ed sika; on, dakel so manpikasi naani ed sika.
Balet saray mata na marelmeng napelag ira, et andian ira naani dalan a batikan; et say ilalo ra sikato naani pangiter da ed saray kamarerwa.
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
Andi duarua a sikayo so baley, tan say kakabatan ompatey pati sikayo.
Balet walaan ak na pakatalos a singa sikayo; siak aliwa ak ya abeba nen sikayo: on, ¿siopa so ag mikabat na ontan a bengabengatla a singa saraya?
Singa ak sakey a eelekan ed kaabay to, siak ya tinmawag ed Dios, tan sikato inmebat: say maptek, say naskey a too sikato so sakey ya eelekan.
Dia ed isip na wala ed kaawangan wala so balaw nipaakar ed inkasegsegang; sikato so maparaan nipaakar ed saray sali ra mankarunias.
Saray tolda na saray managsamsam manaligwas, tan saray managyat ed Dios matalek ira; a dia ed lima ra yakar na Dios ed daakan.
Balet mantepet ka natan ed saray munanakap, et ibangat da ka; tan ed saray manok ed saray tawen, et ibaga ra ed sika:
O mansalita ka ed dalin, et sikato ibangat to ka; tan saray sira ed dayat ipaliwawa ra ed sika.
¿Siopa so ag mikabat dia ed saraya ya amin, a say lima nen Katawan ginawa to so say a,
Dia ed lima to wala so kamarerwa na balang mabilay a bengatla, tan say espiritu na amin a too a mabilay?
¿Say layag agto ta sali en so saray salita, salanti singa say tawentawen nanamen to so kanen?
Et saray mamasiken wala so kakabatan, tan dia ed kinarukey na saray agew say pakatalos.
Ed Dios wala so kakabatan tan pakapanyari; walaan na simbawa tan pakatalos.
Nia, igeba to, et ag nayari ya ipaalagey lamet; kaputan to so sakey a too, et angapo so makapangilukas.
Nia, benbenan to so saray danum, et namagaan ira; lamet, bolosan to ra, et pigaren da so dalin.
Ed sikato wala so biskeg tan kakabatan; say nalingo tan mamalingo kien to ra.
Paakaren to so saray mananimbawa a lakseb ed kalakal, tan saray okom paatiwen to.
Okbaran to so balor na saray ar-ari, tan berberan to so saray banel da ed balkes.
Paakaren to so saray sacerdote a lakseb ed kalakal, tan pigaren to so makapanyari.
Yalis to so bitla na matoor tan ekalen to so pakatalos na saray mamasiken.
Ikalbo to so balaw ed saray principe, tan okbaren to so balkes na mabiskeg.
Lukasan to so aralem a bengabengatla manlapu ed kabilungetan, tan yakar to ed liwawa so anino na patey.
Parakelen to so saray nacion, tan bagbagen to ra: pabalegen to so saray nacion, tan yakar to ra ed inkadakep.
Ekalen to so pakatalos manlapu ed saray manunaan na baley ed dalin, tan panteyengteyengen to ra ed kalawakan ya andian na dalan.
Mankarapas ira ed bilunget ya andi silew; tan panwangelwangelan to ra a singa abuek a too.
Nia, saray matak anengneng da ya amin so saya, say layag ko nadngel to tan sikato so atalosan to.
Say amta yo, sikato lanlamang so amtak met; agak abeba nen sikayo.
Petepeteg labay ko komon so misalita ed Makapanyarinamin, tan pilalek ko so mankatunongan ed Dios.
Balet sikayo so managpalsa na tilatila; sikayo ya amin managtambal kayo ya andi kablian.
¡O no komon ta mandeen kayo a bansag! Tan sikato komon so kakabatan yo.
Denglen yo natan so pankatunongan ko, tan denglen yo so saray bitla na saray bibil ko.
¿Mansalita kayo ta a sipipikewet nipaakar ed Dios, tan mansalita kayo ta a sililingo nipaakar ed sikato?
¿Ipatnag yo ta ed sikato ya wala so panaglabi? ¿Misangsangan kayo ta nipaakar ed Dios?
¿Maong ta ya osisaen to kayo? O singa pamalingo na sakey a too, ¿sikato ta so palingoen yo?
Sikato petepeteg a pooten to kayo, no mangawa kayo a maamoamot ipatnag yo so panaglabi.
¿Say katageyan to agto kayo ta patakoten, tan say katakotan ed sikato napelag ed sikayo?
Saray makapanodnonot a salita yo sikara so uliran a dapodapol, saray panangyagel yo sikara so panangyagel a langa.
Mandeen kayo, paulian yoak a bokor, pian makapansalita ak; tan onsabi ed siak so anto ya onsabi.
¿Akin et alaen ko so laman ko ed saray ngipen ko, tan yan ko so bilay ko dia ed limak?
Nia, pateyen toak; angapo so ilalok: angan ontan pansiansiaen ko so saray dalan ko ed arap to.
Saya met sikato naani kilalaban ko, pian say andian na Dios a too ag onla ed arap to.
Denglen yo a maseeseet so bitlak, tan say paliwawak wala komon ed saray layag yo.
Nia natan, inpasen ko so sengegan ko dia ed oksoy; amtak a matunong ak.
¿Siopa so misupiatan ed siak? Ta sirin mandeen ak tan yawat ko so kamarerwak.
Salambengat agmo gawaen so duara a bengatla ed siak; sirin agko yamot so inkasiak manlapu ed lupam:
Ipaliis mo so limam ed arawi a manlapu ed siak; tan agmo yaboloy a say kakebiewan ed sika taktakoten toak.
Sirin ontawag ka, et onebat ak; o pansalitaen moak, tan ebatan moak.
¿Panon karakel so saray karelmengan ko tan kaskasalanan ko? Ipakabat mo ed siak komon so inpakaloksok tan kasalanan ko.
¿Akin ya yamot mo so lupam, tan egnaan moak nipaakar ed kabusol mo?
¿Deralen mo ta so nibantak a bulong? Tan ¿osilan mo ta so amagaan a dayami?
Ta mansulat ka na ampait a bengabengatla sumpa ed siak, tan pantawiren moak ed saray karelmengan na kalangoeran ko:
Yan mo so saray salik met ed saray pangaw, tan tandaan mo so saray amin a dalan ko; mangipasen ka na ketegan ed saray dapan na salisalik:
Angan singa ak abolok a bengatla a naopot, singa kawes a binokbok.
Say too a nianak ed bii, daiset so saray agew to, tan napno ed gonigon.
Ompaway a singa bulaklak, tan sikato so nasipi; ombatik met a singa anino, tan ag magnayon.
Et ¿lukasan mo ta so saray matarn ed tapew na sakey ya on tan, tan yakar moak ed kaokom pati sika?
¿Siopa so makapangyakar na malinis? angapo.
Bangta sáray agew to ageteran, say bilang na saray agew to wala ed sika, tan tinor'om so saray ketegan to ya agto nalabasan;
Sikato komon so agmo nengnengen, pian makapanpainawa, anga ed nasumpal to, a singa miopupa, so agew to.
Ta wala so ilalo ed sakey a kiew, no nabatang, ya onsimit lamet, tan say malangoer a sanga to ag ontonda.
Angan say lamo' to onmasiken dia ed dalin, tan say sengeg to ompatey ed dalin;
Manwari lapu ed angob na danum sikato so ontobo, tan mangipaway na sangasanga a singa sakey a tanaman.
Balet say too ompatey, tan napaabeba: on, say too yawat to so kamarerwa to, tan ¿inerso kawalaan to?
Singa saray danum onkulang manlapu ed dayat, tan say ilog naekatan tan namagaan;
Dia ed on tan say too ondokol tan ag onbangon: anga ed saray tawen andi lara ag ira onliing, ag ira naliing ed ugip da.
¡O komon ta yamot moak dia ed Sheol, pian niyagel moak a maamoamot, anga ed say sanok mo onlabas, pian toroen mo ed siak so sakey a tinandaan a panaon, tan nonoten moak!
No say sakey a too ompatey, ¿ombilay ta lamet? Amin iray agew na pibabakal ko alagden ko, anga ed say kabolos ko onsabi.
Ontawag ka, et onebatak ed sika: manpilalek ka ed gawa na saray limam.
Balet natan bilangen mo so saray kurang ko: ¿Agmo ta bantayan so kasalanan ko?
Say inpakaloksok atatakan ed sakey a sopot, tan dinait mo so karelmengan ko.
Balet say palandey a nagegeba onla ed angapo; et say bato naalis a manlapu ed pasen to;
Saray danum tunawen da so saray bato; saray idelap to urasan da so dabok na dalin: dia ed ontan bagbagen mo so ilalo na too.
Ontalona ka lawas sumpa ed sikato, tan sikato onlabas; umanen mo so lupa to, tan sikato so pasipoten mo.
Saray anak to a lalaki nagalang ira, tan sikato agto amta; et napaabeba ra, balet sikato so agto nalikas ed sikara.
Balet say laman to ed tapew to walaan na sinagem, tan say kamarerwa to ed dalem to managogol.
Mad saman inmebat si Ehfaz a Temanita, tan inkuan to,
¿Say makabat a too onebat kasi ed maapa a pikakabat, tan panoen to so inkasikato ed dagem na bukig?
¿Mankatunongan ta ed andi pinabangan a salita, Odino dia ed saray bitla so pakagawaan to na aliwan maong?
On, ipaliis mo so takot, tan baaten mo so panangigalang ed arap na Dios.
Ta say karelmengan mo ibangat to so sangim, tan pilien mo so dila na masilib.
Say dili a sangim dusaen to ka, tan aliwa a sika; on saray dili a bibil mo mantasi ra sumpa ed sika.
¿Sika ta so inmona a too a nianak? O ¿pinmaway ka ta ed unaan na saray pokdol?
¿Nadngel mo ta so maamotasimbawa na Dios? Tan ¿pangangaen mo ta so kakabatan nipaakar ed inkasika?
¿Anto ta so antam, ya agmi amta? ¿Anto ta so natalosan mo, a sikato so andi dia ed sikami?
Ed sikami wala a nanpadpara so ubanan tan sankamasikenan a lalaki, a masiken ira nen si amam.
¿Saray panligliwa na Dios sikara ta so melag nipaakar ed sika, say salita mi a sikato so mababig ya arap ed sika?
¿Akin et say pusom yarawl to ka? Tan ¿akin et saray matam mankirem.
A sumpá ed Dios ipawil mo so espiritum, tan papawayen mo so salsalita ed sangim?
¿Anto ta so too, pian sikato komon so malinis? Tan say nianak ed bii, pian sikato komon so matunong?
Nia, ag manmatalek ed saray sasanto to; on, saray tawen ag ira malinis dia ed pakanengneng to:
¡Ag nagkalalo so makadimla tan nabolok, so too ya oninom na karelmengan a singa danum!
Iparongtal ko ed sika, denglen moak; et say anengneng ko ipaliwawak.
(Ya saray makabat a lalaki inbaga ra manlapu ed saray atateng da, tan sikato so agda inyamot;
Ya dia ed sikara a bokor say dalin sikato so initer, tan angapo so sankaili a linmabas ed sikara):
Say mauges a too mansagpot a mairap ed saray amin ya agew to. Say bilang ni na saray taon abantayan nipaakar ed manangapos.
Sakey a tanol na saray makakebiew wala ed layag to; dia ed kaaliguasan say managbagbag onla ed tapew to.
Agto sisiaen ya ompawil a manlapu ed kabilungetan, tan sikato so alagden nipaakar ed kampilan.
Manteyengteyeng ed paway nipaakar ed tinapay, a kuan to ¿iner so kawalaan to? Amta to a say agew na kabilungetan maparaan ed lima to.
Say kaermenan tan kairapan sikato so taktakoten da; ontalona ra sumpa ed sikato, a singa say ari a maparaan ed bakal.
Lapu ed inyunat to so lima to sumpa ed Dios, tan nanpasirayew sumpa ed Makapanyarinamin:
Ombatik ed tapew to ed mataltalker a tenger, pati saray makapal a kutlaong na saray kinlong to;
Lapu ed sinakbongan to so lupa to ed inkataba to, tan tinipon to so taba ed tapew na saray banel to;
Et nanayam ed saray kibalatar a ciudad, dia ed saray abung ya ag nanayaman na too, a sikara so maparaan a magmaliw aloslosbo;
Sikato naani aliwa a mayaman, ag met magnayon so kayarian to, angan saray kayarian to ag ira onkayat ed tapew na dalin.
Ag ohtainan manlapu ed kabilungetan; say dalang pamagaen to so saray sanga to, tan lapu ed linawa na sangi na Dios ontainan.
Ag komon manmatalek ed kaapaan, a paiingoen to so inkasikato; ta say kaapaan sikato naani tumang to.
Nasumpal naani ed arapen na panaon to, tan say sanga to ag naani onbona.
Ipelag to naani so ag aloto a bunga to a singa say sengeg na uvas, tan ibantak to naani so bulaklak to a singa say kiew ya olivo.
Ta say olop na andian na Dios sikato naani lepes, tan say apuy opoten to naani so saray tolda na panoksok.
Manlokon ira na dumsis, tan mangianak ira na karelmengan, tan say puso ra mangitadia na pamalingo.
Nen saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
Nadngel ko so dakel ya ontan a bengabengatla: masegsegang kayo ya amin a managligliwa.
¿Saray maapa a salita walaan ira na angaan? O ¿siopa so managyat ed sika pian onebat ka?
Siak met makapansalita ak a singa gawaen yo; no say kamarerwa yo wala ra ed pasen na kamarerwak, natognop ko so salsalita sumpa ed sikayo, tan ompeyeng so olok ed sikayo.
Balet pabiskegen takayo ed sangik, tan say panligliwa na saray bibil ko tempeyen to so imp yo.
Angan mansalita ak, say irap ko ag natempey; tan angan paulian ko, ¿anto so katempeyan ko?
Balet natan inpansagpot toak: dineral mo so amin ya olop ko.
Tan pinano moak na kumanet, a sikato so tasi sumpa ed siak: et say inkaebeng ko onalagey sumpa ed siak, sikato so man tasi ed lupak.
Pinigpignis toak ed sanok to, tan inusilan toak; nangeget ed tapew ko ed saray ngipen to: say kasumlang ko pinatdem to so saray mata to ed tapew ko.
Insangi ra ed tapew ko so sangi ra; kinabil da ak ed tapew na aping a mabalabalaw: nantitipon ira suiwpa ed siak.
Say Dios yawa' toak ed andian na Dios, tan inbantak toak ed saray lima na marelmeng.
Wala ak nen saman ed painawa, et binuyak toak a maomaong; on, tinengeran toak, tan inbantak toak ya apigpignis: inpasen toak met a nipaakar a tanda to.
Saray managpana to kinobkob da ak ed liberliber; bagbagen to so saray loobloob ko, tan ag mangasi; ikalbo to so apgok ed tapew na dalin;
Buyaken toak ed deral ed tapew na deral; ombatik ed tapew ko a si nga gigante.
Angidait ak na magaspang ya abel ed tapew na baog ko, tan ingaton ko so saklor ko ed dabok.
Say lupak sikato so ambalanga ed pannangis, tan ed tapew na saray lokablokab na matak wala so anino na patey;
Angan ontan angapo so pamasoot ed saray limak, tan say pikakasik sikato so malinis.
O dalin, agmo sakbongan so dalak, tan yaboloy mo a say sinagem ko andian na pasen a painawaan.
Angan natan, nia, say tasik wala ed tawen, tan say onebat lapu ed siak wala ed tagey.
Saray kakaarok balbalawen da ak: balet say matak mangikalbo na saray lua ed Dios,
Pian pansiansiaen to so matunong a too ed Dios, tan matunong a sakey ya anak a laki ne too ed kaabay to.
Ta sano saray daiset ya agew onsabi ra, onla ak naani ed dalan ya agko pawilan.
Say espiritu naopot, saray agew naerep, say lubok sikato so maparaan nipaakar ed siak.
Petepeteg wala ra so managludlurey ed siak, tan say matak manayam ed pananagyat da.
Mangiter ka natan na sanla yebatan moak ed inkasika; ¿siopa so wala a mangitabig na limalima ed siak?
Tan inyamot mo so puso ra manlapu ed pakatalos: kanian sikara so agmo itandoro.
Say mangidalem ed saray kaaro to nipaakar ed sakey a degkem, angan saray mata na saray anak to onkapuy ira.
Balet ginawa toak a palawpaw a salita na baley; tan onlupda ra ed lupak.
Say matak met onkuyep nisengeg ed sinagem, tan amin a kagkagawaan na laman ko singa ra sakey ya anino.
Saray maptek a totoo nikelawan ira ed saya, tan say maalas onliing sumpa ed andian na Dios.
Angan ontan say matunong mansiansia ed dalan to, tan say walaan na malinis a limalima onbiskeg ya onbiskeg.
Balet nipaakar ed sikayo ya amin, galidia natan lamet; et agak makaromog na makabat a too ed sikayo.
Saray agew ko sikara so linmabas, saray kanonotan ko nabuyak angan saray kanonotan na pusok.
Isalat da so labi ed agew: say liwawa, kuan da, asinger ed kabilungetan.
No anapen ko so Sheol a singa abung ko; no inbilkag ko so tandakan ko ed kabilungetan;
No inkuan ko ed kabolok, Sika so amak; ed bigis; sika so inak, tan agik a bii;
¿Iner sirin so ka walaan na ilalok? Et nipaakar ed ilalok, ¿siopa so makanengneng ed sikato?
Sikato onlasor ed saray balewet na Sheol, sano wala la so painawa ed dabok.
Nen saman inmebat si Bildad a Suhita, tan inkuan to,
¿Kaunongan kabayag so panganop yo ed saray salita? Isipen yo, tan insan mansalita itayo.
¿Akin et nibilang kami a singa saray munanakap, tan magmaliw kami ya ag malinis ed pakanengneng yo?
Sika a pignisen mo so inkasika ed sanok mo, ¿say dalin nikaindan kasi lapu ed sika? o ¿say bato naalis kasi ed pasen to?
On, say silew na marelmeng naerep, tan say Hob na apuy to ag onliwawa.
Say liwawa sikato naani bilunget ed tolda to. Tan say tinkaw to ed tagey to naerep.
Saray kurang na bis keg to napatikey, tan say dili a simbawa to so mamaabeba ed sikato.
Ta nibantak ed sakey ya iket ed panamegley na saray dili a salisali to, tan manakar ed tapew na saray bateng.
Sakey a patit so mangerel ed sikato ed mokor, tan sakey a kalot so mangegna ed sikato.
Sakey a lubir so niyamot nipaakar ed sikato ed dalin, tan sakey a pasiklong nipaakar ed sikato ed dalan.
Saray makapakebiew sikato so taktakoten da ed balang diking tan manganop ed sikato ed saray mokor to.
Say biskeg to sikato naani narasan, tan say kairapan maparaan naani ed diking to.
Saray kagawaan na laman to naakmon ira, on, say pangoloan ya anak na patey akmonen to so saray kagawaan na laman to.
Sikato so nabagot ed tolda to a panmatalkan to; tan niyakar ed ari na saray makapakebiew.
Manayam dia ed tolda to so agto kien: say azufre nikayat ed panagayaman to.
Saray lamot to namagaan ed teksab, tan ed tagey say sanga to nabatang.
Say pakanodnonotan ed sikato natawtaw ed dalin, tan andian na ngaran dia ed polong.
Niyakar manlapu ed liwawa anga ed kabilungetan, tan napatainan ed mundo.
Andian naani anak a laki o anak c laki na laki ed baley to, o bengatla a natilak ed panngilian to.
Saray ontombok ya onsabi nikelawan ira ed agew to, singa saray linma ya inmona ataktakot ira.
Petepeteg ya ontan so saray panaayaman na saray mapikewet, ta saya sikato so pasen ag mikabat ed Dios.
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
¿Kaunongan kabayag so pamaermen yo ed kamarerwak, tan patnuyak yo ed siak ed saray salita?
Saraya a samplo a danay binalaw yoak ag kayo binmaing a mamaunong ya anawawet ed siak.
Et no sikato so tua ya alingo ak, say lingok natilak ed inkasiak.
No tua a pabalegen yo so inkasikayo sumpa ed siak, tan isangsang yo sumpa ed siak to balaw ko;
Amtaen yo natan a say Dios, pinigar toak ed sengegan ko, tan nfliber toak ed liket to.
Nia, manakis ak nisengeg ed lingo, balet siak so ag denglen: ontawag ak na tulong, balet angapo so inkatunong.
Binakoran to so dalan ko pian agak makalabas, tan angipasen na kabilungetan ed saray dalan ko.
Nilakseban toak ed galang ko, tan inala to so balanget manlapu ed olok.
Ingeba toak ed balang diking, tan onla ak la: tan say ilalok binago' to a singa sakey a kiew.
Pinarlang to met so sanok to sumpa ed siak, tan inbilang toak ed sikato a singa sakey ed saray kasumlang to.
Saray sondalo to onsabi ra a bansag, tan dantalen da so dalan da sumpa ed siak, tan manpakalso ra ed liberliber na toldak.
Inyarawi to so saray agagik ed siak, tan saray kabkabat ko amin sinmananey ira ed siak.
Saray kanayon ko inmandi ra, tan saray kadilian ko a kaaro alingoanan da ak.
Saray manaayam ed abung ko, tan saray ugugaw ko a bibii, ibilang da ak a sakey a manngili: sakey ak a sankaili ed pakanengneng da.
Ontawg ak ed aripen ko, et ag toak ebatan, angan mankerew ak ed sikato ed sangik.
Say linawak sikato so sankaili ed asawak, tan say pikakasik ed saray anak na dili ya inak.
Angan saray anak ya ugugaw modmoraen da ak; no onalagey ak, man salita ra na sumpa ed siak.
Amin iray kadilian ko a kaaro gulaen da ak tan saray inarok pinma wil ira a sumpa ed siak.
Say pukel ko ompeket ed baog ko tan laman ko, tan akatainan ak pati say baog na saray ngipen ko.
Kasian yoak, kasian yoak, O sikayo kakaarok; ta say lima na Dios diniwit toak.
¿Akin et osilan yo ak a singa Dios, tan ag kayo napenek ed laman ko?
¡O komon ta saray salitak nisulat ira natan! ¡O komon ta nilugan ira ed sakey a libro!
¡Komon ta ed balatyang a pluma tan ismay nibolik ira ed bato ed ando Ian ando!
Balet nipaakar ed siak amtak a say Mananondon ko mabilay, tan dia ed kaunoran onalagey ed tapew na dalin:
Tan kayari na baog ko, salanti saya a laman nabagbag, sirin angan andi laman ko nanengneng ko so Dios;
A sikato, siak, siak lanti, nanengneng ko ed diking ko, tan saray matak nengnengen da, tan aliwa a singa sakey a sankaili. Say pusok naopot ed loob ko.
No kuan yo, Panon kasi pangosil mi ed sikato! Et say lamot na pamaakaran naromog ed siak;
Takotan yo so kampilan: ta say sanok yakar to so pananusa na kampilan, pian naamtaan yo ya wala so pangokom.
Diad saman inmebat si Zofar a Naamatita, tan inkuan to,
Kanian saray kanonotan ko ebatan da ak, lapu ni ed katunongan na pansiglat ko ya wala ed siak.
Nadngel ko so pamano a mangibabaing ed siak; et say espiritu na pakatalos ko ebatan toak.
¿Agmo ta amta so saya a daan a panaon, nanlapu nen say too nipasen ed tapew na dalin,
A say panpalabo na marelmeng sikato so antikey, tan say liket na andian na Dios nipaakar lambengat ed magangano?
Angan say katagey to ondandan ed saray tawen, tan say olo to onsabi ed saray lurem;
Manwari natawtaw ed ando Ian ando a singa say dili a dutak to: saray akanengneng ed sikato inkuan da, ¿Iner so kawalaan to?
Ontekiab a singa sakey a kugip, tan ag naromog: on, napabtik a singa sakey a pasingawey ed labi.
Say mata ya akanengneng ed sikato, sikato so agto la nanengneng; angan say pasen to sikato so agto la nanengneng.
Saray anak to anapen da so pamalangkap na duka, tan saray lima to ipawil da so kayarian to.
Saray pukel to napno ra ed inkabalon too to, balet sikato naani midokol ed sikato ed dabok.
Angan say marelmeng sikato so masamit ed sangi to, angan sikato so yamot to ed leksab na dila to,
Angan sikato so ipaliis to, tan agto paulian ya onla, no ag ingen sikato so yagel to a siansia ed loob na sangi to;
Angan ontan say kanen to dia ed saray banel to sikato so nauman. Sikato so apgo na saray tadioko ed dalem to.
Nanakmon na saray kayamanan, tan sikara so yuta to lamet; say Dios aguaten to ra ed eges to.
Supsupen to so samal na saray tadioko: sikato pateyen na dila na uleg a telek.
Agto onnengneng ed saray ilog, saray managagus a sobol a dilo tan mantekilla.
Say kinimeyan to ipáwil to, tan sikato so agto akmonen; unong ed kayarian ya inala to, ag manliket.
Ta pinasegsegang to tan inkaindan to so duka; ed pasootan inala to so sakey ya abung, tan sikato so agto ipaalagey.
Lapu ed agto naamtaan so kareenan ed dalem to, angapo so nilaban to a balot ed saman so nanliliketan to.
Angapo a balot so atilak ya agto inakmon; kanian say kaaliguasan to ag magnayon.
Dia ed inkapno na kasaragan to wala naani ed kaingetan: say lima na balang sakey ya wala ed kakabosan onla ed sikato.
Sano asinger a napano so eges to, say Dios inbantak to so kasebegan na sanok to ed tapew to, tan pauranen to ed tapew to leleg a mangakan.
Ombatik manlapu ed balatyang ya ayura, tan say bekang a gansa ontalos ed sikato.
Sikato so bagoten to, tan sikato so ompaway manlapu ed laman to; on, say masileng a ngoro ompaway ed apgo to; saray makapakebiew wala ra ed tapew to.
Amin a kabilungetan niyatol a nipaakar a kaykayamanan to: sakey ya apuy ya ag sinibokan na too so mangakmon ed sikato; naopot so atilak ed tolda to.
Saray tawen ipatnag da so inkarelmeng to, tan say dalin onalagey sumpa ed sikato.
Say munat na abung to ontainan; saray kayarian to nikalbo ra ed agew na sanok to.
Saya so betang na sakey a marelmeng a too a manlapu ed Dios, tan say tawir ya ingeter ed sikato na Dios.
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
Denglen yo a maseeseet so bitlak; et saya sikato kornon so kaligliwa ya.
ltepel yoak, tan mansalita ak met; et kayari pansalitak, ituloy yo so manludlurey.
Nipaakar ed siak, ¿say pantagleey ko nipaakar ta ed too? Et ¿akin ya agak komon aliwa a maanus?
Tandaan yoak, et nikelawan kayo, ta igaton yo so lima yo ed tapew na sangi yo.
Angan sano nonoten ko nagonigon ak, tan say kebiew benbenan to so laman ko.
¿Akin et manbilay so saray marelmeng, onmasiken ira, on, onkasil ira dia ed pakayari?
Say bini ra niletneg a pati sikara ed pakanengneng da, tan saray simit da ed arap na saray mata ra.
Saray abung da mareen ira a manlapu ed takot, angan say panaklay na Dios ag nitapew ed sikara.
Saray baka ra a kalakian manilalak ira, et ag ira onkulang; saray baka ra a kabatyan mananak ira, et ag naalis so kilaw da.
Ibaki ra so saray ankekelag da a singa polok, tan saray anak da onsayaw ira.
Manganta ra ed gandang tan harpa, tan manliket ira ed tanol na tulali.
Ikana ra so saray agew da ed kaaliguasan, tan dia ed kasanlilikna onlasor ira ed Sheol.
Et kuan da ed Dios, Ompikal ka a manlapu ed sikami; ta agmi panpilalekan so pakapikabat ed saray dalan mo.
¿Anto ta so Makapanyarinamin, pian manlinkor kami ed sikato? tan ¿anto so natobo mi, no mikasi kami ed sikato?
Nia, say kaaliguasan da angapo ed lima ra: say simbawa na marelmeng arawi ed siak.
¿Maminpiga ta a say tinkaw na marelmeng naerep? ¿Pian say kairapan da onsabi ed sikara? ¿Pian say Dios mangyotob na saray sinagem ed sanok to?
¿Pian sikara so singa dayami ed arap na dagem, tan singa taep a say bagyo ipalir to?
Kuan yo, Say Dios yatol to so karelmengan na ama a nipaakar ed saray anak to. Sikato so tumangan to komon ed inkasikato, pian sikato so naamtaan to:
Saray dili a mata to nengnengen da komon so kabagbag da, tan oninom komon ed sanok na Makapanyarinamin.
Ta ¿anto so panliketan to nipaakar ed abung to ed kayari to, sano say bilang na saray bulan to so napoltot?
¿Wala ta so siopa a mangibangat na kabat ed Dios, Anta okomen to so saray atagey?
Say sakey ompatey a napno na kabiskegan to, anta nagnap a maligen tan mareen:
Saray bobon to napno ra na gatas, tan say otek na saray pukel to sikato so ambasa.
Et say sananey ompatey ed kapaitan na kamarerwa, tan angan kapigan agto natawayan so maong.
Ondokol ira a nanpadpara ed dabok, tan sikara so sakbongan na bigis.
Nia, amtak so saray kanonotan yo, tan saray dumsis a pamauges yo ed siak.
Ta kuan yo, ¿Iner so kawalaan na abung na principe? Tan ¿iner so kawalaan na tolda a panaayaman na marelmeng?
¿Ag kayo ta tinmepet ed saray manakarakar a totoo? Tan ¿agyo ta amta so saray panangipatnag da,
A say mauges a too sikato so intalaga ed agew na kairapan? ¿A niyakar ira ed agew na sanok?
¿Siopa sa mangipaliwawa na dalan to ed lupa to? Tan ¿siopa so manumang ed sikato ed anto a ginawa to?
Angan ontan niyakar ed lubok, tan saray totoo manbantay ira ed tagey na lubok.
Saray bingkol na lawak másamit ira ed sikato, tan amin a totoo ontombok ira ed sikato, singa wala so ag nabilang ed arap to.
¿Panon sirin a ligliwaen yoak ed kaapaan, anta dia ed saray ebat yo salambengat a natilak so inkatila?
Diad saman inmebat si Elifaz a Temanita, tan inkuan to,
¿Nayarian ta na sakey a too a sikato so tobo ed Dios? Petepeteg a say makabat sikato so tobo ed inkasikato.
¿Sikato ta so makapaliket ed Makapanyarinamin, a sika so matunong? O ¿sikato ta so gunguna ed sikato, a sika gawaen mo so saray dalan mo ya ayadyari?
¿Sikato ta so nipaakar ed takot mo ed sikato a banoen to ka, pian miloob ed sika ed panangokoman?
¿Aliwa ta a baleg so inkarelmeng mo? ¿Angapo ta so bengatla ya angaan ed saray karelmengan mo?
Ta angala ka na sansanla ed agim nipaakar ed angapo, tan nilakseban mo so saray lakseb ed saray kawes da.
Agka angiter na danum ed naksawan pian oninom, tan inabalam so tinapay ed narasan.
Balet nipaakar ed makapanyari a too, wala nen saman ed sikato so dalin; tan say magalang a too, manayam ed sikato.
Inbakim so saray balo a bibii a paoypaoy, tan saray taklay na saray olila apiley ira.
Kanian saray kalot niliber ed sika, tan say kasanlilikna a takot gonigonen to ka,
O say kabilungetan, dia ed ontan ya agka makanengneng, tan daakan a danudanum sakbongan da ka.
¿Andi ta so Dios ed tagey na tawen? Tan nengnengen mo so katagey na saray bitewen, ¡panon la so katagey da!
Et kuan mo, ¿Anto so kabat na Dios? ¿Nayarian to so mangokom ed pegley na makapal a bilunget?
Saray makapal a lurem onsasakbong ira ed sikato, dia ed ontan ya ag makanengneng; tan manakar ed buklir na tawen.
¿Labay mo ta a tontonen so daan a dalan a saray marelmeng a totoo ginatinan da?
A sikara so nasamsam ed arapen na panaon da, a say panangipaletnegan da nikalbo a singa sakey ya agos,
Ya inkuan da ed Dios; Ompikal ka manlapu ed sikami; tan, ¿Anto so nagawa na Makapanyarinamin nipaakar ed sikami?
Angan ontan pinano to so saray abung da ed saray maong a bengabengatla: balet say simbawa na marelmeng sikato so arawi a manlapu ed siak.
Sikato so nengnengen na saray matunong, et mangayaga ra; tan say maalas elekan to ra a balawen,
A kuan to, Petepeteg a saray inmalagey sumpa ed sikami napegpeg ira, tan say kera ed sikara inopot na apuy.
Pikaarom natan so inkasika ed sikato, tan mandeen ka: lapu ed satan say maong onsabi ed sika.
Awat mo, pikasik ed sika, so tunong a manlapu ed sangi to, tan isimpen mo so saray salita to ed pusom.
No ompawil ka ed Makapanyarinamin, sika so nipaalagey, no iwaklit mo so inkapikewet ed arawi ed saray toldam.
Et igaton mo so kayamanan mo ed dabok, tan say balitok na Ofir ed nanleleetan na saray bato na kolokolos;
Et say Makapanyarinamin sikato naani kayamanan mo, tan mabli á pilak ed sika.
Ta saman la mangayaga ka ed Makapanyarinamin, tan itangay mo so lupam ed Dios.
Gawaen mo so pikakasim ed sikato, et denglen to ka; et bayaran mo so saray sipan mo.
Igeter mo met so sakey a bengatla, tan sikato so niletneg ed sika; tan say liwawa onsinag ed saray dalan mo.
Sano sika so yabeba ra, ikuan mo, Wala so pangitagey; et say mapaabeba a too ilaban to.
Ilaban to met so maalas: on, nilaban nisengeg ed inkalinis na saray limam.
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
Angan natan ya agew say pantagleey ko sikato so matunganga: say inkapaunong ko sikato so ambelbelat nen say paneyey ko.
¡O komon ta naamtaan ko no iner so pakaromogan ko ed sikato! ¿Komon ta makasabiak ni ed panyorongan to!
Ipasen ko so sengegan ko dia ed oksoy ed arap to, tan panoen ko sangik ed saray pisasangsang.
Amtak so saray salita a pangebat to ed siak, tan natalosan ko so ikuan to ed siak.
¿Misangsangan kasi ed siak dia ed kinabalgan na pakayari to? Andi; no ag ingen imatleken toak.
Diman say matunong nayarian to so mikatunongan ed sikato; dia ed ontan nilaban ak a manlapu ed kaokom to.
Nia, ontoloy ak, balet sikato andid' man; et ompawil ak, balet sikato so agko napatnagan;
Ed nikawigi a lima, sano mankimey, balet sikato so agko nanengneng; sikato onamot ed nikawanan a lima, pian sikato so agko nanengneng.
Balet amta to so dalan a laen ko; sano asali toak, ompaway ak a singa balitok.
Say salik tinmalikarkar ed saray bakat to; say dalan to inonor ko, tan agak sinmipa.
Agak binmeneg manlapu ed gangan na saray bibil to; pinablik so saray salita na sangi to a lalo nen say kaokolan ko a kanen.
Balet sikato wala ed sakey a nonot, et ¿siopa so makapangipataoli ed sikato? Et no anto so pilalek na kamarerwa to, satan lanlamang so gawaen to.
Ta sumpalen to so atoro nipaakar ed siak: tan dakel so ontan a bengabengatla ya wala ed sikato.
Kanian nakebiew ak ed arap to; sano isisipen ko, antakot ak ed sikato.
Ta say Dios ginawa to so pusok a maitatakot, tan say Makapanyarinamin pinakebiew toak;
Lapu ed agak apunaw ed arap na bilunget, agto met insakbong so makapal a bilunget ed lupak.
¿Akin ta et saray panaon ag ira inpasen na Makapanyarinamin? Tan ¿akin ta a saray mikabat ed sikato agda nengnengen so saray agew to?
Wala ra so mangyalis na ketegan na saray dalin; mansamsam ira na saray carnero, tan pakanen da ra.
Patainanen da so saray asno na saray ulila; alaen da so baka na balo a bii a panagkasanla.
Pasipaen da ed dalan so naokolan; say duka ed dalin amin onamot ira.
Nia, singa saray asno a maatap ed lawak ompaway ira ya onla ed gawa ra, a mananap a maseeseet na kanen; sikara so itdan na saray kalawakan na tinapay nipaakar ed saray anak da.
Palaspasen da so dika a tagano ra ed uma; tan dokdoken da so binorbor na marelmeng.
Ondokol ira a mansanlabi a lakseb ya andi kawes, tan andian ira na sakbong ed betel.
Nabasa' ra ed saray uran na saray palandey, tan lakapen da sa bato lapu ed kaandi salimbengan.
Wala ra so mansamsam na saray ulila manlapu ed saray pagew, tan mangala ra na sanla ed duka;
Dia ed ontan manakar ira a lakseb ya andi kawes, tan anta narasan ira awiten da so saray piningey.
Mangawa ra na larak ed dalem na saray bakor na saraya a totoo; igatin da so saray alakan da, et manlikna ra na paga.
Manlapu ed matoo a ciudad saray totoo maneyey ira, tan say kamarerwa na sugatan maningel: angan ontan say Dios agto ikabilangan so kaatiwan.
Saraya sikara so ontunganga sumpa ed liwawa; agda amta so saray dalan to, ag ira met manayam ed saray dalan to.
Say akapatey onalagey ed liwawa; pateyen to so duka tan naokolan; et dia ed labi sikato so singa matakew.
Say mata met na mikakalugoran alagden to so pansilunget, a kuan to, Angapo so mata a makanengneng ed siak: tan agto pabidbir so lupa to.
Dia ed bilunget kotkotan da so saray abung: kapotan da so inkasikara ed agew; agda amta so liwawa.
Ta say kabuasan sikato ed amin da so singa makapal a bilunget: ta amta ra so saray makapakebiew na makapal a bilunget.
Marias ya onlabas ira ed tapew na saray danum; say betang da naayew ed dalin: ag ira onsipa ya onla ed dalan na saray uvasan.
Say tiagew tan petang opoten da so saray danum na nieve: ontan so gawaen na Sheol ed saraman so nankasalanan.
Sikato naani lingoanan na eges; say bigis mangan naani a masamsamit ed sikato, sikato so ag la nanonotan; tan say karélmengan naputer naani a singa kiew.
Akmonen to so lepes ya ag mananak, tan ag mangawa na maong ed balo a bii.
Angan ontan say Dios pansiansiaen to so makapanyari ed panamegley na pakayari to: paalageyen to so andi katalkan ed bilay.
Say Dios iter to ra pian manayam ira ed katalkan, tan manpainawarad' man: et saray mata to wala ra ed tapew na saray dalan da.
Nipaatagey ira; angan ontan ed magangano, imanla ra; on, napaabeba ra, naekal ira ed dalan a singa ed saray amin ya aruarum, tan napegpeg ira a singa saray ngoro na saray dawa na trigo.
No aliwa ya ontan natan, ¿siopa so mangipatnag ed siak a matila, tan gawaen to so bitlak ya andi kakanaan?
Diad saman inmebat si Bildad a Suhita, tan inkuan to,
Pakauley tan takot wala ra ed sikato; gawaen to so deen dia ed saray atagey a pasen to.
¿Wala ta so bengatla a bilang na saray inayuraan to? Tan ¿ed tapew na siopa so ag alageyan na liwawa to?
¿Panon sirin so pakayari na too a mitunong ed Dios? odino ¿panon so pakayari to a malinis so nianak ed bii?
Nia, angan say bulan andian na sinag, tan saray bitewen sikara so ag malinis ed pakanengneng to:
¿Ag nagkalalo so too, a sikat'ó so bigis! Tan ¿say anak na too, a sikato so bigis?
Diad saman si Job inmebat tan inkuan to,
¡Agay la so intulong mo ed saman so andian na pakayari! ¡Agay la so inpangilaban mo ed taklay ya andian na kasil?
¡Agay la so inpanimbawam ed saman so andian na kakabatan, tan agay la so inkaskey na pakatalos ya inpaliwawam!
¿Siopa ta so angibitlaan mo na saray salita? Tan ¿siopa so akanespiritu na pinmaway a manlapu ed sika?
Saray inatey ongiwgiw ira ed leksab na saray danum tan saray manaayam to.
Say Sheol sikato so lakseb ed arap na Dios, tan say Abaddon andian na sakbong.
Ipanat to so amianen ed tapew na paoypaoy a leet, tan ibitin to so dalin ed tapew na angapo.
Bedberan to so saray danum ed saray makapal a lurem to; et say lurem ag napilat ed leksab da.
Kaputan to so lupa na trono to, tan ibuskag to so lurem to ed tapew to.
Ingulis to so ketegan ed tapew na. lupa na saray danum, anga ed saray kasampotan na liwawa tan bilunget.
Saray seklang na tawen mangiwgiw tan nikelawan ira ed pangibano to.
Pakabiewen to so dayat ed pakayari to, tan lapu ed pakatalos to kabilen to so Rahab.
Lapu ed Espiritu to saray tawen napalimgas ira; say lima to tinalos to so masiglat ya uleg.
Nia, saraya sikara lambengat so kabiangan a mapaway na saray dalan to: et ¡agay la kamelag so esaes a narengel tayo ed sikato! Balet ¿say karol na pakayari to siopa so makatalos?
Et si Job intuloy to so alimbawa to, tan inkuan to,
Unong a say Dios mabilay, a sikato so angekal na katunongan ko, tan say Makapanyarinamin, a sikato so amairap ed kamarerwak
(Ta say bilay ko wala ni ya amin ed siak, tan say espiritu na Dios wala ed saray eleng ko);
Petepeteg a saray bibil ko ag ira mansalita na ag matunong, angan say dilak ag mangibalikas na tila.
Arawi komon ed siak so pamatunong ko ed sikayo; anga ed ompatey ak agko ekalen so inkaskey ko a manlapu ed siak.
Say inkatunong ko benbenan ko, tan agko paolian ya onla: say pusok ag toak pooten leleg a manbilay ak.
Say kabusol ko sikato komon so singa marelmeng, tan say onalagey sumpa ed siak sikato komon so singa ag matunong.
Ta ¿anto so ilalo na andian na Dios, angan makarapat na tobo, sano say Dios alaen to so kamarerwa to?
¿Denglen kasi Dios so eyey to, sano say gonigon onsabi ed sikato?
¿Mankaliket kasi ed Makapanyarinamin, tan ontawag ed Dios ed saray amin a panaon?
Ibanga' ta kayo nipaakar ed lima na Dios; say wala ed Makapanyarinamin agko yamot.
Nia, amin yo lanlamang sikato so anengneng yo; ¿akin sirin a magmaliw kayo ya aminpinsan a maapa?
Saya sikato so betang na marelmeng a too ed Dios, tan say tawir na saray manangapos, ya awaten da a manlapu ed Makapanyarinamin:
No saray anak to ondakel, sikato so nipaakar ed kampilan; et saray simit to ag ira napenek ed tinapay.
Saraman so nakeraan ed sikato niponpon ed patey, tan saray balo ra a bibii ag ira mantagleey.
Angan ontan manbonton na pilak a singa dabok, tan mantadia na kawes a singa langa;
Sikato so itadia to, balet sikato so isolong na matunong, tan say maalas apagen to so pilak.
Ipaalagey to so abung to a singa say bokbok, tan singa say alolong a say managbantay gawaen to.
Ondokol a mayaman, balet ag nitipon ed saray ateng to; lukasan to so saray mata to, balet sikato so angapo la.
Sikato so aboten na saray makapakebiew a singa saray danum; sikato so ibalang na bagyo ed labi.
Sikato so ipalir na dagem na bukig, tan sikato so naandi; et sikato so panisen to manlapu ed pasen to.
Ta say Dios topaken to tan ag mamalabas: labay to komon so ombatik a manlapu ed lima to.
Saray totoo itampal da so saray lima ra ed sikato, tan sikato so sompitan da manlapu ed pasen to.
Petepeteg ya wala so minas na pilak, tan pasen nipaakar ed balitok a gogolan da.
Say balatyang naala ed dalin, tan say gam bang nabobo a manlapu ed bato.
Say too mangipasen na sampot ed bilunget, tan manosisa, anga ed kaarawyan a ketegan, saray bato na kabilungetan tan say makapal a bilunget.
Mangotkot na banawang ed arawi a manlapu ed panaayaman na totoo; nalingoanan da ed sali; ibitin da ed arawi manlapu ed totoo, amanbaybayes ira dia tan diman.
Nipaakar ed dalin, sikato so panlapuan na tinapay; tan ed leksab to, wala a singa nagmaliw ed apuy.
Saray bato to sikara so pasen na saray zafiro, tan sikato walaan na mokomok a balitok.
Satan a basbas angapo so manok ed tagey a managsamsam a mikabat, angan say mata na baga sikato so agto nanengneng:
Saray moan a munanakap sikato so agda agatinan, angan say masebeg a leon ag linmabas diman.
Inyan to so lima to ed tapew na anawawet a bato; pigaren to so saray palandey ed saray sengeg.
Mangotkot na saray banawang ed saray bato; tan say mata to nanengneng to so balang mabli a bengatla.
Tanggalen to so saray agos pian ag ira onagos; et say bengatla a niyamot ipaway to ed liwawa.
Balet ¿iner so pakaromogan ed kakabatan? Tan ¿iner so pasen na pakatalos?
Say too agto amta so bili to; ni say sikato ag naromog ed dalin na mabilay.
Say kalinsorong kuan to, Sikato so andi dia ed siak; tan say dayat kuan to, Sikato so angapo ed siak.
Sikato so ag narandan ed balitok, angan say pilak ag nasimbang nipaakar ed bili to.
Sikato so ag napetekan ed balitok na Ofir, ed saray mabli ya onix, odino say zafiro.
Say balitok tan salming ag makapipara ed sikato, sikato met so ag nisalat ed saray kagawaan a madalisay a balitok.
Angapo so pakatongtongan ed koral odino cristal: on, say bili na kakabatan sikato so labas nen saray rubi.
Say topacio na Etiopia ag makapipara ed sikato, ni say sikato ag napetekan ed dalisay a balitok.
¿Iner sirin so panlapuan na kakabatan? tan ¿iner so pasen na pakatalos?
Bangta sikato so niyamot a manlapu ed saray mata na amin a mabilay, tan ag nipabalaw ed saray manok ed saray tawen.
Say Kabagbag tan Patey kuan da, nadngel mi so sakey a tanol to ed saray layag mi.
Say Dios natalosan to so dalan to, tan amta to so pasen to.
Ta sikato napatnagan to so saray sampot na dalin, tan onnengneng ed leksab na amin a tawen;
Pian mangawa na simbangan nipaakar ed dagem: on, gineteran to so saray danum ed panamegley na sukat.
Sanen nangawa na geter nipaakar ed uran, tan sakey a dalan nipaakar ed kirmat na karol;
Diad saman sikato so ninengneng to, tan sikato so inpaliwawa to; sikato so inpasen to, on, tan sikato so inosisa to.
Tan ed too inkuan to, nia, say takot ed Dios, satan sikato so kakabatan; et say yarawi ed mauges sikato so pakatalos.
Et si Job intuloy to so alimbawa to, tan inkuan to,
¡O komon ta walaak a singa dia ed saray bulan nen inmuna, singa dia ed saray agew sanen say Dios binantayan toak;
Sanen say tinkaw to sinminag ed tapew na olok, tan ed panamegley na liwawa to nanakar ak ed kabilungetan;
Singa nen wala ak dia ed inkaloto na saray agew ko, sanen say pikakaaro na Dios wala ed tapew na toldak.
Sanen say Makapanyarinamin wala ni ed siak, tan saray ana' ko wala ra ed liberliber ko;
Sanen saray kundang ko naurasan ira ed mantekilla, tan say bato inkalbo to ed siak so saray kolos na larak?
Sanen pinmaway ak ed wangalan anga ed ciudad, sanen intadiak so yorongan ko ed polong,
Saray tobonbalo a lalaki anengneng da ak tan inmamot ira, tan saray mamasiken inmalagey tan tinmalindeg ira;
Saray principe pinokpokan da so panagsalita, tan inyan da so lima ra ed tapew na sangi ra;
Say voces na saray angkabli apareen, tan say dila ra pinmeket ed tawentawen na sangi ra.
Ta sanen say layag nadngel toak, saman la binendicionan toak; et sanen say mata anengneng toak tinasian toak:
Lapud' no in lab an ko so duka a naningel, say ulila met, ya andian na ontulong ed sikato.
Say bendicion na maparaan a natawtaw sinmabi ed siak; et inpancantak ed liket so puso na balo a bii.
Insolong ko so inkatunong, tan sikato kinawesan toak: say tunong ko sikato so singa sokbong tan diadem a.
Siak nen saman so saray mata ed bulag, tan siak nen saman so salisali ed piley.
Siak nen saman so ama ed naokolan, tan say pegdat to ya agko amta inosisak.
Tan binuyak ko so saray pangal na saray pikewet, tan binagot ko so samsam ed saray ngipen to.
Diad saman inkuan to, Ompatey ak dia ed obong ko, tan parakelen ko so saray agew ko a singa say buer:
Say lamot ko kinmamayat ed saray danum, tan say linaew onpelag a sanlabi ed tapew na sangak:
Say gayagak sikato so balo ed siak, tan say bekang ko napasimbalo ed limak.
Et siak saray totoo dinmengel ira, tan nanalagar ira, tan ag ira sinmalita nipaakar ed simbawak.
Kayari na saray salitak ag ira la nansalita; et say bitlak tinmedter ed sikara.
Et nanalagar ira nipaakar ed siak a singa nipaakar ed uran; et nilukasan da so sangi ra a maawang a singa nipaakar ed uran.
Inmimis ak ed sikara, sanen andian ira na panmatalek; et say liwawa na lupak agda inbantak.
Pinilik so dalan da, tan pinmasenak a singa manunaan, tan nanayam ak a singa ari ed inayuraan, singa sakey a manligliwa ed saray managogol.
Balet natan saray ugugaw nen say siak panelekan da ak, a saray ama ra dinimlak ya inpasen pati saray aso na karcarnerok.
On, say kasil na saray lima ra, ¿ed anto so pamanabangan da ed sika? Lalaki a kaderalan na aloto a taon.
Sikara so mabeng ed kaokolan tan eras; kabkaben da so amaga a dalin, dia ed kaingewan na inkabagbag tan kibalatar.
Bagoten da so kolet ed abay na saray kapasolan; et saray lamot na retama sikara so kanen da.
Sikara so pinaarawi manlapu ed pegley na totoo; onakis ira ed beneg da a singa ed beneg na matakew;
Dia ed ontan manayam ira ed makapataktakot a lawlawak, dia ed saray ongib na dalin tan batobato.
Dia ed saray kasopokan manengak ira: ed leksab na saray sabit mantitipon ira.
Sikara so anak na saray maatiw, on, anak ira na mabanday a totoo; abakbak ira manlapu ed dalin.
Et natan nagmaliw ak a canta ra, on, sakey ak a tagaomen ed sikara.
Kagula ra ak, onarawi ra ed siak, tan ag ira onpaliis ya onlopda ed lupak.
Ta nilukakan to so lubir to, tan pinairap toak; tan inbantak da so freno ed arap ko.
Ed nikawanan a limak onalagey so kabaniakaan; itolak da so saray salik, tan pataren da sumpa ed siak so saray dalan da ed panamagbag.
Deralen da so basbas ko, ipauna ra so kairapan ko, angan saray totoo ya andian na mananulong.
Singa ed maawang a butaw onsabi ra: dia ed pegley na bagbag ontolin ira ed tapew ko.
Saray makapakebiew nipawil ira ed siak; osilan da so dayew ko a singa dagem; et say kaaliguasan ko linmabas a singa lurem.
Et natan say kamarerwa ak naibong ed dalem ko; saray agew na panamairap inmegna ra ed siak.
Dia ed labi saray pukel ko nabotbotan ed siak, tan saray irap a mangkabkab ed siak ag ira manpainawa.
Lapu ed panamegley na baleg a biskeg na Dios say kawes ko nauman; potipotan toak a singa say beklew na aysing ko.
Inbantak toak ed dalem na pitek, et nagmaliw ak a singa dabok tan dapodapol.
Ontawag ak ed sika, ed agka onebat ed siak: Onalagey ak, et pakanengnengen moak.
Nagmaliw ka a maruksa ed siak; ed pakapanyari na limam osilan moak."
Itagey moak ed dagem, tan pakabayoen moak ed tapew to; et tunaw moak ed bagyo.
Ta amtak a yakar moak ed patey, tan ed abung ya atoro nipaakar ed amin a mabilay.
Manwari ¿ag ta yunat na sakey so lima ed kipasag to? odino ¿dia ed kairapan da lanti ontawag ira na tulong?
¿Agko ta ninangisan so wala ed kagogonigon? ¿Say kamarerwak agta inmermen nipaakar ed naokolan?
Sanen nananapak na maong, nen saman say mauges sinmabi; et sanen nanalagar ak na liwawa, sinmabi bilunget.
Say pusok agonigon, tan ag mandeen; saray agew na inkairirap sinmabi ed siak.
Yag-agogol ko ya andi banwa: Onalagey ak ed tip on, tan ontawag ak na tulong.
Sakey ak ya agi ed jackal, tan sakey a kaiba ed saray avestruz.
Say baog ko sikato so andeket, tan napelag a manlapu ed siak, tan saray pukel ko napoolan ira ed petang.
Kanian say harpak nagmaliw a panagogol, tan say tolalik nagmaliw a voces na saray mannangis.
Akisipan ak ed saray matak: ¿Panon sirin so inengneng ko ed sakey a virgen?
Ta ¿anto so betang a manlapu ed Dios ed tagey, tan say tawir a manlapu ed Makapanyarinamin ed tagey?
¿Aliwa ta a kairapan ed pikewet, tan kaderal ed saray managgawa na inkauges?
¿Agto ta nanengneng so saray dalan ko, tan bilangen so saray kurang ko?
No nanakar ak a sititila, tan say salik nansiglat a mamalingo
(Nasimbang ak komon ed sakey a simbangan, pian say Dios naamtaan to so inkaskey ko);
No say kurang ko sinmipa ed dalan, tan say pusok nanakar a unong ed saray matak, tan no angan anto a dumsis pinmeket ed saray limak:
Sirin paolián yoak a mantanem, tan paolian yo a sananey so mangan; on, paolian yo a say bunga na dalin ko nabagot.
No say pusok apalingo ed sakey a bii, Tan no nansaneb ak ed pinto na kaabay ko;
Sirin say asawak mangiling komon ed sananey, tan saray arum ondakmomora ed sikato.
Tan satan sikato so sakey a makababaing a kasalanan; on, sikato so sakey ya inkauges a dusaen na saray okom:
Ta sikato so sakey ya apuy a mangopot anga ed Kabagbag, tan bagoten to so amin a munat ko.
No minodmorak so pegdat na ugaw ko a laki no bii, sanen akisangsangan ira ed siak;
¿Anto sirin so gawaen ko sano say Dios onalagey? tan sano ondalaw, ¿anto so yebat ko ed sikato?
¿Aliwa ta a sikato so nangawa ed siak dia ed eges nen inak a nangawa ed sikato? Tan ¿aliwa ta a sakey so angereng ed sikatayo ed eges?
No pinokpokan ko so duka ed pilalek to, Odino saray mata na saray balo a bibii pinakapuy ko,
Odino kinan ko so tinapay ko a bokor, tan saray ulila ag ira angan ed sikato
(Andi, nanlapu ed inkaugaw ko binmaleg a pati siak a singa ed sakey ya ama, tan sikato so intonton ko manlapu ed eges nen inak);
No anengneng ko so angan siopa a natawtaw nipaakar ed kaandi kawes, odino saman so naokolan ya andian na panakbong;
No saray banel to agda ak binendicionan, tan no sikato so ag apapetang ed bago na saray carnerok;
No in tagey ko so limak sumpa ed saray ulila, lapud' no anengneng ko so tulong ko ed wangalan:
Sirin paolian yo a say abalak napelag a manlapu ed baliwawang, tan say taklay ko nabuyak a manlapu ed pukel.
Ta say kairapan a manlapu ed Dios sikato so sakey a makapakebiew ed siak, tan lapu ed kaatageyan to angapo so nagawaan ko.
No ginawak a say balitok so ilalok, tan inkuan ko ed dalisay a balitok, Sika so panmatalkan ko;
No nanliket ak lapud' no say kayarian ko sikato so baleg, tan lapu ed say limak akarandan na dakel;
No ninengneng ko so banwa sanen sikato so sinminag, odino say bulan a manakakar ed kasnagan,
Tan say pusok maamoamot ya apalingo tan say sangik inangoban to so limak:
Saya met sikato so sakey ya inkauges a dusaen na saray okom: ta pinaandik komon so Dios ya wala ed tagey.
No nanliket ak ed inkabagbag naningongot ed siak, odino pinaatagey ko so inkasiak sanen sikato so aromog na mauges
(On, agko intepel so sangik a nankasalan lapu ed pananap ed bilay to ed sakey ya ayew);
No saray totoo na toldak agda inkuan, ¿Siopa so makaromog na sakey ya ag napno ed laman to?
(Say akidaoes ag tinmonda ed polong; balet inlukas ko so saray pintok ed managakar);
No singa si Adam a sinakbongan ko so saray inpakaloksok, lapu ed inpangyamot ko na inkauges ko ed akualan ko,
Lapu ed tinmakot ak ed baleg a karaklan, tan say balaw na saray familia pinakebiew da ak, dia ed ontan agak inmesel, tan agak pinmaway ed pinto
¡O komon ta walaan ak na sakey ya ondengel ed siak. (Nia, wadia so tatak ko, say Makapanyarinamin ebatan toak komon) tan ¡komon ta walaan ak na dalem a sinulatan na kasumlangan ko!
Petepeteg sikato komon so awiten ko ed tapew na abalak; sikato komon so ibedber ko ed siak a singa sakey a balanget:
Ipaliwawak komon ed sikato so bilang na saray kurang ko; singa sakey a principe onla ak komon ed asinger' to.
No say dalin ko onakis sumpa ed siak, tan saray golis to mannangis ira a bansag;
No kinan ko so saray bunga to ya andi kuarta, odino. ginawak a saray makankien ed sikato nabalang da so bilay da:
Saray sabitan ontobo ra komon ed pasen na trigo, tan say zizana ed pasen na cebada. Saray salita nen Job anganga ra.
Dia ed ontan saraya a taloran lalaki tinmonda ra ya onebat ed Job, lapu ed sikato matunong dia ed saray dili a mata to.
Diad saman dinmalang so sanok nen Eliu ya anak a laki nen Barakel a Buzita, ed familia nen Ram: sumpa ed Job dinmalang so sanok to, lapu ed pinatunong to so inkasikato a magmaong nen say Dios.
Ontan met sumpa ed saray taloran kaaro to dinmalang so sanok to, lapu ed ag ira akaromog na ebat, tan angan ontan inpankasalanan da si Job.
Bang si Eliu nanalagar a misalita ed Job, lapu ed masiken ira nen sikato.
Et sanen si Eliu anengneng to ya angapo so ebat ed sangi na saraya a taloran lalaki, say sanok to dinmalang.
Et si Eliu ya anak a laki nen Barakel a Buzita inmebat tan inkuan to, siak ugawak, tan sikayo masikenkayo a toloy; kanian tinmonda ak, tan agak pinmangaya a mangipatnag ed sikayo na kaisipan ko.
Inkuan ko, Saray agew mansalita ra, tan say karaklan na saray taon ibangat da so kakabatan.
Balet wala so sakey ya espiritu dia ed too, tan say linawa na Makapanyarinamin itdan to ra na pakatalos.
Aliwa a saray ankabaleg so mangakabat, odino saray mamasiken so makatalos na katunongan.
Kanian inkuan ko, Denglenyoak; siak met ipatnag ko so kaisipan ko.
Nia, inalagar ko so saray salita yo, dinengel ko so saray pankatunongan yo, leleg ya osisaen yo no anto so kuan yo.
On, tinmalineng ak ed sikayo, tan, nia, angapo so akapatolok ed Job, odino akaebat ed saray salita to ed sikayo.
Manlikas kayo ompan kuan yo, akaromog kami kakabatan; say Dios so manalo komon ed sikato, ya aliwa a say too:
Ta agto inyarap so saray salita to sumpa ed siak; sikato met so agko ebatan ed saray bitla yo.
Atalagnaw ira, ag ira la onebat: andian ira na sakey a salita ya ikuan.
Et ¿manalagar ak kasi, lapu ed ag ira mansalita, lapu ed mandeen ira, tan ag ira la onebat?
Siak met yebat ko so betang ko, siak met ipatnag ko so kaisipan ko.
Tan napnoak ed saray salita; say espiritu ed dalem ko pilitan toak.
Nia, say pagew ko sikato sakey ya alak ya andian na sengawan; singa saray balo a birong na alak sikato so maparaan ya onterak.
Mansalita ak, pian napalemewan ak; beswaten ko so saray bibil ko tan onebat ak.
Yaboloy yo ed siak, pikasik ed sikayo, ya agko labien so inkatoo na angan siopa; agko met iter so saray pamarayew a pangaran ed angan siopa.
Ta agko amta so mangiter na saray pamarayew a pangaran; ta no andi say Akan-gawa ed siak magangano ya ekalen toak.
Angan ontan, Job, pikasik ed sika, denglen mo so bitlak, tan denglen mo so saray amin a salitak.
Nia natan, nilukasan ko so sangik; say dilak nansalita dia ed sangik.
Saray salitak bitlaen da so inkatunong na pusok; tan say amta na saray bibil ko salitaen to a petepeteg.
Say Espiritu na Dios ginawa toak, tan say linawa na Makapanyarinamin initdan toak a bilay.
No nayarián mo, ebatan moak; oksoyen mo so saray salitam ed arap ko, onarap ka.
Nia, onarap ak ed Dios a singa met sika: siak met agawa ak ed dalin.
Nia, say kakebiewan ko agto ka taktakoten, angan say pangidetdet ko ag naani ambelat ed sika.
Petepeteg a nansalita ka ed pakadngel ko, tan nadngel ko so voces na saray salitam, a kuan da,
Malinis ak, ya andian na inpakalokso; maalas ak, angapo so kaugsan ed siak;
Nia, mananap na saray sengegan a sumpa ed sika, ibilang toak a panagkakabusol to;
Yan to so saray salik ed saray pangaw, tandaan to so saray amin a kurang ko.
Nia, ebatan taka, dia ed saya aliwa ka a matunong; ta say Dios babaleg nen say too.
¿Akin et misumlangan a sumpa ed sikato, lapu ed agto ipakabat so angan anto ed saray pegdat to?
Ta say Dios mansalita ed maminsan, odino mamidua, angan say too agto imatleken.
Dia ed sakey a kogip, dia ed sakey a pasingawey ed labi, sano maitlek ya ogip so napelag ed saray totoo, dia ed pakakaogip ed tapew na dokolan;
Saman to la lukasan so saray layag na saray totoo, tan tatakan to so panangibangat da,
Pian ekalen to so too a manlapu ed kanonotan to, tan yamo' to so pasirayew a manlapu ed too;
Benbenan to so kamarerwa to manlapu ed kalinsorong, tan say bilay to manlapu ed katawtaw ed panamegley na kampilan.
Sikato met nadusa et irap ed tapew na dokolan to, tan ed naynay a kolkol ed saray pukel to;
Dia ed ontan say bilay to kagula to so tinapay, tan say kamarerwa to so masamit a kanen.
Say laman to natunaw, ya ag la nanengneng; tan saray pukel to ya ag ira anengneng ya onbutay.
On, say kamarerwa to onasinger ed kalinsorong, tan say bilay to ed saray managbagbag.
No wala ed sikato so sakey ya angel, sakey a manangipatalos, sakey ed sanlibo, a mangipatnag ed too no anto so matunong nipaakar ed sikato;
Diad ontan say Dios mapangasi ed sikato, tan kuan to, sikato so ilaban mo a manlapu ed ilasor to ed kalinsorong, akaromog ak na karondon.
Say laman to sikato naani tadtariwa nen say laman na ugaw; sikato ompawil ed saray agew na kaugawan to.
Sikato manpikasi ed Dios, tan sikato so mapalabo ed sikato, dia ed ontan nanengneng to so lupa to a malikeliket: tan ipawil to ed too so inkatunong to.
Sikato mancanta ed arap na totoo, tan kuan to, nankasalanan ak, tan dineral ko so matunong, tan ag toak impinabang:
Dinondon to so kamarerwak a manlapu ed iloob ed kalinsorong, tan say bilay ko nanengneng to naani liwawa.
Nia, amin iraya a bengatla gawaen na Dios, mamidua, on mamitlo, ed too,
Pian ipawil to so kamarerwa to a manlapu ed kalinsorong, pian naliwawaan ed liwawa na mabilay.
Tandaan mo a maong, O Job, denglen moak: mandeen ka, tan mansalita ak.
No walaan ka na bengatla ya salitaen, ebatan moak: mansalita ka, ta pilale' ko a patunongen ta ka.
No andi, denglen moak: mandeen ka, tan ibangat taka na kakabatan.
Laot ni si Eliu inmebat tan inkuan to,
Denglen yo so saray salitak, sikayo makabat a totoo; tan talinengen yoak, sikayo ya walaan na pakatalos.
Ta say layag salien to so saray salita, singa say tawentawen tawayanto so kanen.
Pilien tayo komon nipaakar ed sikatayo so matunong: amtaen tayo komon ed inkasikatayo no anto so maong.
Ta si Job inkuan to, Siak matunong ak, et say Dios inekal to so katunongan ko:
Angan ontan a matunong ak nibilang ak a siak matila ak; say sugat ko sikato so ag natambal, angan andian ak na inpakalokso.
¿Anto a too so singa si Job, ya oninom na panlodlorey a singa danum,
A mila ed olop na saray managgawa na inkauges, tan miolop ed saray marelmeng a totoo?
Ta inkuan to, angapo so natobo na sakey a too a miliket so inaksikato ed Dios.
Kanian denglen yoak, sikayo totoo a makatalos: arawi ed Dios, a sikato mangawa na karelmengan, tan ed Makapanyarinamin, a mangawa na inkauges.
Ta say gawa na too bayaran to ed sikato, tan gawaen to a balang too makaromog unong ed saray dalan to.
On, ed katuaan, say Dios ag mangawa a marelmeng, angan say Makapanyarinamin agto deralen so inkatunong.
¿Siopa so angiter ed sikato na betang ed tapew na dalin? Odino? siopa so angimaton ed sansinakuban?
No inpasen to so puso to ed tapew na inkasikato, no tiponen to ed inkasikato so espiritu to tan say linawa to;
Amin a laman natawtaw a bansag, tan say too magmaliw a sapok.
No natan walaan ka na pakatalos, denglen mo so saya: denglen mo so voces na saray salitak.
¿Say sakey a kagula to so inkatunong manuley kasi? Tan dusaen mo so matunong tan makapanyari?
¿Kanepegan ta ya ikuan ed sakey ya ari, Sika mabanday ka, Odino ¿ed saray angkabli, Sikayo marelmeng kayo?
¿Ag lalo ya andi ed saman so agto labien so saray inkatoo na saray principe, odino agto imatleken so mayaman a lalo nen say duka? Ta sikara ya amin sikara so gawa na saray lima to.
Dia ed magangano ompatey ira, angan ed pegley labi; say katooan mangiwgiw ira tan onlabas ira, tan saray makapanyari naekal ira ya andi lima.
Ta saray mata to wala ra ed saray dalan na too, tan sankanengneng to so amin a kakaakar to.
Angapo so bilunget, odino anino na patey, a saray managgawa na inkauges napangyamotan da na inkasikara.
Ta agto kaokolan ni ya isipen so too, pian onla ed arap na Dios ed pangokom.
Buyaken to so saray makapanyari a totoo ed saray dalan ya ag naromog, tan mangipasen na saray arum ed pasen da.
Kanian mangala na pikakabat ed saray gawa ra; et pigaren to ra ed labi, dia ed ontan a nabagbag ira.
Kabilen to ra a singa saray marelmeng a totoo dia ed mapalaway a pakanengneng na saray arum;
Lapu ed sinmipa ra manlapu ed itotombok ed sikato, tan agdainimatlek ed angan anto ed saray dalan da;
Dia ed ontan ginawa ra a say akis na duka onsabi ed sikato, et nadngel to so akis na saray pinasegsegang.
No mangiter na kareenan ¿siopa sirin so makapanusa? Et sano yamo' to so lupa to, ¿siopa sirin so makanengneng ed sikato? Nanpadpara no nagawa ed nacion, odino ed too:
Pian say andian na Dios a too ag man-ari, pian angapo so mamatit ed katooan.
¿Ta wala ta so nankuan ed Dios, intepel ko so pananusa, agak mamaunong la:
Say agko nanengneng ibangat mo ed siak: no nangawaak na inkauges, sikato so agko la gawaen?
¿Say tumang to sikato kasi singa say labay mo, pian sikato so agmo akoen? Ta sika so manpili, tan aliwa a siak: kanian sirin salitaen mo no anto so an tarn.
Saray totoo a walaay pakatalos ikuan da ed siak, on, balang makabat a too ya ondengel ed siak:
Si Job mansalita ya andian na pakatalos, tan saray salita to sikara so andian na kakabatan.
Komon ta si Job nasali ya anga ed kasumpalan, lapu ed say kakaebat to singa saray marelmeng a totoo.
Ta mangyarum na itunganga ed kasalanan to; sikato pantipaken to so saray lima to ed sikatayo, tan parakelen to so saray salita to sumpa ed Dios.
Laot ni si Eliu inmebat tan inkuan to,
¿Nonoten mo ta a saya sikato so tunong mo, odino kuan mo, say inkatunong ko sikato so lalo nen say inkatunong na Dios,
Ta pian kuan mo, ¿Anto so nabang ya wala naani ed sika? Tan ¿Anto so tobok naani, a lalo nen say inpankasalanan ko?
Onebatak ed siak, tan saray kaibam pati sika.
Imatonan mo so saray tawen, tan nengnengen mo; tan muriaen mo so saray nanleleetan ed tagey, a sikara so atagey nen sika.
No nankasalanan ka, ¿anto so pabutayen mo sumpa ed sikato? Et no saray pakaloksom naparakel ira, ¿anto so gawaen mo ed sikato?
No matunong ka, ¿anto so iter mo ed sikato? Odino ¿anto so awaten to ed limam?
Say karelmengan mo makaderal ed sakey a too a singa sika; et say inkatunong mo pinabangen to so sakey ya anak na too.
Lapu ed karakel na saray panangapos onakis ira; onakis ira nipaakar ed tulong lapu ed taklay na makapanyari.
Balet angapo so mankuan, ¿Iner so kawalaan na Dios ya Akangawa ed siak, a mangiter na kancanta ed labi,
A mangibangat ed sikatayo a lalo nen saray munanakap ed dalin, tan gawaen to itayo a makabat nen saray manok ed saray tawen?
Diman onakis ira, balet angapo so onebat, lapu ed inkatagey na linawa na saray mauges a totoo.
Petepeteg a say Dios agto denglen so palawpaw ya akis, angan say Makapanyarinamin sikato so agto: matleken.
¿Ag lalo ya andi sano kuan mo ya agka onnengneng ed sikato, say kanonotan wala ed arap to, tan sikato so alagden mo!
Balet natan, lapu ed ag dinmalaw ed sanok to, sikato agto inimatlek a maomaong so inkapangas;
Kanian si Job nilukasan to so sangi to ed kaapaan; parakelen to so saray salita ya andi kakabatan.
Si Eliu met intuloy to, tan inkuan to,
Itepel moak na daiset, tan ipatnag ko ed sika; ta walaan ak ni melag ya ikuan nipaakar ed kigagaton na Dios.
Alaen ko naani so pakatalos ko manlapu ed arawi, tan igaton ko so inkatunong ed akangawa ed siak.
Ta petepeteg a saray salitak aliwa ra a tila: sakey ya ayadyari dia ed pikakabat sikato so wala ed sika.
Nia, say Dios sikato so makapanyari, tan agto modmoraen so angan siopa: sikato makapanyari ed biskeg na pakatalos.
Sikato agto pansiansiaen so bilay na marelmeng, no ag ingen iter to ed pinairap so matunong da.
Sikato agto isian so saray mata to manlapu ed matunong: balet pati ar-ari ed tapew na yorongan sikato ipasen to ra lawas, tan sikara napaatagey ira.
Tan no nabalor ira komon dia ed saray golonggolong, tan naala ed saray lubir na kairapan;
Sirin ipatnag to ed sikara so gawa ra, tan saray inpakalokso ra, nen nanagamil ira a malangalangas.
Sikato met lukasan to so layag da ed panangibangat, tan mangangan ya ompawil ira a manlapu ed inkauges.
No ondengel tan manlinkor ira ed sikato, opoten da so saray agew da ed kaaliguasan, tan saray taon da ed kagayagaan.
Balet no ag ira ondengel, natawtaw ira ed panamegley na kampilan, tan ompatey ira ya andian na pikakabat.
Balet saray andian na Dios dia ed puso mantipon ira na sanok: ag ira onakis nipaakar ed tulong sano baloren to ra.
Ompatey ira ed kaugawan, tan say bilay da natawtaw ed pegley na marutak.
Ilaban to so saray pinairap ed kairapan da, tan lukasan to so layag da ed panangapos.
On, koyongen to ka a manlapu ed kaermenan anga ed mapalaway a pasen, diman angapo so kaingetan; et say nipasen ed dulang mo napano na katabaan.
Balet napno ka ed pangokom ed marelmeng: pangokom tan inkatunong sika so binenbenan da.
Say sanok agto ka komon teniegen sumpa ed saray panusa; angan say kinabalgan na dondon agto ka isipa.
¿Say akis mo makapinabang kasi, pian sika komon so andi ed kairapan, odino saray amin a biskeg na kasil mo?
Agmo panpilalekan so labi, sano saray katooan napegpeg ira ed pasen da.
Manlikas ka, ag mo imatleken so inkauges; ta saya pinilim a lalo nen say kairapan.
Nia, say Dios mangawa ya atagtagey ed pakayari to: ¿Siopa so managbangat a mipara ed sikato?
¿Siopa so mangiparaan ed sikato na dalan to? Odino ¿Siopa so makapangikuan, sika nangawa ka na inkapikewet?
Nonoten mo a pinategey mo so gawa to, a sikato so nancantaan na saray totoo.
Amin á totoo ninmengneng irad' man; say too onimaton ed sikato ed arawi.
Nia, say Dios sikato so baleg, tan sikato so ag tayo amta; say bilang na saray taon to sikato so ag naosisa.
Ta ibontatok to so saray terter na danum, ya onimey ed uran a manlapu ed alingasew to.
Ya ikalbo na saray nanleleetan ed tagey tan iterter da ed too ed daakan.
On, ¿wala ta so makatalos ed ikayat na saray lurem, saray pankarol na kabongbong to?
Nia, ikayat to so liwawa ra ed liberliber to; et sakbongan to so dalem na dayat.
Ta ed panamegley na saya okomen to so saray baley; sikato mangiter na kanen a daakan.
Sakbongan to so saray lima to ed kirmat, tan sikato so bilinen to pian sikato so onkena ed tanda.
Say anieweng to ibaga to so nipaakar ed sikato. Say ayep met nipaakar ed bagyo ya onabi.
On, ed saya say pusok mangiwgiw, tan naalis a manlapu ed pasen to.
Denglen mo, O, denglen mo so anieweng na voces to, tan say tanol ya ompaway ed sangi to.
