Say kakabatan na masimpit sikato so pakatalos ed dalan to; balet say inkaatiw na saray maatiw sikato so lingo.
Say bagat ed inpakalokso modmoraen na saray maatiw; balet ed saray maptek wala so maong a linawa.
Say puso amta to so inkapai to a dili; et say sankaili ag mibiang ed liket to.
Say abung na marelmeng nabaliktar; balet say tolda na maptek manaligwas.
Wala so dalan a singa maptek ed too; balet say sampot to saray dalan na patey.
Angan dia ed panelek say puso sikato so maerermen; et say sampot na gayaga sikato so kaermenan.
Say manangibeneg ed puso napano ed saray dili a dalan to; et say maong a too napesel a manlapu ed inkasikato.
Say karaklan manisia ed balang salita; balet say masimpit a too nengnengen to a maong so laen to.
Say makabat a too antakot, tan onarawi ed mauges; balet say maatiw ompatnag a marangal, tan sikato so matalek.
Say magangano a manpasnok managamil a maatatiw; et say too a marelmeng so nodnonoten to sikato so kagula.
Say karaklan tawiren to so kaatiwan; balet saray masimpit nabalangetan ira ed pikakabat.
Say mauges ontuek ed arap na maong; et say marelmeng, ed saray wangalan na saray maptek.
Say duka sikato so kagula ni na saray dili a kaabay to; balet say mayaman walaan na dakel a kakaaro.
Say manmodmora ed kaabay to mankasalanan; balet say walaan na panangasi ed duka, sikato so mapalar.
¿Ag ira ta nalingo so saray mannonot na mauges? Balet say panangasi tan tua nipaakar ed saray mannonot na maong.
Dia ed amin a kimey wala so nabang; balet say salsalita na saray bibil arap lambengat ed kadukaan.
Say balanget na saray makabat sikato so kaykayamanan da; balet say inkaatiw na saray maatiw sikato lambengat so inkaatiw.
Say matua a tasi mangilaban na saray kamarerwa; balet say manbitla na tilatila mamalingo.
Dia ed takot ed Katawan wala so mabiskeg a panmatalek; et saray anak to nawalaan ira na pasen na painawa.
Say takot ed Katawan sikato so sobol na bilay, pian say sakey makaarawi ed saray kalot na patey.
Dia ed karaklan na baley wala so gayaga na ari; balet dia ed kaokolan na baley wala so kabagbag na principe.
Say matantan a manpasnok baleg so pakatalos to; balet say maigagano ya espiritu paatageyen to so inkaatiw.
Say mareen a puso sikato so bilay na laman; balet say siblet sikato so inkabolok na saray pukel.
Say mangapos ed duka modmoraen to so Manamalsa to; balet say walaan na panangasi ed makaokolan sikato so idayew to.
Say marelmeng nipelag ed mauges a gawa to; balet say maptek walaan na salimbeng ed patey to.
Say kakabatan mansiansia ed puso na walaan na pakatalos; balet say wala ed kaaralman na saray maatiw nipakabat.
Say inkatunong paatageyen to so nacion; balet say kasalanan sikato so kabalawan ed angan siopa a baley.
Say pamalangkap na ari sikato so dapit ed aripen a managamil a makabkabat; balet say sanok to sikato naani sumpa ed makapabaing.
Say mabannayar ya ebat ipaliis to so sanok; balet say masagapsap a salita patoloen to so sanok.
Say dila na makabat bitlaen to so pikakabat a maptek, balet say sangi na saray maatiw mangibung na kaatiwan
Saray mata nen Katawan wala ed balang pasen, a manbabantay ed mauges tan maong.
Say masimpit a dila sikato so sakey a kiew na bilay; balet say inkarumsis ed sikato sakey a betag na espiritu.
Say maatiw modmoraen to so panangibangat na ama to; balet say mangimatlek na panamaat makagamor na binta.
Dia ed abung na maptek wala so dakel a kayamanan; balet dia ed saray abung na marelmeng wala so gonigon.
Saray bibil na makabat mangikayat na pikakabat; balet say puso na maatiw agto gawaen so ontan.
Say bagat na marelmeng sikato so makapadimla ed Katawan; balet say pikakasi na maptek sikato so kalikliket to.
Say dalan na marelmeng sikato so sakey a makapadimla ed Katawan: balet sikato aroen to so ontombok ed inkatunong.
Wala so masakit a pamoot ed mangikaindan ed dalan; et say mangula ed panamaat ompatey.
Say Sheol tan Abaddon wala ra ed arap nen Katawan: ¡Ag nagkalalo sirin so saray puso na saray anak na to too!
Say managmodmora agto aroen so nabaat; ag onla ed saray makabat.
Say magayaga a puso paligsaen to so lupa; balet lapu ed ermen na puso say espiritu nabuyak.
Say puso na pakatalos anapen to so pikakabat; balet say sangi na saray maatiw mantagano ed inkaatiw.
Amin iray agew na masegsegang sikara so mauges; balet say magayaga so puso to walaan a naynay na liket.
Magmaong so melag, a tekep na takot ed Katawan, nen say baleg a kayamanan tan gonigon so katekep to.
Magmaong so pangogtoan ya agagayep, ya kawalaan na aro, nen say pinataba a baka tan kawalaan na gula.
Say maisasanok a too patoloen to so kolkol; balet say matantan a manpasnok papasen to so sangsangan.
Say dalan na mangiras sikato so singa alar a sabisabit; balet say basbas na maptek nagawa a polong.
Say makabat ya anak pagayagaen to so ama; balet say maatiw a too modmoraen to so ina to.
Say inkaatiw sikato so liket ed andian na kakabatan; balet say too a makatalos peteken to so panakar to.
Ed kaandian na simbawa, saray kanonotan nabagbag; balet dia ed karaklan na mananimbawa sikara so niletneg.
Say too walaan na liket ed ebat na sangi to; et say salita ed kanepegan to, ¡agay la so abig to!
Ed makabat say dalan na bilay mamatagey; pian makaarawi a manlapu ed Sheol ed leksab.
Si Katawan bagoten to so abung na mapangta; balet iletneg to so ketegan na balo a bii.
Saray mauges a kanonotan sikara so makapadimla ed Katawan; balet saray makapaliket a salita sikara so malinis.
Say maagum ed tobo gonigonen to so dili ya abung to; balet say mangula ed saray panoksok manbilay.
Say puso na maptek aralen to so onebat; balet say sangi na marelmeng manibong na mauges a bengabengatla.
Si Katawan arawi a manlapu ed marelmeng; balet denglen to so pikakasi na maptek.
Say liwawa na saray mata panliketen to so puso; et saray maong a balita patabaen da so saray pukel.
Say layag ya ondengel ed panamaat na bilay manayam ed saray makabat.
Say mangiwaklit na panangibangat modmoraen to so dili a kamarerwa to; balet say ondengel ed panamaat makagamor na pakatalos.
Say takot ed Katawan sikato so bangat na kakabatan; et say panagpaabeba unona ed dayew.
Saray kanonotan na puso betang na too; balet say ebat na dila sikato so manlapu ed Katawan.
Amin iray dalan na too sikara so malinis ed saray dili a mata to; balet si Katawan simbangen to so saray espiritu.
Jmatalek mo so saray kimey mo ed Katawan, et saray kanonotan mo niletneg ira.
Si Katawan ginawa to so amin a bengatla nipaakar ed dili a kasumpalan to; on, angan saray marelmeng nipaakar ed agew na mauges.
Balang sakey a mapangta ed puso sikato so makapadimla ed Katawan: angan say lima ompeket ed lima, sikato so aliwa ya ag nadusa.
Lapu ed panangasi tan tua say inkauges sikato so napaandi; et lapu ed takot ed Katawan saray totoo onarawi ra ed mauges.
Sano saray dalan na too kaliktan nen Katawan, pipaknaen to ed sikato so angan saray kabusol to.
Magmaong so melag, a tekep na inkatunong, nen saray belag ya abang a tekep na inkapikewet.
Say puso na too nonoten to sodalan to; balet si Katawan itonton to so saray kurang to.
Say maridios a geter wala ed saray bibil na ari; say sangi to ag onlokso ed pangokom.
Say maong a simbangan tan kakatian kien ira nen Katawan; amin iray simbang na sopot sikara so kimey to.
Makapadimla ed saray ar-ari so pangawa na inkarelmeng; ta say yorongan niletneg ed panamegley na inkatunong.
Saray maptek a bibil sikara so gayaga na saray ar-ari; et aroen da so mansalita na maptek.
Say sanok na ari sikato so singa saray pabaki na patey; balet say makabat a too sikato so pareenen to.
Dia ed liwawa na lupa na ari wala so bilay; et say pamalangkap to sikato so singa lurem na kaunoran ya uran.
¡Agay la so lalo ya abig to so makarandan na kakabatan nen say balitok! on, say panandan ed pakatalos sikato so magmaong a pilien nen say pilak.
Say polong na maptek sikato so yarawi a manlapu ed mauges: say mangunor ed dalan to pansiansiaen to so kamarerwa. to.
Say mapangta onla ed unaan na kabagbag, tan say mapasang ya espiritu ed unaan na kapelag.
Magmaong so mapaabeba ya espiritu ed duka, nen say piapag na samsam ed mapangta.
Say mangimatlek ed salita makaromog na maong; et say manmatalek ed Katawan, sikato so mapalar.
Say makabat ed puso natawag a masimpit; et say kasamitan na saray bibil munaten to so pakaaral.
Say pakatalos sikato so sobol na bilay ed kawalaan to; balet say panangibangat na saray maatiw sikato so inkaatiw da.
Say puso na makabat ibangat to so sangi to, tan mangyarum na pakaáral ed saray bibil to.
Saray makapaliket a salsalita sikara so singa kolaba na dilo, masamit ed kamarerwa, tan kasil ed saray pukel.
Wala so dalan a singa maptek ed too, balet say sampot to sikara so saray dalan na patey.
Say pakapangan na komikimey a too onkimey nipaakar ed sikato; ta say sangi to managdag ed sikato.
Say andi kakanaan a too mannonot na mauges; et dia ed saray bibil to wala so mandarlang ya apuy.
Say marumsis a too mangitayak na kolkol: et say matalabotob pasianen to so saray manuna a kakaaro.
Say too a masebeg natokso to so kaabay to, tan sikato so itoton to ed dalan ya aliwa a maong.
Say mangilikdem ed saray mata to, sikato so pannonot na marumsis a bengabengatla; say mamepet ed saray bibil to mangyakar ed mauges a nagawa.
Say ubanan ya olo sikato so balanget na gayaga; Naromog ed dalan na inkatunong.
Say matantan a manpasnok sikato so magmaong nen say makapanyari; et say manuley ed espiritu to, nen say mangala na ciudad.
Say kapalaran nibantak ed akualan; balet say simoon a kigeter to kien nen Katawan.
Magmaong so amagaan a sankakamot, et say kareenan so tekep to, nen say abung a napno na panliliket a tekep na kolkol.
Say aripen a managamil a makabat manuley ed anak a makapabaing. Tan niyapag éd tawir na sanaagi.
Say panaggogolan sikato so nipaakar ed pilak, tan say palbaan nipaakar ed balitok; balet si Katawan salien to so saray kapusoan.
Et say mangawa na mauges imatleken to so saray marelmeng a bibil, et say matila denglen to so mauges a dila.
Angan siopa a manludlurey ed duka modmoraen to so Manamalsa to; et say manliket ed kairapan aliwa ya ag nadusa.
Saray anak na saray anak sikara so balanget na saray mamasiken, et say gayaga na saray anak sikara so saray ama ra.
Say katageyan a bitla ag onnepeg ed maatiw; nagkalalo so saray matila a bibil ed principe.
Say panoksok sikato so singa mabli a bato ed saray mata na kawalaan to; angan iner a laen to sikato so onaligwas
Say manakbong na pakalokso anapen to so aro, balet say dadaolien to so sakey a kanonotan pasianen to so manunaan a kakaaro.
Say panimbawa onloob ya araldalem ed sakey ya walaan na pakatalos nen sanlasus a lewet ed maatiw.
Say mauges a too mananap lambengat na katungangaan, kanian say masulit ya igagangan nibaki ed sumpa ed sikato.
Say kabatyan ya oso ya atakewan ed saray kilaw to abeten to so too, a lalo nen say maatiw dia ed inkaatiw to.
Angan siopa ya itumang to so mauges ed maong, say mauges ag onarawi ed abung to.
Say igapu na kolkol sikato so singa sano say sakey bolosanto so danum kanian paulian mo so pikokolkol, ed unaan na ipetang na sangsangan.
Say mamatunong ed marelmeng tan say manusa ed maptek, nanpadpara a sikara so makapadimla ed Katawan.
¿Akin ya wala so bili dia ed lima na maatiw pian manaliw na kakabatan, anta andian na pakatalos?
Say kaaro mangaro ed saray amin a panaon, et say agi nianak nipaakar ed kasumlangan.
Say too ya andian na pakatalos ikabil to so saray lima, tan magmaliw a panagmatalkan ed arapan na kaabay to.
Aroen to so pakalokso so mangaro ed kolkol: say mangitandoro na atagey ya wangalan to anapen to so kabagbag.
Say walaan na abalang a puso ag makaromog na maong; ta say walaan na marumsis a dila napelag ed kaugsan.
Say manilalak na maatiw sikato so nagamoran to a panermenan to; et say ama na maatiw andian na liket.
Say magayaga a puso sikato so maong a tambal; balet say binmetag a puso pamagaen to so saray pukel.
Say marelmeng a too mangawat na panoksok manlapu ed akualan, pian paugesen to so saray dalan na inkatunong.
Say kakabatan wala ed arap na lupa na walaan na pakatalos; balet saray mata na maatiw wala ra ed sampot na dalin.
Say maatiw ya anak sikato so ermen ed ama to, tan kapaitan ed angianak ed sikato.
Ontan met say panusa ed maptek sikato so aliwa a maong, angan say pangabil ed saray angkabli lapu ed saray inkatunong da.
Say mamokpok ed saray salita to walaan na pikakabat; et say ambetel so espiritu to sikato so too a makatalos.
Angan say maatiw, sano benbenan to so deen to, nibilang a makabat; sano memeten to so saray bibilto, sikato so nibilang a masimpit.
Say onsian anapen to so dili a pilalek to, tan misangsangan sumpa ed amin ya aralem a kakabatan.
Say maatiw andian na liket ed pakatalos, no ag lambengat so pangipatnag to ed puso to.
Sano say marelmeng onsabi, onsabi met so balaw, tan katekep na kibabaing so panmodmora.
Saray salita na sangi na too sikara so singa aralem a danudanum; say sobol na kakabatan sikato so singa managus a kolos.
Say pangidayew ed inkatoo na marelmeng sikato so aliwan maong, angan say pamikewet ed tunong ed pangokom.
Saray bibil na maatiw onloob ira ed kolkol, tan say sangi to mankelyaw na saray lewet.
Say sangi na maatiw sikato so kabagbag to, tan saray bibil to sikara so kalot na kamarerwa to.
Saray salita na managtalobotob sikara so singa matamoy ya ikakamot, tan onlasor ira ed kaaralman a kabiangan na laman.
Ontan met say makapuy ed kimey to, sikato so agi na managbagbag.
Say ngaran nen Katawan sikato so mabiskeg ya ilang; say maptek ombatik ya onloob ed sikato, tan nilaban.
Say kayarian na mayaman a too sikato so mabiskeg a ciudad to, tan singa atagey a bakor ed dili a kaisipan to.
Arapen na kabagbag say puso na too sikato so mapasang; Et arapen na dayew onla so kaoyamoan.
Say mangiter na ebat ed arapen na idengel to, sikato so inkaatiw tan makapabaing ed sikato.
Say espiritu na too itepel to so kabeblayan to; balet say nabtag ya espiritu siopa so makakpel?
Say puso na masimpit makarandan na pikakabat; et say layag na makabat anapen to so pikakabat.
Say tokdol na too mangawa na silir nipaakar ed sikato, tan mangyakar ed sikato ed arap na baleg a totoo.
Say mangikatunongan na matunong to ya unona singa matunong; balet say kaabay to onsabi tan sikato so osisaen to.
Say panpapalaran pangangaen to so saray pankokolkol, tan mangapag ed saray makapanyari.
Say agi ya apaunong sikato so mamairap a patoloken nen say mabiskeg a ciudad; et saray ontan a pankokolkol sikara so singa saray balewet na Castillo.
Say eges na too napano ed bunga na sangi to; ed munat na saray bibil to sikato so napesel.
Say patey tan say bilay wala ra ed pakayari na dila; et saray mangaro ed sikato mangan ira ed bunga to.
Angan siopa a makaromog na asawa makaromog na maong a bengatla, tan makagamor na pamalangkap nen Katawan.
Say duka agamilen to so pakaskasi; balet say mayaman onebat a masagsagapsap.
Say too a mikakaaro sikato so gawaen to ed dili a kabagbag to; balet wala so kaaro a lalon maapit nen say agi.
Magmaong so duka a manakar ed inkaskey to nen say mauges ed saray bibil to tan sikato so maatiw.
Ontan met, a say kamarerwa ya andian na pikakabat sikato so aliwan maong; et say manganat ed saray sali to mankasalanan.
Say inkaatiw na too paugesen to so dalan to; et say pusoto onsanok a sumpa ed Katawan.
Say kayamanan mangyarum na dakel a kakaaro; balet say duka nisian a manlapu ed kaaro to.
Say matila a tasi sikato so aliwa ya ag nadusa; et say manbitla na saray tila ag makatainan.
Dakel so mankerew na pamalangkap na mapalabo a too; tan balang too sikato so caaro ed mangiter na saray tokdol.
Amin iray agagi na duka sikato so kagula ra: ¡Ag nagkalalo a saray kaaro to onarawi ra ed sikato? Sikara so tomboken to ed saray salita, balet imanla ra.
Say' makarandan na kakabatan aroen to so dili a kamarerwa to: say mangunor na pakatalos makaromog na maong.
Say matila a tasi sikato so aliwa ya ag nadusa; et say mangibesngaw na saray tila natawtaw.
Say matalaw a kabibilay ag matukoy nipaakar ed maatiw; nagkalalo a nipaakar ed aripen a panoleyan to so saray principe.
Say kalakal na too mangawa ed sikato so matantan a manpasnok; et gayaga to so pamalabas na pakalokso.
Say sanok na ari sikato so singa panengak na leon; balet say pamalangkap to sikato so singa linaew ed tapew na dikarika.
Say maatiw ya anak sikato so kairapan na ama to; et saray kolkol na asawa a bii sikara so naynay a panterter.
Say abung tan saray kayamanan sikara so tawir ed saray atateng; balet say masimpit ya asawa a bii sikato so manlapu ed Katawan.
Say kangirasan mangineknek ed maitlek ya ugip; et say mangiras a kamarerwa manlikna na eras.
Say mangunor ed gangan yagel to so kamarerwa to; balet say andian na panangasi ed saray dalan to ompatey.
Say walaan na panangasi ed duka pautangen to si Katawan, et say maong a gawato ipawil to ed sikato a bayaran.
Dusaen mo so anak mo, bangta wala so ilalo; tan agmo ipasen so pusom ed kabagbag to.
Say too a baleg so sanok to awiten to so dusa; ta no sikato so ilaban mo, nepeg mo ni a gawaen lamet.
Denglen mo so simbawa, tan awaten mo so panangibangat, pian onkabat ka, ed kaunaran a kasampotan mo.
Wala ra so dakel a kanonotan ed puso na too; balet say simbawa nen Katawan, satan mansiansia.
Say mangawa ed too pian sikato so panpilalekan sikato so kaoyamoan to; et say duka a too magmaong nen say matila.
Say takot ed Katawan mamaarap ed bilay: et say walaan ed sikato manayam a mapakpakna; ag naani dalawen na mauges.
Say mangiras yamot to so lima to ed lipong, tan agto nisabi a toloy ed sangi to lamet.
Kabilen mo so managbalaw, et say karaklan makaaral na simpit; et baaten mo so walaan na pakatalos, et makatalos na pikakabat.
Say mamaunong ed ama to, tan patainanen to so ina to, sikato so sakey ya anak a makapabaing tan makalanor na balaw.
Ontonda ka, ana' ko, ya ondengel na panangibangat a kalingoan mo ed saray salita na pikakabat.
Say andi kakanaan a tasi ludlureyen to so inkatunong; et say sangi na marelmeng manakmon na inkauges.
Saray pangokom nitadia a nipaakar ed saray managbalaw, tan saray bakbak nipaakar ed beneg na saray maatiw.
Say alak managludlurey, say mabayani ya inumen magolo; et angan siopa a nilawan ed sikara sikato so ag makabat.
Say kigtot na ari sikato so singa panengak na leon: say managyat ed sikato a manpasnok mankasalanan sumpa ed dili a bilay to.
Sakey a kirayewan na too so panikay a manlapu ed kolkol; balet amin a maatiw masupiat.
Say mangiras ag manbaka lapud no ambetel; kanian mipayabol ed panagani, et andian na bengatla.
Say simbawa ed puso na too sikato so singa aralem a danum; balet say too a makatalos sikato so naagwat to.
Sankaraklan a totoo ibawag na balang sakey so dili a kaabigan to; balet say matoor a too ¿siopa so makaromog?
Say maptek a too a manakar ed inkaskey to, mapalar so saray anak to ed kayari to.
Say ari a manyorong ed yorongan na pangokoman itayak to ya amin so mauges ed saray mata to.
¿Siopa so makapangikuan, nilinisan ko so pusok, siak malinisak a manlapu ed kasalanan to?
Saray nambabangil a simbangan tan nambabangil a panagsukat, nampadparara a dua a sikara so makapadimla ed Katawan.
Angan say ugaw ipakabat to so inkasikato ed panamegley na saray gawa to, no say kimey to sikato so malinis, tan no sikato so maptek.
Say makadngel a layag, tan say makanengneng a mata, si Katawan ginawa to ra a nampadpara.
Agmo aroen so ugip, ompan onduka ka; lukasan mo so saray matarn, et napesel ka ed tinapay.
Mauges, mauges, kuan na manaliw: balet no ¡mania ed dalan to, insan manpangta.
Wala so balitok, tan daakan a rubi; balet saray bibil na pikakabat sikara so mabli a kagawaan.
Alaen mo so kawes na mangyalagey ed sankaili; et sikato so benbenan mo a sanla so mangyalagey ed saray sankaili.
Say tinapay na inkatila sikato so masamit ed too; balet kayari to say sangi to napano na yasa.
Balang kanonotan niletneng ed panamegley na simbawa; et ed panamegley na makabat a panangitonton mibakal ka.
Say manakar a manlabirlabir mangipatnag na saray inyamot; kanian agka miolop ed mangilukas a maawang ed saray bibil to.
Angan siopa a mangayew ed ama to odino ina to, say tinkaw to naerep ed inkadeket na bilunget.
Say tawir narandan a magangano ed gapu: balet say sampot to ag naani mapalar.
Agmo ikuan, ibales ko so mauges: manalagar ka ed Katawan, et ilaban to ka.
Saray nambabangil a simbangan sikara so makapadimla ed Katawan; et say mauges a katian so aliwan maong.
Saray kakaakar na too sikara so kien nen Katawan; ¿Panon sirin so pakatalos na too ed dalan to?
Sakey a kalot ed too so kalimbuat a pangikuan, sikato so santo, tan kayari na saray sipan so pangopapet.
Say makabat ya ari itegap to so saray marelmeng, tan yakar to so dalig a pansolsol ed tapew da.
Say espiritu na too sikato so tinkaw nen Katawan, a manosisa ed saray amin a kaaralman a kabiangan.
Say kaabigan tan tua yagel da so ari; et say yorongan to nabenbenan ed panamegley na kaabigan.
Say gayaga na saray tobonbalon lalaki sikato so biskeg da, say kalimgasan na saray mamasiken sikato so ubanan ya olo.
Saray lewet a manugat urasan da so mauges; et saray babag lanoren da so saray kaaralman a kabiangan.
Say puso na ari wala ed lima nen Katawan a singa saray agus, sikato so ikiling to ed angan iner a labay to.
Balang dalan na too sikato so maptek ed saray dili a mata to; balet si Katawan simbangen to so saray puso.
Say pangawa na kaptekan tan inkatunong sikato so lalo ya akoen nen Katawan nen say bagat.
Say atagey a kanenengneng, tan mapangta a puso, angan say tinkaw na marelmeng, sikato so kasalanan.
Saray kaisipan na saray makuli arap ira lambengat ed inkadaakan; balet balang sakey a manganat, manganat lambengat a naokolan.
Say panandan ed saray kayamanan ed panamegley na dila a matila sikato so alingasew a panbanlayonen na saray mananap ed patey.
Say kasebegan na saray marelmeng panisan to ra, lapu ed onaleg ira a mangawa na matunong.
Say dalan na mansasakbat na kasalanan sikato so alabas a pikewet; balet nipaakar ed malinis, say gawa to sikato so maptek.
Magmaong so panayam ed sokong na toktok na abung, nen pati makolkol a bii ed maawang ya abung.
Saray kamarerwa na marelmeng pilalek to so mauges: say kaabay to ag makaromog na pamalangkap ed saray mata to.
Sano say managludlurey nadusa, say karaklan nagawa a makabat; et sano say makabat nibangat, awaten to so pikakabat.
Say maptek a too omamengen to so abung na marelmeng, no panon so kabagbag na saray marelmeng ed kabagbag da.
Say mamepet ed saray layag to ed akis na duka, sikato met onakis, balet ag pakadenglen.
Say tokdol a maamot padeenen to so sanok; et say isaklang ed akualan, padeenen to so mabiskeg a sanok.
Liket ed maptek so pangawa na matunong; balet sikato so kabagbag ed saray managgawa na inkauges.
Say too a nabalang ed dalan na pakatalos manpainawa ed tipon na saray inaatey.
Say mangaro ed talirak sikato naani duka a too; say mangaro ed alak tan larak ag naani onyaman.
Say marelmeng sikato so dondon nipaakar ed maptek; et saray liputan onsandi ra ed maptek.
Magmaong so panayam ed lawak a dalin, nen say piamung ed makolkol tan maingongot a bii.
Wala so mabli a kayamanan tan larak ed panagayaman na makabat; balet say maatiw a too sikato so akmonen to.
Say ontombok ed kaptekan tan kaabigan makaromog na bilay, kaptekan, tan dayew.
Say makabat a too kalaben to so ciudad na makapanyari, tan pangabebaen to so biskeg napanagmatalkanto.
Angan siopa a mangawalo na sangi to tan dila to kawaloen to so kamarerwa to a manlapu ed saray gonigon.
Say mapangta tan marangal a too, managludlurey so ngaran to; onkimey ed inkapasang na pangta.
Say pilalek na mangiras mamatey ed sikato; ta saray lima to onaleg ira a mankimey.
Wala so managum a masibasiba a sanagew; balet say maptek mangiter tan ag mangikibot.
Say bagat na marelmeng sikato so makapadimla; ¡Ag lalo ni, sano sikato so yakar to ed marelmeng a kanonotan!
Say matila a tasi natawtaw naani; balet say too ya ondengel mansalita a singa maando.
Say marelmeng a too ikuliseng to so lupa to; balet say maptek, iletneg to so saray dalan to.
Angapo so kakabatan odino pakatalos odino simbawa sumpa ed Katawan,
Say kabayo nitadia a nipaakar ed agew na bakal: balet say palabo kien nen Katawan.
Say maong a ngaran sikato so lalo a pilien nen saray ankabaleg a kayamanan, tan say maaro a pamalangkap lalo nen say pilak tan balitok.
Say mayaman tan say duka mandomog ira; si Katawan sikato so akanpinalsa ed sikara ya amin.
Say masimpit a too nanengneng to so mauges, tan yamot to so inkasikato; balet say karaklan ontuloy, tan manlikna nipaakar ed sikato.
Say tumang na kaoyamoan tan say takot ed Katawan sikato so saray kayamanan, tan dayew, tan bilay.
Saray sabit tan saray kalot wala ra ed dalan na saray masulit: say mangawalo ed kamarerwa to onarawi ed sikara.
Ibangat mo so anak ed dalan a nepeg to a laen, tan angan sano masiken la ag onarawi ed sikato.
Say mayaman manuley ed duka; et say akautang sikato so aripen ed amautang.
Say mantanem na inkauges manani na kairapan; et say panaklay na sanok to onkulang.
Say walaan na mapanga ko a mata nabendicionan; ta mangiter ed tinapay to ed duka.
Iwaklit mo so managbalaw, et say kolkol ompaway; on, say kababaingan ontonda.
Say mangaro ed inkalinis na puso, lapu ed gayaga na saray bibil to say ari sikato naani kaaro to.
Saray mata nen Katawan kawaloen to so walaan na pikakabat; balet bagbagen to so saray salita na liputan a too.
Say mangiras kuan to, Wala so leon ed paway; siak naani napatey ed saray polong.
Say sangi na sankaili a bibii sikato so aralem a kalinsorong; say mangula ed Katawan napelag diman.
Say inkaatiw nisinger ed puso na ugaw; balet say panaklay na panangibangat mangyarawi ed sikato.
Say mangapos ed duka pian parakelen to so tobo to, tan say mangiter ed mayaman, naokolan lambengat.
Ikiling mo so layag mo, tan denglen mo so saray salita na makabat, tan ipakep mo so pusom ed pikakabat ko.
Ta makapaliket a bengatla no kawaloen mo ra ed sika, no niletneg ira a nitipon ed saray bibil mo.
Pian say panmatalek mo wala ed Katawan, inpakabat ko ra ed sika ed sayan agew, on ed sika.
¿Agko ta insulat ed sika so saray angkabli a bengabengatla nipaakar ed saray simbawa tan pikakabat,
Pian nipakabat ko ed sika so inkapeteg na saray salita na tua, pian nipawil mo so saray salita na tua ed saray angibaki ed sika?
Agmo takewan so duka, lapud' sikato so duka; agmo met aposan so pinairap ed wangalan:
Ta si Katawan ikatunongan to so sengegan da, tan ekalan to na bilay so saray mansamsam ed sikara.
Agka mikaaro ed too a maisasanok; tan agka mila ed masanok a too:
Ompan naaral mo so saray dalan to, tan makagamor ka na kalot ed kamarerwam.
Agka komon sakey ed saray mangabil ed saray lima, odino ed saray mangyalagey nipaakar ed saray utang.
No angapo so panbayar mo, ¿Akin et ekalen to so dokolan mo a manlapu ed leksab mo?
Agmo yalis so daan a ketegan, a inpasen na saray atateng mo.
Nanengneng mo so sakey a too a makuli ed saray kimey to? sikato onalagey naani ed arap na saray arari; sikato ag naani onalagey ed arap na magter iran totoo.
Sano onyorong ka a mikan ed makauley, isipen mo a siimaton so wala ed arap mo;
Et mangyan ka na yoro ed kolokolong mo, no sakey ka a too a masiba.
Agka mapilalek ed saray kanen to; bangta sikara so makapalingo a kanen.
Agka nakolkolan ya onyaman; ontonda ka a manlapu ed dili a kakabatan mo.
¿Inengneng mo ta so saray matam ed angapo? ta saray kayamanan petepeteg a mangawa ra ed sikara na payapayak, singa say agila ya ontekyab ya arap ed tawen.
Agka mangan na tinapay na walaan na mauges a mata, agmo panpilalekan so saray kanen to:
Ta unong na isisipen to ed dalem to, sikato so ontan; mangan ka tan oninom ka, kuan to ed sika; balet say puso to andi ed sika.
Say sankakamot a kinan mo yutam naani, tan nabalang mo so saray masamit a salitam.
Agka mansalita ed pakadngel na maatiw; ta modmoraen to so kakabatan na saray salitam.
Agmo yalis so daan a ketegan; et agka onloob ed saray uma na saray ulila:
Ta say Mananondon da sikato so mabiskeg; sikato ikatunongan to so sengegan da a sumpa ed sika.
Ipakep mo so pusom ed panangibangat ko, tan saray layag mo ed saray salita na pikakabat.
Agmo baaten so panangibangat ed ugaw; ta no sikato so kabilen mo ed panaklay, ag naani ompatey.
Sikato so kabilen mo ed panaklay, et nilaban mo so kamarerwa to ed Sheol.
Anak ko, no say pusom makabat, say pusok mangayaga, angan siak.
On, say pusok manliket, sano saray bibil mo mansalita na maptek a bengabengatla.
Say pusóm ag komon makasiblet ed saray managkasalanan, balet wala ka komon ed takot ed Katawan ed amin ya agew.
Ta petepeteg ya wala so tumang; et say ilalom ag naani naputer
Ondengel ka, ana'ko, tan onkabat ka, tan itonton mo so pusom ed dalan.
Agka miolop ed saray mainom na alak, ed saray masiba a mangan na laman.
Ta say managbuek tan say masiba onduka ra; tan say kayepyep kawesan to so too ed pilatpilat.
Pakadenglen mo so amam a nanilalak ed sika, tan agmo modmoraen so inam sano akulaw.
Saliwen mo so tua, tan sikato so agmo ilako; on, say kakabatan, tan panangibangat, tan pakatalos.
Say ama na matunong manliket na baleg; et say manilalak na makabat ya ugaw manliket ed sikato.
Say amam tan say inam mangayaga ra komon, tan say angianak ed sika manliket komon.
Ana'ko, iter mo ed siak so pusom; et saray matam manliket ira komon ed saray dalan ko.
Ta say biin balangkantis sikato so aralem a payas; et say sankaili a bii sikato so mainget a kalinsorong.
On, sikato mansaneb a singa say matakew, tan parakelento so saray liputan ed saray lalaki.
¿Siopa so walaan na segsegang? ¿siopa so walaan na ermen? ¿Siopa so walaan na kolkol? ¿Siopa so walaan na dalem? ¿siopa so walaan na sugat ya andi sengeg? ¿Siopa so walaan na balanga na saray mata?
Saray manabala a maong ed alak; saray onla a mananap na linaokan ya alak.
Agka onlimgis ed alak sano sikato so ambalanga, sano sikato so mankirlap ed kopa, sano manpaabeba a malamolamoy:
Ed kasampotan sikato so mangabil a singa say uleg, tan mangalat a singa tadioko.
Saray matam makanengneng ira na sankaili a bengabengatla, tan say pusom manbitla na saray mauges a bengabengatla.
On, singa ka naani say ondokol ed pegley na dayat, odino singa say ondokol ed toktok na anlayasan.
Kinabilda ak, ikuan mo, et agak asugat. Pinaunongda ak, et sikato so agko alikna; ¿Kapigan so iliing ko? Sikato so anapen ko ni lamet.
Agka onsiblet ed saray mauges a totoo; agmo met panpilalekan so miolop ed sikara:
Ta say puso ra manaral a mangapos, tan saray bibil da mansalita na marumsis.
Lapu ed kakabatan say abung nipaalagey; et lapu ed pakatalos sikato so niletneg;
Et lapu ed pikakabat saray silir napano ed saray amin a mabli tan makapaliket a kaykayamanan.
Say makabat a too sikato so mabiskeg: on, say too a makabat munaten to so pakapanyari to.
Ta dia ed panamegley na makabat a pangitonton gawaen mo so pibakal mo; tan dia ed karaklan na saray manimbawa wala so kilalaban.
Say kakabatan atagey a toloy nipaakar ed maatiw: agto lukasan so sangi to ed wangalan.
Say mannonot a mangawa na mauges, sikato so tawagen na saray totoo a marumsis.
Say nonot na inkaatiw sikato so kasalanan; et say managbalaw sikato so makapadimla ed saray totoo.
No onkapuy ka ed agew na kasegsegangan, say kasil mo sikato so melag.
Ilaban mo so saray niyakar ed patey, et saraman so maparaan a pateyen nengnengen mo pian baaten mo ra.

No kuan mo, Nia, agmi amta so saya, ¿Sikato ta so ag nonoten na saman so manimbang ed saray puso? Tan say mangawalo ed kamarerwam, ¿sikato ta so agto amta? Tan ¿agto ta itumang ed balang too so unong ed gawa to?
Ana' ko kanen mo so dilo, ta sikato so maong; tan saray terter na kolaba na dilo, a sikara so masamit ed pakananam mo.
Dia ed ontan amtaen mo so kakabatan a nipaakar ed kamarerwam; no sikato so aromog mo, sirin wala naani tumang, tan say ilalom ag naani napoltot.
Agmo siliban, O marelmeng a too, so panagayaman na maptek; agmo bagbagen so panagpainawaan to a pasen:
Ta say maptek a too nipasag a maminpito, tan onbangon lamet; balet saray marelmeng nabaktar ira ed panamegley na kairapan.
Agka manliket sano say kabusol mo nipasag, tan say pusom ag komon mangayaga sano sikato so nabaktar;
Ompan sikato so nanengneng nen Katawan, tan sikato so ag makapaliket ed sikato, tan yarawi to so sanok to a manlapu ed sikato.
Agka napasnokan nisengeg ed saray managgawa na mauges; agka met onsiblet ed saray marelmeng.
Ta angapo so tumang ed mauges a too; say tinkaw na marelmeng naerep naani.
Ana'ko, takotán mo si Katawan tan say ari; tan agka miolop ed saray manangoman-oman:
Ta say kairapan da onalagéy a bigla; tan say kabagbag a manlapu ed sikara a nanpadpara, ¿siopa so mikabat?
Saraya met sikara so salsalita na makabat, say panaglabi ed saray inkatoo éd panangokoman sikato so aliwa a maong.
Say mankuan ed marelmeng, sika matunong, sikato so ayewen na balbaley, sikato so gulaen na saray nacion;
Balet ed saray mamaat ed sikato wala naani liket, tan say maong a bendicion onsabi ed sikara.
Angoban to so saray bibil na mangiter na maptek ya ebat.
Itadiam so gawam ed paway, tan sikato so gawaen mo a magangano nipaakar ed sika ed uma; et kayari to ipaalagey mo so abung mo.
Agka mantasi sumpa ed kaabay mo ya andi makasengeg; et agka mamalingo ed saray bibil mo.
Agmo kuan; Gawaen ko naani ed sikato so unong na ginawa to ed siak; itumang ko ed too so unong ed gawa to.
Linmabas ak ed abay na uma na mangiras, tan ed abay na uvasan na too ya andian na pakatalos;
Et, nia, tinoboan ya amin na sabisabit, say tapew da asakbongan ed saray wakawakal, tan say bato a bakor to nagbala.
Diad saman ninmengneng ak, tan inisip ko a maong: anengneng ko, tan angawat ak na panangibangat:
Daiset ni ya ugip, daiset a pakalirep, daiset a pandakop na saray lima pian naugip;
Ontan a say kadukaaan mo on sabi naani a singa matakew, tan say pankaokolan mo singa inayuraan a too.
Saraya met sikara so uliran nen Salomon, a saray totoo nen Ezekias ari ed Juda inakir da.
Gloria na Dios so pangyamot na bengatla; balet say gloria na saray ar-ari sikato so panosisa na bengatla.
Singa saray tawen ed katagey, tan say dalin ed kaaralem, ontan so puso na saray ari sikato so ag naosisa.
Ekalen mo so saray dutak a manlapu ed pilak, et ompaway so kagawaan nipaakar ed managgogol:
Ekalen mo so marelmeng a manlapu ed arap na ari, et say yorongan to niletneg ed inkatunong.
Agmo paatageyen so inkasika ed arapan na ari, tan agka onalagey ed pasen na baleg a totoo:
Ta magmaong a nikuan ed sika, onsapat ka dia, nen say kiabebam ed arapan na principe, ya anengneng na saray matam.
Agka ompaway a maganganat a mikolkol; ompan agmo amta no anto so gawaen mo ed kasampotan to, sa no say kaabay mo inbabaing to ka.
Isangsang mo so sengegan mo ed kaabay mo lanlamang, tan agmo lukasan so yaamot na sananey;
Ompan say makadngel modmoraen to ka, tan say kibabaing mo ag naekal ed sika.
Say salita a makana so kisalita to sikato so singa saray manzana a balitok ed iket a pilak.
Singa ikaw a balitok, tan agamil a dalisay a balitok, ontan so makabat a mamaat ed matolok a layag.
Singa say betel na kelpa ed panaon na panagani, ontan so matoor ya igagangan ed saray nanbaki ed sikato; ta painawaen to so kamarerwa na saray katawan to.
Singa saray lurem tan dagem ya andi uran, ontan so mangipangta ed inkasikato a mapalabo a matilatila.
Ed karukey na pantepel say manuley napatolok, tan say malambot a dila buyaken to so pukel.
¿Akaromog ka na dilo? kanen mo so masarag ed sika, ompan napesel ka a toloy, tan yutam.
Say salim matalag komon ed abung na kaabay mo, ompan natama ed sika, tan gulaen to ka.
Say too a mamapaway na mauges a tasi sumpa ed kaabay to sikato so sakey a pekpek, tan sakey a kampilan, tan sakey a maotok a pana.
Say panmatalek ed pakalala a too dia ed panaon na gonigon sikato so singa abagot a ngipen, tan sali ya alikda.
Singa sakey a mangokpos na kawes ed panaon na betel, tan singa tuka ed sosa, ontan so manganta na kancanta ed puso ya ambelabelat.
No say kabusol mo narasan, sikato so itdan mo na tinapay a naakan; et no napgaan, sikato so itdanmo na danum ya inomen:
Ta bontonen mo so saray ngalab na apuy ed tapew na oloto, tan si Katawan tumangan to ka.
Say amian mangipaway na uran; ontan so gawaen na malabir a dila ipatnag to so masebeg a lupa.
Magmaong so panayam ed soyok na toktok na abung, nen say pati makolkol a bii ed maawang ya abung.
Singa ambetel a danudanum ed napgaan a kamarerwa, ontan so saray maong a balita a manlapu ed arawi a dalin.
Singa akibol a kolos, tan aderal a sobol, ontan so maptek a too a mangiter na dalan ed arap na marelmeng.
Aliwa a maong so pangan na dakel a dilo; ontan nipaakar ed saray totoo say panosisa ra ed dili a galang da sikato so makapaermen.
Saman so say espiritu to andian na benben na linawa sikato so singa ciudad a nageba tan andian na saray bakor.
Singa nieve ed tiagew, tan singa uran ed panagani, ontan say dayew ag onnepeg nipaakar ed maatiw.
Singa say anuyaw ed panteyengteyeng to, singa say mangalimpana ed pantektekyab to, ontan say ayew ya andi makasengeg ag onsabi.
Say lewet nipaakar ed kabayo, say pakalat nipaakar ed asno, tan say panaklay nipaakar ed beneg ná saray maatiw.
Agmo ebatan so maatiw unong ed inkaatiw to, ompan mipara ka met ed sikato.
Ebatan mo so maatiw unong ed inkaatiw to, ompan onkabat ed dili a matamata to.
Say mangipawit na pabaki ed panamegley na lima na maatiw puteren to so saray dili a sali to, tan oninom ed kababaingan.
Saray sali na piley manbitbitin a lupoy: ontan so alimbawa ed sangi na saray maatiw.
Singa sakey a mangiberber na bato ed lampasot, ontan so mangiter na dayew ed maatiw.
Singa sabit a nisorob ed lima na abuek, ontan so alimbawa ed sangi na saray maatiw.
Singa say managpana a sugaten to so amin, ontan so mangupa ed maatiw tan say mangupa ed saray onlabas.
Singa say aso ya ompawil ed uta to, ontan so maatiw ya uliten to so inkaatiw to.
¿Nanengneng mo so too a makabat ed dili a matamata to? Wala so lalo ya ilalo ed maatiw nen sikato.
Say mangiras kuan to, Wala so leon ed dalan; wala so leon ed saray polong.
Singa say kaput ompeyes ed saray nigawingan to, ontan so gawaen na mangiras ed tapew na dokolan to.
Say mangiras yamot to so lima to ed lipong; mamakapuy ed sikato so pangisabi to ed sangi to.
Say mangiras sikato so makabkabat ed saray dili a mata to nen pitora a totoo a makapankatunongan.
Say onlabas, tan napasnokan ed kolkol ya ag nipaakar ed sikato, sikato so singa sakey a mabitbit na aso ed saray layag.
Singa say atiwel a too a manbantak na saray ngapus, panapana; tan patey,
Ontan so too a mamalingo ed kaabay to, tan kuan to, ¿Agak ta mangagalaw?
Lapu ed kakulangan na kiew say apuy naerep; et iner a kaandian na talobotob, say pankokolkol onton da.
Singa saray uring nipaakar ed petang na saray ngalab, tan kiew ed apuy, ontan so makolkol a too a mamarlang ed kolkol.
Saray salita na managtalobotob sikara so singa saray masamit ya ikakamot, tan onleksab ira ed saray kaaralman a kabiangan.
Saray maralit a bibil tan marelmeng a puso sikara so singa dalin ya agamil ya inokopan na dutak na pilak.
Say mangula mankonkonwari ed saray bibil to; balet manbonton na pamalingo ed dalem to.
Sano mansalita na maong, sikato so agmo sisiaen; ta wala so pitoran makapadimla ed puso to:
Angan say gula to nansakbong na silib, say inkarelmeng to nipanengneng na mapatpatnag ed arap na tipon.
Angan siopa a mangotkot na kalinsorong napelag ed dalem to; et say mangitolin na bato, sikato so ontapil ed sikato.
Say matila a dila gulaen to so nasugat to; et say makoltit a sangi mangawa na kabagbag.
Agmo ipangta so agew na kabuasan; ta agmo amta no anto so ipaway na sakey ya agew.
Sananey a too so mangidayew komon ed sika, tan aliwa a say dili a sangim; say sankaili, et aliwa a saray dili a bibil mo.
Say bato ambelat, tan say buer nasimbang; balet say sanok na maatiw sikato so ambelat nen sikara a dua.
Say sanok sikato so masulit, tan say irang na linawa manangapos; balet ¿siopa so makatanyareg ed arap na inkaimon?
Magmaong so mapatnag a panamaat nen say aro ya ag ibesngaw.
Matoor so saray sugat na kaaro; balet saray kakaangob na kabusol sikara so maslak.
Say napsel a kamarerwa igatin to so kolaba na dilo; balet ed kamarerwa a narasan balang ampait a bengatla sikato so masamit.
Singa say manok a mantekiab a manlapu ed obong to, ontan so too a manakarakar a manlapu ed pasen to.
Say larak tan say balingit paliketen da so puso; ontan so kasamitan na kaaro na too a manlapu ed puso so simbawa to.
Say dili a kaarom, tan say kaaro nen amam, agmo ikaindan; tan agka onla ed abung na agim ed agew na kasegsegangan mo: magmaong so kaaro ya asinger nen say agi ya arawi.
Ana'ko, onkabat ka, tan paliketen mo so pusok, pian naebatan ko so mamalaw ed siak.
Say masimpit a too nanengneng to so mauges, tan yamot to so inkasika to; balet say karaklan ontuloy, tan manlikna nipaakar ed sikato.
Alaen mo so kawes na mangyalagey ed sankaili; tan abalaen mo so sanla na mangyalagey ed sankaili a bii
Say mamendito ed kaaro to ed maksil a voces, ya onbangon a masaksakbay ed kabuasan, sikato so nibilang ya ayew ed sikato.
Say naynay a panterter ed mamauran ya agew tan say makolkol a bii sikara so nanpadpara:
Say mangipokpok ed sikato pokpokan to so dagem; et say kawanan a lima to nisapigar ed larak.
Say balatyang otokan to so balatyang; ontan say too otokan to so lupa na kaaro to,
Say manbantay na higos mangan naani ed bunga to; et say mamabli ed katawan to sikato naani nidayew.
Singa dia ed danum say lupa ebatan to so lupa, ontan so puso na too ed too.
Say Sheol tan Abaddon sikara so ag napesel angan kapigan; et saray mata na too sikara so ag napesel angan kapigan.
Say panagogolan sikato so nipaakar ed pilak, tan say palbaan nipaakar ed balitok; et say too nasali ed panamegley na kidayew to.
Angan mekmeken mo so maatiw ed alo dia ed lasong ed nabayo a belas, angan ontan say inkaatiw to ag onarawi ed sikato.
Kulian mo ya amtaen so kipapasen na saray carnerom, tan imatonan mo a maong so saray bakam:
Ta saray kayamanan sikara so ag magnayon; et ¿say balanget magnayon ta anga ed saray amin a kailalakan?
Say dayami nitainan, tan say malangoer a dika ompatnag, tan saray dika na saray palandey natipon ira.
Saray cordero sikara so nipaakar a kawes mo, tan saray kanding sikara so bili na uma:
Et wala naani gatas na saray kanding a masarag a taganom, tan tagano na kaabung mo, tan tagano nipaakar ed saray ariripen mo a bibii.
Say marelmeng ombatik ya angapo so too a mangosil, balet saray maktek sikara so makpel a singa leon.
Lapu ed inpakalokso na dalin dakel so saray principe to; balet ed panamegley na saray totoo a makatalos tan makabat say kipapasen to magnayon.
Say naokolan a too a mangapos ed duka sikato so singa manpanis ya uran ya ag mangitilak na kanen.
Saray mangikaindan ed tunong idayew da so marelmeng; balet saray mangonor ed tunong misangsangan ira ed sikara.
Say mauges a too agto natalosan so inkatunong; balet saray mananap ed Katawan natalosan da so saray amin a bengatla.
Magmaong so duka a manakar ed inkaskey to, nen say marumsis ed saray dalan to, angan mayaman.
Angan siopa a mangunor ed tunong sikato so makabat ya anak; balet say miolop ed, saray masiba ibabaing to so ama to.
Say mangarum ed kayarian to ed panamegley na tobo tan munat, sikato so tiponen to nipaakar ed walaan na panangasi ed duka.
Say mangyarawi ed layagto manlapu ed pandengel ed tunong, angan say pikakasi to sikato so makapadimla.
Angan siopa a mangitonton ed saray maptek ed mauges a dalan, napelag lanlamang ed dili ya kalinsorong to; balet say ayadyari tawiren to so maong.
Say mayaman a too sikato so makabat ed saray dili a mata to; balet say duka ya walaan na pakatalos sikato so osisaen to.
No say maptek manpalabo, wala so baleg a gayaga; balet no say marelmeng ontagey, saray totoo onamot ira.
Say manakbong ed saray inpakalokso to ag onaliguas; balet say mangipatua tan mangikaindan; ed sikara makagamor na panangasi.
Mapalar so too ya antakot a naynay; balet say mamaawet ed puso to napelag naani ed karumsisan.
Singa say manengak a leon, tan nadnarasan ya oso, ontan so marelmeng a manuley ed duka a baley.
Say principe a mankulang na pakatalos sikato met so baleg a manangapos; balet say mangula ed inkaagum parukeyen to so saray agew to.
Say too a nanawit na dala na angan siopa a too ombatik anga ed kalinsorong; angapo komon so mangabala ed sikato.
Angan siopa a manakar a mapmaptek nilaban; balet say marumsis ed saray dalan to napelag a tampol.
Say ondalus ed dalin to walaan naani daakan a tinapay: balet say ontombok ed saray maapa a totoo masarag to naani kadukaan to.
Say matoor a too narasagan ed saray bendicion; balet say maganat ya onyaman aliwa naani ya ag nadusa.
Say panlabi ed saray totoo sikato so aliwan maong; say too ag met makalokso nipaakar ed sakey a pisag na tinapay.
Say walaan na mata a mauges manganat ya ontombok ed saray kayamanan, tan agto amta a say pankaokolan onsabi ed sikato.
Say mamaat ed too makaromog naani pamalangkap nen say mangoltit ed dila to.
Angan siopa a takewan to so ama to odino ina to, tan kuan to, sikato so aliwa a pakalokso, sikato lanlamang so kaiba na managbagbag.
Say masiba so espiritu to paletawen to so kolkol; balet say mangyan na panilalo to ed Katawan napataba naani.
Say manmatalek ed dili a puso to sikato so maatiw; balet say manakar a makabat, nilaban naani.
Say mangiter ed duka ag naani mankulang; balet say mangyamot ed saray mata to nawalaan na dakel ya ayew.
No saray marelmeng ontagey, saray totoo onamot ira; balet no natawtaw so saray marelmeng, saray maptek ondakel.
Saman so anta maparanay ya abaat paaweten to so tenger to bigla naani a nabagbag, tan satan angapo so panambal.
Sano saray maptek ondakel ira, say baley manliket; balet sano say marelmeng a too manuley, say baley maningel.
Angan siopa a mangaro ed kakabatan paliketen to so ama to; balet say miolop ed saray balangkantis daraken to so kayarian to.
Say ari ed panamegley na tunong iletneg to so dalin; balet say mananap na saray tokdol sikato so bagbagen to.
Say too a koltiten to so kaabay to mangibuskag na iket ed saray kurang to.
Dia ed pakalokso na mauges a too wala so kalot; balet saray maptek mancanta tan manliket ira.
Say maptek mangala na pikakabat ed sengegan na duka; say marelmeng andian na pakatalos pian sikato so amtaen to.
Saray managbalaw ipasen da so ciudad ed dalang; balet saray makabat a totoo papaen da so sanok.
No say makabat a too walaan na sangsangan ed maawit a too, manpasnok man odino manelek, andian naani na deen.
Saray napgaan ed dala kagula ra so ayadyari; et nipaakar ed saray maptek, anapen da so bilay to.
Say maatiw ibesngaw to ya amin so sanok to; balet say makabat a too sikato so pokpokan to tan sikato so papaen to.
No say makauley pakadenglen to so tila, amin iray aripen to sikara so marelmeng.
Say duka a too tan say managlames manabet ira; si Katawan silewan to so saray mata ra a nampadpara.
Say ari a maptek so pangokom to ed duka, say tronoto niletneg lawas.
Say panaklay tan panamaat mangiter na kakabatan; balet say ugaw a napaolian makapabaing ed ina to.
Sano saray marelmeng ondakel ira, say pakalokso ondakel; balet saray maptek nanengneng da so kapelag da.
Ibangat mo so anak mo, et itdan to ka na painawa; on, mangiter na liga ed kamarerwam.
No iner so kaandian napasingawey, say baley okposen to so pamokpok; balet say mangonor ed tunong, sikato so mapalar.
Say aripen ag nibangat ed saray salita; ta angan natalosan to, agto ikabilangan.
¿Nanengneng mo so too a maganganat ed saray salita to? Wala so lalo ya ilalo ed maatiw nen sikato.
Say mangiwi a maomaong ed aripen to a manlapu ed inkaugaw pagmaliwen to naani ya anak to ed kaonoran.
Say mapasnok a too mamalesa na kolkol, tan say ampetang a too maslak ed pakalokso.
Say mapangta a too mangipaabeba ed sikato; balet say espiritu a mapaabeba makagamor na dayew.
Angan siopa a minonong ed matakew kagula to so dili a kamarerwa to; makadngel na pangayew tan angapo so kuan to.
Say takot na too mantarok na kalot; balet angan siopa ya ipasen to so ilalo to ed Katawan nilaban.
Dakel so saray mananap na pamalangkap na manuley; balet say pangokom na too manlapu ed Katawan.
Say pikewet a too sikato so makapadimla ed maptek: et say maptek ed dalan sikato so makapadimla ed saray marelmeng.
Saray salita nen Agur ya anak a laki nen Jake; say paries. Say too kuan to ed Itiel, ed Itiel tan Ucal:
Petepeteg a lalo ya ayep ak nen angan siopa a too, tan andian ak na pakatalos na too;
Tan agak nanaral na kakabatan, andi met ed siak so pikakabat na Sankasantosan.

¿Siopa so sinmegep ed tawen, tan linmasor? Siopa so anipon ed dagem ed saray akop to? ¿Siopa so ananggal ed saray danum ed kawes to? ¿Siopa so angiletneg ed saray amin a sampot na dalin? ¿Anto so ngaran to, tan anto so ngaran na anak to, no amtam?
Balang salita na Dios sikato so ginogolan: sikato so kinlong ed saray onapireng ed sikato.
Agmo aruman so saray salita to, ompan baaten to ka, tan naromog ka a matila.
Duaran bengatla so kinerew ko ed sika; agmo ra ikibot komon ed siak ed unaan na ipatey kor
Yarawim ed siak so kaapaan tan saray tila; agmo iter komon ed siak so kadukaan ono saray kayamanan; taganoen moak ed kanen a nakaokolan ed siak:
Ompan napesel ak, tan iburi ta ka, tan kuan ko, ¿Siopa si Katawan? Odino ompan onduka ak, tan mantakew ak, tan agamilen ko a modmoraen so ngaran na Dios ko.
Agmo paugesen so aripen ed katawan to, ompan ayewen to ka, tan naromog ka a nankasalanan.
Wala so kailalakan ya ayewen da so ateng da, tan agda benditoen so ina ra.
Wala so kailalakan a sikara so malinew ed saray dili a mata ra, et angan ontan sikara so ag naurasan ed saray inkadutak da.
Wala so kailalakan, ¡O agay la so inkapasang na saray mata ra! tan saray lokablokab da akamurikat ira ed tagey.
Wala so kailalakan a say ngipengipen da sikara so singa saray kampilan, tan saray pangal da singa saray yoro, pian akmonen da so duka a manlapu ed dalin, tan say naokolan ed saray totoo.
Say linta walaan na duaran anak a bibii, a manakis, Mangiter ka, Wala so taloran bengabengatla ya ag napesel angan kapigan, on, apati ra ya agda ikuan, Saragla:
Say Sheol; tan say lepes ya eges; say dalin ya ag napesel ed danum; tan say apuy ya agto ikuan, Saragla.
Say mata a manludlurey ed ama to, tan modmoraen to so pangunor ed ina to, saray wawak ed lawak toktoken da ya ipaway, tan saray sibong ya agila sikato so kanen da.
Wala so taloran bengabengatla a sikara so makapakelaw a toloy ed siak, on, apatira ya agko amta:
Say dalan na agila ed dagem; say dalan na uleg ed tapew na bato; say dalan na sasakayan ed pegley na dayat; tan say dalan na too ed marikit.
Ontan so dalan na mikakalugoran a bii; sikato mangan, tan linisan to so sangi to, tan kuan to, Agak nangawa na karelmengan.
Taloran bengabengatla so keyeran na dalin, tan apatira, ya agto nayarian ya isong do:
Lapu ed sakey ya aripen sano manari; tan sakey a maatiw sano sikato so napano ed kanen;
Lapu ed binosol a bii sano mankasal; tan say aripen a bii sano manawir ed katawan to a bii.
Wala so apatiran bengabengatla a sikara so melag ed tapew na dalin, balet sikara so mapalalo a makabat:
Saray gilata sikara so baley ya aliwa a mabiskeg, angan ontan itadia ra so kanen da ed tiagew;
Saray conejo sikara lambengat so makapuy a polok, angan ontan gawaen da so saray abung da ed saray bato;
Saray doron andian ira na ari, angan ontan ompaway ira ya amin a pinolokpolok;
Say tiki ya ompeket ed saray lima to, angan ontan sikato so wala ed saray palacio na saray ar-ari.
Wala so taloran bengabengatla a sikara so marakep ed kurang da, on, apatira a sikara so marakep ed kakaakar:
Say leon, a sikato so sankamapanyarian ed saray ayep, tan ag onsoner lapu ed angan siopa;
Say aso a sumisingob; say kanding a kalakian met; tan say ari a sumpa ed sikato angapo so onalagey.
No ginawam so maatiw ed inpangyatagey mo ed inkasika, odino no nannonot ka a siuuges, ipepet mo so limam ed sangim.
Ta say pamespes et gatas mamapaway na mantekilla, tan say pamespes ed eleng mamapaway na dala; ontan met say pamespes ed sanok mamapaway na kolkol.
Saray salita nen ari Lemuel; say paries ya inbangat nen ina to ed sikato.
¿Anto, ana' ko? tan ¿anto, O anak na eges ko? tan, ¿anto, O anak na saray sipan ko?
Agmo iter so biskeg mo ed saray bibii, odino saray dalan mo ed manderal ed saray ar-ari.
Ag nipaakar ed saray ar-ari, O, Lemuel, ag nipaakar ed saray ar-ari so paninom na alak; ag met nipaakar ed saray principe so pangikuan, ¿Kawalaan na mabayani ya inomen?
Ompan oninom ira, tan nalingwanan da so tunong, tan deralen da so inkatunong ed angan siopa a napasegsegang.
Mangiter ka na mabayani ya inomen ed saman so ngalngali natawtaw, tan alak ed saman so ampait so kamarerwa to:
Paulian mo ta oninum, tan nalingwanan to so inkaduka to, tan agto la nanonotan so kairapan to.
Lukasan mo so sangim nipaakar ed emel, dia ed sengegan na saray amin a napasegsegang.
Lukasan mo so sangim, mangokom ka a matunotunong, tan agamilen mo so inkatunong ed duka tan naokolan.
Say sankakanaan a bii ¿siopa so makaromog? Ta say bili to sikato so arawi nen saray rubi.
Say puso na asawa to manmatalek ed sikato, tan ag nakulangan na nabang.
Say bii mangawa ed sikato na maong tan aliwa a say mauges ed saray amin ya agew na panbilay to.
Sikato mananap na bago tan lino, tan onkimey a malikeliket ed saray lima to.
Sikato so singa saray sakayan a banyaga; sikato alaen to so tinapay to a manlapu ed arawi.
Sikato so ombangon met leleg a labi ni, tan mangiter na kanen ed kaabung to, tan saray gagawaen da ed saray ariripen to a bibii.
Isisipen to so sakey ya uma, tan sikato so saliwen to; ed bunga na saray lima to mantanem na uvasan.
Sikato balkesan to so saray banel to ed biskeg, tan pabiskegen to so saray taklay to.
Nalikas to a say tagilako to sikato so natoboán; say tinkaw to ag naerep éd sanlabi.
Ibenben to so saray lima to ed dalig, tan saráy lima to benbenan da so inarameyan.
Yunat to so lima to ed duka; on, yunat to so saray lima to ed saray naokolan.
Sikato ag antakot ed nieve nipaakar ed kaabung to; ta amin so saray kaabung to akawesan ira ed eskarlata.
Mangawa nipaakar ed sikato lamlamang na saray tandakan ya inalong; say kawes to sikato so mayumis a lienzo tan purpura.
Say asawa to sikato so kabkabat ed saray wangalan, sano miyorong ed saray mamasiken ed dalin.
Mangawa na saray lienzo a kawes tan ilako to ra, tan mangyawat na saray balkes ed saray managbanyaga.
Biskeg tan inkaskey sikara so kawes to; tan panelekan to so panaon ya onsabi.
Lukasan to so sangi to ed kakabatan; et say tunong na kaabigan na linawa wala ed dila to.
Imatonan to a maong so saray dalan na kaabung to, tan ag mangan ed tinapay na inkangiras.
Saray anak to ombangon ira, tan sikato so tawagen da a bendita; say asawa to met, tan sikato so idayew to, a kuan to;
Dakel ya anak a bibii so nangawa a sankakanaan, balet sika talonaan mo ra ya amin.
Say dakep sikato so mamalingo, tan say kalimgasan sikato so apa; balet say bii ya antakot ed Katawan, sikato naani narayew.
Itdan mo na bunga na saray lima to; et sikato so idayew komon na saray gawa to ed saray wangalan.
Saray salita na Managpulong, ya anak a laki nen David, ya ari ed Jerusalem.
Kaapaan na saray kaapaan, kuan na Managpulong; kaapaan na saray kaapaan, amin sikato so kaapaan.
¿Anto so tobo na too ed amin a kimey to a kimeyan to ed leksab na banwa?
Sakey a kailalakan onla, tan sananey a kailalakan so onsabi; balet say dalin mansiansia lawas.
Say banwa met ombutay, tan say banwa onselek, tan mansiglat ya ompawil ed pasen to a butayan to.
Say dagem onla a mamaabalaten, tan ompawil ed dapit amianen; ompawil a naynay ed akar to, tan say dagem ompawil lamet ed saray liliberan to.
Amin iray ilog ombatik ira ya onla ed dayat, angan ontan say dayat sikato so ag napano; ed pasen a nanlapuan na saray ilog, diman onla ra lamet.
Amin iray bengatla sikara so napno ed saray makapasawa; say too sikato so agto nabaliksanan: say mate ag napesel ed pakanengneng, angan say layag ag napano ed pandengel.
Saman so wala nen saman sikato so wala naani; tan saman so agawa nen saman sikato so nagawa naani; et angapo so balo a bengatla ed leksab na banwa.
¿Wala ta so bengatla a napankuanan, Nengnengen yo, saya sikato so balo? sikato wala nen saman ya abayag la, dia ed saray taon ya wala ed unaan tayo.
Angapo so pakanonot ed saray inmona a kailalakan; angapo met so angan anto a pakanonot na saray kaunoran a kailalakan ya onsabi, ed saraman so onsabi ed onor.
Siak a Managpolong ariak nen saman ed Israel ed Jerusalem.

Et inseseg ko so pusok a mananap tan manosisa ed panamegley na kakabatan na nipaakar ed amin ya agawa ed leksab na tawen: sakey a makapasinagem a sagpot so initer na Dios ed saray anak a lalaki na totoo pian nailwam ira ed sikato.
Anengneng ko so saray amin a kimey ya agawa ed leksab na banwa; et, nia, amin sikato so kaapaan tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Say pikewet ag nayari a panpeteken; et say kulang ag nayari a nabilang.

Akisalita ak ed dili a pusok, ya inkuan ko, Nia, agamoran ko so baleg a kakabatan labas nen saray amin ya wala ed onaan ko ed Jerusalem; on, say pusok walaan nen saman na baleg a likas ed kakabatan tan pakatalos.
Et inseseg ko so pusok a mangamta na kakabatan, tan mangamta na inkaatiwel tan inkaatiw: alikas ko a saya met sikato so pangoosil ed dagem.
Ta dia ed dakel a kakabatan wala so dakel ya irap; et say mamarakel ed pikakabat parakelen to so ermen.
Inkuan ko dia ed pusok, Gala natan, salien ta ka a malikeliket; kanian manliket ka a magayaga: et, nia, saya met sikato so kaapaan.
Inkuan ko ed elek, Atiwel; tan ed liket, ¿Anto so gawaen na saya?

Inosisak ed pusok no panon so pamaliket ko na laman ko ed alak, say pusok ni itotonton toak a sikakabat, tan no panon so pamenben ko ed inkaatiw, anga ed agko nanengneng komon no anto so maong a nipaakar ed saray anak a lalaki na totoo a gawaen da ed leksab na tawen ed saray amin ya agew na panbilay da.
Nangawa ak ed siak na ankakabaleg a kimey; angipaalagey ak ed siak na saray abung; nantanem ak ed siak na saray uvasan:
Nangawa ak ed siak na saray tanamanan tan saray sasarangan, tan angitanem ak na kiekiew ed sikara ed saray amin a nengneng na bunga;
Nangawa ak ed siak na saray tanke na danum, pian manlapudman naparanuman so takel a saray kiew a tinoboan da;

Analiw ak na ariripen a lalaki tan bibii, tan walaan ak nen saman na ariripen a nianak ed abung ko; ontan met walaan ak na baleg a kaykayarian a bakbaka tan karcarnero, a lalo nen saray amin ya akaona nen siak ed Jerusalem;

Nantipon ak met na pilak tan balitok, tan say kayamanan na saray arari tan saray luyag; akagamor ak met na managcanta a lalaki tan bibii, tan saray ligliwa na saray anak a lalaki na totoo, kagkagawaan na togtog, tan ed amin na saray nengneng.
Dia ed ontan siak nen saman so baleg, tan minmunat ak a lalo nen saray amin ya akaona nen siak ed Jerusalem: ontan met say kakabatan ko nansiansia ed siak

Et angan anto a nanpilalekan na saray matak' agko ra mangananganan; agko pinokpokan so pusok manlapu ed angan anto a liket; ta say pusok nanliket lapu ed amin a kimey ko; et saya sikato nen saman so betang ko a manlapu ed amin a kimey ko.

Diad saman ninmengneng ak ed saray amin a gawa a ginawa na saray limak, tan ed kimey a nansagpotan ko a gawaen; et, nia, amin sikato nen saman so kaapaan, tan pangoosil ed dagem, tan angapo nen saman so tobo ed leksab na banwa.
Et linmingaw ak pian imanoen ko so kakabatan, tan inkatiwel, tan inkaatiw: ta ¿anto so nayarian na too a gawaen ya ontombok ed ari? say agawa lanlamang sanen abayag la.
Diad saman anengneng ko a say kakabatan talonaan to so inkaatiw, unong a say liwawa talonaan to so kabilungtan.
Saray mata na makabat a too wala ra ed olo to, tan say maatiw manakar ed kabilungtan, et angan ontan alikas ko a sakey ya agawa palabasen da ya amin.
Diad saman inkuan ko ed pusok, singa nagawa ed maatiw, ontan so nagawa met ed siak, et ¿akin sirin a siak nen saman so lalo a makabat? Diad saman inkuan ko ed pusok, a saya met sikato so kaapaan.

Ta ed makabat a too, singa met lanlamang ed maatiw, angapo so pakanonot lawas; bangta dia ed saray agew ya onsabi amin abayag la ya alingoanan. Et ¿abagey la a say makabat a too ompatey a singa lanlamang say maatiw!
Dia ed ontan ginulak so bilay, lapu ed say gawa ya agawa ed leksab na banwa sikato nen saman so ambelat ed siak; ta amin sikato so kaapaan tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Et ginulak so amin a kimey ko a nankimeyan ko ed leksab na banwa bangta sikato komon so pinaulian ko ed too ya ontombok ed siak.

Et ¿siopa ta so mikabat no sikato naani makabat a too odino maatiw? angan ontan walaan ta naani pakauley to ed amin a kimey a nankimeyan ko, tan angipatnagan ko na inkasiak a makabat ed leksab na banwa. Saya met sikato so kaapaan.
Kanian pinmawil ak pian say pusok agko panilaloen a nipaakar ed amin a kimey a nankimeyan ko ed leksab na banwa.
Ta wala so too a say kimey to wala ed kakabatan, tan pakatalos, tan karonongan; angan ontan ed too ya ag nankimey diman napaulian a panagkabetang to. Saya met sikato so kaapaan tan baleg ya uges.
Ta ¿anto so wala ed too ed amin a kimey to, tan ed pangoosil na puso to, ed nankimeyan to ed lepsag na banwa?
Ta amin iray agew to sikara lambengat so ermen, tan say irap to sikato so sinagem; on, angan dia ed labi say puso to ag makapainawa. Saya met sikato so kaapaan.

Angapo so bengatla a magmaong nipaakar ed too nen say pangan to tan yinom to, tan pangawa to ed kamarerwa to a manliket a maong ed kimey to. Saya met anengneng ko, a sikato so nanlapu ed lima na Dios.
Ta ¿siopa so makapangan, odino siopa so makapanliket, a lalo nen siak?

Ta say too a makapaliket ed sikato itdan na Dios na kakabatan, tan pakatalos, tan liket; balet ed managkasalanan mangiter na irap, pian mantipon tan manbonton, pian niiter to ed saman so mamapaliket ed Dios. Saya met sikato so kaapaan tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Nipaakar ed amin a bengatla wala so sakey a panaon, tan sakey a panaon nipaakar ed balang pegdat ed leksab na tawen:
Panaon a kianak, tan panaon ya ipatey; panaon a pantanem, tan panaon a pamagot ed intanem;
Panaon a pamatey, tan panaon a panambal; panaon a pangigeba, tan panaon a pamaalagey;
Panaon a pannangis, tan panaon a panelek; panaon a panagogol, tan panaon a pansayaw;
Panaon a pangibantak ed saray bato, tan panaon a pantipon ed saray bato; panaon a panayakop, tan panaon ya ag panayakop;
Panaon a pananap, tan pananap a pakabalang; panaon a pangawalo, tan panaon a pangibantak;
Panaon a panpilat, tan panaon a pandait; panaon ya ag yesel, tan panaon a pansalita;
Panaon a pangaro, tan panaon a pangula; panaon nipaakar ed bakal, tan panaon nipaakar ed deen.
¿Anto so tobo na mangawa dia ed saman so pansagpotan to?
Anengneng ko so irap a initer na Dios ed saray anak a lalaki na totoo pian napasal ira ed sikato.
Ginawa to so balang bengatla a marakep ed panaon to: ontan met inpasen to so kaandoan ed puso ra, angan ontan say too agto natontonan so gawa a ginawa na Dios a manlapu ed gapu anga ed sampot.
Amtak ya angapo so bengatla a magmaong nipaakar ed sikara, nen say panliket, tan pangawa na maong ed leleg na panbilay da.
Et ontan met a balang too mangan tan oninom, tan manliket a maong ed amin a kimey to, sikato so pamalangkap na Dios.
Amtak ya, angan anto a gawaen na Dios, sikato naani lawas: angapo so niyan ed sikato, angapo met so naekal ed sikato pian saray totoo ontakot ira ed arap to.
Say wala natan wala nen saman ya abayag la: say onwala ni sikato so wala nen saman ya abayag la; et say Dios anapen to nen saman lamet so linmabas la.
Et lalo ni anengneng ko ed leksab na banwa, dia ed pasen na inkatunong, a say karelmengan wala nen saman diman; et dia ed pasen na inkaptek, a say karelmengan wala nen saman diman.
Inkuan ko ed pusok, Say Dios okomen to naani so maptek tan marelmeng; ta wala so panaon diman nipaakar ed balang pegdat tan nipaakar ed balang gawa.
Inkuan ko ed pusok, Sikato so ontan lapu ed saray anak a lalaki na totoo, pian say Dios nasali to ra, tan nanengneng da a sikara lanlamang sikara lambengat so saray ayep.

Ta say nagawa ed saray anak a lalaki na totoo nagawa ed saray ayep; sakey lanlamang a bengatla so nagawa ed sikara: singa say sakey ompatey, ontan met ompatey so sakey; on, walaan ira ya amin na sakey a panlinawa: et say too andian na katageyan ed saray ayep: ta amin sikato so kaapaan.
Amin onla ed sakey a pasen; amin nanlapu ed dabok, tan amin ompawil ed dabok lamet.
¿Siopa so mikabat ed espiritu na too, no mamatagey, tan say espiritu na ayep, no mamaleksab ed dalin?

Kanian anengneng ko ya angapo so bengatla a magmaong, nen say panliket na too ed saray gawa to; ta satan sikato so betang to: ta ¿siopa so mangipawil ed sikato pian nengnengen to no anto so wala naani ed kayari to?

Diad saman pinmawil ak tan anengneng ko so saray amin a panamasegsegang a nagagawa ed leksab na banwa; et, nia, saray lua na saray naaposan, tan andian ira na managligliwa; et dia ed abay na saray manangapos da wala nen saman so pakayari; balet andian ira na managligliwa.
Kanian indayew ko so saray inaatey ya inatey ira ya abayag la a lalo nen saray mabilay a mabilay nira;
On, magmaong nen sikara a nanpadpara pinablik so angapo ni, ya agto anengneng so mauges a gawa a nagawa ed leksab na banwa.
Diad saman anengneng ko so amin a kimey tan balang mabmabig a gawa, a nipaakar ed saya say too sibletan na kaabay to. Saya met sikato so kaapaan tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Say maatiw pandakopen to so saray lima to, tan kanen to so dili a laman to.
Magmaong so sankaakop, a tekep na kareenan, nen duaran kaakop a tekep na sagpot tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Diad saman pinmawil ak tan anengneng ko so kaapaan ed leksab na banwa.

Wala so sakey a sikato so manbokbokor, tan sikato so andian na kadua; on, sikato andian na anak a laki odino agi a laki; angan ontan angapo so sampot na amin a kimey to, angan saray mata to ag ira napesel ed saray kayamanan. Ta ¿nipaakar ed siopa sirin, kuan to, so pankimeyan ko, tan pangisebel ko na maong ed kamarerwak? Saya met sikato so kaapaan, on, sikato so makapasinagem ya irap.
Say duara sikara so magmaong nen sakey, lapu ed walaan ira na maong a tumang nipaakar ed kimey da.
Ta no nipasag ira, say sakey bangonen to so kapara to; balet kasi la so bokbokor sano nipasag, tan andian na sananey a mamangon ed sikato.
Ontan lamet ni, no saray duara mankaakdol ira, sirin manpetangan ira; balet ¿panon so panpapetang na bokbokor?
Et no say sakey a too ontalona ed saman so bokbokor, saray duara ontanyereg ira ed sikato; et say tinalo a lubir sikato so ag maganggano a napoltot.
Magmaong so duka tan makabat ya ugaw nen say masiken tan maatiw ya ari, ya agto amta ya awaten so pananimbawa la.
Ta manlapu ed panangipangawan sikato so ompaway a man-ari; on, angan dia ed nanarian to nianak nen saman a duka.
Anengneng ko so amin a mabilay a manaakar ed leksab na banwa ya wala ra ed kaugawan, a komadua, ya inmalagey dia ed pasen to.
Angapo nen saman so sampot na amin a baley, angan ed saray amin a nasasakopan to: angan ontan saray ontombok ag ira manliket ed sikato. Petepeteg a saya met sikato so kaapaan tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Dangkaan mo so salim sano onla ka ed abung na Dios; ta say yaasinger a pandengel sikato so magmaong nen pangiter na bagat na saray maatiw: ta agda amta a mangawa ra na mauges.

Agka manbengatbengat ed sangim, tan agmo paulian so pusom a manganat a mangibesngaw na angan anto ed arap na Dios; ta say Dios wala ed tawen, tan sika wala ka ed tapew na dalin: kanian saray salitam matalag ira komon.
Ta sakey a kugip onsabi a pati dakerakel a gawa, tan say voces na maatiw mantekep na dakel a salsalita.
Sano mangisipan ka na sakey a sipan ed Dios, agmo ilaron a sumpalen; ta andian na liket ed saray maatiw: sumpalen mo so sipan mo.
Magmaong ya agka mangisipan, nen say mangisipan ka tan agmo sumpalen.

Agmo itepel a say sangim pankasalananen to so laman mo; agmo met ikuan ed arap na angel, a sikato nen saman so sakey a lingo: ¿akin ta a say Dios onsanok ed voces mo, tan bagbagen to so gawa na saray limam?
Ta dia ed kinaraklan na saray kugip wala ra so kaapaan, tan dia ed saray dakel a salita; balet takotan mo so Dios.

No nanengneng mo so kaaposan na duka, tan say pasoot a panangekal na tunong tan kaptekan ed sakey a luyag, agka nikelawan ed kanonotan: ta sakey ya atagtagey nen atagey so maniimaton; et wala ra so atagtagey nen sikara.
Laot ni say tobo na dalin sikato so nipaakar ed amin: ya ari lanlamang panlinkoran ed panamegley na uma.
Say mangaro ed pilak ag napesel ed pilak; odino say mangaro ed daakan, ag napesel ed munat: saya met sikato so kaapaan.
Sano saray kayarian namunat ira, ondakel so saray mangan ed sikara; et ¿anto so nabang ya wala ed akankien, nilikod so panimaton to ed sikara ed saray mata to?
Say ugip na mankikimey a too sikato so masamit, mangan na daiset odino dakel; balet say inkapno na mayaman ag mangitepel ed sikato ya onugip.
Wala so ambelat a mauges ya anengneng ko ed leksab na banwa, salanli, saray kayamanan ya inyatol na akankayarian makaderal ed sikato:
Et saraman a kayamanan natawtaw ira ed panamegley na mauges ya onsabi; et no nanilalak na sakey ya anak a laki, angapo so bengatla ed lima to.
Unong ed inpaway to a manlapu ed eges nen ina to, lakseb ya onla lamet a singa insabi to nen saman, tan ag mangala na bengatla a nipaakar ed kimey to, a nayarian to ya itarok ed lima to.
Et saya met sikato so ambelat a mauges, a dia ed saray amin a nengneng na singa insabi to, ontan onla naani: et ¿anto so tobo na mankimey nipaakar ed dagem?
Amin iray agew to met mangan ed kabilungetan, tan napairap a makapasinagem, tan walaan na sakit tan sanok.

Nia, saman so anengneng ko a maong tan marakep nipaakar ed sakey sikato so pangan tan yinom, tan panliket a maong ed amin a kimey to, a pankimeyan to ed leksab na banwa, ed saray amin ya agew na panbilay to a say Dios initer to ed sikato: ta saya sikato so betang to.

Balang too met ya angitdan na Dios na saray kayamanan tan kayarian, tan sikato so initdan to na pakayari a mangan ed sikato, tan mangala ed betang to, tan manliket ed kimey to saya sikato so pamalangkap na Dios.
Ta agto nanonotan a maong so saray agew na bilay to; lapu ed say Dios onebat ed sikato ed liket na puso to.
Wala so mauges ya anengneng ko ed leksab na banwa, tan sikato so ambelat ed saray totoo:

Sakey a too ya initdan na Dios na kaykayamanan, kayarian, tan dayew, dia ed ontan ya ag mankulang na bengatla nipaakar ed kamarerwa to ed amin a panpilalekan to, angan ontan sikato so ag initdan na Dios na pakayari a mangan ed sikato, no ag ingen sikato so kanen na sankaili; saya sikato so kaapaan, tan sikato so mauges a sakit.

No say sakey a too manilalak na sanlasus ya anak, tan manbilay na dakerakel a taon, dia ed ontan a saray agew na saray taon to sikara so dakel, balet say kamarerwa to ag napno ed maong, tan arum ni andian na pangiponponan; kuan ko, a say anak a naekal sikato so magmaong nen sikato:
Ta onsabi dia ed kaapaan, tan onsipot dia ed kabilungetan, tan say ngaran to nasakbongan ed kabilungetan;
Laot ni agto anengneng so banwa odino sikato so agto naamtaan; saya walaan na painawa a lalo nen say sakey:
On, angan mabilay a sanlibo a taon a mamidua a nabilang, tan angan ag manliket a maong, ¿ag onla ya amin'ta ed sakey a pasen?
Amin a kimey na too sikato so nipaakar ed sangi to, et angan ontan say pakapapangan sikato so ag napano.
¿Ta anto ta so panalonggaringan na makabat ed maatiw? odino ¿anto ta so wala ed duka a too, ya amta to no panon so panakar ed arap na saray mabilay?
Magmaong so pakanengneng na saray mata nen say panakarakar na pilalek: saya met sikato so kaapaan tan pangoosil ed dagem.
Angan anto ya wala nen saman, say ngaran to niiter ya abayag la; et naamtaan a sikato so too; agto met nayarian so misangsangan ed lalo a makapanyari nen sikato.
Bangta wala so dakerakel a bengabengatla a mamarakel ed kaapaan, ¿anto so too a magmaong?

Ta ¿siopa so mikabat no anto so maong a nipaakar ed too dia ed bilay to, amin iray agew na maapa a bilay to a dinarak to a singa anino? Ta ¿siopa so makapangibaga ed / too no anto naani ed sagmonor to ed leksab na banwa?
Say sakey a maong a ngaran sikato so;. magmaong nen say mabli a larak; tan say agew na ipatey, nen say agew na kianak.
Magmaong so yakar ed abung a panagogolan nen say yakar ed abung a panlike tan: ta satan sikato so kasumpalan na amin a totoo; et say mabilay sikato so igaton to ed puso to.
Say sinagem sikato so magmaong nen panelek; ta ed panamegley na ermen na lupa say puso napaliket.
Say puso na makabat wala ed abung na panagogolan: baleg say puso na saray maatiw wala ed abung na liket.
Magmaong a denglen so panamaat na makabat, nen sakey a too ya ondengel ed canta na saray maatiw.
Ta singa say tagatag na sabisabit ed leksab na banga, ontan so panelek na maatiw: saya met sikato so kaapaan.
Petepeteg a say panpalalo gawaen to so makabat a too a maatiw; et say panoksok bagbagen to so pakatalos.
Magmaong so sampot na sakey a bengatla nen say gapo to; et say maanos ed espiritu sikato so magmaong nen say mapangta ed espiritu.
Agka manganat ed pusom a manpasnok; ta say sanok onteen ed akualan na saray maatiw.
Agmo kuan, ¿Anto so sengeg a saray akaona ya agew sikara so magmaong nen saraya? ta agmo opapeten a makabkabat so nipaakar ed saya.
Say kakabatan sikato so maong a singa sakey a tawir; on, lalo a sikato so atagey nipaakar ed saray makanengneng ed banwa.
Ta say kakabatan sikato so sakey a sakorong, singa met say kuarta sakey a sakorong, balet say katageyan na pikakabat sikato, a say kakabatan kawaloen to so bilay na walaan ed sikato.
Pakaisipen mo so gawa na Dios: ta ¿siopa so makapetek ed pinikewet to?

Dia ed agew na kaaliguasan manliket ka, tan dia ed agew na kairapan mannonot ka; on, say Dios ginawa to a manabay so sakey tan sakey, ed sampot a say too agto naromog so angan anto ya wala naani ed kayari to.
Amin ya anengneng ko dia ed saray agew ko a kaapaan wala so maptek a too a natawtaw ed kaptekan to, tan wala so marelmeng a too a magnayon so bilay to ed mauges a kagagawa to.
Agka manpetek ya alabas; agmo met gawaen so inkasika ya alabas a makabat ¿akin ta a bagbagen mo so inkasika?
Agka alabas komon a marelmeng, agka met komon maatiw ¿akin ta ya ompatey ka ed unaaa na panaon mo?
Maong a benbenan mo so saya; on, manlapu ed satan met agmo pikosen so limam ta say antakot ed Dios ompaway a manlapu ed sikara ya amin.
Say kakabatan sikato so sakey a biskeg ed makabat a too a lalo nen samploran manuley ya wala ra ed ciudad.
Petepeteg angapo so maptek a too ed tapew na dalin a mangawa na maong, tan ag mankasalanan.
Ontan met agmo imanoen so saray amin a salita ya asalita, ompan narengel mo so aripen mo ya ayewen to ka;
Ta mabetbet met a say dilim a puso amta to a sika lanlamang inayew mo met so saray arum.
Amin so saya sinalik ed kakabatan: inkuan ko, Makabat ak naani; balet sikato nen saman so arawi a manlapu ed siak.
Say wala, sikato so arawi tan alabas so kaaralem; ¿siopa so makaromog ed sikato?

Pinmawilak, tan say pusok nipasen a mangamta tan mangosisa, tan mananap na kakabatan tan say sengeg na bengabengatla, tan pian amtaen ko a say karelmengan sikato so kaatiwan, tan say inkaatiw sikato so inkaatiwel.

Et naromog ko ni a lalo ya ampait nen say patey so bii a say puso to sikato so kalokalot tan iket tan saray lima to sikara so pamalor: angan siopa a mamaliket ed Dios makabatik a manlapu ed sikato; balet say managkasalanan naerel ed sikato.
Nia, saya so aromog ko, kuan na Managpolong, sanen igaton ko so sakey a bengatla ed sananey, pian naromog ko so sengeg;
Ya anapen ni na kamarerwak, balet agko aromog: sakey a too ed sanlibo aromog ko; balet sakey a bii ed saraman ya amin agko aromog.
Nia, saya lambengat so aromog ko: a say Dios ginawa to so too a maptek; balet sikara nananap ira na dakerakel a palpaltaw.
¿Siopa so singa say makabat a too? tan ¿siopa so mikabat na kabaliksan na sakey a bengatla? Say kakabatan na too paliwawaen to so lupa to, tan say kuliseng na lupa to nasalatan.
Siak simbawaen ta ka, Unoren mo so gangan na ari, tan say pangimaton ed samba na Dios.
Agka manganat ya ompaway a manlapu ed arap to; agka mankapilitan dia ed mauges a bengatla: ta gawaen to so angan anto a makapaliket ed sikato.
Ta say salita na ari walaan na pakayari: et ¿siopa so makapangikuan ed sikato, Anto so gawaen mo?
Angan siopa a mangunor ed gangan agto naamtaan so mauges a bengatla; et say puso na makabat a too pandumaen to so panaon tan pangokom;
Ta dia ed balang kanonotan wala so panaon tan pangokom; lapu ed say kairapan na too sikato so baleg ed sikato:
Ta agto amta so wala naani; ta ¿siopa so makapangibaga ed sikato no panon to naani?

Angapo so too ya walaan na pakayari ed tapew na espiritu pian abalaen to so espiritu; andian met na pakayari ed agew na ipatey; et angapo so panangipolisay ed bakal: say karelmengan agto met niiter ed sikato.
Amin so saya anengneng ko, tan inpakep ko so pusok ed balang gawa ya agawa ed leksab na banwa: wala so sakey a panaon a sakey a too walaan na pakayari ed sananey pian kaugsan to.
Dia ed ontan anengneng ko so saray marelmeng a niponpon, tan linma ra ed lubok; et saray nangawa na maptek tinainan da so masanto a pasen, tan alingoanan ira ed ciudad: saya met sikato so kaapaan.
Ta say totol sumpa ed mauges a gawa sikato so ag nasumpal a magangano, lapu ed say puso na saray anak a lalaki na totoo sikato so naskey ed sikara a mangawa na mauges.
Angan say managkasalanan mangawa na mauges a maminlasus, tan parukeyen so saray agew to, angan ontan petepeteg amtak a maong naani ed saray antakot ed Dios, ta antakot ira ed arap to;
Balet aliwa naani a maong ed marelmeng, ag met naparukey so saray agew to, a sikara so singa anino; lapu ed ag antakot ed arap na Dios.

Wala so kaapaan a nagawa ed tapew na dalin, ya wala ra so maptek a totoo ya dia ed sikara nagawa so unong ed gawa na marelmeng; ontan met, wala ra so marelmeng a totoo ya dia ed sikara nagawa so unong ed gawa na saray maptek: inkuan ko a saya met sikato so kaapaan.

Diad saman binilin ko so liket, lapu ed say too andian na magmaong a bengatla ed leksab na banwa, nen say pangan, tan say yinom, tan say panliket; ta satan mansiansia ed sikato ed kimey to ed saray amin ya agew na panbilay to a say Dios initer to ed sikato ed leksab na banwa.
Sanen inpakep ko so pusok a mangamta ed kakabatan, tan onnengneng ed saray kimey ya agawa ed tapew na dalin (ta wala met so angan dia ed agew odino labi agda nanengneng so ugip ed saray mata ra),

Diad saman inimanok so amin a gawa na Dios, a say too agto atontonan so gawa ya agawa ed leksab na banwa: lapu ed angan panon karakel so pansagpot na too a mananap ed sikato, angan ontan sikato so agto naromog; arum ni, angan say makabat a too isipen to ya amtaen, angan ontan sikato so ag masarag naani a makaromog ed sikato.

Nipaakar ed saya ya amin ingaton ko ed pusok, salanti pian anapen ko so saya ya amin: a say maptek, tan say makabat, tan saray gawa ra, wala ra ed lima na Dios; no sikato so naaro odino nagula, say too sikato so agto amta; amin wala ed arap da.

Amin a bengatla onsabi a nanpadpara ed amin: wala so sakey a nagawa ed maptek tan ed marelmeng; ed maong tan ed malinis tan ed marutak; ed manbagat tan ed ag manbagat; singa say maong, ontan so managkasalanan; et say mansamba, singa say antakot ed samba.

Saya sikato so sakey a mauges ed amin ya agawa ed leksab na banwa, ya wala so sakey a nagawa ed amin: ontan met, say puso na saray anak a lalaki na totoo sikato so napno ed mauges, tan say kaatiwelan wala ed puso ra leleg a manbilay ira, tan kayari ya onla ra ed patey.
Nipaakar ed saman so nitipon ed amin a mabilay wala so ilalo; ta say mabilay ya aso sikato so magmaong nen say inatey a leon.
Ta saray mabilay amta ra a sikara ompatey ira: balet saray inaatey agda amta so bengatla, ag ira met nawalaan la na tumang; ta say pakanonot ed sikara alingoanan.
No panon so aro ra, ontan so gula ra tan siblet da, atawtaw ya abayag la; andian ira la na betang lawas dia ed angan anto ya agawa ed leksab na banwa.
Onla ka ed dalan mo, kanen mo so tinapay mo a sililiket, tan inomenmo so alak mo ed malikeliket a puso; ta say Dios inako to la so saray gawam.
Amputi komon a naynay so saray kawes mo; et agmo paulian a say olom mankulang na larak.

Miamong ka a malikeliket ed asawa ya inarom ed saray amin ya agew na bilay mo a kaapaan, ya initer to ed sikato ed leksab na banwa, ed saray amin ya agew mo a kaapaan: ta satan sikato so betang mo ed bilay, tan dia ed kimey mo a nansagpotan mo ed leksab na banwa.
