Angan anto a say limam naromog to a gawaen, sikato so gawaen mo ed pakapanyarim; ta angapo so gawa, no kanonotan, no pakaamta, no kakabatan, dia ed Sheol, a laen mo.

Pinmawil ak, tan anengneng ko ed leksab na banwa, a say lumba andi ed saray masiglat, odino say bakal ed saray mabiskeg, angan say tinapay met ed makabat, angan saray kayamanan met ed totoo a makatalos, angan say pamalangkap met ed totoo a matalabit; balet say panaon tan kapalaran nagawa ed sikara ya amin.

Ta say too met agto amta so panaon to: singa saray sira a naala dia ed mauges ya iket, tan singa saray manok a naerel dia ed kalot, ontan met so saray ának a lalaki na totoo nakalotan ira ed mauges a panaon, sano napelag a bigla ed sikara.
Anengneng ko met so kakabatan ed leksab na banwa ed saya a nengneng, tan sikato so ingaton ko a baleg:
Wala nen saman so melag a ciudad, tan pigara a totoo ed dalem to: et sinmabi so baleg ya ari sumpa ed sikato, tan sikato so kinobkob to, tan angipaalagey na ankakabaleg a pakdaal sumpa ed sikato.
Bang nen saman aromog dia ed sikato so sakey a duka a makabat a too, tan sikato ed panamegley na kakabatan to inlaban to so ciudad; angan ontan angapo so too ya akanonot ed saman a duka a too.
Diad saman inkuan ko, Say kakabatan sikato so magmaong nen say biskeg: angan ontan say kakabatan na duka a too sikato so namodmora, tan saray salita to ag ira pakadenglen.
Saray salita na makabat a narengel ed mareen sikara so magmaong nen say akis na manuley ed saray maatiw.
Say kakabatan sikato so magmaong nen saray ayura na bakal; balet say sakey a makasalanan bagbagen to so dakel a maong.
Saray inaatey ya apangat gawaen da so larak na managbalingit a nabolok tan mamapaway na mauges ya angob: ontan so melag a kaatiwan misimbangan ed kakabatan tan dayew.
Say puso na makabat a too wala ed kawanan a lima to; balet say puso na maatiw ed kawigi to.
Ontan met, sano say maatiw manakar ed dalan, say pakatalos to onkulang ed sikato, tan kuan to ed balang sakey ya sikato so maatiw.
No say espiritu na makauley onbangon sumpa ed sika, agmo paulian so pasen mo; ta say kaoyamoan pareenen to so ankakabaleg a panamaunong.
Wala so sakey a mauges ya anengneng ko ed leksab na banwa, a singa sikato so sakey a lingo a manlapu ed makauley:
Say kaatiwan nipasen ed baleg a kakanaan, tan say mayaman manyorong ed abeba a pasen.
Anengneng ko so saray ariripen ed tapew na saray kabayo, tan saray principe a manaakar a singa saray ariripen ed tapew na dalin.
Say mangotkot na abot napelag ed sikato; et angan siopa a mamutaw na bakor, sikato so kalaten naani na uleg.
Angan siopa a mampanday na batobato nasakitan naanid' tan et say mamisag na kiew maatap naani ed sikato.
No say balatyang naepel, tar. say sakey agto obolen so tarem, sirin nepeg to ya yan so lalo a biskeg: balet say kakabatan sikato so napinabangan a mangitonton.
No say uleg mangalat ed arapen a naibawanen, sirin angapo so napinabangan ed ibawanen.
Saray salita na sangi na makabat a too sikara so malikeliket; balet saray bibil na maatiw akmonen da so inka sikato.
Say gapu na saray salita na sangi to sikato so kaatiwan; et say angaan na pansalita to sikato so makapauges ya inkaatiwel.
Say maatiw met parakelen to so saray salita; angan ontan say too agto amta no anto so wala naani; et saman so wala naani ed kayari to, ¿siopa so makapangibaga ed sikato?
Say sagpot na saray maatiw pakapoyen to so balang sakey ed sikara; ta agto amta no panon so yakar ed ciudad.
¡ Kasika la, O dalin, sano say arim sikato so sakey ya ugaw, tan saray principem mangan ira ed kabuasan!
¡Mapalar ka, O dalin, sano say arim sikato so anak na saray angkabli, tan saray principem mangan ira ed makana a panaon, nipaakar ed biskeg, tan ag nipaakar ed inkabuek!
Lapu ed inkangiras say atep nageba; et lapu ed inkakapuy na saray lima say abung manterter.
Say liket sikato so nagawa nipaakar ed elek, tan say alak panliketen to so bilay; et say kuarta ebatanto so amin a bengabengatla.

Agka ontunganga ed ari, andi, angan dia ed kanonotan mo; et agka ontunganga ed mayaman ed dokolan mo a silir; ta sakey a manok na saray tawen yakar to so voces, tan saray walaan na payapayak ibaga ra naani so kanonotan.
Ibantak mo so tinapay mo ed tapew na saray danum; ta sikato so naromog mo ed kayari na saray dakel ya agew.
Mangiter ka na apag ed pito ra, on, ed walo ra ni; ta agmo amta no anto a mauges so wala naani ed tapew na dalin.
No saray lurem napno ed uran, onibung ira ed tapew na dalin; et no nageba so kiew a dapit abalaten, no dapit amianen, dia ed pasen a nigebaan na kiew, sikato so wala naanid man.
Say mangimaton ed dagem ag mantanem naani; et say mangimatlek ed saray lurem ag naani manani.
Unong ya agmo amta no anto so dalan na dagem, no panon so itobo na saray pukel ed eges na malokon; ontan met agmo amta so gawa na Dios a sikato so manggawa ed amin.
Dia ed kabuasan itanem mo so binim, tan dia ed labi agmo ipiko so limam; ta agmo amta no anto so onaliguas, no saya kasi odino saman, no sikara kasi nampadpara naani a maong.
Petepeteg say liwawa sikato so masamit, tan makapaliket a bengatla nipaakar ed saray mata so inengneng ed banwa.

On, no say sakey a too manbilay ed dakerakel a taon, manliket komon dia ed sikara ya amin; balet pakanonoten to komon so saray agew na kabilungetan, ta sikara naani dakel. Amin ya onsabi sikato so maapa.

Mangayaga ka, O tobonbalo a laki, dia ed kaugawan mo, tan say pusom paliketen to ka komon ed saray agew na inkaugaw mo, tan manakarka ed saray dalan na pusom, tan dia ed pakanengneng na saray matam; balet amtaen mo, a lapu ed saraya ya amin a bengatla say Dios yakar to ka ed kaokom.
Kanian ekalen mo so ermen a manlapu ed pusom, tan iwaklit mo so mauges a manlapu ed laman mo; ta say inkaugaw tan katayatdang na bilay sikara so kaapaan.
Nonoten mo met so Manamalsam dia ed saray agew na inkaugaw mo, ed arapen a saray mauges ya agew onsabi, tan saray taon onasinger ira, sano ikuan mo, Andian ak na liket ed sikara:
Ed arapen a say banwa, tan say liwawa, tan say bulan, tan saray bitewen, ombilunget ira, tan saray lurem ompawil ira ed kayari uran;

Dia ed agew sano saray managbantay na abung mangiwgiw ira, tan saray mabiskeg a totoo onyoko ra, tan saray mangiling ontonda ra lapu ed sikara so daiset, tan saray ontandag ed saray dorongawen nabilungetan ira,
Tan saray pinto nikaput ira ed polong; sano say tanol na panaggiling sikato so abeba, tan say sakey onalagey ed oni na sakey a manok, tan amin iray anak a bibii na togtog napaabeba ra;

On, natakot ira ed saman so atagey, tan saray makapatakot wala ra naani ed dalan; et say almendro manbulaklak, tan say doron sikato naani awit, tan say pilalek onkulang naani; lapu ed say too onla ed maando ya abung, tan saray managogol onliber ira ed saray polong:
Ed arapen a say pilak a kawat napoltot, no say balitok a yaong napisit, no say boyog nabetag ed sobol, no say dalig nabuyak ed bobon.
Tan say dabok ompawil ed dalin a singa sikato nen saman, tan say espiritu ompawil ed Dios ya angiter ed sikato.
Kaapaan na saray kaapaan, kuan na Managpulong; amin sikato so kaapaan.
Et arum ni, lapu ed say Managpulong sikato nen saman so makabat, inbangat to a siansia so pikakabat ed baley; on, sikato tinalineng to, tan inosisa to, tan inoksoy to so dakerakel ya uliran.
Say Managpolong inosisa to ya inanap so saray makapaliket a salsalita, tan say nisulat nen saman a maptek, salanti salsalita a matua.
Saray salita na makabat sikara so singa panikil; tan singa saray pasak a nipasak so saray salita na saray kakatawan na saray tipon, a sikara so niiter a manlapu ed sakey a pastol.
Et arum ni, ana' ko, nasimbawaan ka, komon: say pangawa ed dakerakel a libro angapo so angaan; et say dakel ya aral sikato so sakey a belat na laman.
Saya sikato so angaan na kanonotan; amin, sikara so nadngel: Takotan mo so Dios, tan unoren mo so saray gangan to; ta saya sikato so katipunan na kanepegan na too.
Ta say Dios ipatnag to so balang gawa ed kaokom, pati balang inyamot a bengetla, no sikato kasi maong, odino sikato kasi mauges.
Say Canta na saray canta, a sikato so kien nen Salomon.
Angoban toak komon ed saray angob na sangi to; ta say arom sikato so magmaong nen alak.
Saray larak mo walaan ira na mabmabig a samiong; say ngaran mo sikato so singa larak ya inkal bo, kanian saray virgen aroen da ka.

Igoyor moak; ombati' kami naani ya ontombok ed sika: say ari inyakar toak ed dalem na saray silir to; mangayaga tan manliket kami ed sika; salitaen mi so arom a lalo nen say alak: matonotonong ya aroen da ka.
Andeket ak, balet malimgas ak, O sikayo anak ira na Jerusalem, singa saray tolda na Cedar, singa saray salimbeng nen Salomon.

Ag kayo onnengneng ed siak, lapu ed kayomangi ak, lapu ed say banwa tinektek to ak. Saray anak a lalaki nen inak nanpasnok ira a sumpa ed siak; ginawa ra ak a managbantay ed saray kauvasan; balet say dilin kauvasan ko agko binantayan.

Ibagam ed siak, O sika ya aroen na kamarerwak, ¿iner so pangipapakabkaban mo ed ayep mo, iner so pamainawaan mo ed sikato ed pegley agew: ta akin et singa ak sakey ya asakbongan ed abay na saray ayep na saray kaibam?
No agmo amta, O kalimgasan ed saray bibii, ompaway ka ed dalan mo ed saray bakat na ayayep, tan ipakabkab mo so saray kanding mo ed abay na saray tolda na saray pastol.
Inyaliling taka, O inarok, ed sakey a kabayo ed saray luganan nen Faraon.
Saray aping mo sikara so marakep ed saray laga na buek, say tenger mo ed saray baklaw ya agamil.
Igawaan mika na saray laga a balitok pati saray tompok a pilak.
Leleg a say ari manyorong ed dulang to, say tálak insamiong to so balingit to.
Say inarok sikato ed siak so singa sankaberber a mirra, ya ondokol ed leet na saray pagew ko.
Say inarok sikato ed siak so singa sankamonil a bolaklak na alhena dia ed saray kauvasan na Engadi.
Nia, malimgas ka, inarok; nia, malimgas ka; saray matam sikara so singa palekpek.
Nia, malimgas ka, inarok, on, makapaliket ka: ontan met say tandakan ta sikato so malambot.
Saray panoksolan na abung ta sikara so cedro, tan saray pagsen ta sikara so cipres.
Siak sakey ak a bulaklak na Saron, sakey a lirio ed saray lawak.
Singa sakey a lirio ed leet na saray sabit, ontan so inarok ed leet na saray anak a bibii.
Singa say manzana ed leet na kiewkiew ed takel, ontan so inarok ed leet na saray anak a lalaki. Imyorong ak ed leksab na sirom to ed baleg a liket, et say bunga to sikato so masamit ed pakananam ko.
Inyakar toak ed pandoroypoan ya abung, et say laylay to ed tagey ko sikato so aro.
Tagano yoak ed saray inpamaga ya uvas, palamisan yoak ed saray manzana; ta mabeblay ak ed aro.
Say kawigi a lima to wala ed leksab na olok, et say kawanan a lima to sayakopen toak.
Pansambaen ta kayo, O anak a bibii na Jerusalem, lapu ed saray corzo, no lapu ed saray ulsa ed uma, ya ag yo tenyegen, ag yo met liingen so arok, anga ed labay to.
¡Say voces na inarok! nia, onsabi, a manlokso ed tapew na saray palandey, a manloksolokso ed tapew na saray pokdol.
Say inarok sikato so singa corzo odino tobonbalo ya ulsa: nia, manalagey ed beneg na bakor tayo; onnengneng ed saray dorongawen; ontakiling ed panagtakilingan.
Say inarok nansalita, tan inkuan to ed siak, alagey ka, inarok, malimgas ko, tan ompaway ka.
Ta, nia, say ketel linmabas la; say uran ayari la tan iman la;
Saray bulaklak ompatnag ira ed dalin; say panaon na panagcanta na saray manok sinmabi la, tan say voces na malapati narengel ed dalin tayo;
Say kiew ya higos lotoen to so saray tariwa ya higos to, tan saray uvas manbulaklak ira; isamiong da so balingit da. Alagey ka, inarok, malimgas ko, tan ompaway ka.

O malapatik, ya wala ed saray letak na bato, dia ed amot na kalinsorong a pasen, ipanengneng mo pa ed siak so lupam, ipadngel mo ed siak so voces mo; ta masamit so voces mo, tan say lupam sikato so marakep.
Alam ed sikata so saray zorra, saray ankelag a zorra, a manderal ed saray uvasan; ta saray uvasan ta manbobolaklak ira.
Say inarok sikato so kien ko, tan siak kien toak; ipakabkab to so ayep to ed leet na saray lirio.
Anga ed say agew ombetel, tan saray anino ombatik, pawil ka, inarok, tan singa ka komon sakey a corzo odino tobonbalo ya ulsa ed tapew na saray palandey na Bether.
Dia ed labi ed dokolan ko inanap ko so inaro na kamarerwak; sikato so inanap ko, balet sikato so agko aromog.
Inkuan ko, Onalagey ak natan, tan liberen ko so ciudad; dia ed saray polong tan dia ed saray mapalaway a dalan anapen ko so inaro na kamarerwak: sikato so inanap ko, balet sikato so agko aromog.
Saray bantay ya onliber ed ciudad aromog da ak; a sikara so nankuanan ko, ¿Anengneng yo so inaro na kamarerwak?

Kalabas ko na daiset ed sikara, sanen aromog ko so inaro na kamarerwak: sikato so inegnaan ko, tan sikato so agko pinaulian ya onla, anga ed sikato so inyakar ko ed abung nen inak, tan ed silir na saman so angilokan ed siak.
Pansambaen ta kayo, O anak a bibii na Jerusalem, lapu ed saray corzo, odino lapu ed saray ulsa ed uma, pian agyo tenyegen, no liingeii so inarok, anga ed kaliktan to.
¿Siopa ya so ontatatdang a manlapu ed kalawakan a singa saray seklang ya asewek, a nanbalingit na mirra tan incienso, pati saray amin a tapong na managlako?
Nia, sikato so dokolan nen Salomon; anemaplo a makapanyari a lalaki so akaliber ed sikato, ed saray makapanyari a lalaki na Israel.
Sikara ya amin nanegna ra na kampilan, tan maronong ira ed bakal: balang laki walaan na kampilan ed tapew na ulpo to, lapu ed takot ed labi.
Si ari Salomon nangawa ed sikato na palankin a kiew na Libano.
Ginawa to so saray seklang to a pilak, say sasaralan to balitok, say yorongan to purpura, say pegley to tinandakanan ed aro, manlapu ed saray anak a bibii na Jerusalem.

Ompaway kayo, O sikayo anak a bibii na Sion, tan nengnengen yo si ari Salomon, ya akabalanget ed imbalanget nen ina to ed sikato dia ed agew na inpanbansal to, tan dia ed agew na inkagayaga na puso to.

Nia, sika malimgas ka, inarok; nia, sika malimgas ka; saray matam sikara so singa malapati ed beneg na pandong mo. Say buek mo sikato so singa polok na saray kanding, a manpainawa ed daligdig na palandey Galaad.
Saray ngipen mo sikara so singa polok na oveja a kapangatli, ya ontatdang ira ed amesan, balang sakey walaan na siping, tan angapo so managogol ed sikara.
Saray bibil mo sikara so singa inaramey ya escarlata, tan say sangim sikato so marakep. Saray aping mo sikara so singa pisag a granada ed beneg na pandong mo.
Say tenger mo sikato so singa say ilang nen David nipaalagey a nipaakar a panagayuraan, ya dia ed sikato nisabit so sanlibo a panagamper, amin iray kinlong na saray makapanyari a lalaki.
Saray duaran pagew mo sikara so singa duara a kilaw ya ulsa a sikara so siping na sakey a kubilang, a mankabkab ed utel na saray lirio.
Anga ed say agew ombetel, tan saray anino ombatik, onla ak ed palandey na mirra, tan ed pokdol na incienso.
Sika tua a malimgas ka, inarok; et angapo so kabalawan ed sika.

Mila ka ed siak a manlapu ed Libano, noviak, pati siak a manlapu ed Libano: nengneng ka a manlapu ed toktok na Amana, manlapu ed toktok na Senir tan Hermon, manlapu ed ongib na saray leon, manlapu ed saray palandey na saray leopardo.
Sinigpot mo so pusok; agik a bii, noviak; sinigpot mo so pusok ed sakey a limgis na saray matam, ed sakey a baklaw na tenger mo.
¡Agay lay dakep na arom, agik a bii, noviak! Agay lay abig na arom nen say alak! Tan say samiong na saray larak mo nen amin ya olibay na saray balingit!
Saray bibil mo, O noviak, manimey ira a singa kolaba na dilo: dilo tan gatas wala ra ed leksab na dilam; et say angob na saray kawes mo sikato so singa angob na Libano.
Sakey a tanamanan a sinikop so agik, say noviak; sakey a kolos a tinanggal, sakey a sobol a tinatakan.
Saray simit mo sikara so tanamanan na granada, pati angkabli a bungabunga; Alhenas pati tála a tantanaman.
Tála tan kolalaw, kalamus tan cinamomo, pati amin a kiekiew na incienso; mirra tan aloe, pati saray amin a manunaan a balingit.
Sika sakey ka a sobol na tantanamanan, sakey a bobon na saray mabilay a danum, tan managagos a kolos a manlapu ed Libano.
Liing ka, O amian; tan gala, sika abagat; sibok kayo ed tanamanan ko, pian saray balingit to mansamiong. Onloob komon so inarok ed tanamanan to, tan mangan na saray mabli a bunga to.

Linmoob ak ed tanamanan ko, agik a bii, noviak; tinipon ko so mirrak pati balingit ko; kinan ko so kolabak pati say dilok; ininom ko so alak ko pati say gatas ko. Mangan kayo, O kakaaro; oninum kayo, on, oninum kayo ed daakan, O inaro.

Naugipak nen saman, balet say pusok aliing: sikato so voces na inarok ya ompatok, a kuan to, lukasan moak, agik, inarok, malapatik, ayadyarik; ta say olok napno na linaew, saray buek ko ed saray terter na labi.
Inokpos ko so kawes ko; ¿panon so pangisolong ko ed sikato? Inurasan ko so saray salik; ¿panon so pangiduta' ko ed sikara?
Say inarok inkaot to so lima to ed abut na pinto, et atenyeg so pusok nipaakar ed sikato.
Inmalagey ak pian lukasan ko ed inarok; et saray limak nanterter ira na mirra, tan saray tamorok ed atunaw a mirra, ed tapew na saray panangegnaan na balewet.

Nilukasan ko ed inarok; balet say inarok pinmawil, tan iman la. Say kamarerwak inmandi sanen nansalita: sikato so inanap ko, balet sikato so agko aromog; sikato so tinawagan ko, balet ag toak inebatan.
Saray bantay a linmiber ed ciudad aromog da ak, kinabil da ak, sinugatan da ak; saray bantaybakor inokpos da so sokbong ko ed siak.
Pansambaenta kayo, O anak a bibii na Jerusalem, no naromog yo so inarok, pian ibaga yo ed sikato, ya mabeblay ak ed aro.
¿Anto so inarom a lalo nen say sananey ya inaro, o sika kalimgasan ed saray bibii? ¿Anto so inarom a lalo nen say sananey ya inaro, pian pansambaen mo kami na ontan?
Say inarok sikato so ampoti tan ambalanga, a sankamanunaan ed saray samplon libo.
Say olo to sikato so singa kasurian a balitok; saray buek to sikara so manbuskag, tan andeket a singa wawak.
Saray mata to singa ra malapati ed abay na saray kolos, a nanames ira ed gatas, tan nipasen ira a matokotokoy.
Saray aping to sikara so singa sankamonil a balingit, singa abonton a masamit a dika: saray bibil to sikara so singa lirio, a manterter na atunaw a mirra.
Saray lima to sikara so singa saray singsing a balitok a nantompok na topacio: say kabalgan to sikato so singa gawa a garing ya atatakan ed saray safiro.
Saray bitking to sikara so singa sekseklang a marmol, a nipasen ed tapew na saray panangiletnegan a dalisay a balitok: say ereng to sikato so singa Libano, atagey a singa saray cedro.
Say sangi to sikato so sankasamitan; on, simoon ya aroen. Saya sikato so inarok, tan saya sikato so kaarok, o anak a bibii na Jerusalem.
¿Iner so nila na inarom, o sika sankalimgasan ed saray bibii? ¿iner so pinawilan na inarom, pian sikato so anapen mi a pati sika?
Say inarok linmasor ed tanamanan to, ed saray dasig na saray balingit, pian manpakabkab ed saray tanamanan, tan mantipon na saray lirio.
Siak kien toak nen inarok, tan say inarok sikato so kien ko: ipakabkab to so polok to ed leet na saray lirio.
Sika malimgas ka, O inarok, singa si Tirsa, marakep a singa Jerusalem, makapataktakot a singa inayuraan ya akalaylay.
Isipam so saray matam a manlapu ed siak, ta tinalo ra ak. Say buek mo sikato so singa polok na saray kanding, a manpainawa ed daligdig na Galaad.
Saray ngipen mo sikara so singa polok na saray ovejas, ya ontatdang ira a manlapu ed panagamesan, a balang sakey walaan na siping, tan angapo so managogol ed sikara.
Saray alupising mo sikara so singa pisag a granada ed beneg na pandong mo.
Wala so anemaplo a reyna, tan walomplo a kalugoran, tan saray virgen andi bilang.

Say malapatik, say ayadyarik, sikato so sakey lambengat; sikato so saksakey lambengat nen ina to; sikato so pinili a saksakey na angianak ed sikato. Saray anak a bibii sikato so anengneng da, tan sikato so tinawag da a bendita; on, saray reyna tan saray kalugoran, tan sikató so ingalang da.
¿Siopa so saya ya onnengneng a singa kabuasan, malimgas a singa say bulan, malinew a singa say banwa, makapataktakot a singa inayuraan a nanlaylay?
Inmaksebak ed tanamanan na saray nueces, pian nengnengen ko so saray malambot a tanaman na lawak, pian nengnengen ko so uvas a sinmolming, tan saray granada a nanbolaklak.
Sanen agko ni amta, say kamarerwak inpasen toak ed leet na saray luganan na maprincipe a baley ko.
Pawil ka, pawil ka, O Sulamita: pawil ka, pawil ka, pian onnengneng kami ed sika. ¿Akin et onnengneng kayo ed Sulamita, singa ed sayaw na Mahanaim?
¡Agay la so limgas na saray salim ed saray tapakan, O anak a bii na principe! Saray tibukel ya ulpom sikara so singa saray kagawaan, say gawa na saray lima a marunong a panday.
Say kabalgan mo sikato so singa tibukel a tagayan, ya ed sikato ag onkulang so alak ya andi laok: say balangbang mo sikato so singa sakey a bonton na trigo a nipasen ed liberliber na lirio.
Saray duaran pagew mo sikara so singa duaran kilaw a sikara so siping na sakey a kubilang.

Say tenger mo sikato so singa say ilang a garing; saray matam singa saray tanke ed Hesbon, ed abay na wangalan na Batrabbim; say eleng mo sikato so singa say ilang na Libano ya onnengneng ed dapit Damasko.
Say olom ed tapew mo sikato so singa Carmelo, tan say buek na olom singa purpura; say ari adakep ed saray laga to.
¡Agay la so kalimgasan tan karambaan mo, o aro, a makapagayaga!
Saya a katagey mo sikato so singa sakey a kiew a palma, tan saray pagew mo ed saray pognel to.
Inkuan ko, onkalabak ed kiew a palma, onegna ak ed saray sanga to: paulian mo a saray pagew mo singa ra komon monil na uvas, tan say angob na panlinawam singa ra komon saray manzana,
Tan say sangim singa sankaabigan ya alak, ya onlasor a malamlamoy nipaakar ed inarok, ya onsaklayat ed saray bibil na saramay naugip.
Siak kien toak nen inarok; tan say pilalek to árap ed siak.
Gala, inarok, ompaway ita ed uma; ontonda ita ed saray lawak.
Ontatdang ita a masaksakbay ed saray uvasan; nengnengen ta no say uvas binmosilak kasi, tan saray bulaklak to binmuskag ira, tan saray granada nanbolaklak ira: diman iter ko ed sika so arok.
Saray mandragoras mansamiong ira; tan ed saray pinto ta wala' ra so amin ya olibay na saray mabli a bungabunga, balo tan ombak, ya inyatol ko nipaakar ed sika, o inarok.
¡O no sika komon so singa agik a laki, a sinmoso ed saray pagew nen inak! Sano naromog taka ed paway, angoban taka komon; on, tan angapo so manmodmora ed siak.
Itabin taka komon, tan yakar taka ed abung nen inak, a mangibangat ed siak; painomen taka komon na binalingitan ya alak, ed tabol na granadak.
Say kawigi a lima to wala naani ed leksab na olok, tan say kawanan a lima to lakapen toak.
Pansambaen ta kayo, O anak a bibii na Jerusalem, pian agyo tenyegen, no liingen so arok, anga ed kaliktan-to.
¿Siopa so saya ya ontatdang a manlapu ed kalawakan, ya akasaral ed inaro to? Ed leksab na kiew a manzana niliing taka; diman si inam nanpasakit ed sika, diman nanpasakit so angianak ed sika.

Ipasen moak a singa tatak ed tapew na pusom, singa tatak ed tapew na taklay mo: ta say aro sikato so mabiskeg a singa patey; say imon sikato so masulit a singa Sheol; saray ngalab to sikara so ngalangalab na apuy, sakey a matua a dalang nen Katawan.
Saray dakel a danum agda naerep so aro, angan saray delap sikato so agda nasebseban: no sakey a too iter to komon so amin a kayarian na abung to nipaakar ed aro, sikato so sigpot a namodmora.
Walaan itayo na melag ya agi a bii, et sikato andian na saray pagew: ¿Anto so gawaen tayo nipaakar ed agi tayo a bii dia ed agew a panpilalekan da?
No sikato so sakey komon a bakor, mamaalagey itayo ed tapew to na sakey ya ilang a pilak: et no sikato so sakey komon a pinto, sikato so kaputan tayo ed saray tapi a cedro.
Siak sakey ak a bakor, tan saray pagew ko singa saray ilang to: diad saman wala ak ed saray mata to a singa sakey ya akaromog na kareenan.
Si Salomon walaan nen saman na uvasan ed Baal-hamon; inpaabang to so uvasan ed saray managbantay; balang sakey lapu ed bunga to mangyakar na sanlibo a tapi na pilak.
Say uvasan ko, a sikato so kienko, sikato so wala ed arap ko: Sika, O Salomon, walaan ka naani na sanlibo, et saray manbantay ed bunga to duan lasus.
Sika a manaayam ed saray tanamanan, saray kaiba pakadenglen da so voces mo; sikato komon so ipadngel mo ed siak.
Manganat ka, inarok, tan sika komon so singa korzo odino kilaw ya ulsa ed tapew na saray palandey na saray balingit.
Say pasingawey nen Isaias ya anak a laki nen Amoz, a sikato so anengneng to a nipaakar ed Juda tan Jerusalem ed saray agew nen Uzias, Jotam, Akaz, tan Ezekias, ar-ari na Juda.
Denglen yo, O katawenan, tan talinengen mo, O dalin; ta si Katawan nansalita: Naniwi ak tan amabalegak na saray anak, et tinmunganga ra a sumpa ed siak.
Say baka amta to so akankien ed sikato, tan say asno so atotong na katawan to; balet say Israel agto amta, say baley ko ag manisip.

Ay managkasalanan a nacion, baley a nanawit na inkauges, bini na saray managgawa na mauges, anak ira a managamil a siuuges! inkaindan da si Katawan, binalaw da so Santo na Israel, sinmananey ira tan linma ra a binmeneg.
Akin nabakbak kayo ni, pian ontunganga kayo a nagkalalo? say simoon ya olo sikato so mabeblay, tan say simoon a puso onkapuy.

Manlapu ed dapan na sali anga ni ed olo angapo so biskeg ed sikato; no ag ingen sugasugat, tan siresireg, tan tadtariwa ran babababag: ag ira kinmupit, ag ira met abedberan, ag ira met apuyokan na larak.
Say dalin yo nabagbag; saray ciudad yo naulam ira na apuy; say dalin yo akmonen na saray sankaili dia ed arap yo, tan sikato so nabagbag, a singa inggeba na saray sankaili.
Et say anak a bii na Sion napaulian a singa alolong ed uvasan, singa darawesan ed tanamanan na melon, singa kinobkob a ciudad.
Nilikod no si Katawan na saray ejercito angitilak ed sikatayo na melamelag a kera, mipara itayo komon ed Sodoma, mipara itayo komon ed Gomorra.
Denglen yo so salita nen Katawan, sikayo managuley na Sodoma; talinengen yo so gangan na Dios tayo, sikayo baley na Gomorra.

Anto ta ed siak so karaklan na saray bagat yo? kuan nen Katawan: wala ed siak so masarag ed saray bagat a pinoolan a karcarnero, tan say taba na saray pinataba ya ayep; et agak manliket ed dala na saray baka, ni saray kordero, ni saray kanding.
Sano ondago kayo ya ompatnag ed arap ko, siopa so nankaokolan na saya ed lima yo, a gatinan yo so saray saban ko?
Agyoak la yaakaran na saray apa a patanir; say incienso sikato so makapadimla ed siak; say balo a bulan tan sabaton, say pananawag na tiptipon, agko nitepel so inkauges tan say naasalan a tipon.
Saray balo a bulan yo tan saray tinoro yo a liket say kamarerwak kagula to ra; sikara so gonigon ed siak; masagpotak a manawit ed sikara.
Et sano unaten yo so saray lima yo, yamot ko so saray matak a manlapu ed sikayo; on, sano mangawa kayo na dakel a pikakasi, agak ondengel: saray lima yo napno ra na dala.
Manuras kayo, manlinis kayo; iwaklit yo so mauges ed saray gawa yo a manlapu ed arap na saray matak; ontonda kayo a mangawa na mauges;
Manaral kayo a mangawa na maong; anapen yo so katunongan, tulongan yo so inaposan, ikatunongan yo so saray ulila, yagel yo so balo a bii.

Dago kayo natan, tan mankakatunongan itayo, kuan nen Katawan: angan saray kasalanan yo sikara so singa eskarlata, napaputi ra a singa say nieve; angan sikara sa ambalanga a singa karmesi, magmaliw ira a singa ampoti a bago.
No labay yo tan maonor kayo, kanen yo so abig na dalin:
Balet no onaleg kayo tan ontunganga, naakmon kayo ed kampilan; ta say sangi nen Katawan sinalita to.
Panon a say matalek a ciudad magmaliw a balangkantis! sikato a napno na katunongan! say kaptekan nanayam ed sikato, balet natan saray managpatey.
Say pilak mo nagmaliw a lati, say alak mo alaokan na danum.

Saray principem sikara so matunganga, tan kaiba ra na saray matakew; balang sakey aroen to so saray panoksok, tan tomboken da so saray pananumang: agda ikatunongan so ulila, agda met pasabien so pegdat na balo a bii ed sikara.
Kanian kuan na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, say Makapanyari na Israel, A, onganganaak ed saray kasumlang ko, tan ombalesak ed saray kabosol ko;
Et ipawil ko so limak ed tapew mo, tan linisan ko a maong so latim, tan ibantak ko ya amin so estañom;
Et ipawil ko so saray oko-okom mo a singa nen inmuna, tan saray mananimbawam a singa nen gapu: kayari to natawag ka a, Say ciudad na kaptekan, sakey a matoor a baley.
Say Sion narondon ed inkatunong, tan saray apatombok to ed kaptekan.
Balet say kabagbag na saray mananumlang tan managkasalanan sikato so bansag, tan saray angikaindan ed Katawan naopot ira.
Ta nabaingan ira ed saray roble a nanpilalekan yo, tan nagotgot kayo nipaakar ed saray tanamanan a pinili yo.
Ta singa kayo naani sakey a roble a say bulong to nalenes, tan singa tanamanan ya kinmelang.
Et say mabiskeg sikato naani singa bonot, tan say gawa to singa kidiam; et sikara so manbansag a napoolan, tan angapo so mangerep ed sikara.
Say salita a si Isaias ya anak a laki nen Amoz anengneng to a nipaakar ed Juda tan Jerusalem.

Et nagawa dia ed saray kaonoran ya agew, a say palandey na abung nen Katawan niletneg ed toktok na saray palandey, tan nipatagey ed labas na saray pokdol; et saray amin a nacion onagos ira ya anga ed sikato.

Et dakerakel a baley so onla tan kuan da, Dago kayo, tan ontatdang itayo ed palandey nen Katawan, ed abung na Dios nen Jacob; ta ibangat to itayo ed saray dalan to, tan manakar itayo dia ed saray basbas to: ta manlapu ed Sion ompaway so tunong, tan say salita nen Katawan manlapu ed Jerusalem.

Et mangokom ed leet na saray nacion, tan mangigeter a nipaakar ed dakerakel a baley; et pitpiten da naani so saray kampilan da a pagmaliwen da a dingding na lokoy, tan saray gayang da a komkompay; say nacion ag naani mangitagey na kampilan a sumpa ed nacion, ag ira met la manaral na bakal ed angan kapigan.
O abung nen Jacob, dago kayo, tan manakar itayo ed silew nen Katawan.

Ta inkaindan mo so baley mo say abung nen Jacob, lapu ed napno ra ed saray ugali a nanlapu ed bokig, tan sikara pomaparles ira a singa saray Filisteo, tan milakapan ira ed saray lima ed saray anak na saray sankaili.
Et say dalin da sikato so napno na pilak tan balitok, angapo met so angaan na saray kayamanan da; say dalin da met napno na saray kabayo, angapo met so angaan na saray luganan da.
Say dalin da met napno na saray talintao; panpikasian da so kimey na saray dili a lima ra, a sikato so ginawa na saray dili a garnet da.
Et say abeba a too ondakmomo, tan say baleg a too napaabeba: kanian agmo ra perdonaen.
Onloob ka ed bato, onamot ka ed dabok, manlapu ed arap na makapakebiew nen Katawan, tan manlapu ed gayaga na katageyan to.
Saray malangas a kanenengneng na too napaabeba, tan say karangalan na totoo nipadakmomo, et si Katawan lambengat sikato naani napaatagey ed saman ya agew.
Ta wala naani agew nen Katawan na saray ejercito ed amin a mapangta tan marangal, tan ed amin a nipatagey; et sikato naani napaabeba;
Tan ed saray amin a cedro na Libano, a sikara so baleg tan atagey, tan ed saray amin a roble na Basan,
Tan ed saray amin ya atagey a palandey, tan ed saray amin a pokdol a sikara so atagey,
Tan ed balang atagey ya ilang, tan ed balang kinutaan a bakor,
Tan ed saray amin a sakayan na Tarsis, tan ed amin a makapaliket ya inalongan.
Et say karangalan na too nipadakmomo, tan say inkapangta na totoo napaabeba: et si Katawan lambengat sikato naani napaatagey ed satan ya agew.
Et saray talintao naekal ira naani a sigpot.

Et saray totoo onloob ira naani ed saray ongib na saray bato, tan ed saray longog na dalin, manlapu ed arap na makapakebiew nen Katawan, tan manlapu ed gayaga na kaatageyan to, sano onalagey a manenyeg a makapanyarian ed dalin.

Dia ed satan ya agew saray totoo ibantak da so saray talintao ra a pilak, tan saray talintao ra a balitok, a sikara so ginawa a nipaakar ed sikara a panpikasian, ed saray bulilit tan ed saray kulalaknit;

Pian onloob ira ed saray longog na saray bato, tan ed saray letak na saray dili a batobato, manlapu ed arap na makapakebiew nen Katawan, tan manlapu ed gayaga na katageyan to, sano onalagey a manenyeg a makapanyarian ed dalin.
Paulian mo so too, a say panlinawa to wala ed eleng to; ta anto ta so kikanaan to?
Ta, nia, say Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, ekalento a manlapu ed Jerusalem tan manlapu ed Juda so panpaksilan tan tayokor, say amin a panpaksilan a tinapay, tan amin a panpaksilan a danum;
Say makapanyari a too, tan say too a mibabakal, say okom, tan say profeta, tan say pomaparles, tan say kamasikenan;
Say kapitan na limamplo, tan saray magalang a totoo, tan say mananimbawa, tan say maronong a mangagawa, tan say kaabigan a mangkokolam.
Et mangiter ak na saray anak pian sikara so principe, tan saray ugugaw ya man-ari ed sikara.
Et say baley napasegsegang naani, balang sakey lapu ed sakey, tan balang sakey lapu ed kaabay to: say ugaw onalagey naani a mapangpangta a sumpa ed masiken a too, tan say abeba a sumpa ed magalang.
Sano say too egnaan to so agi to ed abung nen ama to, a kuan to, Sika walaan ka na kawes, sika komon so ari mi, tan paulian mo so saya a kabagbag a wala ed lepsag na limam;
Dia ed satan ya agew itagey to so voces to, a kuan to, Aliwa ak naani a mananambal; ta dia ed abung ko angapo so tinapay odino kawes: agyo ak gawaen a makauley ed baley.
Ta say Jerusalem abagbag, tan say Juda nagba; lapu ed say dila ra tan saray gawa ra sikara so sumpa ed Katawan, pian sagyaten da so saray mata na gayaga to.
Say nengneng na lupa ra mantasi a sumpa ed sikara; et ipaliwawa ra so kasalanan da a singa Sodoma, sikato so agda yamot. Abagey la so kamarerwa ra! ta nangawa ra na mauges ed sikara lanlamang.
Kuan yo ed matunong, a sikato naani maong ed sikato; ta canen da so bunga na saray gawa ra.
Abagey la so marelmeng! sikato naani mauges ed sikato; ta say ginawa na saray lima to nagawa ed sikato.
Nipaakar ed baley ko, ugugaw so saray manamasegsegang da, tan bibii so manuley ed sikara. O baley ko, saray mangitonton ed sika palingoen da ka, tan bagbagen da so dalan na saray basbas mo.
Si Katawan manal-alagey a misangsang, tan manal-alagey a mangokom ed saray baley.
Si Katawan onloob naani ed pangokoman pati saray mamasiken na baley to, tan saray principe to: Sikayo so angan ya angopot ed uvasan; say samsam ed duka wala ed saray kaabungan yo.
Anto so nonoten yo a pilditen yo so baley ko, tan gilingen yo so lupa na duka? kuan na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito.

Laot ni si Katawan inkuan to, Lapu ed saray anak a bibii na Zion sikara so mapangta, tan manakar ira a mataltalker so saray beklew da tan maramdamag so saray mata ra, a manaakar tan manandawes ya onla, tan tikortikor so saray sali ra;
Kanian say Katawan kabilen to ed pelsa so lomonlomonan na olo na saray anak a bibii na Zion, tan si Katawan paulian ton akalukas naani so saray maamot a kabiangan da.
Dia ed satan ya agew say Katawan ekalen to so kalimgasan na saray palagaygay na kalitkalit da, tan saray iket, tan saray kinonbulan;
Saray tagikaw, tan saray baklaw, tan saray sokbong;
Saray panagalimpogo, tan saray barungbarung na saray sali, tan saray balkes, tan saray panangyatolan na balbalingit, tan saray palbayani;
Saray singsing, tan saray pakaw na eleng;
Saray pililiket a kawekawes, tan saray pandong, tan saray kolibenben, tan saray supot;
Saray salming, tan saray malambot a lienzo, tan saray turbante, tan saray sokbong.

Et nagawa, a saray masamit a balbalingit nasalatan ira na ambanget; et say balkes nasalatan na lubir; et say maoksoy a buek nasalatan na inkayangyang; et say sokbong nasalatan na magaspang a kawes; say kalimgasan nasalatan na inkaatungan.
Saray lalakim nipasag ira ed panamegley na kampilan, tan saray makapangyarim dia ed bakal.
Et saray pinto to maney-ey tan managogol; et sikato naani kitungilang tan nipayorong ed tapew na dalin.

Et pitora a bibii benbenan da so sakey a laki dia ed satan ya agew, kuan da, Kanen mi naani so dili a tinapay mi, tan isulong mi so dili a kawes mi: salambengat a natawag kami komon ed panamegley na ngaran mo; ekalen mo komon so kibabaing mi.
Dia ed satan ya agew say simit nen Katawan sikato naani malimgas tan magayaga, tan say bunga na dalin sikato naani mabmabig tan marakep a nipaakar ed saray alegyas ed Israel.
Et nagawa, a say natilak ed Zion, tan say nakeraan ed Jerusalem, sikato naani natawag a santo, angan balang sakey ni a nisulat ed saray mabilay dia ed Jerusalem;

Sano say Katawan inurasan to so dutak na saray anak a bibii na Zion, tan ginogolan to so dala na Jerusalem a manlapu ed pegley to, lapu ed panamegley na espiritu na inkatunong, tan lapu ed panamegley na espiritu na panamool.

Et si Katawan palsaen to ed tapew na amin a panagayaman ed palandey Zion, tan ed tapew na saray tipon to, so lurem tan asewek ed agew, tan say liwawa na mandarlang ya apuy ed labi; ta dia ed tapew na amin a gayaga onbuskag so sakbong.
Et wala naani kobongkobong a nipaakar a sirum ed agew dia ed petang, tan nipaakar ya apireng tan nipaakar a sakbong ed bagyo tan uran.
Mankantaak komon a nipaakar ed inadarok na canta na inarok nipaakar ed uvasan to. Say inadarok walaan nen saman na uvasan ed balang mabona a pokdol:

Et sikato so kinotkotan to, tan tinipon to ya inekal so saray bato to, tan sikato so tinaneman to ed saray pinili ya uvas, tan angipaalagey na ilang ed pegley to, tan amanday met na alakan diman: et inalagar to a sikato so mangipaway na saray uvas, et angipaway na saray balang ya uvas.
Et natan, O sikayo a manaayam ed Jerusalem tan totoo na Juda, okomen yo, pikasik ed sikayo, so nipaakar ed siak tan say uvasan ko.
Anto so nayari komon a gawaen ni ed uvasan ko, ya agko ni ginawa ed sikato? akin sirin, sanen inalagar ko a mangipaway na saray uvas, angipaway na saray balang ya uvas?
Et natan ibagak ed sikayo no anto so gawaen ko ed uvasan ko: Ekalen ko so alar to, tan sikato naani naopot; igebak naani so bakor to, tan sikato naani nigatingatin:

Et sikato naani paulian ko a kitungilang; sikato naani, ag napalaspasan ag met nabaka; bangbalet diman ontobo so saray tala tan saray sabit: igangan ko met ed saray lurem pian ag ira onoran ed tapew to,

Ta say uvasan nen Katawan na saray ejercito sikato so abung na Israel, tan saray totoo na Juda so makapaliket a tanaman to: et inalagar to so inkatunong, balet nia, so panangapos; say kaptekan, balet nia, so akis.
Abagey la so saray manangisoldong na abung tan abung, saray mangigaton na uma ed uma, anga ed angapo so pasen, tan nagawa kayo a manayam a bokbokor dia ed pegley na dalin.
Dia ed saray layag ko, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, Ed katuaan dakel so saray abung a kibalatar, baleg man tan maong, ya angapo so manayam.
Ta samplora ya akre na uvasan mangiter na sakey a bat, tan sakey ya homer a bini mangiter lambengat na sakey efa.
Abagey la so saray ombangon a masaksakbay ed kabuasan, pian ontombok ira ed mabayani ya inumen; a manpainawa ra a nataraw ed labi, anga ed say alak parlangen tora!
Et say arpa tan say viola, say pandereta tan say tolali, tan alak, wala ra ed saray panliket da; balet agda imatleken so gawa nen Katawan, agda met omamengen so panagkimey na saray lima to.
Kanian say baley ko onla ra ed inkadakep lapu ed kakulangan na pikakabat; et saray angkabli ra a totoo naerasan ira, tan saray karaklan da naekatan ira ed pega.

Kanian say Sheol pinabaleg to so pilalek to, tan nilukasan to so sangi to ya andi sukat; et say gayaga ra, tan say karaklan da, tan say ongol da, tan say miliket ed kasiksikaanan da, onlasor ira ed loob to.
Et say makabos a too sikato so napaabeba, tan say baleg a too napaabeba, tan saray mata na marangal napaabeba ra:
Balet si Katawan na saray ejercito napaatagey dia ed inkatunong, tan say Dios a Santo napasantos dia ed kaptekan.
Saman la mantagano so saray kordero a singa dia ed panagkabkaban da, tan saray aderal a pasen na saray mataba kanen naani na saray manteyengteyeng.
Abagey la so saray mangoyor na inkauges ed saray lubir na inkatila, tan kasalanan a singa guyoran na galosa;
A kuan da, Mansiglat komon, ganatan to komon so gawa to, pian sikato so nanengneng tayo; et say simbawa na Santo na Israel onasinger komon tan onsabi, pian sikato so naamtaan tayo!

Abagey la so saray manawag na mauges ed maong, tan maong so mauges; ya iyan da so kabilungetan a panagkaliwawa, tan say liwawa a panagkabilunget; ya iyan da so ampait a panagkamasamit, tan say masamit a panagkaampait!
Abagey la so saray makabat ed saray dili a mata ra, tan saray mabinta ed dili a pakanengneng da!
Abagey la so saray makapanyari ya oninum na alak, tan saray totoo a mabiskeg a manlaok na mabayani ya inumen;
A patunongen da so marelmeng nipaakar ed panoksok, tan ekalenda so inkatunong na matunong a manlapu ed sikato!

Kanian singa say liab na apuy opoten to so dayami, tan singa say amaga a dika naopot ed dalang, ontan so lamot da a sikato naani singa kabolok, tan say bolaklak da onalagey naani a singa dabok; lapu ed inwaklit da so tunong nen Katawan na saray ejercito, tan minora ra so salita na Santo na Israel.

Kanian say sanok nen Katawan dinmalang a sumpa ed baley to, tan inonat to so lima to a sumpa ed sikara, tan sikara so kinabil to; et saray palandey kinmeyer, tan saray inatey a laman da sikara so singa dutak dia ed pegley na saray polong. Nipaakar ed saya ya amin say sanok to ag onarawi, no ag ingen say lima to akaonat a maligeligen.
Et mangiatagey naani na tanda ed saray nacion a manlapu ed arawi, tan ngisiwan to ra a manlapu ed sampot na dalin; et nia, ondago ra naani a tampol a maganganat.
Angapo so nakesawan odino nigapol ed sikara; angapo so mantemeg odino naugip; nisay balkes na saray banel da ag met naokpos, nisay lubir na sapin da ag met napoltot:
Saray pana ra sikara so maotok, tan saray amin a bekang da sikara so akabekas; saray koko na saray kabayo ra nibilang ira a singa ginmibato, tan saray dalig da singa alimbosabos:

Say panongol da singa naani saray leon a kabatyan, manongol ira naani a singa saray kilaw a leon, on, manongol ira, tan tekmelan da so samsam, tan sikato so itainan da ya ag naano, tan angapo naani mogmo a mangilaban.

Et manongol ira sumpa ed sikara dia ed satan ya agew a singa say panongol na dayat: et no say sakey onnengneng ed dalin, nia, so kabilungetan tan kaermenan; et say liwawa ombilunget ed saray lurem to.
Dia ed taon ya inpatey nen Uzias anengneng ko so Katawan a manyodyorong ed sakey a trono, ya atagey tan nitandoro; et say saloy na kawes to alaknaban to so templo.
Ed tagey to akaalagey so saray serafin: balang sakey ed sikara walaan na anemira a payak; say duara panakbong to ed lupa to, tan say duara panakbong to ed saray sali to, tan say duara pantekyab to.
Et say sakey tan sakey nanaakisan ira, tan inkuan da, Santo, santo, santo, si Katawan na saray ejercito: say amin a dalin napno na liket to.
Et saray panangiletnegan na saray sasabien kinmeyer ira ed voces na saman so manakis, tan say abung napno ed asewek.

Diad saman inkuan ko, Abagey ak la! ta nabalang ak; lapu ed too ak a marutak so saray bibii, tan manaayam ak dia ed pegley na baley a marutak so saray bibii: ta saray matak anengneng da so Ari, si Katawan na saray ejercito.
Diad saman tinmekyab so sakey a serafin ed siak, ya walaan na ngalab ed lima to; a sikato so inala to ed saray sipit a nanlapu ed altar:
Et diniwit to so sangik ed sikato, tan inkuan to, Nia, saya diniwit to so saray bibii mo: et say inkauges mo nakal, tan say kasalanan mo apaandi.
Et nadngel ko so voces na Katawan, ya inkuan to, Siopa so ibakik, tan siopa so onla a nipaakar ed sikatayo? Diad saman inkuan ko, Wadiaak; ibaki moak.
Et inkuan to, Onla ka, tan ibagam ed saya a baley, Dengdenglenyo a tua, balet agyo natalosan; et nengnengnengenyo a tua, balet agyo nibiig.

Gawaen mo so puso na saya a baley a mataba, tan gawaen mo so saray layag da ya ambelat, tan saniban mo so saray matara; ompan makanengneng ira ed saray mata ra, tan makadngel ira ed saray layag da, tan makatalos ira ed puso ra, tan magbabawi ra, tan natambal ira.
Diad saman inkuan ko, Katawan, anga ed kapigan? Et inmebat, Anga ed saray ciudad nabagbag ya andi manayam, tan saray abung andi too, tan say dalin magmaliw a sigpot ya andi-kana,
Tan si Katawan yarawi to so totoo ed arawi, tan saray napaulian a pasen sikara so dakel ed pegley na dalin.

Et no wala ni kakaplo dia ed sikato, sikato met dia ed betang to nakan naani: singa kiew a terebinto, tan singa roble, a say sengeg da napaulian, sano nahatang ira: ontan say masanto a bini sikato so sengeg to.

Et agawa dia ed saray agew nen Acaz ya anak a laki nen Jo tarn, ya anak a laki nen Uzias, ari ed Juda, a si Rezin ari ed Siria, tan si Peca ya anak a laki nen Remalias, ari ed Israel, tinmatdang ira ed Jerusalem a mibakal sumpa ed sikato, balet agda ayarian so tinmalona a sumpa ed sikato.
Et nibaga ed abung nen David, ya inkuan, Say Siria akikasakey ed Efraim. Et say puso to pinmarok, tan say puso na baley to, singa saray kiekiew ed takel a nagalaw ed dagem.
Diad saman inkuan nen Katawan ed Isaias, Ompaway ka natan a mangabet ed Acaz, sika, tan si Searjasub ya anak mo, a laki ed sampot na salolog na katageyan a tanke, dia ed lansangan na uma na batanero;

Et kuan mo ed sikato, Manlikas ka, tan mankalna ka; agka antakot, nisay pusom ag met napunaw, nisengeg ed saraya a duaran ngoro na ngapos, nipaakar ed masebeg a sanok nen Rezin tan Siria, tan say anak a laki nen Remalias.
Lapu ed Siria, say Efraim, tan say anak a laki nen Remalias, ninonot da so mauges, a sumpa ed sika, ya inkuan da,
Ontatdang itayo sumpa ed Juda, tan sikato so goloen tayo, tan mangawa itayo na kutlaong diman nipaakar ed sikatayo, tan mangipasen itayo na ari ed pegley to, angan say anak a laki nen Tabeal;
Onia so kuan nen Katawan á Dios, Sikato so agmansiansia, ni sikato met so ag nagawa.
Ta say olo na Siria sikato so Damasco, tan say olo na Damasco sikato si Rezin; et dia ed loob na anemaplo tan lima a taon say Efraim nabuybuyak, dia ed ontan aliwa naani a baley:
Et say olo na Efraim sikato so Samaria, tan say olo na Samaria sikato so anak a laki nen Remalias. No agkayo manisia, petepeteg ya ag kayo niletneg.
Et si Katawan nansalita lamet ed Acaz, ya inkuan to.
Kerew ka na tanda ed Katawan a Dios mo; sikato so kerewen mo dia ed kaaralman, ni dia ed katageyan ed tagey.
Balet si Acaz inkuan to, Agak onkerew, agko met toksoen si Katawan.
Et inkuan to, Dengel kayo natan, O abung nen David: Sikato ta so melag a bengatla a nipaakar ed sikayo so mamaalipanes ed totoo, a paalipanesen yo so Dios ko met?
Kanian say Katawan lanlamang itdan to kayo na tanda nia, sakey a virgen manlokpn naani, tan mangianak na sakey ya anak a laki, tan natawag so ngaran to ya Emmanuel.
Mantekilla tan dilo so kanen to, sano amta to ya iwaklit so mauges, tan pilien so maong.
Ta arapen a say ugaw agto ni amta ya iwaklit so mauges, tan pilien so maong, say dalin a saray duaran ari to a kagulam nikaindan.
Si Katawan yakar to naani ed sika, tan ed baley mo, tan ed abung nen amam, so saray agew ya ag sinmabi, manlapu ed agew a say Efraim pinmikal a nanlapu ed Juda, salanti say ari ed Asiria.
Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, a si Katawan ngiswaan to so apangat ya wala ed kaarawiyan a kabiangan na saray ilog na Egipto, tan say potiokan ya wala ed dalin na Asiria.
Et ondago ra, tan manayam so amin ed sikara dia ed saray abagbag a lawak, tan dia ed saray letak na saray bato, tan ed tapew na saray amin a kasabitan, tan ed tapew na saray amin a panagpakabkaban.

Dia ed saman ya agew say Katawan kiskisan to ed sakey a pangiskis ya inabangan dia ed saray gaton a hibaliw na Ilog, salanti ed ari na Asiria, so olo tan say bago na saray sali; et opoten to met so iming.
Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, a sakey a too mangiwi na baka a kabatyan a kilaw, tan duara a karnero;
Et nagawa naani, lapud inkadaakan na gatas a papawayen da mangan naani na mantekilla: ta mantekilla tan dilo so kanen naani na balang sakey a napaolian dia ed pegley na dalin.
Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, a balang sakey a pasen, a kawalaan na sanlibo ya uvas a manbili sanlibo a kapisag a pilak, nipaakar naani ed saray tala tan saray sabitan.
Onsabi naani sakey ed satan a pasen a pati saray pana tan bekang, lapu ed say amin a dalin sikato naani tala tan kasabitan.

Et saray amin a pokdol ya akotkotan so akotkot ed asarol, agka naani onladtan lapu ed takot ed saray tala tan saray sabitan: balet sikato naani nipaakar a pangyakaran ed saray baka, tan nipaakar a gatingatinan na saray carnero.
Et si Katawan inkuan to ed siak, Mangala ka na baleg a tabla, tan isulat mo ed tapew to ed pluma na too, Nipaakar ed Maher-shalal-hashbaz:
Et mangitarok ak na saray matoor a tasi a mangipanonot, si Unas a sacerdote, tan si Zacarias ya anak a laki nen Jeberekias.
Et linma ak ed profeta a bii; et nanlokon, tan angianak na sakey ya anak a laki. Diad saman inkuan nen Katawan ed siak, Tawagen mo so ngaran to a Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Ta onaan a say ugaw nawalaan na pikakabat ya onakis na: Amak, tan Inak, saray kayamanan na Damasco tan say samsam na Samaria niyarawi ra ed arap na ari ed Asiria.
Et si Katawan nansalita ed siak ni lamet, ya inkuan to,
Bangta saya a baley inwaklit to so saray danum na Silos a managos a makalkalna, tan nanliket ira ed kinen Rezin tan say anak a laki nen Remalias;

Natan sirin, nia, say Katawan pasapaten to ed sikara so saray danum na Ilog, mabiskeg tan dakel, salanti ed ari na Asiria tan amin a gayaga to: et sikato naani onsapat ed saray amin a panagusan to, tan onlepwas ed saray amin a pangdel to;
Et sikato naani onagus anga ed Juda; sikato so ondelap tan onlabas; sikato so onabot anga ed tenger; et say pangibuskag to ed saray payak to laknaban to naani so kaawang na dalin mo, O Emmanuel.
Mangawa kayo na golo, O sikayon balbaley, et nabuyakbuyak kayo; et talineng kayo, aminyon arawi a daldalin: manbalkes kayo, tan nabuyakbuyak kayo.
Mannononong kayo, et sikato so andi kakanaan; bitlaen yo so salita, et agmansiansia: ta say Dios sikato so wala ed sikami.
Ta si Katawan nansalita na onia ed siak a tekep na mabiskeg a lima, tan inbangat to ya ag ak manakar dia ed dalan na saya a baley, ya inkuan to,
Agyo ikuan, Sakey ya yaalagey, nipaakar ed amin ya ikuan na saya a baley, Sakey ya yaalagey; agkayo met ontakot ed takot da, agkayo met natakot ed sikato.
Si Katawan na saray ejercito, sikato so pasantosen yo; et sikato so takotan yo, tan sikato so takot yo.

Et sikato naani nipaakar a santuario; balet ed saray duaran abung na Israel nipaakar a singa sakey a bato a kigapolan tan bato a kipaonongan, a nipaakar a pasiklong tan nipaakar a kalot ed saray manaayam ed Jerusalem.
Et dakel naani nigapol ed saraman, tan nipasag ira, tan napiley ira, tan nakalotan ira, tan naerel ira.
Bedberen mo so pantasi, tatakan mo so tunong ed nanleleetan na saray babangatan ko.
Et alagden ko si Katawan, ya yamot to so lupa to a manlapu ed abung nen Jacob, tan sikato so anapen ko.

Nia, siak tan saray ugugaw ya iter ed siak nen Katawan nipaakar ira a tantanda tan nipaakar a makapakelaw dia ed Israel a manlapu ed Katawan na saray ejercito, a sikato so manayam dia ed palandey Sion.

Et sano ikuan da ed sikayo, Anap yo ed sikara so saray walaan na kaiba ya espiritu tan ed saray mankukulam, a manesaes tan mantalabotob: agta say baley anapen to komon so Dios da? lapu ed saray mabilay anapen ira ta ed saray inatey?
Ed tunong tan ed pantasi! no ag ira mansalita unong ed saya a salita, petepeteg ya angapo so kabuasan a nipaakar ed sikara.

Et sikato so labasan da, a makapakebiew a mairirap tan narasan; et nagawa naani ya, sano narasan ira, onsanok ira lanlamang, tan manayew ira lapu ed panamegley na ari tan lapu ed panamegley na Dios da, tan ontangay ira:
Et onnengneng ira ed dalin, tan, nia, irap tan kabilungetan, say inkakuyep na kaermenan; et dia ed makapal a kabilungetan sikara naani nitonton.

Balet angapo naani inkakuyep ed saman so wala ed kaermenan. Dia ed inmona a panaon inyakar to ed pansasangsangan so dalin nen Zabulon tan say dalin nen Neftali; balet dia ed kaonoran a panaon sikato so ginawa to a magayaga, lapu ed panamegley na dalan na dayat, ed nibaliw na Jordan, so Galilea na saray nacion.
Saray kabalbaleyan a nanakar ed kabilungetan anengneng da so baleg a silew: saray nanayam ed dalin na anino na patey, dia ed sikara sinminag so silew.
Pinarakel mo so nacion, pinabaleg mo so liket da: manliket ira ed arap mo unong na liket ed panagani, singa saray totoo manliket ira sano apagen da so samsam.
Ta say pako na awit to, tan say panaklay na abala to, say tayokor na manangapos to, binuyak mo a singa dia ed agew nen Madian.
Ta amin ya ayura na inayuraan a too dia ed golo, tan saray kawes a nitolin dia ed dala, nipaakar naani a poolan, nipaakar a itongo ed apuy.

Ta dia ed sikatayo nianak so sakey ya ugaw, dia ed sikatayo sakey ya ugaw a laki so niiter; et say uley wala naani ed tapew na abala to; et say ngaran to natawag naani a Makapakelaw, Mananimbawa, Makapanyari a Dios, Andi angaan ya Ama, Principe na Kareenan.

Ed ibaleg na panaguley to tan kareenan angapo naani angaan, ed trono nen David, tan ed panarian to, a sikato so iletneg to, tan sikato so ipaalagey to a tekep na inkatunong tan kaptekan a manlapud natan anga ed ando lan ando. Say paga nen Katawan na saray ejercito so manumpal ed saya.
Say Katawan angipawit na salita ed Jacob, et aliwawaan so Israel.
Et amin a baley nakabatan to, angan say Efraim tan say manaayam ed Samaria, a kuan da ed pasirayew tan dia ed kapangtaan na puso.
Saray lario nagba ra, balet mamaatagey kami ed pinanday a bato; saray sikomoro abatang ira, balet mangyan kami na cedro dia ed pasen da.
Kanian si Katawan ipasen to ed atagey a sumpa ed sikato so saray kairangan nen Rezin, tan tenyegen to so saray kabosol to,
Saray Sirio ed onaan, tan saray Filisteo ed onor; et akmonen da so Israel ed akalukas a sangi. Lapu ed saya ya amin say sanok to ag nakal, no ag ingen say lima to akaunat a maligeligen.
Angan ontan say baley ag inmarap ed saman so angabil ed sikara, agda met inanap si Katawan na saray ejercito.
Kanian si Katawan pegpegen to a manlapu ed Israel so olo tan ikol, say sanga tan kawayan, dia ed sakey ya agew.
Say kamasikenan tan say magalang a too, sikato so olo; et say profeta a mangibangat na saray tila, sikato so ikol.
Ta saray mangitonton ed saya a baley palingoen da ra; et saray nitonton ed sikara nabagbag ira.

Kanian say Katawan ag manliket ed saray tobonbalo a lalaki ra, ag met nawalaan na panangabagey ed saray ulila ra tan saray babalo ra a bibii; ta balang sakey agda igalang so sagrado tan managgawa ra na mauges, tan balang sangi mansalita na kaatiwan. Lapu ed saya ya amin say sanok to ag nakal, no ag ingen say lima to akaunat a maligeligen.

Ta say karelmengan mamool a singa say apuy; sikato akmonento so saray tala tan saray sabitan; on, sikato ondalang dia ed saray kakdelan na takel, tan ontolin ira a mamaatagey ed sakey a lusek na asewek.
Lapu ed sanok nen Katawan na saray ejercito say dalin natektek; et say baley sikara so singa liob na apuy: angapo so too a mangisibeg ed agito.
Et sakey so mangunot ed kawanan a lima, tan narasan; et mangan ed kawigi a lima, tan ag ira napera: sikara kanenda balang sakey a too so laman na dili a taklayto:
Say Manases ed Efraim; et say Efraim ed Manases; et sikara a sankatipon sumpara ed Juda. Lapu ed saya ya amin say sanok to ag nakal, no ag ingen say limato akaunat a maligeligen.
Abagey la so saray mangigeter na saray pikewet a geter, tan saray sumusulat a mansulat na inkauges;
Ya isipa ra so naokolan a manlapu ed inkatunong, tan takewen da ed baley ko so matunong da, pian saray babalo a bibii sikara so samsam da, tan pian nagawa ra so saray olila ya erel da!
Et anto so gawaen yo dia ed agew na kadadalaw, tan dia ed kabagbag ya onsabi a manlapu ed arawi? siopa so batikan yo a nipaakar ed tulong? tan iner so pangitilakan yo na gayaga yo?
Ontuek ira lambengat ed lepsag na saray pinangaw, tan napelag ira ed lepsag na saray pinatey. Lapu ed sayan amin say sanok to ag nakal, no ag ingen say lima to akaunat a maligeligen.
O Asirio, say pekpek na sanok ko, say tayokor ed lima to a kawalaan na kasnokan ko!

Sikato so ibakik naani a sumpa ed nacion ya ag mangigalang ed sagrado, tan sumpa ed baley na sanok ko sikato so itdan ko na bilin, pian alaen to so samsam, tan alaen to so erel, tan igatingatin to ra a singa say pitek na saray polong.
Angan ontan agto ipaliwawa ya ontan; ag met nonoten na puso to ya ontan; no ag ingen wala ed puso to so pamagbag, tan pamegpeg ed saray nacion ya aliwan daiset.
Ta kuan to, Aliwa ta ya ar-ari so saray amin a principek?
Aliwa ta a say Calno singa Carkemis? Aliwa ta a say Hamath singa Arpad? aliwa ta a say Samaria singa Damasco?
Bangta say limak aromog to so saray nanarian na saray talintao, a saray inbolik a talintao ra tinmalona ed saray talintao na Jerusalem tan Samaria;
Agko ta gawaen so singa ginawak ed Samaria tan saray talintao to ed Jerusalem tan saray talintao to?

Kanian nagawa, ya, sano say Katawan nasumpal to so amin a gawa to ed palandey S¡on tan ed Jerusalem, dusaen ko naani so bunga na masunggay a puso na ari ed Asiria, tan say gayaga na saray marangal a kanenengneng to.

Ta inkuan to, Lapu ed panamegley na limak sikato so ginawak, tan lapu ed panamegley na kakabatan ko; ta walaan ak na pakatalos: et inekal ko so saray ketegan na saray baley, tan tinakew ko so saray kayamanan da, tan singa mabayani a too niyepas ko so saray manyorong ed saray trono:

Et say limak akaromog a singa ubong so saray kayamanan na saray balbaley; et singa sakey a tiponen to so saray iknol a sikara so akaindan, tinipon ko so amin a dalin: et angapo a mogmo so anenyeg na payak, ni say angilukas na sangi, ni say nanesaes.

Manpasirayew ta so wasay a sumpa ed mangiwasay ed sikato? paatageyen ta na lagari so inkasikato a sumpa ed mangigarigar ed sikato? singa no say pekpek onalagey sumpa ed saray mangitagey ed sikato, odino singa no say tayokor itagey to so saman a sikato so aliwa a kiew.
Kanian say Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, mangipawit ed nanleleetan na saray mataba to na inkaebeng; et diad lepsag na gayaga to ondalang so pool a singa pool na apuy.
Et say silew na Israel sikato naani nipaakar ya apuy, tan say Santo to nipaakar a dalang; et poolan to tan opoten to so saray sabitan to tan saray tala to ed sakey ya agew.
Et opoten to naani so gayaga na takel to, tan ed mabunga ya uma to, nampadpara ed kamarerwa tan laman: et sikato naani singa manangegna na laylay sano napunaw.
Et say kera ed saray kiew na takel to sikato naani daiset, dia ed ontan a sakey ya ugaw nisulat tora.

Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a say natilak ed Israel, tan saray akatainan ed abung nen Jacob ag ira la onsaral ed angabil ed sikara, no ag ingen onsaral ira naani ed Katawan, say Santo na Israel, dia ed tua.
Sakey so natilak a ompawil, salanti say natilak ed Jacob, ed makapanyari a Dios.
Ta angan say baley mo, Israel, sikato so singa say buer na dayat, salambengat say natilak ed sikara so ompawil: sakey a kabagbag so nigeter, a manlepwas ed inkatunong.
Ta sakey a napno a kasumpalan, tan say nigeter, gawaen naani na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito dia ed pegley na amin a dalin.

Kanian onia so kuan na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercitos, o baley ko a manaayam ed Sion, agka antakot ed Asirio, angan kabilen to ka ed pekpek, tan yayag to so tayokor to sumpa ed sika, unong ed olibay na Egipto.
Ta ed dagdaiset a kasanlilikna say kasanokan a sumpa ed sika nasumpal, tan say sanok ko niyarap ed kabagbag to.

Et si Katawan na saray ejercito mamaatagey a sumpa ed sikato na lewet, singa dia ed inpamatey ed Madian ed bato na Oreb: et say tayokor to wala naani ed tagey na dayat, tan sikato so itagey to a unong ed olibay na Egipto.
Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew a say awit to ontainan a manlapu ed abalam, tan say pako to manlapu ed tenger mo, tan say pako naputer nisengeg ed inkataba.
Sinmabi ed Ayat, dinmalan ed Migron; ed Micmas tiponen to so agamil to;
Binmaliksat ira ed dalan; inpaalagey da so darawesan da ed Geba; say Rama manggiwgiw; say Gabaa nen Saul binmatik.
Yakis mo a maksil so voces mo, O anak a bii nen Gallim! dengel ka, O Lais! O pangaskasian ya Anatot!
Say Madmena sikato so batik; saray manaayam ed Gebim ombatik ira nipaakar ed kaligenan.
Ed saya lanlamang ya agew ontonda ed Nob: igalaw to so lima to ed palandey na anak a bii na Sion, say pokdol na Jerusalem.
Nia, say Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, lapniten to so saray sanga ed makapataktakot: et saray atagey ed inalageyan nabatang ira, tan saray atagey napaabeba ra.
Et palaspasen to so saray makdel a takel ed balatyang, tan say Libano nageba ed panamegley na sakey a makapanyari.
Et ompaway naani simit a manlapu ed sengeg nen Isai, tan say sanga a manlapu ed saray lamot to manbunga naani.
Et say Espiritu nen Katawan manayam naani ed tapew to, say espiritu na kakabatan tan pakatalos, say espiritu na pananimbawa tan pakapanyari, say espiritu na pikakabat tan say takot ed Katawan.
Et say liket to wala naani ed takot ed Katawan; et ag naani mangokom unong ed pakanengneng na saray mata to, ag met mangigeter unong ed pakadngel na saray layag to;

No ag ingen dia ed kaptekan okomen to so duka, tan mangigeter a situtunong nipaakar ed saray maoyamo ed salin; et bakbaken to so dalin ed pekpek na sangi to; et lapu ed panlinawa na saray bibii to pateyen to so marelmeng.
Et say kaptekan sikato naani so balkes na awak to, tan say katooran so balkes na saray banel to.

Et say lobo miayam naani ed kordero, tan say leopardo miakdol naani ed kanding; et say kilaw na baka tan kilaw na leon tan say pinataba mantitipon ira; et sakey a melag ya ugaw so mangitonton ed sikara.
Et say baka tan say oso mankabkab ira naani; saray kilaw da ondokol ira a mantitipon; et say leon mangan naani na dayami a singa say baka.
Et say mansoso ya ugaw mangalaw naani ed abut na uleg ya aspid, tan say pinakso ya ugaw ikaot to naani lima to ed balaong na tadioko.
Ag ira naani mamaunong odino mamagbag dia ed amin a masanto a palandey ko; ta say dalin napano naani ed pikakabat ed Katawan, singa saray danum sakbongan da so dayat.
Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a say lamot nen Jesse, ya akaalagey a nipaakar a tanda na saray baley, sikato so anapen na saray nacion; et say panagpainawaan to a pasen sikato naani magaygayaga.

Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a say Katawan ipasen to so lima to lamet ed komadua a danay pian nabawi to so nakdaan ed baley to, saray natilak naani, manlapu ed Asiria, tan manlapu ed Egipto, tan manlapu ed Patros, tan manlapu ed Kus, tan manlapu ed Elam, tan manlapu ed Sinar, tan manlapu ed Hamat, tan manlapu ed saray polo ed dayat.
Et mangipaalagey naani na tanda nipaakar ed saray nacion, tan tiponen to so saray nibantak a manlapu ed Israel, tan tiponen to so saray asiyansiyan ed Juda a manlapu ed saray apatiran suyok na dalin.
Say siblet met na Efraim onandi, tan saray amairap ed Juda napegpeg ira: say Efraim agto naani sibletan so Juda, tan say Juda agto met naani pairapen so Efraim.

Et ontekyab ira ed tapew na abala na saray Filisteo ed dapit sagud; mantitipon a samsaman da so saray anak na bokig: yunat da so lima ra ed tapew na Edom tan Moab; et sikara so onoren na saray anak nen Ammon.

Et si Katawan sigpot a bagbagen to so dila na dayat na Egipto; et lapu ed panamegley na makakalot a dagem yayag to so lima to ed tagey na Ilog, tan sikato so kabilen to a pankapitoen ya kolos, tan gawaen to so totoo a manakar ed kamagaan.
Et wala naani polong a nipaakar ed saray nakdaan ed baley to, a natilak ira, a manlapu ed Asiria; singa say wala nen saman nipaakar ed Israel dia ed agew ya intatdang to a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto.
Et dia ed satan ya agew ikuan mo, Misalamat ak ed sika, O Katawan; ta angan asanokan ka lapud siak, say sanok mo inmandi, tan niligliwa mo ak.
Nia, say Dios sikato so Manangilaban ko; manilalo ak, tan agak antakot; ta si Katawan, si Katawan lambengat, sikato so kasil ko tan kantak; et sikato so nagmaliw a manangilaban ko.
Kanian sililiket ya onasol kayo na danum a manlapu ed saray bobon na panangilaban.
Et dia ed satan ya agew ikuan yo, Misalamat kayo ed Katawan, tawagan yo so ngaran to, ipaliwawa yo so saray gawa to ed nanleleetan na balbaley, oliten yo a say ngaran to nitandoro.
Kantaan yo si Katawan; ta nangawa na ankabli ran bengabengatla: saya komon so nakabatan na amin a dalin.
Oningal tan oneyag ka, sika manaayam ed Sion; ta baleg dia ed pegley mo so Santo na Israel.
Say awit na Babilonia, ya anengneng nen Isaias ya anak a laki nen Amoz.
Mangitagey kayo na tanda ed tapew na malinis a palandey, itagey yo so voces ed sikara, yayag yo so lima, pian onloob ira ed saray wangalan na saray ankabli.
Ingangan ko so saray kinonsagrak, on, tinawag ko so saray makapanyarik a totoo nipaakar ed sanok ko, salanti saray mapasirayew a malikeliket.

Say tanol na karaklan ed saray palandey, singa tanol na baleg a baley! say tanol na ongol na saray nanarian na saray nacion nantitipon! Si Katawan na saray ejercito sinopen to so ejercito nipaakar ed bakal.
Onsabi ra a manlapu ed arawi a dalin, manlapu ed kasampotan a kabiangan na tawen, salanti si Katawan, tan saray ayura na inkasnokan to, pian bagbagen da so amin a dalin.
Managogol kayo; ta say agew nen Katawan asinger la; singa pamagbag a manlapu ed Makapanyarin amin sikato naani onsabi.
Kanian saray amin a lima onkapuy, tan balang puso na too natunaw:

Et sikara naani napunaw; inkairirap tan erermen so mamenben ed sikara; wala ra naani ed otot a singa bii no manpasakit: mannenengnengan ira ed pankelkelaw na sakey tan sakey; saray lupa ra sikara naani luplupa na dalang.
Nia, say agew nen Katawan onsabi, masulit, pati petang tan masebeg a sanok; pian gawaen to so dalin a kibalatar, tan bagbagen to so saray managkasalanan to a manlapu ed sikato.
Ta saray bitewen na tawen tan saray polpolok na bitbitewen to ag irá onsinag; say banwa onbilunget dia ed ibutay to, tan say bulan agto naani pasnagen so liwawa to.
Et dusaen ko naani so mundo nipaakar ed uges da, tan saray marelmeng nipaakar ed inkauges da: et pangangaen ko naani so inkapangta na mapasirayew, tan pangabebaen ko so karangalan na makapataktakot.
Gawaen ko so too a lalo a matalag nen say dalisay a balitok, say too ni nen say pulos a balitok na Ofir.
Kanian pagiwgiwen ko so saray tawen, tan say dalin nayegyeg ed pasen to, dia ed sanok nen Katawan na saray ejercito, tan dia ed agew na masubeg a pasnok to.
Et nagawa, a singa say ulsa ya inanupan, tan singa saray karnero ya angapo so too a manipon, ompawil naani balang too ed dili a baley to, tan ombatik so balang too ed dili a dalin to.
Balang sakey a naromog natalos naani; et. balang sakey a naala napelag naani ed panamegley na kampilan.
Saray anak da met ya angkekelag nibasig a nalinglingkay ira ed arap na saray mata ra; saray kaabungan da natakewan, tan saray kaasawaan da a bibii napasoot ira.
Nia, bangonen ko so saray Medo a sumpa ed sikara, ya agda pablien so pilak, tan nipaakar ed balitok, ag ira manliket dia ed sikato.
Et saray bekang da ibasig da so saray tobonbalo ra a lalaki a nalinglingkay; et andian ira na panangasi ed bunga na eges; say mata ra ag onsibeg ed saray ugugaw
Et say Babilonia, say gayaga na saray nanarian, say kalimgasan na pangta na saray Caldeo, sikato naani singa sanen say Dios binagbag to so Sodoma tan Gomorra.

Sikato naani agla natooan ag met la napanayaman a manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan saray Arabes met ag ira mangipaalagey na toldad'man; ni saray pastol agda met parokolen so saray ayepdad' man.
Bangbalet monmonanakap ed takel so ondokol diman; et saray kaabungan da napano ra ed saray pangaskasian a pinalsa; et saray avestruz manayam irad'man, tan saray kanding ed takel onsayaw irad'man.
Et saray lobo manakis ira ed saray kastillo ra, tan saray tadioko ed saray makapaliket a pasen: et say panaon to sikato so asinger ya onsabi, tan saray agew to ag ira naparukey.
Ta si Katawan walaan naani panangasi ed Jacob, tan pilien to ni so Israel, tan ipasen to ra dia ed dili a dalin da: et say sangkaili mitipon ed sikara, tan onegna ra ed abung nen Jacob.

Et sikara so alaen na saray baley, tan yakar da ra ed pasen da: et say abung na Israel kayarianen to ra dia ed dalin nen Katawan a nipaakar ya ariripen a lalaki tan bibii: et dakepen da naani so saray anakep ed sikara; et panoleyan da naani so saray manangapos da.
Et nagawa dia ed agew a si Katawan iter to ed sika so painawa ed ermen mo, tan ed gonigon mo, tan ed mairap a panaglingkor a nangawaan da a nanpalingkor ed sika,
Pian alaen mo so sayan alimbawa a sumpa ed ari na Babilonia, tan kuan mo. Panon la so itonda na manangapos! say binmalitok a ciudad tinmon da!
Si Katawan pinuter to so tayokor na marelmeng, say cetro na saray managuley;
A kinabil da so saray baley dia ed petang a tekep na naynay a pekpek, ya inuleyan da so saray nacion dia ed sanok, a tekep na panangosil ya andi anebel.
Say amin a dalin wala ed painawa, tan sikato so mareen: ombutay ira a mankancanta.
On, saray saleng manliket ira ed sika, tan saray cedro na Libano, a kuan da, Nanlapu ed inkiyabebam, angapo so panday a tinmatdang a sumpa ed sikami.

Say Sheol manlapu ed lepsag agalaw nipaakar ed sika ya onabet ed sika ed isasabim; binangon to so inatey nipaakar ed sika, salanti saray amin a manona ed dalin, pinaalagey to a manlapu ed saray trono ra so saray amin ya ar-ari na saray nacion.
Amin da onebat ira tan kuan da ed sika, Kinmapuy ka ta a singa sikami? Nagmaliw ka ta a singa sikami?
Say pasirayew mo nilepsag ed Sheol, tan say tanol na saray violam: say bigis ombuyak ed lepsag mo, tan saray bigis sakbongan da ka.
Panon la so inkaplag mo a nanlapu ed tawen, O kabuntatala, anak na kabwasan! panon la so inkabatang mo ed dalin, sika ya inpanangabebam so saray nacion!

Et inkuan mo ed pusom, Onkalabak ed tawen, ipatagey ko so yorongan ko ed tagey na saray bibitewen na Dios; et onyorongak ed tapew na palandey na moyong, dia ed saray kasampotan na kabiangan na amianen;
Onkalab ak ed tagey na saray a tagey a lurem: gawaen ko so inkasiak a singa say Sankatagyan.
Angan ontan nilepsag ka ed Sheol, ed saray kasampotan a kabiangan na kalinsorong.
Saray makanengneng ed sika limgisen da ka naani, pakanonoten da ka, a kuan da, Sikatoya ta so too a nangawa ed dalin ya onkeyer, ya anenyeg ed saray nanarian;
A ginawa to so mundo a singa kalawakan, tan ingeba to so saray ciudad to; ya agto bolosan so saray pinangaw to ed abung to?
Amin na saray ar-ari ed saray nacion, amin da, naugip ira ed gayaga, balang sakey ed dili ya abung to.

Balet nibantak ka a manlapu ed lobok mo a singa kadimla so sanga, ya akawesan ed pinatey, a sikara so atalos ed kampilan, ya onlepsag ed saray bato na kalinsorong; singa inatey a laman ya agatingatinan ed lepsag na sali.
Agka nitipon naani ed sikara ed ponpon, lapu ed binagbag mo so dalin mo, pinatey mo so baley mo; say bini na saray managgawa na mauges ag ira nabitla lawas.
Itadia yo so panagpateyan a nipaakar ed saray anak to lapu ed inkauges na saray atateng da, pian ag ira onalagey, tan kayarianen da so dalin, tan panoen da so lupa na mundo ed saray ciudad.
Onalagey ak naani sumpa ed sikara, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, tan pegpegen ko a manlapu ed Babilonia so ngaran na natilak, tan say anak na anak, kuan nen Katawan.
Sikato met so gawaen ko a kayarian na saray puerko ispin, tan tantanke na danum: et sikato so panisan ko ed panis na panamagbag, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito.
Si Katawan na saray ejercito insamba to, a kuan to, Petepeteg, singa ninonot ko, ontan so nagawa; et singa pinegdat ko, ontan so mansiansia naani:

A betagen ko so Asirio ed dalin ko, tan dia ed tapew na saray palandey sikato so igatingatin ko ed lepsag na sali; saman la naekal so pako to a manlapu ed sikara, tan say awit to naekal a manlapu ed abala ra.
Saya sikato so kanonotan a ninonot a nipaakar ed amin a dalin; tan saya sikato so lima a niyunat ed tapew na saray amin a nacion.
Ta si Katawan na saray ejercito ninonot to, tan siopa so mamaandi kabaliksan to? et say lima to niyunat, tan siopa so mangipikos ed sikato?
Dia ed taon ya inpatey nen ari Acaz wala nen saman so saya ya awit.
Agka manliket, O Filistia, amin ed sika, lapu ed say pekpek ya angabil ed sika aputer; tan manlapu ed lamot na uleg ompaway so tadioko, tan say bunga to sikato naani masebeg a basibas ya uleg.
Say pangoloan ya anak na duka mantagano, tan say naokolan ondokol a maligen; et peteyen ko so lamot mo ed panamegley na eras, tan say natilak ed sika napatey.
Dangol ka, O wangalan; akis ka, O ciudad; natunaw ka, O Filistia, amin ed sika; ta onsabi asewek a manlapu ed amianen, tan angapo so naonor ed saray dasig to.
Anto sirin so yebat na sakey ed saray igagangan na nacion? A si Katawan inpaalagey to so Sion, tan dia ed sikato say pinairap ed baley to onapireng naani.
Say awit na Moab. Ta dia ed sanlabi say Ar na Moab sikato so nabagbag, tan niyakar ed andi kakanaan; ta dia ed sanlabi say Kir na Moab sikato so abagbag, tan niyakar ed andi kakanaan.
Tinmatdang ira ed Bayith, tan ed Dibon ed saray atagey a pasen, a mannangis: say Moab agogolan to so Nebo, tan say Medeba; ed saray amin ya olo ra wala so inkayangyangan, balang balbas akiskisan.
Dia ed saray polong da balkesan da so inkasikara ed magaspang ya abel; ed saray toktok na abung da, tan dia ed saray mapalaway a pasen da, balang sakey managogol, a mannangis a mapalalo.
Et say Hesbon onakis, tan say Eleale; say voces da narengel anga ni ed Jahaz: kanian saray inayuraan a totoo na Moab manakis ira na maksil; say kamarerwa to ongiwgiw ed dalem to.

Say pusok manakis nipaakar ed Moab; saray angkabli to ombatik ira anga ed Zoar, anga ed Eglatshelishiyah: ta ed tatatdangan na Luhit sinanangis ira ya ontatdang; ta dia ed dalan na Horonaim amaalagey ira na akis na panamagbag.
Ta saray danum na Nimrim naopot ira; ta say dika namagaan, say tariwa a dika nalenes, angapo so malambot a bengatla.
Kanian say inkadaakan arandan da, tan say tinipon da, ibaliw da ed nibaliw na kolos na saray kinonkawayan.
Ta say akis linmiber ed saray ketegan na Moab; say panagogol to sinmabi ed Eglaim, tan say panagogol to anga ed Beer-elim.
Ta saray danum na Dimon napno ra na dala; ta mangyakar ak ni lalo ed Dimon, sakey a leon ed tapew na saray makatainan ed Moab, tan ed tapew na natilak ed dalin.
Ipawit yo so saray kordero a nipaakar ed managuley ed dalin a manlapu ed Selah anga ed kalawakan, anga ed palandey na anak a bii na Sion.
Ta nagawa naani ya, singa saray manteyengteyeng a manok, singa say nitayak ya obong, ontan so saray anak a bibii na Moab ed saray babaliwan na Arnon.
Mangiter ka na panimbawa, mangawa ka na inkatunong; gawam a say aninom singa say labi dia ed pegley na agew; yamot mo so saray nibantak; agmo yawat so binmatik.

Paulian mo a saray imbantak ko miayam ira ed sika: singa nipaakar ed Moab, sika komon so sakey a sakbong ed sikato ed lupa na manamagbag. Ta say manamaduka niyakar ed andi kakanaan, say panamagbag ontonda, saray manangapos naopot ira ed dalin.
Et sakey a trono so niletneg naani ed maaron abig na linawa; et sakey so onyorong diman ed katuaan, dia ed tolda nen David, a mangokom, tan mananap na inkatunong, tan magano a mangawa na kaptekan.
Nadngelan mi so pangta na Moab, a sikato so sankapangtaan; salanti say karangalan to, tan say kalangasan to, tan say petang to; saray pasirayew to sikara so andi kakanaan.
Kanian say Moab managogol a nipaakar ed Moab, balang sakey managogol: nipaakar ed saray bibingka a pasas na Kir-areset managogol kayo, a sigpot ya apaonong.

Ta saray uma na Hesbon ombeleng ira, tan say uvas na Sibma; saray kakatawan na saray nacion nilupis da so saray apili a sanga to, a dinmandan ira anga ed Jazer, a nanteyengteyeng ira ed kalawakan; saray sirnit to kinmayat ira, binmaliw ira ed dayat.

Kanian miagogol ak ed panagogol na Jazer a nipaakar ed uvas na Sibma, sika naani salogen ko ed saray luak, O Hesbon, tan Eleale: ta ed tapew na saray bungam ed tiagew tan ed tapew na anien mo so naplagan na eyag na bakal.

Say inkagayaga nakal, tan say liket nitainan a manlapu ed mabunga ya uma; et dia ed saray uvasan angapo naani pankankanta, ni makapalikliket a tanol: angapo so managgatin a mangigatingatin na alak ed panagalakan, pinatondak so eyag na panagbodbor.
Kanian say pusok ontanol a singa arpa nipaakar ed Moab, tan saray loobloob ko nipaakar ed Kirhares.
Et nagawa, sano say Moab ompatnag, sano nábanalan ed tapew na atagey a pasen, tan ondago ed santuario to a manpikasi, ya ag ontalona.
Saya sikato so salita a si Katawan sinalita to nipaakar ed Moab ed panaon a linmabas.

Balet natan si Katawan nansalita, ya inkuan to, Ed loob na taloy taon, a singa saray taon na miopopa, say gayaga na Moab niyakar ed kabalawan, pati amin a baleg a karaklan to; et say natilak sikato naani melamelag tan andi kakanaan.
Say awit na Damasco. Nia, say Damasco nakal ed inkaciudad to, tan sikato so magmaliw ya abagbag a losbo.
Saray ciudad na Aroer apaulian ira; nipaakar ira naani ed saray polok na ayayep ya ondokol ira, tan angapo so manaktakot ed sikara.

Et saray salimbeng ontonda ra a manlapu ed Efraim, tan say nanarian a manlapu ed Damasco, tan say kera ed Siria; sikara naani singa say gayaga na saray anak na Israel, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito.
Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a say gayaga nen Jacob nagawa naani a melag, tan say inkataba na laman to magmaliw naani a mabeng.
Et sikato naani singa say manani á too sano mantipon na manalalagey a bukel, tan say taklay to sinopen to so saray dawá; on, sikato naani singa say mantudtur na saray dawa ed lawak na Refaim.

Angan ontan wala naani nakeraan diman a tutudturen, singa say pamaspas ed kiew ya olivo, duara odino talo ra a bunga dia ed toktok na kasampotan na sanga, apat ira odino lima ra dia ed kangorongoroan a sangasanga na mabunga a kiew, kuan nen Katawan, say Dios na Israel.
Dia ed satan ya agew saray totoo onnengneng ira ed Makangawa ed sikara, tan saray mata ra pagalangan da so Santo na Israel.
Et ag ira onnengneng ed saray altar, a gawa na saray lima ra; agda met pagalangan so ginawa na saray garnet da, angan say Ashera, ni saray kinonbanua.

Dia ed satan ya agew saray mabiskeg da a ciudad singa saray inkaindan a paspasen dia ed kakiewan tan ed toktok na palandey, ya ákaindan ira a manlapu ed arapan na saray anak na Israel; et sikato naani kibalatar.
Ta alingoanan mo so Dios na kilalaban mo, tan agmo ninodnonot so bato na kasil mo; kanian mantanaman ka na makapalikliket a tantanaman, tan sikato so itanem mo ed saray sankaili a simit.
Dia ed agew na panagtanem mo sikato so bayoboan mo, tan dia ed kabuasan panrosasen mo so bukel; balet angapo so anien ed agew na irap tan andi ilalo ya ermen.
A, say ongol na dakerakel a baley, a manongol a singa panongol na saray kadayatan; tan say pantatabonan na saray nacion, a mantatabonan ira a singa pantatabonan na saray makapanyari a danum!

Saray nacion mantatabonan ira naani a singa pantatabonan na saray dakel a danum: balet baaten to ra naani, et ombatik ira ed arawi, tan nibantak ira a singa saray taep na saray palandey ed arap na dagem, tan singa say manalimbosabos a dabok ed arap na bagyo.
Ed mankapisdem, nia, so makapataktakot; et ed arapen na kabwasan andila ra. Saya sikato so betang na saray manamsam ed sikatayo, tan say apag na saray manakew ed sikatayo.
A, say dalin na panbanesbes na saray payak, ya wala ed nibaliw na saray ilog na Etiopia;

A mangibaki na saray igagangan ya ondalan ed dayat, salanti dia ed saray sakayan a bakubak ed tapew na saray danum, a kuanto, Onla kayo, sikayo masiglat ya igagangan, ed nacion ya alagey tan mapalanas, ed baley a makapataktakot manlapu ed gapo ra, sakey a nacion a mansukat tan mangigatin a say dalin to apagen na saray ilog!
Aminyon manaayam ed mundo, tan sikayon manaayam ed dalin, sano say tanda niyalagey ed saray palandey, nengnengen yo; tan sano say tamboyog napaknol dengel yo.
Ta onia so inkuan nen Katawan ed siak, Ondeen ak, tan limgisen ko ed panagayaman ko a pasen, singa say malinew a petang ed sinag na agew, singa say lurem na linaew ed petang na panagani
Diad arapen na panagani, sano say panbolaklak alabas la, tan say bulaklak magmaliw a bunga na uvas ya aloto, pegpegen to so saray olnos ed yoro, tan saray malambot a sanga ekalen to tan igeba to.
