Nitilak ira naani a nitipon ed saray masiba a manomanok na saray palandey, tan ed saray munanakap na dalin; et saray masiba a manomanok manayam ira naani ed sikara ed panaon na petang, tan saray amin a munanakap na dalin manayam ira naani ed sikara ed panaon na betel.

Dia ed satan a panaon sakey a tokdol so niyakar ed Katawan na saray ejercito a manlapu ed baley ya atagey tan mapalanas, salanti manlapu ed baley a makapataktakot a manlapu ed gapu ra angad arapen, sakey a nacion a mansukat tan mangigatin, a say dalin to apagen na saray ilog, ed pasen na ngaran nen Katawan na saray ejercito, say palandey na Sion.
Say Awit na Egipto. Nia, si Katawan onlugan ed masiglat a lurem, tan onla ed Egipto: et saray taltalintao na Egipto ongiwgiw ira ed arapto; et say puso na Egipto natunaw dia ed pegley to.

Et bangonen ko so saray Egipcio a sumpa ed saray Egipcio: et mankakabilan. ira a balang sakey sumpa ed agi to, tan balang sakey sumpa ed kaabay to; ciudad sumpa ed ciudad, tan nanarian sumpa ed nanarian.

Et say espiritu na Egipto onkulang naani ed pegley to; et bagbagen ko so pananimbawa to: et ompanon ira naani ed saray talintao, tan ed saray mangkokolam tan ed saray walaan na kaibiba ya espiritu, tan ed saray pomaparles.
Et yawat ko naani so saray Egipcio ed lima na masulit a katawan: et sakey a masubeg ya ari so manuley ed sikara, kuan na Katawan,. si Katawan na saray ejercito.
Et saray danum onkulang ira naani a manlapu ed dayat, tan say ilog naekatan tan namagaan.
Et saray ilog magmaliw ira ya ambanget; saray agos na Egipto ondaiset tan namagaan, saray kawayan tan dampig nalenes ira.
Saray talogtog ed abay na Nilo, ed abay na pangdel na Nilo, tan amin ya ataneman ya um-uma na Nilo, namagaan ira, nipalir ira, tan naandi lara.
Et saray sumisigay maneyey ira, tan amin iray angipelag na banwit ed Nilo maningel ira, tan saray mangibuskag na iket ed saray danum ombeleng ira.
Laot ni saray mankimey ed sinagaysay a lino, tan saray manabel na ampoti ya abel, nagotgot ira naani.
Et saray seklang na Egipto nabuyakbuyak ira: amin iray miopopa sikara naani napaermen ed kamarerwa.

Saray principe na Soan sikara so sigpot a maatiw; say simbawa na saray sankakabatan a mananimbawa nen Faraon magmaliw ira a mureng: panon so pangikuan yo ed Faraon, Siak anak ak na makabat, anak na saray toon daan ya arari?
Iner sirin so kawalaan na saray makabat a totoom? tan ibaga ra komon ed sika natan; et ipakabat da no anto so ninonot nen Katawan na saray ejercito nipaakar ed Egipto.
Saray principe na Soan magmaliw ira a makulangkulang, saray principe na Memfis sikara so napalingo; ginawa ra so Egipto a nabalang, sikara a panoyok a bato na saray poli to.
Si Katawan inlaok to so espiritu na inkauges ed pegley to; et imbalang da so Egipto ed balang kimey to, a singa abuek a too ya manilakilak ed uta to.
Angapo met so bengatla a kimey nipaakar ed Egipto, a say olo odino ikol, singa na palma odino dampig, nagawa ra.
Dia ed satan ya agew saray Egipcio singa ra naani saray bibii; et mangiwgiw tan antakot ira lapu ed akaayag a lima nen Katawan na saray ejercito, a yayag to ed tagey da.
Et say dalin na Juda magmaliw naani a makapataktakot ed Egipto: balang sakey a manongtong ed sikato nataktakot, nisengeg ed getma nen Katawan na saray ejercito, a ninonot to sumpa ed sikato.
Dia ed satan ya agew wala naani limaran ciudad ed dalin na Egipto a mansalita ed salita na Canaan, tan mansamba ra ed Katawan na saray ejercito; say sakey natawag naani a Say ciudad na kabagbag.
Dia ed satan ya agew wala naani sakey ya altar ed Katawan ed pegley na dalin na Egipto, tan sakey a seklang ed ketegan to nipaakar ed Katawan.

Et sikato naani nipaakar a tanda tan nipaakar a tasi ed Katawan na saray ejercito ed dalin na Egipto; ta ontawag ira ed Katawan nisengeg ed saray manangapos, et mangibaki ed sikara na manangilaban, tan manangyagel, et sikara so ilaban to.

Et si Katawan nakabatan naani ed Egipto, et saray Egipcio nakabatan da si Katawan ed satan ya agew; on, manpikasi ra a tekep na bagat tan patanir, tan mangisipan ira na sakey a sipan ed Katawan, tan sikato so sumpalen da.
Et si Katawan bakbaken to naani so Egipto, a mamakbak tan manambal: et manpataoli ra ed Katawan, tan sikato so nakerewan da, tan tambalen to ra.
Dia ed satan ya agew wala naani sakey a polong a manlapu ed Egipto ya arap ed Asiria, et say Asirio onloob ira ed Egipto, tan say Egipcio ed Asiria; et saray Egipcio manpikasi ra a pati saray Asirio.
Dia ed satan ya agew say Israel sikato naani komatlo ed Egipto tan Asiria, sakey a bendicion ed pegley na dalin;
Ta si Katawan na saray ejercito binendicionan to ra, ya inkuan to, Bendito so Egipto a baley ko, tan say Asiria a kimey na saray limak, tan say Israel a tawir ko.
Dia ed taon a si Tartan linma ed Asdod, sanen sikato so inbaki nen Sargon ya ari ed Asiria, tan akibakal sumpa ed Asdod tan sikato so inala to;

Ed satan a panaon si Katawan nansalita ed panamegley nen Isaias ya anak a laki nen Amoz, ya inkuan to, Onla ka, tan okposen mo so magaspang ya abel a manlapu ed saray banel mo, tan ekal mo so sapin mo ed salim. Et ginawa to so ontan, a nanakar a lakseb tan kasalisali.
Et si Katawan inkuan to, Singa si aripen ko ya Isaias a nanakar a lakseb tan kasalisali a taloy taon a nipaakar a tanda tan pankelawan nipaakar ed Egipto tan nipaakar ed Etiopia;

Ontan naani so ari na Asiria a mangyakar ed arawi ed saray dinakep ed Egipto, tan saray apalis ed Etiopia, ugaw tan masiken, lakseb tan kasalisali, tan andi sakbong so saray kipuy, a kibabaingan na Egipto.
Et napunaw ira naani tan nagolo ra, nisengeg ed Etiopia a panilaloan da, tan say Egipto a gayaga ra.

Et say manaayam ed saya a gilig na dayat ikuan da ed satan ya agew, Nia, onia so panilaloantayo, iner so binatikan tayo nipaakar ed tulong pian nilaban itayo a manlapu ed ari na Asiria: et sikatayo, panon so ibatik tayo?
Say awit ed kalawakan na dayat. Singa saray alimbosabos ed Abalaten onsibok ed amin, sikato so onsabi a manlapu ed kalawakan, manlapu ed makapataktakot a dalin.

Sakey a makapaermen a pasingawey so nipaliwawa ed siak: say liputan a too managamil a sililiput, tan say managbagbag mamagbag. Ontatdang ka, O Elam; onkobkob ka, O Media; amin a pansibek to pinatondak.

Kanian saray banel ko napno ra ed irap; say otot nansiansia ed siak, a singa saray otot na bii dia ed panpasakit: mairirap ak dia ed ontan ya agak makadngel; apunaw ak dia ed ontan ya agak makanengneng.
Say pusok manparok, say makapataktakot kinebiew to ak; say kapisdem a nanpilalekan ko nagmaliw a makapagiwgiw ed siak.
Itadia ra so dulang, ipasen da so bantay, mangan ira, oninum ira: onalagey kayo, sikayo piprincipe, poyokan yo so kinlong.
Ta onia so inkuan na Katawan ed siak, Onla ka, mangipasen ka na bantay; ipaliwawa to komon so nanengneng to:

Et sano makanengneng na sakey ya ejercito, lalaki a kabayoan dia ed nantopag, sakey ya ejercito na saray asno, sakey ya ejercito na saray kamello, ondengel naani a maimatlek a pati baleg a pangimaton.
Et inmakis a singa sakey a leon: O Katawan, akaalagey ak a naynay ed tapew na bantayan na talayap dia ed agew, tan nipasen ak dia ed bantay ko ed makasanlabi;

Et, nia, dia onsabi so sakey ya ejercito na lalaki, lalaki a kabayoan ed nantopag. Et inmebat tan inkuan to, Naplag, naplag so Babilonia; et saray amin ya inbolik a taltalintao na saray dirios to nigeba ra ed dalin.
O sika taltagan ko, tan say bukel na datal ko! saman a nadngel ko nanlapu ed Katawan na saray ejercito, say Dios na Israel, inpaliwawak ed sikayo.
Say awit na Duma, Sakey so mantawag ed siak a manlapu ed Seir, Managbantay, anto ta so horas na labi? Managbantay, anto ta so horas na labi?
Say managbantay inkuan to, Say kabuasan onsabi la, tan say labi met: no mibalita kayo, mibalita kayo: ompawil kayo, onla kayo dia.
Say awit ed tapew na Arabia. Dia ed takel na Arabia ontondakayo, O sikayo manangili na saray Dedaneos.
Dia ed samay napgaan angyakar ira na danum; saray manaayam ed dalin na Tema inabet da so saray tinmainan a pati tinapay da.
Ta binmatik ira a nanlapu ed saray kampilan, manlapu ed akabagot a kampilan, tan manlapu ed akabekas a bekang, tan manlapu ed kaermenan na bakal.
Ta onia so inkuan na Katawan ed siak, Ed loob na sakey taon, unong ed saray taon na miopopa, amin a gayaga na Cedar onandi,
Et say solok ed bilang na saray managpana, saray makapanyari a totoo na saray anak na Cedar, sikara naani pigpigara; ta si Katawan, a Dios na Israel, sinalita to.
Say awit na lawak na pasingawey. Anto ta so liliknaen mo natan, ta sigpot a tinmatdang ka ed saray toktok na abung?
O sika a napno ka na saray paneyag, sakey a magolo a ciudad, sakey a malikeliket a baley; saray inatey ed sika ag ira inatey ed kampilan, ag ira met inatey ed bakal.
Amin iray managoley mo binmatik ira a nanoolop, binalor ira na saray managpana; amin iray aromog ed sika abalor ira a nantitipon; tinmainan ira ed arawi.
Kanian inkuan ko, Agkayo onnengneng ed siak, mannangis ak na ampaipait; agkayo mansagpot a manligliwa ed siak nipaakar ed kabagbag na anak a bibii na baley ko.

Ta sikato so agew na kagologolo, tan kigatingatin, tan panduaruwa, a manlapu ed Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, dia ed lawak na pasingawey; sakey a kageba na saray bakor, tan sakey a panakis ed saray palandey.
Et si Elam nanawit na pananginan na pana, pati saray diluganan iran totoo tan kabayoan a lalaki; et say Kir nilukasan to so kinlong.
Et nagawa, a saray apili a lawak mo napno ra na saray luganan, tan saray lalaki a kabayoan nandarasig ira ed wangalan.
Et inekal to so sakbong na Juda; et ninmengneng ka ed saman ya agew ed panagayuraan ed abung ed takel.
Et anengneng yo so saray kutkutlaong na ciudad nen David, a sikara so dakel; et tinipon yo so saray danum na bandadlepsag a tanke;
Et binilang yo so saray kaabungan na Jerusalem, tan ingebayo so saray kaabungan pian onkana a pamabiskeg ed bakor;
Nangawa kayo met na sakey a tanke ed leet na saray duaran bakor nipaakar ed danum na daan a tanke. Balet ag kayo ninmengneng ed saman so nangawa ed saya, agyo met ingalang imay nannonot ya abayag la.
Et dia ed satan ya agew say Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, tinawag to so pannangis, tan panagogol, tan panyangyang, tan panbalkes na magaspang ya abel:
Et, nia, so liket tan kagayagaan, a panpatey ed saray baka tan panpatey ed saray carnero, panangan na laman tan paninum na alak: Mangan itayo tan maninum itayo, ta nabuas ompatey itayo.
Et si Katawan na saray ejercito pinmuyan ed saray layag ko, Petepeteg a saya ya inkauges ag napaandi ed sikayo anga ed ompatey kayo, kuan na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito.
Onia so kuan na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, Onla ka, onsabi ka ed saya a panangisimpen na kayamanan, salanti si Sebna, a sikato so manonaan ed abung, tan kuan mo,
Anto so gawaen mo dia? tan anto so wala ed sika dia, ya angotkot ka na lobok nipaakar ed sika? mangokotkot na lobok nipaakar ed sikato ed tagey, mamapanday na panagayaman nipaakar ed sikato ed bato!
Nia, si Katawan, a singa mabiskeg a too, ibantak to ka a makmaksil; on, balkoten toka a malmalet.

Sikato petepeteg a patpatleken to ka, tan itolintolin to ka a singa bola ed maawang a dalin; diman ka ompatey naani, tan diman so kawalaan na saray luganan na gayagam, sika so kibabaingan na abung na katawan mo.
Et ekalen toka a manlapu ed betang mo; et manlapu ed kipapasen mo igayogoy toka.
Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, a tawagen ko so aripen ko ya Eliakim ya anak a laki nen Elcias:

Et sikato so kawesan ko ed sokbong mo, tan sikato so pabiskegen ko ed balkes mo, tan imatalek ko so panagoleyan mo ed lima to; et sikato naani ama ed saray manaayam ed Jerusalem, tan diad abung nen Juda.
Et say tombok na abung nen David nigaton ed abala to; et sicato so mangilukas, tan angapo so mangikaput; et sikato so mangikaput, tan angapo so mangilukas.
Et sikato so ipalpal ko a singa pasak ed matalek a pasen; et sikato naani nipaakar a yorongan na gayaga na abung nen ama to.
Et isabit da ed sikat so amin a gayaga na abung nen ama to, say simit to tan say gawa to, balang melag ya agamil, manlapu ed saray yaong anga ed saray poronggo to.

Dia ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, say pasak a nipalpal ed matalek a pasen nabagot; et sikato naani nigeba, tan napelag; et say awit ya wala nen saman ed tapew to naekal; ta sikato so sinalita nen Katawan.
Say Awit na Tiro. Dangol kayo, sikayon sasakayan na Tarsis; ta sikato so abagbag, dia ed ontan angapo so abung, ni looban: manlapu ed dalin na Kitim sikato so nipaliwawa ed sikara.
Mandeen kayo, sikayon manaayam ed pangdel, sika a saray lomalako na Sidon, ya ombaliw ed dayat, pinano ra ka lamet.
Et ed saray ankabaleg a danum say bukel na Sihor, say panagani na Nilo, sikato nen saman so nabang to; et sikato nen saman so panaglakoan na saray nacion.
Ombaing ka, O Sidon; ta say dayat sinalita to, say salimbeng na dayat, inkuan to, Agak nanpasakit, ni nananak ak, agak met naniwi na saray tobonbalo a lalaki, ni amabaleg ak na saray virgin.
Sano onsabi so balita ed Egipto, sikara naani naermenan a mairirap ed balita na Tiro.
Basil kayo ed Taris; maningel kayo, sikayo a manaayam ed pangdel.
Sikatoya ta so malikeliket a ciudad yo, a say inkadaan to sikato so inkadaan na saray agew, a saray sali to sikato so inyakar da ed arawi a miayam?
Siopa so nannonot na saya a sumpa ed Tiro, say manangyotob na saray balanget, a saray lomalako to principe ra, a saray manangili to sikara so angkabli ed dalin?
Si Katawan na saray ejercito ninonot to, pian moraen to so pangta na amin a gayaga, pian yakar to ed kabalaw so amin ya angkabli ed dalin.
Labasan mo so dalin mo a singa say Nilo, O anak a bii na Tarsis; angapo so bengatla a sebel.
Niyunat to so lima to ed tagey na dayat, niyegyeg to so saray nanarian; si Katawan angiter na gangan nipaakar ed Canaan, pian nabagbag so saray salimbeng to.
Et inkuan to, Agka la naani manliket, O sika inaposan a virgen ya anak a bii na Sidon: onalagey ka, ombasil ka ed Kitim; angan diman agka nawalaan na painawa.

Nia, say dalin na saray Caldeo: saya a baley angapo nen saman; sikato so inpaalagey na Asirio a nipaakar ed saray manaayam ed kalawakan; inpaalagey da so saray ilang da; binagbag da so saray palacio to; sikato so ginawa ra a sakey a bagbag.
Dangol kayo, sikayo sasakayan na Tarsis; ta say salimbeng yo sikato so abagbag.

Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, a say Tiro nalingoanan a pitomplo a taon, unong ed saray agew na sakey ya ari kayari angaan na pitomplo a taon nagawa ed Tiro so singa dia ed canta na balangkantis.
Mangala ka na sakey ya harpa, liberen mo so ciudad, sika balangkantis ya alingoanan; mangawa ka na makaanlay a togtog, mancanta ka na saray dakel a canta, pian sika so nanonotan.
Et nagawa ed kayari angaan na pitomplo a taon, a si Katawan dalawen to so Tiro, tan sikato so ompawil naani ed upa to, tan mibalangkantis ed saray amin a nanarian na mundo ed tapew na dalin.

Et say lako to tan say upa to sikara naani kasantosan ed Katawan; sikato naani ag nisimpen no nilosbo: ta say lako to nipaakar ed saray manaayam ed arap nen Katawan, a kanen da a masarag, tan nipaakar ed mabayag a pankawes.
Nia, si Katawan gawaen to so dalin a paoypaoy, tan sikato so gawaen to ya abagbag, tan sikato so pigaren to, tan itayaktayak to so saray manaayam ed sikato.

Et nagawa naani, ya unong na baley, ontan so sacerdote, unong na aripen, ontan so katawan to, unong na aripen a bii, ontan so ali to, unong na manaliw, ontan so manlako; unong na mamautang, ontan so akautang; unong na manangala na abang, ontan so manangiter na abang ed sikato.
Say dalin sikato naani sigpot a paoypaoy, tan sigpot ya abagbag, ta si Katawan sinalita to so saya a salita.
Say dalin maningel tan nalenes, say mundo ombeleng tan nalenes, say mapaatagey a totoo na dalin ombeleng.
Say dalin met narutakan ed lepsag na saray manaayam ed sikato; lapu ed niloksoan da so saray tunong, sinumpa ra so saray panontonan, binuyak da so maando a sipan.
Kanian say ayew inakmon to so dalin, tan saray manaayam diman aromog ira a nankasalanan: kanian saray manaayam ed dalin napoolan ira, tan daiset a totoo so nakeraan.
Say balo ya alak managogol, say uvas ombeleng, amin iray magayaga a puso onsinagem ira.
Say liket na pandereta ontonda, say ongol na saray manliliket manganga, say liket na harpa ontonda.
Ag ira oninum na alak a tekep na canta; say mabayani ya inumen ampait naani ed saray oninum ed sikato.
Say nabagbag a ciudad sikato so nageba, balang abung nakaputan, pian angapo so too a makaloob.
Wala so panakis ed saray polong nisengeg ed alak; amin a liket ombilunget, say gayaga na dalin naandi.
Dia ed ciudad napaulian so kibalatar, tan say wangalan nakabil ed panamagbag.
Tan onia naani dia ed pegley na dalin ed nanleleetan na saray balbaley, singa say panbanlayon na kiew ya oliva, singa saray pantudtur sano say panagbodbor na uvas agawa la.
Saraya itagey da so voces da, oneyag ira; nipaakar ed kaatageyan nen Katawan onakis ira na maksil a manlapu ed dayat.
Kanian pagayagaen yo si Katawan ed bokig, salambengat say ngaran nen Katawan, a Dios na Israel, dia ni ed saray polo na dayat.

Manlapu ed kaarawiyan a kabiangan na dalin akadngel kami na kancanta. Gloria ed matunong. Balet inkuan ko, Onebeng ak, onebeng ak, abagey ak la! say liputan managamil ed liput; on, say liputan ed kaliputan.
Takot, tan say kalinsorong, tan say kalot, wala ra ed tepew, mo, O manaayam ed dalin.

Et nagawa, a say ombatik a manlapu ed tanol na takot napelag naani ed kalinsorong; et say ontatdang manlapu ed pegley na kalinsorong naala naani ed kalot: ta saray dorongawen ed tagey akalukas ira, tan saray angipaletnegan ed dalin onkeyer.
Say dalin sigpot a nabuyak, say dalin naderal a maminpinsan, say dalin natenyeg a makmaksil.
Say dalin mantogingging naani a singa abuek a too, tan nibayesbayes dia tan diman a singa anduyan; et say inpakalokso to sikato naani ambelat et tapew to, et sikato so nipasag, tan ag la onalagey.
Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a si Katawan dusaen to so ejercito na saray atagey ed tagey, tan saray arari na dalin ed tapew na dalin.
Et natiptipon ira, a singa saray pinangaw natipon ira ed kalinsorong, tan nipokok ira ed panangipangawan; et kayari na saray dakel ya agew sikara so nadalaw.
Saman la say bulan natiweng, tan say banwa nabaingan; ta si Katawan na saray ejercito man-ari ed palandey Sion, tan dia ed Jerusalem; tan dia ed arap na saray mamasiken to napagloria.
O Katawan, sika so Dios ko; sika so paatageyen ko, igalang ko naani ngaran mo; ta nangawa ka na saray makapakelaw, saray pananimbawa lanti nen inmuna, dia ed katooran tan katuaan.
Ta ginawam so ciudad a sakey a losbo, say sakey a kinutaan a ciudad ed sakey ya inkageba, say sakey a palacio na saray sankaili ya aliwa a ciudad la; sikato naani ag la nipaatagey angan kapigan.
Kanian say baley a mabiskeg paliketen toka; say ciudad na saray makapakebiew a nacion ontakot ira naani ed sika.

Ta sika so apireng na duka, sakey ya apireng na naokolan ed kairapan, sakey a salimbeng ed bagyo, sakey a sirum ed petang, sano say ngapos na saray makapakebiew a totoo sikato so singa sakey a bagyo ya onsumpa ed bakor.
Singa say petang ed sakey a pasen ya amaga paabebaen mo so tanol na saray sankaili; singa say petang lapu ed sirum na lurem, say canta na saray makapakebiew a totoo napaabeba.

Et dia ed saya a palandey si Katawan na saray ejercito mangawa naani ed saray amin a baley na sakey a liket ed saray mataba a bengatla, sakey a liket na saray alak ed tapew na saray bolirek, saray mataba a bengatla a napno na utek, tan saray alak ed tapew na saray bolirek napaitneng ira.
Et bagbagen to dia ed saya a palandey so lupa na sakbong a manakbong ed saray amin a baley, tan say pandong a nibilkag ed tagey na saray amin a nacion.

Inakmon to so patey ed ando lan ando; et say Katawan a Dios punasen to naani so saray lua a onagus ed saray amin a lupa; et say kabalawan na baley to ekalen to naani a manlapu ed amin a dalin: ta si Katawan sikato so sinalita to.

Et nikuan ed saman ya agew, Nia, saya sikato so Dios tayo; sikato so inalagar tayo, tan sikato ilaban to itayo: saya sikato si Katawan; sikato so inalagar tayo, manliket tan mangayaga itayo dia ed panangilaban to.
Ta dia ed saya a palandey say lima nen Katawan manpainawa; et say Moab nigatingatin naani ed pasen to, a singa dayami a nigatingatin ed danum na panagdutakan.

Et yunat to naani so saray lima to ed pegley to, a singa say onlangoy yunat to so saray lima to ya onlangoy; balet si Katawan paabebaen to naani so pangta to a nitipon a pati say inkapsel na saray lima to.
Et saray atagey a kuta na saray bakor mo igeba to, paabebaen to, tan yakar to ed dalin, anga ed dabok.
Dia ed saman ya agew nacanta so saya a canta ed dalin na Juda: Walaan kami na mabiskeg a ciudad: panangilaban so ipasen to naani nipaakar ed saray bakor tan panagtalayapan.
Lukasan yo so saray pinto, pian say matunong a nacion a mangonor nasisia makaloob.
Sikato naani kawaloen mo ed ayadyari a deen a say kanonotan to mansiansia ed sika; lapu ed nanmatalek ed sika.
Manmatalek kayo ed Katawan lawas; ta dia ed Katawan, si Katawan lanlamang sikato so ando lan ando a batondampay.
Ta inyakseb to so saray manaayam ed tagey, say mapangta a ciudad: sikato so inpangabeba to, sikato, so inpangabeba to anga ed dalin; sikato so inyakar to anga ed dabok.
Say sali sikato so igatin to; angan saray salisali na duka, tan saray kurang na naokolan.
Say dalan na matunong sikato so inkatunong: sika a matunong ka itonton mo so dalan na matunong.
On, dia ed dalan na saray panangokom mo, O Katawan, nanalagarkami ed sika; ed ngaran mo, say makapanodnonot lanlamang a ngaran mo, sikato so pilalek na kamarerwa mi.
Ed kamarerwak nanpilalekan taka dia ed labi; on, ed espirituk ed dalem ko anapen taka a maseeseet: ta sano saray panangokom mo wala ra dia ed dalin, saray manaayam ed mundo aralen da so inkatunong.
Say pamalangkap nipatnag komon ed marelmeng, angan ontan ag makaaral na inkatunong; dia ed dalin na inkatunong managamil naani ed inkalingo, tan agto napatnagan so kaatageyan nen Katawan.
Katawan, say limam niatagey, angan ontan agda nanengneng: balet nanengneng da so panamabaing mo nipaakar ed baley, tan nibabaing ira: on, apuy so mangakmon naani ed saray kasumlang mo.
Katawan, mangoksoy ka na deen nipaakar ed sikami; ta ginawam met so saray amin a kimey mi nipaakar ed sikami.
O Katawan a Dios mi, arum a kakatawan nilikod ed sika manuleyan da kami; balet lapu ed panamegley mo salambengat a nasalita mi so ngaran mo.
Sikara so inatey, ag ira ombilay; sikara so anino, ag ira onalagey la: kanian dinalaw mo tan binagbag mo ra, tan ginawam so amin a pakanodnonotan ed sikara a natawtaw.
Pinabaleg mo so nacion, O Katawan, pinabaleg mo so nacion, naraydayew ka; pinaawang mo so saray amin a ketegan na dalin.
Katawan, dia ed gonigon dinalaw da ka; angiapay ira na pikakasi sanen say pananusam wala ed tapew da.
Singa bii a malokon, a rhana singer so panaon a panpasakit to, ya wala ed irap tan panakis ed saray panpasakit to; dia ed ontan wala kami nen saman ed arap mo, O Katawan.
Nanlokon kami, nanpasakit kami, singa kami angianak na dagem: ag kami nangawa na bengatla a panangilaban dia ed dalin; ni saray manaayam ed mundo ag ira met nipasag.

Saray inatey mo ombilay ira; saray inaatey a laman ko onalagey ira. Liing tan mancanta kayo, sikayo, a manayam dia ed dabok; ta say linaew mo sikato ed singa linaew na saray dika, tan say dalin ipaway da naani so saray inatey.
Gala, baley ko, onloob ka ed saray silir mo, tan ikapot mo so saray silir mo, tan ikapot mo so saray pintom ed liberliber mo: yamot mo so inkasika ed daiset a panaon anga ed say kasanokan onlabas.

Ta, nia, si Katawan ompaway a manlapu ed pasen to pian dusaen to so saray manaayam ed dalin lapu ed inkauges da: say dalin met lakseban to so dala to, tan angan kapigan agto la sakbongan so saray inatey to.

Dia ed saman ya agew si Katawan lapu ed panamegley na anawet tan baleg tan mabiskeg a kampilan dusaen to naani so Leviatan a marlas ya uleg, tan say Leviatan a makiwi ya uleg; et pateyen to naani so tongol ya wala ed dayat.
Dia ed saman ya agew: Sakey ya uvasan na alak, sikato so kantaan yo.
Siak si Katawan ya managtalima ed sikato, sikato so salogen ko ed balang kasanlilikna: ompan wala so raanduksa ed sikato, sikato so talimaen ko ed labi tan agew.
Sanok andi ed siak saray tala tan saray sabitan wala ra komon a sumpa ed siak ed bakal! Manakar ak komon ed tapew da, poolan ko ra komon a bansag.
Odino andi sikato so ombenben komon ed biskeg ko, pian makapipakna ed siak; on, paulian mo a sikato komon so mipakna ed siak.
Dia ed saray agew ya onsabi si Jacob manlamot; say Israel manbolaklak tan onsimit: et panoen da so lupa na mundo ed bunga.
Kinabil to ta ra a singa inpangabil to ed saray angabil ed sikara? odino apatey ira a singa inpamatey ed saray pinatey da?
Ed panamegley na sukat, sano Patainanen mo ra, misangsangan ka ed sikara; sikato inekal to ra ed panamegley na mabiskeg a ngapos to ed agew na dagem a baitan.

Kanian lapu ed saya say inkauges nen Jacob napaandi, tan saya sikato so amin a bunga na panangekal ed kasalanan to: pian gawaen to so saray amin a bato na altar a singa dena a batobato ya abuybuyak, pian dia ed ontan saray Ashera tan say kinonbanwa ag la ra onalagey.
Ta say kinutaan a ciudad sikato so maingew, sakey a panagayaman ya atainan tan pinaulian, a singa kalawakan: diman mankabkab so kilaw na baka, tan diman ondokol, tan opoten to so saray sanga to.

Sano saray sanga to sikara so namagaan, napoter ira: saray bibii onsabi ra, tan sikara so poolan da; ta sikato, sakey a baley ya andian na pakatalos; kanian say nangawa ed sikara andian naani na panangasi ed sikara, tan say anogiop ed sikara ag mangipatnag ed sikara na pamalangkap.
Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a si Katawan paspasen to so bunga to a manlapu ed delap na Ilog anga ed colos na Egipto; et natipon kayo a sinansakey, O sikayo anak ira na Israel.

Et nagawa dia ed satan ya agew, a sakey a baleg a tamboyog so napaknol; et onsabi so saray maparaan ya ompatey ed dalin na Siria, tan saray nibantak ed dalin na Egipto; et manpikasira ed Katawan ed masanto a palandey ed Jerusalem.
Abagey la so balanget na inkapangta na saray managbuek na Efraim, tan say nalenes a bolaklak na magayaga a kalimgasan to, a sikato so wala ed olowan na mataba á lawak na saray naelew ed alak!

Nia, say Katawan walaan na sakey a makapangyari tan mabiskeg, singa bagyo a cristal, sakey a makabagbag a bagyo, singa bagyo na saray mabiskeg a danum ya onlepuas, ontan naani so pangipelag to ed dalin ed panamegley na lima.
Say balanget na inkapangta na saray managbuek na Efraim nigatingatin naani ed lepsag na sali:

Tan say nalenes a bolaklak na magayaga a kalimgasan to a sikato so wala ed olowan na mataba a lawak, sikato naani singa say bunga na higos a naloto ya unona ed arapen na tiagew; sikato a sano say onnengneng ed sikato naimatonan to, leleg a sikato ni wala ed lima to sikato so kanen to.
Dia ed satan ya agew si Katawan na saray ejercito magmaliw a balanget na gayaga tan sakey a diadema na kalimgasan, ed kera ed baley to;
Tan sakey ya espiritu na inkatunong ed saman so onyorong ed panangokom, tan kasil ed saray mamapoliktar ed bakal ed wangalan.

Et angan saraya mantogingging ira ed alak, tan nabalang ira ed mabayani ya inomen; say sacerdote tan say profeta mantogingging ira ed mabayani ya inomen, sikara so inakmon na alak, abalang ira ed mabiskeg ya inomen; nalingo ra ed pakanengneng, nigapol ira ed panangokom.
Ta amin iray dulang napno ra ed uta tan inkadutak, a dia ed ontan angapo so pasen a malinis.
Siopa so ibangat to na pikakabat? tan siopa so gawaen to a makatalos na balita? saray apakso ed gatas, tan nisian ed saray suso?
Ta sikato so bilin ed tapew na bilin, bilin ed tapew na bilin; gulis ed tapew na gulis, gulis ed tapew na gulis; dia daiset, diman daiset.
Andi, no ag ingen dia ed panamegley na totoo a sankaili a bibibibil tan arum a salita misalita ed saya a baley;
Sikato a nankuanan to, Saya sikato so painawa, itdan yo na panpainawa so naksawan; et saya sikato so pananempey: angan ontan ag ira dinmengel.

Kanian say salita nen Katawan sikato naani ed sikara so bilin ed tapew na bilin, bilin ed tapew na bilin; gulis ed tapew na gulis, gulis ed tapew na gulis; dia daiset, diman daiset: pian makakar ira, tan natibakiar ira, tan nabetag ira, tan nakalotan ira, tan naerel ira.
Kanian denglen yo so salita nen Katawan, sikato a mabalaw, a manuley ed sayan baley ya wala ed Jerusalem:

Lapu ed inkuan yo, Akipakna kami ed. patey, tan ed Sheol akinonong kami; sano say delap a bakbak onlabas, sikato naani ag onsabi ed sikami lapu ed ginawa mi so saray tila a sakorong mi, tan ed lepsag na inkatila inyamot mi so inkasikami:

Kanian onia so kuan na Katawan a Dios, Nia, ipasen ko dia ed Sion so sakey a bato a nipaakar a pangiletnegan, sakey ya asali a bato, sakey a bato a mabli a panokong na mátalek a pangiletnegan: say manisia ag naani manganat.
Et gawaen ko naani gulis ya inkatunong, tan panagkagulis so tunong; et say cristal ya uran panisen to naani so salimbengan na saray tila, tan saray danum delapen da naani so amutan a pasen.
Et say akipaknaan yo ed patey naandi kakanaan to, tan say inpinonong yo ed Sheol ag mansiansia: sano say delap a bakbak onlabas, saman la nigatingatin kayo ed lepsag to.
Singa say maparanay ya ilabas to, alaen to kayo naani; ta kinabuasan ya onlabas, ed agew tan ed labi: et angapo naani no ag say takot lambengat ed pangawat na balita.
Ta say dokolan sikato so antiktikey nen say too ya ononat ed tapew to; et say sakbong makiskisir nen saman so mansakbong.

Ta si Katawan onalagey naani a singa diman ed palandey Perasim, singa diman ed lawak na Gabaon so isanok to; pian nagawa to so kimey to, say kimey to a makapakelaw, tan palabasen to so gawa to, say gawa to a makapakelaw.
Natan sirin ag kayo manbalaw, ompan lamang onelet so saray balor yo, ta sakey a bilin a panamagbag so nadngel ko a manlapu ed Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, ed amin a dalin.
Dengel kayo, tan denglen yo so voces ko; talineng kayo, tan denglen yo so salitak.
Say manbaka na tataneman manbaka ta a naynay? naynay ta a lukasan to tan gubaten to so dalin to?
Sano napalanas to so tapew to, agto ta isibwag so eneldo, tan itayak so komino, tan ikotkot so trigo ed saray dasig, tan say cebada ed pasen a nigeter, tan say espelta ed ketegan to?
Ta sikato so bilinen a maptek na Dios, to tan sikato so ibangat to.
Ta saray eneldo ag ira iliken ed maotok ya alo, ag met nitulin ed tapew na komino so dalig na kareton; no ag ingen saray eneldo napaspas ira ed sakey a pekpek, tan say komino ed sakey a panaklay.
Say bukel a gawaen a tinapay sikato so gilingen; ta sikato so ag tapongen a naynay: tan angan say dalig na kareton to tan saray kabayo to sikato so itayak da, sikato so agto gilingen.
Saya manlapu lanlamang ed Katawan na saray ejercito, sikato a pankelkelawan a manimbawa, tan nasnaskey ed kakabatan.
O Ariel, Ariel; a ciudad a nanpakalsoan nen David! panaaroman yo so taon tan taon; saray liket onliber ira:
Saman la pairapen ko so Ariel, et wala naani paningel tan paney-ey, et sikato naani ed siak so singa Ariel.
Et manpakalso ak ed liberliber mo a sumpa ed sika, tan kobkoben taka ed inpasen a sosondalo, tan mamaalagey ak na salimbeng sumpa ed sika.

Et sika naani napaabeba, tan mansalita ka naani a manlapu ed dalin, et say salitam ompaway naani ya abeba ed dabok; et say voces mo sikato naani singa say walaan na espiritu a kaiba, manlapu ed dalin, tan say salitam malaramorom naani ya ompaway ed dabok.
Balet say karaklan na saray kabosol mo sikato naani singa daiset a dabok, tan say karaklan na saray makapakebiew singa say taep ya ontainan: on, sikato naani bigla ed kasanlilikna.
Sikato so dalawen nen Katawan na saray ejercito a tekep na saray karol, tan yegyeg, tan baleg a tanol, ed alimbosabos tan bagyo, tan say dalang na mangakmon ya apuy.
Et say karaklan na saray amin a nacion a mamakal ed Ariel, salanti amin a mamakal ed sikato tan ed salimbeng to, tan say mamairap ed sikato, sikara naani singa kogip, sakey a pasingawey ed labi.

Et sikato naani singa say pankogip na sakey a too a narasan, et nia, sikato so mangan; balet sikato so naliing, et say kamarerwa to paoypaoy: odino singa say pankogip na sakey a too no napgaan, et, nia, sikato so oninum, balet naliing, et, nia, sikato so makapuy, et say kamarerwa to walay pakapangan to: ontan da naani so karaklan na saray amin a nacion a mamakal sumpa ed palandey Sion.
Manabala kayo tan mankelaw kayo; alaen yo so kaliktan yo, et nabulag kayo: abuek ira, balet andi ed alak; mantogingging ira, balet andi ed mabayani ya inomen.
Ta si Katawan inibong to ed sikayo so espiritu na maitlek ya ugip, tan pinalikdem to so saray profeta; et saray olo yo, saray managnengneng, sinakbongan to.

Et amin a pasingawey nagmaliw ed sikayo a singa saray salita na sakey a libro ya atatakan, ya inyawat na saray totoo ed sakey ya abangatan, a kuan da, Kerewen ko ed sika, basam pa so saya; et sikato kuan to, Agko nayarian, ta atatakan:
Et samay libro niyawat ed saman so ag-abangatan a kuan da, Kerewen ko ed sika, basam pa so saya; et sikato kuan to, Agac abangatan.

Et say Katawan inkuan to, Lapu ed saya a baley onasinger ed siak, tan dia ed sangi ra tan dia ed saray bibii da igalang da ak, ingen saray puso ra inyarawi ra ed siak, tan say takot da ed siak sikato so sakey a bilin na saray totoo a nibangat ed sikara;

Kanian, nia, omanen ko naani a gawaen so sakey a makapakelaw a gawa ed pegley na saya a baley, salanti makapakelaw a gawa tan pankelawan; et say kakabatan na saray totoo ra a makabat nabalang, tan say pakatalos na saray totoo ra a mabinta niyamot.
Abagey la so saray mangyamot na simbawa ra a manlapu ed Katawan, tan saray gawa ra wala ra ed bilunget, et kuan da, Siopa so makanengneng ed sikami? tan siopa so mikabat ed sikami?

Sikayo pigaren yo so saray bengatla! Pablien ta so domadamili a singa say pitek; a say bengatla a ginawa to kuan to ed saman so nangawa ed sikato, Sikato ag toak ginawa: odino say bengatla a tinibokel kuanto ed anibokel ed sikato, Sikato angapo so pakatalos to?
Aliwa ta ni a magangano la, et say Libano magmaliw a sakey a mabunga ya uma, tan say mabunga ya uma pablien a singa takel?
Et dia ed saman ya agew say telek narengel to so saray salita na libro, tan saray mata na bulag makanengneng ira naani ed paway na inkakilot tan kabilungetan.
Saray maoyamo met ombaleg so liket da ed Katawan, tan saray duka ed nanleleetan na totoo manliket ira naani ed Santo na Israel.
Ta say makapakebiew a top sikato so napaandi, tan say mabalaw ontonda, tan amin iray mabanday a nipaakar ed inkauges nalenes ira;
Saray mamakasalanan ed sakey a too ed kanonotan to, tan mangyan na kalot nipaakar ed saman ed wangalan, tan pikeweten to so maptek ed sakey a bengatla a maapa.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan, ya anondon ed Abraham, a nipaakar ed abung nen Jacob: Si Jacob ag la nibabaing natan, say lupa to ag met omposisaw la natan.

Balet sano nanengneng to so saray anak to, a gawa na saray limak, ed pegley to, pasantosen da naani so ngaran ko; on, pasantosen da naani so Santo nen Jacob, tan mansiansia ra naani ed takot ed Dios na Israel.
Saray nalingo met ed espiritu onsabi ra ed pakatalos, tan saray matalabotob awaten da naani so panangibangat.

Abagey la so saray matunganga ya anak, kuan nen Katawan, a mangawat na simbawa, ya ag manlapu ed siak; tan saman so mangawa na sakey a siglaot, ya ag manlapu ed Espirituk, pian niyarum da so kasalanan ed kasalanan.
A manpikal ira ya onlasor ed Egipto, et ag ira tinmepet ed sangik; pian manpabiskeg ira lanlamang ed biskeg nen Faraon, tan onapireng ira ed sirum na Egipto!
Kanian say biskeg nen Faraon sikato naani so kabaingan yo, tan say yapireng ed sirum na Egipto sikato naani kagotgotan yo.
Ta saray principe ra wala ra ed Zoan, tan saray embajador da sinmabi ra ed Hanes.
Nababaingan ira naani ya amin nisengeg ed sakey a baley ya agto nayarian a tumangan ira, ya aliwa ed sikara a sakey a tulong tan ag met nabang, no ag ingen sakey a baing, tan sakey a balaw.

Say awit na saray ayayep ed Abalaten. Diad dalin na gotgot tan ermen, a panlapuan na leon a kabatyan tan leon a kalakian, say tadioko tan masebeg ya uleg ya ontekyap, yakar da so saray kayarian da ed abala na saray kilaw ya asno, tan saray kayamanan da ed beneg na saray kamello, ed sakey a baley ya agda, ra tumangan.
Ta say Egipto ontulong ya andi kakanaan, tan maapa: kanian sikato so inngaran ko a Rahab so onyorong a maligeligen.
Natan onla ka, sikato so isulat mo ed arapan da ed sakey a tabla, tan ikurit mo ed sakey a libro, pian sikato komon so nipaakar ed panaon ya arapen, ed ando lan ando.
Ta sikato so matunganga a baley, anak a matila, anak ira ya agda labay a denglen so tunong nen Katawan.

Sikara a mankuan ed saray makanengneng ed arapen, Agkayo onnengneng; tan ed saray pomaparles, Ag kayo manparies ed sikami ed saray maptek a bengabengatla, mansalita kayo ed sikami ed saray makaanlay a bengabengatla, mangiparles kayo na saray lingo.
Ontainan kayo ed dalan, sianan yo so basbas, patondaen yo so kiwawala na Santo na Israel ed arapan tayo.
Kanian onia so kuan na Santo na Israel, Lapu ed balawen yo so saya a salita, tan manmatalek kayo ed panamairap, tan sikara so sinaralan yo;
Kanian saya ya inkauges sikato naani ed sikayo so sakey a ungib a maparaan a nageba, akadungaw ed atagey a bakor, a say kageba to onsabi a bigla ed kasanlilikna.

Et sikato naani nabuyak a singa nabuyak a sakey a kagawaan na domadamili, a sikato so buyaken to ya angapo so nilikod; dia ed ontan ya angapo naani naromog ed saray taping to a sakey a taping a sikato so pangala na apuy ed dalikan, odino pangaor na danum ed samang.
Ta onia so kuan na Katawan a Dios, say Santo na Israel, Nilaban kayo naani ed pampataoli tan pampainawa; dia ed kareenan tan panmatalek so kawalaan naani na biskeg yo. Et agyo nilabay:
No ag ingen inkuan yo, Andi, ta ontainan kami naani ya akakabayo; kanian ontainan kayo naani: tan, Onkabayo kami naani ed masiglat; kanian saray onosil ed sikayo masiglat ira naani.

Sanlibo so ontainan naani ed pangayag na sakey: ed pangayag na lima ontainan kayo naani: anga ed natila 'kayo a singa sakey a farola ed toktok na palandey, tan singa sakey a laylay ed tapew na sakey a pokdol.

Et sikato so makasengeg a manalagar si Katawan, pian kasian to kayo; pian diad ontan sikato so nitandoro; et sikato so maparaan ed panangasi ed sikayo: ta si Katawan sikato so Dios na inkatunong; mapalar so saray amin a manalagar ed sikato.
Ta saray ombaley manayam ira naani ed Sion ed Jerusalem; agka la naani onnangis; ag onlaron naani a mangasi ed sika lapu ed voces na pantawag mo; sano narengel to ka, ebatan to ka naani.

Et angan iter na Katawan ed sikayo so tinapay na panamairap tan say danum na pamasegsegang, angan ontan ag ira niyamot angan kapigan so saray mangibangat ed sika, no ag ingen saray matam nanengneng da naani so saray mangibangat ed sika.
Et saray layag mo makadngel ira naani na sakey a salita ed beneg mo, a kuan to, Saya so dalan, ondalan kayo ed sikato; sano onarap kayo ed nikawanan, tan sano onarap kayo ed nikawigi.
Et dotakan yo naani so okiop a pilak na saray inbolik a talintao, tan say inpanorado ed inbobo a talintao: ibantak mora naani a singa bengatla a marutak; ikuan mo naani ed sikato, ontainan kayo dia.

Et sikato iter to naani uran a nipaakar ed binim ya itanem mo ed dalin; tan say tinapay manlapu ed bunga na dalin, tan sikato naani mataba tan daakan. Dia ed satan ya agew mantagano so saray ayep mo ed saray maawang a pankabkaban;
Ontan met so saray baka a kalakian tan saray kilaw ya asno a manbaka ed dalin, mangan ira naani ed mananam ya ilik, ya integap ya inagamil so sariok tan karalukar.
Et wala naani ed tapew na amin a palandey ya atagey, tan ed tapew na amin a pokdol ya atagey, so saray kolos tan sobosobol na danum, dia ed agew na baleg a panagpatey, sano nigeba so saray ilang.

Sakey ni say liwawa na bulan singa naani liwawa na banwa tan say liwawa na banwa maminpito naani, a singa say liwawa na pitoran agew, dia ed agew a pamedber nen Katawan ed sugat na baley to, tan say panamaabig to ed saray letak na sugat da.

Nia, say ngaran nen Katawan onsabi a manlapu ed arawi, a mandarlang ed sanok to, tan dia ed makapal a mamaatagey ya asewek: saray bibii to napno ra ed sanok, tan say dila to singa say manunaw ya apuy;
Tan say panlinawa to sikato so singa delap, a sabien to so tenger a yakayaken to so saray nacion ed yakayak na kabagbag: et sakey a patili a mamalingo so wala naani ed sangi na saray totoo.

Nawalaan kayo naani na sakey a canta a singa dia ed labi no ngilinen so sakey a liket a masanto; tan gayaga na puso, a singa no say sakey onla ya akatolali ed palandey nen Katawan, ed Batondampay na Israel.

Et si Katawan gawaen to naani a narengel so magloria a voces to, et ipanengneng to naani so inkileksab na taklay to, pati say masubeg a sanok to, tan say dalang na sakey a manunaw ya apuy, dia ed sakey ya alimbosabos tan bagyo, tan cristal ya uran.
Ta dia ed panamegley na voces nen Katawan napunaw naani so Asirio; sikato naani kabilen to ed pekpek to.

Et balang pangabil na pekpek ya atoro, a si Katawan isiplat to naani ed sikato, wala naani anyeweng na saray pandereta, tan saray arpa; et dia ed saray bakal na pangyayag na taklay to mibakal naani ed sikara.

Ta sakey a Tofet so nitadia la nen saman; on, tan say ari nitadia la; sikato so ginawa to ya aralem tan baleg; say losbo to sikato so apuy tan dakel a kiew; say panlinawa nen Katawan, singa sakey ya agus ya azufre, sikato so selselan to.

Abagey la so saray onlasor ed Egipto nipaakar ed tulong, tan manmatalek ed saray kabayo, tan manmatalek ed saray luganan lapu ed dakel ira, tan ed saray too to ya akakabayo lapu ed sankabiskegan ira, balet ag ira onnengneng ed Santo na Israel, tan ag da met anapen si Katawan!

Angan ontan sikato so makabat met, et yakar to naani mauges, tan agto naani babawiyen so saray salita to, no ag ingen onalagey ya onsumpa ed abung na saray managgawa na mauges, tan onsumpa ed saray ontutulong ed saray managgawa na inkarelmeng.

Et saray Egipcio totoo ra, tan aliwa ra a Dios; et saray kabayo ra laman ira, tan aliwa ra ya espiritu: et sano unaten nen Katawan so lima to, nanpadpara a samay ontulong nikaronias tan say natulongan nipasag, et sikara ya amin naopot ira a mantitipon.

Ta ontan so kuan nen Katawan ed siak, Singa say leon tan say kilaw na leon manngayemngem ira ed tapew na naerel da, no say sakey a karakel na saray pastol natawag ira a sumpa ed sikato, ag naani natakot ed voces da, tan ag naani ontalaw ed dalagorog da: ontan naani yaakseb nen Katawan na saray ejercito a mamakal ed palandey Sion, tan ed pokdol to.
Singa saray manok a mantekyab ya ondepa ra, ontan naani so pangyagel nen Katawan na saray ejercito ed Jerusalem: sikato naani yagel to tan ilaban to, onlabas naani ed tagey to tan yagel to.
Onlingaw kayo ed saman so tinungangaan yo a mapalalo a toloy, O anak ira na Israel.

Ta dia ed satan ya agew say balang sakey ed saray totoo ibantak to naani so saray talintao to a pilak, tan saray talintao to a balitok a saray lima yo lanlamang ginawara a nipaakar ed sikayo a sakey a kasalanan.

Et say Asirio nipasag naani nisengeg ed kampilan, aliwan lapu ed laki; et sikato naani opoten na kampilan, aliwan lapu ed lalaki, et sikato naani tainan to so kampilan, tan saray tobonbalo to a lalaki mangawara naani na ambelat a kimey.
Et say bato to nabalang naani a nisengeg ed takot, tan saray principe natalagnaw ira naani ed laylay, kuan nen Katawan, a say apuy to wala ed Sion, tan say palbaan to dia ed Jerusalem.
Nia sakey ya ari so man-ari naani ed kaptekan, tan saray principe manuley ira naani ed inkatunong.

Et sakey a too so magmaliw naani a singa sakey ya amotan na dagem, tan sakey a siroman ed bagyo, singa saray agus na saray danum ed pasen ya amaga, singa anino na sakey a baleg a batondampay ed sakey a dalin ya apagaan.
Et saray mata na saray makanengneng ag ira naani onkuyep, tan saray layag na saray makadngel ondengel ira naani.
Et say puso na agmalikas natalosan to naani pikakabat, et say dila na saray amil masiglat naani a manbalikas a maliwawa.
Say makulangkulang angan kapigan ag la natawag a mabli, ag met la naani ikuan a mapalabo so too a madaakan.

Ta say makulangkulang mansalita a makulangkulang, tan say puso to mangawa naani na inkauges, a mangawa na agpanangigalang ed masagrado, tan mangibitla na lingo a sumpa ed Katawan, gawaen to ya angapo so manayam ed kamarerwa na narasan, tan paandien to so inumen ed napgaan.
Ta saray kagawaan na maagum sikara so mauges, sikato mannonot ed saray silib a mauges a maneral ed mabinta ed saray matila a salsalita, angan say naokolan mansalita na maptek.
Balet say mabli mannonot ed saray mabli a bengatla; et sikato magnayon naani ed saray mabli a bengatla.
Onalagey kay, sikayo a bibii ya wala ed painawaan, et denglen yo so voces ko; sikayo ya andi likasan ya anak ira a bibii, denglen yo so salitak.
Ta dia ed saray agew ed labas na sakey a taon nagonigon kayo, sikayo bibii ya andi likasan; ta say panborbor na uvas, onandi, say panagani ag naani onsabi.
Giwgiw kayo bibii ya wala ed kareenan; nagonigon kayo, sikayo ya andi likasan; manlakseb kayo, tan manlabos kayo, tan manbalkes kayo na abel a magaspang ed saray banel yo.
Sikara dugalen da so saray pagew nipaakar ed makapalikliket ya umuma, nipaakar ed mabunga ya uvas.
Dia ed tapew na dalin na baley ko ompaway naani so saray sabitan tan saray tala; on, dia ed tapew na saray amin ya abung na liket dia ed malikeliket a ciudad.

Ta say palacio napaolian naani, say ciudad a dakel so totoo nikaindan; say pokdol tan say talayapan magmaliw ira naani ya ongib ed ando lan ando, sakey a liket na saray asno ya atap, sakey a panpakabkaban ed saray ay-ayep:
Anga ed naibong ed sikatayo so Espiritu a manlapu ed tagey, et say kalawakan magmaliw a mabunga ya uma tan say mabunga ya uma nigaton a singa takel.
Saman la say inkatunong manayam ed kalawakan; et say inkatunong manayam naani ed mabunga ya uma.
Et say gawa na inkatunong sikato naani so deen; et say kasumpalan na inkatunong inkaulimek tan panmatalek lawas.
Et say baley ko manayam naani ed mareen a panagayaman; tan dia ed maligen a paspasen, tan dia ed saray mareen a panpainawaan.
Balet onoran naani na hielo a mamagbag ed takel; et say ciudad sigpot naani a nigeba a patar.
Mapalar kayo a mantanem ed abay na saray amin a danum, a paakaren yo so saray sali na baka tan asno.

Abagey ka la a mamagbag, et agka abagbag; tan managamil ka a liputan, et agda ka nanagamilan ed liputan! Sano manganga ka a mamagbag, nabagbag ka naani, tan sano ontonda ka a managamil ed liputan, panagamilan da ka naani ed liputan.
O Katawan, kasian mo kami komon; inalagar mika: sika komon so panagkataklay mi ed kinabuasan, kilalaban mi met ed panaon na kairapan.
Saray ombaley tinmainan ira ed tanol na ingal; dia ed inyalagey mo lanlamang abuybuyak so saray nacion.
Et saray samsam yo natipon ira naani a singa say pantitipon na antataro: singa panlokso na saray duron so panlokso na saray totoo ed sikato.
Si Katawan nitandoro: ta manayam ed tagey; sikato pinano to so Sion ed inkaptek tan inkatunong.
Et wala naani inkasekder ed saray panaon mo, inkadaakan na panangilaban, kakabatan tan pikakabat: say takot ed Katawan sikato so kayamanan mo.
Nia, saray mabayani ra manakis ira ed paway; saray embajador na panpapakna mannangis ira na ampaipait.
Saray polong naderal ira, say akar-akar a too ontonda, say kabosol binagbag to so sipanan, binalaw to so saray ciudad, ag to pablien so too.
Say dalin maningel tan ombeleng; say Libano nagotgot tan namagaan; say Saron sikato so singa sakey a kalawakan; et say Basan tan Carmelo yagyagen da so saray bolong da.
Natan onalagey ak, kuan nen Katawan; yatagey ko natan so laman ko lanlamang; nitandoro ak natan la.
Mannginew kayo na taep, yanak yo naani so dayami: say panlinawa yo sikato so sakey ya apuy a mangakmon ed sikayo.
Et saray balbaley singa ra naani ed saray panpalbaan na dena, singa saray sabit a pinalaspas tan pinoolan na apuy.
Denglen yo, sikayo ya wala ed arawi, so ginawak; et sikayo ya wala ed asinger, bidbiren yo so biskeg ko.

Saray makasalanan ed Sion antakot ira; saray andian na dips da inala ra na pangiwgiw: Siopa ed sikatayo so makayari a miayam ed mangakmon ya apuy? siopa ed sikatayo so makayari a miayam ed andi angaan a kapoolan?

Saman so manakar a mapmaptek, tan mansalita a matunotunong; say manigpay a modmoraen to so anap ed saray panangapos, say mangipayag ed saray lima to ta agto labay ya awaten so panoksok, say mamepet ed layag to pian ag makadngel na marala, tan mangilikdem ed saray mata to pian ag makanengneng na mauges:
Sikato so manayam naani ed tagey; saray bakor a binato sikara naani so pansalimbengan to, say tinapay niiter naani ed sikato; saray danum to ag naani onkulang.
Saray matam nanengneng da naani so ari ed kalimgasan to: napatnagan da naani so sakey a dalin ya onsabi ed arawi.

Say pusom pakanonoten to naani so nipaakar ed makapataktakot: Iner so kawalaan na saman so nanbilang, iner so kawalaan na saman so animbang ed buis? iner so kawalaan na saman so nanbilang ed saray ilang?
Agmo naani nanengneng so masebeg a baley, sakey a baley ya aralem so salita to ya agmo natalosan, sakey a salita a sankaili ya agmo natalosan.

Nengnengen mo so Sion, say ciudad na inkagayaga tayo: saray matam nanengneng da naani so Jerusalem a sakey a mareen a panagayaman, sakey a tolda ya ag niyalis, saray palitek to ag ira nabagot angan kapigan, tan ag met napoltot so saray lubir to.

No ag ingen si Katawan miayam ed sikatayod'man ed kaatageyan to, sakey a pasen na saray maawang ya ilog tan agus, ya angapo naani onsabi a balo to ya akabegsay diman, tan angapo met naani marakep a sakayan ya onlabas diman.
Ta si Katawan sikato so okom tayo, si Katawan sikato so mangiiter na tunong ed sikatayo, si Katawan sikato so ari tayo; ilaban to itayo.
Saray lubir mo malukak ira: agda apabiskeg so sali na anlayasan da, agda nibuskag so layag: saman la naapag-apag so betang ed baleg a samsam; say piley angala ed samsam.
Et say manaayam agto naani ikuan, Mabeblay ak: saray ombaley a manayam diman napaandi naani inkauges da.
Asinger kayo, sikayo a nacion, ya ondengel; tan talineng yo, sikayo a balbaley: ondengel komon so dalin, tan say inkapano to, say mundo, tan amin ya ompaway ed sikato.
Ta si Katawan wala so sanok to sumpa ed saray amin a nacion, tan sanok to sumpa ed saray amin ya ejercito ra: sikato dineral to ra a sigpot, inyawat to ra ed pamatey.
Saray pinatey da nibantak ira met ed paway, et say banget na saray bangkay da onsengaw naani; et saray palandey natunaw ira naani ed saray dala ra.

Et amin ya ejercito na tawen nabuybuyak, tan saray tawen nalukot ira naani a singa sakey a libro ya alukot; et amin ya ejercito ra nalenes ira naani, a singa say bulong a nalenes no napelag ed uvas, tan singa sakey a bulong a nalenes a manlapu ed kiew na higos.
Ta say kampilan ko ininom to so kaperaan to ed tawen: nia, onlasor naani ed tapew na Edom, tan tapew na baley so pangayew ko, ed pangokom.

Say kampilan nen Katawan napno na dala, sikato so apataba ed taba, na dala na saray kordero tan kanding, ed taba na saray batok na saray carnero a kalakian; ta si Katawan wala so sakey a bagat to dia ed Bosra, tan sakey a baleg a panagpatey ed dalin na Edom.
Et saray baka ya atap milasor ira naani ed sikara, tan saray baka a kalakian a pati saray bolog: et say dalin da nabuek naani ed dala, tan say dabok da napataba naani ed taba.
Ta si Katawan wala so sakey ya agew to a pamales, sakey a taon na tumang a nipaakar ed sengegan na Sion.
Et saray Ilog na Edom magmaliw ira naani ya alkitran, tan say dabok to azufre, tan say dalin to magmaliw naani a mandarlang ya alkitran.
Sikato naani ag naerep ed labi odino agew; say asewek to manpaatagey ya naynay; manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan sikato naani kibalatar; angapo naani onlabas ed sikato ed ando lan ando.

Balet say pelikano tan say puerko ispin sikato naani kayarianen da; et say kolayot tan say wawak manayam ira naanid'man; et yunat to naani ed tapew to so paltikna kagonigon, tan say bantawin na kapalis.
Tawagen da naani so saray angkabli to ed nanarian, balet angapo so manayam naanid'man; et amin iray principe to sikara naani angapo.
Et saray sabitan ontobora naani ed saray palacio to, saray kamiing tan saray tala tan saray pakdaal to; et sikato naani sakey a panayaman na saray chakal; sakey a saban a nipaakar ed saray avestruz.

Et saray atap ya ay-ayep ed takel miromog ira naani ed saray lobo, tan say atap a kanding tawagan to naani iba to; on, say olimaw ompasen naanid'man tan sikato naani naromog to a sakey a pasen a panayaman.
Diman naani pangawaan na uleg a masiglat na obong to, tan paniknolan to, tan panposnakan to, pantiponan to ed lepsag na sirom to, on, diman natipon ira naani baga balang sakey a pati iba to.
Anapen yo ed libro nen Katawan, tan basaen yo: angapo ed saraya so onkulang naani, angapo naani mananap na iba to; ta say sangik sikato so inbilin to, tan say Espiritu to sikara so tinipon to.
Et inpanpapalaran to ra, tan diad lima to sikato so inapag to ed sikara ed panamegley na gulis: sikato naani kayarianen da lawas; manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan manayam ira naanid'man.
Say kalawakan tan say amagan dalin magayaga ra naani; et say kabueran a lawak manliket naani, tan manbolaklak a singa bolaklak.

Sikato manbolaklak naani na daakan, tan manliket a tekep na gayaga tan kancanta; say gayaga na Libano niiter naani ed sikato, say kaatageyan na Carmelo tan Saron: nanengneng da naani so gayaga nen Katawan, say kaatageyan na Dios tayo.
Pabiskegen yo so saray makapuy a lima, tan paksilen yo so saray makapuy a pueg.
Kuanyo ed saray matakot a puso, Manpabiskeg kayo, agkayo antakot: nia, say Dios yo onsabi naani a pati pangibales, pati pananumang na Dios; sikato so onsabi tan ilaban to kayo.
Satan la nilukas so saray mata na bulag, tan say layag na saray telek nibuang naani.
Satan la manlokso so piley a singa sakey ya ulsa, tan say dila na umel mancanta naani; ta dia ed kalawakan ompositsit naani so saray danum, tan saray sobol ed kabueran a lawak.

Et say mansinag a buer magmaliw naani a libsong, tan say napgaan a dalin magmaliw naani a sobol na danum: dia ed panayaman na saray chakal, a sikato so dokolan da, wala naani dika a pati kawayan tan babuyan.

Et wala naanid'man so sakey a polong, tan sakey a dalan, et sikato naani ningaran a, Say dalan na inkasanto; say agmalinis ag naani ondalan ed sikato; no ag ingen sikato so nipaakar ed arondon; saray nanakarakar a totoo, on, totoo a makulangkulang, ag ira naani nabalang diman.
Angapo so leon a manayam naanid'man, tan angapo met so mangasebeg ya ayep ya ontatdang diman; ag ira naani naromog diman; no ag ingen say arondon so manakar naanid'man:

Et saray dinondon nen Katawan ompawil ira naani, tan onla ra dia ed Sion a tekep na pankancanta; tan naynay a liket so wala naani ed tapew na kaoloan da: narapat da naani inkagayaga tan liket, tan say ermen tan paney-ey onandi ra.
Et agawa a sanen mikalabinapat a taon nen ari Ezekias, a si Senakerib ya ari na Asiria tinmatdang a sumpa ed saray amin a kinutaan a ciudad na Juda, tan inalato ra.

Et say ari na Asiria inbaki to si Rabsaces ya nanlapu ed Lakis anga ed Jerusalem ed ari Ezekias ya iba to so sakey a dakel ya ejercito. Et sikato so nanalagey ed abay na salolog na atagtagey a samang ed polong na uma na manpapakapal na abel.
Saman la linma ed sikato si Eliacim ya anak a laki nen Helcias, a sikato so mayordomo nen saman, tan si Sebna ya eskriba; tan si Joa ya anak a laki nen Asaf a managawaran.
Et si Rabsaces inkuan to ed sikara, Kuan yo natan ed Ezekias, Onia so kuan na baleg ya ari, say ari na Asiria Anto ya a panmatalkan a sikato so panmatalkan yo?
Kuan ko, say simbawam tan say biskeg mo a nipaakar ed bakal polos ira ya amin a maapa a salsalita: natan siopa ta so panmatalkan mo, a sika inmalagey ka a sumpa ed siak?

Nia, sika manmatalek ka ed kiew na saya ya abalbal a kawayan, salanti say Egipto lanlamang, sikato a no say sakey a too onsaral, sikato so onloob ed lima, to tan sikato so talosen to: ontan si Faraon ya ari na Egipto ed saray amin a manmatalek ed sikato.

Balet no kuan mo ed siak, Manmatalek kami ed Katawan a Dios mi: aliwa ta a sikato so saman, a saray pasen to ya atagey tan saray altar to inekal nen Ezekias, tan inkuan to ed Juda tan ed Jerusalem, Manpikasi kayo ta éd arap na saya ya altar?

Natan sirin, pikasik ed sika, ya itdan mo komon so katawan ko ya ari na Asiria ed saray sanla, et itdan ta ka naani na duanlibo a kabayo, no nayarian mo ed inkasika so mangipasen na saray onkabayo ed tapew da.

Panon sirin so pakayarim a mamabeneg na lupa na sakey a kapitan na saray kamelagan ed saray ariripen nen katawan ko, tan ipasen mo so panmatalek mo ed Egipto a nisengeg ed saray luganan tan totoo a mankabayo?

Tan tinmatdang ak ta natan ya agko kaolop si Katawan ya onsumpa ed saya a dalin pian sikato so deralen ko? Si Katawan inkuan to ed siak, Ontatdang ka a sumpa ed saya a dalin, tan sikato so deralen mo.

Saman la inkuan di Eliacim tan Sebna tan Joa ed Rabsaces, Mansalita ka, kerewen ko ed sika, ed saray ariripen mo ed salita na Siria; ta sikato so natalosan mi; et agka komon misalita ed sikami ed salita na saray Judio, ed layag na saray totoo ya wala ed tapew na bakor.

Balet si Rabsaces inkuan to, Ingangan ak ta na katawan ko ed katawan mo tan ed sika, a mansalita na saraya a salita? Agto ak ta inbaki ed saray totoo a manyorong ed tapew na bakor, a mikan ed sikara ed dutac da, tan miinom ed sikayo ed sirit da lanlamang?
Saman la si Rabsaces inmalagey, tan inmakis ed maksil a voces ed salita na saray Judio, tan inkuan to, Denglen yo so saray salita na baleg ya ari, say ari na Asiria.
Onia so kuan na ari, Si Ezekias agto kayo komon palingoen; ta agto kayo nayarian ya ilaban:
Tan si Ezekias agto kayo met komon panmataleken ed kinen Katawan, a kuanto, Si Katawan ilaban to itayo ya andi saew; saya a ciudad ag naani niiter ed lima na ari ed Asiria.

Agyo pakadenglen si Ezekias: ta onia so kuan na ari na Asiria, Mipakna kayo ed siak, tan ompaway kayo ya ondago ed siak; et mangan so balang sakey ed sikayo ed uvas to, tan balang sakey ed higos to, tan oninum so balang sakey ed sikayo ed saray danum na samang to lanlamang;
Anga ed onsabiak tan yakar takayo ed sakey a dalin a singa say dalin yo, sakey a dalin na bukel tan balo ya alak, sakey a dalin na tinapay tan kauvasan.

Manlikas kayo ompan lamang nasagyat to kayo nen Ezekias, á kuan to, Si Katawan ilaban to itayo. Wala ta so angan siopa ed saray dirios na saray nacion ya angilaban na dalinto ed lima na ari ed Asiria?
Iner ta so kawalaan na saray dirios na Emat tan Arfad? Iner ta so kawalaan na saray dirios na Sefarvaim? et inlaban da ta so Samaria ed limak?
Siopa ta ra ed saray amin a dirios na saraya a dalin, so angilaban nen saman na dalin da ed limak, pian si Katawan ilaban to komon so Jerusalem ed limak?
Balet ag ira inmesel, tan agda inebatan na sakey a salita; ta sikato so inbilin na ari nen saman, ya inkuan to, Agkayo oneebat ed sikato.

Saman la linma ed Ezekias di Eliacim ya anak a laki nen Helcias, a sikato so mayordomo nen saman, tan si Sebna ya escriba, tan si Joa ya anak a laki nen Asaf, a managawaran, ya apilatpilat so saray kawes da, tan inbaga ra ed sikato so saray salita nen Rabsaces.
Et agawa, sanen sikato so nadngel nen ari Ezekias, a pinilat to so saray kawes to, tan nansakbong na magaspang ya abel, tan linmoob ed abung nen Katawan.
Et inbaki to ed Isaias ya anak a laki nen Amoz, di Eliacim a sikato so mayordomo nen saman, tan Sebna ya escriba, tan saray mamasiken na saray sacerdote; ya akasakbong ira na magaspang ya abel.
Et inkuan da ed sikato, Onia so kuan nen Ezekias, Saya ya agew sikato so agew na gonigon, tan say pananumpa, tan say kibabaing; ta saray anak onsabi lara ed kianak, et angapo so kasil a pangianak.

Lagi ta si Katawan a Dios mo denglen to naani so saray salita nen Rabsaces, ya ingangan na ari na Asiria a katawan to a mangayat ed Dios a mabilay, et sumpaen to naani so saray salita a nadngel nen Katawan a Dios mo: kanian itagey mo so pikakasim a nipaakar ed kera ya atilak.
Dia ed ontan linma so saray ariripen nen ari Ezekias ed kinen Isaias.

Et si Isaias inkuan to ed sikara, Onia, so kuan yo naani ed katawan yo; Onia so kuan nen Katawan, Agka antakot ed saray salita a nadngel mo, a sikara so inpangayew na saray ariripen na ari ed Asiria ed siak.
Nia, ya ko naani ed sikato so sakey ya espiritu, et makadngel naani na saray balita, et ompawil naani ed dalin to lanlamang: et gawaen ko a nipasag ed kampilan ed dili a dalin to.
Dia ed ontan si Rabsaces pinmawil, tan aromog to so ari na Asiria a babakalen to so Lebna; ta nadngel to la nen saman a sikato so pinmikal a nanlapu ed Lakis.
Tan nadngel to a nasasalita so nipaakar ed Taraca ya ari na Etiopia, Sikato pinmaway a mibakal sumpa ed sika. Et sanen nadngel to, angibaki na saray igagangan ed kinen Ezekias, ya-inkuan to,
Onia so salitaen yo naani ed Ezekias ya ari na Juda, a kuan yo, Agto ka komon palingoen na Dios mo a sikato so panmatalkan mo, a mankuan, Say Jerusalem ag naani niiter ed lima na ari ed Asiria.
Nia, nadngel mo no anto so ginawa na saray ar-ari na Asiria ed saray amin a dalin, ed inpaneral ed sikara a sigpot: et sika nilaban ka ta naani?

Saray dirios na saray nacion inlaban da ta ra, a sikara so dineral nen saman na saray atateng ko, say Gozan, tan say Haran, tan say Rezef tan saray anak na Eden a manaayam ira nen saman dia ed Talasar?
Iner so kawalaan na ari na Emat tan say ari na Arfad, tan say ari na ciudad na Sefarvaim, say Ana tan say Ava?
Et si Ezekias inawat to so sulat ed lima na igagangan, et sikato so binasa to; et si Ezekias sinmegep ed abung nen Katawan, tan sikato so binuskag to ed arap nen Katawan.
Et si Ezekias nanpikasi ed Katawan, ya inkuan to,
O Katawan na saray ejercito, Dios na Israel, ya akayurong ed tagey na saray kerubin, sika so Dios, sika lambengat a bokor, ed saray amin a nanarian ed mundo; sika ginawam so tawen tan dalin.

Ikiling mo sa layag mo, O Katawan, tan dengel ka; lukasan mo so saray matam, O Katawan, tan nengnengen mo; tan denglen mo so saray amin a salita nen Senakerib, sikato a nanbaki a managyat ed Dios a mabilay.
Dia ed katuaan, Katawan, a saray ar-ari na Asiria binagbag da so saray amin a nacion tan say dalin da,
Tan inbantak da so saray dirios da ed apuy; ta sikara aliwa ra a dirios, no ag ingen gawa na saray lima na saray totoo, a kiew tan bato; kanian dineral da ra.
Natan sirin, O Katawan a Dios mi, ilaban mo kami ed lima to, pian amin so saray nanarian ed mundo amtaen da komon a sika si Katawan, sika lambengat.
Diad saman si Isaias ya anak a laki nen Amoz nanbaki ed Ezekias, ya inkuan to, Onia so kuan nen Katawan, a Dios na Israel, Nipaakar ed akikasi ka ed siak, sumpa ed Senakerib ya ari ed Asiria,

Saya sikato so salita a si Katawan sinalita to nipaakar ed sikato: Say virgen ya anak a bii na Sion minodmora to ka tan inelekan to ka a binalaw; say anak a bii na Jerusalem inpeyeng to so olo to ed sika.
Siopa so inayat mo tan inayew mo? tan sumpa ed siopa so angitageyan mo na voces mo tan angitageyan mo ed saray matam ed tagey? sumpa lanti ed Santo a Sakey na Israel.

Dia ed panamegley na saray aripen mo inayat mo so Katawan, tan inkuan mo, Ed kinarakel na saray luganan ko ontatdang ak ed tagey na saray palandey ed kaaraldalman a kabiangan na Libano; et batangen ko so saray atagey a cedro to, tan saray kaabigan a saleng to; et onloobak ed kaarawiyan a toktok to, say takel na mabunga a dalin to;
Nankotkot ak tan inminom ak na danum, tan ed dapan na saray salik pamagaen ko so saray amin ya ilog na Egipto.

Agmo ta nadngelan no panon so ginawak nen abayag la, tan inisip ko ed saray daan a panaon? sikato ta so sinumpal ko, pian sikato so kien mo komon a mangigaton a patar ed saray kinutaan a ciudad ed saray losbo na bagbag.

Kanian saray manaayam da melag so pakayari ra, apunaw tan agolo ra, sikara so singa say dika ed uma, tan singa say malambot ya agayep, singa say dika ed saray toktok na abung, tan singa uma na bukel ed arapen to ya ontobo.
Balet amtak so kayoyorong mo, tan kapapaway mo, tan kaloloob mo, tan kapapasnok mo sumpa ed siak.

Nisengeg ed kapapasnok mo a sumpa ed siak, tan nisengeg ed say karangalan mo sinmegep ed saray layag ko, kanian yan ko so tagak ed eleng mo, tan say patilik dia ed saray bibii mo, tan papawilen taka ed dalan ya dinalan mo dia.

Et saya sikato so tanda ed sika: mangan kayo ed saya a taon na ontobo ed inka sikaton dili, tan dia ed komadua a taon say ontobo ed sikato lanlamang; et dia ed komatlo a taon mantanem kayo, tan manani kayo, tan mantanem kayo na uvas, tan mangan kayo ed bunga to.
Et say kera ya nipaliis ed abung nen Juda manlamut a mamalepsag, tan manbunga a mamatagey.
Ta manlapu ed Jerusalem ompaway so kera, tan manlapu ed palandey Sion so ombatik. Say seseg nen Katawan na saray ejercito gawaen to so saya.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan nipaakar ed ari ed Asiria, Ag onla dia ed saya a ciudad, odino mangibekas na panad' man, ag met onla ed arap to ya akakinlong, odino mangipaalagey na pilapil sumpa ed sikato.
Dia ed dalan ya dinalan to dia, ed sikato lanlamang so pawilan to, tan ag onla dia ed saya a ciudad, kuan nen Katawan.
Ta yagel ko so saya a ciudad pian sikato so ilaban ko, nipaakar ed dili a kakanaan ko, tan nipaakar ed kakanaan nen aripen ko a David.

Et say angel nen Katawan pinmaway, tan kinabil to ed pakalso na Asiria so sanlasus tan walomplo tan lima a libo; et sanen saray lalaki binmangon ira ya asaksakbay dia ed kabuasan, nia saraya sikara so inatey ya amin a bangkay.
Dia ed ontan si Senakerib ya ari na Asiria tinmainan tan linma tan pinmawil, tan nanayam ed Ninive.

Et agawa, sanen sikato so manpipikasi ed abung nen Nisroc a dios to, a di Adramelec tan Sarezer ya anak to ra a lalaki sikato so kinabil da ed kampilan; et tinmainan ira anga ed dalin na Ararat. Et nanari a sinmalat ed sikato si Asaradon ya anak to a laki.

Dia ed saraman ya agew si Ezekias asakitan na makapatey. Et si Isaias a profeta ya anak a laki nen Amoz linma ed sikato, tan inkuan to ed sikato, Onia so kuan nen Katawan, Oksoyen mo so abung mo; ta ompatey ka naani, tan agka manbilay.
Saman la si Ezekias inlingaw to so lupa to ed dingding, tan akikasi ed Katawan,

Et inkuan to, Nonot mo natan, O Katawan, kerewen ko ed sika, no panon so inpanakar ko nen saman dia ed arapan mo ed katuaan tan dia ed sakey a naskey a puso, tan ginawak so maabig dia ed pakanengneng mo. Et si Ezekias nannangis na makapasinagem.
Saman la sinmabi so salita nen Katawan ed Isaias ya inkuan to,
Onla ka, tan kuan mo ed Ezekias, Onia so kuan nen Katawan, say Dios nen David, ya ateng mo, Nadngel ko so pikakasim, anengneng ko so saray luam: nia, yarum ko ed saray agew mo so labinlima a taon.
Et ilaban taka naani tan saya a ciudad ed lima na ari ed Asiria, tan yagel ko naani so saya a ciudad.
Et saya naani panandaan ed sika a manlapu ed Katawan, a si Katawan gawaen to naani so saya a bengatla a sinalita to:

Nia, gawaen ko naani so anino ya onsoner na samplo a katonda, ed saray katonda a linmepsag ed panamegley na banwa ed reloj na banwa nen Acaz. Dia ed ontan say banwa sinmoner na samplo a katonda ed saray katonda a nilepsagan to.
Say sulat nen Ezekias ya ari na Juda, sanen asakitan, tan inmabig ed sakit to.
Inkuan ko, Dia ed pegley agew na saray agew ko onlaak naani ed saray pinto na Sheol; Nakal ed siak so saray kera na saray taon ko.
Inkuan ko, Agko nanengneng naani si Katawan, si Katawan lanlamang ed dalin na saray mabilay: Agak la makanengneng na saray totoo pati saray manaayam ed mundo.

Say panayaman ko niyalis, tan niyarawi ed siak a singa sakey a tolda na pastol: Nilukot ko so bilay ko a singa sakey a manabel; okposen toak naani ed abelan: Manlapu ed agew ya anga ed labi mangawa ka naani na sakey a pangangaan ko.
Dinmeen ak ya anga ed kabuasan; singa sakey a leon, ontan so inpamoterpoter to ed saray amin a pukel ko: Manlapu ed kabuasan anga ed labi lanlamang mangawa ka naani na sakey a pangangaan ko.
Singa sakey a mangalimpana, odino sipo, ontan so pantitit ko: Naney-ey ak a singa palekpek; saray matak onkapuy ira ed pangitangay; O Katawan, napairap ak, sika so panmatalkan ko.
Anto naani salitaen ko? sikato so nansalita ed siak, tan sikato lanlamang ginawa to: Manakar ak naani a maoyamo nisengeg ed kapaitan na kamarerwak ed saray amin a taon ko.
O Katawan, lapu ed saraya a bengatla manbilay so saray totoo; Et diman ya sigpot so kawalaan na bilay na espirituk: Kanian paabigen moak, tan panbilayeh moak.
Nia, walaanak nen saman na baleg a kapaitan nipaakar ed deen ko: Balet inarom so kamarerwak ya inlaban mo ed kalinsorong na kabulok; Ta inbantak mo so saray amin a kasalanan ko ed beneg mo.
Ta say Sheol agto ka nayari ya igalang, say patey agto ka naambegya: Saray onlasor ed kalinsorong agda nayarian ya ilaloan so katuaan mo.
Say mabilay, say mabilay, igalang to ka naani, singa gawaen ko ed sayan agew: Say ama ipakabat to naani so katuaan ed saray anak.
Si Katawan maparaan a mangilaban ed siak: Kanian cantaen tayo naani so saray cantak ed saray kagawaan a dinelesan. Ed saray amin ya agew na saray bilay tayo ed abung nen Katawan.
Et si Isaias inkuan to nen saman, Mangala ra komon na sankatipay ya higos, tan yan a singa sakey a pakep ed babag to, et onabig naani.
Et si Ezekias inkuan to met nen saman, Anto so tanda a siak onsegep ak naani ed abung nen Katawan?
Sanen saman a panaon si Merodacbaladan, ya anak a laki nen Baladan, ya ari na Babilonia, angibaki na saray sulat tan sakey a tokdol ed Ezekias: ta nadngelan to a sikato asakitan, tan inmabig.

Et si Ezekias nanliket ed sikara, tan inpanengneng to ed sikara so abung na saray kayamanan a mabli, pilak, tan balitok, saray balingit, tan say mabli a larak, tan say amin ya abung na saray kagawaan, tan saray amin a naromog ed saray panangisempenan na kayamanan; angapo nen saman ed abung to, angapo met ed amin a panoleyan to, a si Ezekias agto inpanengneng ed sikara.

Saman la linma si Isaias a profeta ed ari Ezekias, tan inkuan to ed sikato, Anto so inkuan na saraya a lalaki? tan iner so nanlapoan da anga ed sika. Et si Ezekias inkuan to, Nanlapu ra ed sakey ya arawi a dalin anga ed siak, nanlapu ra lanlamang ed Babilonia.
Saman la inkuan to ed sikato, Anto so anengneng da ed abung mo? Et si Ezekias inmebat, Amin ya wala ed abung ko anengneng da: angapo so bengatla ed saray kayamanan ko so agko inpanengneng ed sikara.
Saman la inkuan nen Isaias ed Ezekias, Denglen mo so salita nen Katawan na saray ejercito:

Nia, onsabi so agew, sano amin ya wala ed abung mo, tan saray tinipon na saray atateng mo ed panangisempenan anga ed saya ya agew, niyakar ira naani ed Babilonia: angapo naani natilak, kuan nen Katawan.
Et saray anak mo a lalaki a manlapu ed sika, a sikara so yanak mo alaenda ra: et sikara naani eunuko ed palacio na ari ed Babilonia.
Saman la si Ezekias inkuan to ed Isaias, Maong so salita nen Katawan a sinalitam. Inkuan to ni, Ta wala naani deen tan katuaan ed saray agew ko.
Ligliwaen yo, ligliwaen yo so totook, kuan na Dios yo.

Mansalita kayo na makaligliwa ed Jerusalem; et yakis yo ed sikato a say pibabakal to manganga la, ta say inkauges to aperdona la, a sikato so inawat to ed lima nen Katawan ed mamidua a nipaakar ed amin a kasalanan to.
Say voces na sakey a mantawag, Itadia yo ed kalawakan so dalan nen Katawan, pataren yo so sakey a dalan ed takel a nipaakar ed Dios tayo.
Balang lawak nitandoro, tan amin a palandey tan pokdol napaabeba ra naani; tan say tibatibagkol napalanas naani, tan saray lasonglasong a pasen magmaliw a sakey a mapatar:
Tan say gloria nen Katawan nipatnag naani, tan amin a laman sikato so nanengneng da a sankatipon; ta say sangi nen Katawan sinalita to.
Say voces na sakey a kuan to, Yakis mo. Et say sakey inkuan to, Anto so yakis ko? Amin a laman sikato so dika, tan amin a kalimgasan sikato so singa bolaklak ed uma.
Say dika namagaan, say bolaklak nalenes, lapu ed say panlinawa nen Katawan onsibok ed sikato; tua a saray totoo sikara so dika.
Say dika namagaan, say bolaklak nalenes; balet say salita na Dios tayo mansiansia ed ando lan ando.

O sika a mangibaga na saray maong a balita ed Sion, ontatdang ka ed toktok na atagey a palandey: O sika a mangibaga na saray maong a balita ed Jerusalem, itagey mo so voces mo a tekep na biskeg: itagey mo, agka antakot; ibagam ed saray ciudad na Juda, Nia, so Dios yo!
Nia, say Katawan a Dios onsabi a singa sakey a makapanyari, tan manuley naani taklay to nipaakar ed sikato: Nia, say panumang to kaolop to, tan say panumang to wala ed arap to.
Pankabkaben to naani so ayep to a singa sakey a pastol, tiponen to naani so saray cordero ed taklay to, tan awiten to ra ed pagew to, tan guyoren to a makalna naani so saray walaan na kilaw.

Siopa ta so anukat na danum ed kotlaong na lima to, tan anukat na tawen ed dangan, tan say angilugan na dabok na dalin ed sakey a sukatan, tan animbang na saray palandey ed saray katiyan, tan saray pokdol ed sakey a simbangan?
Siopa ta so angipanengneng na Espiritu nen Katawan, odino anta sikato so manimbawa ed sikato, sikato so ibangat to?

Siopa so angala na simbawa, tan siopa so angibangat ed sikato, tan angipaliwawa ed sikato na dalan na inkatunong, tan say angibangat ed sikato na pikakabat, tan angipatnag ed sikato na dalan na pakatalos?
Nia, saray nacion singa ra sangkatedter na sakey a timba, tan nibilang ira a singa melanting a dabok na simbangan: nia, sikato ekalen to so saray polo a singa sakey a melag a bengatla.
Et say Libano ag onsarag a poolan, tan ag met masarag so saray ayep to a napoolan a bagat.
Amin iray nacion singa angapo so kakanaan da ed arapan to; ¡bilang to ra a melmelag nen say angapo, tan kaapaan.
Siopa sirin so pangiparaan yo ed Dios? odino anto a kapadpara so ipadpara yo ed sikato?
Say talintao, sikato so inereng na sakey a gomagawa, tan say panday na balitok sikato so inoklopan to na balitok tan insanto igawaan na saray golonggolong a pilak.
Say karukaan a toloy a mangisaklang na ontan a bagat pilien to so kiew ya ag bakabaken: yanapan to na sakey a maronong ya onkimey a mamaalagey na sakey a talintao ya inbolik, ya ag naani niyalis.
Agyo ta naamtaan? agyo ta nadngelan? agta nibaga ed sikayo a nanlapu ed gapu? agyo ta atalosan a nanlapu ed inkialagey na dalin?

Sikato a manyorong ed tagey na tibukel a dalin, tan saray manayam ed sikato singa ra dondonaron; a mangibuskag na saray tawen a singa sakey a kobongkobong, tan mangibilkag ed sikara a singa sakey a tolda a panayaman;
A mangibalang ed saray principe; sikato a mangawa na saray okom na dalin a singa kaapaan.
On, sikara ag ira nitanem; on, ag ira nipasedser; on, say sengeg da ag linmamot ed dalin: angan ontan sikato sibokan to so tapew da et namagaan ira, tan say alimbosabos yarawi to ra a singa dayami.
Siopa sirin so pangiparaan yo ed siak, pian nipara ak komon ed sikato? kuan na Santo.

Itangay yo so saray mata yo ed tagey, tan nengnengen yo no siopa so amalsa ed saraya, a sikato alaen to so saray ejercito ra ed bilang; sikato tawagen to ra ya amin ed ngaran; lapu ed kabaleg a toloy na biskeg to ed pakapanyari, tan lapu ed mabiskeg ed pakayari, angapo so kulang angan sakey.
Akin ed kuan mo, O Jacob, tan salitaen mo, O Israel, Say dalan ko nisanib ed kinen Katawan, tan say inkatunong a nipaakar ed siak linmabas a nanlapu ed Dios ko?
Agmo ta naamtaan? agmo ta nadngelan? Say ando lan ando a Dios, si Katawan, ya Manamalsa ed saray sampot na dalin, ag onkapuy, tan ag met nakesawan; angapo so makaosisa ed linawa to.
Sikato mangiter na pakayari ed makapuy; et saman so andian na pakapanyari sikato so parakelan to na biskeg.
Angan saray ugugaw onkapuy ira tan nakesawan ira, tan saray tobonbalo parokol ira naani a sigpot;
Balet saray manalagar ed Katawan pasimbaloen to so biskeg da; mamaatagey ira naani ya akapayak a singa say aguila; ombatik ira naani, tan ag ira nakesawan; manakar ira naani, tan ag ira onkapuy.
Ag kayo onesel ed arap ko, O polpolo; et saray totoo pasimbaloen da komon so saray biskeg da; onasinger ira komon; saman lara mansalita; onasinger itayo komon a manoolop ed kaokom.

Siopa so amaatagey na sakey a nanlapu ed bokig, a sikato so tawagen to dia ed katunongan ed sali to? sikato yawa to so saray nacion ed arap to, ta sikato so gawaen to a manuley ed saray ar-ari; iter to ra ed kampilan to a singa dabok, tan singa nitekyab a dayami ed bekang to.
Sikato osilan to ra, tan onlabas ya ag naano, angan ed sakey ni a dalan ya ag ni dinalan na saray sali to.
Siopa so nangawa tan anumpal na saya, a tawagen to so saray kailalakan a manlapu ed gapu? Siak, a Katawan, say unona tan naonor, Siak iman.
Saray polpolo anengneng da, tan antakot ira; saray sampot na dalin ongiwgiw ira; onasinger ira, tan onsabi ra.
Sikara nantutulongan ira a balang sakey ed kaabay to; et say balang sakey kuan to ed agi to, Manpabiskeg ka a maong.

Ontan met so anlawagi pakulien na panday-balitok, tan say mamalanas ed babatla pakulien to samay manpitpit ed papasnaan, a kuan to ed manpapainang, Sikato so maong; et inpasak to, pian sikato so ag natenyeg.
Balet sika, Israel, ya aripen ko, Jacob a pinilik, bini nen Abraham a kaarok,
Sika ya inegnaan ko a nanlapu ed saray sampot na dalin, tan tinawag ko a nanlapu ed saray suyok to, tan inkuan ko ed sika, Sika so aripen ko, pinilit taka, tan agtaka inbantak;
Agka antakot, ta walaak ed sika, agka napagaan, ta siak so Dios mo; pabiskegen ta ka naani; on, tulongan ta ka: on, ampayaen ta ka ed nikawanan a lima na inkatunong ko.
Nia, amin iray nangula a sumpa ed sika nibabaing ira naani tan nagolo ra: saray misangsangan ed sika singa ra naani angapo tan nabalang ira.
Sika anapen mo ra et agmo ra naromog, angan saray misangsangan ed sika: saray mamakal ed sika magmaliw ira naani a singa angapo, tan singa sakey a bengatla ya andi kakanaan to.
Ta siak, si Katawan a Dios mo, a mangitagey na kawanan a limam, a kuan ko ed sika, Agka antakot; tulongan to ka naani.
Agka antakot, sika bigis a Jacob, tan sikayo totoo na Israel; tulongan ta kayo naani, kuan nen Katawan, tan say Mananondon mo sikato so Santo na Israel.

Nia, ginawa ta ka a sakey a balo tan maotok a panbayo ya walaan na ngipen; sika bayoen mo naani so saray palandey, tan mekmeken mo ra naani a melamelanting, tan gawaen mo naani a singa taep so saray pokdol.
Itegap mo ra naani, tan itekyab ira naani na dagem, tan say bagyo buyaken to ra naani; et sika manliket ka naani ed Katawan, mangloria ka naani ed Santo na Israel.
Saray duka tan saray naokolan anapen da so danum, et angapo a balot, et saray dila ra onkapuy a nisengeg ed pega; siak, si Katawan ebatan ko ra naani, siak, a Dios na Israel, agko ra naani ikaindan.

Mangilukas ak naani na saray ilog ed saray malinis a palandey, tan sobosobol ed pegley na saray lawak; gawaen ko so kalawakan a sakey a libsong na danum, tan sakey ya amaga a dalin a mantakbol na danum.
Yan ko naani ed kalawakan so cedro, say acacia, tan say arrayan, tan say kiew a mangiter na larak, ipasen ko naani ed takel so kiew ya abeto, say saleng, tan say kiew na alamo a manlalason ira:
Pian nanengneng da, tan naamtaan da, tan naisip da, tan natalosan da a sankaolop, a say lima nen Katawan ginawa to so saya, tan say Santo na Israel sikato so pinalsa to.
Ipaliwawa yo so pegdat yo, kuan nen Katawan; ipatnag yo so saray mabiskeg a pamaakaran yo, kuan na ari nen Jacob.

Yakar dara komon, tan ipakabat da ed sikami no anto naani nagawa: ipakabat yo so saray inmuna a bengatla, no anto ra, pian isipen mi ra, tan naamtaan mi so kaunoran a kasumpalan da; odino ipanengneng yo ed sikami so saray bengatla ya onsabi.

Ibaga yo so saray bengatla ya onsabi ed arapen, pian naamtaan mi a dirios kayo; on, mangawa kayo na maabig, odino mangawa kayo na mauges, pian sikami nikelawan kami tan sikato so nanengneng mi a sankatipon.
Nia, angapo so kakanaan yo, tan say gawa yo sikato so angapo; sakey a kadimla so mamili ed sikayo.
