Amaatagey ak na sakey a nanlapu ed amianen et sikato so onsabi; manlapu ed letakan na banwa sakey a nantawag na ngaran ko: et sikato so onsabi naani ed tapew na saray makauley a singa manakar ed tapew na pitek, tan singa say domadamili ya igatingatin to so pitek.
Siopa so angibaga ed sikato nanlapu nen inmuna, pian nakabatan tayo komon? tan sanen inmuna, pian nikuan mi, Wala so katunongan to? on, angapo so mangibaga, on, angapo so ondengel ed saray salitayo.
Siak so ununa a mankuan ed Sion, Nengnengen yo, nengnengen yo ra; iter ko naani ed Jerusalem so sakey a mangyakar na saray maong a balita.
Et no onnengneng ak, angapo so too; angan komon no sakey a manimbawa angapo ed sikara, ya, no mantepet ak komon na nipaakar ed sikara, makaebat komon ed sakey a salita.
Nia, sikara ya amin, saray gawa ra sikara so maapa tan andi kakanaan da; saray inbobo a talintao sikara so dagem tan kagolo.
Nia, say aripen ko, a sikato so ampayaen ko; say pinilik, a panliketan na kamarerwak: inyan ko so Espirituk ed sikato: sikato yakar to naani inkatunong ed saray Gentil.
Sikato ag naani onakis, tan ag to met itagey so voces to, tan ag to met gawaen a narengel ed polong.
Say sakey a kawayan ya abalbal agto naani poteren, tan say sakey a pabilo a mandarlang a makuyep agto naani erepen: sikato papawayen to naani kaptekan ed katuaan.
Sikato ag naani onkulang tan ag met ontakot so linawa to ya anga ed nipasen to so inkatunong ed dalin; et saray polo alagden da naani so tunong to.

Onia so kuan na Dios a Katawan, a sikato so amalsa ed saray tawen, tan amuskag ed sikara, sikato ya angilaknab na dalin tan say ompaway ed sikato; sikato a mangiter na panlinawa na saray totoo ed tapew to, tan say espiritu ed saray manakar ed sikato:

Siak, si Katawan, tinawag ta ka ed inkatunong, tan egnaan ko naani limam, tan kawaloen ta ka naani, tan iter to ka naani a nipaakar a sakey a sipan ed saray totoo, nipaakar a sakey a silew na saray Gentil;
Pian lukasan mo so saray bulag a mata, pian ipaway mo so saray pinangaw ed mainget a panangipangawan, tan saray manyorong ed kabilungetan ipaway mo ra ed panangipangawan.
Siak si Katawan, satan so ngaran ko; et say gloriak agko naani iter ed sananey, tan agko met iter so galang ko ed saray inbolik a talintao.
Nia, saray ununa a bengatla nagawala, tan balobalo a bengabengatla so ipaliwawak; dia ed arapen na ipaway da ibagak ed sikayo so nipaakar ed sikara.

Ikantaan yo si Katawan na sakey a balo a canta, tan say galang to a manlapu ed sampot na dalin; sikayo ya onlepsag ed dayat, tan saray amin a wala ed sikato, saray polpolo, tan saray manaayam ed sikara.
Say lawak tan saray ciudad to itagey da komon so voces da, saray polok a panayaman na Cedar; mankanta komon so saray taga Sela, oneyag ira komon ed liket a manlapu ed toktok na saray palandey.
Mangiter ira komon nai balang ed Katawan, tan ipaliwawa ra eat galang to ed saray polpolo.

Si Katawan ompaway naani a singa sakey a mabayani a too; papawayen to naani so seseg a singa sakey a too na bakal: sikato naani oningal, on, sikato naani oneyag; gawaen to naani a mabisbiskeg a sumpa ed saray kabosol to.
Abayag la a binenbenan ko so deen ko; agak inmesel, tan pinokpokan ko so inkasiak: natan oningal ak naani a singa sakey a bii a manpasákit; mamagbagak tan mangakmon ak a maminpinsan.
Igebak naani so saray palandey tan pokdol, tan pamagaen ko so amin a dika ra; tan saray ilog pagmaliwen ko ra naani a polpolo, tan paekaten ko naani so saray libsong.

Tan yakar ko naani so bulag ed sakey a dalan ya agda amta: ed saray basbas ya agda amta so pangidalanan ko ed sikara; say bilunget gawaen ko naani a liwawa ed arap da, tan panpeteken ko so pikewet a pasen. Saraya a bengatla so gawaen ko naani, tan agko ra paulian.
Ompawil ira naani, nibabaing ira naani a toloy, saray manmatalek ed saray inbolik a talintao, a mankuan ed saray inbobo a talintao, Sikayo so dirios mi.
Dengel kayo, sikayo a telek; tan nengnengen yo, sikayo a bulag, pian nanengneng yo.
Siopa so bulag, no ag say aripen ko? odino say telek, singa say igagangan ko ya ingangan ko? siopa so bulag a singa saman so akipakna ed siak, tan bulag a singa say aripen nen Katawan?
Sika nanengneng mo so saray dakel a bengatla balet sika agmo imanoen; saray layag to akalukas ira, balet sikato so ag makadngel.
Sikato so makapaliket ed kinen Katawan, lapu ed kaptekan to, a pamabaleg ed tunong, tan pagalangan to.

Et saya sikato so sakey a baley ya atakewan tan asamsaman; sikara ya amin akalotan ira ed saray abot, et wala ra a niyamot ed abung a panangipangawan nipaakar ira a dinakep, tan angapo so mangilaban; nipaakar ira a sakey a samsam, et angapo so mankuan, Ipawil yo.
Siopa ed sikayo so ondengel na saya? a talinengen to tan imatleken nipaakar ed panaon ya onsabi?

Siopa so angyawat ed Jacob a sakey a samsam, tan say Israel ed saray tulisan? aliwa ta a si Katawan? a sikato so nankasalananan tayo, tan saray dalan to agda nilabay a dinalan, tan ag ira met inmonor ed tunong to.

Kanian yibong to ed sikato so kasebegan na sanok to, tan say kasil na bakal, tan sikato so sinelselan to ed liberliber, manwari agto kinabat; et sikato so pinoolan to, angan ontan agto ingaton ed puso.
Balet natan onia so kuan nen Katawan ya amalsa ed sika, O Jacob, tan sikato ya anibukel ed sika, O Israel; Agka antakot, ta siak dinondon taka; siak tinawag taka ed ngaran mo, sika so kayarian ko.
Sano baliwen mo so saray danum, walaak ed sika; tan dia ed saray ilog, agka nadelap naani: sano manakar ka ya onlabas ed apuy, agka naani napoolan, tan agto ka met silayutan na dalang.
Ta siak si Katawan a Dios mo, say Santo na Israel, a Manangilaban mo; initer ko so Egipto a singa panagkadondon mo, nisalat ed sika so Etiopia tan Saba.
Lapu ed mabli ka nen saman ed pakanengneng ko, tan magalang tan inaro taka; kanian iter ko naani so saray totoo a salat mo, tan saray baley ya onsandi ed bilay mo.
Agka antakot; ta walaak ed sika: yakar ko naani so bukel mo a manlapu ed bokig tan tiponen ta ka naani a manlapu ed sagur;
Ikuan ko naani ed amianen, Ikbanan mo; tan ed abalaten, Agmo pokpokan; yakar mo so saray anak mo a lalaki a manlapu ed arawi, tan saray anak mo a bibii a manlapu ed sampot na dalin;
Balang sakey a natumangan ed ngaran ko, tan sikato so pinalsak a nipaakar ed gloriak, sikato a tinibukel ko, on a ginawak.
Ipatnag mo so saray bulag a totoo ya wala so mata ra, saray telek ya wala so layag da.

Natipon komon so saray amin a nacion, tan manmomoyong so saray balbaley: siopa ed sikara so makapangipaliwawa na saya, tan mangipatnag na saray akauna a bengatla ed sikatayo? itarok da komon so saray tasi ra, pian napatunong ira; odino, denglen da komon, tan kuan da, Sikato so tua.

Sikayo so saray tasik, kuan nen Katawan tan say aripen ko a pinilik; pian naamtaan yo tan sisiaen yo ak tan natalosan yo a siak iman: angapo nen saman so agawa a Dios ya inmona nen siak, tan angapo met naani so ontombok ed siak.
Siak, siak lanlamang si Katawan; no aliwa a siak angapo komon so manangilaban.
Impaliwawak, tan inlaban ko, tan inpanengneng ko; et angapo so sananey a Dios ed sikayo: kanian sikayo so tasik, kuan nen Katawan, et siak so Dios.
On, nanlapu ed inkiwala na agew siak iman; et angapo a balot so makaokpos ed limak; labay ko a gawaen, et siopa so makasbel?

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, a Mananondon ed sikayo, say Santo na Israel: Lapu ed sikayo nanbaki ak ed Babilonia, tan yakseb ko ra ya amin a singa ontainan, a sikara so saray Caldeo, ed saray sakayan so panliket da.
Siak si Katawan a Santo yo, say Amalsa ed Israel ya Ari yo.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan, a mangawa na dalan ed dayat, tan sakey a basbas ed saray makapanyari a danum;
Sikato a mangala na luganan tan kabayo, say ejercito tan mabayani a too (nipasag ira ya amin, ag ira naani ombangon; napaandi ra, naerep ira a singa say pabilo):
Agyo nodnonoten so saray inmona a bengatla, tan agyo met nonoten so saray daan a bengatla.
Nia, mangawa ak naani na balo a bengatla; ompaway la natan; agyo ta naani naamtaan? mangyanak naani na sakey ni a dalan ed kalawakan, tan saray ilog ed saray kabueran.
Saray ayep ed uma igalangda ak naani, saray chacal tan avestruz; lapu ed mangiter ak na danum ed saray kalawakan, ta saray ilog ed saray kabueran, pian oninum so baley ko a pinilik,
Say ombaley a ginawak a nipaakar ed siak lanlamang, pian ipatnag da komon so kigalang ko.
Angan ontan sika agmo ak tinawagan, O Jacob; no ag ingen sika abanalan ka ed siak, O Israel.
Agka angyakar ed siak na nanlapu ed saray carnerom a nipaakar a napoolan a bagat: agmo ak ingalang ed saray bagat mo. Agtaka pinaawitan ed saray nibagat, agtaka pinakapuy ed incienso.
Agmo ak insaliwan ed pilak na unas, tan agmo ak met pinera ed taba na saray bagat mo: no ag ingen pinabelatan mo ak ed saray kasalanan mo, pinaksaw mo ak ed saray inkauges mo.
Siak, siak lanlamang so amunas ed saray inpakasumlang mo lapu ed dili a kakanaan ko; et agko la naani nonoten so saray kasalanan mo.
Ipanonot mo ed siak; mansangsangan ita: ipatnag mo so sengegan mo, pian napatunong ka.
Say inmona ya amam nankasalanan, tan saray managbangat mo sinmumpa ra ed siak.
Kanian mogmoraen ko naani so saray principe na santuario; et gawaen ko naani si Jacob a sakey ya ayew, tan say Israel a sakey a kibabaing.
Natan sirin deglen mo, O Jacob ya aripen ko, tan Israel a pinilik:
Onia so inkuan nen Katawan a nangawa ed sika, tan anibukel ed sika a nanlapu ed eges, a sikato naani manulong ed sika: Agka antakot, O Jacob ya aripen ko; tan sika Jesurun a pinilik.
Ta mangibung ak na danum ed napgaan, tan saray agos na danum ed tapew na amaga a dalin; Yibong ko naani so Espirituk ed tapew na binim, tan say bendicion ko ed tapew na simit mo.
Et sikara onbosilak ira naani ed pegley na karikaan, a singa kiew a kinmawayan ed abay na danum.

Say sakey inkuan to, Kayarian ak nen Katawan; et say sakey ingaran to naani inkasikato ed ngaran a Jacob; et say sakey isulat to naani ed lima to so nipaakar ed Katawan, tan ingaranan to naani so inkasikato ed ngaran ya Israel.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan, ya ari na Israel tan Mananondon to, a Katawan na saray ejercito: Siak so inmuna tan say kaonoran; et angapo la so arum a Dios no ag siak.

Et Siopa so singa siak, a manawag, tan mangipaliwawa, tan mangoksoy a nipaakar ed siak, nanlapu ed inpangipasen ko ed saray inmuna a totoo? tan saray bengatla ya onsabi, tan say nagawa, ipaliwawa ra komon.

Agkayo antakot, tan agkayo met ontalaw: agko ta inpaliwawa ed sika nen inmuna, tan inpatnag ko? et sikayo so saray tasik? wala ta so sananey a Dios nen say siak? on, angapo so Batondampay; angapo so amtak.

Saray mangereng na inbolik a talintao sikara so maapa ya amin et saraya a bengatla a panliketan da ag naani mamanabang; tan saray tasi ra lanlamang ag ira makanengneng, agda met amta: pian nibabaing ira naani.
Siopa so angereng na sakey a dios, odino angibobo na sakey a talintao ya angapo a balot so napinabangan?
Nia, amin a kaolop to nibabaing ira; tan saray mangawa totoo ra: natipon ira komon a sankatipon, nibabaing ira a nanpapara.

Say panday mangawa na sakey a wasay, tan mankimey ed saray ngalab, tan say babatla sikato so pangereng to, tan gawaen to ed mabiskeg a lima to: on, sikato narasan et onkulang so biskeg to: ag oninum na danum et onkapuy.

Say anlawagi mangyunat na sakey a paltik; gulisan to ed sakey a lapiz; say sorsor so pangiter to na ereng, tan ed compas balasbasan to, tan gawaen to a singa talintao na too, unong ed kalimgasan na sakey a too, pian manayam ed abung.
Sikato batangen to ed saray cedro, tan alaen to so encina tan roble, tan pasekderen to a nipaakar ed sikato so sakey ed saray kiew ed katakelan: mangitanem na abeto, tan taganoen na uran.

Et dia ed ontan agamilen naani sakey a too a pamool: et insanto alaen ed satan tan pandangdangan; on, sikato so parlangen to, tan manloto na tinapay; on sikato mangawa na sakey a dios, tan pikasian to: sikato so gawaen to a sakey ya inbolik a talintao, tan pantalimokoran to.
Poolan to so kabiangan to ed apuy; say arum a kabiangan so panganan to na laman; mangikalot na inkalot a sira, et napesel; on, mandangdang, tan kuan to, A, pinmetangak, anengneng ko so apuy.

Et say kera ed sikato gawaen to a sakey a dios, a sikato so inbolik a talintao; sikato so mangigalang ed saya a talintao tan manpikasi, tan mandasal ed sikato, tan kuanto, Ilaban mo ak; ta sika so dios ko.
Sikara agda amta, tan agda met isipen: ta sikato sinakbongan to so saray mata ra, pian ag ira makanengneng; tan saray puso ra, pian ag ira makatalos.

Tan angapo so mangipanonot, tan angapo so pikakabat tan angapo met so pakatalos a mangikuan, Pinoolan ko so kiew a kabiangan na saya a talintao ed apuy; on, nanloto ak na tinapay ed tapew na ngalab to; angikalot ak na laman tan sinirak: et gawaen ko ta so nakeraan ed sikato a sakey a kadimla? mangigalangak ta ni ed puter na sakey a kiew?
Sikato mantagano ed dapol; say alingo a puso pinasipa to; et agto naani nilaban so kamarerwa to, tan agto met kuan, Angapo ta so tila ed nikawanan a limak?
Nodnonoten mo so saraya a bengatla, O Jacob, tan Israel; ta sika so aripen ko: ginawa taka; sika so aripen ko: O Israel, ag taka naani nalingoanan.
Pinunas ko a singa lurem a makapal so saray inpakaloksom, tan singa lurem so saray kasalanan mo: ompawil ka ed siak; ta dinondon taka.

Mankanta kayo, O katawenan, ta si Katawan sikato so nangawa; oneyag kayo abeba a pasen na dalin; ombetag kayo a mankanta sikayo a palandey, O takel, tan amin a kakiewan ed sikato: ta si Katawan dinondon to si Jacob, tan nagalang so inkasikato ed Israel.

Nia so kuan nen Katawan, a Ma nanondon mo, tan anibukel ed sika a nanlapu ed panaganakan: Siak si Katawan a mangawa ed saray amin a bengatla; ya ibuskag ko a bokor ko so saray tawen; tan mangibilkag na dalin (siopa so ibak?);
A maneral ed saray tanda na saray matila, tan mamasanok ed saray pomaparles; tan mamalikdo ed saray makabat a totoo, tan mangawa na pikakabat da a kaatiwan;

A mamalet ed salita na aripen to, tan manumpal ed simbawa na saray igagangan to; a mankuan ed Jerusalem, Sikato so natooan naani; dia ed saray ciudad na Juda, Sikara napaalageyan ira naani, tan ipaalagey ko naani so saray nagba a paspasen to;
A mankuan ed kalinsorong, Onmaga ka, tan pamagaen ko naani so saray ilog mo;
A mankuan ed Ciro, Sikato so pastol ko, tan gawaen to ya amin so labay ko, a kuanto a nipaakar ed Jerusalem lanlamang, Sikato nipaalagey naani, say cimiento to niletneg naani.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan ed nilanaan to, ed Ciro, a say lima to a kawanan binenbenan ko, a mamatolok ed saray nacion ed arap to, et okbaran ko naani so saray banel na saray ar-ari; a mangilukas ed saray pinto ed arap to, et saray wangalan ag ira naani nikaput:
Onla ak naani ed onaan mo, tan palanasen ko naani so saray lasonglasong: buyaken ko naani so saray wangalan a gambang; puterputerea ko naani so saray balewet a balatyang.

Et iter ko naani ed sika so saray kayamanan na kabilungetan, tan saray kayamanan ya inyamot ed saray maamot a pasen, pian sika naamtaan mo a siak, si Katawan, a manawag ed sika ed ngaran mo, salanti say Dios na Israel.
Lapu ed Jacob ya aripen ko, tan say Israel, a pinilik, tinawag ta ka ed ngaran mo: siak pangaranantaka, angan agmo ak kabat nen saman.
Siák si Katawan, et angapo so arum la: angapo so Dios no ag siak lambengat, Balkesan taka, angan agmo ak kabat nen saman;
Pian sikara nakabatan da a manlapu ed letakan na banwa, tan manlapu ed sagur, ya angapo la so sananey no ag siak lambengat; Siak si Katawan, et angapo la so sananey.
Siak pawalaen ko so liwawa, tan, palsaen ko so bilunget; gawaen ko so deen tan palsaen ko so mauges; siak si Katawan mangawa na saraya ya amin.

Manpatoro kayo, katawenan a manlapu ed tagey, tan saray tawen mangyibong ira komon na inkatunong: onlukas komon so dalin pian mamapaway na kilalaban, tan gawaen to a mibansag ya ompaway so inkatunong; siak, si Katawan, sikato so pinalsak.
Abagey la so mikolkol ed Akangawa ed sikato! sikato so sakey a langa ed saray langa na dalin! Ikuan ta na pitek ed domadamili, Anto so gawaen mo? odino say ginawam, Angapo so lima to?
Abagey la so mankuan ed sakey ya ama, Anto ta so nanilalakan mo? odino ed sakey a bii, Anto ta so panpasakitan mo?

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, say Santo na Israel, tan say Nangawa ed sikato: Tepeten mo ed siak so saray bengatla ya onsabi; ganganen yo ak nipaakar ed saray ana' ko, tan nipaakar ed gawa na saray limak.
Ginawak so dalin tan pinalsak so too ed tapew to: Siak, dia ed saray limak lanlamang binuskag ko so saray tawen; tan ginangan ko so saray amin ya ejercito ra.

Sikato so pinaalagey ko ed inkatunong, tan gawaen ko a maptek naani so saray amin a dalan to: sikato paalageyen to naani ciudad ko, tan sikato paulian to naani so dinakep ko ya bulos, aliwa a lapu ed bili tan aliwa met a lapu ed nabang, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, say gawa na Egipto, tan say lako na Etiopia, tan Saba, totoo ya a tagey, onla ra naani ed sika, tan sikara naani kayarian mo: ontombok ira naani ed sika; onsabi ra naani a sigogolonggolong; et mangigalang ira naani ed sika, mikasi ra naani ed sika, a kuan da, Tua ya wala ed sika so Dios; et angapo la so sananey a Dios.
Tua a sika so Dios ya isanib mo so laman mo, O Dios na Israel, a Manangilaban.
Sikara nibabaing ira naani, on, tan nagolo ra ya amin; niyakar ira naani ed kagonigon a manoolop so saray mangagawa na saray talintao.
Balet say Israel ilaban naani nen Katawan ed ando lan ando a panangilaban: agkayo naani nibabaing tan agkayo met nagolo ed mundo ya andi ebas to.

Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan ya amalsa ed saray tawen, say Dios ya anibukel tan nangawa na dalin, sikato ya angiletneg ed sikato tan sikato so pinalsa to ya aliwa a kibalatar, ya tinibukel to ta pian sikato so panayaman: Siak si Katawan; et angapo la so sananey.

Agak nansalita ed maamot, odino ed sakey a pasen na dalin na kabilungetan; agko inkuan ed bini nen Jacob, Anapen yo ak ed kaapaan: siak, si Katawan, mansalitaak na inkatunong, ipaliwawak so saray maptek a bengatla.

Mantitipon kayo tan dago kayo; onasinger kayo a mantitipon, sikayo ya akabatik ed saray nacion; sikara ya andian na pikakabat a manawit na kiew na saray inbolik a taltalintao, tan mikasi ira ed sakey a dios ya agto nayarian so mangilaban ed sikara.

Ipaliwawa yo, tan sikato so ipatnag yo; on, mansisimbawaan ira komon: siopa so angipanengneng na saya a nanlapu nen inmuna a panaon? siopa so angipaliwawa na saya nen abayag la a panaon? aliwa ta a siak, si Katawan? et angapo la so sananey a Dios no ag siak lambengat, sakey a matunong a Dios tan sakey a Manangilaban: angapo la so sananey no ag siak lambengat.
Nengneng yo ak, et nilaban kayon amin a sampot na dalin; ta siak so Dios, et angapo la so sananey.
Nansamba ak ed inkasiak lanlamang, pinmaway ed sangik so salita na inkatunong, et ag naani ompawil, ya amin a pueg ontalimokor ed siak, tan amin a dila mansamba naani.
Tan si Katawan lambengat, sikato so nikuan ed sika, sikato so inkatunong tan kabiskegan; dia ed sikato lanlamang onla naani so saray totoo; et amin iray nanggula ed sikato nibabaing ira naani.
Dia ed Katawan so pakapatunongan na amin a bini na Israel, tan pangloriaan da naani.

Si Bel ondakmomo, si Nebo ontuek; saray talintao a dios da wala ra ed tapew na saray ayayep, tan ed tapew na saray baka: saray bengatla ya inawit yo nagawa ra ya awit, sakey ya awit ed naksawan ya ayep.
Ontuek ira, ondakmomo ra a mantitipon; agda ayarian so pinmaliis ed awit, no ag ingen sikara linma ra lanlamang ed inkadakep.
Dengel kayo ed siak, O abung nen Jacob, tan amin ya atilak ed abung nen Israel, ya inawit lapu ed panamegley ko a nanlapu ed inkianak da, a naawit ira a nanlapu ed eges;
Tan anga ni ed inkamasiken Siak iman, tan anga ni ed panuban awiten ta kayo: ginawak la, tan awiten ko naani; on, awiten ko naani, tan yawak.
Siopa so pangiparaan yo ed siak, tan pangiparengan yo ed siak, tan pangyalilingan yo ed siak, pian nayarian tayo so mipara?

Saray mandarak na balitok ya ipaway da ed supot, tan simbangen da so pilak ed simbangan, sikara mangopa ra ed sakey a panday na balitok, et sikato so gawaen to a sakey a Dios; sikara ontikleb ira, on, mangigalang ira.

Sikato so sakbaten da ed abala, sikato so awiten da, tan sikato so ipasen da ed pasen to, tan sikato so onalagey; ag naani onalis ed pasen to: on nayarian na too so ontawag ed sikato, angan ontan ag makaebat odino makapangilaban ed sikato ed kairapan to.
Nonoten yo so saya, tan ipatnag yo so inkalaki yo; ipanonot yo lamet, O sikayo a mananumlang.
Nonoten yo so saray inmuna a bengatla nen abayag la: ta siak so Dios, et angapo la so sananey; Dios ak, et angapo so mipara ed siak;

Ya ipaliwawak so pangangaan a manlapu ed gapo, tan nanlapu nen inmuna a panaon ipaliwawak so saray bengatla ya ag ni agawa; a kuanko, Say simbawak mansiansia naani, tan gawaen ko naani so amin a labay ko;
A tawagen ko so sakey a manok ed tagey a manlapu ed bokig, say too na simbawak a manlapu ed arawi a dalin; on, sinalitak, gawaen ko naani ya onlabas met; ninonot ko, sikato naani met so gawaen ko.
Denglen yo ak, sikayo ya inmawet a puso, ya wala kayo ya arawi ed inkatunong:
Yasinger ko so inkatunong ko, ag naani arawi, tan say panangilaban ko ag naani mantantan; et ipasen ko naani panangilaban diman ed Sion a. nipaakar ed Israel a gayagak.

Onlasor ka, tan onyorong ka ed dabok, O virgen ya anak na Babilonia; onyorong ka ed dalin ya angapo so angan sakey a yorongan, O anak a bii na Caldeo; ta sika la naani natawag a malanguer tan maisisinagel.
Alaen mo so saray bato a gilingan, tan mangiling ka na tapong; ekalen mo so pandong mo, okposen mo so karangalan mo, lislisan mo so salim, yakyaken mo so saray ilog.
Say inkalaboslakseb mo nalukasan naani, tan say ibabaing mo nanengneng naani: alaen ko naani pangibales, tan angapo naani ilegyas ko.
Say Mananondon ed sikatayo, Katawan na saray ejercito so ngaran to, say Santo na Israel.
Onyorong ka ya andi eseesel, tan loob ka ed kabilungtan, O anak a bii na saray Caldeo; ta agka la naani ningaran a Say ali na saray nanarian.
Nanpasnok ak ed baley ko, minodmorak so tawir ko, tan initer ko ra ed limam: agmo ra pinatnagan na panangasi; dia ed tapew na masiken ingaton mo ya ambelabelat so pakom.
Et inkuan mo, Siak naani so ali ed ando lan ando; dia ed ontan ya agmo inyan ed puso ra so saraya a bengatla, tan agmo met ninonot so kaonoran a kasumpalan to.

Natan sirin denglen mo so saya, sika a niyawat ed saray liket, ya onyorong ka a mataletalek, a kuan mo ed pusom, Siak, et angapo so sananey no ag siak lambengat; agak naani onyorong a singa sakey a balo a bii, tan agko met naani amta so kabalang na saray anak:

Balet saraya, a duaran bengatla on onsabi naani ed sika a bigla ed sakey ya agew, kabalang na saray anak, tan say kabalo: onsabi ra naani ed sika ed napno a sukatan, ed inkarakel na pananitom, tan say baleg a karaklan na mangkokolam mo.

Ta sika nanmatalkan mo so inkauges mo; sika inkuan mo, Angapo so makanengneng ed siak, say kakabatan mo tan say pikakabat mo dineral da ka; et sika inkuan mo ed pusom, Siak, et angapo la so sananey no ag siak lambengat.

Kanian say mauges so ontapew naani ed sika; agmo naani naamtaan so panlapuan to; et say duksa napelag naani ed sika; agmo naani nayarian ya ipulisay; tan say kabuybuyak so onsabi naani ed sika a bigla, ya agmo naamamtaan.

Onalagey ka natan a pati say inkamangkokolam mo, tan ed inkarakel na panaganitom, a sikara so nansagsagpotan mo a nanlapu ed inkaugaw mo; ompan lamang makagamor ka na nabang, ompan lamang ontalona ka.

Naalipanesan ka ed kinarakel na saray simbawam; onalagey komon natan a mangilaban ed sika ed saray bengatla ya onsabi naani ed sika so saray astrologo, saray mangimatlek ed saray bitewen, saray manpakta ed binulan onalagey ira komon tan ilaban da ka ed saray amin a bengatla ya onsabi ed sika.
Nia, singara naani dayami; say apuy olamen to ra naani; ag ira naani nilegyas ed pakayari na dalang: angapo naani nakeraan a ngalan a panpapetangan; odino apuy a pandangdangan.

Onia naani so pansumpalan da ed sika so saray bengatla a nansagsagpotan mo: saray nanlako ed sika nanlapu ed inkaugaw mo manteyengteyeng ira naani balang sakey ed nanlapuan to; angapo naani mangyawa ed sika.

Denglen yo so saya, O abung nen Jacob, ya inngaranan na Israel, tan nanlapu ed saray danum na Juda; sikayo a mansamba ed ngaran nen Katawan, tan mangipanonot ed Dios na Israel, balet aliwan dia ed katuaan tan aliwa met ed inkatunong.
(Ta tawagen da so laman da a totoo ra ed santo a ciudad, tan onligen ira ed Dios na Israel; Katawan na saray ejercito so ngaran to):
Inpaliwawak so saray inmuna a bengatla a nanlapu nen gapu; on, pinmaway ira ed sangik, tan inpatnag ko ra: bigla a ginawak ira, et agawa ra.
Lapu ed amtak nen saman ya anawet ka, tan say tenger mo ulat a balatyang, tan say muling mo gansa.

Kanian sikato so inpaliwawak ed sika a nanlapu nen inmuna; sanen ag ni agawa inpanengneng ko ed sika; ompan lamang ikuan mo, Say pidiosan ko ginawa to ra, tan say inbolik a talintao, tan say inbobo a talintao a kien ko inbilin to ra.

Sika sikato so nadngel mo; pakanengnengen yo ya amin so saya; et sikayo, agyo ta ipaliwawa? inpanengneng ko ed sika so saray balobalo a bengatla a manlapu ed saya a panaon, a sikara so saray niyamot a bengatla, ya agmo ra naamtaan.
Apalsa ra natan, tan aliwa a nanlapu nen gapu; et sanen arapen na saya ya agew agmo ra nadngelan; ompan lamang ikuan mo, Nia, amtak ira la nen saman.

On, agmo ra nadngelan; on, agmo met ira naamtaan; on, nanlapu nen inmuna say layag mo ag alukasan nen saman: ta amtak nen saman ya agawa a liputan a toloy, tan ningaran ka a sakey a matunganga a nanlapu ed eges.
Lapu ed ngaran ko pantantanen ko so sanok ko, tan lapu ed galang ko pokpokan ko nipaakar ed sika, pian agta ka ni puteren.
Nia, siak ginogolan ta ka, balet aliwa a singa say pilak; siak pinili taka ed palbaan na kairapan.
Nipaakar ed dili a kakanaan ko, nipaakar ed dili a kakanaan ko, sikato naani gawaen ko; ta panon so kamodmora na ngaran ko? Et say gayagak agko naani iter ed sananey.
Dengel kayo ed siak, O Jacob, tan Israel a tinawag ko: Siak iman; siak so ununa, siak met so onor.
On, say limak, inletneg to so cimiento na dalin, tan say limak a kawanan inlaknab to so saray tawen: no tawagen ko ra, maminpinsan ira ya onalagey.

Mantitipon kayo lanlamang, sikayo ya amin, tan denglen yo; siopa ed sikara so mangipaliwawa naani na sarayan bengatla? Saman so inaro nen Katawan gawaen to naani labay to ed Babilonia, tan say taklay to nigaton naani ed saray Caldeo.
Siak, siak lanlamang sinalitak, on, sikato so tinawag ko; sikato so inyakar ko, tan gawaen to naani a maaligwas so dalan to.
Onasinger kayo ed siak, denglen yo so saya; a nanlapu nen gapu Agak nansalita ed maamot; nanlapu nen panaon ya inkiwala to, walaak diman; et natan si Katawan a Dios inbakitoak, tan say Espiritu to.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan, say Mananondon mo, say Santo na Israel: Siak si Katawan a Dios mo, ya angibangat ed sika na nipaakar ed nabang mo, a mangitonton ed sika ed dalan a laen mo komon.
O no komon ta dinengel mo so saray bilin ko! dia ed ontan say deen mo singa komon sakey a ilog, tan say inkatunong mo singa komon daluyon na dayat:
Say binim singa met komon buer, tan saray ilalak na eges mo singa ra komon ed saray dalakirik to; say ngaran to ag komon napunas odino nabagbag ed arap ko.

Manakar kayo a manlapu ed Babilonia, tainan yo so saray Caldeo; ipaliwawa yo ed panamegley na voces na pankanta, ibagayo so saya, ibeliao yo anga ed sampot na dalin: ikuan yo, Si Katawan dinondon to si aripen to a Jacob.
Et ag ira napgaan sanen intonton to ra ya indalan ed saray kabueran: sikato pinaagos to so saray danum a nanlapu ed bato a nipaakar ed sikara: pinisag to so bato met, et pinmaway so saray danum.
Angapo so deen, kuan nen Katawan, ed marelmeng.
Talineng yo ak, O polpolo; tan dengel kayo a balbaley a manlapu ed arawi: Si Katawan tinawag toak a nanlapu ed eges nanlapu ed eges nen inak asalsalita la so ngaran ko;
Et ginawa to so sangik a singa sakey a kampilan a makdem; sinaniban toak ed anino na lima to: tan sikato ginawa toak a sakey a masileng a pana: dia ed pasikit to inyatol toak:
Et inkuan to ed siak, Sika so aripen ko; Israel, a dia ed sika so kigloriaan ko.

Balet inkuan ko, Nansagpot ak ed maapa, inagamil ko so biskeg ko a nipaakar ed angapo tan ed kaapaan; angan ontan ag onsaew so inkatunong ya onnepeg ed siak a wala ed Katawan, tan say tumang ko wala ed Dios ko.

Et natan kuan nen Katawan a nangawa ed siak ya aripen to a nanlapu ed eges, pian papawilen ko ed sikato si Jacob, tan pian say Israel natipon ed sikato (ta mabliak ed saray mata nen Katawan, tan say Dios ko nagmaliw a biskeg ko);

On, sikato kuan to, Daiset a toloy a bengatla so inpagmaliw mo ya aripen ko a mamaalagey ed saray kailalakan nen Jacob, tan mangipawil na niyagel ya Israel: Iter ta ka met naani a silew na saray Gentil, pian makapagmaliw ka a pangilaban ko anga ed sampot na dalin.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, a Mananondon na Israel tan Santo to, sikato a modmoraen na too, sikato a gulaen na nacion, et sakey ya aripen na saray makauley: Saray ar-ari nanengneng da naani tan onalagey ira; saray oloen, et mangigalang ira naani; lapu ed Katawan a matoor, say Santo na Israel, ya amili ed sika.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, Dia ed sakey a panaon a makana inebatan taka, tan dia ed sakey ya agew na kilalaban tinulongan taka; et yagel taka naani tan iter taka naani a sakey a sipan a nipaakar ed totoo, a mamaalagey na dalin, tan ipatawir mo so saray abagbag a tawir:
A kuan mo ed saray abalor, Manakar kayo; ed saray wala ed kabilungetan, Ompatnag kayo. Mankabkab ira naani ed saray dalan, tan ed saray palandey a malinis so pankabkaban da naani.
Ag ira naani naerasan tan napgaan; ag met ira nasakitan na petang tan say banwa: ta say wala so panangasi to ed sikara itonton to ra, a dia ed abay na sobol na danum so pangyarapan to ed sikara.
Et gawaen ko ya amin so palpalandey ko a sakey a dalan, tan saray polong ko nipaatagey ira naani.
Nia, saraya onsabi ra naani a manlapu ed arawi; et, nia, saraya manlapu ed amianen tan manlapu ed sagur; tan saraya manlapu ed dalin na Sinnim.

Mankanta kayo, O sikayo katawenan, tan manliket ka, O dalin; tan onarakak kayo ed pancanta, O palpalandey, ta si Katawan niligliwa to so baley to, tan maparaan naani panangasi ed saray maermen a totoo to.
Balet say Sion inkuan to, Si Katawan pinaulian toak, et say Katawan alingoanan toak.
Nayarian ta na sakey a bii a lingoanan so anak to a mansoso, ya agto komon kasian so anak na eges to? on, saraya makalingoan ira, balet agak makalingoan ed sika.
Nia, inbolik ta ka ed dakulap na saray limak; saray bakor mo wala ra a siansia ed arap ko.
Saray anak mo mansiglat ira, saray amagbag ed sika tan saray nanderal ed sika arawiyan da ka naani.

Itangay mo so saray matam ed liberliber, tan pakanengnengen mo: amin iraya mantitipon ira, tan onsabi ra ed sika. Singa mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan, ag onsaew a kawesan mo naani so laman mo ed sikara ya amin a singa sakey ya along, tan sikara so ibalkes mo a singa sakey a novia.
Ta no nipaakar ed kibalatar a pasen mo tan say nagba a pasen mo, tan say dalin mo ya aderal andi duarua a natan naingetan ka a toloy ed saray ombaley, tan saray angakmon ed sika niyarawi ra naani.
Saray anak na inkaulilam ikuan da naani ed saray layag mo, Say pasen mainget a toloy ed siak; mangiter ka na pasen ed siak pian makapanayam ak.

Saman la ikuan mo ed pusom, Siopa so angianak ed saraya ed siak, anta naulila ak ed saray ana' ko, tan manbokbokor ak, sakey ak a nibantak, tan pawilpawil a manakar-akar? et siopa so maniwi ed saraya? Nia, apaulian ak a saksakey: saraya iner so kawalaan da nen saman?

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Nia, itagey ko naani so limak ed saray nacion, tan ipatagey ko naani so laylay ko ed saray totoo; et yakar da naani so saray anak mo a lalaki ed saray akualan da; et yakar da naani so saray anak mo a bibii ed abala ra.

Et saray ar-ari sikara naani so mantagibi ya atateng mo tan saray reyna mantagibi ya inam: ondakmomo ra naani ed sika ya idunget da so lupa ra ed dalin, tan dildilan da naani so dabok na saray salim; et naamtaan mo naani a siak si Katawan; et saray manalagar ed siak ag ira naani nabaingan.
Naekal naani ta so samsam ed mabiskeg, odino say maptek ya adakep nabolosan ta?

Balet onia so kuan nen Katawan, Angan saray adakep na biskeg naekal ira naani, tan say sinamsam na makapakebiew nilaban naani; ta misangsangan ak naani ed misangsangan ed sika, tan ilaban ko naani so saray anak mo.

Tan pakanen ko naani so saray mamairap ed sika ed laman da lanlamang; et nabuek ira ed dala ra lanlamang, a singa masamit ya alak; et amin a laman naamtaan to naani a siak, si Katawan, so Mangilaban ed sika, tan Mananondon mo, say Makapanyari nen Jacob.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, Iner so kawalaan na sulat na pisian nen inam, a sikato so amatainanan ko ed sikato? odino siopa ed saray akautangan ko so angilakoan ko ed sikayo? Nia, alako kayo lapu ed saray inkauges yo, tan lapu ed saray inpakasumlang yo nisian si ina yo.

Akin sirin, a sanen linmaak, angapo so too? sanen tinmawag ak, angapo so inmebat? Apatikey ta so lima, pian agto nayarian so manondon? odino, angapo ta so pakapanyarik a mangilaban? Nia, dia ed pamaat ko pamagaen ko so dayat, gawaen ko áp saray ilog a kalawakan: saray sira ra nabolok ira, ta angapo so danum, tan ompatey ira ed pega.
Kawesan ko so saray tawen ed inkadeket, tan gawaen ko a saksakbong da so abel a magaspang.

Si Katawan a Dios initer to ed siak so dila na saray abangatan, pian naamtaan ko komon no panon so panamabiskeg ed saray naksawan ed panamegley na saray salita: sikato onliing a kinabuasan, sikato liingen to so layag ko a pandengel a singa pandengel na saray abangatan.
Si Katawan a Dios nilukasan to so layag ko, et agak masunggay, tan agak met binmeneg.
Inbeneg ko so saray mangabil, tan saray aping ko inyarap ko ed saray manbabagot na buek, agko insanib so lupak ed kibabaing tan kalupdaan.
Ta si Katawan a Dios tulongan toak naani, kanian agak agolo; kanian inpasen ko so lupak a singa bato na paminki, tan amtak ya agak naani nibabaing.
Wala ya asinger so mamatunong ed siak; siopa so misangsangan ed siak? onalagey itayo komon a mankakasakey: siopa so kabusol ko? onasinger komon ed siak.
Nia, si Katawan a Dios tulongan toak naani, siopa ta so mangokom ed siak? nia, sikara ya amin singara kawes ya ondaan: say bokbok kanen to ra naani.

Siopa so wala ed nanleleetan tayo ya antakot ed Katawan, a mangonor ed voces na aripen to? say manaakar ed kabilungetan, tan angapo so liwawa to, manmatalek komon ed ngaran nen Katawan, tan onsaral ed Dios to.

Nia, sikayo ya amin a manelsel na sakey ya apuy, tan liberen yo so inkasikayo na ngapus; manakar kayo ed dalang na apuy yo, tan dia ed nanleetan na ngapus a sinebelan yo. Wala naani ya a manlapu ed limak; ondokol kayo naani ed ermen:
Denglen yoak, sikayo a mangoonor ed inkatunong, sikayo a manaanap ed kinen Katawan: onnengneng kayo ed batondampay ya anapingan ed sikayo, tan ed abut na kalinsorong ya angotkotan ed sikayo.
Onnengneng kayo ed kinen Abraham ya ama yo, tan ontan met ed kinen Sara ya angianak ed sikayo sanen bokbokor to ni, sikato so tinawag ko, tan sikato so binendicionan ko tan pinarakel ko.

Ta si Katawan niligliwa to si Sion, sikato niligliwa to so saray amin a pasen to ya abagbag, tan ginawa to so kalawakan to a singa Eden, tan say kabueran a dalin to a singa tanamanan nen Katawan; liket tan gayaga so naromog naanid' man, pisasalamat tan say voces na canta.
Talineng yoak, O baley ko; tan denglen yoak, O nacion ko: ta sakey a tunong so ompaway naani ed siak, et ipasen ko naani inkatunong ko a nipaakar a sakey a silew na saray balbaley.
Say inkatunong ko asinger, say panangilaban ko pinmaway la, tan saray taklay ko okomen da naani so saray balbaley, saray polpolo alagden da ak naani, tan manmatalek ira naani ed saray taklay ko.

Itangay yo so saray mata yo ed tawen, tan onnengneng kayo ed tapew na dalin ed lepsag; ta saray tawen naandipat ira naani a singa asewek, tan say dalin ondaan a singa sakey a kawes; et saray manaayam diman ompatey ira naani met ed ontan ya olibay: balet say panangilaban ko magnayon lawas tan say inkatunong ko ag naani naekal.
Talinengen yoak, sikayo a mikabat na inkatunong, saray totoo a say puso ra so kawalaan na tunong ko; agkayo antakot ed panagbalaw na totoo, tan agkayo met napunaw ed saray panmodmora ra.
Say bokbok kanen da ra a singa sakey a kawes, tan say bigis kanen da ra a singa abel a bago; balet say inkatunong ko sikato naani ando lan ando, tan say panangilaban ko anga ed amin a kailalakan.

Liing ka, liing ka, isolong mo so biskeg, O taklay nen Katawan; liingka, a singa ed saray agew nen inmuna, saray kailalakan nen inmuna a panaon. Aliwa ta a sika so anegteg ed kinen Rahab, ya analos ed saman so olimaw?
Aliwa ta a sika so amaekat ed dayat, saray danum na baleg a kaaraleman; a ginawam so inkaaralem na dayat a sakey a dalan a baliwan na saray arondon?

Et saray dinondon nen Katawan ompawil ira naani, tan onsabi ra a mankankanta anga ed Sion; et say andi angaan a gayaga mansiansia naani ed tapew na kaoloan da: nagamoran da naani so liket tan gayaga; et say ermen tan sibek ontainan ira naani.
Siak, siak lanlamang so manligliwa ed sikayo: siopa ka, ya antakot ka ed too ya ompatey naani, tan ed anak na too a nagawa naani a singa dika:

Et alingoanan mo la si Katawan a Nangawa ed sika a sikato so angilaknab ed saray tawen, tan angipasen na cimiento na dalin; tan natatakot ka a naynay lapu ed sanok na manamairap, sano manparaan la a mabagbag? et iner so kawalaan na sanok na manamairap?
Say adakep a niyarawi ed baley to tampol naani a nibolos; et sikato ag naani ompatey et ag naani onlepsag ed kalinsorong, tan ag met naani onkulang so tagano to.
Ta siak si Katawan a Dios mo, a mangiwal na dayat, pian saray daloyon to manongol ira: Katawan na saray ejercito so ngaran to.
Et inyan ko so saray salitak ed sangim, tan sinaniban taka ed anino na limak, pian nitanem ko so saray tawen, tan nipasen ko so saray cimiento na dalin, tan ikuan ko ed Sion, Sika so baley ko.
Liing ka, liing ka, onbangoh ka, O Jerusalem, sika ya inminum ed ongot na sanok nen Katawan ya wala ed limam; sika inminum ka ed sangab na ongot na pantogingging, tan sikato so inpaterter mo.
Dia ed saray amin ya anak to a lalaki ya inyanak to angapo so sakey ed sikara a mangitonton ed sikato; et angapo met so mangitabin ed sikato ed saray amin ya anak to a lalaki a tinagibi to.
Saraya a duaran bengatla nagawa ra ed sika; siopa so mangagogol ed sika? kibalatar, tan kabagbag, tan eras tan kampilan; panon naani so panligliwak ed sika?
Saray anak mo a lalaki apunaw ira, nipasag ira ed saray amin ya oloan na polong, a singara ulsa na palandey ed dalem na bateng; napno ra ed sanok nen Katawan, say panamaat na Dios mo.
Kanian denglen mo natan ya, sika a mairap, tan abuek, balet aliwan dia ed alak:
Onia so kuan nen Katawan mo a Katawan tan Dios mo a mangikolkol ed sengegan na baley to, Nia, inekal ko ed limam so ongot na pantogingging, pati say ongot na sanok ko; sikato la so agmo inoman naani:
Et yan ko naani ed lima na saray mamairap ed sika, a nankuan ed kamarerwam, Dakmomo ka, pian onlabas kami; et sika inpasen mo so beneg mo a singa dalin, tan singa polong, ed saray onlabas.
Liing ka, liing ka, isolong mo so biskeg mo, O Sion; isolong mo so maYakerakep a kawes mo, O Jerusalem, Santo a ciudad: ta manlapud natan ag la naani onloob ed sika so ag agalsiman tan say agmalinis.
Pokpokan mo so laman mo ed dabok: onalagey ka, onyorong ka ed tronom, O Jerusalem: okbaren mo so saray balor na tenger mo, O adakep a bii ya anak na Sion.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan, Alako kayo ya andi bili; et narondon kayo ya angapo so pilak.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Say baley ko linmasor ed Egipto nen inmuna, pian manayam diman: et say Asirio pinairap da ra ya angapo so makasengeg.

Natan sirin, anto so gawaen ko dia, kuan nen Katawan, bangta say baley ko niyarawi ya andi bili to? saray makauley ed sikara ondangol ira, kuan nen Katawan, tan say ngaran ko naynay a naayew a sanngarem.
Kanian say baley naamtaan to naani so ngaran ko: kanian naamtaan da naani ed satan ya agew a siak iman so nansalita; nia, Siak.

Agay la so kalimgasan ed tapew na saray palandey so saray sali na mangyakar na saray maong a balita, a mangibawag na deen, a mangyakar na saray maong a balita na kaabigan, a mangibawag na kilalaban, a kuan to ed Sion, Say Dios mo man-ari!
Say voces na saray manbabantay ed sika? itagey da so voces, mankanta ra a bansag; mannenengnengan ira naani ed mata tan mata, sano ompawil si Katawan ed Sion.
Onarakak kayo ed liket, mancanta kayo a bansag, sikayo a kibalatar a paspasen na Jerusalem; ta si Katawan niligliwa to so baley to, dinondon to so Jerusalem.
Si Katawan nilislisan to so taklay to a masanto ed saray mata na saray amin a nacion; tan amin a sampot na dalin nanengneng da so panangilaban na Dios tayo.

Ontainan kayo, ontainan kayo, a manlapud' man, agkayo maniwit na angan anto a bengatla ya agmalinis; ontainan kayo ed pegley to; linisan yo so laman yo, sikayo a manawir ed saray kagawaan nen Katawan.
Ta agkayo naani onpaway a maganganat, tan agkayo met naani onla a manbabtik: ta si Katawan onla naani ed onaan yo; tan say Dios na Israel sikato naani so talabay yo ed beneg yo.
Nia, say aripen ko managamil a makabkabat, nitandoro tan nipaa-tagey, tan sikato naani Sankatageyan.
Singa karakel na saray nikelawan ed sika (say ereng to sikato so apabanday a lalo nen saray anak na too),
Dia ed ontan walsikan to so saray dakel a nacion; saray ar-ari kupiten da so sangi ra ed sikato: ta say ag nibaga ed sikara nanengneng da; et say agda nadngelan natalosan da.
Siopa so anisia na inbalita mi? tan siopa so akapangipatnagan na taklay nen Katawan?

Ta sikato so binmaleg ed arap to a singa sakey a malanguer a tanaman, tan singa sakey a lamut a manlapu ed amaga a dalin: sikato angapo so nengneng to odino abig to; et no sikato so nanengneng tayo, angapo so kalimgasan to, pian panpilalekan tayo komon.

Sikato so amodmora, tan inkaindan na saray totoo; sakey a too na saray erermen, tan amta to so ermen: tan abalawbalaw a singa sakey a too a dia ed sikato Isanib da so lupa ra; tan sikato so agtayo pinabli.
Tua a sikato intepel to so saray sakit tayo tan inawit to so saray ermen tayo: angan ontan sikato so inbilang tayo ya alewet, a kinabil na Dios, tan pinairap.

Balet sikato so asugatsugat nisengeg ed saray inpakasumlang tayo, sikato so apasireg nisengeg ed saray inkauges tayo; say dusa a pakapipaknaan tayo nigaton ed sikato; et lapu ed saray inkalewet to natambal itayo.
Sikatayo ya amin abalang itayo a singa carnero; inmarap so balang sakey ed sikatayo ed dalan to lanlamang; et si Katawan ingaton to ed sikato so inkauges tayo ya amin.

Sikato so inaposan, angan sanen sikato so pinairap agto nilukasan so sangi to; singa sakey a cordero a niyarap ed panagpateyan, tan singa sakey a carnero a sikato so emel ed arap na saray mamoklis ed sikato, ontan agto nilukasan so sangi to.

Lapu ed panangapos tan panangokom sikato so nakal; et no nipaakar ed kailalakan to, siopa ed sikara so nannonot a' sikato so apegpeg ed dalin na saray mabilay nisengeg ed inpakasumlang na baley ko a sikato so kikanaan na lewet?
Et ginawa ra so lobok to a nitipon ed saray marelmeng, tan ed sakey a too a mayaman so ipatey to; anta sikato ag nangawa na duksa, tan angapo met so panamalingo ed sangi to.

Angan ontan apaliket ed Katawan so pamasireg ed sikato; sikato so inyan to ed ermen: sano gawaen mo so kamarerwa to a sakey a bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan, nanengneng to naani so bini to, padukeyen to naani so saray agew to, tan say kaliktan nen Katawan onaliguas naani ed lima to.
Nanengneng to naani so gonigon na kamarerwa to, et napenek naani; lapu ed pikakabat to ed matunong ya aripen ko patunongen to naani so saray dakel; tan sikato awiten to naani so saray inkauges da.

Kanian sikato so yapagan ko na betang ed saray baleg, tan apagen to so samsam ed mabiskeg; nisengeg ed inkalbo to so kamarerwa to anga ed patey, tan nibilang ed saray akasumlang: angan ontan inawit to so kasalanan na dakel, tan nangawa na inpangyesel a nipaakar ed saray akasumlang.
Mankanta ka, O lepes, sika ya agnananak; onarakak ka ed pancanta, tan yingal mo, sika ya agnampasakit: ta nagkalalo ni so saray anak na apaulian nen saray anak na bibii a naasawa, kuan nen Katawan.
Pabalegen mo so pasen na kobongkobong mo, tan pabuskag mo ed sikara so saray sakbong na saray panayaman mo; agka mangikera: padukeyen mo so saray lubir mo, tan pasekderen mo so saray palitek mo.
Ta ontayak ka ed nikawanan tan nikawigi; et say binim kayarianen to naani so saray nacion, et gawaen to a saray ciudad ya abagbag natooan ira naani.
Agka antakot; ta agka naani nabaingan; et agka met nagolo; ta agka naani nibabaing; ta sika nalingoanan mo naani so baing na inkaugaw mo; tan say kabalaw na inkabalom agmo la naani nanonotan.
Ta say Nangawa ed sika sikato so asawam a laki; Katawan na saray ejercito so ngaran to: et say Santo na Israel, sikato so Mananondon mo; say Dios na sankamundoan so katawag to naani.
Ta si Katawan tinawag to ka a singa sakey ya asawa a bii ya apaulian tan apaermen ed linawa, say sakey lanlamang ya asawa na inkatobonbalo, no sikato so napatainan, kuan na Dios mo.
Dia ed aganon kasanlilikna pinaolian taka, balet dia ed baleg a panangasi alaen taka naani.
Dia ed manleplepuas a sanok insanib ko so lupak ed sika ed sakey a kasanlilikna; balet dia ed ando lan ando a kaabigan na linawa, kasian taka naani, kuan nen Katawan a Mananondon mo.

Ta saya sikato so singa dia ed saray danum nen Noe ed siak; ta singa insambak a saray danum nen Noe agda la naani delapen so dalin, ontan met ya insambak ed sika ya agak naani onsanok la ed sika, tan agtaka la baaten.

Ta saray palandey makatainan ira tan saray pokdol niyalis ira; balet say maaro ya abig na linawak ag naani ontainan ed sika, tan ag met naalis so sipan ko ed pipakna, kuan nen Katawan ya walaan na panangasi ed sika.
O Sika ya apairap, a pinakesaw na bagyo, tag ag aligliwa, nia, ipasen ko so saray batom ed marakep a batebatek, tan yan ko so saray zafiro a cimientom.
Tan gawaen ko naani a panpantok mo so saray rubi, tan saray pintom a karkarbunklo, tan amin a ketegan mo a mabli a batobato.
Tan amin iray anak mo nibangat ira ed Katawan; et baleg naani deen na saray anak mo.
Dia ed inkatunongso kipasenan mo; arawi ka naani ed kapairap, ta agka la naani antakot; et say takot ag la naani onasinger ed sika.
Nia, sikara makapankakasakey ira, balet aliwa a lapu ed siak: angan siopa a mantipon ya onsumpa ed sika nipasag naani a nisengeg ed sika.
Nia, pinalsak so panday a manibok ed saray ngalab, tan pawalaen to so sakey a kagawaan a pankimey to; tan pinalsak so mangigeba a maneral.

Angapo so ayura ya agawa a sumpa ed sika ya onaligwas naani; tan balang sakey a dila ya onsumpa ed sika ed pangokom dusaen mo naani. Saya sikato so tawir na saray ariripen nen Katawan, tan say inkatunong da a manlapu ed siak, kuan nen Katawan.

O, amin a napgaan, dago kayo ed saray danum, tan say andian na pilak; dago kayo, manaliw kayo, tan mangan kayo; on, dago kayo, tan manaliw kayo na alak tan gatas ya angapo so pilak tan angapo so bayar to.
Akin ta et gastosen yo so pilak ed aliwa a tagano? tan say sagpot yo ed ag makasel? talinengen yoak a maseeseet, tan kanen yo so maong, tan panliketen yo komon so kamarerwa yo lanlamang ed inkataba.

Ikiling yo so layag yo, tan dagokayo ed siak; dengel kayo, et say kamarerwa yo manbilay naani: et mangawaak naani na ando lan ando a sipan ed sikayo, a sikato so saray ag on saew a panangasi nen David.
Nia, sikato so inter ko a nipaakar a tasi ed saray baley a pangulo tan managgangan ed saray baley.

Nia, tawagen mo naani so sakey a nacion ya agmo kabkabat; et say sakey a nacion ya agto ka ni kabkabat onbatik naani ya onla ed sika, lapu ed kinen Katawan a Dios mo, tan lapu ed Santo na Israel; ta sikato pinagayaga to ka.
Anapen yo si Katawan natan ta naromog yo ni; ontawag kayo ed sikato natan ta asinger ni:

Say marelmeng paulian to komon so dalan to, tan say too ya aliwa a maptek so saray kanonotan to; et ompawil komon ed Katawan, et sikato naani kasian to; tan ed Dios tayo, ta sikato perdonaen to naani ed daakan.
Ta saray kanonotan ko agyo kanonotan, et saray dalan yo aliwa ra met a daladalan ko, kuan nen Katawan.
Ta unong ya atagtagey so saray tawen nen say dalin, ontan ira so saray dalan ko atagtagey ira nen saray dalan yo, tan saray kanonotan ko nen saray kanonotan yo.

Ta unong a say uran tan say musiak a lurem onlasor ira a manlapu ed tawen, et ag ira ompawil diman no ag ingen salogen da so dalin, tan panbungaen da tan panbukelen da, tan pangitdan to na bini ed saray managtanaman tan tinapay ed manangan.
Ontan met naani so salitak ya ompaway ed sangik; sikato naani ag ompawil ed siak a paoypaoy, no ag ingen sumpalen to naani so kaliktan ko, tan onaliguas naani ed bengatla a pangyakaran ko ed sikato.

Ta ompaway kayo naani ya walaan na liket, tan nitonton a mareereen: saray palandey tan saray pokdol onarakak ira naani ed arapan yo a mankankanta ra; tan amin a kakiewan ed saray uma pantipaken da naani so saray lima ra.
Dia ed pasen na sabitan ontobo naani so abeto; et dia ed pasen na tala ontobo naani so arrayan: et sikato naani nipaakar ed Katawan a sakey a ngaran, sakey a tanda ya ando lan ando ya ag napegpeg.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan, Kawaloen yo so inkatunong, tan mangawa kayo na kaptekan; ta say panangilaban ko onasinger, tan say inkatunong ko a nipatnag naani.

Mapalar so too a mangawa na saya, tan say anak na too a mamenben ed sikato; a ngilinen to so agew a sabaton tan pablien to a singa sagrado, tan pegetan to so lima to a mangawa na angan anto ya mauges.

Et ag met paulian na sankaili, ya akikasakey ed Katawan, a mansalita, a kuan to, si Katawan isian toak naani ya andi teldan ed baley to; et ag met paulian a mankuan so eunuko, Nia, sakey ak a kiew ya amagaan.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan ed saray eunuko a manngilin ed saray agew ko a sabaton, tan pilien da sb saray bengatla a makapaliket ed siak, tan mangawalo ed sipan ko:

Mangiter ak naani ed sikara na abung ko tan dia ed dalem na bakor ko sakey a pakanodnotan tan sakey a ngaran a maong nen saray anak a lalaki tan anak a bibii; itdan ko ra naani na sakey a ngaran ya ando lan ando, ya ag napegpeg.

Ontan met so saray sankaili a mikasakey ed Katawan, a manlingkor ed sikato, tan mangaro ed ngaran nen Katawan, a magmaliw ira ya ariripen to, balang sakey a manngilin ed agew a sabaton ed panamabli to ed sikato a singa sagrado, tan kinawaloto so saray sipan ko;

Angan sikara yakar ko ra ed masanto a palandey ko, tan gawaen ko ra naani a malikeliket ed abung ko a panagpikasian: saray napoolan a bagbagat da tan saray bagat da naawat ira naani ed tapew na altar ko; ta say abung ko natawag naani ya abung na pikakasi a nipaakar ed saray amin a baley.
Say Katawan a Dios, sikato a manipon ed saray nitainan ed Israel, kuan to, Itipon ko ni so saray sananey ed sikato, niyarum ed kiento lanlamang ya atipon.
Amin yo ya ay-ayep ed uma dago kayo a mangakmon, on sikayo ya amin ya ay-ayep ed takel.
Saray pantalayapen to bulag ira, sikara ya amin andian ira na pikakabat; sikara ya amin aso ra ya emel; agda nayarian so ondangol; mankogkogip ira, ondokol ira lablabayen da so onugip.

On, saray aso masiba ra, angan kapigan agda nayarian so nawalaan na daakan; et saraya sikara so pastol ya ag ira makatalos; sikara ya amin sinmipa ra ed dalan da lanlamang, balang sakey pinabangan to, manlapu ed balang pasen.
Dago kayo, kuan da, onlaak naani a mangala na alak, et manpesel itayo naani ed mabayani ya inumen; et nabauas singa naani sayan agew, sakey ya agew a baleg ed labas na sukat.
Say matunong natawtaw, et angapo so too a mangyan ed sikato ed puso; et saray manangasi a totoo naekal ira, angapo so manisip a say matunong naekal a manlapu ed mauges ya onsabi.
Sikato onloob ed deen; sikara manpainawa ra ed saray dokolan da, balang sakey a manakar ed inkatunong to.
Balet onasinger kayo dia, sikayo anak a lalaki na managanito, ilalak ka mikakalogoran tan balangkantis.
Sumpa ed siopa so nanmodmoraan yo? sumpa ed siopa so pangisangian yo na sangi, tan pangidilatan yo na dila? aliwa ta a sikayo so saray anak na inpakasumlang, sakey ya ilalak na inkatila;
Sikayo a parlangan yo so saray laman yo ed pegley na saray roble, ed silong na balang malambot a kiew, a mamatey na saray ának ed saray lawak, ed lepsag na saray letak na saray bato?

Diad laet na saray malinis a batobato na lawak sikato so betang mo: sikara, sikara so kapalaran mo; ed sikara lanlamang so angibongan mo na bagat ya inumen, sika angyapay ka na sakey a panangigalang. Napipakna ak ta ed saraya a bengatla?
Dia ed tapew na atagey tan baleg a palandey inpasen mo so dokolan mo: diman met tinmatdang ka a mangyapay na bagat.

Dia ed sanib na saray pinto tan saray lusek inpasen mo so pakanodnonotan; ta sika pinmatnag ka ed sananey ya aliwa a siak, et tinmatdang ka; pinabaleg mo so dokolan mo, et akisipan ka ed sikara: sika inarom so saray dokolan da ed angan iner ya akanengnengan mo.
Sika linma ka ed ari ya intarok mo so larak, et pinarakel mo so saray balingit mo, et ingangan mo so saray ibabakim ed arawi, et pinaabebam so inkasika anga met lanlamang ed Sheol.
Sika abanalan ka ed inkarukey na dalan mo; angan ontan agmo inkuan, Sikato so maapa: sika akaromog ka na mamakasil ed biskeg mo; kanian agka apunaw.

Et siopa so atakotan mo tan inkiwalaan mo dia ed takot, pian sika mantila ka, et agmo ak ninonot odino sikato so ingaton mo ed puso? agko ta binenbenan nen saman so deen ko ed abayag a panaon, et sika agka tinmakot ed siak?
Ipaliwawak naani so inkatunong mo; et no nipaakar ed saray gawam, sikara ag ira makanabang ed sika.

Sano oningal ka, saray tinipon mo yagel da ka komon; balet say dagem alaen to ra naani, sakey a sibok itainan to ra ya amin: balet say onapireng ed siak kayarianen to naani so dalin, tan tawiren to naani so masanto a palandey ko.
Et sikato ikuan to, Tabonan yo tabonan yo, itadia yo so dalan, ekalen yo so kigapolan ed dalan na baley ko.

Ta onia so kuan na Atagey tan Baleg a manayam ed ando lan ando, a say ngaran to sikato so Santo: Manayam ak ed atagey tan masanto a pasen, pati say walaan na sakey ya espiritu a maoyamo, pian bilayen ko lamet so espiritu na maoyamo tan pian bilayen ko lamet so puso na nansibkel.
Ta agak naani misangsangan lawas, agak naani onsanok lawas; ta say espiritu napunaw komon ed arap ko, tan saray kamarerwa a ginawak.
Ta lapu ed inkauges na inkaagum to nasnokan ak; et sikato so kinabil ko; insanib ko so lupak et nanpasnok ak; et sikato tinmuloy ed kasisipa na puso to ed dalan.
Anengneng ko so saray dalan to, tan sikato naani tambalen ko: sikato naani itonton ko met, tan ipawil ko naani so saray ligliwa ed sikato tan ed saray manamaermen to.
Mamalsa ak na bunga na saray bibii: Deen, deen, ed saman so wala ed arawi tan ed saman so wala ed asinger, kuan nen Katawan; et sikato naani tambalen ko.
Balet saray marelmeng singa ra saray nagolo a dayat; ta agto nayarian so onlinak tan saray danum to mangibontok ira na pitek tan dutak.
Angapo so deen, kuan na Dios ko, ed saray marelmeng.
Oningal ka na maksil, agka rnankawanan, itagey mo so voces mo a singa sakey a tamboyog, tan ipaliwawam ed baley ko so inpakasumlang da, tan ed abung nen Jacob so saray kasalanan da.

Angan ontan sikara anapenda ak ed inagew-agew, tan manliket ira a makapikabat na saray dalan ko: singa sakey a nacion a nangawa na inkatunong, et agto inkaindan so panangoksoy na Dios da, mankerew ira ed siak na maptek a panangokom; manliket ira ya onasinger ed Dios.

Akin et nanayunal kami, kuan da, et agka onnengneng? akin et pinairap mi so kamarerwa mi, et agmo naamtaan? Nia, dia ed agew na panayunal yo naromog yo so panliketan yo, tan anapen yo so amin a kimkimey yo.
Nia, sikayo manayunal kayo a nipaakar ed pansasangsang tan pankokolkol, tan pian pangabil so punete ed sankaugsan: agkayo manayunal ed sayan agew pian dia ed ontan narengel so voces yo ed tagey.

Ontan ta so panayunal a pinilik? say agew ta nipaakar ed too a pamairap to ed kamarerwa to? Ituek to ta so olo to a singa sakey a talaib, tan ibuskag to ta so abel a magaspang tan dapodapol ed lepsag to? tawagen mo naani so saya a nanayunal, tan sakey ya agew a naawat ed kinen Katawan?

Aliwa ta a saya so panayunal a pinilik: say pamoltot ed saray taker na inkarelmeng, pian pangokbar ed saray taker na pako, et napaolian komon a nibolos so saray inaposan, tan pian poteren tayo komon so balang pako?

Aliwa ta a say paugyotob mo na tinapay mo ed narasan, tan say pangalam ed abung mo na duka a pinatainan? no nanengneng mo so lakseb, et sikato so kawesan mo; ya agmo komon yamot so inkasika a manlapu ed laman mo a dili?

Saman la ombetag so liwawam a singa dia ed kabuasan, et say katambal mo onbutay naani a masigsiglat; et say inkatunong mo onla naani ed arap mo; say gloria nen Katawan sikato naani talabay ed beneg mo.
Saman la ontawag ka, et si Katawan onebat naani; oningal ka naani, et sikato kuan to naani, Wadia ak. No sika ekalen mo ed pegley mo so pako, say pangyunat ed tamoro, tan pansalita a mareldelmeng;
Et no yibong mo so kamarerwam ed narasan, tan peselen mo so kamarerwa a pinairap: saman la onalagey so liwawam ed kabilungetan, et say inkakuyep mo singa naani dia ed pegley agew;

Et si Katawan itonton to ka naani ya andi ebas, tan peselen to naani so kamarerwam ed saray amaga a pasen, tan pakasilen to naani so saray pukel mo; et mipara ka naani ed nambabangil a tanamanan, tan singa say sobol, a saray danum to ag ira onkulang.

Et saray wala ed sika paalageyen da naani so saray daan a paspasen a nagba; paalageyen mo naani so cimiento na saray dakel a kailalakan; et natawag ka naani a Manangapiger na butaw, Manamasimbalo ed saray basbas pian panayaman.

No isipam so salim ed agew a sabaton, manlapu ed pangawa na kaliktan mo ed masanto ya agew ko; et tawagen mo so sabaton a sakey a liket, tan santo nen Katawan a galgalangen; et sikato naani igalang mo, agmo gawaen so saray dili a dalan mo, agmo anapen so saray liket mo, agmo salitaen so saray salitam a dili;
Saman la manliket ka ed kinen Katawan; et pasakayen taka naani ed saray atagey a pasen na dalin; tan taganoen taka naani ed tawir nen Jacob ya ateng mo: ta sikato so sinalita na sangi nen Katawan.
Nia, say lima nen Katawan ag apatikey, pian agto nayarian so mangilaban komon; say layag to ag met apoletan, pian agto nayarian so ondengel komon:
Balet saray inkauges yo so amasian ed sikayo tan ed Dios, tan saray kasalanan yo inyamot da so lupa to ed sikayo, dia ed ontan ya ag naani ondengel.
Ta saray lima yo adutakan ira ed dala, tan saray gamegamet yo ed inkauges; saray bibii yo nansalita ra na tila, say dila yo nantalabotob na mauges.
Angapo so manpirawat na inkatunong, tan angapo so mangyagel na katuaan manmatalek ira ed inkaapa, tan mansalita ra na saray tila; manlokon ira na mauges, tan mangiyanak ira na inkauges.
Manposnak ira na saray iknol na uleg, tan manabel ira ed saray ilol na genggeng: say mangan ed saray iknol da ompatey; et say natapilan ombetag ed ompaway so sakey ya uleg.
Saray abel da ag ira naani magmaliw a kawes, agda naani nasakbongan so saray laman da lanlamang ed saray gawa ra; saray gawa ra gawa na inkauges, et say gawa na panamasoot wala ed saray lima ra.
Saray sali ra ombatik ira ed mauges, tan manganat ira a mangibung na dala ya andi kasalanan to: saray kanonotan da sikara so kanonotan na inkauges, kabagbag tan kaderal so wala ed saray dalan da.
Say dalan na deen agda amta; et angapo so inkatunong ed saray laen da: ginawa ra a pikewet a daladalan; angan siopa ya onladman agto amta so deen.
Kanian say inkatunong arawi ed sikami, say kaptekan agto kami met naabot: anapen mi so liwawa, balet, nia so kabilungetan: say kasnagan, balet manakar kami ed kakuyepan.

Mankarkarapas kami ed dingding a singa say bulag; on, sikami mankarkarapas kami a singa saray andian na mata: sikami nigapol kami ed pegley agew a singa ed mansilunget; ed pegley na saman so masekder singa kami inatey a totoo.
Manongol kami a singa saray oso, tan mantagleey kami a singa saray malapati: anapen mi so inkatunong, balet angapo; say kilalaban, balet sikato so arawi ed sikami.
Ta saray inpakasumlang mi ondakel ira ed arap mo, tan saray kasalanan mi mantasi ra a sumpa ed sikami; ta saray inpakasumlang mi wala ed sikami, et no nipaakar ed saray inkauges mi, amta mi ra.
Kasosumlang tan panangiburi ed kinen Katawan, tan isipa ed katotombok ed Dios mi, pansalita na panamairap tan yaalagey, panlinawa tan pansalita ed puso na saray salita na inkatila.
Say inkatunong nipoliktar, et say kaptekan manalagey ed arawi; ta say katuaan nayagyag ed dalan, et say kaptekan agto nayarian so onloob.
On, say katuaan manandi; et say ompaliis ed inkauges nagawa lanlamang a sakey a dinakep. Et sikato so anengneng nen Katawan, et amasanok ed sikato, ta angapo nen saman so inkatunong.

Et anengneng to nen saman ya angapo so too, et nikelawan nen saman ta angapo so mangyesel: kanian say taklay to lanlamang so angyakar na kilalaban ed sikato; et say inkatunong to, sikato so amenben ed sikato.

Et inkawes to so inkatunong a singa sakey a kabal, tan sakey a kapacete na kilalaban ed tapew na olo to; et nankawes ed saray kawes na kababales a nipaakar ed kawes, et asakbongan ed seseg a singa sakey a kolibenben.
Unong na saray gawa ra, ontan naani panumang to, say sanok ed saray kabosol to, tumangan to naani so saray kabosol to; dia ed saray polo iter to naani so tumang.

Dia ed ontan antakot ira naani ed ngaran nen Katawan a manlapu ed sagud, et say gloria to manlapu ed letakan na banwa; ta sikato onsabi naani a singa maples ya agus, ya ingeswa na panlinawa nen Katawan.
Et sakey a Mananondon so onsabi naani ed Sion, tan ed saray ompoliktar ed susumlang ed Jacob, kuan nen Katawan.

Et say nipaakar ed siak, saya sikato so sipan ko ed sikara, kuan nen Katawan, say Espirituk a tinmapew ed sika, tan saray salitak ya inyan ko ed sangim, ag ira naani ontainan ed sangim, angan ed sangi na ilalak mo, angan ed sangi na ilalak na ilalak mo, kuan nen Katawan manlapud natan tan ando lan ando.
Onalagey ka, onsinag ka; ta say liwawam onsabi; et say gloria nen Katawan ompelnak ed sika.
Ta, nia say kabilungetan sakbongan to so dalin, tan say makapal a kabilungetan so saray balbaley; balet si Katawan onalagey naani ed tapew mo, et say gloria to nanengneng mo naani ed tapew mo.
Et saray nacion ondago ra naani ed liwawam, tan saray ar-ari ed sinag na kapepelnak mo.

Itangay mo so saray matam ed liberliber et onnengneng ka: sikara ya amin mantitipon ira, onla ra ed sika; saray anak mo a lalaki onsabi ra naani a manlapu ed arawi, et saray anak mo a bibii niyakar ira naani ed saray taklay.
Saman la nanengneng mo tan isinag mo, et say pusom omparok naani tan napabaleg, lapu ed inkadaakan na dayat ompawil naani ed sika; say kayamanan na saray nacion onla ed sika.

Say in karakel na saray camello sakbongan to ka naani, saray dromedario a taga Madian, tan taga Efa; sikara ya amin manlapu ed Saba ondago ra naani; sikara ya amin onsabi ra a mangyakar na balitok tan incienso, et ibawag da naani so saray kagalangan nen Katawan.

Saray amin a carnero na Cedar natipon ira ed sika, saray kalakian a carnero na Nabaiot onkana ra naani ed sika; ontatdang ira naani a katekep na panangonor na altar ko; et pagayagaen ko naani so abung na gayagak.
Siopa ta so saraya ya ontekyab a singa lurem, tan singa ra malapati ed saray dorongawen da?

Tua a saray polo manalagar ira naani ed siak, tan saray sakayan na Tarsis unona, a mangyakar ed saray anak mo a lalaki a manlapu ed arawi, say pilak da tan balitok da a kaolop da, nipaakar ed ngaran nen Katawan a Dios mo, tan nipaakar ed Santo na Israel, lapu ed sikato so amagayaga ed sika.
Et saray sankaili ipaalagey da naani so saray bakor mo, et saray ari ra manlingkor ira naani ed sika: ta dia ed sanok ko kinabil ta ka, balet dia ed pamalangkap ko kinasian ta ka.

Saray pintom met akalukas ira naani a naynay; ag ira naani nikaput ed agew odino labi; pian saray lalaki nayarian da komon a yakar ed sika so kayamanan na saray nacion, tan saray ar-ari ra niyakar ira a dinakep.
Ta satan a nacion tan nanarian ya ag naani manlinkor ed sika natawtaw; on, saraman a nacion nabagbag ira naani a sigpot.
Say gayaga na Libano onla naani ed sika, say abeto, say saleng, tan say alamo manbabansag, pian parakepen da so pasen na santuariok; et gawaen ko naani so pasen na saray salik a magayaga.

Et saray anak a lalaki na saray mamairap ed sika onla ra naani a mapaabeba ed sika; et amin iray mamabalaw ed sika ondakmomo ra naani ed saray dapan na saray salim; et tawagen da ka naani a Say Ciudad nen Katawan, Say Sion na Santo na Israel.
Bangta nikaindan ka tan sika so ginula nen saman, dia ed ontan ya angapo so too a dinmalan ed sika nen saman, gawaen ta ka naani a sakey a sankablian lawas, sakey a liket na saray dakel a kailalakan.

Sika met sopsopen mo naani so gatas na saray nacion, et sopsopen mo naani so saray ar-ari; et sika naamtaan mo naani a siak, si Katawan, say Manangilaban ed sika, tan Mananondon ed sika, say Makapanyari a Saksakey nen Jacob.

Lapu ed gansa mangyakar ak naani na balitok, et lapu ed balatyang mangyakar ak naani na pilak, et lapu ed kiew mangyakar ak na gansa, tan lapu ed saray bato mangyakar ak na balatyang. Et gawaen ko naani met so saray panuleyen mo a deen, tan saray manamairap mo gawaen ko ra a matunong.

Say panamasoot ag la naani narengelan ed dalin mo, say kabagbag tan kageba ag la naani narengelan ed saray ketegan mo; no ag ingen sika tawagen mo naani so saray bakor mo na Kilalaban, tan saray wangalan mo tawagen mo naani a Galang.

Say banwa angan kapigan aliwa a sikato naani la so liwawam ed agew; angan say sinag na bulan ag la naani onsinag ed sika; no ag ingen si Katawan sikato naani so andi ebas a liwawa ed sika, et say Dios mo so gloriam.
Say banwam ag la naani onselek, angan say bulan mo ag la umpaliis; ta si Katawan sikato naani so maando a liwawam, et saray agew na panbaliwan mo manganga ra naani.
Saray ombaley mo met matunong ira ya amin naani; sikara tawiren da naani so dalin ed ando lan ando, say sanga na pantanaman ko, say gawa na saray limak, pian napagayagak.
Say daiset magmaliw naani a sanlibo, et say melag magmaliw naani a mabiskeg a nacion: Siak, si Katawan, sikato naani gawaen ko a magano ed panaon to.

Say Espiritu nen Katawan a Dios wala ed siak; ta si Katawan nilanaan toak a mangipolong na saray maong a balita ed saray mauyamo inbaki toak a mamedber ed puso a maermen, a mangibawag na kawayangan ed saray dinakep, tan say kilukas na panangipangawan ed saray pinangaw;
A mangibawag na taon na pamalangkap nen Katawan, tan say agew na kababales na Dios tayo; a manligliwa ed amin a managogol;

A mangigeter ed Sion ed saray managogol, pian itdan to ra na balanget ed pasen na dapol, say larak na liket ed pasen na agogol, say kawes na galang ed pasen na espiritu na ermen; pian natawag ira komon a kiekiew na inkatunong, say tanamanan nen Katawan, pian sikato so napagayaga.

Et sikara ipaalagey da naani so saray daan ya abagbag, paalageyen da naani so saray inmuna a nagnagba, tan sikara apigden da naani so saray agaygay a ciudad, say inkabagbag na saray dakel a kailalakan.
Et saray sankaili manalagey ira naani tan pakanen da naani so saray ay-ayep yo, et saray sankaili magmaliw ira naani a panbakaen yo tan mangimaton ed kauvasan yo.

Balet sikayo ningaran kayo naani a sacerdote nen Katawan; saray totoo tawagen da kayo naani na katangbayan na Dios tayo; kanen yo naani so saray kayamanan na saray nacion, tan ed gayaga ra nitandoro kayo naani.

Dia ed pasen na kabaingan yo mamiddua so walad sikayo naani; ed pasen na kaekal na galang yo pagalangan da kayo ed saray betang da: kanian dia ed dalin da kayarianen da so mamidua; naynay a liket so wala naani ed sikara.
Ta siak, si Katawan, aroen ko so inkatunong, gulaen ko so pantakew pati inkauges; et iter ko naani ed sikara so tumang da ed katuaan, et mangawa ak naani na maando a sipan ed sikara.
Et say bini ra naamtaan naani ed pegley na saray nacion, tan say simit da ed pegley na saray balbaley: amin a makanengneng ed sikara nabidbirda ra naani, a sikara so bini a binendicionan nen Katawan.

Siak manliket ak naani balbaleg ed Katawan, say kamarerwak mangayaga naani ed Dios ko; ta sikato kinawesan toak ed saray kawes na kilalaban, sikato sinakbongan toak ed sokbong na inkatunong, a singa sakey a novio a man-along na balanget, tan singa sakey a novia a man-along ed saray kagawaan to.

Ta singa say dalin ipaway to so saray bosilak to tan singa say tanamanan patoboen to so saray bengatla a nitanem ed sikato, ontan so pamatobo na Katawan a Dios ed inkatunong tan panangigalang ed arapan na saray amin a nacion.

Lapu ed kakanaan na Sion agko naani benbenan so deen ko, tan lapu ed kakanaan na Jerusalem agak manpainawa anga ed ompaway so inkatunong a singa sinag, tan say kilaban to a singa sakey a silew a mandarlang.
Et saray nacion nanengneng da naani so inkatunong mo, tan saray amin ya ar-ari so gayagam; et sika natawag ka ed balo a ngaran, ya ingaran na sangi nen Katawan naani.
Sika met naani so sakey a balanget na kalimgasan ed lima nen Katawan, tan maari a diadema ed lima na Dios.

Angan kapigan agka la naani ningaran a say Apaulian; et ag met la ningaran so dalin mo a kibalatar: no ag ingen sika ningaran ka naani na Hephziba tan say dalin mo ningaran naani a Beulah; ta si Katawan manliket ed sika, tan say dalin mo naasawaan naani.
Ta singa say tobonbalo a laki mangasawa na sakey a virgen, ontan naani pangasawa ed sika na saray anak mo a lalaki; et singa say novio manliket ed novia, ontan naani panliket na Dios ed sika.
Siak angipasen ak na saray talayap ed tapew na saray bakor mo, O Jerusalem; sikara ag ira naani mandeen angan kapigan ed agew odino labi: sikayo a mangipanonot ed Katawan, agkayo manpainawa,
Tan agyo iter so painawa ed sikato anga ed sikato so mangiletneg, tan anga ed nagawa to so Jerusalem a sakey a galang ed dalin.

Si Katawan insamba to a lapu ed lima to a kawanan, tan lapu ed taklay na biskeg to, Tua ya agko la naani iter so trigom a kanen na saray kabosol mo; et saray sankaili angan kapigan ag la ra oninum ed balo ya alak mo, a sika kinimeyan mo nen saman:
No ag ingen saray angikamalir ed sikato, sikato naani kanen da, tan igalang da naani si Katawan; et saray anipon ed sikato, sikato naani inumen da ed saray saban na santuariok.
Onloob kayo, onloob kayo ed saray wangalan; itadia yo so dalan na baley; tabonan yo, tabonan yo so dalan; ekalen yo so saray batobato; mangipaalagey kayo na laylay a nipaakar ed saray balbaley.
Nia, si Katawan inbawag to ya anga ed sampot na dalin, Salitaen yo ed anak a bii na Sion, Nia, say kilalaban mo onsabi; nia, say upam wala ed sikato, tan say nabang mo ed arap to.
Et tawagen da ra naani a Say masanto a baley, Say dinondon nen Katawan: et sika natawag ka naani ya Aromong, Sakey a ciudad ya ag napaulian.

Siopa ya so onsabin manlapu ed Edom, ya akakawes na tinina a nanlapu ed Bosra? saya a magloria so kawes to, a manakar ed inkabaleg na biskeg to? Siak a mansalita na inkatunong, makapanyari a mangilaban.
Akin et sika ambalanga ka ed kawes mo, tan say kawes mo mipadpara ed saman so ginmatin ed pespesan na uvas?

Siak a bokor so ginmatin ed pespesan na uvas; et dia ed saray balbaley angapo nen saman so laki ya akiiba ed siak; on, igatin kora ed sanok ko, tan ingatin-gatin ko ra ed petang ko; et say dala na bilay da niwalsik ed saray kawes ko, et dinutakan ko nen saman so amin a kawes ko.
Ta say agew na pangibales wala nen saman ed pusok, et say taon na dinondon ko sinmabi la.

Et ninmengneng ak et angapo nen saman so tinmulong; et nikelawan ak ya angapo nen saman so manayakop; kanian say dili a taklay ko so angyakar na kilalaban ed siak; et say sanok ko sikato so anayakop ed siak.
Et ingatin ko ya inyabeba so saray balbaley ed sanok ko, et binuek ko ra ed petang ko, et inyibong ko so dala na bilay da ed dalin.

Siak oliten ko naani so saray maaro ya abig na linawa nen Katawan, tan saray galang nen Katawan, unong na amin ya initer nen Katawan ed sikatayo, tan say baleg a kaabigan a nipaakar ed abung na Israel, ya ginawa to unong na saray panangasi to, tan unong na daakan ya maaron ababig na linawa to.
Ta sikato inkuan to, Tua, sikara so baley ko, anak ira ya ag ira mangawa na inkatila; dia ed ontan sikato so Manangilaban da.

Dia ed amin ya irap da sikato so apairap, et say angel na arapan to inlaban to ra: dia ed aro to tan dia ed panangasi to dinondon to ra; et inawit to ra, tan inolor to ra ed saray amin ya agew nen inmuna.
Balet sinmumpa ra, tan pinaermen da so masanto ya Espiritu to; kanian sikato so nagmaliw a kabosol da, et sikato lanlamang akibakal sumpa ed sikara.

Saman la anonotan to so saray agew nen inmuna, si Moises tan say baley to a kuanto, Iner so kawalaan na saman so angitatdang ed sikara a nanlapu ed dayat pati saray pastol na ay-ayep to? iner so kawalaan na saman so angyan na masanto ya Espiritu to ed nanleleetan da?
Saman so angyakar ed magloria a taklay to ed kawanan a lima nen Moises? saman so amelsay ed saray danum ed arap da, pian gawaen to ed sikato lanlamang a sakey a ngaran ed ando lan ando?
Saman so angidalan ed sikara ed kaaralman, a singa say sakey a kabayo ed kalawakan, dia ed ontan ya ag ira nigapol?
Singa saray baka ya onlasor ed lawak, say Espiritu nen Katawan inpanpainawa to ra: dia ed ontan intonton mo so baley mo, pian gawaen mo ed sika lanlamang a magloria a ngaran.

Onosdong ka a manlapu ed tawen, tan onnengneng ka a manlapu ed panagayaman na inkasantom tan gloriam: iner so kawalaan na maseseg tan makapanyari a gawam? say kaiiliw na pusom tan saray panangasim asebelan ira ed siak.
Ta sika so Ama mi, angan si Abraham agto kami amta, tan say Israel agto kami nabidbir: sika O Katawan, sika so Ama mi; Mananondon mi a manlapu ed ando lan ando sikato so ngaran mo.
O Katawan, akin ta et ginawam a nalingo kami ed saray dalan mo, tan pinaawet mo so puso mi ed ag itakot ed sika? Pawil ka lapu ed kakanaan na saray ariripen mo, saray ilalak na tawir mo.
Say masanto a baley mo sikato so kinayarian to ed antikey a kasanlilikna: saray kabosol mi ingatin-gatin da so santuariom.
Nagmaliw kami a singa saraman so angan kapigan agmo nanuleyan, singa saraman so angan kapigan ag ira ningaranan ed ngaran mo.
O no sika pilatpilaten mo komon so saray tawen, tan onlasor ka komon, tan saray palandey ongiwgiw ira ed arap mo.
A singa no say apuy poolan to so tongo, tan say apuy mamalwag na saray danum; pian ipakabat mo so ngaran mo ed saray kabosol mo, pian amin a nacion ongiwgiw ira ed arap mo!
Sanen ginawam so saray makapataktakot a bengatla ya agmi naalagar nen saman, sika linmasor ka, saray palandey ginmiwgiw ira ed arap mo.
Ta nanlapu nen inmuna saray totoo agda nadngel, agda met nadngelan ed layag, angan say mata ag akanengneng ed sakey a Dios nilikod ed sika, a mangawa na nipaakar ed saman so manalagar ed sikato.

Sika inabet mo so manliket tan mangawa na inkatunong, saray mannonot ed sika ed saray dalan mo: nia, sika nanpasnok ka, et sikami nankasalanan kami: ed sikara wala kami nen saman ed abayag a panaon; et nilaban kami?

Ta sikami ya amin nagmaliw kami a singa sakey ya ag malinis, tan amin ya inkatunong mi sikara so singa sakey ya arutakan a kawes; et sikami ya amin nalenes kami a singa bulong; et saray inkauges mi, singa say dagem, ipalir to kami.
Et angapo so manawag na ngaran mo, a mansiglat pian ompeket ed sika; ta sika inyamot mo so lupam ed sikami, tan tinunaw mo kami ed panamegley na saray inkauges mi.
Balet natan, O Katawan, sika so Ama mi; sikami pitek kami, et sika so domadamili; et sikami ya amin so gawa no limam.
Agka manpasnok na makapasinagem a toloy, O Katawan, agmo nonoten a naynay so inkauges: nia, nengnengen mo, mantagleey kami ed sika, sikami ya amin so baley mo.
Saray masanto a ciudad mo nagmaliw ira kalawakan, say Sion nagmaliw a kalawakan, say Jerusalem nagmaliw a kibalatar.
Say masanto tan marakep ya abung mi, a saray atateng mi angigalangan da ed sika, naulam ed apuy ed saray amin a makapaliket a pasen mi abagbag ira.
Onligen ka ta nipaakar ed saraya a bengatla, O Katawan? mandeen ka ta naani, tan pairapen mo kami ta ed makapasinagem a toloy?
Siak so binalita na saray ag tinmepet a nipaakar ed siak; siak so aromog na saray agnananap ed siak: inkuan ko, Nengneng yoak, nengneng yoak ed sakey a nacion ya ag atawag ed panamegley na ngaran ko.
Inyunat ko so limak ed amin ya agew ed masugnar a baley, a manakar ed dalan ya aliwa a maong, unong ed saray kanonotan da lanlamang;
Sakey a baley a naynay a manasagyat ed siak ed lupak, a manbagat ed loob na saray tanamanan, tan manpasob na incienso ed tapew na saray lario;
Ya onyorong ira ed pegley na lobok, tan ondawes ira ed saray maamot a pasen; a kanen da so laman na babuy, tan say digo na saray macadimla a bengabengatla a wala ed saray kagawaan da;
A kuan da, Deen ka, agka onabay ed siak, ta siak masantoak nen sika. Saraya sikara so sakey ya asewek ed eleng ko, sakey ya apuy ya ondalang ed amin ya agew.
Nia, nisulat ed arap ko: agak naani ag-onesel, no ag ingen ontumangak naani, on tumangan ko naani ed akualan da,

Saray inkauges yo lanlamang, tan saray inkauges na saray atateng yo ya atiptipon, kuan nen Katawan, a nanpasob ira na incienso ed tapew na saray palandey, et inayew da ak ed pantay na saray pokdol: kanian sukaten ko naani ya ununa so gawara ed akualan da.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan, Singa say balo ya alak naromog ed mognel na bunga na uvas, et say sakey kuanto, Sikato so agyo deralen, ta sakey a bendicion so wala ed sikato: ontan so gawaen ko naani nipaakar ed saray aripen ko, pian agko ra deralen ya amin.

Et yakar ko naani so sakey a kailalakan ya ompaway ed kinen Jacob, tan ompaway ed Juda so sakey a manawir ed saray palandey ko; et say pinilik sikato so tawiren to naani, et saray aripen ko manayam irad man.
Et say Saron sikato naani sakey a panangipokokan na saray carnero, et say lawak na Akor sakey a pasen a nipaakar a dokolan na saray baka, a nipaakar ed baley ko a nananap ed siak.
Balet sikayo ya angikaindan ed kinen Katawan, ya angilingoan ed masanto a palandey ko, ya angitadia na sakey a dulang a nipaakar ed Kapalaran tan mamano ed alaokan ya alak ed Signo;

Igeter ta kayo naani ed kampilan, et sikayo ondakmomo kayo naani ed managpatey; lapu ed sanen tinmawagak, agkayo inmebat; sanen nansalita ak agyo tinalineng; no ag ingen ginawa yo ray mauges ed saray 'matak, tan pinili yo ray agko panliketan.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Nia, saray aripen ko mangan ira naani, balet sikayo naerasan kayo; nia, saray aripen ko oninum ira naani, balet sikayo napgaan kayo naani; nia, saray aripen ko manliket ira naani, balet sikayo nabaingan kayo naani;
Nia, saray aripen ko mankanta ra naani a nisengeg ed liket na puso, balet sikayo manakis kayo naani a nisengeg ed ermen na puso, tan managogol kayo naani a nisengeg ed irap na espiritu.
Et paulian yo naani so ngaran yo a nipaakar a sakey ya ayew ed pinilik; et si Katawan a Dios pateyen to ka naani; et ingaran to naani so saray aripen to ed sananey a ngaran:

Dia ed ontan a say mamendicion ed sikato lanlamang ed dalin bendiciónan to naani so laman to lanlamang ed Dios na tua; et say mansamba ed dalin mansamba naani ed Dios na tua; lapu ed saray inmuna a gonigon nalingwanan la tan lapu ed sikara onamot ira ed saray matak.
Ta, nia, mamalsa ak na saray balo a tawen tan balo a dalin; ta saray inmuna a bengatla ag ira la nanonotan, ag ira la onla ed nonot.
Balet mangayaga tan manliket kayo ed ando lan ando ed saman a palsaen ko; ta nia, palsaen ko so Jerusalem a sakey a panliketan, tan say ombaley ed sikato a sakey a liket.
Et manliket ak naani ed Jerusalem, tan gayaga naani ed baley ko; et ag la narengelan angan kapigan ed sikato so voces na nangis tan say voces na panakis.

Manlapu ed saman a panaon angapo la so sakey ya ugaw na saray agew, angan masiken a too ya ag napno ed saray agew to; ta say ugaw ompatey naani ed sanlasus a taon, et say managkasalanan angan mantaon na sanlasus naayew naani.
