Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, a Dios na Israel: Nia, dusaen ko naani so ari na Babilonia tan say dalin to, singa say inpanusak ed ari na Asiria.
Et yakar ko naani so Israel lamet ed pankabkaban to, et mankabkab naani ed Carmelo tan Basan, et say kamarerwa to napenek naani ed tapew na saray pokdol na Efraim tan ed Galaad.

Dia ed saratan ya agew tan saratan a panaon, kuan nen Katawan, say inkauges na Israel sikato naani naal mo, et angapo naani; tan saray kasalanan na Juda, et ag ira naani naromog: ta perdonaen ko naani so saray paulian ko a singa kera.

Ontatdang ka sumpa ed dalin a Merataim, a sumpa ed sikato, tan sumpa ed saray manaayam ed Pecon; pateyen tan deralen yo ra a sigpot, kuan nen Katawan, tan gawaen yo so unong na amin ya inbilin ko ed sika.
Sakey ya ongol na bakal so wala ed dalin, tan say baleg a kabagbag.
Agay la so inkaputer tan inkabuyak na babatla na amin a dalin! agay la so inpagmaliw na Babilonia a sakey a kibalatar, ed nanleleetan na saray nacion!
Inyan ko so sakey a kalot nisengeg ed sika, et naerel ka met, O Babilonia, et sikato so agmo naamtaan: naromog ka tan naerel ka met, lapu ed ginawam so sumpa ed Katawan.

Si Katawan nilukasan to so saray panagisimpenan na saray ayura to, et impaway to so saray ayura na sanok to; ta say Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, wala so sakey a kimey a gawaen to ed dalin na saray Caldeo.
Onsumpa kayo ed sikato manlapu ed kaarawiyan a ketegan: lukasan yo ray abung to a panagisimpenan; ibantak a singa saray losbo tan deralen yo a sigpoten angapo komon ed sikato so nakeraan.
Pateyen ko so amin a baka to a kalakian; paulian yo ra ya onlasor ed panagpateyan: abagey lara! ta say agew da sinmabi la, say panaon na kadalaw da.
Say voces na saray onbatik tan ontainan a manlapu ed dalin na Babilonia, pian ipaliwawa ra ed Sion so kababales nen Katawan a Dios tayo, say kababales na templo to.

Tawagen yo a tiponen iray managpana a sumpa ed Babilonia, saray amin a mangibekas na bekang; manpakalso kayo a sumpa ed sikato ed liberliber; angapo komon so makatainan; sikato so tumangan yo unong ed kimey to; unong ed amin a ginawa to, gawaen yo ed sikato, ta sikato mapangta nen saman a sumpa ed Katawan, sumpa ed Santo na Israel.
Kanian saray tobonbalo a lalaki to nipasag ira naani ed saray polong to tan saray amin a lalaki to ed bakal namemet ira naani ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan.
Nia, siak sumpaak ed sika, O sika mapangta, kuan na Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito; ta say agew mo sinmabi la, say panaon na idalaw ko ed sika.
Et say mapangta nigapol naani tan naparokol, et angapo naani ma ngipaalagey ed sikato; et selselan ko naani ray ciudad to na apuy, et si kato akmonen to naani so wala ed liberliber to.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan na sa ray ejercito: Saray anak na Israel tan saray anak na Juda napairap ira a manoolop; et amin a marakep ed sikara benbenan da ra; agda ra pau lian ya onla.

Say Mananondon da sikato so mabiskeg; Katawan na saray ejercito so ngaran to: sikato kawaloen to na ani a maong so sengegan da, pian nayarian to so mangiter na painawa ed dalin, tan mangonigon ed saray manaayam ed Babilonia.
Sakey a kampilan so wala ed tapew na saray Caldeo, kuan nen Katawan, tan ed tapew na saray ma naayam ed Babilonia, tan ed tapew na saray principe to, tan ed tapew na saray makabat to.
Sakey a kampilan so wala ed ta pew na saray manpasirayew, et mag maliw ira naani a maatiw; sakey a kampilan so wala ed tapew na saray lalaki to a makapanyari, et napunaw ira naani.

Sakey a kampilan so wala ed ta pew na saray kabayo ra, tan ed ta pew na saray luganan da, tan ed ta pew na saray amin a nilaok a balba ley ya wala ed pegley to; et mag maliw ira naani a singa bii: sakey a kampilan so wala ed tapew na saray kayamanan to, et natakew ira naani.
Sakey a tiagew so wala ed ta pew na saray danum to, et namagaan naani; ta sikato so sakey a dalin na saray talintao ya inbolik, tan man kulangkulang ira nipaakar ed saray anito.

Kanian saray maatap ya ayep ed kalawakan pati saray lobo manayam ira naanid'man, tan diman manayam naani ray avestruz: et ag naani na tooan lawas; et ag naani natooan a manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kaila lakan.
Unong na impamagbag na Dios ed Sodoma tan Gomorra tan saray ciudad a kaabay da, kuan nen Katawan, dia ed ontan angapo naani too a ma nayam diman, angapo so angan siopa ya anak na too a mibaley diman.
Nia, sakey a baley so onsabi a manlapu ed amianen; et sakey a ba leg a nacion tan dakel ya ar-ari na liing ira naani a manlapu ed kaara wian a gaton na dalin.

Manegna ra na bekang tan pana; masulit ira, tan angapo so panangasi ra; say voces da manongol a singa dayat; et onkabayo ra ed saray ka bayo, batang sakey akaparaan ed ba kal, a singa too na bakal sumpa ed sika, O anak a bii na Babilonia.
Say ari na Babilonia nadngel to so saray balita nipaakar ed sikara et saray lima to onkapuy ira; sikato so binenbenan na ermen, tan say otot a singa sakey a bii a manpasakit.

Nia, say kabosol ontatdang na ani a singa leon a manlapu ed pangta na Jordan a sumpa ed mabiskeg a panagayaman: ta pabatiken ko ra na ani a bigla a manlapu ed sikato; et siopaman a napili toroen ko naani ed tagey to: ta siopa so singa siak? tan siopa so mangigeter ed siak na sakey a panaon? tan siopa so pastol ya onalagey ed arap ko?

Kanian denglen yo so pananim bawa nen Katawan, ya inala a sumpa ed Babilonia; tan saray pegdat to a ninonot to a sumpa ed dalin na saray Caldeo: Petepeteg a guyoren da ra naani ya yarawi, salanti saray anke kelag ya ayep; petepeteg a pagma liwen to naani so panagayaman da a kibalatar ed sikara.
Ed tanol na kabagbag na Babilonia say dalin onyegyeg, tan say akis narengel ed saray nacion.
Onia so inkuan nen Katawan; Nia, ipaalagey ko naani sumpa ed Babi lonia, tan sumpa ed saray mana ayam ed Leb-kamai, so sakey a da gem a manamagbag.
Et ibakik naani ed Babilonia so saray sankaili, pian sikato so tega pan da; et palisen da naani so dalin to: ta dia ed agew na kagonigon si kara naani sumpa ed sikato ed liber liber.
Sumpa ed mangibekas say ma nagpana bekasan to komon so be kang to, tan sumpa ed manpasirayew ed kabal to: et agyo kasian iray to bonbalo a lalaki; deralen yo a sigpot so amin ya ejercito to.
Et nipasag ira naani a pinatey ed dalin na saray Caldeo, tan nagayang ed saray polong to.
Ta say Israel tan say Juda ag ikaindan na Dios da, Katawan na saray ejercito; manwari a say dalin da napno na kasalanan sumpa ed Santo na Israel.
Ibatikan yo so pegley na Babilo nia, tan ilaban na balang sakey so bilay to; agkayo komon napegpeg ed inkauges to: ta panaon la na pangi bales nen Katawan; iterto naani ed si kato so tumang.
Say Babilonia nialiling nen sa man ed sakey ya copa a balitok ed lima nen Katawan, a binuek to so amin a dalin; saray nacion ininum da so alak to, kanian saray nacion naatiwel ira.
Say Babilonia abagbag a bigla tan aderal; managogol kayo lapu ed si kato; yakar yo so balsamo a nipa akar ed sakit to, ompan sikato so natambal.

Labay mi nen saman a natambal so Babilonia, balet ta ag atambal: si kato so ikaindan yo, tan onla itayo a balang sakey ed dili a dalin to; ta say kaokom to onsabi anga ed tawen, tan nipatagey anga ni ed saray fir mamento.
Si Katawan inpatnag to so inkatu nong tayo; dago kayo, tan ipaliwawa tayo ed Sion so gawa nen Katawan a Dios tayo.

Otokan yo ray pana, benbenan yo a malmalet iray kinlong: si Katawan tinenyeg to so linawa na saray ari na saray Medo; ta say getma to sum pa ed Babilonia, pian sikato so de ralen to; ta sikato so pangibales nen Katawan, say panangibales na templo to.

Ipaalagey yo so sakey a laylay sumpa ed saray bakor na Babilonia, paletan yo ray panagbantayan, ipa sen yo ray bantay itadia yo ray pan saneban; ta si Katawan ginetma to tan ginawa to a nanpadpara so sinalita to a nipaakar ed saray nanayam ed Babilonia.
O sika a manayam ed tapew na saray dakel a danum, a daakan iray ka yamanan mo say kasumpalan mo sin mabi la, say sukat na inkaagum mo.
Si Katawan na saray ejercito nan samba ed inkasikato lanlamang, ya inkuan to, Petepeteg panoen ta ka naani ed saray lalaki, singa saray lokton; et ipatagey da naani so sakey ya eyag sumpa ed sika.
Ginawa to so dalin ed inpanga gamil to na pakapanyari to, dia ed kakabatan to inletneg to so mundo, tan dia ed pakatalos inbuskag to so saray tawen.

No ibesngaw to so voces to, wala so ongol na saray danum ed saray tawen, tan pasegepen to so saray alingasew a manlapu ed saray sam pot na dalin; gawaen to so saray kirmat a nipaakar ed uran, tan ipa way to so dagem a manlapu ed pa nangisimpenan to.
Balang too magmaliw a mureng tan angapo so amta to; balang pandaybalitok nabaingan ed talintao a ginawa to, ta say inbobo a talintao sikato' so tila, tan angapo so panlinawa ed sikara.
Sikara so kaapaan, sakey a gawa a pamalingo; dia ed horas a kadalaw da, natawtaw ira.
Say betang nen Jacob aliwa a singa saraya; ta sikato so sengegan na amin a bengatla; et say Israel sikato so kailalakan na tawir to; Katawan na saray ejercito so ngaran to.
Sika so wasay ko ed bakal tan ayurak ed bakal: et lapu ed panamegley mo buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so saray nacion; tan ed sika deralen ko naani so saray nanarian:
Tan pati, sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so kabayo tan say onkabayo:

Tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so luganan tan say onlugan; tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so laki tan bii; tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so masiken tan say ugaw; tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen sa balolaki tan marikit;

Tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so pastol tan say polok to; tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen so tomatalon tan say sankatupag a baka to; tan pati sika buyaken ko naani a pingpinglisen iray managuley tan saray diputado.
Et itumang ko naani ed Babilonia tan ed saray manaayam ed Caldea so amin ya inkauges da a ginawa ra ed Sion ed pakanengneng yo, kuan nen Katawan.

Nia, Siak sumpaak ed sika, O bantay a manamagbag, kuan nen Katawan, sika a maneral ed amin a dalin; et yunat ko naani so limak ed sika, tan ipelag ta ka naani ya itulin ed saray bato, tan gawaen ta ka naani a sakey a palandey a napoolan.
Et agda naani alaen ed sika so sakey a bato a panuyok, ni sakey a bato a nipaakar ed cimiento: no ag ingen kibalatar ka naani lawas, kuan nen Katawan.

Ipaalagey yo so laylay ed dalin, paknolen yo so tamboyog ed nanleleetan na saray nacion, itadia yo ray nacion sumpa ed sikato, tawagen yo a tiponen a sumpa ed sikato so saray nanarian na Ararat, Minni, tan Ascenez: toroen yo so sakey ya oloen a sumpa ed sikato; patatdangen yo so saray kabayo a singa say alosbo a lokton.
Itadia yo a sumpa ed sikato so saray nacion, saray ar-ari na saray Medo, saray managuley da, tan amin a diputado ra, tan amin a dalin na panuleyan da.
Et say dalin onkeyer tan manirap: ta saray kanonotan nen Katawan sumpa ed Babilonia mansiansia ra, pian pankibalataren to so dalin na Babilonia, ya angapo so manayam.

Saray makapanyari a lalaki na Babilonia pinaulian da so mibakal, sikara ontilak ira ed saray salimbeng da; say biskeg da kinmulang; nagmaliw ira a singa bibii saray pasen a panagayaman da aselselan ira na apuy; saray balewet to naputer ira.
Sakey a manangitulor na sulat so ombatik naani ya onabet ed sananey, tan sakey ya ibabaki ya onabet ed sananey, pian nipatnag ed ari na Babilonia a say ciudad to nala ed amin a kagaton:
Et saray babaliwan nala, tan saray talaib pinoolan da na apuy, et saray lalaki na bakal antakot ira.

Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, a Dios na Israel: say anak a bii na Babilonia singa sakey a taltagan ed templo a nigatingatin; magangano ni, et say panaon na panagani onsabi a nipaakar ed sikato.

Si Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia inakmon toak, pinildit toak, ginawa toak a sakey a kagawaan ya andi yan, singa sakey ya olimaw inakmon toak, pinano to so eges to na saray masamit a taganok; sikato inbantak toak.
Say duksa ya agawa ed siak tan diad laman ko wala komon ed tapew na Babilonia, ikuan naani manaayam ed Sion; tan, Say dalak wala komon ed tapew na saray manaayam ed Caldea, ikuan naani na Jerusalem.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan: Nia, kawaloen ko naani so sengegan mo, tan balesen ta ka; et pamagaen ko naani so daya'to, tan say sobol to patondaen ko naani.
Et say Babilonia magmaliw naani a loslosbo, sakey a panagayaman na saray chacal, sakey a pankelkelawan, tan sakey a pantamsikan, ya angapo so manayam.
Manongol ira naani a singa saray kilaw na leon, manengak ira naani a singa saray anak na leon.
Sano ampetang ira, gawaen ko naani so liket da, et panbueken ko ra naani, pian manliket ira ed lawas ya ugip, tan ag ira onliing, kuan nen Katawan.
Paakseben ko ra naani a singa saray cordero ed saray managpatey, singa saray carnero a kalakian pati saray kanding a kalakian.
Agay la so inkala na Sesac! tan agay la so inkapatolok na kagalang na amin a dalin! agay la so inpagmaliw na Babilonia a sakey a kibalatar ed nanleleetan na saray nacion!
Say dayat sinmegep ed tapew na Babilonia; sikato asakbongan ed karaklan na saray daloyon to.
Saray ciudad to nagmaliw lara a kibalatar, sakey ya amaga a dalin, sakey a kabueran, sakey a dalin ya ag panayaman na too, angapo met so anak na too ya onlabas ed sikato.

Et gawaen ko naani so pangokom ed Bel ed Babilonia, tan ipaway ko naani a manlapu ed sangi to so inakmon to; et saray nacion ag ira la naani onla ed sikato angan kapigan: on, say bakor na Babilonia nageba naani.
Baley ko, ompaway kayo ed pegley to, tan ilaban yo so inkasikayo a balang sakey a too manlapu ed masebeg a sanok nen Katawan.

Et ag komon onkapuy so puso yo, agkayo met antakot ed saray dengel a narengelan ed dalin, ta saray balita onsabi ra naani ed sakey a taon, et kayari satan dia ed sananey a taon onsabi naani so saray balita tan say panagduksa dia ed dalin, say makauley sumpa ed makauley.
Nia, sirin, saray agew onsabi, a gawaen ko so pangokom ed saray inbolik a talintao na Babilonia; et say amin a dalin to nagolo naani; et saray amin a napatey ed sikato nipasag ira naani ed pegley to.

Dia ed ontan saray tawen, tan say dalin tan amin ya wala ed sikara mankanta ra naani lapu ed liket a nipaakar ed Babilonia; ta saray managderal onla ra naani ed sikato a manlapu ed amianen, kuan nen Katawan.
Unong a say Babilonia inpasag to so saray pinatey ed Israel, ontan met nipasag ed Babilonia so saray napatey ed amin a dalin.
Sikayo ya akaliktar ed kampilan, onla kayo, agkayo manabala a mareereen; nonoten yo si Katawan a manlapu ed arawi, tan yabuloy yo a say Jerusalem onloob ed kanonotan yo.
Nagolo kami, ta narengel mi so kabalaw, say kagotgot sinakbongan to so saray lupa mi: ta saray sankaili linmoob ira ed saray santuario na abung nen Katawan.
Kanian, nia, saray agew onsabi, kuan nen Katawan, pian sumpalen ko so pangokom ed saray talintao to ya inbolik: et dia ed amin a dalin to mandageyem naani so saray sugatan.
Angan say Babilonia ontagey komon ed tawen, tan angan komon pabiskegen to so katagey na biskeg to, balet manlapu ed siak onsabi naani ed sikato so sakey a manderal, kuan nen Katawan.
Say tanol na sakey ya eyag a nanlapu ed Babilonia, tan say baleg ya kabagbag a nanlapu ed dalin na saray Caldeo!
Ta si Katawan pankibalataren to so Babilonia, tan bagbagen to ed sikato so baleg a voces; et saray daluyon to manongol ira a singa saray dakel a danum: say tanol na voces da nibesngaw:

Ta say manderal wala ed sikato, salanti ed Babilonia, et saray lalaki to a makapanyari naala, saray bekang da naputerputer ira; ta si Katawan sikato so Dios na pananumang, tumangan to naani ya ag onlaron.

Et panbueken ko ray principe to tan saray makabat to, saray managuley to tan saray diputados to, tan saray lalaki to a makapanyari; et onogip ira naani ed lawas ya ugip, tan ag ira naani onliing, kuan na Ari, a say ngaran to sikato so Katawan na saray ejercito.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito; Saray maawang a bakor na Babilonia nageba ra naani a sigpot, tan saray atagey ya wangalan to napoolan ira naani na apuy; et saray baley mansagpot ira naani a maapa, tan saray nacion nipaakar ed apuy: et nakesawan ira naani.

Say salita a si Jeremias a profeta inbilin to ed Saraias ya anak a laki nen Nerias, ya anak a laki nen Maasias, sanen linma ra a pati si Sedekias ya ari na Juda ed Babilonia ed komapat a taon na inpanari to. Et si Saraias so manonaan a bantaysilir nen saraan.
Et si Jeremias insulat to ed sakey a libro so amin ya inkauges ya onsabi ed Babilonia, salanti saraya ya amin a salita nisulat a nipaakar ed Babilonia.
Et si Jeremias inkuan to ed Saraias, Sano onsabi ka ed Babilonia, nengnengen mo sirin ta basaen mo so saraya ya amin a salita,

Tan kuan mo, O Katawan, nansalita ka na nipaakar ed saya a pasen, a pegpegen mo, pian angapo naani so manayam diman, totoo man odino ayep, no ag ingen kibalatar naani ed sikato so sakey a bato, tan ibantak mo lawas.
Et sikato naani, sano nayarim a basaen yan libro, isinger mo naani ed sikato so sakey a bato, tan ibantak mo ed pegley na Eufrates:
Et kuan mo naani, Onia so ilereg na Babilonia et ag la naani onbangon lamet lapu ed mauges ya yakar ko naani ed sikato; et nakesawan ira naani. Anga dia so saray salita nen Jeremias.

Mantaon si Sedekias nen saman na duamplo tan sakey sanen ginmapu a man-ari: et sikatoy nanari ed labinsakey taon; ed Jerusalem; et say ngaran na ina to sikato so Amital ya anak a bii nen Jeremias a taga Lebna.
Et ginawa to so mauges ed pakanengneng nen Katawan, unong na amin a ginawa nen saman nen Joacim.
Ta lapu ed sanok nen Katawan agawa dia ed Jerusalem tan Juda, anga ed inbantak to ra a manlapu ed arap to. Et si Sedekias inmalagey a sumpa ed ari na Babilonia.

Et agawa sanen komasiam a taon ed inpan-ari to, ed komaplo a bulan, ed komaplo ya agew na bulan, a si Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia, sikato tan amin ya ejercito to, sinmabi ra a sumpa ed Jerusalem, tan nanpakalso ra a sumpa ed sikato, tan angipaalagey ira na saray salimbeng a sumpa ed sikato ed liberliber.
Dia ed ontan say ciudad akobkob anga ed komalabinsakey a taon nen ari Sedekias.
Dia ed komapat a bulan, ed komasiam ya agew na bulan, say eras pinmalalo ed ciudad, tan angapo nen saman so tinapay a nipaakar ed saray ombaley ed dalin.

Saman la agawa so sakey a butaw ed ciudad, et amin a lalaki na bakal tinmainan ira, tan pinmaway ira ed ciudad ed labi ed dalan na wangalan ed nanleetan na duaran bakor, ya wala nen saman ed abay na tanamanan na ari (bang saray Caldeo wala ra nen saman a sumpa ed ciudad ed liberliber); et linma ra ed dapit Arabah.
Balet saray ejercito na saray Caldeo inosilan da so ari, et nabotan da si Sedekias ed saray talogtog na Jerico; et say amin ya ejercito to abuybuyak ira a nanlapu ed sikato.
Dia ed ontan inala ra so ari tan sikato so inyakar da ed ari na Babilonia anga ed Ribla ed dalin ya Emat; et sikato so angokom ed sikato.
Et say ari na Babilonia pinatey to ray anak a lalaki nen Sedekias ed arap na saray mata to: pinatey to met so saray amin a principe na Juda ed Ribla.
Et sinukit to ray mata nen Sedekias; et sikato so binalor na ari ed Babilonia ed saray golonggolong tan intarok to ed Babilonia, tan sikato so inyan to ed panangipangawan anga ed agew na inpatey to.

Et dia ed komalima a bulan ed komaplo ya agew na bulan, a sikato so komalabinsiam a taon nen ari Nabucodonosor, ya ari na Babilonia, linmoob ed Jerusalem si Nabuzardan ya oloen na bantay, a sikato so inmalagey ed arap na ari ed Babilonia.
Et pinoolan to so abung nen Katawan tan say abung na ari; tan saray amin ya abung ed Jerusalem, angan saray ankakabaleg ya abung pinoolan to na apuy.
Et saray amin ya ejercito na saray Caldeo ya wala nen saman ed oloen na bantay ingeba ra so saray amin a bakor na Jerusalem ed liberliber.
Samanla inyakar nen Nabuzardan a dinakep so saray kadukaan, tan say kera ed saray totoo ya atilak ed ciudad, tan saraman so sinmian, a pinmelag ira ed ari na Babilonia, tan say kera ed karaklan.
Balet intilak nen Nabuzardan so saray sankarukaan ed dalin pian mangimaton ira ed saray uvasan tan sikara so tomatalon.

Et saray seklang a gansa ya wala nen saman ed abung nen Katawan, tan saray ansagan tan say dayat a gansa ya wala nen saman ed abung nen Katawan, binuyak na saray Caldeo a pinisag, tan inyakar da ray amin a gansa ra ed Babilonia.
Saray banga met tan saray sariok, tan saray panagdelsangan tan saray banga, tan saray balaok, tan amin a kagawaan da a gansa a pankatangbayan da nen saman, inala ra.

Et saray ongot, tan saray pananginan na apuy, tan saray kalamba, tan saray banga, tan saray panangiturekan na candela, tan saray balaok, tan saray yaong-saraman so balitok, ed balitok tan saraman so pilak, ed pilak-saman so oloen na bantay inyakar to ra.

Saray duaran seklang, say sakey a dayat, tan saray labindua a kinonbaka a kalakian ya wala nen saman ed silong na gagatinan, a si ari Salomon ginawa to nen saman nipaakar ed abung nen Katawan, saray gansa na saraya ya amin a kagawaan ag asimbang nen saman.

Et nipaakar ed saray seklang, say katagey na sakey a seklang sikato nen saman so labinwalo a kasiko; tan sakey a lubir a labindua a kasiko so niliber ed sikato; et say kakapal to apatira a tamoro: sikato nen saman so longogan.

Et sakey a palatok a gansa so wala nen saman ed toktok to; et say kaatagey na sakey a palatok sikato nen saman so limaran kasiko, pati saray iket tan saray granada ed palatok ed liberliber, gansa ya amin: et say komadua a seklang walaan met na singa saraya, tan say granada.
Et wala nen saman so siamaplo tan anem a granada ed saray diking; amin iray granada sikara nen saman so sanlasus ed iket a niliber.
Et say oloen na bantay inala to si Saraias a kaatageyan a sacerdote, tan si Sofonias a komadua a sacerdote, tan talora a bantay-sasabien:

Tan diad ciudad angala na sakey a makauley a manonaan nen saman na saray lalaki na bakal; tan pitora a lalaki ed saraman so akanengneng na lupa na ari, ya aromog nen saman ed ciudad; tan say escriba na capitan na ejercito, a mantitipon nen saman na saray totoo ed dalin; tan anemaplo a lalaki ed totoo ed dalin, a sikara so aromog nen saman ed pegley na ciudad.
Et si Nabuzardan ya oloen na bantay inala to ra, tan inyakar to ra ed ari na Babilonia ed Ribla.
Et say ari na Babilonia kinabil to ra, tan pinatey to ra ed Ribla ed dalin na Emat. Onia so inkiakar na Juda ya adakep a nanlapu ed dalin to.
Saraya sikara so totoo a si Nabucodonosor inyakar to nen saman a dinakep: ed komapito a taon talonlibo talonlasus tan duamplo a Judio.
Ed komolabinwalo a taon nen Nabucodonosor inyakar to a dinakep a nanlapu ed Jerusalem so walonlasus talomplo tan dua a totoo;

Ed komaduamplo tan talo a taon nen Nabucodonosor, si Nabuzardan ya oloen na bantay inyakar to a dinakep ed saray Judio so pitonlasus apataplo tan lima a totoo; amin iray totoo apat a libo tan anem a lasus ira nen saman.

Et agawa nen saman ed komatalomplo tan pito a taon na inkadakep nen Joachin ya ari na Juda, sanen bulan a komalabindua, ed komaduamplo tan pito ya agew na bulan, a si Evil-merodac ya ari na Babilonia, sanen inmuna a taon na inpanari to, intagey to so olo nen Joachin ya ari na Juda, tan inpaway to ed panangipangawan.
Et nansalita a makaan-anlay ed sikato, tan inpasen to so yorongan to ed tagey na saray yorongan na ar-ari ya wala nen saman ya iba to ed Babilonia,
Tan sinaltan to ray kawes to a balor. Et si Joachin angan a naynay ed arap to ed saray amin ya agew na bilay to:

Et nipaakar ed tagano to, wala nen saman so naynay a tagano a niiter ed sikato a nanlapu ed ari, ed Babilonia ed balang agew sakey ya apag, anga ed agew na inpatey to, ed saray amin ya agew na inpanbilay to.

Agay la so panbokbokor na sakey a baley a napno nen saman ed saray totoo! Sikato so nagmaliw a singa sakey a balo, samay baleg nen saman ed saray nacion! Sikato a sakey nen saman a princesa ed saray luyag nagmaliw a pauleyan!

Mapalalo a nangis to ed labi et saray lua to managos ed saray aping to; Ed saray amin a manangaro to angapo so manligliwa ed sikato; amin iray kaaro to nanagamil ira a liputan ed sikato; nagmaliw ira a kabosol to.

Say Juda linma ed inkadakep nisengeg ed kairapan, tan nisengeg ed baleg a panaglingkor; Sikato so miayam ed saray nacion, angapo so naromog to a painawa: Amin iray mangoosil ed sikato nabot da ed saray mainget a dalan.

Saray dalan na Sion manermen ira, lapu ed angapo so onla ed saray tipon da a mabinta; Amin iray wangalan to abagbag ira, saray sacerdote mansibek ira: Saray virgen to napairap ira, tan sikato lanlamang wala ed kapaitan.

Saray kasumlang to nagmaliw ira ya olo, saray kabosol to maaligwas ira; Ta si Katawan sikato so pinairap to lapu ed karaklan na saray inpakalokso to: Saray ugugaw ya anak to niyakar ira ed inkadakep ed arap na kabosol.

Et nanlapu ed anak a bii na Sion amin a kaatageyan to tinmainan: Saray principe to nagmaliw ira ya ulsa a kalakian ya angapo so naromog da a pankabkaban da, Et linma ra ya angapo so kasilda ed arap na saray mango-osil ed sikara.

Say Jerusalem nanonotan to ed saray agew na kairapan tan panermen to so saray amin a makapaliket a kayarian to ya wala a nanlapu nen inmuna: Sanen saray totoo to naplag ira ed lima na kabosol, et angapo so tinmulong ed sikato, Saray kasumlang anengnengda, tan niludlurey da ray inkabagbag to.
Say Jerusalem nankasalanan na makapaermen a toloy; kanian nagmaliw a marutak a bengatla; Amin iray angigalang ed sikato so modmoraen da, ta anengneng da so inkalakseb to: On, mansibek, tan ombeneg.

Say inkadutak to wala nen saman ed saray sapey to; sikato agto ninonot so kaonoran a kasumpalan to; dia ed ontan linmasor a makapakelaw, angapo so manligliwa ed sikato: Nia, O Katawan, so irap ko; ta say kabosol pinabaleg to so inkasikato lanlamang.
Say kabosol inunat to so lima to ed saray amin a makapaliket a kayarian to: ta anengneng to a saray nacion linmoob ira ed santuario to, nipaakar ed saray angiganganan mo ya ag ira onloob ed tipon mo.

Amin iray totoo to mansibek ira, mananap ira na tinapay; initer da so saray makapaliket a kayarian da ya insalat ed tagano a mamakasil ná kamarerwa: Nengnengen mo, O Katawan, et nia, ta siak nagmaliwak ya abeba.

Angapo ta a mogmo ed sikayo, sikayo ya amin ya onlabas? Nia, et nengnengen yo no wala so angan anto ya ermen a mipara ed ermen ko, a sinmabi ed siak, a sikato so inpanusa nen Katawan ed siak sanen agew na masebeg a sanok to.

Nanlapu ed tagey angipawit na apuy ed dalem na saray pokel ko, et sikato tinmalona a sumpa ed sikara; sikato angibuskag na sakey ya iket a nipaakar ed saray salik, sikato pinabeneg toak: sikato ginawa toak a kibaiatar tan makapkapuy a sanagew.

Say pako na saray inpakaloksok abedberan lapu ed lima to; sikara so asoldong, onsegep ira ed tenger ko; ginawa to so biskeg ko ya onkapuy: say Katawan inyawat toak ed saray lima ra, a sumpa ed sikara agak makayari ya onalagey.

Say Katawan pinaandi to so saray amin a makapanyari a lalakik ed pegley ko; sikato anawag na sakey a mabinta a tipon a sumpa ed siak pian mesmesen da so saray tobonbalo a lalakik: say Katawan ingatin to so anak a virgen na Juda a singa say panpespesan na uvas.

Lapu ed saraya a bengatla mannangis ak; say matak, say matak ontoro na danum; lapud' say managligliwa a mamainawa komon ed kamarerwak sikato so arawi ed siak: saray anak apalis ira, nisengeg ed say kabosol tinmalona.

Say Sion yunat to so saray lima to; angapo so manligliwa ed sikato; si Katawan ingangan to so nipaakar ed Jacob, a saray wala ed liberliber to sikara so kabosol to: say Jerusalem wala ed nanleleetan-da a singa ag malinis a bengatla.

Si Katawan sikato so matunong; ta siak tinmunganga ak a sumpa ed gangan to: denglen yo, pikasik ed sikayo, sikayo ya amin a totoo, tan nengnengen yo so ermen ko: saray marikit ko tan saray balolakik nadakep ira.
Tinmawag ak ed saray manangarok, balet pinalingo ra ak; saray sacerdotek tan saray mamasiken ko inyawat da so espiritu ed ciudad, leleg a nananap ira na kanen a pamakasil ed saray kamarerwa ra.

Nengnengen mo, O Katawan; ta siak wala ak ed kaermenan; say pusok agonigon: say pusok nabaliktar ed dalem ko; ta tinmunganga ak ya ambelabelat: Ed paway say kampilan mandenden, ed loob wala a singa patey.

Nadngel da a mansibek ak; angapo so manligliwa ed siak; saray amin a kabosol ko nadngelda so gonigon ko; mangayaga ra ta sikato so ginawam: Sika pasabien mo so agew ya inbawag mo, et sikara so singa siak.

Amin komon ya inkauges da niyarap ira ed sika; Et gawaen mo ed sikara, so singa ginawam ed siak nipaakar ed saray amin ya inpakaloksok: Ta saray paneyey ko sikara so dakel, tan say pusok sikato so napunaw.

Agay la so inpanakbong na Katawan ed anak a bii na Sion ed sakey a lurem na sanok to! Inpelag to a nanlapu ed tawen anga ed dalin so kalimgasan na Israel, tan agto anonotan so pangigatonan to na sali to ed agew na sanok to.

Say Katawan inakmon to ya amin iray panagayaman nen Jacob, tan ag angasi; Ingeba to ed sanok to so saray salimbeng na anak a bii na Juda; Pinaabeba to ra ed dalin; tinaldengan to so nanarian tan saray principe to.

Pinuter to ed masebeg a sanok so amin a saklor na Israel; Inpikos to so kawanan a lima to a manlapu ed arap na kabosol: et pinoolan to si Jacob a singa mandarlang ya apuy, a sikato so mangakmon ed liberliber.

Pinilok to so bekang to a singa sakey a kabosol, inmalagey ed nikawanan a lima to a singa sakey a kasumpa, et pinatey to ray amin a makapaliket ed mata; dia ed kobongkobong na anak a bii na Sion inyibong to so sanok to a singa apuy.

Say Katawan nagmaliw a singa sakey a kabosol, sikato inakmon to so Israel; inakmon to so saray amin a palacio to, ingeba to ray salimbeng to; et pinarakel to ed anak a bii na Juda so agogol tan tagleey.

Et inala to a pinasoot so tabernaculo to, a singa nen saman ed sakey a panagtanamanan; binagbag to a pantitiponan; si Katawan ginawa to so pamaliket ed tipon tan sabaton a nalingoanan ed Sion, tan minodmora to ed insebeg na sanok to so ari tan sacerdote.

Si Katawan inbantak to so altar to, ginula to so santuario to; initer to ed lima na kabosol so saray bakor na saray palacio to: nangawa ra na tanol ed abung nen Katawan, singa dia ed agew na mareereen a tipon.

Si Katawan ginetma to a bagbagen so bakor na anak a bii na Sion; inyunat to so lubir, agto pinikos so lima to a manlapu ed panamagbag: et inpantagleey to so salimbeng tan bakor; binmeleng ira a bansag.

Saray wangalan to linmereg ira ed dalin; binagbag to tan pinuter to so saray balewet to: say ari to tan saray principe to wala ra ed nanleleetan na saray nacion a sikato so andian na tunong; On, saray profeta to ag ira akaromog na pasingawey a manlapu ed Katawan.

Saray kamasikenan na anak a bii na Sion manyorong ira ed dalin, sikara ag ira oneseesel. Angyan ira na dabok ed tapew na saray olo ra; nanbalkes ira na magaspang ya abel: saray virgen na Jerusalem ituek da so saray olo ra ed dalin.

Saray matak onkapuy ira lapu ed saray lua, say pusok nagonigon; say altey ko nikalbo ed tapew na dalin, lapu ed inkabagbag na anak a bii na baley ko, tan saray ugugaw ya anak tan saray mansoso naalimureng ira ed saray polong na ciudad.
Kuan da ed saray ina ra, iner so kawalaan na bukel tan alak? Sano naalimureng ira a singa saray sugatan ed saray polong na ciudad, Sano say kamarerwa ra naibung ed akualan na saray ina ra.

Anto so tasian ko naani ed sika? anto so pangiparaan ko naani ed sika, O anak a bii na Jerusalem? Anto so pangialilingan ko naani ed sika, pian naligliwa ta ka, O anak na virgen na Sion? Ta say deral mo baleg a singa dayat: Siopa so makatambal ed sika?

Saray profetam akanengneng ira ed sika na saray tila tan maatiw a paspasingawey; Et agda nilukasan so inkauges mo, pian nipawil so inkadakep mo, Balet akanengneng ira ed sika na saray tila a paries tan sengesengeg na kapalis.

Amin ya onlabas pantipaken da so lima ra ed sika; Manngisiw ira tan ipeyeng da so olo ra ed anak a bii na Jerusalem, a kuan da, Saa sikato so ciudad ya inngaran na totoo, Say ayadyari a kalimgasan, Say liket na amin a dalin?

Saray amin a kabusol mo nilukasan da so sangi ra a maawang sumpa ed sika: Manngisiw ira tan ngayeten da so saray ngipen; kuan da, Sikato so inakmon mi; Petepeteg saya so agew ya inanap mi; aromog mi, sikato so anengneng mi.

Si Katawan ginawa to so ginetma to; sikato sinumpal to so salita to ya ingangan to ed saray inmuna ya agew; Inpelag to, tan ag angasi: Et ginawa to ya inpanliket so kabosol ed sika; intandoro to so saklor na saray kasumlang mo.

Saray puso ra inmakis ed Katawan: O bakor na anak a bii na Sion, yabuloy mo a saray lua onsaklayat a singa sakey ya ilog ed agew tan labi; Agmo itdan so inkasika na panlinawa; agmo patondaen so ugawugaw na matam.

Onalagey ka, onakis ka ed labi, ed gapu na saray panpuyat; Yibung mo so pusom a singa danum ed arap na lupa na Katawan: Itagey mo ray limam ed sikato lapu ed bilay na saray anak mo ya ugugaw a manalimureng ed eras ed oloan na balang polong.

Nengnengen mo, O Katawan, tan imatonan mo so nangawaan mo na saya: Saray bibii kanen da ta naani so bunga ra, saray ugugaw a nibaybayes ed saray lima? Say sacerdote tan say profeta napatey ira ta naani ed santuario na Katawan?
Say ugaw tan say masiken ondokol ira ed dalin ed saray polong; Saray virgen ko tan saray balolakik nipasag ira ed kampilan: Pinatey mo ra ed agew na sanok mo; pinotolan mo ra, tan agka angasi.

Tinawag mo, a singa dia ed agew na mabinta a tipon, so saray kakebiewan ko ed amin a diking; Et angapo so akatainan ni atilak dia ed agew na sanok nen Katawan; Saraman so inbayesbayes ko tan pinabaleg ko inopot na saray kabosol ko.
Siak so too ya akanengneng na kairapan ed panamegley na tayokor na sanok to.
Intonton toak tan inpanakar toak ed kabilungetan, tan aliwan dia ed liwawa.
Petepeteg a sumpa ed siak yarap to so lima to ya olioli ed inagewagew.
Say laman ko tan say baog ko pinamasiken to; pinuterputer to ray pukel ko.
Pinaalagey to so sumpa ed siak, tan liniktob toak na apgo tan panpasakit.
Inpanayam toak ed saray ambilunget a pasen, singa saraman so abayag la ya inatey.
Binakor toak ed liberliber, ya agko nayarian so ompaway; pinabelat to so golonggolong ko.
On, sano onakis ak, tan ontawag ak na tulong, kaputan to so pikakasik.
Binakor to ray dalan ko ed pinanday a bato; ginawa to ray basbas ko a pikewet.
Sikato ed siak so singa sakey ya oso a mantalaran, singa sakey a leon ed saray maamot a pasen.
Pinasipa to ray dalan ko, tan biningbingkas toak; ginawa toak a kibalatar.
Piniklo to so bekang to, tan inpasen toak a singa tanda a nipaakar ed pana.
Pinaloob to ed saray loobloob ko so saray pana ed poton ko.
Nagmaliw ak a balaw ed saray amin a baley ko, tan tagaumen da ed agewagew.
Pinano to ak ed kapaitan, pinenek to ak na ajenjo.
Pinuter to met iray ngipen ko ed saray dalakirik a bato; sinakbongan toak na saray dapol.
Tan inyarawim so kamarerwak a nanlapu ed deen; alingoanan ko so kaaligwasan.
Et inkuan ko, Say biskeg ko abalang, tan say ilalok ed kinen Katawan.
Nonoten mo so kairapan ko tan say segsegang ko, say ajenjo tan say apgo.
Say kamarerwak wala ra ni ed pakanodnonotan to, tan sikato so nanpaabeba ed loob ko.
Saya so nanonotan ko ed isip ko; kanian wala so ilalok.
Sikato so abig na linawa nen Katawan yá ag itayo naopot, ta saray panangasi to ag onkuiang.
Sikara so balo a kinabuasan; baleg so katooran mo.
Si Katawan so apag ko, kuan na kamarerwak; kanian manilalo ak ed sikato.
Si Katawan maong ed saray manalagar ed sikato, ed kamarerwa a mananap ed sikato.
Maong a say too manilalo tan mareereen komon a manalagar ed panangilaban nen Katawan.
Maong a nipaakar ed too ya awiten to so pako ed kaugawan to.
Onyorong komon a bokbokor tan agoneseesel, lapu ed sikato so ingaton to ed tapew to.
Isobsob to komon so sangi to ed dabok. pian diaed ontan wala so ilalo.
Paulian to komon so aping to ed mangabil ed sikato; sikato komon so napano na kabalawan.
Ta say Katawan ag mangiwaklit a naynay.
Ta angan amaermen, balet sikato walaan na panangasi unong ed karakel na maaro ya abig na linawa to.
Ta sikato ag mamairap a malikeliket, ag met mamaermen ed saray anak na totoo.
Say pangilik ed lepsag na sali ed saray pinangaw na dalin,
Say pangipaliis ed katunongan na too ed arap na lupa na Sankatageyan,
Say pamikewet ed sakey a too ed kanonotan to, say Katawan agto abobonan.
Siopa so mangikuan, tan sikato so nagawa, sano say Katawan sikato so agto igangan?
Ed sangi na Sankatageyan ag ompaway ta so mauges tan maong?
Akin ta et sakey a too a mabilay maningel, sakey a too lapu ed panusa ed saray kasalanan to?
Laen tayo komon ya osisaen tan salien so saray dalan tayo, tan ompawil itayo lamet ed Katawan.
Itangay tayo komon so puso tayo pati saray lima tayo ed Dios ed saray tawen.
Sikatayo linmokso itayo tan tinmunganga itayo; sika agka amerdona.
Sinakbongan mo so inkasika ed sanok tan inosilan mo kami; nanpatey ka, agka angasi.
Sinakbongan mo so inkasika ed sakey a lurem, pian angapo so makalabas a pikakasi.
Sika ginawa mo kami a sakey a nibantak tan dutak ed nanleleetan na saray baley.
Saray amin a kabosol mi insangira a maong so sangi ra a sumpa ed sikami.
Takot tan kalinsorong so onsabi ed sikami, kibalatar tan kabagbag.
Dia ed matak managos so danum lapu ed inkabagbag na anak a bii na baley ko.
Say matak mantoro, tan ag ontonda, angapo so angan anto ya itonda to.
Anga ed si Katawan onosdong, tan onnengneng a manlapu ed tawen.
Say matak lanuren to so kamarerwak lapu ed saray amin ya anak a bii na ciudad ko.
Inanupandaak a mapalalo a singa sakey a manok ed tagey, sikara a kabosol ko ya andi makasengeg.
Insian da so bilay ko ed ambilunget a panangipokokan tan intupak da so sakey a bato ed tapew ko.
Saray danum inmagos ira ed tapew na olok; inkuan ko, Asiyanak la.
Siak tinawag ko so ngaran mo, O Katawan, ed paway na kalepsagan a panangipokokan.
Dinengel mo so voces ko; agmo yamot so layag mo ed panlinawak, ed akis ko.
Inmasinger ka ed agew ya intawag ko ed sika; sika inkuan mo, Agka antakot.
O Katawan, insangsang mo ray sengegan na kamarerwak; dinondon mo so bilay ko.
O Katawan, anengneng mo so inkipaonong ko; okomen mo so sengegan ko.
Anengneng mo ray amin a pamales da tan saray kanonotan da a sumpa ed siak.
Nadngel mo so pamabaing da, O Katawan, tan saray amin a kasiliban da, a sumpa ed siak.
Saray bibil na saray inmalagey a sumpa ed siak, tan say kasiliban da a sumpa ed siak ed amin ya agew.
Nengnengen mo so kayoyorong da, tan say kakaalagey da; siak so tagaumen da.
Iter mo naani ed sikara so sakey a tumang, O Katawan, unong ed gawa na saray lima ra.
Itdan mo ra naani na kaawetan na puso, say ayew mo ed sikara.
Osilan mo ra naani ed sanok, tan bagbagen mo ra naani a manlapu ed lepsag na saray tawen nen Katawan.
Agay la so inudiem na balitok! agay la so inkauman na masuri a balitok! Saray bato na santuario nibantak ira ed oloan na balang polong.
Saray mabli ya anak na Sion, nipadpara ed masuri a balitok, Agay la so inkana ra a singa gorgorita a damili, say gawa na saray lima na domadamili!
Angan saray chakal ni ipaway da so pagew da, pasusoen da so saray anak da: Say anak a bii na baley ko nagmaliw a masulit, a singa saray avestruz ed kalawakan.
Say dila na mansoso ya ugaw ompeket ed tawentawen to lapu ed pega: Saray anak ya ugugaw onkerew ira na tinapay, et angapo so too ya amisag na tinapay ed sikara.
Saray nantagano na masamisamit wala ra a kibalatar ed saray polong: Saray binmaleg ed escarlata sayakopen da so saray panagdutakan.
Ta say inkauges na anak a bii na baley ko balbaleg nen say kasalanan na Sodoma, Ya atibakiar ed kasanlilikna, tan angapo ray lima a nigaton ed sikato.
Saray angkabli to malinlinis ira nen saman nen say nieve, sikara so amputi nen gatas; Sikara ambalanga ra nen saman ed laman nen saray rubi, say sileng da singa zafiro.
Say ereng da andeket nen say sakey ya uring; ag ira nabidbir ed saray polong: Say baog da ompeket ed saray pokel da; sikara so amagaan, magmaliw a singa sakey a bislak.
Saray pinatey ed kampilan magmaong ira nen saray pinatey ed eras; Ta saraya onkapuy ira, atalos ira ed inkaokolan da na saray bunga na uma.
Saray lima na saray pangaskasian a bibii inlambong da ray anak da lanlamang; Sikara nen saman so tagano ra ed inkabagbag na anak a bii na baley ko.
Si Katawan sinumpal to so sanok to, inibung to so makapataktakot a sanok to; Tan sikato amarlang na sakey ya apuy ed Sion, a sikato so angakmon ed saray cimiento to.
Saray ar-ari ed dalin ag ira anisia, tan angan saray amin a manaayam ed firmamento, a say kasumpa tan kabosol onloob ira ed saray wangalan na Jerusalem.
Lapud saray kasalanan na saray profeta to, tan saray inkauges na saray sacerdote to. Ya angibung na dala na matunung dia ed pegley to.
Sikara manteyengteyeng ira a singa saray bulag ed saray polong, adutakan ira na dala, Dia ed ontan a saray totoo agda nadiwit so saray kawes da.

Ontainan kayo, inyakis da ed sikara, Marutak! ontainan kayo, ontainan kayo, agyo diwiten! Sanen tinmainan ira tan nanteyengteyeng ira, saray totoo inkuan da ed saray nacion, Sikara ag ira manayam la naani dia.
Say sanok nen Katawan binuybuyak to ra; agto ra naani imatonan la: Agda ingalang so saray inkatoo na saray sacerdote, agda pinalaboan so saray kamasikenan.
Saray mata mi onkapuy ira ni ed kanengneng ed maapa a tulong mi: Dia ed panaalagar mi akaalagarkami na sakey a nacion ya ag makapangilaban.
Anapen da ray kurang mi, dia ed ontan agkami makakar ed saray polong: Say angaan mi asinger, saray agew mi nasumpal; ta say angaan mi onsabi la.
Saray mangoosil ed sikami masiglat ira nen saray agila ed firmamento: inusilan da kami ed tapew na saray palandey, nansaneb ira a nipaakar ed sikami ed kalawakan.
Say panlinawa na saray abut na eleng mi, say nilanaan nen Katawan, nala ed saray patit da; sikato a nankuanan mi, Ed lepsag na sirum to manbilay kami naani ed nanleleetan na saray nacion.
Manliket tan mangayaga ka, O anak a bii na Edom a manayam ed dalin na Uz: say copa onlabas naani met ed sika; nabuek ka naani, tan gawaen mo naani so inkasika a lakseb.
Say dusa na inkauges mo nasumpal, O anak a bii na Sion; agto ka la naani yakar ed kadakep: dalawen to naani inkauges mo, O anak a bii na Edom; lukasan to naani so saray kasalanan mo.
Nonoten mo, O Katawan, no anto so onsabi ed sikami: Nia, et nengnengen mo so kibabaingan mi.
Say tawir mi niyawat ed saray sankaili, saray abung mi ed saray akidawes.
Sikami ulila kami tan angapo so ama mi; saray ina mi singa ra balo.
Ininum mi so danum mi lapu ed pilak; say kiew mi nilako ed sikami.
Saray mangosil ed sikami wala ra ed saray tenger mi: naksawan kami, et angapo so painawa mi.
Akilakap kami ed saray Egipcio, tan saray Asirio, pian napesel kami ed tinapay.
Saray ama mi nankasalanan ira, et andi lara; et inawit mi so saray inkauges da.
Saray aripen panuleyan da kami: angapo so angan siopa a mangilaban ed sikami ed lima ra.
Gamoran mi so tinapay mi ed kaatapan na bilay mi, nisengeg ed kampilan ed kalawakan.
Say baog mi andeket a singa sakey ya hornó, nisengeg ed mandarlang a petang na eras.
Pinasoot da so saray bibii ed Sion, saray virgen ed saray ciudad na Juda.
Saray principe inbitin da ra ed lima ra: Saray lupa na saray kamasikenan ag ira pagalangan.
Saray tobonbalo a lalaki sakbaten da so gilingan; et saray ugugaw nigapol ira ed silong na kiew.
Saray kamasikenan tinmonda ra a manlapu ed wangalan, saray tobonbalo a lalaki ed panagtogtog da.
Say liket na puso mi apatonda; say sayaw mi nagmaliw a panagogol.
Say balanget naplag a nanlapu ed olo mi: abagey kami la! ta nankasalanan kami.
Lapu ed saya say puso mi onkapuy; lapu ed saraya a bengatla saray mata mi onkuyep ira;
Ta say palandey na Sion a sikato so kibalatar; saray lobo manakar ira ed tapew to.
Sika O Katawan mansiansia ka lawas; say yorongan mo manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan.
Akin et lingaanan mo kami lawas, Tan ikaindan mo kami ed ontan a karukey na panaon?
Ipawil mo kami ed sika, O Katawan, et nipawil kami naani; Pasimbaloen mo ray agew a singa nen inmuna.
Ompan lagi no inwaklit mo kami a sigpot; Ompan lagi no sika so sankasnokan sumpa ed sikami.

Bang nen saman agawa ed komatalomplo a taon, dia ed komapat a bulan, dia ed komalima ya agew na bulan, unong ya walaak ed nanleleetan na saray dinakep ed abay na ilog a Chebar, a saray tawen alukasan ira, et anengneng ko ray pasingawey na Dios.
Dia ed komalima ya agew na bulan, a sikato so komalima a taon na inkadakep nen ari Joacim,
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi a talaga ed Ezequiel a sacerdote, ya anak a laki nen Buzi, dia ed dalin na saray Caldeo ed abay na ilog a Chebar; et walad man ed sikato nen saman so lima nen Katawan.

Et ninmengnengak, et, nia, sakey a bagyo a dagem so sinmibok a nanlapu ed amianen, sakey a baleg a lurem, pati sakey ya apuy ya alokotlokot, tan sakey a sinag ed liberliber to, tan nanlapu ed pegley to singa wala so manesyab a metal, a nanlapu ed pegley na apuy.
Et nanlapu ed pegley to pinmaway so kapara na apatira a pinalsa a mabilay. Et saya nen saman so nengneng da: Wala so nengneng da a singa ra too;
Et balang sakey walaan na apatira a lupa, tan balang sakey ed sikara walaan na apatira a payak.
Et saray salita maptek ira a sali; et say dapan na sali ra singa dapan na kilaw na baca; et silengsileng ira a singa gansa a pinasileng.
Et walaan ira na saray lima na too ed silong na saray payak da ed saray apatira a diking da; et sikara ya apat walaan ira na saray lupa ra tan saray payak da ya onia:
Saray payak da nansoldongan so sakey tan sakey: ag ira ombalingling sano onla ra; onla ra a balang sakey a maptek ed arap.

Nipaakar ed kapadpara na saray lupa ra, walaan ira na lupa na sakey a too: et sikara ya apat walaan ira na lupa na sakey a leon ed nikawanan a diking; et sikara ya apat walaan ira na lupa na sakey a baka ed nikawigi a diking; sikara ya apat met walaan ira na lupa a sakey ya agila.
Et saray lupa ra tan saray payak da nisian ira ed tagey; duaran payak na balang sakey sinmoldong ed sakey tan sakey, tan say duara sinakbongan da so saray laman da.
Et linma ra a balang sakey a maptek ed arap; angan iner a laen komon na espiritu, linma ra; ag ira pinmawil sanen linma ra.

Nipaakar ed kapadpara na saray mabilay a pinalsa, say nengneng da singa ngalab a mandarlang, singa say nengneng na saray banoot; say apuy tinmagey tan linmepsag ed nanleleetan na saray mabilay a pinalsa: et say apuy sikato nen saman so masnag, tan nanlapu ed apuy pinmaway so kirmat.
Et saray mabilay a pinalsa binmatik ira tan pinmawil ira a singa say nengneng na sakey ya esyab na kirmat.
Bang nen leleg ko a ninmengneng ed saray mabilay a pinalsa, nia, so sakey a dalig ed tapew na dalin ed abay na saray pinalsa a mabilay, nipaakar ed balang sakey ed apatira a lupa ra.

Say nengneng na saray dalig tan say inkagawa ra singa say berilo: et sikara ya apat walaan ira na sakey a nengneng: et say nengneng da tan say inkagawa ra singa sakey a dalig ed dalem na sakey a dalig.
Sanen linma ra, linma ra ed apatira ya arap da: et ag ira pinmawil sanen imanla ra.
Nipaakar ed saray basikaw da, sikara so atagey tan makapataktakot; et sikara ya apat a basikaw walaan ira na saray mata ed liberliber.
Et sanen linma ra so saray mabilay a pinalsa, saray dalig linma ra met ed abay da; et sanen saray mabilay a pinalsa nipaatagey ira a nanlapu ed dalin, saray dalig nipaatagey ira.
No iner man so nila na espiritu, linma ra; diman wala so espiritu ya onla; et saray dalig nipaatagey ira ed abay da: ta say espiritu na saray mabilay a pinalsa wala nen saman ed saray dalig.

Sanen saraman linma ra, saraya linma ra; et sano saraman ontonda ra, saraya ontonda ra; et sano saraman nipaatagey ira a manlapu ed dalin, saray dalig nipaatagey ira ed abay da: ta say espiritu na saray mabilay a pinalsa wala nen saman ed saray dalig.
Tan dia ed tagey na olo na mabilay a pinalsa wala nen saman so singa kaparpara na firmamento, singa say makakebiew a salming a lingisen, a nibuskag ed tagey na saray olo ra.

Tan dia lepsag na firmamento wala nen saman so saray payak da a maptek, say sakey arap ed sakey: balang sakey walaan na duara a sikara so sinmakbong ed saya a diking, tan balang sakey walaan na duara a sinmakbong ed saman a diking, na saray laman da.

Et sanen linma ra, nadngel ko so ongol na saray payak da a singa ongol na dakerakel a danum, a singa voces na Makapanyarin amin, sakey a tanol na ongol a singa tanol na sakey ya ejercito: sanen tinmonda ra, inlepsag da ray payak da.
Et wala nen saman so sakey a voces ed tagey na firmamento ya wala nen saman ed tagey na olo ra: sanen tinmonda ra, inlepsag da ray payak da.

Et diad' tagey na firmamento ya wala nen saman ed tagey na olo ra wala nen saman so kapara na sakey ya trono, a singa nengneng na bato a zafiro; et ed tapew na kapara na sakey ya trono wala nen saman so sakey a kapara a singa say nengneng na sakey a too ed tapew to ed tagey.

Et anengneng ko so singa mandarlang a metal, a singa say nengneng na apuy ed loob to a manliberliber manlapu ed nengneng na saray banel to a mamaatagey; et manlapu ed nengneng na saray banel to a mamalepsag, anengneng ko a singa wala nen saman so nengneng na apuy, tan wala so sinag ed liberliber to.

Singa say' nengneng na kabunlalakaw ya wala ed lurem ed agew na uran, ontan nen saman so nengneng na sinag ed liberliber. Saya sikato nen saman so kaparpara na kaatageyan nen Katawan. Et sanen anengneng ko, tinmikleb ak, tan nadngel ko so voces na sakey a nansalita.
Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, onalagey ka ed saray salim, et mansalita ak naani ed sika.
Et say Espiritu linmoob ed siak sanen akisalita ed siak, et pinaalagey to ak ed saray salik; et nadngel ko so nansalita ed siak.

Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, siak ibakita ka ed saray anak na Israel, ed saray nacion a matunganga, a tinmunganga sumpa ed siak: sikara tan saray atateng da sinmumlang ira a sumpa ed siak anga ni ed sayan agew.
Et saray anak marutak ira tan anawet ya inpanpuso: siak ibaki taka ed sikara; et kuan mo naani ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et sikara, angan ondengel ira naani, odino ag ira ondengel (ta sikara so matunganga ya abung), anga ontan amta ra naani ya wala nen saman so profeta ed sikara.

Et sika, anak na too; agka ontatakot ed sikara, agka natalagnaw ed saray salita ra, angan saray sabitan tan saray tala so wala ed sika, tan manayam ka ed nanleleetan na saray alakdan: agka antakot ed saray salita ra, odino napunaw ed saray kanenengneng da, angan sikara so matunganga ya abung.
Et salitaen mo naani ed sikara so saray salitak, angan ondengel ira naani odino italirak da naani; ta sikara matunganga ra a toloy.
Balet sika, anak na too; denglen mo so salitaen ko ed sika; agka komon matunganga a singa satan a matunganga ya abung: isangim so sangim tan kanen mo so iter ko ed sika.
Et sanen ninmengneng ak, nia sakey a lima so angiderew ed siak; et nia, wala ed sikato so sakey a lokot a libro.
Et sikato so binuskag to ed arap ko: et asulatan ed dalem tan paway to; et wala a nisulat so tagleey, tan agogol, tan ey-ey.
Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, kanen mo so naromog mo; kanen mo so saya a lokot, tan onla ka, mansalita ka ed abung na Israel.
Kanian sinmangi ak, tan inpakan to ed siak imay lokot.

Et inkuanto ed siak, Anak na too, gawaen mo a say eges mo mangan komon, tan peselen mo ray pait mo ed saya a lokot ya iter ko ed sika. Saman sikato so kinan ko; et wala ed sangik a singa dilo so samit to.
Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, onla ka, onsabi ka ed abung na Israel, tan salitaen mo ed sikara so saray salitak.
Ta agka nibaki ed baley a sankaili so salita to, tan mairap so pansasalita to, no ag ingen dia ed abung na Israel;
Andi ed saray dakel a baley a sankaili so pansasalita to tan mairap, a saray salita ra agmo natalosan. Andi duaruwa, no ibaki taka komon ed sikara, denglen da ka komon.
Balet say abung na Israel ag naani ondengel ed sika; ta ag ira naani met ondengel ed siak: ta amin ya abung na Israel anawet so muling da tan anawet so puso ra.
Nia, pinakuliseng ko so lupam a sumpa ed saray lupa ra, tan pinakumanet ko so muling mo a sumpa ed saray muling da.
Singa diamante ya anawet nen bato so ginawak ed muling mo: agka antakot ed sikara, tan agka met napunaw ed kanenengneng da, angan sikara so matunganga ya abung.
Sakey ni inkuanto ed siak, Anak na too, saray amin a salitak a salitaen ko naani ed sika awaten mo ed pusom, tan denglen mo ed saray layag mo.

Et onla ka, tan onsabi ka ed saray dinakep, ed saray anak na baley mo, tan salitaen mo ed sikara, tan ibagam ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; angan ondengel ira naani, odino ag ira ondengel.
Diad saman say Espiritu intagey toak, tan nadngel ko ed beneg ko so voces na baleg ya ongol, ya inkuan to, Bendito so gloria nen Katawan a manlapu ed pasen to.
Et nadngel ko so banesbes na saray payak na saray mabilay a pinalsa a nanpepeketan, tan say tanol na saray dalig ed abay da, say tanol ni na baleg ya ongol.
Dia ed ontan say Espiritu intagey to ak, tan inala to ak; et linma ak ed kapaitan, dia ed petang na espirituk; et say lima nen Katawan sikato so mabiskeg ed siak.
Diad saman linma ak ed saray dinakep ed Telabib, a manaayam ed abay na ilog a Chebar, tan ed panagayaman da; et imyorong ak diman ya atalagnaw ed nanleleetan da a pitoy agew.
Et agawa ed sampot na pitoy agew, a say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, ginawa taka a bantay ed abung na Israel: kanian denglen mo so salita na sangik, tan itdan mo ra na simbawa a manlapu ed siak.

Sano kuan ko ed mauges, Petepeteg ya ompatey ka; et sikato so agmo itdan na simbawa, ni agka misalita a manimbawa ed mauges a manlapu ed mauges a dalan to, pian nilaban so bilay to; say too lanlamang a mauges ompatey ed inkauges to; balet say dala to anapen ko ed limam.
Manwari no simbawaen mo so mauges, et ag magbabawi a manlapu ed inkauges to, odino manlapu ed dalan to a mauges, ompatey ed inkauges to; balet inlaban mo so kamarerwam.

Ontan met, sano say sakey a matunong a too magbabawi a manlapu ed inkatunong to, tan mangawa na inkauges, tan mangigaton ak na kagapolan ed arap to, ompatey: lapu ed sikato so agmo initdan na simbawa, ompatey ed kasalanan to, tan saray matunong a gawa to a ginawa to ag natumangan; balet say dala to anapen ko ed limam.
Angan ontan no simbawaen mo so matunong a too, pian say matunong ag mankasalanan, tan ag mangawa na kasalanan, petepeteg a manbilay, lapu ed inpasimbawa; et inlaban mo so kamarerwam.
Et wala nen saman ed siak diman so lima nen Katawan; et inkuanto ed siak, Ombangon ka, tan ompaway ka ed patar, tan diman misalita ak naani ed sika.
Saman la inmalagey ak, tan linmaak ed patar: et, nia, say gloria nen Katawan inmalagey diman, a singa say gloria ya anengneng ko ed abay na ilog a Chebar; et tinmikleb ak.
Saman la linmoob ed siak so Espiritu, et pinaalagey to ak ed saray salik; et nansalita ed siak, tan inkuan to, Onla ka, tan manpokok ka ed abung mo.
Balet sika, anak na too, nia, itapew da naani ed sika so saray lubir, tan baloren da ka naani ed sikara, tan agka naani ompaway ed nanleleetan da:
Ipeket ko naani so dilam ed tawentawen mo, pian naumel ka, tan agka naani mamalaw ed sikara; ta sikara matunganga ra ya abung.

Balet no kasalita ta ka lukasan ko naani so sangim, tan kuan mo naani ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Say ondengel, makadngel komon; et say agto ondengel, agto komon ondengel: ta sikara matunganga ra ya abung.
Sika met, anak na too, mangala ka na sakey a baldosa, tan yan mo ed arap mo, tan ikurit mo ed tapew to so sakey a ciudad, salanti Jerusalem

Et mangigaton ka na alar a sumpa ed sikato, tan mangipaalagey ka na saray salimbing a sumpa ed sikato, tan mangilosbo ka na pokdol a sumpa ed sikato; mangipasenka met na saray pakalso a sumpa ed sikato, tan mangyan ka na saray kagawaan a panamagbag a sumpa ed sikato ed liberliber.

Et mangala ka ed sika na sakey a kawali a balatyang, et sikato so yan mo a singa sakey a bakor a balatyang ed leet mo tan say ciudad: et ipatnag mo naani so lupam ya arap ed sikato, et sikato so nakobkob naani, tan sika sikato so kobkoben mo naani. Saya sikato naani sakey a tanda ed abung na Israel.
Sakey ni ondokol ka ed diking mo a kawigi, tan yan mo so inkauges na abung na Israel ed tapew to; unong ed bilang na agew ya idokol mo ed tapew to, awiten mo naani so inkauges da.
Ta gineteran ko ray taon na inkauges da a sikara ed sika so sakey a bilang na saray agew, a sikara so talonlasus tan siamaplo ya agew: ontan naani so pangawit mo ed inkauges na abung na Israel.
Tan ontan met no nasumpal mo ya, ondokol ka naani ed diking mo a kawanan, et awiten mo naani so inkauges na Juda; apataplo ya agew, balang agew ed sakey taon, sikato so inggeter ko ed sika.
Et yarap mo so lupam ed akobkob a Jerusalem, pati say taklay mo ya ag asakbongan; et manprofeta ka naani na sumpa ed sikato.
Et, nia, mangyan ak na lubilubir ed tapew mo, et agka naani makapigar a manlapu ed sakey a diking anga ed sananey, anga ed nasumpal mo so saray agew na pangobkob mo.

Mangala ka met ed sika na trigo, tan cebada, tan ag-agayep, tan baktaw, tan mijo, tan espelta, tan yanmo ra naani ed sakey a kagawaan, tan gawaen mo ra a tinapay; unong ed bilang na saray agew a pandokol mo naani ed diking mo, a sikara so talonlasus tan siamaplo ya agew, mangan ka naani ed sikato.
Et say taganom a kanen mo naani, sikato naani nasimbang, duamplo a siclo ed sakey ya agew: et kanen mo naani ed balang panaon a manepeg.
Et oninum ka naani na danum a sinukat, say kakanem na sakey a hin: balang panaon a manepeg oninum ka naani.
Et sikato naani kanen mo a singa saray bibingka a cebada, et sikato so lutoen mo ed horno ed pakanengneng da pati say dutak ya ompaway ed too.
Et si Katawan inkuan to, Salanti onia so pangan na saray anak na Israel ed ag malinis a tinapay da ed nanleleetan na saray nacion a pangipaarapan ko naani ed sikara.

Saman la inkuan ko, Ay Katawan a Dios! nia, so kamarerwak ag adumsisan: ta nanlapu ed inkaugaw ko anga ed natan lanlamang agak angan na angan anto ya inatey ed inkasikato, odino say biningbingkas na saray ayep; et ag met linmoob ed sangik so laman a makadimla.
Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Nengnengen mo, initdan ta ka na dutak na baka a nisalat ed dutak na too, et lutoen mo naani so tinapay mo ed tapew to

Ontan met inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, nia, deralen ko naani so tayokor na tinapay dia ed Jerusalem: et mangan ira na tinapay a sinimbang, tan sitatakot: et inumen da naani so danum a sinukat, tan dia ed kapunaw;
Pian onkulang ira na tinapay tan danum, tan napunaw so sakey tan sakey, tan onebeng ira ed inkauges da.

Et sika, anak na too, mangala ka na sakey a kampilan a matdem; singa sakey a pangiskis, alaen mo naani ed sika, tan kiskisan mo so olom tan say balbas mo; insan ka mangala na simbangan pian simbangen mo, tan apagapagen mo so buek.

Sakey a kakatlo so puulan mo ed apuy ed pegley na ciudad, sano nasumpal so saray agew na kakobkob; et alaen mo naani so sananey a kakatlo, et isigbat mo so kampilan ed liberliber to: et say sananey a kakatlo isibwag mo naani ed karageman, et siak baguten ko naani so kampilan ed beneg da.
Et mangala ka naani ed sikara na daiset a bilang, tan isinger mo naani ed saray saloy na kawes mo.
Tan mangala ka lamet, et saraya tan ibantak mo ra ed pegley na apuy, tan ipuul mo ra naani ed apuy; et ompaway naanid'man so apuy ed abung na amin ya Israel.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Saya so Jerusalem sikato so inpasen ko ed nanleleetan na saray dalin ed liberliber to.

Et sikato tinmunganga a sumpa ed saray bilin ko ed panaggawa to na inkauges a lalo nen saray nacion, tan sumpa ed saray panontonan ko a lalo nen saray dalin ed liberliber to; ta inpulisay da ray pangoksoyan ko, tan nipaakar ed saray panontonan ko, ag ira nanakar ed sikara.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu'd no makolkol kayo nen saray nacion ya wala ed liberliber yo, tan agkayo manakar ed saray panontonan ko, agyo met inonor iray pangoksoyan ko, agyo met ginawa so unong na saray pangoksoyan na saray nacion ya wala ed liberliber yo.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, siak siak lanlamang onsumpaak ed sika: et gawaen ko naani so pangokom ed pegley mo ed pakanengneng na saray nacion.
Et gawaen ko naani ed sika so agko ni ginawa, et no nipaakar ed saya agko naani gawaen ed angan kapigan ed kapara to, lapu ed saray amin a kadimlaan mo.

Kanian saray ama ed pegley mo kanen da naani so saray anak da, et saray anak kanen da naani so saray atateng da; et gawaen ko naani pangokom ko ed sika: et amin a kera ed sika isibuag ko naani ed saray amin a dagem.

Bangta unong a mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan, tua a sika dinumsisan mo so santuariok ed saray amin a makapaingongot a bengabengat mo tan ed saray amin a kadimlaan mo, kanian siak met pamelagen ta ka naani; say matak angapo met naani isakit to, tan ontan met ya angapo naani panangasik.

Say sakey a kakatlom ompatey naani ed salot, tan lapu ed eras naopot ira naani dia ed pegley mo; et say sakey a kakatlo nipasag ira naani ed kampilan ed liberliber mo; et say sakey a kakatlo isibuag ko naani ed saray amin a dagem, tan baguten ko naani so kampilan ed beneg da.

Onia naani so kasumpal na sanok ko, tan paligenen ko naani sanok ko ed sikara, tan naligliwa ak naani: et naamtaan da naani a siak, si Katawan, nansalitaak ed imon ko, sano asumpal ko la so sanok ko ed sikara.
Ontan met pagmaliwen ta ka naani a kibalatar tan balaw ed saray nacion ya wala ed liberliber mo, dia ed pakanengneng saray amin ya onlabas.

Dia ed ontan sikato naani kabalawan tan kamodmoraan, tan kabangatan, tan pankelawan ed saray nacion ya wala ed liberliber ed sika, sano siak gawaen ko ray pangokom ed sika ed sanok tan petang, tan masebeg a panamaat (Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak);

Sano siak pasabien ko naani ed sikara so saray mauges a pana na eras, a sikara so panamagbag, a sikara naani pasabien ko a pamagbag ed sikayo. Et aruman ko naani so eras ed sikayo, tan deralen ko naani so tayokor a tinapay;
Et ibakik naani ed sikayo so eras tan mauges ya ayep, a mamaermen ed sika; tan salot tan say dala ya onlabas naani ed sika; tan yakar ko naani kampilan ed sika: Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam ed saray palandey na Israel, tan manprofeta ka ed sikara,

Tan kuan mo, Sikayo a palandey na Israel, denglen yo so salita nen Katawan a Dios: Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed saray palandey tan saray pokdol, ed saray kolos tan saray lawak: Nia, siak, lanlamang, payakar ko naani ed sikayo so kampilan, tan bagbagen ko naani so saray atagey a pasen yo.
Et saray altar yo magmaliw ira naani a kibalatar, tan saray talintao yo a banwa nabuyak ira naani tan ibantak ko naani ray inatey yo ed arap na saray talintao yo.
Et yan ko naani ray bangkay na saray anak na Israel ed arap na saray talintao ra; et itayak ko naani ray pokel yo ed liberliber na saray altar yo.

Ed saray amin a panayaman yo a saray ciudad nabagbag ira naani, tan saray atagey a pasen mankibalatar ira naani; ta pian saray altar yo nabagbag ira naani tan nagawa ra a mankibalatar, tan saray talintao yo nabuybuyak tan ontonda ra, tan saray talintao yo a banwa natawtaw ira, tan saray gawa yo naandi ra naani.
Et saray inatey napelag ira naani ed pegley yo, tan naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Angan ontan paulian ko naani so sakey a kera, lapu ed wala naani arum ed sikayo a makatainan ed kampilan na saray nacion, sano nitayak kayo ed saray dalin.

Et saray makatainan ed sikayo nanonotan da ak naani ed nanleleetan na saray nacion a kiakaran da naani a dinakep, no panon so inkipaunong ko ed maramag a puso ra, a sinmian ed siak, tan ed saray mata ra, ya akibalangkantis ira unong ed saray talintao ra: et gulaen da naani so laman da lanlamang ed pakanengneng da a dili lapu ed mauges a ginawa ra ed saray amin a kadimlaan da.
Et amta ra ak naani a siak si Katawan: agko inbaga dia ed maapa ed sikara a gawaen ko naani ed sikara so saya a mauges.

Onia so inkuan nen Katawan a Dios: Ikabil mo so limam tan igatin mo ed saray salim, tan kuan mo, Abagey la! lapu ed saray amin a mauges a kadimla ed abung na Israel; ta napelag ira naani lapu ed kampilan, ed eras tan ed salot.
Say wala ed arawi ompatey naani ed salot; et say asinger napelag naani ed kampilan; et say nakeraan tan say mangobkob ompatey naani ed eras: onia naani so panumpal ko na sanok ko ed sikara.

Et amtayo naani a siak si Katawan, sano saray inatey da wala ra naani ed nanleleetan na saray talintao ra ed liberliber na saray altar da, ed saray amin a pokdol ya atagey, tan ed amin a toktok na saray palandey, tan ed lepsag na balang malambot a kiew tan lepsag na amin a roble a masalompapak, saray pasen ya angyapayan da na ambalingit a samiong ed saray amin a talintao ra.

Et yunat ko naani so limak ed tapew da, tan gawaen ko naani so dalin a kibalatar tan pinalis, manlapu ed kalawakan ya arap ed Deblata, anga ed saray amin a panayaman da; et amta ra naani a siak si Katawan.
Ontan met say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Et sika, anak na too, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed dalin na Israel, Sakey a kasumpalan: say kasumpalan onsabi la ed saray apatiran suyok na dalin.
Natan sikato so kasumpalan ed sika, et pasabien ko naani ed sika so sanok ko, tan okomen ta ka naani unong ed saray dalan mo; et yakar ko naani ed sika ray amin a kadimlaan mo.

Et say matak agto ka naani isakit, tan angapo met naani panangasik; balet saray dalan mo yakar ko naani ed sika; tan saray kadimlaan mo wala ra naani ed pegley mo: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sakey a mauges, sakey a mauges lambengat; nia, sikato so onsabi.
Sakey a kasumpalan so onsabi la, say kasumpalan onsabi la; sikato so onliing a sumpa ed sika; nia, sikato so onsabi.
Say kadusam onsabi la ed sika, O manaayam ed dalin: say panaon onsabi la, say agew asinger la, sakey ya agew na kolkol, tan aliwa a maliket ya eyag ed saray palandey.

Natan magano ya yibung ko ed sika naani so sanok ko, tan sumpalen ko naani so petang ko sumpa ed sika, tan okomen ta ka naani unong ed saray dalan mo; tan yakar ko naani ed sika so saray amin a kadimlaan mo.

Et say matak ag naani mangisakit tan angapo met naani panangasik; yakar ko naani ed sika unong ed dalan mo: tan saray kadimlaan mo wala ra naani ed pegley mo; et naamtaan yo naani a siak, si Katawan, mangabil ak.
Nia, say agew, nia, sikato so onsabi: say kadusam ompaway la say tayokor nanbolaklak la, say kapangtaan mankamoktil la.
Say panamasoot ombangon a sakey a tayokor na inkauges; angapo naani ed sikara so nakeraan, angan say inkadakel da, ni say inkamayaman da: angapo met naani kaatageyan ed sikara.
Say panaon onsabi la, say agew onasinger: say manaliw ag komon manliket, et say manlako ag met komon manermen, ta say sanok wala ed saray amin ya inkadakel da.

Ta say manlako ag naani ompawil ed saman so alako, angan mabilay nira: ta say pasingawey tenyegen to so amin ya inkadakel da, angapo naani so ompawil; et angapo met naani so makapakasil ed inkasikato lanlamang ed inkauges na bilay to.
Sinibok da so tamboyog, et amin intadia ra; balet angapo so angan siopa ya ed bakal; ta say sanok ko wala ed amin ya inkadakel da.
Say kampilan wala ed paway, et say salot tan say eras ed dalem; say wala ed uma ompatey naani ed kampilan: et say wala ed ciudad kanen naani na eras tan salot.
Balet saraman so akatainan ontainan ira naani, tan manayam ira naani ed tapew na saray palandey a singa saray palekpek ed saray lawak, sikara ya amin mansibek ira, balang sakey ed inkauges to.
Amin a lima makapuy naani, tan amin a pueg makapuy naani a singa danum.
Manbalkes ira met naani na magaspang ya abel, tan nasakbongan ira naani na kataktakot; et say baing wala naani ed saray amin a lupa, tan say kayangyangan ed saray amin ya olo ra.

Ibantak da naani so pilak da ed saray polong, tan say balitok da singa naani marutak a bengatla; say pilak da tan say balitok da agda naani nayarian ya ilaban ira ed agew na sanok nen Katawan: ag naani napenek iray kamarerwa ra, agda met napesel so saray pait da; ta sikato so kigapolan na inkauges da.

No nipaakar ed kalimgasan naparakep to, sikato so inpasen to ed kaatageyan; balet ginawa ra so saray kadimlaan da tan saray bengabengat da a makapaingongot diman: kanian sikato so ginawak ed sikara a singa sakey a bengatla ya ag malinis.
Et sikato naani iter ko ed lima na saray sankaili a nipaakar a samsam, tan ed saray marelmeng ed dalin a sakey a samsam: et sikato naani modmoraen da.
Say lupak ibeneg ko naani met ed sikara, tan modmoraen da naani so maamot ko a pasen; et saray matakew onloob ira naani ed sikato, tan sikato naani modmoraen da.
Mangawa ka na golonggolong: ta say dalin napno na saray kasalanan a marala, tan say ciudad napno na panagdusa.
Kanian yakar ko naani so kamaugesan na saray nacion, et kayarianen da naani ray abung da: siak patundaen ko met naani so pangta na saray mabiskeg da: et saray masanto a pasen da namodmora ra naani.
Say kabagbag onsabi; et mananap ira naani na deen, et angapo naani.
Duksa so ontombok naani ed duksa, balita so ontombok naani ed balita; et anapen da naani so pasingawey na profeta; balet say tunong natawtaw naani ed sacerdote, tan say simbawa ed saray mamasiken.

Say ari manermen naani, tan say principe nakawesan naani na kabagbag, et saray lima na saray ombaley ed dalin nagolo ra naani; gawaen ko naani ed sikara so unong ed dalan da, tan unong ed saray kakanaanda okomen ko ra naani; et amtaenda naani a siak si Katawan.

Et agawa a sanen komanem a taon, ed bulan a komanem, ed komalima ya agew na bulan, sanen manyodyorongak ed abung ko, tan saray mamasiken na Juda akayorong ira ed arap ko, a say lima nen Katawan a Dios dinmapo ed siak diman.

Saman la ninmengneng ak, et, nia sakey a kapara na nengneng na apuy; manlapu ed nengneng na saray banel to a mamalepsag, apuy; tan manlapu ed saray banel to a mamatagey, singa say nengneng na sinag, a singa mandarlang a metal.

Et sikato inyunat to so nengneng na sakey a lima, tan inala toak ed sankagonot na olok; et say Espiritu intagey toak ed nanleetan na dalin tan tawen, tan inyakar toak ed saray pasingawey na Dios ed Jerusalem, ed pinto na wangalan na akandalem a saban ya arap ed amianen; a kawalaan nen saman na yorongan na talintao na imon, a managyat na imon.
Et, nia, a say gloria na Dios na Israel, wala nen saman diman unong ed nengneng ya anengneng ko ed patar.

Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, itangay mo natan so saray matam ed dalan a mamaamianen. Kanian intangay ko ray matak ed dalan a mamaamianen, et, nia, ed amianen na wangalan na altar saya a talintao na imon ed lolooban.

Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, nanengneng mo so gawaen da? salanti saray baleg a kadimlaan a say abung na Israel gawaen to dia, pian onarawi ak komon ed santuariok? Balet sika nanengneng mo lamet naani so saray sananey ni a baleg a kadimlaan.
Et inyakar to ak ed pinto na saban; et sanen ninmengneng ak, nia, sakey ya abot ed bakor.
Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, mankotkot ka natan ed bakor: et sanen nankotkot ak ed bakor, nia sakey a pinto.
Et inkuan to ed siak, Onloob ka, tan nengnengen mo ray mauges a kadimlaan a gawaen da dia.
Linmoobak lanti tan anengneng ko; et nia, balang nengneng na bigibigis, tan makadimla ya ayep, tan amin a talintao ed abung na Israel, a nibolik ira ed bakor ed liberliber.

Et nanalagey ed arap da so pitomplo a lalaki ed saray mamasiken ed abung na Israel; et dia ed pegley da inmalagey si Jezonias ya anak a laki nen Safan, balang too walaan na inciensoan ed lima to; et say samiong na lurem na incienso tinmagey.

Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, anengneng mo so gagawaen na saray mamasiken ed abung na Israel dia ed bilunget, balang sakey dia ed saray silir to a pinintaan? ta kuan da, Agto itayo nanengneng nen Katawan; si Katawan pinaulian to so dalin.
Sikato inkuan to met ed siak, Sika nanengneng mo lamet naani ray arum ni a baleg a kadimlaan a gawaen da.
Saman la inyakar to ak ed pinto na wangalan na abung nen Katawan ya wala ed dapit amianen; et nia, diman imyorong iray bibii a nanangisan da so Tammuz.
Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Anengneng mo la so saya, O anak na too? Nanengneng mo lamet naani ray baleg ni a kadimlaan nen saraya.

Et inloob toak ed aralem a saban na abung nen Katawan; et nia ed pinto na templo nen Katawan, ed nanleetan na pintoan tan say altar, wala so mikaduamplo tan lima a lalaki, a saray beneg da inyarap da ed templo nen Katawan, tan say lupa ra ed bokig; et angigalgalang ira ed banua ya inmarap ira ed bokig.

Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Anengneng mo ya, O anak na too? Sikato ta so anlemew a bengatla ed abung nen Juda a gawaen da so saray kadimla a gagawaen da dia? ta pinano ra so dalin ed panamasoot, tan pinawil da ak lamet a sagyaten a manpasnok; et, nia, inan da na sanga so eleng da.
Kanian mangawa ak met naani na sanok; say matak ag naani mangisakit tan angapo met naani panangasik; et angan mantawag ira ed saray layag ko na maksil a voces, angan ontan agko ra naani denglen.
Saman la tinmawag ed saray layag ko ed maksil a voces, ya inkuan, Paasingeren yo ray bantay na ciudad, balang too akaegna na ayura to a pamagbag.

Et nia, ya anem iran lalaki a nanlapu ra ed dalan na bandadtagey ya wangalan, ya inmarap ed amianen, balang sakey akaegna na ayura to a pamatey; et sakey a laki ed pegley da akakawes na lienzo, ya wala so tinteroan ed awak to. Et linmoob ira, tan nanalagey ira ed abay na altar a gansa.

Et say gloria na Dios na Israel tinmagey a nanlapu ed kerubin, a sikato so kawalaan ko nen saman, anga ed sasabien na abung: et tinawag to so laki ya akakawes na lienzo, ya wala so tinteroan ed awak to.

Et si Katawan inkuan to ed sikato, Onlabas ka ed pegley na ciudad, ed kapegleyan na Jerusalem, tan inan mo na tanda so muling na saray lalaki a mansibek tan manakis lapu ed amin a kadimlaan a nagagawa ed kapegleyan to.
Tan ed saray sananey inkuan to ed dengel ko, Onlabas kayo ed ciudad ed beneg to, tan kabilen yo: ag komon isakit na matayo, tan agkayo mangasi;

Pateyen yo a sigpot iray mamasiken, babalolaki tan mamarikit, ugugaw tan bibii; balet agyo singeran so angan siopa a too ya wala so tanda to; et ongapo kayo ed santuariok. Saman la inggapo ra ed saray mamasiken ya wala ed arap na abung.
Et inkuan to ed sikara, Dutakan yo ray abung panoen yoray saban ed saray pinatey: ompaway kayo. Et pinmaway ira, tan nankabil ira ed ciudad.
Et agawa, sanen nankabil ira, atilak ak, a tinmiklebak, tan inmakisak tan inkuan ko! O Katawan a Dios! Bagbagen mo ta ya amin so kera ed Israel dia ed panangibung mo na sanok mo ed Jerusalem?

Saman la inkuanto ed siak, Say inkauges na abung na Israel tan Juda sikato so mapalalo a baleg, tan say dalin napno na dala, tan say ciudad napno ed panamikewet ed pangokom: ta kuan da, Si Katawan pinaulian to so dalin, tan si Katawan ag makanengneng.
Et no nipaakar ed siak met, say matak ag naani mangisakit, tan angapo met naani panangasik, balet ipawil ko naani so dalan da ed tapew na olo ra.
Et, nia, say laki a nankawes na lienzo, ya walaan na tinteroan ed awak to, inpakabat to so pegdat, ya inkuan to, Ginawak so unong na ingangan mo ed siak.
Saman la ninmengneng ak, et, nia, ed firmamento ya wala nen saman ed tagey na olo na saray kerubin pinmatnag ed tagey da so singa sakey a bato a zafiro, a singa nengnengna kapadpara na sakey a trono.

Et nansalita ed laki a nankawes na lienzo tan inkuan to, Onloob ka dia ed pegley na saray mantetlek a dalig, salanti ed lepsag na saray kerubin, tan panoen mo ray nanpadpara a limam ed saray ngalab a manlapu ed leet na saray kerubin, tan itayak mo ra ed ciudad. Et sikato linmoob a nengnengnengen ko.
Bang saray kerubin nanalagey ira ed diking a nikáwanan na abung, sanen say laki linmoob; et say lurem pinano to so bandad dalem a saban.
Et say gloria nen Katawan tinmagey a manlapu ed kerubin, tan nanalagey ed sasabien na abung; et say abung napno na lurem, tan say saban napno na sinag na gloria nen Katawan.
Et say ongol na payak na saray kerubin nadngel anga ni ed bandad paway a saban, a singa say voces na Dios a Makapanyarin amin no mansalita.

Et agawa, sanen ginangan to so laki a nankawes na lienzo, ya inkuan to, Mangala ka na apuy a manlapu ed nanleleetan na saray dalig a mantetlek, manlapu ed nanleleetan na saray kerubin, a sikato linmoob tan nanalagey ed abay na sakey a dalig.

Et say kerubin inyunat to so lima to a nanlapu ed nanleleetan na saray kerubin anga ed apuy ya wala ed nanleetan na saray kerubin, tan angala ed sikato, tan inyan to ed lima na saman so nankawes na lienzo, a sikato so angala ed sikato tan pinmaway.
Et pinmatnag ed saray kerubin so nengneng na sakey a lima na too ed silong na saray payak da.

Et ninmengnengak, et nia, apatira a dalig ed abay na saray kerubin, sakey a dalig ed abay na sakey a kerubin, tan sananey a dalig ed abay na sananey a kerubin; et say nengneng na saray dalig singa bato a berilo.
Et no nipaakar ed nengneng da, sikara ya apat wala nen saman so saksakey a nengneng da, unong a sakey a dalig wala ed loob na sakey a dalig.
Sanen linma ra ed apatira ya arap da: ag ira linmingaw leleg a linma ra, no ag ingen ed pasen ya arapen na olo ra sikato so tinombok da; ag ira linmingaw leleg na inyakar da.
Et say amin a laman da, tan saray beneg da, tan saray lima ra, tan saray payak da, tan saray dalig, napno ed saray mata ed liberliber, salanti saray dalig ya wala ed sikara ya apat.
No nipaakar ed saray dalig, atawag ira ed pakadngel ko na saray mantetlek a dalig.

Et balang sakey wala nen saman so apatira a lupa to: say ununa a lupa sikato so lupa na kerubin, et say komadua a lupa sikato so lupa na sakey a too, et say komatlo sikato so lupa na sakey a leon, et say komapat sikato so lupa na sakey ya agila.
Et saray kerubin tinmagey ira: saya so pinalsa a mabilay ya anengneng ko ed abay na ilog a Chebar.
Et sanen linma ray kerubin, saray dalig linma ra ed abay da; et saray kerubin intagey da ray payak da pian ontagey ira a manlapu ed dalin, saray dalig ag ira met sinmian ed abay da.
Sanen inmalagey ira, saraya inmalagey ira; et sanen tinmagey ira, saraya tinmagey ira a niolop ed sikara: ta say espiritu na mabilay a pinalsa wala nen saman ed sikara.
Et say gloria nen Katawan pinmaway a nanlapu ed tagey na sasabien na abung, tan tinmon da ed tagey na saray kerubin.

Et saray kerubin intagey da ray payak da, tan tinmagey ira a nanlapu ed dalin ed pakanengneng ko sanen pinmaway ira, tan saray dalig ed abay da: et nanalagey ira ed pinto na wangalan a bokig na abung nen Katawan; et say gloria na Dios na Israel wala nen saman ed tagey da.
Saya sikato so pinalsa a mabilay ya anengneng ko ed lepsag na Dios na Israel ed abay na ilog a Chebar; et naamtaan ko a kerubin ira.
Balang sakey wala so apatira a lupa to, tan balang sakey apatira so payak to; et say kapadpara na lima na too wala nen saman ed silong na saray payak da.
Et no nipaakar ed kapadpara na saray lupa ra, sikara so saray lupa ya anengneng ko ed abay na ilog a Chebar, say nengneng da tan sikara lanlamang; linma ra a balang sakey ed arap na lupa to.

Laot ni say Espiritu intagey toak, tan inyakar toak ed bokig ya wangalan na abung nen Katawan, a sikato so arap ed bokig: et nia, ed pinto na wangalan duamplo tan lima a lalaki; et anengneng ko ed pegley da si Jezonias ya anak a laki nen Azur, tan si Pelcias ya anak a laki nen Banaias, a principe ra ed baley.
Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, saraya sikara so totoo a mannonot na mauges, tan mangiter na mauges a simbawa ed saya a ciudad;
A kuanda, Say panaon aliwa ya asinger a panangipaalagey na saray abung: saya a ciudad sikato naani so kaldero, tan sikatayo so latnan.
Manprofeta ka sirin na sumpa ed sikara, manprofeta ka, O anak na too.

Et say Espiritu nen Katawan dinmapo ed siak, tan inkuan to ed siak, Salitaen mo, Onia so inkuan nen Katawan: Onia so sinalita yo, O abung na Israel; ta amtak iray bengatla ya onloob ed saray kanonotan yo.
Pinarakel yo ray pinatey yo ed saya a ciudad, tan pinano yo ray polong to ed saray pinatey.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Saray pinatey yo ya inyan yo ed pegley to, sikara so laman, tan saya a ciudad sikato so caldero; balet nipaway kayo naani ed pegley to.
Sikayo tinmakot kayo ed kampilan; et yakar ko naani kampilan ed sikayo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
