Et ipaway takayo naani ed pegley to, tan yawat takayo naani ed lima na saray sankaili, tan gawaen ko naani ray pangokom ed sikayo.
Nipasag kayo naani ed kampilan; okomen takayo naani ed ketegan na Israel: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Saya a ciudad aliwa a sikato naani so caldero yo, et aliwa met a sikayo naani laman ed pegley to; okomen takayo naani ed ketegan na Israel;

Et amtaen yo naani a siak si Katawan: ta agkayo nanakar ed saray panontonan ko, tan agyo met sinumpal so saray pangoksoyan ko, no ag ingen ginawa yo so unong ed saray panangoksoy na saray nacion ed liberliber yo.

Et agawa, sanen nanprofeta ak, a si Pelcias ya anak a laki nen Banaias inatey. Dia ed ontan tinmiklebak, tan inmakis ak na maksil a voces, tan inkuan ko, O Katawan a Dios! gawaen mo naani so ayadyari a kasumpalan na kera ed Israel?
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, saray agagim, on saray agagim, saray totoo a kanayon mo, tan amin ya abung na Israel, sikara ya amin, saray nankuanan na saray manaayam ed Jerusalem, Onarawi kayo ed Katawan; ed sikatayo niiter so saya a dalin a kayarianen tayo.

Kanian inkuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Bangta sikara so inyalis ko ya inyarawi ed pegley na saray nacion, tan angan intayak kora ed saray dalin, siak naani ed sikara so sakey a santuario ed daiset a panaon ed saray dalin a nasabi ra.

Kuan mo sirin, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Siak tiponen takayo naani a manlapu ed saray balbaley, tan tiponen takayo naani a manlapu ed saray dalin a nikayatanyo tan iter ko naani ed sikayo so dalin ya Israel.
Et onla ra naanid'man tan ekalen da naani ray makaingongot a bengatla ed sikato tan saray amin a makadimla ed sikato a manlapud'man.
Et iter ko naani ed sikara so sakey a puso, tan yanko naani ed dalem yo so sakey ya espiritu a balo; et ekalen ko naani ed laman da so ginmibato a puso, tan iter ko naani ed sikara so puso a laman.
Pian manakar ira komon ed saray panontonan ko, tan onoren da ray pangoksoyan ko, tan gawaen da ra: et sikara naani baley ko, tan siak naani Dios da.

Balet nipaakar ed saray puso ra a manaakar unong ed puso na saray makapaingongot ed sikara a bengatla ta saray kadimlaan da, yakar ko naani so dalan da ed tapew na saray olo ra, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Saman la intagey na saray kerubin so saray payak da, tan saray dalig wala ra ed diking da; et say gloria na Dios na Israel wala nen saman ed tagey da.
Et say gloria nen Katawan tinmagey a nanlapu ed pegley na ciudad, tan tinmonda ed tapew na palandey ya wala ed bokig a diking na ciudad.
Et say Espiritu intagey toak, tan inyakar toak ed pasingawey ed panamegley na Espiritu na Dios ed Caldea, ed saray adakep. Et say pasingawey ya anengneng ko tinmainan ed siak.
Saman la sinalitak ed sikara so saray amin a bengatla ya inpatnag ed siak nen Katawan.
Say salita met nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, sika manaayam ka ed pegley na abung a matunganga, ya wala so mata ra a pannengneng da, et ag ira makanengneng, ya wala so layag da a pandengel da, et ag ira ondengel; ta sikara so sakey ya abung a matunganga.

Kanian, sika anak na too, itadiam so kayarian mo ya onalis, tan onalis ka ed agew ed pakanengneng da; et onalis ka naani a manlapu ed pasen mo anga ed sananey a pasen ed pakanengneng da: lagi ta isipen da naani manwari a sikara so abung a matunganga.

Et ipaway mo naani so kayarian mo ed agew ed pakanengneng da, a singa kayarian a nipaakar a yalis; et sika ompaway ka naani ed mankapisdem ed pakanengneng da, singa sano saray totoo ompaway ira nibantak.
Buangan mo naani so bakor ed pakanengneng da, tan ipaway mo naanid'man.

Ed pakanengneng da sikato naani sakbaten mo ed saray abalam, tan sikato naani ipaway mo ed bilunget; sakbongan mo naani so lupam, nian agmo nanengneng naani so dalin: ta inyan taka a sakey a tanda ed abung na Israel.

Et siak ginawak so unong na nigangan ed siak: impaway ko so kayarian ko ed agew, a singa kayarian a nipaakar ed yalis, et sanen mankapisdem binuangan ko so bakor ed limak; sikato so inpaway ko ed bilunget, tan sinakbat ko ed abalak ed pakanengneng da.
Et dia ed kabuasan sinmabi ed siak so salita nen Katawan, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, ag sinalita ed sika na abung na Israel, say matunganga ya abung, Anto so gawaen mo?
Kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Saya ya awit sikato so nipaakar ed principe na Jerusalem, tan amin ya abung na Israel a dia ed nanleleetan da so kawalaan da.
Kuan mo, Siak so tanda yo: unong ed ginawak, ontan naani nagawa ed sikara; niyakar ira naani ed kibantak, ed kadakep.

Et say principe ya wala ed sikara mansakbat naani ed abala to ed bilunget, tan ompaway naani; et buangan da naani, so bakor a pangipawayan da: sakbongan to naani lupa to, pian agto naani nanengneng so dalin ed saray mata to.

Say bateng ko ibuskag ko naani met ed tapew to, et sikato naani naerel ed kalot ko; et sikato naani yakar ko ed Babilonia, ed dalin na saray Caldeo; balet sikato naani agto nanengneng, angan ompatey naanid' man.
Et ipalir ko naani ed amin a dagem so amin ya wala ed liberliber ya ontulong ed sikato, tan saray amin ya ejercito to; et baguten ko naani kampilan ed beneg da.
Et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan sano itayak ko ra naani ed saray nacion tan isibwag ko ra ed saray dalin.

Balet ilaban ko naani so pigara a lalaki ed sikara ed kampilan, ed eras, tan ed salot; pian ipaliwawa ra komon so saray am in a kadimlaan da ed saray nacion a nasabi ra; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Ontan met say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, kanen mo so tinapay mo a sigigiwgiw, tan inumen mo so danum mo a simamayegmeg, tan sitatakot;

Tan kuan mo ed baley ed dalin, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios a nipaakar ed saray manaayam ed Jerusalem, tan ed dalin na Israel: Kanen da naani tinapay da a sitatakot, tan inumen da naani so danum da ed kapunaw, pian say dalin da mankibalatar, tan nasamsaman ed amin ya wala ed sikato, lapu ed panamasoot na saray amin a manaayam ed sikato.
Et saray ciudad ya wala so manaayam ed sikara nabagbag ira naani, tan say dalin mankibalatar naani; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, anto so uliran ya wala ed sikayo ed dalin na Israel, a kuan to, Saray agew naparukey ira naani tan amin a pasingawey ag nasumpal?

Ibagam sirin ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Patondaen ko naani so saya ya uliran, tan agda la naani agamilen a singa sakey ya uliran ed Israel; balet ikuan mo ed sikara, Saray agew asinger la, tan say kasumpal na amin a pasingawey.
Ta angapo la naani so tila a pasingawey ni say profecia a pasirayew ed dalem na abung na Israel.

Ta siak si Katawan; mansalitaak naani, et say salita a salitaen ko nagawa naani; ag naani nilaron; ta dia ed saray agew yo, O abung a matunganga, ibesngaw ko naani so salita, et sikato naani sumpalen ko, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Sinmabi lamet ed siak so salita nen Katawan, ya inkuanto,
Anak na too, nia, sikara ed abung na Israel kuanda, Say pasingawey a nanengnengto sikato so nipaakar ed dakel ya agew ya onsabi, tan sikato rnanprofeta ed saray panaon ya arawi.
Kanian kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Angapo la so nilaron naani ed saray salita, no ag ingen say salita ya ibesngaw ko nagawa naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, rnanprofeta ka na sumpa ed saray profeta na Israel a manpoprofeta, tan kuan mo ed saray manpoprofeta ed saray dili a puso ra, Denglen yo so salita nen Katawan;
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Kasi la ray manpoprofeta a maatiw, a tomboken da so dili ya espiritu ra, et angapo so anengneng da.
O Israel, saray profetam singa ra saray zorra ed saray pasen a malinis.
Agkayo tinmatdang ed saray letak tan agkayo met angipaalagey na bakor a nipaakar ed abung na Israel ya onalagey ed bakal ed agew nen Katawan.
Anengneng da so inkatila tan paries a tila, a mankuan, Kuan nen Katawan balet sikara so ag inbaki nen Katawan et inpanilalo ra ray totoo a say salita nasumpal naani.
Agkayo ta akanengneng na tila a pasingawey, tan agkayo ta nansalita na tila a paries, a kuanyo, Kuan nen Katawan; anta sikato so agko sinalita?
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; lapu ed sikayo nansalita kayo na tila, tan ninengneng yo ray tila, nia sirin onsumpaak ed sikayo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Et say limak onsumpa naani ed saray profeta ya onnengneng ed saray tila a pasingawey, tan manparles na saray tila: sikara angapo ra naani ed tipon na baley ko, tan ag ira met naani nisulat ed awaran na abung na Israel, tan ag ira met naani makaloob ed dalin na Israel; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan a Dios.
Lapu ed, on lapu ed tinokso ra so baley ko, ya inkuan da, Deen; et angapo so deen; et no say sakey ipaalagey to so bakor, nia, sikato so palanasen to ed ag akames a masa:

Ikuan mo ed saray manpalanas ed ag akames a masa a sikato naani nageba; onsabi naani so sakey a delap ya uran; et sikayo, O angkakabaleg a kinmigtel ya uran a bato ompelag kayo naani; et sikato naani buyaken na sakey a mabiskeg a dagem.
Nia, no say bakor nageba la, ag ta naani nisalita ed sikayo, Iner so kawalaan na mauges a masa ya inpamalanas yo ed sikato?

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: sikato naani betagen ko ed dagem a mabiskeg ed sanok ko; et wala naani sakey a delap ya uran ed petang ko, tan ankakabaleg a kinmigtel ya uran a bato a masubesubeg a mangopot ed sikato.

Ontan ta naani so pamagbag ko na bakor a pinalanas yo ed ag akames a masa, et sikato naani igebak ed dalin, pian say angipaletnegan to nalukasan naani; et napelag naani, tan naopot ka naani ed pegley to: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Onia so panumpal ko ed sanok ko ed bakor, tan ed saray amalanas ed sikato ed ag akames a masa; et kuan ko naani ed sikayo, Angapo la so bakor, tan saray amalanas met ed sikato;
Salanti, saray profeta na Israel a rnanprofeta na nipaakar ed Jerusalem, tan makanengneng ed saray pasingawey na deen a nipaakar ed sikato, et angapo so deen, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et sika, anak na too, yarap mo so lupam a sumpa ed saray anak a bibii na baley mo, a mangiprofeta ra na manlapu ed dili a puso ra; et rnanprofeta ka na sumpa ed sikara,

Et kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Abagey la ray bibii a mangidait na saray danganan ed tapew na saray amin a sikosiko, tan mangawa na saray panio a nipaakar ed olo na saray totoo ed amin a kabaleg pian mananap na saray kamarerwa! Anapen yo ta ray kamarerwa na baley ko, et ilaban yo a bilayen so saray kamarerwa a nipaakar ed sikayo lanlamang?

Et sikayo minodmora yoak ed nanleleetan na baley ko lapu ed saray sankaakop a cebada tan pisapisag a tinapay, pian pateyen yo ray kamarerwa yá ag komon ompatey, tan bilayen yo ray kamarerwa ya ag komon manbilay, lapu ed panamalingo yo ed baley ko ya ondengel ed saray tila.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, onsumpa ak ed saray danganan yo, et samsamen ko ra naani a manlapu ed saray taklay yo: et ibolos ko naani ray kamarerwa, salanti saray kamarerwa ya anapen yo a patekyaben.
Pilaten ko met naani ray panio yo, tan ilaban ko naani baley ko ed lima yo, tan andi lara naani ed lima yo a naanup; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Ta lapu ed saray tila pinaermen yo so puso na matunong, a sikara so agko pinaermen, et pinabiskeg yo ray lima na saray marelmeng, pian ag onsian komon ed mauges a dalan to, et nilaban a mabilay:
Kanian agyo la naani nanengneng iray pasingawey a tila, agkayo met makapanprofeta na saray profecia: et ilaban ko naani baley ko ed lima yo; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Saman la sinmabi ed siak so arum ed saray mamasiken na Israel, tan imyorong ira ed arap ko.
Et sinmabi ed siak so salita nen Katawan, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, saraya a totoo inpasen da ray talintao ed puso ra, tan inyan da so kagapolan ya inkauges da ed arap na lupa ra: Siak ta kasi so petepeteg a pibalitaan da ya amin?

Misalita ka sirin ed sikara, tan kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Balang sakey a too ed abung na Israel ya ipasen to so saray talintao ed puso to, tan yan to so kagapolan ya inkauges to ed arap na lupa to, tan onla naani ed profeta: Siak, si Katawan, onebatak naani ed sikato unong ed karakel na saray talintao to;
Pian naalak komon so abung na Israel ed dili a puso ra, ta sinmian ira ed siak ya amin lapu ed saray talintao ra.
Kanian ibagam ed abung na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Ompawil kayo, tan tainan yo ray talintao yo; et isian yo so lupa yo ed saray amin a kadimlaan yo.

Ta balang sakey ed abung na Israel, odino ed saray sankaili a manaayam ed Israel, a sinmian ed siak tan ipasen to ray talintao to ed puso to, tan yan to so kagapolan ya inkauges to ed arap na lupa to, tan onla ed profeta a mibalita a nipaakar ed sikato lanlamang ed siak; siak si Katawan, ebatan ko naani a siak lanlamang:

Et yarap ko naani so lupak a sumpa ed satan a too, tan sikato so gawaen ko naani a pankelawan, a singa tanda tan uliran, et sikato naani pegpegen ko ed pegley na baley ko; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.

Et no say profeta napalingo tan mansalita na sakey a salita, siak, si Katawan, pinalingok so ontan a profeta, tan yunat ko naani limak ed tapew to, tan sikato naani deralen ko ed pegley na baley ko ya Israel.
Et awiten da naani so inkauges da: say inkauges na profeta sikato naani so singa say inkauges na saman so mibalita ed sikato;

Pian say abung na Israel ag la naani nabalang a manlapu ed siak, tan ag ira met la naani narutakan ed saray amin a pakasumlang da; no ag ingen pian sikara naani baley ko, et siak naani Dios da, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, no say dalin mankasalanan na sumpa ed siak lapu ed pakasumlang, tan yunat ko so limak ed tapew to, et deralen ko so tayokor a tinapay ed sikato, tan pasabien ko ed sikato so eras, tan palisen ko ed sikato so totoo tan ay-ayep;
Angan wala komon ed sikato so saraya a taloran lalaki, Noe, Daniel, tan Job, a sikara lapu ed inkatunong da ilaban da komon lambengat so dili a kamarerwa ra, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
No siak palabasen ko ray mauges ya ayep ed dalin, et sikato so deralen da, et mankibalatar, pian angapo so angan siopa a too a makalabas lapu ed saray ayep;

Manwari a saraya a taloran lalaki wala ra komon ed sikato, unong a mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, agda komon ilaban so angan saray anak a lalaki angan saray anak a bibii: sikara lambengat so nilaban, et say dalin mankibalatar naani.
Odino no siak yakar ko so kampilan ed tapew na dalin, tan kuan ko, kampilan, onla ka ed dalin; pian palisen ko ed sikato so saray lalaki tan saray ayayep:

Manwari a saraya a taloran lalaki wala ra ed sikato unong a mabilayak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, agda komon ilaban so angan saray anak a lalaki angan saray anak a bibii, balet sikara lambengat so nilaban.
Odino no say salot so ibakik ed satan a dalin, tan yibung ko a marala so sanok ko ed tapew to, pian napalis ed sikato so saray too tan ayep;

Manwari ya wala ed sikato komon di Noe, Daniel tan Job, unong a mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, agda komon ilaban so angan say anak a laki angan anak a bii; sikara lapu ed inkatunong da nilaban da lambengat so dili a kamarerwa ra.

Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nagkalalo la sano ibakik so saray apatira a makapasinagem a pangokom ko ed Jerusalem, say kampilan, tan say eras, tan saray mauges a munanakap, tan say salot, pian palisen ko ed sikato so saray totoo tan ay-ayep!

Angan ontan, nia natilak naani ed sikato so sakey a kera a nipaway ira naani, anak a lalaki tan anak a bibii: nia ompaway ira naani ed sikayo, tan nanengneng yo naani so ugali ra tan saray gawa ra; et naligliwa kayo naani lapu ed mauges ya inyakar ko ed Jerusalem, salanti nipaakar ed amin ya inyakar ko ed sikato.
Et sikara ligliwaen da kayo naani, sano nanengneng yo so ugali ra tan saray gawa ra; et naamtaan yo naani ya agko ginawa so amin a ginawak ed sikato, no angapo so sengeg to, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, anto so kiew na uvas a lalo nen say bengatla a kiew, say sanga na uvas ya wala ed nanleleetan na saray kiew ed takel?
Mangala ra ta naani ed sikato na kiew pian gawaen da so bengatla a kimey? Odino mangala naani ta so saray lalaki ed sikato na sakey a palitek a pangibitinan da na sakey a kagawaan?
Nia, sikato so nibantak ed apuy a itongo; ed duaran sampot to kinan na apuy, tan say pegleyto napoolan: Wala ta so kikanaan to ed bengatla a kimey?
Nia, sanen sikato so simoon ni, sikato so ag nipaakar ed bengatla a kimey: nagkalalo sirin a sanen kinan na apuy, tan apoolan, ya ag nipaakar ed bengatla a kimey?
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Singa say kiew na uvas ed nanleleetan na saray kiew ed takel, a sikato so initer ko ed apuy a itongo, ontan naani pangyawat ko ed saray manaayam ed Jerusalem.
Et yarap ko naani lupak a sumpa ed sikara: ompaway ira naani ed apuy, balet sikara naani kanen na apuy: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan, sano yarap ko so lupak a sumpa ed sikara.
Et gawaen ko naani so dalin a mankibalatar, ta nangawa ra na sakey ya inpakalokso, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Say salita lamet nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, ipakabat mo ed Jerusalem so saray kadimlaan to;
Et kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed Jerusalem: Say nanlapuan mo tan say niyanakan mo sikato so dalin na Kananeo; say Amorreo sikato so amam, tan say inam Jetea.
Et no nipaakar ed inkianak mo, sanen agew na inkianak mo say puseg mo ag aputer, tan agka met inurasan ed danum pian nalinisan ka; agka naasinan a balot, tan agka met apongos a balot.

Angapo so mata a nankawanan ed sika, pian gawaen to so angan anto ed saraya ed sika, a kasian to ka; no ag ingen nibantak ka ed maawang ya uma lapu ed say inkatoom sikato so ginula, dia ed agew ya inkianak mo.
Et sanen linmabas ak ed abay mo, tan anengneng ko a mantibtiblak ka ed dalam, inkuan ko ed sika, Angan wala ka ed dalam, manbilay ka; on, inkuan ko ed sika, Angan wala ka ed dalam, manbilay ka.

Siak pinarakel taka a singa say ontobo ed uma, et sika dinmakel ka tan binmaleg ka, tan nagmaliw ka a sankalimgasan a parakep; saray pagew mo binmaleg, tan say buek mo tinmobo: angan ontan lakseb ka nen saman tan angapo so sakbong mo.

Bang nen linmabas ak ed abay mo, tan sika so ninengneng ko, nia, say panaon mo sikato nen saman so panaon na aro; et inbuskag ko so kolibenben ko ed tapew mo, tan sinakbongan ko so inkalakseb mo: on, insambak ed sika, tan linmoobak ed sakey a sipan ed sika, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, et sika nagmaliw ka a kayarian ko.
Saman la inames ta ka na danum; on, nilinisan ko a maong so dalam ed sika, tan pinoyokan ta ka na larak.
Kinawesan ta ka met ed saray inalongan a gawa, sinapinan ta ka ed katat na foca, tan binalkesan ta ka ed liberliber na mayumis a lienzo, tan sinakbongan ta ka na sutla.
Et inalongan ta ka ed saray parakep, tan ininan ko na saray baklaw so saray limam, tan sakey a golonggolong ed tenger mo.
Et inyan ko so sakey a singsing ed eleng mo, tan ik-ikaw ed saray layag mo, tan sakey a marakep a balanget ed olom.

Onia so inkaalongan mo ed balitok tan pilak; et say kawes mo sikato so mayumis a lienzo, tan sutla, tan inalongan a gawa; angan ka na tapong na harina tan dilo, tan larak; et marakep ka a toloy nen saman, tan inmaligwas ka anga ed kipapasen a maari.
Et say galang mo pinmaway ed nanleleetan na saray nacion lapu ed karakpan mo; ta sikato so ayadyari lapu ed kaatageyan ko ya inyan ko ed sika, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Balet sika nanmatalek ka ed karakpan mo, tan akibalangkantis ka nisengeg ed inkibawag mo, tan inyibung mo so inkabalangkantis mo ed balang sakey a linmabas; sikato so kien to nen saman.

Et angala ka ed saray kawes mo, tan ginawam a nipaakar ed sika ray atagey a pasen a pinarakpan ed saray nambabangil a batek, tan akibalangkantis ka ed tapew da: say singa saraya a bengatla ag naani onsabi, tan sikato met naani aliwa ya ontan.
Inalam met iray marakep ya agamil mo a balitok ko tan pilak ko, a sikara so initer ko ed sika, tan ginawam a nipaakar ed sika a talintao na lalaki, tan akikalugoran ka ed sikara;
Et inalam so saray kawes mo ya inalongan, tan sinakbongan mo ra, tan inyan mo so larak ko tan say inciensok ed arap da.

Say tinapay ko met ya initer ko ed sika, sikato so tapong na harina, tan larak, tan dilo, ya inpantaganok ed sika, inyan mo ni ed arap da a panagkabalingit; et onia nen saman, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Laot ni inalam so saray anak mo a lalaki tan bibii, a sikara so inyanak mo nipaakar ed siak, et saraya inbagat mo ed sikara a naakmon. Saray inkabalangkantis mo sikara ta so melag pa lagi a bengatla,
Anta pinatey mo ray anak ko, tan sikara so inyawat mo, dia ed pangipalabas da ed sikara ed apuy?
Tan ed saray amin a kadimlaan tan inkabalangkantis mo agmo ninonot so saray agew na inkaugaw mo, sanen lakseb ka tan angapo so sakbong mo, tan nipatiblak ka ed dalam.
Et agawa kayari amin ya inkauges mo, (ay, ay, kasi ka la, kuan nen Katawan a Dios),
Ya angipaalagey ka nipaakar ed sika na sakey a binobedaan a pasen, tan nangawa ka ed sika na atagey a pasen ed balang oloan na polong,
Pinaalagey mo so atagey a pasen mo ed oloan na balang dalan, tan ginawam so kalimgasan mo a kadimlaan, tan nilukasan mo so saray salim ed balang linmabas, tan pinarakel mo so inkabalangkantis mo.
Nangawa ka met na pikakalogoran ed saray Egipcio, saray kaabay mo, ya angkakabaleg a laman; et pinarakel mo so inkabalangkantismo a panagyat ed siak a manpasnok.

Nia sirin, inyunat ko so limak ed sika, tan pinaraiset ko so ugalim a tagano, tan inyawat ta ka ed pankaliktanan na saray mangula ed sika, saray anak a bibii na saray Filisteo, ya ambaing ira lapu ed masabo a dalan mo.
Akibalangkantis ka met ed saray Asirio, lapu ed angapo so kapenekmo: on, akibalangkantis ka ed sikara, angan ontan agka ni apenek.
Pinarakel mo met so inkabalangkantis mo ed dalin na Kanaan, anga ed Caldea; angan ontan agka ni apenek ed sikato.
Agay lay inkakapuy na pusom, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, bangta gawaen mo raya ya amin a bengatla a gawa na sakey a magantil a balangkantis;
Lapu ed inpaalagey mo so abobedaan a pasen mo ed oloan na balang dalan, tan ginawam so atagey a pasen mo ed balang polong, tan aliwa ka a singa balangkantis, lapu ed balbalawen mo so upa.
Sakey ya asawan bii a manggawa na pikalogoran! ya alaen to so saray sankaili ed pasen na asawa to!

Sikara so mangiter na tokdol ed saray amin a balangkantis; balet sika so mangiter na saray tokdol ed saray amin a manangarom, tan suksukan mo ra, pian onla ra ed sika ed amin a diking nipaakar ed inkabalangkantis mo.

Et sika niduma ka ed saray arum a bibii ed saray inkabalangkantis mo lapu ed angapo so ontombok ed sika ed pibabalangkantis; tan bangta sika so mangiter na upa, et angapo so upa a niiter ed sika, kanian niduma ka.
Kanian, O balangkantis, denglen mo so salita nen Katawan.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Lapu ed naibung so inkadutak mo, tan say inkalakseb mo alukasan lapu ed saray inkabalangkantis mo ed saray kaaroan mo; tan lapu ed saray amin a talintao na kadimlaan mo, tan say dala na saray anak mo, ya initer mo ed sikara;

Dia ed ontan, nia, siak tiponen ko so saray amin a kaaroan mo ya akalaan mo na saray likeliket, tan saray amin ya inarom, pati saray amin a ginulam; et tiponen ko ra a sumpa ed sika ed amin a diking, tan ipatnag ko so inkalakseb mo ed sikara, pian nanengneng da so amin ya inkalakseb mo.
Et siak okomen ta ka naani, unong ed pangokom ed saray bibii a milawanan ed agda asawa tan mangibung na dala; et siak yakar ko naani ed sika so dala na sanok tan panimon.

Iter taka met naani «d lima ra et gaygayen da naani so binobedaan a pasen mo, tan bagbagen da naani ray atagey a pasen mo; et lakseban daka naani ed saray kawes mo, tan alaen da naani ray marakep ya agamil mo; et tainan da ka naani a lakseb tan angapo so sakbong mo.
Sikara met mangitatdang ira na sakey ya olop a sumpa ed sika, et topaken daka naani ed bato, tan duyoken da ka naani ed saray kampilan da.
Et puulan da naani ray abung mo na apuy, tan okomen da ka naani ed pakanengneng na dakel a bibii, tan siak patondaen ta ka naani ed pikakalugoran mo, tan agka met la naani mangiter na upa.
Dia ed ontan napanpainawak naani so sanok ko ed sika, tan say panimon ko nisian naani ed sika, tan agak la onesel naani, tan agak la naani nasanokan.

Lapu ed agmo ninodnonot so saray agew na inkaugaw mo, no ag ingen sinmanok ka sumpa ed siak ed saraya ya amin a bengatla, kanian nia siak ipawil ko met so dalan ko ed tapew na olom, kuan nen Katawan a Dios: ta angan saray kadimlaan mo agmo ni ninonot.
Nia, balang mangagamil na saray ulirán agamilen da so saya ya uliran sumpa ed sika, a kuanto, No anto so ina ontan met naani so anak to a bii.

Sika so anak a bii nen inam, a kinadimla to so asawa to tan saray anak to; et agi da ka na saray agagim a bibii, a sikara kinadimla ra so saray asawa ra tan saray anak da: say ina yo sakey a Jetea, tan say ama yo sakey ya Amorreo.

Et say agim a bii a pangoloan sikato so Samaria, a manaayam ed nikawigim, sikato tan saray anak to a bibii: et say yugtan ya agim a bii a manaayam ed nikawanan mo sikato so Sodoma tan saray anak to a bibii.

Angan ontan agka nanakar ed saray dalan da, tan agka met nangawa na unong ed saray kadimlaan da; balet, no sikara so sankamelagan a bengatla, sika lalo a marutak ka nen sikara ed saray amin a dalan mo.
Unong a mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, say Sodoma ya agim a bii ag nangawa, sikato tan angan saray anak to a bibii na singa say ginawam, sika tan saray anak mo a bibii.

Nia, saya so inkauges na agim a bii a Sodoma; kapangtaan, inkapenek na tinapay, tan inkadaakan na kamenengan so wala ed sikato tan dia ed saray anak to a bibii; agto met pinaksil so lima na duka tan naokolan.
Et sikara so pinmasirayew, tan nanggawa ra na kadimlaan ed arap ko: kanian inekal ko ra, unong ya anengneng ko a maong.

Say Samaria ag met nangawa na kapaldua na saray kasalanan mo; balet pinarakel mo ray kadimlaan mo a lalo nen Sikara, tan pinatunong mo ray agagim a bibii ed panamegley na saray amin a kadimlaan mo a ginawam.

Sika met awiten mo so dili a baing mo lapu ed inpangokom mo ed saray agagim a bibii; nisengeg ed saray kasalanan a ginawam a lalo a kadimlaan nen sikara, sikara so matunong nen say sika: On nagolo ka met, tan awiten mo so baing mo, lapu ed pinatunong mo so saray agagim a bibii.
Et siak ipawil ko lamet so kadakep da, say kadakep na Sodoma tan saray anak to a bibii, tan say kadakep na Samaria tan saray anak to a bibii, tan say kadakep na saray adakep mo dia ed pegley da;
Pian awiten mo so dilin baing mo, tan ombaing ka lapu ed saray amin a ginawam, sika so ligliwa ed sikara.

Et saray agagim a bibii, Sodoma tan saray anak da a bibii ompawil ira naani ed inmuna a kipapasen da; et say Samaria tan saray anak to a bibii ompawil ira naani ed inmuna a kipapasen da; sika met tan saray anak mo a bibii ompawil kayo naani ed inmuna a kipapasen yo.
Lapu ed say Sodoma ya agim a bii ag inolit na sangim ed agew na kapangtaan mo.
Arapen na kalukasan na inkalakseb mo, singa nen panaon na inkabalaw na saray anak a bibii na Siria, tan amin a liberliber to, ya anak a bibii na saray Filisteo, a manbalaw ed sika ed liberliber.
Sika intarok mo so inkasabom tan saray kadimlaan mo, kuan nen Katawan.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Gawaen ko met naani ed sika so ginawam, a nanmodmora na samba ed inpamagbag na sipan.
Angan ontan nonoten ko naani so insipan ko ed sika ed saray agew inkaugaw mo, tan iletneg ko naani ed sika so sipan a maando.

Dia ed ontan nanonotan mo naani ray dalan mo, et ombaing ka naani, sano awaten mo ray agagim a bibii, saray pangoloan ya agagim a bibii tan saray yugtan; et iter kora naani ed sika a singa anak ira a bibii balet aliwa a lapu ed sipan mo.
Et iletneg ko naani so sipan ko ed sika, et naamtaan mo naani a siak si Katawan;
Pian nanonotan mo, et nagolo ka tan angan kapigan agmo la isangi so sangim, lapu ed baing mo, sano paandien ko ed sika ray amin a ginawam, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, mangipaway ka na sakey a pabitla, tan mansalita ka na inyalimbawa ed abung na Israel:

Et kuan mo, Onia, so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sakey a baleg ya agila ya angkabaleg so saray payak to tan andurukey a payak makapal ya bago a nambabangil so batek, linma ed Libano, tan inala to so ngoro na cedro:
Binagot to so kasampotan na saray ankekelag ya simit to, tan inyakar to ed dalin na Kanaan; et inyan to ed ciudad so saray lomalako.
Angala met na bini na dalin, tan intanem to ed sakey ya uma a mabunga; inyan to ed abay na saray dakel a danum; tan inpasen to a singa sakey a kiew a babuyan.

Et tinmobo, tan nagmaliw a masanga ya uvas ya abeba, a saray sanga to arap ira ed sika to, tan saray lamut to wala ra ed lepsag to; dia ed ontan sikato so nagmaliw ya uvas, tan nansanga, tan nansimit.

Wala met nen saman so sananey ya agila a baleg ya angkakabaleg so payak to tan makapal so bago to: et, nia saya ya uvas inyoko to so saray lamut to ya arap ed sikato, manlapu ed panagpasekan na tanamanan to, pian sikato so nasalog.
Sikato so nitanem ed sakey ya mabuna a dalin ed abay na saray dakel a danum, pian mansanga, tan manbunga, tan sikato komon so sakey a marakep ya uvas.

Kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sikato kasi onaligwas? agto naani ta baguten iray lamut to, tan deralen iray bunga to, pian namagaan komon, pian saray amin a malambot a bulong to nalenes ira naani? et aliwa a sikato so nabagut ed panamegley na mabiskeg a taklay odino dakel a totoo a manlapu ed saray lamut to.
On, nia, lapu ed nitanem la, sikato ta so onaligwas? ag kasi naani namagaan ya andi kera, no sikato so siplogen na dagem a manlapu ed bokig? sikato naani namagaan ed panagpasekan a tinoboan to.
Ontan met say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Kuan mo natan ed abung a matunganga, Agyo ta ni amta so kabaliksan na saraya? ibagam ed sikara, Nia, say ari na Babilonia linma ed Jerusalem, et inala to so saray arari to, tan saray principe to, tan inyakar to ra ed Babilonia.
Et angala ed maari a bini, tan akisipan ed sikato; sikato'y inpansamba to met, tan inala to ray makapanyari na dalin;
Pian say nanarian napaabeba komon, pian ag komon ontagey, no ag ingen lapu ed panangonor ed sipan to sikato so makapansiansia.

Balet sikato'y tinmunganga a sumpa ed sikato dia ed inpangigangan to na saray ibabaki to ed Egipto, pian sikato komon so itdan da na kabayo tan dakel a totoo. Onaligwas kasi naani? Makaliktar kasi so nangawa ed saraya a bengatla? deralen to kasi naani so sipan, tan makatainan kasi ni?

Unong a mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, andi duarua a dia ed pasen a panayaman na ari a nangawa ed sikato ya ari, a say samba to minodmora to, tan say sipan to dineral to, pati sikato ni dia ed pegley na Babilonia ompatey naani.
Ag met naani tulongan nen Faraon ed baleg ya ejercito to tan baleg ya olop to ed bakal, sano mangipaalagey ira na saray pokdol tan mangipaalagey na saray salimbeng, pian utasen da so dakel a totoo.
Ta minodmora to so samba lapu ed inpaneral na sipan; et nia, sikato initer to so lima to, et angan ontan ginawa to raya a bengatla ya atnin; sikato ag naani ontainan.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; unong a siak mabilay ak, petepeteg a say sambak a minodmora to, tan say sipan ko a dineral to, sikato so yakar ko ed olo to lanlamang.
Et ibuskag ko naani ed sikato so iket ko, et naerel naani ed kalot ko, tan yakar ko naani ed Babilonia tan onloob ak naani ed kaokom pati sikatod' man lapu ed inpakalokso ya inlokso to sumpa ed siak.

Et saray amin a tinmainan ed saray amin a kaolop to nipasag ira naani ed kampilan, et saray natilak nisibwag ira naani ed saray amin a dagem: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak la.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Mangala ak met naani ed atagey a ngoro na cedro, tan sikato naani iletneg ko; mamuter ak naani ed kangoroan na saray ankekelag a simit to ed sakey a malangwer, a sanga et sikato naani itanem ko ed tapew na atagey tan baleg a palandey.

Ed palandey na kaatageyan na Israel sikato naani itanem ko; et sikato naani mansanga, tan manbunga, tan magmaliw a malimgas a cedro; et dia ed silong to manayam naani so amin a manok a nambabangil a payak; ed sirom na saray sanga to manayam ira naani.

Et saray amin a kiew ed uma naamtaan da naani a siak, si Katawan, pinaabebak so atagey a kiew, inpaatagey ko so abeba a kiew, pinamagak so malambot a kiew, tan pinalambot ko so amaga a kiew: Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak tan ginawak.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anto so labay yo a salitaen, ya agamilen yo so saya ya uliran nipaakar ed dalin na Israel, a kuan yo, Saray kaamaan kinan da so uvas ya anapseng et saray ngipen na saray ugugaw akilem?
Unong a siak mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, angapo la naani kibanaan ed pangagamilan yo na saya ya uliran dia ed Israel.
Nia, amin a kakamarerwa kien ko; singa say kamarerwa na ama ontan met so kamarerwa na anak a laki kien ko; say kamarerwa a mankasalanan ompatey naani.
Balet no say sakey a too sikato so matunong, tan gawaen to so unong ed matunong tan maptek,

Tan ag angan dia ed tapew na saray palandey, tan agto met intangay so saray mata to ed saray talintao ed palandey na Israel, tan agto met dinumsisan so asawa na kapara to a too, agto met siningeran so sakey a bii ed kaliberan to na bulan,
Tan ag to dinuksa so angan siopa, no ag ingen inpawil to ed akautangan so insanla to, angapo so inala to a tinakew, initer to so tinapay to ed narasan, tan kinawesan to so lakseb ed kawes;
Say ag nanpaanak, tan ag met angawat na masolok, ya tubo ya inpaliis to so lima to ed inkauges, ginawa to so tua ya inkatunong ed leet na too tan too,
Nanakar ed saray panontonan ko, tan inonor to ray pangoksoyan ko a, nanagamil a matood; sikato so matunong, ag onlaron a sikato naani manbilay, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
No sikato manilalak naani na sakey a laki a matakew, sakey a manangibung na dala, tan mangawa na angan anto ed saraya a bengatla,
Et agto gawaen so angan anto ed saraman a kanepegan, no ag ingen angan ed tapew na saray palandey, tan dinumsisan to so asawa na kapara to a too,
Dinuksa to so duka tan naokolan, angala na tinakew, agto impawil so sanla, tan intangay to ray mata to ed saray talintao, nangawa na kadimlaan,

Nanpaanak tan angawat na masolok: sikato naani kasi sirin so manbilay? ag naani manbilay: ginawa to so saraya ya amin a kadimlaan; ag onlaron a sikato so ompatey naani; say dala to wala naani ed tapew to.
Nia, bang no manilalak naani na sakey a laki, a makanengneng na saray kasalanan nen ama to a ginawa to, et ontakot, tan agto gawaen so singa saraman;
Ya ag angan ed tapew na saray palandey, tan agto met intangay so saray mata to ed saray talintao ed abung na Israel, agto dinumsisan so asawa na kapara to a too;
Agto met dinuksa so angan siopa, ag angawat na sanla, tan ag met angala na tinakew, no ag ingen initer to so tinapay to ed narasan, tan sinakbongan to so lakseb ed kawes;

Ya inpaliis to so lima to ed duka, ag angawat na abang odino tubo, ginawa to ray pangoksoyan ko, nanakar ed saray panontonan ko; sikato naani ag ompatey lapu ed inkauges nen ama to sikato so manbilay naani ya ag onlaron.
Nipaakar ed ama to, lapu ed amairap a masulisulit, tinakewan to so agi to, tan ginawa to so aliwa a maong ed pegley na baley to, nia, sikato so ompatey naani ed inkauges to.

Angan ontan kuan yo ni, Akin et say anak agto awiten so kasalanan nen ama to? Sano say anak a laki ginawa to so nikatunongan tan maptek, tan sinumpal to ray amin a panontonan ko, tan ginawa to ra, sikato so manbilay naani ya ag onlaron.

Say kamarerwa a mankasalanan ompatey naani: say anak a laki agto naani awiten so inkauges nen ama to, et say ama agto met naani awiten so inkauges na anak to a laki; say inkatunong na matunong wala naani ed sikato, tan say inkauges na marelmeng wala naani ed sikato.

Balet no say marelmeng pagbabawien to ray amin a kasalanan to a ginawa to, tan sumpalen to ray amin a panontonan ko, tan gawaen to so nikatunungan tan kaptekan, sikato so manbilay naani ya ag onlaron, ag naani ompatey.
Angapo ed saray inpakalokso to a ginawa to so nanonotan a sumpa ed sikato: dia ed inkatunong to a ginawa to sikato so manbilay naani.
Wala ta so bengatla a liket ko ed ipatey na marelmeng? kuan nen Katawan a Dios; ag magmaong ta a sikato ompawil komon a manlapu ed dalan to, tan manbilay?

Balet no say matunong onsian ed inkatunong to, et mangawa na inkauges, tan mangawa na unong ed saray amin a kadimla a gawaen na marelmeng a too, sikato ta so manbilay naani? Angapo naani ed saray matunong a gawa to a ginawa to so nanonotan? dia ed inpakalokso to a sikato so akaloksoan to, tan dia ed kasalanan to a nankasalanan to, dia ed sikara ompatey naani.
Angan ontan kuan yo ni, Say dalan na Katawan ag nanpadpara, Denglen yo natan, O abung na Israel: Ag ta nanpapara so dalan ko? aliwata a saray dalan yo so nanduruma?
No say matunong a too onsian ed inkatunong to, tan mangawa na inkauges, tan sikato so ompatey ed inkauges to; dia ed inkauges a ginawa to ompatey naani.
Ontan met, sano say marelmeng a too ompawil a manlapu ed karelmengan to a ginawa to, tan gawaen to so nikatunongan tan maptek, ilaban to naani kamarerwa to a mabilay.
Lapu ed isipen to, tan onsian ed saray amin ya inpakasumlang to a ginawa to, sikato manbilay naani ya ag onlaron, ag naani ompatey.
Angan ontan say abung na Israel kuan to, Say dalan na Katawan ag nanpapara. O abung na Israel, aliwa ta ya nanpapara so dalan ko? aliwa ta a saray dalan yo so ag nanpapara?

Kanian siak okomen ta ka naani, O abung na Israel, balang sakey unong ed dalan to, kuan nen Katawan a Dios. Ompawil kayo, tan tainan yo ray amin ya inpakasumlang yo; pian say inkauges aliwan sikato naani kaderalan yo.

Ibantak yo a manlapu ed sikayo so saray amin ya inpakasumlang yo, a sikara so akasumlangan yo; et mangawa kayo na sakey a puso a balo tan sakey ya espiritu a balo; ta akin et ompatey kayo naani, O abung na Israel?
Ta angapo so gayagak ed ipatey na ompatey, kuan nen Katawan a Dios: manpataoli kayo sirin, tan manbilay kayo.
Ontan met, sika gawaen mo so sakey a tagleey lapu ed saray principe na Israel,
Et kuan mo, Siopa nen saman so inam? Sakey a leon a kabatyan: akiarol ed saray leon, dia ed pegley na saray tobonbalo a leon sikato kinumisan to ray kilaw to.
Et pinabaleg to so sakey ed saray kilaw to; et nagmaliw a tobonbalo a leon, tan nanaral a maneral na samsam; sikato nantuklab na totoo.
Saray nacion met nadngelan da so nipaakar ed sikato; sikato so narel ed kalinsorong da: et inyakar da ed panamegley na saray balangkat anga ed dalin na Egipto.
Bang nen anengneng to a sikato so manalagar, tan say ilalo to abalang, saman la angala na sananey ed saray kilaw to, tan sikato so ginawa to a tobonbalo a leon.
Et sikato so tinmatdang tan linmasor ed nanleleetan na saray leon; sikato nagmaliw a tobonbalo a leon, tan nanaral a manerel na samsam; sikato so nantuklab na totoo.
Et sikato naamtaan to ray palacio ra, tan binagbag to so saray ciudad da; et say dalin nankibalatar, tan say inkadaakan to, lapu ed ongol na panengak to.
Saman la saray nacion sinmumpa ed sikato ed amin a diking a nanlapu ed saray luyag; et inbuskag da so iket da ed tapew to; sikato so narel ed kalinsorong da.

Et sikato so inyan da ed sakey a kolongan ya akabalangkat, tan inyakar da ed ari na Babilonia; sikato so inloob da ed saray salimbeng, pian say voces to ag la komon narengel ed saray palandey na Israel.
Si inam sikato nen saman so singa sakey ya uvas, dia ed dalam, nitanem ed abay na saray danum: sikato so mabunga tan masanga lapu ed saray dakel a danum.

Et sikato walaan. nen saman na mabiskeg a tayokod to a sikara so cetro ed saray managuley, et say kabaleg da nipaatagey ed nanleleetan na saray makdel a sanga to, et sikara so anengneng ed kaatageyan da pati kinarakel na saray sanga ra.
Balet sikato so abagut ed sanok, nibantak ed dalin, tan say bunga to pinamagaan na dagem ed bokig; saray mabiskeg a tayokor to aputerputer ira tan amagaan ira; say apuy inopot to ra.
Et natan sikato so nitanem ed kalawakan, dia ed amaga tan naklangan a dalin.

Et pinmaway so apuy ed saray tayokor na saray sanga to, kinan to so bunga to, pian angapo ed sikato so mabiskeg a tayokor a magmaliw a cetro ed managuley. Saya sikato so sakey a tagleey, et sikato naani nipaakar a tagleey.
Et agawa dia ed komapito a taon, dia ed komalima a bulan, say komaplo ya agew na bulan, ya arum ed saray mamasiken na Israel linma ra a mibalita ed Katawan, et imyorong ira ed arap ko.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, mansalita ka ed saray mamasiken na Israel, tan kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Linma kayo dia a mibalita ed siak? Unong a siak mabilayak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios ag yoak naani napibalitaan.
Okomen mo ta ra, anak na too, okomen mo ta ra? Ipakabat mo ed sikara so saray kadimla na saray atateng da;

Et kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dia ed agew ya inpamilik ed Israel, tan sinambaan ko ed kailalakan na abung nen Jacob, tan inpakabat ko so inkasiak ed sikara ed dalin na Egipto, sanen sinambaan ko ed sikara, ya inkuan ko, Siak si Katawan a Dios yo:

Dia ed saman ya agew insambak ed sikara ya agwaten kora a manlapu ed dalin na Egipto ya yakar ed dalin ya intalagak ed sikara, a panagagusan na gatas tan dilo, a sikato so dayew na saray amin a dalin.
Et inkuan ko ed sikara, ibantak yo balang too so saray kadimlaan na saray mata to, tan agyo dumsisan so inkasikayo ed saray talintao na Egipto; Siak si Katawan a Dios yo.

Balet tinmunganga ra a sumpa ed siak, tan ag ira tinmalineng ed siak; ag inbantak na balang sakey so saray kadimlaan na saray mata to, tan agda met inkaindan iray talintao na Egipto. Saman la inkuan ko ya yibung ko so sanok ko ed sikara, pian nasumpal so sanok ko a sum pa ed sikara ed pegley na dalin na Egipto.

Balet siak nangawa ak lapu ed kakanaan na ngaran ko, pian ag komon namodmora ed pakanengneng na saray nacion, a dia ed nanleleetan da so kawalaan da nen saman, dia ed pakanengneng da inpakabat ko so inkasiak ed sikara, dia ed inpangipaway ko ed sikara a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto.
Dia ed ontan pinapaway ko ra a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto, tan inyakar ko ra ed kalawakan.
Et initer ko ed sikara so saray panontonan ko, tan inpanengneng ko ed sikara so saray pangoksoyan ko, a no sikara so gawaen na too, sikato so manbilay naani ed sikara.
Laot ni initer ko met ed sikara so saray agew ko a sabaton, a sikara so tanda ed siak tan sikara, pian naamtaan da komon a siak si Katawan a mamasanto ed sikara.

Balet say abung na Israel tinmunganga a sumpa ed siak ed kalawakan; ag ira nanakar ed saray panontonan ko, tan inpolisay da ray pangoksoyan ko, a no sikara so gawaen na too, sikato so manbilay ed sikara; et saray sabaton ko minodmora ra a toloy. Saman la inkuan ko ya yibung ko so sanok ko ed tapew da ed kalawakan, pian naopot ira.
Balet nangawaak a lapu ed kakanaan na ngaran ko, pian sikato komon so ag namodmora ed pakanengneng na saray nacion, a dia ed pakanengneng da inagwat ko ra.
Laot ni insambak met ed sikara ed kalawakan, ya agko ra yakar ed dalin ya initer ko ed sikara, a panagagusan na gatas tan dilo, a sikato so dayew na saray amin a dalin;
Ta sikara impolisay da so saray pangoksoyan ko, tan ag ira nanakar ed saray panontonan ko, tan minodmora ra so saray sabaton ko: lapu ed say puso ra tinmombok ed saray talintao ra.
Angan ontan say matak insakit tora, tan sikara so agko binagbag, agak met nangawa na ayadyari a kasampotan da ed kalawakan.
Et inkuan ko ed saray anak da ed kalawakan, Agkayo manakar ed saray panontonan na saray atateng yo, tan agyo met onoren iray pangoksoyan da, agyo met dutakan so inkasikayo ed saray talintao ra.
Siak si Katawan a Dios yo; manakar kayo ed saray panontonan ko; tan onoren yo ray pangoksoyan ko, tan gawaen yo ra;
Et ngilinen yo ray sabaton ko: et sikara naani so tanda ed siak tan sikayo, pian komon naamtaan yo a siak si Katawan a Dios yo.

Balet saray anak tinmunganga ra sumpa ed siak: ag ira nanakar ed saray panontonan ko, agda met inonor so saray pangoksoyan ko pian gawaen dara, a no sikara so gawaen na too, sikato so manbilay ed sikara; sikara minodmora ra so saray sabaton ko. Saman la inkuan ko ya yibung ko so sanok ko ed sikara pian nasumpal ko so sanok ko sumpa ed sikara ed kalawakan.
Angan ontan pinokpokan ko so limak, tan nangawa ak a lapu ed kakanaan na ngaran ko, pian sikato komon so ag namodmora ed pakanengneng na saray nacion, a dia ed pakanengneng da inpaway kora.
Laot ni sinambaan ko ed sikara ed kalawakan, a siak ikayat ko ra naani ed saray nacion, tan ibuyak ko ra naani ed saray dalin;
Lapud'no agda ginawa so saray pangoksoyan ko, no ag ingen inpolisay da so panontonan ko, tan minodmora ra so saray sabaton ko, tan saray mata ra tinmombok ed saray talintao na saray atateng da.
Laot ni initdan ko ra met na saray panontonan ya aliwan maong, tan saray pangoksoyan a dia ed sikara ag ira makapanbilay;

Tan dinutakan ko ra ed saray dili a tokdol da, dia ed pangipalabas da ed apuy ed amin a mangilukas na panaganakan, pian gawaen ko ra a mankibalatar, anga ed kasumpalan a pakaamtaan da a siak si Katawan.

Kanian, anak na too, mansalita ka ed abung na Israel, tan kuan mo ed sikara Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dia ed saya laot ni a saray atateng yo minodmora ra ak, ed inpangawa ra na sakey a pakasumlang a sumpa ed siak.

Ta sanen inyakar ko ra ed dalin, a sikato so sinambaan ko ya iter ed sikara, saman la anengneng da so balang atagey a pokdol, tan balang makdel a kiew, et inyapaydad man so saray bagat da, tan diman inpatnag da so pananagyat na bagat da; diman met ginawa ra so saray mansamiong a balingit da, tan diman inkalbo ra so saray bagat da ya iinumen.
Saman la inkuan ko ed sikara, Anto so kipaakaran na atagey a pasen a laen yo? Kanian say ngaran to sikato so atawag a Bama anga ed natan ya agew.
Kuan mo sirin ed abung na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dutakan yo ta so inkasikayo lanlamang unong ed ugali na saray atateng yo? tan mikalugoran kayo ta ya ontombok ed saray kadimlaan da?

Tan sano yapay yo ray tokdol yo, sano gawaen yo ray anak yo a lalaki ya onlabas ed apuy, dutakan yo ta so inkasikayo lanlamang ed saray amin ya talintao yo anga ed sayan agew? tan siak ta naani pibalitaan yo, O abung na Israel? Unong a siak mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, ag yoak naani napibalitaan.
Et say onia ed kanonotan yo ag naani nagawa a mogmo, dia ed pangikuan yo, Singa kami naani saray nacion, singa saray kabaley ed saray dalin, a manlingkor ed kiew tan bato.
Unong a siak mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, petepeteg a lapu ed lima a mabiskeg tan akaunat a taklay, tan sanok a naibung, manari ak naani ed sikayo.
Et ipaway takayo naani ed saray baley, tan tiponen takayo a manlapu ed saray dalin a nikayatan yo lapu ed lima a mabiskeg, tan akaunat a taklay tan sanok a naibung;
Et yakar takayo naani ed kalawakan na saray baley, et diman onloob ak naani ed pangokom ed sikayo ed lupanlupa.
Singa say inloob ko ed pangokom ed saray atateng yo ed kalawakan ed dalin na Egipto, ontan met so iloob ko naani ed pangokom ed sikayo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et palabasen takayo naani ed lepsag na tayokor, tan yakar takayo naani ed siglaot na sipan;

Et ibiig ko naani a manlapu ed sikayo so saray matunganga, tan saray tinmunganga a sumpa ed siak; ipaway kora naani ed dalin a panayaman da, balet ag ira naani onloob ed dalin ya Israel: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.

Nipaakar ed sikayo, O abung na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; Onlakayo, manlingkor kayo a balang sakey ed saray talintao, tan manlapu ed natan met, no agkayo ontalineng ed siak; balet say masanto a ngaran ko agyo la naani modmoraen ed saray tokdol yo, tan ed saray talintao yo.

Ta dia ed masanto a palandey ko, dia ed palandey ya atagey na Israel, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, diman amin ya abung na Israel, sikara ya amin, manlingkor ira naani ed siak dia ed dalin; diman awaten kora naani, tan diman anapen ko naani ray bagat yo, tan saray ununa a bunga na pangisaklang yo, tan saray amin a kayarian yo a masanto.

Singa sakey ya ambalingit a samiong awaten takayo naani, sano ipaway takayo ed saray baley, tan tiponen takayo a manlapu ed saray dalin a nikayatan yo; et siak napasanto ak naani ed sikayo ed pakanengneng na saray nacion.
Et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan, sano yakar takayo ed dalin na Israel, ed dalin a sinambaan ko ya iter ko ed saray atateng yo.

Et diman nanonotan yo naani ray dalan ko, tan saray amin a gawa yo, ya adutakan yo lanlamang; et kagula yo naani so inkasikayo lanlamang ed pakanengneng yo a dili lapu ed saray amin a mauges a ginawa yo.

Et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan, sano gawaen ko ed sikayo lapu ed kakanaan na ngaran ko, aliwa a lapu ed saray mauges a dalan yo odino unong ed saray mauges a gawa yo, O sikayo abung na Israel, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam ed abalaten, tan itedter mo so salitam ed dapit abalaten, tan manprofeta ka sumpa ed takel na uma na Abalaten;

Tan kuan mo ed takel na Abalaten; Denglen mo so salita nen Katawan: Onia so kuan hen Katawan a Dios, Nia, selselan ko naani ed sika so sakey ya apuy, et kanen to naani so amin a kiew a malambot, tan amin a kiew ya amaga: say mandarlang a layap ag naani naerep, tan amin a lupa a manlapu ed abalaten anga ed amianen napuulan naani lapu ed sikato.
Et amin a laman nanengneng to naani a siak, si Katawan, so amarlang ed sikato; ag naani naerep.
Saman la inkuan ko, A Katawan a Dios! kuan da a nipaakar ed siak, Aliwa tan sikato so masalita na alimbawa?
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam ed Jerusalem; tan itedter mo so salitam ya arap ed saray santuario, tan iprofetam so sumpa ed dalin na Israel.
Et kuan mo ed dalin na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Nia, onsumpa ak ed sika, et baguten ko naani so kampilan ko ed kaloban to, et tapsingen ko naani ed sika so maptek tan pikewet.
Bangta sirin ya tapsingen ko ed sika naani so maptek tan pikewet, kanian say kampilan ko nabagut naani ed kaloban to a sumpa ed amin a laman a manlapu ed abalaten anga ed amianen:
Et amin a laman naamtaan to naani a siak, si Katawan, binagut ko so kampilan ko ed kaloban to; et ag la naani ompawil.
Mansibek ka sirin, sika anak ya laki na too; lapu ed kabetag na saray banel mo tan mansibek ka naani ya ampaipait ed arap na saray mata ra.

Et nagawa naani, no kuan da ed sika, Akin et mansibek ka? a sika kuan mo naani, Lapu ed saray balita, ta sikara so onsabi; et amin a puso natunaw naani, tan amin a lima onkapuy naani, tan amin ya espiritu napunaw naani, tan amin a pueg onkapuy naani a singa danum; nia onsabi, tan nagawa naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Ikuan mo, Sakey a kampilan, sakey a kampilan, napatarem, tan napasileng met;
Sikato so napatarem pian napamatey, napasileng pian magmaliw a singa kirmat: mangawa itayo sirin kasi na liket? say tayokor na anak ko a laki modmoraen to so amin a kiew.
Et sikato so niiter a napasileng, pian nabenbenan: say kampilan napatarem, on, napasileng, pian niyawat ed lima na managpatey.

Onakis ka tan managogol ka, anak na too; ta sikato so wala ed tapew na baley ko, wala ed amin a principe na Israel: sikara so niyawat ed kampilan a pati say baley ko; kabilen mo sirin so tapew na ulpom.
Ta wala so panalsalian; et anto no say tayokor lanlamang a manmodmora andi la naani? kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Sika sirin, anak na too, manprofeta ka, tan pantipaken mo ray limam; et paulian mo so kampilan a napiko ed komatlo a danay, say kampilan na asugatan na makapatey; sikato so kampilan na baleg ya asugatan na makapatey, ya onloob ed saray silirda.

Impasen ko so mangigagaem a kampilan a sumpa ed saray amin ya wangalan da, pian say puso ra natunaw komon, tan saray kigapol da ondakel komon: ay! sikato so nagawa a singa kirmat, naotokan a nipaakar ed panagpatey.
Mantipon ka, onla ka ed nikawanan, ondasig ka, onia ka ed nikawigi, angan iner a kipaarapan na lupam.
Pantipaken ko met naani ray limak tan pampainawaen ko naani so sanok ko; siak si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Ontan met, sika anak na too, manoro ka na duaran dalan, a dalanen no onsabi so kampilan na ari ed Babilonia; sikara a dua ompaway ira naani ed sakey a dalin: tan mananda ka na sakey a pasen, sikato so tandaan mo ed oloan na dalan ya onarap ed ciudad.
Sika manoro ka na sakey a dalan ed kampilan ya onla ed Rabbat ed saray anak nen Ammon, tan ed Juda ed Jerusalem a kinutaan.
Ta say ari na Babilonia inmalagey ed pansisianan na dalan, ed oloan na duaran dalan, pian gawaen to so pamarles: pinagpag to so saray pana a pinawilpawil, akibalita ed terafin, ninmengneng ed altey.

Dia ed nikawanan a lima to wala nen saman so paries a nipaakar ed Jerusalem, pian yan to ray pamaakaran a pamagbag, lukasan to so sangi ed panagpatey, itagey to so voces ed paneyag, yan to ray kagawaan a pamagbag a sumpa ed saray wangalan, pian mangipaalagey na saray pokdol, mangipaalagey na saray salimbeng.
Et sikato naani ed sikara so singa matila a pomaparles ed pakanengneng da, a sikato so nansamba na saray samba ed sikara; balet sikato mangyakar na inkauges a pakanonotan, pian sikara naerel ira.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed inpanonot yo so inkauges yo, lapu ed saray inpakasumlang yo alukasan ira, dia ed ontan dia ed saray amin a gawa yo saray kasalanan yo ompatnag; lapu ed sinmabi kayo ed pakanonot, naerel kayo naani ed lima.
Et sika, O sugatan ed makapatey a marelmeng, principe na Israel, a say agew to sinmabi, dia ed panaon na inkauges na kasumpalan,
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; Yalis mo so mitra, tan ekalen mo so balanget; saya aliwa la naani ya onia; ipaatagey mo so abeba, tan yabebam so atagey.
Baliktaren ko, baliktaren ko, sikato naani baliktaren ko: saya angapo met la naani, anga ed onsabi so akankanepegan; et sikato naani iter ko ed sikato

Et sika, anak na too, manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios a nipaakar ed saray anak nen Ammon, tan nipaakar ed kibabaing da; et sika ikuan mo, Sakey a kampilan, sakey a kampilan so nabagut, nipaakar ed panagpatey sikato so napasileng, pian sikato so pangakmonen, pian sikato naani singa kirmat;

Leleg a nengnengen da so matila a pasingawey a nipaakar ed sika, leleg a mangiparles ira na saray tila ed sika, pian igaton da ka ed saray tenger na saray marelmeng ya sugatan na makapatey, a say agew da onsabi la ed panaon na inkauges na kasumpalan.
Sikato so papawilen mo ed kaluban to. Ed pasen ya akapalsaan mo, ed dalin a nianakan mo, okomen taka naani.
Et yibung ko naani so sanok ko ed sika; sika so sibukan ko ed apuy na sanok ko; et yawat taka naani ed lima na saray muan a totoo a maong a manbagbag.
Sika naani so itungo ed apuy; say dalam wala naani ed pegley na dalin; agka la naani nanonotan: ta siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak.
Ontan met say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Et sika, anak na too, okomen mo ta, okomen mo ta so kadaladala a ciudad? ipakabat mo sirin ed sikato so saray amin a kadimlaan to.

Et sika kuan mo naani, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sakey a ciudad a mangibung na dala ed pegley to, pian say panaon to onsabi komon, tan mangawa na dirios a sumpa ed sikato lanlamang a manutak ed sikato!

Sika nagmaliw ka a nankasalanan ed dalam ya inibung mo, tan nadutakan ka ed dirios a ginawam; et pinaasinger mo so saray agew mo, tan sinmabi ka la anga lanlamang ed saray taon mo: kanian ginawa taka a kibabaingan ed saray nacion, tan balabalaw ed saray amin a dalin.
Saraman so asinger, tan saraman so arawi, sika naani balbalawen da, sika ya andian na dayew tan napno na golo.
Nia, saray principe na Israel, balang sakey unong ed pakayari to, wala ra nen saman ed sika pian mangibung na dala.
Ed sika agda pinabli so ama tan ina; ed pegley mo nangawa ra na panangapos ed saray manaayam; ed sika dinuksa ra so ulila tan balo.
Binalaw mo so saray masantos ko a bengatla, tan minoram so saray sabaton ko.
Saray managpauges a totoo wala ra nen saman ed sika a mangibung na dala; et dia ed sika angan ira ed tapew na saray palandey: dia ed pegley mo nangawa ka na inkalawan.
Dia ed sika nilukasan da so inkalakseb na saray atateng da; dia ed sika inpangabeba ra so bii ya agmalinis ed kaliberan to na bulan.

Et say sakey nangawa na kadimlaan ed asawa na kapara to a too; et say sakey dinumsisan to a masabosabo so manugang to a bii; et say sananey dia ed sika inpangabeba to so agi to a bii, say anak a bii nen ama to,

Dia ed sika angala ra na saray panuksuk pian mangibung ira na dala; angala ka na upa tan nanpaanak ka a maagum ed saray kaparam a totoo lapu ed panangapos, et sika nilingoanan moak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Nia, sirin, kinabil ko so limak ed makapabaing ya agum a ginawam, tan ed dalam ya wala nen saman ed pegley mo.
Nayarian ta na pusom so mantepel, odino nayarian ta na saray liman so ombiskeg ed saray agew a panagamil ko ed sika? Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak, et gawaen ko naani.
Et itayak taka naani ed saray nacion, tan ibuyak taka naani ed saray dalin: et opoten ko naani so inkadutak mo a manlapu ed sika.
Et namora ka naani ed sika lanlamang, dia ed pakanengneng na saray nacion; et naamtaan mo naani a siak si Katawan.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, say abung na Israel nagmaliw a lati ed siak: sikara ya amin nagmaliw ira a gansa tan lata tan balatyang tan ismay, dia ed pegley na palbaan; sikara so lati na pilak.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed nagmaliw kayo ya amin a lati, nia, sirin, tiponen takayo naani ed pegley na Jerusalem.

Singa panipon da na pilak tan gansa tan balatyang tan ismay tan lata ed dalem na palbaan, a sibukan da so apuy ed tapew to, pian sikara so tunawen da; ontan so panipon ko ed sikayo ed sanok ko tan ed petang ko, tan igaton takayo naanid'man, tan tunawen takayo naani.
On, tiponen takayo naani, tan sibukan ko naani tapew yo na apuy na sanok ko, et sikayo natunaw'kayo naani dia ed pegley to.
Singa say pilak natunaw ed pegley na palbaan, ontan naani so katunaw yo ed pegley to; et naamtaan yo naani a siak, si Katawan, inibung ko so sanok ko ed sikayo.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, ikuan mo ed sikato, Sika sakey ka a dalin ya ag nalinisan ag met nauran ed agew na kasanokan.

Wala so yaalagey na saray profeta to ed pegley to, a singa panengak na leon a mantuklab na samsam: sikara nantuklab ira na kakamarerwa; sikara angala ra na kayamanan tan mabli a bengabengatla; pinarakel da so saray babalo to a bibii ed pegley to.

Saray sacerdote to nangawa ra na paneral ed tunong ko, tan minura ra so saray masantos ko a bengatla; ag ira nangawa na inpangibiig ed masanto tan say karaklan, agda met ginawa so totoo a mamidbir na agmalinis tan malinis, tan inyamot da ray mata ra a manlapu ed saray sabaton ko, tan siak so amura ed nanleleetan da.
Saray principe to singa ra saray lobo a mangakmon na samsam, a mangibung na dala, tan manderal na kamarerwa, pian makagamor ira na mauges a totoo.

Et saray profeta to nanpalanas ira a nipaakar ed sikara ya agda inagamil so akames a masa, lapu ed kanenengneng da ed saray matila a pasingawey, tan nanparles ira na tilatila ed sikara, ya inkuan da, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, anta sikato so ag sinalita nen Katawan.
Saray totoo ed dalin inagamil da so panangapos tan inagamil da so panagtakew; on, pinaermen da so duka tan naokolan, tan inaposan da ya ag onkatunongan so sankaili.
Et nananap ak na sakey a too ed nanleleetan da, a mangipaalagey komon na bakor, tan onalagey dia ed butaw ed arap ko nipaakar ed dalin, pian sikato komon so agko deralen; balet angapo so aromog ko.
Kanian inibung ko so sanok ko ed sikara; inopot ko ra ed apuy na sanok ko: say dalan da lanlamang inyakar ko ed tapew na saray olo ra, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, wala nen saman so duara a bibii, anak ira na sakey ya ina:
Et sikara akibalangkantis ira ed Egipto; akibalangkantis ira ed kaugawan da; diman akames so saray pagew da, tan diman naegnaan so akualan na inkavirgen da:

Et say ngaran da Ahola so pangoloan, tan Aholiba so agi to: et sikara nagmaliw ira a kayarian ko, tan nananak ira na lalaki tan bibii. Et nipaakar ed ngaran da, Samaria so Ahola, tan Jerusalem so Aholiba.
Et si Ahola akibalangkantis sanen sikato so kien ko: et sikato so adakep ed saray manangaro to, ed saray Asirio a kaabay to,
A sikara so akawesan na azul, managuley tan diputado ra, amin da makapalikliket ira a balolaki, nagnapan ya akakabayo ed saray kabayo.
Et inyabobon to so inkabalangkantis ed sikara, saray apili a lalaki na Asiria ya amin da; tan ed siopaman ya adakepan to, ed saray amin ya talintao ra dinutakan to so inkasikato.

Et agto met pinaulian so saray inkabalangkantis a nanlapu ed saray agew na Egipto; ta dia ed inkaugaw to akiarol ira ed sikato, tan inegnaan da so akualan na inka virgen to; et inibung da so inkabalangkantis da ed sikato.
Kanian sikato so inyawat ko ed lima na saray kaaroan to, ed lima na saray Asirio a sikara so adakepan to,

Saraya linukasan da so inkalakseb to; inala ra so saray anak to a lalaki tan bibii: et sikato so pinatey da ed kampilan; et sikato so nagmaliw a konwari a salita ed saray bibii; ta ginawa ra so pangokom ed sikato.

Et say agi to a bii a Aholiba anengneng to ya, et sikato so nagkalalo ni a mauges so inkamaramag to nen sikato; tan dia ed saray inpibalangkantis a nagkalalo ra nen saray inkabalangkantis nen agi to a bii.
Dinamagan to so saray Asirio, saray managuley tan diputado, a kaabay to, ya akawesan a sankarakpan, nagnapan ya akakabayo ed saray kabayo, aminda makapalikliket a balolaki.
Et anengneng ko a sikato adutakan; sikara a dua nanakar ira ed sakey a dalan.
Et sikato inaruman to ray inkabalangkantis to; ta akanengneng na saray lalaki a nipinta ed bakor, saray talintao na saray Caldeo ya inpinta ed bermellon,

Ya abalkesan ed saray balkes ed saray banel da, ya wala so pamulaw ed saray olo ra, sikara ya amin principe ra ed pakanengneng, singa kapadpara na saray taga Babilonia ed Caldea, a dalin a nianakan da.
Et kanengneng to ed sikara dinmamag ed sikara, tan nangangan na saray ibabaki ed sikara ed Caldea.
Et saray taga Babilonia linma ra ed sikato ed dokolan na aro, tan sikato so dinumsisan da ed pikalogoran da, et sikato so adutakan ed sikara, tan say kamarerwa to apatabang ed sikara.
Dia ed ontan linukasan to so saray inkabalangkantis to, tan nilukasan to so inkalakseb to: saman la tinmabang so kamarerwak ed sikato, singa intabang na pusok ed agi to a bii.
Angaman ontan pinarakel to ni ray inpikalogoran to, a nodnonoten to ray agew na kaugawan to, ya inpibalangkantis to ed dalin na Egipto.
Et sikato dinamagan to ray lalaki a kalogoran da, a saray laman da singa laman na asno, tan say ilalak da singa ilalak na kabayo.
Onia so inpakanodnonot mo ed inkasabo na inkaugaw mo, dia ed inpanegna na saray Egipcio ed saray akwalan mo lapu ed saray pagew na inkaugaw mo.
Kanian, O Aholiba, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, paalageyen ko naani ray kaaroan mo a sumpa ed sika, lapu ed sikara say kamarerwam napatey, tan yakar ko ra a sumpa ed sika ed amin a diking.

Saray taga Babilonia tan saray amin a Caldeo, say Pecod tan Soa tan say Koa, tan saray amin ya Asirio a miolop ed sikara; saray makapalikliket a balolaki, saray managuley tan diputado, amin da, saray principe tan lalaki a nibalbalita, sikara ya amin akakabayo ra ed saray kabayo.

Et onsabi ra naani a sumpa ed sika pati saray ayura, luganan, tan bagobagon, tan pati sakey ya olop na balbaley; sikara ompasen ira naani a sumpa ed sika pati saray panagsegpay tan kinlong tan cabal na olo ed liberliber: et yawat ko naani pangokom ed sikara, et sikara okomen da ka naani unong ed panangokom da.

Et yan ko naani so imon ko a sumpa ed sika, et managamil ira naani ed sika a masulisulit; isian da naani so eleng mo tan saray layag mo; et say keram nipasag naani ed kampilan: alaen da naani ray anak mo a lalaki tan bibii; et say keram akmonen naani na apuy.
Ontan met a lakseban da ka naani ed saray kawes mo, tan alaen da ray marakep a kagawaan mo.

Onia so pamatondak ed sika ed inkasabom, tan say inkabalangkantis mo a niyakar a manlapu ed dalin na Egipto; dia ed ontan agmo naani itangay so saray matam ed sikara, tan agmo met naani nanonotan la so Egipto.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, yawat taka naani ed lima na saray kagulam, ed lima na saray nanlapuan na tinabangan na kamarerwam;

Et managamil ira naani ed sika a sigugula, tan alaen da ya amin so kimey mo, tan itilak da ra naani a lakseb tan labos: et say inkalakseb na inkabalangkantis mo nalukasan naani, nanpadpara say inkasabom tan saray inkabalangkantis mo.
Saraya a bengatla nagawa naani ed sika, lapu ed akibalangkantis ka ed saray nacion, tan lapu ed adutakan ka ed saray talintao ra.
Nanakar ka ed dalan nen agim a bii; kanian yawat ko naani so copa to ed limam.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sika oninum ka naani ed copa nen agim a bii, a sikato so aralem tan baleg; sika naelekan ka naani a naludlurey tan nabalaw; sikato dakel so yan to.
Napano ka naani na panagbuek tan ermen, ed copa na kelaw tan pankibalatar, ed copa na agim a Samaria.
On, sikato so inumen mo tan paekatan mo, tan kabkaben mo so lapislapis to, tan igonot mo ray pagew mo; ta sikato so sinalitak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Kanian, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed nilingoanan mo ak, tan inpolisay mo ak ed beneg mo, awiten mo met sirin so inkasabom tan inkabalangkantis mo.
Si Katawan inkuan to ni ed siak: Anak na too, okomen mo ta naani di Ahola tan Aholiba? ipaliwawam sirin ed sikara so saray kadimlaan da.

Ta akilawan ira ed agda asawa, et say dala wala ed lima ra; tan ed saray talintao ra akikalogoran ira; et saray anak da a lalaki, ya inyanak da ed siak, pinalabas da ra ed apuy anga ed sikara pian naakmon ira.
Laot ni saya so ginawa ra ed siak; dinutakan da so santuariok ed satan lanlamang ya agew, tan minura ra so saray sabaton ko.
Ta sanen pinatey da ray anak da ed saray talintao ra, saman la linma ra ed saman lanlamang ya agew ed santuariok pian sikato so muraen da; et, nia, onia so ginawa ra ed pegley na abung ko.

Et nagkalalo ni sikayo nanpatawag kayo na saray lalaki pian ondago ra a manlapu ed arawi, a sikara so nibakian na sakey ya igagangan, et, nia, dinmago ra; lapu ed sikara nanuras ka, pinintaan mo ray matam, can pinarakpan mo so inkasika ed saray along,
Et imyorong ka ed sankarakpan a dokolan, ya wala so sakey a dulang a nitadia ed arap to a dia ed tapew to inpasen mo so inciensok tan larak ko.

Et say voces na sakey a karaklan ya wala a mareereen wala nen saman ed sikato: et pati lalaki ed karaklan a nengneng niyakar so saray managbuek a nanlapu ed kalawakan; et angyan ira na saray baklaw ed saray lima na saray siping, tan marakep a balabalanget ed saray olo ra.
Saman la inkuan ko ed inmakulaw ed saray pikakalogoran, Natan sikara naani mibalangkantis ed sikato, tan sikato ed sikara.
Et linmoob ira ed sikato, unong na iloloob da ed sakey a balangkantis: ontan linmoob ira ed Ahola tan Aholiba, saray maramag a bibii.

Et saray matunong a lalaki, sikara so mangokom ed pangokom ed saray bibii a mikakalogoran, tan pangokom ed bibii ya angibung na dala; lapu ed sikara so bibii a mikakalogoran, tan say dala wala ed saray lima ra.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Mangitatdangak naani na sakey ya olop a sumpa ed sikara, et yawat ko ra naani a nibontatok a pawilpawil tan natakewan.
Et say olop topaken to ra naani ed saray bato, tan pateyen to ra ed saray kampilan da, pateyen da naani ray anak da a lalaki tan bibii, tan puulan da so abung da na apuy.
Onia so pamatondak ed inkadamag na dalin, pian amin a bibii nibangat komon ya ag mangawa na unong ed inkadamag mo.
Et tumangan da naani so inkamaramag yo ed sikayo, tan awiten yo naani so saray kasalanan na saray talintao yo et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan a Dios.
Lamet, dia ed komasiam a taon, ed komaplo a bulan, ed komaplo ya agew na bulan, say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, isulat mo so ngaran na agew, a sikato so saya lanlamang ya agew say ari na Babilonia inmasinger ed Jerusalem ed saya lanlamang ya agew.
Et ibesngaw mo so sakey ya alimbawa ed matunganga ya abung, tan kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Itoon mo so caldero, sikato so itoon mo, tan mangikalbo ka met na danum ed sikato:
Tiponen mo ray tegteg to ed sikato, salanti amin a maong a tegteg, say ulpo, tan say abala; sikato so panoen mo ed saray pinili a pukel.
Mangala ka na pinili ed polok, tan sakey met a losbo a kiew nipaakar ed saray pukel ed lepsag na caldero; sikato so palwagen mo a maong; on, saray pukel ed sikato nilambong ira komon ed pegley to.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Kasi la so ciudad a kadadala, say caldero a say bura to wadman, tan say bura to ag pinmaway ed sikato! ipaway mo ed sikato so tegteg a mantotombokan; angapo so kapalaran a napelag ed sikato.
Ta say dala to wala ed pegley to; sikato so inyan to ed alukasan a bato; sikato so agto inkalbo ed tapew na dalin, pian sikato so sakbongan to na dabok.
Pian patatdangen to so sanok a mangala na pamales, inyan ko so dala to ed tapew na alukasan a bato, pian sikato komon so ag nasakbongan.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Kasi la so ciudad a kadadala! Siak pabalegen ko met naani so losbo.
Ilosbo so kiew, papetangen so apuy, lambongen a maong so laman, ta papaleten so digo, tan saray pukel napoolan komon.
Insan yan ya angapo so yan to ed tapew na saray ngalab to pian napapetang komon, tan say gansa to napoolan komon, tan say dutak to natunaw komon ed sikato, pian say bura to naopot komon.
Sikato pinaksaw to so inkasikato lanlamang ed kimey; angan ontan say baleg a bura to ag ompaway ed sikato, say bura to ag ompaway lapu ed apuy.
Dia ed inkadutak mo wala so sabo; lapu ed nilinisan ta ka et agka alinisan, agka la naani nalinisan ed dutak mo, anga ed panpainawaen ko ed sika so sanok ko.

Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak: sikato so nagawa naani, tan sikato naani gawaen ko; agak naani ompawil, tan agko met naani isakit, tan agak met naani magbabawi; unong ed saray dalan mo, tan unong ed saray gawam, sikara okomen da ka naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Ontan met a sinmabi ed siak so salita nen Katawan, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, nia, ekalen ko ed sika so pilalek na saray matam ed sankasikmat ya irap; angan ontan agka naani manermen odino onnangis, tan ag met naani onagus so saray luam.

Mansibek ka, balet aliwa a maksil, agka manermen ed saray inatey; ibedber mo so oklop mo ed olom, tan isulong mo ray sapinmo ed salim, tan agmo sakbongan so saray bibii mo, tan agmo kanen so tinapay na saray lalaki.
Kanian nansalita ak ed baley ed kabwasan; et dia ed mansilunget inatey so asawak; et dia ed kabwasan ginawak so nibilin ed siak.
Et say baley inkuan to ed siak, Agmo ta naani ibaga ed sikami no anto so saraya a bengatla ed sikami, a gawaen mo?
Saman la inkuan ko ed sikara, Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Mansalita ka ed abung na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, muraen ko naani so santuariok, say pangta na pakapanyari yo, say pilalek na saray matayo, tan say kasian na kamarerwa yo; et saray anak yo a lalaki tan bibii ya intilak yo ed beneg nipasag ira naani ed kampilan.
Et gawaen yo naani so unong ed ginawak: agyo naani sakbongan so saray bibil yo, tan ag kayo met naani mangan na tinapay na saray lalaki.

Et saray oklop yo wala ra naani ed saray olo yo, tan saray sapin yo ed saray sali yo: agkayo naani manermen odino onnangis; no ag ingen onkapuy kayo ed saray inkauges yo, tan maneyey kayo ed sakey tan sakey.
Onia si Ezequiel sikato naani tanda ed sikayo; unong ed saray amin a ginawa to gawaen yo naani: sano saya onsabi, naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan a Dios.

Et sika, anak na too, aliwa ta a dia ed agew a pangekal ed sikara na biskeg da, say liket na gayaga ra, say pilalek na saray mata ra, tan say nanpirawatan na saray puso ra, anak da a lalaki tan bibii,
Pian dia ed satan ya agew say makatainan onla naani ed sika pian sika so ipadngel to ed sika ed saray layag mo?
Dia ed satan ya agew say sangim onsangi naani ed akatainan, et mansalita ka naani, et aliwa ka la naani ya umel: dia ed ontan magmaliw ka a tanda ed sikara; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam ed saray anak nen Ammon, tan manprofeta ka na sumpa ed sikara:

Et ikuan mo ed saray anak nen Ammon, Denglen yo so salita nen Katawan: Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Lapu ed inkuan mo, Aha, sumpa ed santuariok, sanen sikato so amura; tan sumpa ed dalin na Israel, sanen sikato so nankibalatar: tan sumpa ed abung na Juda, sanen linma ra ed inkadakep:

Nia, sirin, yawat taka naani ed saray anak ed bukig a nakayarian, et sikara ipasen da naani ray panpakalsoan da ed sika, tan gawaen da ray panayaman da ed sika; kanen da naani so bungam, tan inumen da naani so gatas mo.
Et gawaen ko naani so Rabbat a pangipokokan ed saray camello, tan saray anak nen Ammon a pasen a dokolan na saray carnero: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed inpantipak mo ray limam, tan inkarag mo so saray salim, tan nanliket ka ed amin a gula na kamarerwam a sumpa ed dalin na Israel;

Nia, sirin, inyunat ko so limak ed sika, et yawat taka naani a sakey a samsam ed saray nacion; et isian taka naani ed saray baley, tan tawtawen taka naani ed saray dalin: deralen taka naani; et naamtaan mo naani a siak si Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed say Moab tan Seir ikuan da, Nia, say abung na Juda singa saray amin a nacion;
Nia sirin, lukasan ko naani so diking na Moab a manlapu ed saray ciudad, manlapu ed saray ciudad to ya wala ed saray onaan to, say dayew na dalin, say Bet-meon, tan Cariatakn.
Ed saray anak ed bokig pian onla a sumpa ed saray anak nen Ammon, et iter kora naani a nakayarian, pian saray anak na Ammon ag komon nanonotan ed saray nacion;
Et gawaen ko naani pangokom ed Moab; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed say Edom nangawa na sumpa ed abung na Juda ed inpamales, tan apasanok a mapalalo, tan sikato so abales ed sikara;

Onia sirin so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Yunat ko naani so limak ed Edom, et isian ko naani ed sikato so too tan ayep; et sikato naani gawaen ko a mankibalatar a manlapu ed Teman: on, dia ed Dedan nipasag ira naani ed kampilan.

Et yan ko naani so pamales ko ed Edom ed panamegley na lima na baley ko ya Israel; et gawaen da naani ed Edom so unong ed sanok ko tan unong ed petang ko; et naamtaan da naani so pamales ko, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed. saray Filisteo nangawa ra na inpamales, tan binmales ira ya wala so gula ra ed kamarerwa a maneral ed maando a bosolan;
Onia sirin so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Nia, yunat ko naani so limak ed saray Filisteo, et pegpegen ko naani so saray Cereteo, tan deralen ko naani so kera ed gilig na dayat.
Et gawaen ko naani so baleg a pamales ed sikara pati masebeg a panamaat; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, sano yan ko so pamales ko ed sikara.
Et agawa a sanen komalabinsakey a taon, ed unona ya agew na bulan, a say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, lapu ed say Tiro inkuan to a sumpa ed Jerusalem, Aha, nabuyak so satan ya wangalan na saray baley; sikato so pinmawil ed siak; siak napano ak naani lamet, natan ta sikato so mankibalatar:
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Nia, onsumpa ak ed sika, O Tiro, et patatdangen ko naani so dakel a nacion a sumpa ed sika, unong a say dayat patatdangen to so saray daluyon to.
Et sikara igeba ra naani ray bakor na Tiro, tan bagbagen da naani ray ilang to: kaskasen ko met naani so dabok to ed sikato, tan sikato naani gawaen ko a sakey a bato ya alukasan.
Sikato naani sakey a pasen a pangibuskagan na saray iket ed pegley na dayat; ta sikato so sinalitak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios; et sikato naani magmaliw a samsam ed saray nacion.
Et saray anak to a bibii ya wala ed uma napatey ira naani ed kampilan: et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.

Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, yakar ko naani ed Tiro si Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia, ari na saray ar-ari, manlapu ed amianen, pati saray kabayo, tan saray luganan, tan lalaki a kabayoan, tan sakey ya olop, tan dakel a totoo.

Sikato pateyen to naani ed kampilan so saray anak mo a bibii ed uma; et mangawa naani na saray salimbeng a sumpa ed sika, tan mangawa naani na pokdol a sumpa ed sika, tan itagey to naani so panagamped sumpa ed sika.
Et yan to naani so saray kagawaan to a pamagbag a sumpa ed saray bakor mo, tan ed saray wasay to igeba to naani so saray ilang mo.

Nisengeg ed karakel na saray kabayo to say dabok da sakbongan daka naani: saray bakor mo onmayegmeg ira naani ed ongol na saray lalaki a nankabayo, tan saray bagon, tan saray luganan, sano sikato so onloob ed saray wangalan mo, singa saray totoo ya onloob ed sakey a ciudad ya akagawaan na sakey a butaw.
Ed saray koko na saray kabayo to igatin to naani so saray amin a polong mo; sikato pateyen to naani so baley mo ed kampilan; et saray lusek na biskeg mo nigeba ra naani ed dalin.

Et mangawa ra naani na sakey a samsam ed saray kayamanan mo, tan mangawa ra naani na sakey a samsam ed saray tagilakom; et gaygayen da naani so saray bakor mo, tan deralen da naani so saray makapaliket ya abung mo; et ipaldeg da naani so saray batom tan saray kiew mo tan say dabok mo ed pegley na saray danum.
Et patondaen ko naani so alingag na saray kancion mo; tan say anyeweng na saray arpam ag naani narengel.
Et gawaen taka naani ya lakseb a bato; sika naani sakey a pasen a pangibuskagan ed saray iket; agka la naani nipaalagey; ta siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed Tiro: Ag ta naani onmayegmeg so saray polpolo ed tanol na kapelag mo, na saray sugatan manayengeng ira, no say panagpatey nagawa ed pegley mo?

Saman la saray amin a principe ed dayat onlasor ira naani a manlapu ed saray yorongan da, tan igaton da so saray sokbong da, tan lakseban da so saray inlongan a kawes da: mankawes ira naani a sigigiwgiw; onyorong ira naani ed dalin, tan onmayegmeg ira naani ed balang sankasikmat, tan mankelaw ira naani ed sika.

Et mantagleey ira naani ed sika, tan kuan da ed sika, Agay la so inkaderal mo, a nanayaman na saray lalaki ed dayat, say nibawag a ciudad, a mabiskeg nen saman dia ed dayat, sikato tan saray totoo to a nansengegan na kakebiew ed saray amin a manaayam diman!
Bang saray polpolo onmayegmeg ira naani ed agew na kapelag mo; on, saray polpolo ya wala ed dayat napunaw ira naani ed itainan mo.

Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sano gawaen ta ka a kibalatar a ciudad, singa saray ciudad ya angapo so manayam; sano patatdangen ko so kaaralman ed sika, et saray ankabaleg a danum yanepen da ka naani:

Sikato naani pamaabebak ed sika a miolop ed saray onlasor ed kalinsorong ed saray totoo ed inmuna a panaon, et panayamen ta ka naani ed saray aralem a kabiangan na dalin, ed saray pasen a kibalatar nen inmuna, a miolop ed saray onlasor ed kalinsorong, pian agka napanayaman; et iletneg ko naani so gayaga dia ed dalin na saray mabilay.
Gawaen ta ka naani a sakey a katakotan, tan andi ka la naani; angan anapen daka, angan kapigan agkan balot naromog lamet, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed Siak, ya inkuan to,
Et sika, anak na too, tagleeyan mo so Tiro;
