Et kuan mo ed Tiro, O sika a manaayam ed lolooban na dayat, a sika so lomalako ed saray baley anga ed saray dakel a polpolo, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sika, O Tiro, inkuan mo, siak ayadyariak ed kalimgasan.
Saray ketegan mo wala ra ed puso na saray dayat; saray angipaalagey ed sika yinadyari ra so kalimgasan mo.
Sikara ginawa ra so saray amin a tablam ed kiew a saleng a nanlapu ed Senir; angala ra na sakey a cedro a nanlapu ed Libano a ginawa ra ya anlayasan na sakayan a nipaakar ed sika.
Ginawa ra so saray begsay mo ed saray roble na Basan; ginawa ra so saray bankom ed garing ya inyoklop ed kiew ya alamo, a nanlapu ed saray polo na Kittim.

Say mayumis a lienzo ya inalongan a nanlapu ed Egipto sikato so layag mo, pian sikato komon ed sika so sakey a laylay; azul tan purpura a nanlapu ed saray polpolo na Elisa sikato nen saman so sirum mo.
Saray manaayam ed Sidon tan Aruad sikara nen saman so managbegsay mo: saray makabat mo, O Tiro, wala ra nen saman ed sika, sikara so saray pilotom.

Saray mamasiken na Gebal tan saray makabat to a lalaki wala ra nen saman ed sika a managgalagala: saray amin a sakayan ed dayat pati saray manangisakay da wala ra nen saman ed sika a mibiang ed panaglakom.
Say Persa tan Lud tan Put wala ra nen saman ed ejercitom, saray lalakim ed bakal: inbitin da so kinlong tan say pamulaw na olo ed sika; sikara inpatnag da so dayew mo.

Saray lalaki na Aruad pati say inayuraan mo wala ra nen saman ed tapew na saray bakor mo ed liberliber, et saray makpel a lalaki wala ra nen saman ed saray ilang mo; inbitin da so saray kinlong da ed saray bakor mo ed liberliber; niyadyari ra so kalimgasan mo.
Say Tarsis sikato so lomalakom lapu ed karakel na saray amin a nengneng na inkayaman; ed pilak, balatyang, lata, tan ismay, insalat da so saray tagilakom.
Say Jeva, Tubal tan Mesec, sikara so manangilim; insalat da so saray inkatoo na lalaki tan kagkagawaan a gansa ed saray lakom.
Saray taga abung na Togorma insalat da ed saray lakom so saray kabayo tan saray kabayo a pibabakal tan saray mula.
Saray lalaki na Dedan sikara nen saman so saray manangilim; dakel a polpolo sikara nen saman so panaglakoan na liman; inyakar da ed sika ya insalat so saray saklor a garing tan batolinew.

Say Siria sikato nen saman so lomalakom lapu ed karakelna saray kayarian mo a kimey a lima; insalat da ed saray lakom so saray esmeral da, purpura, tan inalongan a gawa, tan mayumis a lienzo, tan koral, tan rubi.
Say Juda, tan say dalin na Israel, sikara nen saman so manangilim: insalat da ed lakom so saray trigo na Minit, tan pannah, tan dilo, tan larak tan balsamo.
Say Damasco sikato nen saman so lomalakom lapu ed karakel na saray kayarian mo a kimey na lima, lapu ed karakel na saray amin a nengneng na inkayaman, pati say alak na Holbon, tan ampoti a bago.
Say Veden tan Javan insalat da so estambre, ed saray lakom: masileng a balatyang, casia, tan calamo, wala ra nen saman ed saray lakom.
Say Dedan sikato nen saman so manangilim ed saray mabli ya abel na somasarang.
Say Arabia, tan saray amin a principe na Cedar, sikara so lomalakom ed limam; ed saray cordero, saray carnero a kalakian, tan saray kanding, ed saraya sikara nen saman so lomalakom.
Saray manangili na Saba tan Reema, sikara nen saman so manangilim: insalat da ed saray lakom so manonaan ed saray amin a balingit, tan ed saray amin a mabli a bato, tan balitok.
Say Haran tan Canneh, tan Eden a manangili na Saba, Asiria, tan Quelma, sikara nen saman so manangilim.

Saraya nen saman so manangilim ed saray apili a laen, saray binalkot ya azul tan inalongan a kimey, tan saray binalolang a kawes, a binedber ed lubilubir tan ed saray ginawa ed cedro, ed nanleleetan na saray lakom.
Saray sakayan na Tarsis sikara so manangitulor nipaakar ed lakom: et nagnap ka, tan agawa ka a sankadayewan ed puso na saray dayat.
Saray bomebegsay mo inyakar da ka ed saray maawang a danum: say dagem na bokig binagbag to ka ed pegley na saray dayat.

Saray kayamanan mo, tan saray lakom, say panaganapan mo, saray manangisakay mo, tan saray pilotom, saray managgalagalam, tan saray manag-agamil ed saray lakom, tan saray amin a lalakim ed bakal ya wala ed sika, pati amin a kaolop mo wala ed pegley mo, napelag ira naani ed pegley na saray dayat, dia ed agew na kabagbag mo.
Lapu ed tanol na akis na saray pilotom saray daluyon onmayegmeg ira naani.
Et saray amin a manegna na begsay, saray manangisakay, tan saray amin a pilotom na dayat, onepas ira naani a manlapu ed saray sakayan da; sikara onalagey ira naani ed tapew na dalin.
Et ipadngel da naani so voces da ed sika, tan oneyag ira naani na ampaipait, tan sibuan da naani na dabok so saray olo ra; sikara ontiblak ira naani ed saray dapol:
Et yangyangan da naani so inkasikara lapu ed sika, tan manbalkes ira na magaspang ya abel, tan onnangis ira naani a nipaakar ed sika dia ed capitan na kamarerwa pati ampaipait a panermen.
Tan dia ed panagogol da ed sika mantagleey ira naani ed sika, tan mandageyem ira naani ed sika, a kuan da, Siopa so wala a singa say Tiro, singa say abagbag ed pegley na dayat?
Sanen saray lakom pinmaway ira ed saray dayat, sika pinanom so dakel a balbaley; pinayaman mo so saray ar-ari na dalin ed karakel na saray kayamanan mo tan lakom.
Dia ed panaon ya inkabagbag mo lapu ed saray dayat ed kaaralman na saray danum, say lakom tan amin a kaolop mo nipasag ira ed pegley mo.
Saray amin a manaayam ed saray polpolo mankelaw ira ed sika; tan saray ar-ari ra ontakot ira a mapalalo; nagolo ra ed nengneng da.
Saray lomalako ed nanleleetan na saray baley ngisiwan da ka; nagmaliw ka a kakebiewan, tan angan kapigan andi ka la naani.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, ibagam ed principe na Tiro, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed say pusom nipaatagey, tan inkuan mo, Siak sakey ak a dios, onyorongak ed yorongan na Dios, ed pegley na saray dayat: angan ontan sika too ka, ya aliwa a Dios, angan inyan mo so pusom a singa say puso na Dios;
Nia, nagkalalon makabat ka nen si Daniel; angapo so maamot a niyamot ed sika:
Lapu ed kakabatan mo tan lapu ed pakatalos mo akagamor ka na saray kayamanan, tan akagamor ka na balitok tan pilak ed saray panaglsimpenan mo:
Lapu ed baleg a kakabatan mo tan lapu ed panaglakom pinarakel mo so saray inkayaman mo, et say pusom nipaatagey lapu ed saray kayamanan mo;
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; Lapu ed inyan mo so pusom a singa puso na Dios;

Nia, sirin, yakar ko naani ed sika so saray sankaili, say makapataktakot ed saray nacion, et sikara baguten da naani so saray kampilan da a sumpa ed limgas na kakabatan mo, tan dutakan da naani so sinag mo.
Yabeba ra ka naani ed kalinsorong, tan ompatey ka naani ed patey na sararnan so pateyen, dia ed pegley na saray dayat.
Ikuan mo ta ni ed arap na mamatey ed sika, Siak dios ak? balet sika too ka, ya aliwa a Dios, ed lima na manugat ed sika.
Ompatey ka naani ed patey na saray ag ginalsiman lapu ed lima na saray sankaili; balet sikato so sinalitak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Laot ni say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, mantagleey ka ed ari na Tiro, tan kuan mo ed sikato, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sika tatakan mo so sukat, a napno na kakabatan, tan angapo so pankulangan to ed limgas.

Wala ka nen saman ed Eden, a tanamanan na Dios; balang mabli a bato sikato so sakbong mo, sardio, topacio, tan say berilo, tan say diamante, say onix, tan say jaspe, tan say zafiro, say esmeralda tan say carbunclo, tan balitok: say inka-gawa na saray panderetam tan saray gandang mo wala nen saman ed sika; sanen agew ya apalsa ka sikara nitadia ra.

Sika so nilanaan a kerubin a minakbong; et siak inpasen ta ka, pian wala ka nen saman ed tapew na palandey a masanto na Dios; sika nanakar ka ya amaatagey tan amaabeba ed pegley na saray bato ya apuy.
Sika ayadyari ka nen saman ed saray dalan mo a nanlapu ed agew ya inkapalsam anga ed aromog ed sika so inkapikewet.

Lapu ed karakel na inpanlakom pinano ra so pegley mo ed panagduksa et sika nankasalanan ka: kanian sika so inbantak ko a singa aliwa a masanto ed palandey na Dios; et sika so dineral ko, O manakbong a kerubin, manlapu ed pegley na saray bato ya apuy.
Say pusom nipaatagey lapu ed limgas mo; sika dineral mo so kakabatan mo lapu ed sinag mo; inbantak ta ka ed dalin: ingaton taka ed arap na saray ar-ari, pian nanengneng daka komon.

Lapu ed karaklan na inkauges mo, ed inkapikewet na panaglakom, minuram so saray santuariom; kanian inpaway ko so sakey ya apuy a manlapu ed pegley mo; sikato kinan to ka, inpagmaliw ta ka a dapol ed tapew na dalin ed pakanengneng na saray amin a makanengneng ed sika.
Saray amin a mikabat ed sika ed saray balbaley mankelaw ira naani ed sika; sika nagmaliw ka a kakebiewan, et angan kapigan ni andi ka la.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam ya arap ed Sidon, tan manprofeta ka na sumpa ed sikato,

Et kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia onsumpaak ed sika, O Sidon: et siak nitandoro ak naani ed pegley mo; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, sano gawaen ko so saray pangokom ko ed sikato, tan napasantos ak ed sikato.

Ta ipawit ko naani so salot ed sikato tan say dala ed saray polong to; et saray sugatan nipasag ira naani ed pegley to, ya wala so kampilan ed sikato ed balang diking; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.

Et angapo la naani so matalisiw a sabitan ed abung na Israel, odino makatenek a sabit so antokaman ya wala ed liberliber da, a nangawa na gula ed sikara; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan a Dios.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sano tiponen ko so abung na Israel a manlapu ed saray baley a dia ed pegley da so nibuyakan da, tan napasanto ak ed sikara ed pakanengneng na saray nacion, sirin manayam ira ed dili a dalin da ya initer ko ed aripen ko a Jacob.

Et manayam ira naani ed sikato a mataletalek: on, mamaalagey ira naani na saray abung, tan mantanem ira na saray uvas, tan manayam ira naani a mataletalek, sano gawaen ko so pangokom ed sararnan ya amin so nangula ed sikara ed liberliber da; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan a Dios da.
Dia ed komaplo a taon, ed komaplo a bulan, ed komalabindua ya agew na bulan, say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam a sumpa ed Faraon ya ari na Egipto, tan manprofeta ka na sumpa ed sikato, tan sumpa ed amin ya Egipto.

Mansalita ka, tan kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, onsumpaak ed sika, Faraon ya ari na Egipto, say baleg ya olimaw ya wala ed pegley na saray ilog to, a nankuan, Say ilog ko kien ko a bokor, tan sikato so ginawak nipaakar ed siak lanlamang.

Et mangyan ak naani na saray taga ed saray pangal mo, tan papeketen ko naani ray sira na saray ilog mo ed saray siksik mo; et itatdang ta ka naani a manlapu ed pegley na saray ilog mo, pati saray amin ya sira na saray ilog mo a sikara so onpeket ed saray siksik mo.

Et ibantak ta ka naani ed kalawakan, sika tan saray amin ya sira na saray ilog mo: nipasag ka naani ed maawang a dalin; agka naani natipon odino naragdagup; initer taka a panagkatagano ed saray ayep na dalin tan ed saray manok na saray tawen,
Et saray amin a manaayam ed Egipto naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, lapu ed sikara so sakey a tayokor a singa kawayan ed abung na Israel.
Sanen inegnaan da ka ed lima, sika aputer ka, tan pinilat mo so saray amin ya abala ra; et sanen sinmaral ira ed sika, sika aputer ka, tan inpanmayegmeg mo so saray banebanel da.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, yakar ko naani so sakey a kampilan ed sika, tan pegpegen ko naani ed sika so too tan ayep.
Et say dalin na Egipto mankibalatar naani tan deral: et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan. Lapu ed inkuan to, Say ilog kien ko, tan sikato so ginawak;

Nia, sirin, onsumpaak ed sika, tan onsumpaak ed saray ilog mo, tan gawaen ko naani so dalin na Egipto a sakey ya ayadyari a deral tan mankibalatar, manlapu ed ilang na Sevene anga ed ketegan lanlamang na Etiopia.
Angapo so sali na too ya onlabas ed sikato, ni sali na ayep ya onlabas naani ed sikato, tan ag met naani napanayaman ed leleg na apataplo a taon.

Et gawaen ko naani so dalin na Egipto a mankibalatar ed pegley na saray dalin a mankibalatar; et saray ciudad to ed pegley na saray ciudad ya abagbag mankibalatar ira naani ed leleg na apataplo a taon, tan itayak ko naani so saray taga Egipto ed saray nacion, tan itayak kora naani ed saray daldalin.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Ed kasumpalan na apataplo a taon tiponen ko naani so saray Egipcios a manlapu ed saray baley a nitayakan da;
Et ipawil ko naani so inkadakep na Egipto, tan papawilen ko ra naani ed dalin na Patures, ed dalin a nianakan da; et diman sikara naani abeba a panarian.
Sikato naani kaabebaan ed sa: ray amin a panarian: et ag met la naani nipaatagey ed tagey na saray naciones; et pamelagen ko ra naani, pian ag ira la naani manuley ed saray nacion.
Et sikato so ag la naani panmatalkan na abung na Israel, a mangipanonot na inkauges, no sikara onlingaw ira naani ya onnengneng ed sikara: et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan a Dios.
Et agawa a sanen komaduamplo tan pito a taon, ed ununa a bulan, ed ununa ya agew na bulan, say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, si Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia inpanlinkor to so sondalo to ed baleg a panaglinkor a sumpa ed Tiro: balang olo ayangyang, tan balang abala apongpong: angan ontan angapo nen saman so upa to, angan say sondalo to, a nanlapu ed Tiro, lapu ed panaglinkor ya inpanlinkor to a sumpa ed sikato.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, iter ko naani so dalin na Egipto ed Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia: et sikato itainan to naani so inkadakel to, tan alaen to so samsam to, tan alaen to so degkem to; et sikato naani so upa na sondalo to.
Initer ko ed sikato so dalin na Egipto a singa tumang to lapu ed inpanlinkor to, lapu ed nangawa ra na nipaakar ed siak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Dia ed satan ya agew pankamuktilen ko naani so saklor ed abung na Israel, et iter ko naani ed sika so pangilukas na sangi ed pegley da; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Managogol kayo, Kawaen la so agew!
Ta say agew asinger, on, say agew nen Katawan asinger; sikato naani agew na saray lurem, sakey a panaon na saray nacion.

Et sakey a kampilan so onla naani ed Egipto, et wala naani ermen ed Etiopia, sano saray napatey nipasag ira ed Egipto; et itainan da naani so saray inkadakel to, tan saray angipaletnegan to nageba naani.
Say Etiopia, tan Put, tan Lud, tan saray amin ya alaok a baley, tan Cub, tan saray anak na dalin ya wala ed siglaot, nipasag ira naani a niolop ed sikara lapu ed kampilan.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Saray mamenben met ed Egipto nipasag ira naani; et say kapangtaan na biskeg to napaabeba naani: manlapu ed ilang na Sevene nipasag ira naani ed sikato ed kampilan, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et mankibalatar ira naani ed pegley na saray dalin a kibalatar: et saray ciudad to wala ra naani ed pegley na saray ciudad ya abagbag.
Et naamtaan da naani a Siak si Katawan, sano dangatan ko na apuy so Egipto, et saray amin a mananolong to naderal ira.

Dia ed satan ya agew saray ibabaki ompaway ira naani a manlapu ed arap ko ed saray sakayan pian taktakoten da so saray andian na alaur ya Etiopa; et wala naani ermen ed sikara, singa nen agew na Egipto; ta, nia, sikato so onsabi.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: patondaen ko met naani so inkarakel na Egipto, lapu ed lima nen Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia.

Sikato tan say baley to a niolop ed sikato, say makapataktakot ed saray nacion, niyakar naani a manbagbag na dalin; et baguten da naani so saray kampilan da a sumpa ed Egipto, tan panoen da so dalin ed saray napatey.

Et paekaten ko naani so saray ilog, tan ilakok naani so dalin ed lima na saray mauges a totoo; et gawaen to naani so dalin a mankibalatar, tan amin ya wala ed sikato, lapu ed lima na saray sankaili: Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: deralen ko met naani so saray dirios, tan patondaen ko naani so saray talintao a manlapu ed Memfis; et diman angapo la naani so principe a manlapu ed dalin na Egipto: et mangyanak naani na sakey a takot ed dalin na Egipto.
Et gawaen ko naani so Patures a mankibalatar, tan dangatan ko naani so sakey ya apuy dia ed Zoan, tan gawaen ko naani so saray pangokom ed No.
Et yibung ko naani so sanok ko ed Sin, say salimbeng na Egipto; bawasan ko naani so karakel na No.
Et dangatan ko naani so Egipto: say Sin wala naani ed baleg ya ermen, et say No nabuybuyak naani; et say Memfis wala naani kasumpaan to ya inagew-agew.
Saray tobonbalo a lalaki na Aven tan Pubasti nipasag ira naani ed kampilan, et saraya a ciudad onla ra naani ed kadakep.

Dia ed Tafnes met say agew mankaput, sano puterenkod'man so saray pako na Egipto, et say kapangtaan na biskeg to ontonda naani ed sikato: nipaakar ed sikato, sikato naani sakbongan na sakey a lurem, et saray anak to a bibii onia ra naani ed kadakep.
Onia so pangawak na saray pangokom ed Egipto; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Et agawa sanen komalabinsakey a taon, ed ununa a bulan, ed komapito ya agew na bulan, a say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, pinuter ko so taklay nen Faraon ya ari na Egipto, et nia, sikato so ag binalor pian naitdan na saray makatambal a tambal, a nainan na saray bedber a mangibedber ed sikato, pian sikato komon so mabiskeg a mangegna na kampilan.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, onsumpa ak ed Faraon ya ari na Egipto, et puteren ko naani so saray taklay to, say mabiskeg a taklay, tan saman so aputer; et papelagen ko naani so kampilan ed lima to.
Et itayak ko naani so saray Egipcio ed pegley na saray nacion, tan itayak ko ra naani ed saray dalin.

Et pabiskegen ko naani so saray taklay na ari na Babilonia, tan yanko so kampilan ko ed lima to: balet puteren ko naani so taklay nen Faraon, et sikato mansibek naani ed arap to ed saray sibek na sakey ya asugatan a too ed makapatey.

Et yatagey ko naani so saray taklay na ari na Babilonia; et saray taklay nen Faraon onlepsag ira naani; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, sano yan ko so kampilan ko ed lima na ari ed Babilonia, tan sikato naani yunat to ed dalin na Egipto.
Et itayak ko naani so saray Egipcio ed saray nacion, tan itayak ko ra naani ed saray dalin; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Et agawa sanen komalabinsakey a taon, ed komatlo a bulan, ed ununa ya agew na bulan, a say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, mansalita ka ed Faraon ya ari na Egipto, tan ed saray karaklan to: Siopa so kapadparam ed kaatagey mo?

Nia, say Asirio sikato nen saman so sakey a cedro ed Libano ya wala so marakep a sangasanga to, tan sirom a singa ed takel, tan atagey ed kabalgan; et say toktok to wala nen saman ed saray makdel a sangasanga.
Sikato so tinagano na saray danum, sikato so pinatobo na aralem: saray ilog to inmagus ira ed liberliber na pantaneman to; et inyarap to so saray banawang to ed saray amin a kiew ed uma.
Kanian say kabaleg to nipaatagey ed tagey na saray amin a kiew ed uma; et saray sanga to dinmakel ira, tan saray sanga to dinmukey ira lapu ed dakel a danum, sanen binmusilak ira.

Saray amin a manok ed saray tawen ginawa ra so saray abong da ed saray sanga to; et dia ed silong na saray sanga to saray amin ya ayep ed uma yakar da so saray kilaw da; tan ed silong na sirum to nanayam so saray amin ya ankabaleg a nacion.
Onia nen saman so limgas to ed kabaleg to, ed karukey na saray sanga to; ta say lamut to wala nen saman ed abay na dakel a danum.

Saray cedro ed panagtanamanan na Dios sikato so agda ayarian ya saniban; saray kiew a saleng aliwa ra nen saman a singa saray sanga to, tan saray kiew a castano aliwa ra nen saman a singa saray sangato; et angapo met nen saman so angan anto a kiew ed panagtanamanan na Dios a singa sikato ed abig to.
Sikato so ginawak a malimgas lapu ed karakel na saray sanga to, pian saray amin a kiew ed Eden, ya wala nen saman ed panagtanamanan na Dios, sikato so sinibletan da.
Kanian onia so inkuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed nipaatagey ka ed kabaleg, tan sikato inpasen to so toktok to ed nanleleetan na saray makdel a sanga, tan say puso to nipaatagey ed kabaleg to:
Sikato lanlamang so yawat ko ed lima na mabiskeg a sakey ed saray nacion; ag onlaron a sikato naani mibiang ed sikato; sikato so pinapaway ko lapu ed inkauges to.

Et saray sankaili, say kakebiew na saray nacion, sikato so pinegpeg da, tan sikato so tinainan da: ed tapew na saray palandey tan ed saray amin a lawak saray sanga to naplag ira, tan saray sanga to aputer ira ed abay na saray amin a panagusan na danum na dalin; et saray amin a baley ed dalin linmasor ira a nanlapu ed sirum to, tan sikato so tinainan da.
Ed tapew na deral to saray amin a manok ed saray tawen manayam ira naani, tan saray amin ya ayep ed uma wala ra naani ed saray sanga to;

Pian angapo ed saray amin a kiew ed abay na saray danum so ontagey ed kabaleg to, tan agda met yan so toktok da ed nanleleetan na saray makdel a sanga, odino saray mabiskeg onalagey ira ed katagey da, salanti saray oninum na danum; ta sikara ya amin niyawat ira ed patey, ed saray abeba a gaton na dalin, ed pegley na saray anak na totoo, pati saray onlasor ed kalinsorong.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dia ed agew sanen inmakseb ed Sheol nanpaermenak: sinakbongan ko so kaaralman lapu ed sikato, tan inabalak so saray ilog to; et saray ankabaleg a danum tinmon da ra; et inpanermen ko so Libano lapu ed sikato, tan saray amin a kiew ed uma kinmapuy ira lapu ed sikato.

Inpanmayegmeg ko so saray nacion ed tanol na inkaplag to, sanen sikato so inbantak ko ed Sheol a niolop ed saray onlasor ed kalinsorong; et saray amin a kiew ed Eden, saray apili tan saray kamaongan ed Libano, saray amin ya oninum na danum, aligliwa ra ed saray abeba a gaton na dalin.
Sikara met linmasor ira ed Sheol a niolop ed sikato anga ed saray pinatey ed kampilan; on, sikara a taklay to, a nanayam ed silong na sirum to ed pegley na saray nacion.

Siopa so kaparam ya onia dia ed gayaga tan dia ed inkabaleg na saray kiew na Eden? angan ontan nipaabeba ka ta naani a niolop ed saray kiew na Eden anga ed saray abeba a gaton na dalin: ondokol ka naani ed pegley na saray agginalsiman pati saray pinatey ed kampilan. Saya sikato si Faraon tan amin so karakel to, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et agawa dia ed komalabindua a taon, ed komalabindua a bulan, ed ununa ya agew na bulan, a say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, mantagleey ka ed Faraon, ya ari na Egipto, tan kuanmo ed sikato, Sika nialiling ka ed sakey a kilaw a leon na saray nacion; angan ontan singa ka sakey ya olimaw ed saray dayat; et pinmaway ka ed il-ilog, tan kiniwal mo so saray danum ed salim, tan dinutakan mo so saray ilog da.
Onia so kuan nén Katawan a Dios: ibuskag ko naani so iket ko ed sika pati sakey ya olop na dakel a balbaley; et itatdang da ka naani dia ed iket ko.

Et itilak taka naani ed dalin, ibantak taka naani ed mapatar ya uma, et saray amin a manok ed saray tawen patoonen ko ra naani ed sika, tan peneken ko naani so saray ayep ed saray amin a dalin ed sika.
Et yan ko naani so laman mo ed tapew na saray palandey, tan panoen ko naani so saray lawak ed kaatageyan mo.
Salogen ko met naani ed dalam so dalin a nanlangoyan mo, anga ed saray palandey; et saray panagusan na danum napano ra naani ed sika.
Et sano erepen ta ka saniban ko naani so saray tawen, tan pabilungeten ko naani so saray bitewen to; saniban ko naani so banwa ed sakey a lurem, tan say bulan agto naani isinag so liwawa to.
Saray amin a masnag a silew na tawen pabilungeten ko naani ed tagey mo, tan yan ko naani so bilunget ed dalin mo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Siak panermenen ko met naani so saray puso na saray dakel a baley, sano yakar ko so kabagbag mo ed nanleleetan na saray nacion, ed saray dalin ya agmo naamtaan.

On, pankelawen ko naani so saray dakel ed sika, et saray ar-ari ra ontakot ira naani a mapalalo lapu ed sika, sano pankirlapen ko so kampilan ko ed arap da; et sikara onmayegmeg ira naani ed balang sankasikmat, balang too lapu ed dili a bilay to, ed agew a kapelag mo.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Say kampilan na ari na Babilonia onla naani ed sika.

Ed panamegley na saray kampilan na makapanyari papelagen ko naani so karaklan mo; say kakebiewan na saray nacion sikara ya amin: et paandien da naani so kapangtaan na Egipto, tan amin a karaklan to nabagbag naani.
Bagbagen ko met naani so saray amin ya ayep to a manlapu ed abay na saray dakel a danum; ag ira met la naani kiwalen na sali na too, angan saray koko na saray ayep sikara so agda la kiwalen.
Saman la palinewen ko so saray danum da, tan panagusen ko so saray ilog da a singa larak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Sano gawaen ko so dalin na Egipto a mankibalatar tan deral, sakey a dalin a nakalan ed saman so napnoan to, sano pateyen ko so saray amin a manaayam ed sikato, naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.

Saya so tagleey ya itagleey da naani; saray anak a bibii na saray nacion mantagleey ira naani ed sikara; ed Egipto, tan ed amin a karaklan to, mantagleey ira naani ed sikato na tagleey kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Agawa met a sanen komalabindua a taon, ed komalabinlima ya agew na bulan, a say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, managogol ka a nipaakar ed karakel na Egipto, tan sikara so ibantak mo, sikato lanlamang tan saray anak a bibii na saray nibawag a nacion, anga ed saray abeba a gaton na dalin a niolop ed saray onlasor ed kalinsorong.
Siopa so labasan mo dia ed kalimgasan? onabeba ka, tan midokol ka ed saray ag ginalsiman.
Sikara nipasag ira naani ed pegley na saray napatey ed kampilan: sikato niyawat ed kampilan; sikato so ipaway yo tan saray amin a karaklan to.

Say mabiskeg ed saray makapanyari mansalita naani ed sikato a manlapu ed pegley na Sheol pati saray ontulong ed sikato: inmabeba la ra, ondokol ira a mareereen, salanti saray ag ginalsiman, a pinatey ed kampilan.
Say Assur wadman a pati amin a kaolop to; saray lobok to wala ra ed liberliber to; amin da pinatey ira, a nipasag ed kampilan;

A saray lobok da niyan ira ed kaaralman a gaton na kalinsorong, et say kaolop to wala ed liberliber na lobok to; sikara ya amin pinatey ira, nipasag ed kampilan, a sikara so kakebiewan dia ed dalin na saray mabilay.

Wadman si Elam tan saray amin a karakel to ed liberliber na lobok to; sikara ya amin pinatey ira, a nipasag ed kampilan, a linmasor ira ya ag ginalsiman ed saray abeba a gaton na dalin, a ginawa ra so kakebiewan da ed dalin na saray mabilay, tan inawit da so baing da a pati saray linmasor ed kalinsorong.

Sikato so ininan da na sakey a dokolan ed pegley na saray pinatey pati saray amin a karakel to; saray lobok da wala ra ya amin ed liberliber to; sikara ya amin ag ira ginalsiman, a pinatey ed kampilan; ta say kakebiewan da agawa ed dalin na saray mabilay, tan inawit da so baing da a niolop ed saray linmasor ed kalinsorong: sikato so niiyan ed pegley na saray pinatey.

Wadman so Mesec, Tubal, tan saray amin a karakel da; saray lobok da wala ra ed liberliber da; sikara ya amin ag ira ginalsiman, a pinatey ed kampilan; ta ginawa ra so kakebiewan da dia ed dalin na saray mabilay.

Et ag ira naani midokol ed saray mabiskeg a nipasag ed saray ag ginalsiman a linmasor ed Sheol pati saray ayura ed bakal, tan ingaton da so saray kampilan da ed lepsag na saray olo ra, tan saray inkauges da wala ed tapew na saray pokel da; ta sikara nen saman so takot na saray mabiskeg dia ed dalin na saray mabilay.
Balet sika naputer ka naani ed pegley na saray ag ginalsiman, et midokol naani ed saray pinatey ed kampilan.

Wadman so Edom, saray ari to tan saray amin a principe to, a sikara dia ed pakapanyari ra akidokol ira ed saray pinatey ed kampilan: midokol ira naani ed saray ag ginalsiman, tan ed saray linmasor ed kalinsorong.

Walad man so saray principe na amianen, sikara ya amin, tan saray amin a Sidonio, a sikara so linmasor a niolop ed saray pinatey; dia ed takot a ginawa ra lapu ed pakapanyari ra niyan ira ed kababaingan; et midokol ira ya ag ginalsiman ed saray pinatey ed kampilan, tan awiten da so baing da a niolop ed saray onlasor ed kalinsorong.
Si Faraon nanengneng to ra naani, tan naligliwa naani ed saray amin a karakel to, si Faraon lanlamang tan amin ya inayuraan to, pinatey ed kampilan, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Ta inyan ko so takot to dia ed dalin na saray mabilay; et sikato naani nigaton ed pegley na saray ag ginalsiman, a niolop ed saray pinatey ed kampilan, si Faraon lanlamang tan amin a karakel to, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, mansalita ka ed saray anak na baley mo, tan kuan mo ed sikara, Sano yakar ko so kampilan ed dalin, et say baley ed dalin mangala na sakey a laki a manlapu ed nanleleetan da, tan sikato so yan da a nipaakar a managbantay da;
Bang, no nanengneng to so kampilan ya onsabi ed dalin, paknolen to so tamboyog, tan pakabatan to so baley;
Sirin angan siopa ya ondengel ed tanol na tamboyog tan ag to awaten so pasakbay, no say kampilan onsabi, tan sikato so itainan to, say dala to wala ed olo to lanlamang.
Nadngel to so tanol na tamboyog et ag to inawat so pasakbay, say dala to wala ed sikato naani: balet no tinmalineng, nilaban to komon so kamarerwa to.

Balet no say bantay anengneng to so kampilan ya onsabi, et agto paknolen so tamboyog, tan say baley to ag napakabatan, et say kampilan onsabi a mangala na angan siopa a too ed nanleleetan da; sikato so nitainan ed inkauges to, balet say dala to anapen ko naani ed lima na bantay.
Kanian sika, anak na too, inyanta ka a manbantay ed abung na Israel; denglen mo sirin so salita ed sangik, tan iter mo ed sikara so pakapikabatan a manlapu ed siak.

No kuan ko ed marelmeng, O marelmeng a too, ompatey ka naani ya andi saew, et sika agka mansalita a mangipakabat ed marelmeng na daIan to; satan a marelmeng a too ompatey naani ed inkauges to, balet say dala to anapen ko naani ed limam.

Angan ontan no panpakabatan mo so marelmeng ed dalan to pian ompawil a manlapu ed sikato, et ag ompawil a manlapu ed dalan to: sikato so ompatey naani ed inkauges to, balet sika inlaban mo so kamarerwam.

Et sika anak na too, kuan mo ed abung na Israel: Onia so pansalitayo, a kuan yo, Saray inpakasumlang mi tan saray kasalanan mi wala ra ed tapew mi, tan onkapuy kami ed sikara; panon sirin so panbilay mi?

Kuan mo ed sikara, Unong a siak mabilayak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Angapo so liket ko ed ipapatey na marelmeng; no ag ingen say marelmeng ompawil komon a manlapu ed dalan to tan manbilay; Ompawil kayo, ompawil kayo a manlapu ed saray dalan yo a mauges; ta akin et ompatey kayo, O abung na Israel?

Et sika, anak na too, kuan mo ed saray anak na baley mo, Say inkatunong na matunong sikato naani ag mangilaban ed sikato ed agew na pakasumlang to; et no nipaakar ed karelmengan na marelmeng, ag naani napelag nisengeg ed satan ed agew a sikato ompawil a manlapu ed karelmengan to; ni say matunong ag met naani manbilay ed satan ed agew na pankasalanan to.

No kuan ko ed matunong, a sikato manbilay naani ya andi saew; no sikato manmatalek ed inkatunong to, et mangawa na mauges, angapo naani ed saray matunong a gawa to so nanonotan; no ag ingen say inkauges to a ginawa to, dia ed sikato ompatey naani.
Lamet, no kuan ko ed marelmeng, Ompatey ka naani ya andi saew; no magbabawi ed kasalanan to, tan gawaen to so nikatunongan tan maptek;
No say marelmeng ipawil to so inala to a tinakew, manakar ed saray panontonan na bilay, ya ag mangawa na inkauges, sikato manbilay naani a petepeteg, ag naani ompatey.
Angapo naani ed saray kasalanan to a ginawa to so nanonotan a sumpa ed sikato; sikato ginawa to so unong ed tunong tan maptek; sikato manbilay naani ya andi saew.
Angan ontan saray anak na baley mo kuan da, Say dalan na Katawan ag nanpapara; balet no nipaakar ed sikara, say dalan da ag nanpapara.
No say matunong ompawil a manlapu ed inkatunong to, tan mangawa na inkauges, sikato so ompatey lanlamang ed inkauges.
Et no say marelmeng ompawil a manlapu ed karelmengan to, tan mangawa na inkatunong tan maptek, sikato so manbilay naani lapu ed inkatunong.
Kuan yo ni, Say dalan na Katawan ag nanpapara, O abung na Israel, okomen ta kayo naani balang sakey unong ed dalan to.
Et agawa sanen komalabindua a taon na inkadakep tayo, ed komaplo a bulan, ed komalima ya agew na bulan, a sakey a tinmainan ed Jerusalem linma ed siak ya inkuan to, Say ciudad akabil.

Bang say lima nen Katawan sinmabi nen saman ed siak ed labi, arapen na inyakar na tinmainan; et nilukasan to so sangik anga ed sinmabi ed siak ed kabuasan; et say sangik alukasan tan agak la emel nen saman.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, saray manaayam ed saray pasen ya abagbag ed dalin na Israel mansalita ra, a kuan da, Si Abraham saksakey nen saman, et tinawir to so dalin: balet sikami dakel kami; say dalin niiter ed sikami a tawir.
Kanian kuan mo ed sikara: Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Mangan kayo na dala, tan itangay yo so saray mata yo ed saray talintao yo, tan mangikalbo kayo na dala: et kayarianen yo naani ta so dalin?
Onalagey kayo ed kampilan yo, mangawa kayo na makadimla, tan dumsisan yo balang sakey so asawa a bii na kaabay to: et kayarianen yo naani ta so dalin?

Onia so kuan mo naani ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Unong a siak mabilayak, ag onlaron a saray wala ed saray abagbag a pasen nipasag ira naani ed kampilan; et say wala ed maawang ya uma iter ko naani ed saray ayep pian sikato so nakan; et saray wala ed salimbeng tan saray ongib ompatey ira naani ed salot.
Et gawaen ko naani so dalin a mankibalatar tan pankelawan; et say kapangtaan na biskeg to ontonda naani; et saray palandey na Israel napalis ira naani, kanian angapo naani so onlabas.
Saman la nakabatandaak naani a siak si Katawan, sano gawaen ko so dalin a mankibalatar tan sakey a pankelkelawan, lapu ed saray amin a kadimlaan a ginawa ra.

Et nipaakar ed sika, anak na too, saray anak na baley mo mansalita ra naani a nipaakar ed sika ed abay na saray bakor tan ed saray pinto na saray abung, tan mansalita ra naani a sakey tan sakey, balang sakey ed agi to a laki, a kuan da, Gala, kerewen mi ed sika, tan denglen mo no anto so salita ya ompaway a manlapu ed Katawan.

Et onia ra ed sika, a singa yakar na baley, et onyorong ira ed arap mo a singa say baley ko, tan denglen da so saray salitam, balet agda ra sumpalen; ta dia ed saray sangi ra ipatnag da so dakel ya aro, balet say puso ra onia ra onia ra ed pananap na tubo ra.

Et, nia, sika et sikara so singa sakey a marakep a cancion na sakey ya wala so makapaliket a voces to, tan manogtog a maong ed sakey a kagawaan; ta narengel da so saray salitam, balet agda ra sumpalen.
Et sano saya nasumpal (nia sikato so onsabi), naamtaan da naani a sakey a profeta so wala nen saman ed nanleleetan da.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, manprofeta ka a sumpa ed saray pastol na Israel, manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo ed sikara, ed saray pastol lanlamang, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Kasi la so saray pastol na Israel a pakanen da so saray laman da lanlamang! saray pastol agda ta komon pakanen so saray carnero?
Kanen yo so taba, tan mankawes kayo na bago na carnero, pateyen yo so saray mataba; balet agyo pakanen so saray carnero.

Say makapuy agyo pinabiskeg, tan agyo met tinambal so mabeblay, tan agyo met binedberan so aputer, agyo met isempet so pinatainan, agyo met inanap so abalang; lapu ed panamasoot tan panamairap nanuley kayo ed sikara.
Et ataytayak ira lapu ed angapo so pastol, et agawa ra a tagano ed saray amin ya ayep ed uma, tan atayak ira.

Saray carnerok nanteyengteyeng ira ed saray amin a palandey, tan ed balang atagey a pokdol: on, saray carnerok atayak ira ed amin a lupa na dalin; et angapo so angan siopa ya angosisa odino, nananap ed sikara,
Kanian, sikayo a paspastol, denglen yo so salita nen Katawan:

Unong a mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, petepeteg a lapu ed saray carnerok nagmaliw ira a samsam, tan saray carnerok agawa ra a tagano na saray amin ya ayep ed uma, lapu ed angapo nen saman so manpastol, tan saray managpastol ko agda met inanap so saray carnerok, no ag ingen saray pastol tinagano ra so saray laman da lanlamang, tan agda tinagano so saray carnerok;
Kanian, sikayo paspastol, denglen yo so salita nen Katawan:

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, onsumpaak ed saray pastol; et anapen ko naani so saray carnerok ed lima ra, tan patondaen ko ra naani a manpakan ed saray carnerok; et saray pastol agda met la naani pakanen so inkasikara lanlamang; et ilaban ko naani so saray carnerok ed sangi ra, pian ag ira komon onkana a tagano ed sikara.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, siak lanlamang, on siak, manosisaak naani nipaakar ed saray carnerok, tan anapen ko ra naani.

Unong a say sakey a pastol anapen to so polok to ed agew a sikato so wala ed nanleleetan na saray carnero to a nitayak ed arawi, ontan so pananap ko ed saray carnerok; et ilaban ko ra naani ed saray amin a pasen a nitayakan da ed malurem tan ambilunget ya agew.

Et ipaway ko ra naani a manlapu ed saray baley, tan tiponen ko ra naani a manlapu ed saray dalin, tan yakar ko ra naani ed dalin da lanlamang; et pakanen ko ra naani ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel, ed abay na saray panag-agusan na danudanum, tan ed saray amin a napanayaman a pasen na dalin.

Pakanen ko ra naani ed maong a pankabkaban; et wala naani ed tapew na saray palandey na katageyan na Israel so pokokan da: diman ondokol ira naani ed maong a pokokan; tan ed mataba a pankabkaban napakan ira naani ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel.
Siak met lanlamang so manpastol ed saray carnerok, et parokolen kora naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Anapen ko naani so abalang, tan ipawil ko naani so pinatainan, tan bedberan ko naani so aputer, tan pabiskegen ko naani so mabeblay: balet say mataba tan mabiskeg bagbagen ko; taganoen ko ra naani ed inkatunong.
Et nipaakar ed sikayo, O polok ko, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, okomen ko so carnero tan carnero, say carnero a kalakian tan say kanding a kalakian.

Singa ta melag a bengatla ed sikayo so panangan yo ed maong a pankabkaban, balet igatin yo ed saray sali yo so kera ed pankabkabanyo? tan say paninum yo ed saray malinew a danum, balet dutakan yo so kera ed sali yo?
Et nipaakar ed saray carnerok, kanen da naani so ingatin yo ed saray sali yo, tan inumen da so dinutakan yo ed saray sali yo.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed sikara: Nia, siak, on siak, okomen ko naani so mataba a carnero tan say mabeng a carnero.
Lapu ed dinoyok yo so diking tan abala, tan intoldon yo so saray amin a mabeng ed saray saklor yo, anga ed nitayak ed arawi;
Ilaban ko sirin naani so polok ko, et aliwa lara naani a sakey a samsam; et okomen ko naani so carnero tan carnero.
Et paalageyen ko naani so sakey a pastol ed sikara, et pakanen to ra naani, a sikato si aripen ko a David; pakanen to ra naani, tan sikato naani so pastol da.
Et siak, si Katawan, siak naani Dios da, tan si aripen ko a David so principe ed sikara; Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak.
Et mangawa ak naani ed sikara na sakey a sipan na deen, et patondaen ko naani so saray mauges ya ayep ed dalin; et manayam ira naani a mataletalek dia ed kalawakan, tan naugip ira ed takel.
Et gawaen ko ra naani tan saray pasen ed liberliber na pokdol ko a sakey a bendicion; et papelagen ko naani so mayamaya ed panaon to a nigeter; wala naani mayamaya na bendicion.

Et say kiew ed uma mamapaway naani na bunga to, tan say dalin mangiter naani na munat to, et mataletalek ira naani ed dalin da; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, sano puteren ko so saray balewet na pako ra, tan ilaban ko ra ed lima na saray angaripen ed sikara.
Et ag ira la naani sakey a samsam ed saray nacion, et saray ayep ed dalin agda ra met la naani sabsaben; no ag ingen manayam ira naani a mataletalek, tan angapo ni manaktakot ed sikara.
Et mangipasen ak naani ed sikara na sakey a tanamanan a nipaakar a dayew, et ag ira la naani naopot ed eras ed dalin, tan agda met la naani awiten so baing na saray nacion.
Et naamtaan da naani a siak, si Katawan a Dios da, wala ak ed sikara, et sikara, say abung na Israel, sikara so baley ko, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et sikayo so carnerok, say carnero na panagpakabkaban ko totoo ra, et siak so Dios yo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Arum ni say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam a sumpa ed palandey Seir, tan manprofeta ka a sumpa ed sikato,
Et kuan mo ed sikato, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, onsumpa ak ed sika, O palandey Seir, et yunat ko naani so limak a sumpa ed sika, et gawaen ta ka naani a mankibalatar tan pankelkelawan.
Bagbagen ko naani so saray ciudad mo, et sika mankibalatar ka naani; et naamtaan mo naani a siak si Katawan.
Lapu ed wala nen saman ed sika so naynay a pibobosolan, et inyawat mo so saray anak na Israel ed biskeg na kampilan ed panaon na irap da, et panaon na inkauges na kasumpalan;
Kanian, unong a siak mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, itadia taka naani anga ed dala, et say dala osilan to ka naani: lapu ed agmo ginula so dala, dala sirin so onosil naani ed sika.
Onia naani so gawaen ko ed palandey Seir a sakey a pankelawan tan mankibalatar; et isian ko naani ed sikato so onlabas tan say ompawil.
Et panoen ko naani so saray palandey to ed saray pinatey to: ed saray pokdol mo tan ed saray lawak mo, tan ed saray amin a panag-agusan mo na danum nipasag ira naani so saray pinatey ed kampilan.
Gawaen ta ka naani a mankibalatar lawas tan saray ciudad mo ag ira naani panayaman; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Lapu ed inkuan mo, Saraya so duaran nacion tan saraya a duaran dalin kien ko ra naani, tan sikara naani kayarianen mi; lapu ed si Katawan wala nen saman diman.

Kanian, unong a siak mabilay ak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, gawaen ko naani so unong ed sanok ko, tan unong ed siblet mo a sikato so inpatnag mo a nanlapu ed gulam a sumpa ed sikara; et manpakabatak naani ed sikara, sano okomen ta ka.
Et naamtaan mo naani a siak, si Katawan, nadngel ko so saray amin a panangayew mo a sinalitam a sumpa ed saray palandey na Israel, ya inkuan mo, Mankibalatar ira, niiter ira ed sikatayo a kanen.
Et pinabaleg yo so saray inkasikayo lanlamang a sumpa ed siak a pati sangi yo, tan pinarakel yo so saray salita yo a sumpa ed siak: sikato so nadngel ko.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sano say amin a dalin manliket, gawaen taka naani a mankibalatar.

No panon a nanliket ka ed tawir na abung na Israel, lapu ed sikato so mankibalatar, ontan naani so gawaen ko ed sika: mankibalatar ka naani. O palandey Seir tan amin ya Edom, salanti amin to; et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan.
Et sika, anak na too, manprofeta ka ed saray palandey na Israel, tan ikuan mo, Sikayo palpalandey na Israel, denglen yo so salita nen Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed say kabosol inkuan to a sumpa ed sikayo, Aha, tan, Saray daan ya atagey a paspasen mo kientayo ra dia ed pankayarian;

Kanian manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed, on lapu ed ginawa ra kayo a mankibalatar, ed inakmon da kayo ed balang diking, pian magmaliw kayo komon a kayarian na kera na saray nacion, tan nala kayo ed saray bibil na malabir, tan say mauges a balita ed baley;

Kanian, sikayo palpalandey na Israel, denglen yo so salita nen Katawan a Dios: Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed saray palandey tan ed saray pokdol, ed saray panagagusan na danudanum tan ed saray lawak, ed saray mankibalatar a bagbag tan ed saray ciudad ya apaulian a sikara so nagmaliw a samsam tan ludlurey ed kera na saray nacion ya wala ed liberliber;

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Andi saew dia ed apuy na imon ko nansalita ak ed kera na saray nacion, tan sumpa ed amin ya Edom, ya anoro ed dalin ko ed sikara lanlamang a sakey a kayarian ya wala so liket ed amin a puso ra, ya wala so gula na kamarerwa, pian sikato so ibantak da a nipaakar a samsam.

Kanian manprofeta ka nipaakar ed dalin na Israel, tan ikuan mo ed saray palandey tan ed saray pokdol, ed saray panag-agusan na danudanum tan saray lawak, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, nansalita ak dia ed imon ko, tan dia ed sanok ko, lapu ed inawit mo so baing na saray nacion:
Onia lanti so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Insambak, ya inkuan ko, Andi saew a saray nacion ya wala ed liberliber yo, sikara awiten da naani so baing da.
Balet sikayo, O palpalandey na Israel, isimit yo naani so saray sanga yo, tan iter yo so bunga yo ed baley ko ya Israel: ta sikara asinger lara ya onsabi.
Ta, nia, siak gampi ak ed sikayo, tan ompawil ak naani ed sikayo, et nadalusan kayo naani tan nataneman kayo naani;
Et parakelen ko naani so saray lalaki ed sikayo, amin ya abung na Israel, on amin; et saray ciudad napanayaman ira naani, tan saray abagbag a pasen nipaalagey ira naani:

Et parakelen ko naani ed sikayo so too tan say ayep; et naaroman ira naani tan mabunga ra; et pagmaliwen ta kayo naani a napanayaman a singa nen inmuna a kipapasen yo, et mangawa ak naani na magmaong ed sikayo nen dia ed saray gapu yo: et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
On, panakaren ko naani so saray lalaki ed sikayo, salanti say baley ko ya Israel; et kayarianen da ka naani, tan sika naani táwir da, et manlapu la ed natan agmo ra ekalan na saray anak.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed kuan da ed sikayo, Sika dalin manangakmon ka na totoo, tan sakey a manamaermen ed nacion mo;
Kanian agka la naani manbuag ed saray totoo, tan agka met la naani mamaermen ed nacion mo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios;
Tan ag taka la naani paulian ya ondengel na baing na saray nacion, tan agmo met la naani awiten so balaw na saray baley, agka met la naani paigapol ed baley mo, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Laot ni say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Anak na too, sanen say abung na Israel nanayam ed dili a dalin da, sikato so dinutakan da lapu ed dalan da tan lapu ed saray gawa ra: say dalan da ed arap ko singa say inkarutak na bii ed kaliberan to na bulan.
Kanian inibung ko so sanok ko ed sikara lapu ed dala ya inibung da ed dalin, tan lapu ed sikato so dinutakan da ed saray talintao ra:
Et intayak ko ra ed saray nacion, tan nitayak ira ed saray dalin, unong ed dalan da; tan unong ed saray gawa ra inokom ko ra.

Et sanen sinmabi ra ed saray nacion a nila ra, minurara so masanto a ngaran ko, dia ed ontan a saray totoo inkuan da a nipaakar ed sikara, Saraya sikara so baley nen Katawan, et pinmaway ira ed dalin to.
Et wala nen saman so panangasik lapu ed masanto a ngaran ko, a sikato so minura na abung na Israel ed nanleleetan na saray nacion, a nila ra.

Kanian kuan mo ed abung na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Agko gawaen so say a lapu ed sikayo, O abung na Israel, no ag lapu ed masanto a ngaran ko, a sikato so minura yo ed nanleleetan na saray nacion a nila yo.

Et pasantoen ko naani so baleg a ngaran ko, a sikato so amura ed nanleleetan na saray nacion, a sikato so minura yo ed nanleleetan da; et saray nacion naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, sano napasanto ak ed sikayo ed arap na saray mata ra.
Ta alaen ta kayo naani a manlapu ed nanleleetan na saray nacion, tan tiponen takayo naani a manlapu ed saray amin a dalin, tan yakar takayo ed dili a dalin yo.
Et iwalsik ko naani so malinew a danum ed sikayo, et malinis kayo naani; manlapu ed amin ya inkarutak yo, tan manlapu ed saray amin a taltalintao yo, linisan ta kayo naani.
Itdan ta kayo naani na sakey a balo a puso, tan sakey a balo ya espiritu so yan ko naani ed dalem yo; et ekalen ko naani so ginmibato a puso ed laman yo, tan itdan ta kayo naani na puso a laman.
Et yan ko naani so Espirituk ed dalem yo, tan panakaren ta kayo naani ed saray panontonan ko, tan onoren yo naani so saray pangoksoyan ko, tan gawaen yo ra.
Et manayam kayo naani ed dalin ya initer ko ed saray atateng yo; et sikayo naani so baley ko, et siak naani Dios yo.
Et ilaban ta kayo naani ed saray amin a karutakan yo, et manawagak naani na bukel, et sikato naani parakelen ko, tan agak naani mangyan na eras ed sikayo.
Et parakelen ko naani so bunga na kiew, tan say munat na uma, pian agyo la awaten komon ed saray nacion so balaw ed eras.

Saman la nonoten yo so saray mauges a dalan yo, tan saray gawa yo ya aliwa ra nen saman a maong; et kagula yo naani so saray laman yo lanlamang dia ed dili a pakanengneng yo lapu ed saray inkauges yo tan lapu ed saray kadimlaan yo.
Aliwa a lapu ed sikayo gawaen ko so saya, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, amtaen yo: ombaing kayo tan nagolo kayo lapu ed saray dalan yo, O abung na Israel.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dia ed agew a linisan ta kayo ed saray amin ya inkauges yo, gawaen ko naani so saray ciudad a napanayaman, tan nipaalagey so saray abagbag a pasen.
Et say dalin a mankibalatar nen saman nadalusan naani, angan sikato nen saman so mankibalatar ed pakanengneng na saray amin a linmabas.
Et ikuan da naani, Saya a dalin a mankibalatar nen saman nagmaliw a singa say panagtanamanan na Eden; et say abagbag tan mankibalatar tan apalis a ciudad akutaan tan napanayaman.

Saman la saray nacion ya atilak ed liberliber yo, naamtaan da naani a siak, si Katawan, pinaalagey ko so saray abagbag a pasen, tan tinaneman ko so nankibalatar: Siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak tan sikato so gawaen ko naani.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Lapu ed saya, ontan met, siak naani pibalitaan na abung na Israel, pian sikato so gawaenton nipaakar ed sikara: parakelen ko ra naani ed saray lalaki a singa polok.

Singa say polok a nipaakar a bagat, singa say polok na Jerusalem ed saray nigeter a panliket to, ontan so saray abagbag a ciudad napano ra naani ed saray polok na lalaki; et naamtaan da a siak si Katawan.
Say lima nen Katawan wala nen saman ed siak, et sikato impaway to ak ed Espiritu nen Katawan, tan ingaton toak ed pegley na lawak; et napno na pukepukel.
Et sikato pinalabas toak ed abay da ed liberliber; et, nia, dakerakel ira ed maalindaway a lawak; et nia, naklangan ira.
Et inkaun to ed siak, Anak na too nayarian na saraya a pukepukel so manbilay? Et siak inmebatak, O Katawan a Dios, sika antam.
Inkuan to lamet ed siak, Manprofeta ka ed saraya a pukepukel, tan kuan mo ed sikara, O sikayo naklangan a pukepukel, denglen yo so salita nen Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios ed sarayan pukepukel: Nia, palooben ko naani so panlinawa ed sikayo, et manbilay kayo naani.

Et mangigaton ak naani na saray ulat ed tapew yo, tan mangyakar ak naani na laman ed sikayo, tan ponggosen takayo na baog, tan mangyanak na panlinawa ed sikayo, et manbilay kayo naani; et naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan.
Dia ed ontan nanprofeta ak unong ed nibilin ed siak: et leleg na inpanprofetak, wala nen saman so sakey ya ongol, et nia, sakey a yegyeg: et saray pukel nantitipon ira, pukel ed pukel to.
Et ninmengnengak, et, nia, wala nen saman so ulat ed tapew da, tan sinmabi laman, tan say baog sinakbongan to ra; balet ta angapo nen saman so panlinawa ed sikara.

Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Manprofeta ka ed dagem, manprofeta ka, anak na too, tan kuan mo ed dagem, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Ondago ka a manlapu ed saray apatiran dagem, O panlinawa, tan panlinawaen mo so saraya a pinatey, pian manbilay ira komon.
Kanian nanprofeta ak unong ed inbilin to ed siak, et say panlinawa linma ed sikara, et sikara nanbilay ira, tan inmalagey ira ed saray sail ra, sakey a mapalalo ya kinarakel a inayuraan.
Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, saraya a pukepukel sikara ya amin so abung na Israel: nia, kuan da, Saray pukel mi naklangan ira, et say ilalo mi abalang; sikami nasiyan kami a sigpot.

Kanian manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, lukasan ko naani so saray lobok yo, et patatdangen takayo naani a manlapu ed saray lobok yo, O baley ko; et yakar takayo naani ed dalin na Israel.
Naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan, sano lukasan ko so saray lobok yo, tan patatdangen takayo a manlapu ed saray lobok yo, O baley ko.
Et yan ko naani so Espirituk ed sikayo, et manbilay kayo naani, tan ipasen takayo naani ed dili a dalin yo; et naamtaan yo naani a siak, si Katawan, sikato so sinalitak tan ginawak, kuan nen Katawan.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi lamet ed siak, ya inkuan to,

Et sika, anak na too, mangala ka na sakey a tayokor, tan isulat mo ed sikato, Nipaakar ed Juda, tan ed saray anak na Israel a kaiba to ra: insan ka mangala na sananey a tayokor, tan isulat mo ed sikato, Nipaakar ed Jose, say tayokor nen Efraim, tan nipaakar ed amin ya abung na Israel a kaiba to ra:
Et pantiponen mo ra nipaakar ed sika say sakey tan sakey ed sakey a tayokor, pian magmaliw ira komon a saksakey ed limam.
Et no saray anak na baley mo mansalita ra naani ed sika, a kuan da, Agmo ta ipatnag ed sikami no anto so kanonotan mo ed saraya?

Ikuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, alaen ko naani so tayokor nen Jose, a sikato so wala ed lima nen Efraim, tan say kailalakan nen Israel a kaiba to ra: et yan ko ra naani a niolop ed sikato, on niolop ed tayokor na Juda, et gawaen ko ra naani a saksakey a tayokor, et saksakey ira naani ed limak.
Et saray tayokor a nansulatan mo wala naani ed limam ed arap na saray mata ra.

Et kuan mo ed sikara, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, alaen ko naani so saray anak na Israel a manlapu ed saray nacion, a sikara so nila ra, tan tiponen ko ra naani ed balang diking, tan yakar ko ra naani ed dili a dalin da:

Et pagmaliwen ko ra naani a sakey a nacion ed dalin, ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel; et sakey ya ari sikato naani ari ed sikara ya amin; et agla'ra naani duara a nacion, et ag met lara naani naapag a mogmo ed duara a panarian;

Agda met la naani dutakan so inkasikara lanlamang ed saray talintao ra odino ed saray makapaingongot a bengabengat da, odino ed angan anto ed saray pakasumlang da; no ag ingen ilaban ko ra naani ed saray amin a pasen a panayaman da, a sikara so naiikasalananan da, et linisan ko ra naani: pian sikara naani baley ko, tan siak naani Dios da.

Et si aripen ko a David sikato naani ari ed sikara; et sikara ya amin wala naani saksakey a pastol da: manakar met ira naani ed saray panontonan ko, tan onoren da so saray pangoksoyan ko, tan gawaen da ra.

Et manayam ira naani ed dalin ya initer ko ed Jacob ya aripen ko, a sikato so nanayaman na saray atateng yo; et manayam ira naanid'man, sikara tan saray anak da, tan saray anak na saray anak da ed ando lan ando: et si David ya aripen ko sikato naani principe ra ed ando lan ando.

Ontan met mangawa ak naani na sakey a sipan na panpapaknaan ed sikara; sikato naani magnayon a sipan ed sikara; et ipasen ko ra naani tan parakelen ko ra, tan iletneg ko naani santuariok ed pegley da ed ando lan ando lawas.
Say tabernaculok met wala naani ed sikara; et siak naani Dios da, tan sikara naani baley ko.
Et saray nacion naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan a mamasanto ed Israel, sano say santuariok wala ed pegley da ed ando lan ando lawas.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed siak, ya inkuan to,
Anak na too, yarap mo so lupam ed Gog, ed dalin na Magog, say principe na Ros, Mesec tan Tubal, tan manprofeta ka a sumpa ed sikato.
Et kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, onsumpa ak ed sika, O Gog, principe na Ros, Mesec tan Tubal,

Et patleken ta ka naani, tan mangyan ak na saray taga ed saray pangal mo, et ipaway taka naani, tan amin ya inayuraan mo, saray kabayo, tan lalaki a nankabayo ed saray kabayo, amin da nankawes ira dia ed nagnap ya ayura, sakey a baleg ya olop ya walaan na saray panagsegpay tan kinlong, sikara ya amin nanegna ra na saray kampilan:
Say Persia, Cush, tan Put niolop ed sikara, sikara ya amin walaan ira na saray kinlong tan pamulaw;
Say Gomer, tan saray amin ya olop to; say abung na Tagorma ed kaatageyan a gaton ed amianen, tan saray amin a dakel ya olop to; salanti dakel a balbaley niolop ed sika.
Manparaan ka komon, on, iparaan mo so inkasika, sika, tan saray amin ya olop mo ya atipon ed sika, et sika komon so manbantay ed sikara.

Kayari na saray dakel ya agew nadalaw ka naani: ed saray kaonoran a taon onla ka naani ed dalin a nipawil a nanlapu ed kampilan, a natipon a manlapu ed saray dakel a baley, ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel, a sikara nen saman so naynay ya abagbag; balet sikato so nipaway a manlapu ed saray baley, et sikara manayam ira naani a mataletalek, sikara ya amin.
Et onsegep ka naani, onsabi ka naani a singa sakey a bagyo, singa ka naani sakey a lurem a manakbong ed dalin, sika, tan saray amin ya olop mo, tan dakel a balbaley a niolop ed sika.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nagawa naani ed satan ya agew, a bengabengatla onla ra naani ed kanonotan mo, tan mannonot ka naani na mauges a kanonotan:

Et ikuan mo naani, ontatdang ak naani ed dalin ya ag binakoran a polok; onla ak naani ed saray wala ed pampainawa, a manaayam a mataletalek, ya amin da manaayam ira ya andian na saray bakor, tan angapo met so balbalewet odino wangwangalan;

Pian alaen ko so samsam tan mangalaak na degkem; pian ipawil ko so limam a sumpa ed saray abagbag a pasen a napanayaman la natan, tan sumpa ed baley a natipon a manlapu ed saray nacion, ya akagamor na saray baka tan kayarian, a manayam ed pegley na dalin.

Say Saba, tan Dedan, tan saray managlako na Tarsis, pati saray amin a kilaw to a leon, ikuan da naani ed sika, Linma ka dia a mangala na samsam? tinipon mo so olop mo pian mangala ka na degkem? pian itainan mo so pilak tan balitok, pian itainan mo so saray baka tan kayarian, pian alaen mo so baleg a samsam?
Kanian, anak na too, manprofeta ka, tan kuan mo ed Gog, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dia ed satan ya agew sano say baley ko ya Israel onligen a mataletalek sikato naani ta so agmo naamtaan?

Et onsabi ka naani a manlapu ed pasen mo ya ompaway ed saray kasampotan a gaton na amianen, sika, tan dakel a balbaley a niolop ed sika, ya amin da dikabayoan ira sakey a baley ya olop tan sakey a mabiskeg ya inayuraan;

Et ontatdang ka naani a sumpa ed baley ko ya Israel, a singa sakey a lurem a manakbong na dalin: nagawa naani ed saray kaonoran ya agew a yakar ta ka naani a sumpa ed dalin ko, pian saray nacion naamtaan da ak, sano napasanto ak ed sika, O Gog, ed arap na saray mata ra.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Sika ta man so sinalitak sanen inmuna a panaon ed panamegley na saray ariripen ko a profeta na Israel, ya nanprofeta ed saraman ya agew nipaakar ed saray dakel a taon pian yakar ta ka a sumpa ed sikara?
Et nagawa dia ed saman ya agew, sano say Gog onsabi a sumpa ed dalin na Israel, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, a say sanok ko onloob naani ed saray abot na eleng ko.
Ta dia ed imun ko tan dia ed apuy na sanok ko sinalitak, Petepeteg dia ed satan ya agew wala naani baleg a yegyeg ed dalin na Israel:

Dia ed ontan ya saray sira na dayat, tan saray manok ed saray tawen tan saray ayep ed uma, tan saray amin a bigis ya korongkorong ed tapew na dalin, tan saray amin a totoo ya wala ed lupa na dalin onyegyeg ira naani ed arap ko, tan saray palandey nabagbag ira naani, tan saray nipangdel a pasen nageba ra naani, tan amin a bakor napelag ed dalin.
Et manawag ak naani na sakey a kampilan a sumpa ed sikato anga ed saray amin a palandey ko, kuan nen Katawan a Dios: balang sakey a kampilan na laki sumpa naani ed agi to a laki.

Et pati salot tan dala onloob ak naani ed pangokom ed sikato; et pauranen ko naani ed tapew to, tan ed saray dakel ya olop to, tan ed saray baley ya wala ed sikato, na sakey a manelap a mayamaya, tan ankabaleg ya uran a bato, apuy tan asufre.

Et pabalegen ko so inkasiak lanlamang, tan pasantoen ko so inkasiak lanlamang, tan ipakabat ko naani so inkasiak lanlamang ed pakanengneng na dakel a nacion; et naamtaan da ak naani a siak si Katawan.
Et sika, anak na too, manprofeta ka a sumpa ed Gog, tan kuan mo, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Nia, Onsumpaak ed sika, O gog, principe na Ros, Mesec tan Tubal:
Et patleken ta ka naani, tan itonton ta ka naani, tan patatdangen taka naani a manlapu ed kaatageyan a gaton na amianen; et yakar ta ka naani ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel;
Et kabilen ko naani so bekang mo ed kawigi a limam, tan papelagen ko naani so saray panam ed kawanan a limam.

Nipasag ka naani ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel, sika, tan amin ya dakel ya olop mo, tan saray baley a niolop ed sika: iter taka naani ed saray managsamsam a manok ed saray tawen ya amin a nengneng, tan ed saray ayep ed uma a naakmon.
Nipasag ka naani ed mapalaway ya uma, ta sikato so sinalitak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et mangipawitak naani na apuy ed Magog tan ed saray manaayam a mataletalek ed saray polpolo; et naamtaan da ak naani a siak si Katawan.

Et say masanto a ngaran ko ipakabat ko naani ed pegley na baley ko ya Israel; et agko la naani itepel a say masanto a ngaran ko namura; et saray nacion naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan, say Santo na Israel.
Nia, sikato so onsabi, tan nagawa naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios; saya sikato so agew a sinalitak.

Et saray manaayam ed ciudad na Israel ompaway ira naani, tan mangawa ra naani na saray apuy ed saray ayura tan poolan da ra, saray panagsegpay tan kinlong, saray bekang tan saray pana, tan saray batagan tan saray sakal et mangawa ra naani na saray apuy ed sikara a pito' ran taon;

Dia ed ontan ya ag ira mangala naani na kiew ed uma, tan ag ira met naani mamatang na angan anto ed saray takel; ta mangawa ra naani na saray apuy ed saray ayura; et samsaman da naani so saray nansamsam ed sikara, tan takewan da naani so saray nantakew ed sikara, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew ya iter ko naani ed Gog so sakey a pasen a panangiponponan dia ed Israel, say lawak na saray onlabas ed bokig na dayat; et patondaen to naani so saray onlabas: et diman ikotkot da naani so Gog tan say amin a karakel to; et sikato naani tawagen da na Say lawak na Hamongog.
Et say abung na Israel pito a bulan ya ikotkot to ra, pian nalinisan to so dalin.
On, amin a baley ed dalin so mangitabon ed sikara; et sikato naani ed sikara so sakey a galang ed agew a kitandorok naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Et mangibiig ira naani na lalaki ya ag ontonda a mankimey, ya onlabas naani ed dalin, tan, pati saray onlabas, saraman so mangitabon a natilak ed tapew na dalin, pian manlinis ed sikato; kasumpal na pito'ran bulan manosisa ra naani.

Et saray onlabas ed dalin onlabas ira naani; et sano angan siopa a nanengneng to so pukel na sakey a too, sikato so mangiletneg na sakey a tanda ed abay to, anga ed saray mangitabon sikato so itabon da dia ed lawak na Hamongog.
Et Hamona naani so ngaran na ciudad. Onia so panlinis da ed dalin.

Et sika, anak na too, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Mansalita ka ed saray manok ed saray tawen a nambabangil a nengneng, tan ed balang ayep ed uma, Mantitipon, kayo, tan dago kayo, mantitipon kayo ed balang diking ed bagat ko ya ibagat ko lapu ed sikayo, on, sakey a baleg a bagat ed tapew na saray palandey na Israel, pian mangan kayo komon na laman tan oninum kayo na dala.

Kanen yo naani so laman na saray mabiskeg, tan inumen yo naani so dala na saray principe na dalin, saray carnero a kalakian, saray cordero, tan kankanding, tan saray baka, sikara ya amin apataba ra ed Basan.
Et mangan kayo naani na taba anga ed napesel kayo, tan oninum kayo, na dala anga ed nabuek kayo, ed bagat ko ya inbagat ko lapu ed sikayo.
Et napenek kayo naani ed abay na dulang ko ed saray kabayo tan saray luganan, pati saray mabiskeg a lalaki, tan amin a lalaki a mibabakal, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et iletneg ko naani so gloriak, ed nanleleetan na saray nacion; et saray amin a nacion nanengneng da naani so pangokom ko a ginawak, tan say limak ya ingaton ko ed tapew da.
Dia ed ontan say abung na Israel naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan a Dios da, manlapu ed satan ya agew tan ed arapen.

Et saray nacion naamtaan da naani a say abung na Israel linma ed inkadakep lapu ed inkauges da; lapu ed sinmumlang ira sumpa ed siak, et inyamot ko so lupak ed sikara: kanian initer kora ed lima na saray kasumpa ra, et sikara nipasag ira ya amin ed kampilan.
Unong ed inkarutak da tan unong ed saray inpakasumlang da nanagamilak ed sikara; et inyamot ko so lupak ed sikara.
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Natan ipawil ko naani ta so inkadakep nen Jacob, tan wala naani panangasik ed abung na Israel: et manimun ak naani lapu ed masanto a ngaran ko.
Et awiten da naani so baing da, tan saray amin ya inpakasumlang da a sinumlangan da sumpa ed siak, sano manayam ira a mataletalek ed dalin da, tan angapo so manaktakot naani ed sikara;
Sano nipawil kora a manlapu ed saray baley, tan nadagdagup ko ra a manlapu ed saray dalin na saray kabosol da, tan napasanto ak ed sikara ed pakanengneng na dakel a nacion.

Et naamtaan da naani a siak si Katawan a Dios da, tan pinaakar ko ra ed inkadakep ed saray nacion, tan tinipon ko ra ed dili a dalin da lanlamang; et angapo la naani so itilak ko ya angan siopa ed sikarad'man:
Et agko met la naani yamot so lupak ed sikara; ta inyibung ko so Espirituk ed abung na Israel, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Dia ed komaduamplo tan lima a taon na inkadakep mi, ed kagapu na taon, ed komaplo ya agew na bulan, ed komalabinapat a taon ed kayari na inkabagbag na ciudad, dia ed satan lanlamang ya agew, say lima nen Katawan wala nen saman ed siak, et sikato inyakar to ak diman.

Dia ed saray pasingawey na Dios inyakar to ak ed dalin na Israel, tan ingaton to ak ed sakey a sankatageyan a palandey, a sikato so kawalaan nen saman na sakey a singa kapadpara na sakey a ciudad ed abalaten.

Et inyakar toak diman; et, nia wala nen saman so sakey a laki, a say nengneng to singa nengneng na gansa, ya wala so lubir a lino ed lima to, tan sakey a panagsukat a kawayan; et sikato so nanalagey dia ed wangalan.

Et saman so laki inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, nengnengen na saray matam, tan denglen na saray layag mo, tan yan mo so pusom ed saray amin ya ipatnag ko naani ed sika; ta, lapu ed kanonotan a nipatnag ko ra ed sika, niyakar ka dia: ipaliwawam ya amin so nanengneng mo ed Israel.

Et, nia, sakey a bakor ed paway na abung ed liberliber, tan dia ed lima na laki sakey a panagsukat a kawayan, ya anem a siko so karukey, a sakey a siko tan sankadakulap so balang sakey: dia ed ontan sinukat to so kakapal na abung, sakey a kawayan; et say kaatagey, sakey a kawayan,

Saman la linma ed wangalan ya arap ed dapit bokig, tan sinmegep ed saray balitang to: et sinukat to so sasabien na wangalan, sakey a kawayan so kaawang to; et say sananey a sasabien, sakey a kawayan so kaawang to.

Et balang silir sakey a kawayan so karukey to, tan sakey a kawayan so kaawang to; et say leet ed pegley na saray silir sikato so lima a siko; et say sasabien na wangalan ed abay na olsoran na wangalan ya arap ed abung sikato so sakey a kawayan.
Sinukat to met so olsoran na wangalan ya arap ed abung, sakey a kawayan.
Saman la sinukat to so olsoran na wangalan, waloraa siko; et saray lusek to, duaran siko; et say olsoran na wangalan arap nen saman ed abung.

Et saray silir na wangalan a mamabokig talora ra nen saman ed saya a diking, tan talora ra ed satan a diking; sikara a talo saksakey ira a sukat: et saray lusek saksakey so sukat da ed saya a diking tan ed satan a diking.
Et sinukat to so kaawang na pangilukasan ed wangalan, samploran siko: et say karukey na wangalan labintalo a siko;

Tan sakey a leet ed arap na saray silir, sakey a siko ed saya a diking, tan sakey a leet, sakey a siko ed satan a diking; et saray silir, anem a siko ed saya a diking, tan anem a siko ed satan a diking,
Et sinukat to so wangalan a manlapu ed atep na sakey a silir anga ed atep na sananey, sakey a kaawang na duamplo tan lima a siko; pinto ya petek ed pinto.
Sikato nangawa met na saray lusek, anemaplo a siko; et say saban dinmampot anga ed saray lusek, ed liberliber na wangalan.
Et manlapu ed patnag na wangalan ed lolooban anga ed patnag na akindalem ya olsoran na wangalan sikato so limamplo a siko.

Et wala ra nen saman so nikaput a dorongawen ed saray silir, tan ed abay na saray lusek da ed loob na wangalan ed liberliber, tan ontan met ed saray basikaw; et saray dorongawen wala ed liberliber ed loob; tan ed tapew na balang lusek wala ra so kiew a palma.

Saman la inyakar toak ed akinpaway a saban; et, nia, wala ra nen saman so silisilir tan sakey a gagatinan ya agawa nipaakar ed saban ed liberliber; talomplo a silir so wala nen saman ed tapew na gagatinan.
Et say gagatinan wala nen saman ed abay na saray wangalan unong ed karukey na saray wangalan, say akinlepsag ni a gagatinan.
Saman la sinukat to so kaawang a manlapu ed patnag na akinlepsag ya wangalan anga ed patnag na akindalem a saban ed paway, sanlasus a siko, nanpadpara ed bokig tan amianen.
Et say pulong-pinto na akinpaway a saban ya akaarap ed amianen sinukat to so karukey to tan say kaawang to.

Et saray silir to sikara so talora ed saya a diking tan talora ed satan a diking; et saray lusek to tan saray basikaw to singa ra say sukat na inmuna ya wangalan: say karukey to sikato so limamplo a siko, et say kaawang duamplo tan lima a siko.

Et saray dorongawen to, tan saray basikaw to, tan saray kiew to a palma singa ra say sukat na wangalan ya inmarap ed bukig; et sinmegep ira ed sikato ed pitora a balitang; et saray basikaw to wala ra nen saman ed arap da.
Et wala nen saman so sakey ya wangalan na akindalem a saban ed petek na sananey ya wangalan, nanpadpara ed amianen tan ed bokig; et sinukat to manlapu ed wangalan anga ed wangalan sanlasus a siko.
Et sikato intonton to ak ed dapit abalaten; et, nia, sakey ya wangalan ya arap ed abalaten: et sinukat to so saray lusek to tan saray basikaw to unong ed saraya a sukat.

Et wala ra nen saman so dorongawen ed sikato tan ed saray basikaw to ed liberliber, singa saraman a dorongawen: say karukey sikato so limamplo a siko, et say kaawang sikato so duamplo tan lima a siko.

Et wala nen saman so pitora a balitang a segepan ed sikato, et saray basikaw to wala ra nen saman ed arap da; et wala nen saman so kiekiew to a palma, sakey ed saya a diking, tan sakey ed satan a diking ed saray lusek to.
Et wala nen saman so sakey ya wangalan ed akindalem a saban ed mamaabalaten; et sinukat to manlapu ed wangalan anga ed wangalan sanlasus a siko.
Saman la inyakar toak ed akindalem a saban ed abay na akinabalaten ya wangalan: et sinukat to so akinabalaten ya wangalan ya unong ed saraya a sukat;

Et saray silir to, tan saray lusek to, tan saray basikaw to, unong ed saraya a sukat: et wala ra nen saman so dorongawen ed sikato tan ed saray basikaw to ed liberliber; sikato so limamplo a siko ed karukey, tan duamplo tan lima a siko ed kaawang.
Et wala nen saman so basbasikaw ed liberliber, duamplo tan lima a siko ed karukey, tan lima'ran siko ed kaawang.
Et saray basikaw to onarap ira nen saman ed akinpaway a saban; et kiekiew a palma wala nen saman ed saray lusek to: et say segepan ed sikato wala so walo ra a balitang to.
Et inyakar toak ed akindalem a saban ed mamabokig: et sinukat to so saban ya unong ed saraya a sukat;

Et saray silir to, tan saray lusek to, tan saray basikaw to, unong ed saraya a sukat: et wala ra nen saman so dorongawen diman tan ed saray basikaw to ed liberliber; sikato so limamplo a siko ed karukey tan duamplo tan lima a siko ed kaawang.

Et saray basikaw to onarap ira nen saman ed akinpaway a saban; et saray kiew a palma wala ra nen saman ed saray lusek to, ed saya a diking, tan ed satan a diking, et say segepan ed sikato wala so walo ra a balitang to.
Et inyakar toak ed akinamianen a wangalan: et sikato so sinukat to unong ed saraya a sukat;
Saray silir to, saray lusek to, tan saray basikaw to: et wala ra nen saman so dorongawen diman ed liberliber: say karukey sikato so limamplo a siko, et say kaawang duamplo tan lima a siko.

Et saray lusek to arap ira nen saman ed akinpaway a saban; et saray kiew a palma wala ra nen saman ed saray lusek to, ed saya a diking, tan ed satan a diking; et say segepan ed sikato wala so walora a balitang to.
Et sakey a silir pati say pinto to wala nen saman ed abay na saray lusek ed saray wangalan; diman inurasan da so bagat a napoolan.

Et dia ed olsoran wala nen saman so duara a dulang ed saya a diking, tan duara a dulang ed satan a diking pian pateyen diman so bagat a napoolan tan say bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan tan say bagat lapu ed inpakasumlang.

Tan ed sakey a diking ed paway, no say sakey onsegep ed lolooban na wangalan a mamaamianen, wala nen saman so duara a dulang; tan ed sananey a diking; a sikato so nipaakar ed olsoran na wangalan, wala so duara a dulang.
Apatira a dulang so wala nen saman ed saya a diking, tan apatira a dulang ed satan a diking, ed abay na wangalan; walo ra a dulang, a dia ed tapew da pinatey da so saray bagat.

Et wala nen saman so apatira a dulang nipaakar ed bagat a napoolan, a pinanday a bato, sakey a siko tan kapaldua so kadukey, tan sakey a siko tan kapaldua so kaawang, tan sakey a siko so kaatagey; ed tapew da ingaton da so saray kagawaan ya inpamatey da ed bagat a napoolan tan say bagat.
Et saray kalawit, sankadakulap ed dukey, nisinger ira ed dalem ed liberliber: tan ed tapew na saray dulang wala nen saman so laman na bagat.

Tan ed paway na akindalem a wangalan wala ra nen saman so silir nipaakar ed saray komacanta dia ed akindalem a saban, a sikato so wala nen saman ed abay na akinamianen a wangalan; et akaarap ira nen saman ed abalaten; sakey ed diking na akinbokig a wangalan ya akaarap ed amianen.
Et sikato inkuan to ed siak, Saya a silir, ya arap ed abalaten, sikato so nipaakar ed saray sacerdote, saray managbantay ed panangimaton ed abung.

Et say silir ya arap ed amianen sikato so nipaakar ed saray sacerdote, saray managbantay ed panangimaton ed altar: saraya sikara so saray anak a lalaki nen Sadoc, a sikara manlapu ed saray anak a lalaki nen Levi onasinger ira ed Katawan mankatangbayan ed sikato.
Et sinukat to so saban, sanlasus a siko ed karukey, tan sanlasus a siko ed kaawang a cuadrado; et say altar wala nen saman ed arap na abung.

Saman la inyakar to ak ed olsoran na abung, tan sinukat to so balang lusek na olsoran, lima a siko ed saya a diking, tan lima a siko ed satan a diking; et say kaawang na wangalan sikato so taloran siko ed saya a diking, tan talora a siko ed satan a diking.

Say karukey na olsoran sikato so duamplo a siko, et say kaawang labinsakey a siko; salanti ed abay na saray balitang a sinegepan da ed sikato: et wala'ray seklang nen saman ed abay na saray lusek, sakey ed saya a diking tan sananey ed satan a diking.

Et sikato inyakar to ak ed templo, tan sinukat to so saray lusek, anem a siko so kalapar ed sakey a diking, tan anem a siko so kalapar ed sananey a diking, a sikato nen saman so kalapar na tabernaculo.

Et say kalapar na lolooban sikato so samplo a siko; et saray diking na lolooban sikara so limaran siko ed sakey a diking, tan limaran siko ed sananey a diking: et sinukat to so karukey to, apataplo a siko, et say kalapar duamplo a siko.
Saman la linma ed loob, et sinukat to so balang lusek ed lolooban, duaran siko; et say lolooban, anem a siko; et say kalapar na lolooban, pitora a siko.
Et sinukat to so karukey to, duamplo a siko, tan say kalapar, duamplo a siko, ed arap na templo; et inkuan to ed siak, saya sikato so kasantosan a pasen.
Saman la sinukat to so dingding na abung, anem a siko; et say kalapar na balang silir, apatira a siko, ed liberliber na abung ed balang diking.

Et saray silir talora nen saman a katoon, sakey ed tagey na sananey, tan talomplo dia ed inkaoksoy; et linmoob ira ed dingding a betang na abung ed saray silir ed liberliber, pian nidaleyet irad'man, tan ag ira nidaleyet dia ed dingding na abung.

Et saray silir sikara so lalo a maawang ed inkiliber da ed abung a mamaatagey lan mamaatagey; ta say kaliliber ed abung mamaatagey lan mamaatagey ed liberliber na abung: kanian say kaawang na abung tinmuloy a mamaatagey; et dia ed ontan sakey sinmegep a nanlapu ed kalepsagan a silir ed kaatageyan ed panamegley na pegley a silir.
Anengneng ko met a say abung walaan nen saman na pinatagey ya angipaletnegan ed liberliber: saray cimiento na silir sikara so anem ya ayadyari a kawayan ya angkabaleg a siko.
Say kakapal na dingding, a nipaakar ed saray silir, ed paway, sikato so lima a siko: et say atilak sikato nen saman so gaton na saray silir a betang na abung.
Et dia ed nanleetan na saray silir wala nen saman so awang a duamplo a siko ed liberliber na abung ed balang diking.

Et saray pinto na saray silir arap ira nen saman ed gaton ya atilak, sakey a pinto a mamaamianen, tan sakey a pinto a mamaabalaten: et say kaawang na gaton ya atilak sikato so lima a siko a manliberliber.

Et say abung ya wala nen saman ed arap na nisian a gaton ed diking a mamasagur sikato so pitomplo a siko so kaawang; et say dingding na abung sikato so lima a siko so kakapal a manliberliber, et say karukey to siamaplo a siko.
Dia ed ontan sinukat to so abung, sanlasus a siko karukey; et say nisian a gaton, tan say abung, pati saray dingding to, sanlasus a siko ed karukey.
Ontan met so kaawang na lupa na abung, tan say nisian a gaton a mamabokig, sanlasus a siko.

Et sinukat to so karukey na abung ed arap na nisian a gaton a sikato so wala nen saman ed beneg to, tan saray olsoran ed sakey a diking tan ed sananey a diking, sanlasus a siko; et say akindalem a templo, tan saray olsoran na saban;

Saray sasabien, tan saray nikaput a dorongawen, tan saray olsoran ed liberliber ed saray taloran inkatoon da, a nipetek ed sasabien, ya abobedaan na kiew a manliberliber, et manlapu ed dalin anga ed saray dorongawen (bang saray dorongawen asakbongan ira),
Anga ed pasen na tagey na pinto, anga met lanlamang ed akindalem ya abung, tan ed paway, tan ed abay na amin a dingding ed liberliber ed dalem tan ed paway, a sinukat.
Et sikato so agawa ya wala so kerubin tan kiekiew to a palma; et sakey a kiew a palma wala nen saman ed nanleetan na kerubin tan kerubin, et balang kerubin wala nen saman so duara a lupa to;

Dia ed ontan wala nen saman so lupa na sakey a laki ya onarap ed kiew a palma ed sakey a diking, tan lupa na sakey a kilaw a leon ya arap ed kiew a palma ed sananey a diking. Onia nen saman so inkagawa to ed amin ya abung ed liberliber:
Manlapu ed dalin anga ed tagey na pinto wala nen saman so kerubin tan kiekiew a palma ya agawa; onia nen saman so dingding na templo.
Nipaakar ed templo, saray lusek na pinto pasagi ra et nipaakar ed lupa na santuario, say ereng to singa say ereng na templo.

Say altar sikato so kiew, taloran siko kaatagey et say karukey to, duaran siko; et saray suyok to, tan say karukey to, tan saray dingding to, sikara so kiew: et inkuan to ed siak, Saya so dulang ya wala ed arap nen Katawan.
Et say templo tan say santuario wala nen saman so duara a pinto ra.
Et saray pinto walaan nen saman na duaran bulong balang sakey, duara a napatlek a bulong: duara a bulong so nipaakar ed sakey a pinto, tan duara a bulong so nipaakar ed sananey.
Et agawa ed sikara, ed saray pinto na templo, so kerubin tan kiekiew a palma, singa saray agawa ed saray dingding; et wala nen saman so sakey a sasabien a kiew ed lupa na olsoran ed paway.
Et wala nen saman so saray nikaput a dorongawen tan kiekiew a palma ed sakey a diking tan ed sananey a diking, ed saray diking na olsoran: onia nen saman so saray silir na abung, tan saray sasabien.

Saman la inpaway to ak ed akinpaway a saban, say dalan a mamaamianen: et inyakar to ak ed silir ya wala nen saman ed petek na nisian a gaton, ta sikato ya wala nen saman ed petek na abung a mamaamianen.
Ed arap na karukey na sanlasus siko wala nen saman so amianen a pinto, et say kaawang to sikato so limamplo a siko.

Ed petek na duamplo a siko a sikato so betang na akindalem a saban, tan petek na gagatinan a sikato so betang na akinpaway a saban, wala nen saman so olsoran ed petek na olsoran dia ed talora a katoon.
