Tan ed arap na saray silir wala nen naman so akaren a samplo a siko so kaawang to ya arap ed dalem, sakey a dalan a sakey a siko; et saray pinto ra mamaamianen ira.
Bang saray akintagey a silir sikara so antikey; ta saray olsoran angala ra ed saraya, a lalo nen manlapu ed kaabebaan tan say kapegleyan dia ed abung.
Ta sikara so talon katoon et angapo nen saman so lusek da a singa say lusek na saray olsoran: kanian say kaatageyan makiskisir nen say kaabebaan tan say kapegleyan manlapu ed dalin.
Et say dingding ya wala nen saman ed paway ed abay na saray silir, ya arap ed akinpaway ya olsoran ed arap na saray silir, say karukey to sikato so limamplo a siko.
Ta say karukey na saray silir ya wala nen saman ed akinpaway ya olsoran sikato so limamplo a siko: et, nia, ed arap na templo wala nen saman so sanlasus a kasiko.
Et manlapu ed lepsag na saraya a silir wala nen saman so looban ed mamabokig a diking, no sakey onloob ed sikara a manlapu ed akinpaway ya olsoran.
Dia ed kapal na dingding na saban a mamabokig, ed arap na nisian a gaton, tan say arap na abung, wala ra nen saman so silir.

Et say dalan ed arap da singa say nengneng na dalan na saray silir a mamaamianen; unong ed karukey da ontan so kaawang da; et saray amin a papawayan da sikara so nanpadpara unong ed saray ereng da, tan unong ed saray pinto ra.

Et unong ed saray pinto na saray silir ya wala a mamaabalaten wala nen saman so sakey a pinto ed oloan na dalan, salanti say dalan a mapmaptek ed arap na dingding a mamabokig, no singa sakey onloob ed sikara.

Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Saray akinamianen a silir tan saray akinabalaten a silir, a sikara so wala ed arap na nisian a gaton, sikara so masanto a silir, a panganan naani na saray sacerdote ya asinger ed Katawan ed saray kasantosan a bengatla: diman igaton da naani so saray kasantosan a bengatla, tan say bagat a tapong, tan say bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan tan say bagat lapu ed inpakasumlang; ta say pasen sikato so masanto.

No saray sacerdote onloob ira, ag ira naani ompaway ed masanto a pasen ya onla ed akinpaway a saban, no ag ingen diman igaton da naani so saray kawes da a pankatangbayan da; ta sikara so masanto: et mangisolong ira naani na sananey a kawes, tan onasinger ira naani ed satan a nipaakar ed baley.
Bang nen asumpal to so inpansukat ed akinloob ya abung, sikato inpaway toak ed dalan na wangalan ya arap ed bokig, tan sikato so sinukat to ed liberliber.
Sinukat to so akinbukig a diking ed kawayan a panagsukat limanlasus kawayan, ed kawayan a panagsukat ed liberliber.
Sinukat to so akinamianen a diking limanlasus kawayan ed kawayan a panagsukat ed liberliber.
Sinukat to so akinabalaten a diking limanlasus siko ed kawayan a panagsukat.
Sikato pinmawil ed mamasagur a diking, et sinukat to so limanlasus kawayan ed kawayan a panagsukat.
Sikato so sinukat to ed apatira a diking: sikato so walaan na bakor ed liberliber, say karukey limanlasus, pian nagawa so pansianan na satan so masanto tan satan sokaraklan.
Kayari to inyakar toak ed wangalan, a sikato so wangalan ya arap ed bokig.
Et, nia, say gloria na Dios na Israel sinmabi a nanlapu ed dalan a bokig: et say voces to singa say ongol na dakel a danum; et say dalin sinminag ed gloria to.

Et sikato so unong ed ereng na pasingawey ya anengneng ko, on, unong ed pasingawey ya anengneng ko sanen linma ak a maneral ed ciudad: et saray pasingawey singara ed pasingawey ya anengneng ko ed abay na ilog a Chebar; et siak tinmikleb ak.
Et say gloria nen Katawan linma ed abung ed dalan na wangalan ya arap ed bokig.
Et say Espiritu inpatagey toak, tan inyakar toak ed akindalem a saban; et, nia, say gloria nen Katawan pinano to so abung.
Et nadngel ko so sakey a nansalita ed siak ed paway na abung; tan sakey a too inmalagey ed abay ko.

Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, saya sikato so pasen na tronok tan say pasen na saray salik, a sikato so panayaman ko ed pegley na saray anak na Israel ed ando lan ando. Et say abung na Israel agda la naani dutakan so masanto a ngaran ko, angan sikara odino saray ari ra, lapu ed inkadamag da tan lapu ed saray bangkay na saray arari ra ed saray atagey a pasen da;

Dia ed panangipasen da na sasabien ko, tan say lusek na pinto ra ed abay na lusek na pintok, et say wala ed nanleetan ko tan sikara sikato lambengat so dingding; et dinutakan da so masanto a ngaran ko lapu ed saray kadimlaan da a ginawa ra: kanian inopot kora ed sanok ko.
Natan ekalen da komon so inkadamag da, tan saray bangkay na saray ari ra, ed arawi ed siak; et manayamak naani ed pegley da ed ando lan ando.
Sika, anak na too, ipanengneng mo so abung ed abung na Israel, pian nabaingan ira komon ed saray inkauges da; et sukaten da komon so pangaligan.

Et no nabaingan ira ed saray amin a ginawa ra, ipaamtam ed sikara so ereng na abung tan say nengneng to, tan saray papawayan to tan saray lolooban to, tan saray amin ya indengan to, tan saray amin a pangoksoyan to, tan saray amin a nengneng to tan saray amin a tunong to; et sikara so isulat mo dia ed pakanengneng da; pian naonor da so amin a nengneng to, tan saray amin a pangoksoyan to, tan gawaen da ra.
Saya sikato so tunong ed abung: ed tapew na toktok na palandey na amin a sakop to ed liberliber sikato naani so sankasantosan. Nia, saya sikato so tunong na abung.

Et saraya sikara so saray sukat na altar ed siko (say siko sikato so sankasiko tan sankadakulap); say longog to sakey naani a siko, say sangab to ed liberliber sankarangan; et saya sikato naani so ansagan na altar.

Et manlapu ed longog ed tapew na dalin anga ed akinlepsag a balkes sikato naani duaran siko, et say kaawang sakey a siko; et manlapu ed melag a balkes anga ed baleg a balkes sikato naani apat a siko, et say kaawang sakey a siko.
Et say akintagey ya altar apatira naani a siko; et manlapu ed panelselan na altar tan mamaatagey wala naani apatira a saklor.
Et say panelselan na altar sikato naani labindua a siko ed dukey tan labindua ed kaawang, pasagi ed apatira a diking to.

Et say balkes sikato naani labinapat a siko ed karukey tan labinapat so kaawang ed apatira a diking to; et say sangab ed liberliber to sikato naani kapaldua a siko; et say longog to sikato naani sakay a siko ed liberliber; et saray balitang to arap ira naani ed bokig.

Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Saraya sikara so pangoksoyan na altar dia ed agew a sikato naani so gawaen da, pian mangyapay ira na saray bagat a napoolan ed tapew to, tan mangiwalsik ira na dala ed tapew to.

Iter mo naani ed saray sacerdote a Levita a sikara so bini nen Sadok, a sikara so asinger ed siak, a mankatangbayan ed siak, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, so sakey a kilaw a baka a nipaakar a bagat lapu ed kasalanan.

Et sika mangala ka ed dala to, tan yan mo ed saray apatira a saklor to tan ed saray apatira a suyok na balkes, tan ed sangab ed liberliber: onia so panlinis mo ed sikato tan pangawam na pananumang nipaakar ed sikato.
Alaen mo met so bagat a bagat lapu ed kasalanan, et sikato naani napoolan ed nigeter a pasen na abung, ed paway na santuario.

Et dia ed komadua ya agew mangibagat ka naani na sakey a kanding a kalakian ya angapo so kabalawan to a nipaakar a bagat lapu ed kasalanan; et linisan da naani so altar, unong ed panlinis da ed panamegley na baka.
Sano nayarim so manlinis ed sikato, mangibagat ka naani na sakey a kilaw a baka ya angapo so kabalawan to, tan sakey a carnero a kalakian a nanlapu ed polok ya angapo so kabalawan to.
Et yakar mo ra naani ed asinger ed arap nen Katawan, et saray sacerdote mangiwalsik ira naani na asin ed sikara, tan ibagat da ra naani a nipaakar a bagat a napoolan ed kinen Katawan.

Pitoran agew a mangitadia ka naani balang agew sakey a kanding a nipaakar a bagat lapu ed kasalanan: mangitadia ra met naani na sakey a kilaw a baka, tan sakey a carnero a kalakian a manlapu ed polok ya angapo so kabalawan to.
Pitoran agew a mangawa ra naani na pananumang a nipaakar ed altar tan sikato naani gogolan da; onia so pangikonsagra ra ed sikato.

Et sano nasumpal da so saray agew, nagawa naani a dia ed komawalo ya agew, tan ed arapen, saray sacerdote gawaen da naani so saray bagat yo a napoolan ed tapew na altar, tan saray bagat yo ed pipapakna; et awaten takayo naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Saman la inpawil toak ed dalan na akinpaway a wangalan na santuario, ya arap ed bokig; et sikato so akaputan.

Et si Katawan inkuan to ed siak, Saya ya wangalan nakaputan naani; sikato naani agnalukasan, tan angapo met so angan siopa a too ya onloob ed sikato: ta si Katawan a Dios na Israel linmoob ed sikato; kanian nakaputan naani.

Nipaakar ed principe, sikato so onyorong naanid' man a singa principe a mangan na tinapay ed arap nen Katawan; sikato so onloob naani ed dalan na olsoran na wangalan, tan ompaway naani lanlamang ed saman a dalan.
Saman la inyakar toak ed dalan na akinamianen a wangalan ed arap na abung; et ninmengnengak, et, nia, say gloria nen Katawan pinano to so abung nen Katawan: et tinmikleb ak.

Et si Katawan inkuan to ed siak, Anak na too, tandaan mo a maong, tan nengnengen na saray matam, tan denglen na saray layag mo so amin a salitaen ko ed sika nipaakar ed saray amin a pangoksoyan ed abung nen Katawan, tan saray amin a tunong to; et tandaan mo a maong so lolooban na abung pati say amin a papawayan na santuario.
Et ikuan mo naani ed matunganga, salanti ed abung na Israel, Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; O sikayo, abung na Israel, sarag la komon ed sikayo so saray amin a kadimlaan yo.

Dia ed inpangyakar yo dia ed saray sankaili, ag ginalsiman ed puso tan ag ginalsiman dia ed laman, pian manayam ira dia ed santuariok, pian sikato so muraen da, salanti say abung ko, sano yapay yo so tinapay yo, say taba tan say dala, et dineral da so sipan ko, ya inyarum ed saray amin a kadimlaan yo.
Et agyo inonor so pangimaton ed saray masantos ko a bengatla; no ag ingen angipasen kayo na saray managbantay ed pangimaton ko dia ed santuariok nipaakar ed sikayo lanlamang.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios, Angapo so sankaili komon, ya ag ginalsiman ed puso tan ag ginalsiman ed laman, ya onloob naani ed santuariok, say angan siopa a sankaili ya wala ed nanleleetan na saray anak na Israel.
Balet saray Levita ya inmarawi ed siak, sanen say Israel abalang ya abalang a nanlapu ed siak a tinmombok ira ed saray talintao ra awiten da naani so inkauges da.

Angan ontan sikara naani so mankatangbayan ed santuariok, ya walaan na panagbantay ed saray wangalan na abung, tan mankatangbayan ira dia ed abung: sikara pateyen da naani so bagat a poolan tan say bagat a nipaakar ed baley, tan onalagey ira naani ed arap da pian mankatangbayan ira ed sikato.

Lapu ed nankatangbayan ira ed sikara ed arap na saray talintao ra, tan nagmaliw ira a kagapolan na inkauges ed abung na Israel; kanian intagey ko so limak a sumpa ed sikara, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, et awiten da naani so inkauges da.

Et ag ira naani ondago ya onasinger ed siak, a mangawa na agamil na sacerdote ed siak, odino onasinger ed angan anto ed saray masantos ko a bengatla, ed saray bengatla a sankasantosan; no ag ingen awiten da naani so baing da, tan saray kadimlaan da a sikara so ginawa ra.
Angan ontan gawaen ko ra naani a managbantay ed panangimaton ed abung, nipaakar ed amin a panbetang ed sikato, tan nipaakar ed saray amin a nagawad'man.

Balet saray sacerdote a Levita, saray anak a lalaki nen Sadok a nanbantay ed panangimaton ed santuariok sanen saray anak na Israel abalang ira a nanlapu ed siak, onasinger ira naani ed siak pian manlinkor ira ed siak; et onalagey naani ed arap ko pian yapay da ed siak so taba tan say data, kuan nen Katawan a Dios:
Onloob ira naani ed santuariok, tan ondago 'ra naani ed asinger ed dulang ko, pian manlinkor ira ed siak, tan bantayan da naani so pangimaton ko.

Et nagawa naani sano onloob ira ed saray wangalan na akindalem a saban, mankawes ira naani na lienzo a kawes; et angapo naani abel a bago ya onla ed sikara, leleg na pankatangbayan da ed saray wangalan na akindalem a saban tan ed loob.
Wala naani lienzo ya oklop da ed saray olo ra, tan wala naani tapis a lienzo ed saray banel da; ag ira naani manbalkes na angan anto a makapalinget.

Et sano ompaway ira ed akinpaway a saban, salanti say akinpaway a saban ed saray totoo, ekalen da naani so saray kawes a pankatangbayan da, tan igaton da ra ed saray masanto a silir; et mangikawes ira naani na saray sananey a kawes, pian agda pasantosen so baley ed saray kawes da.
Agda met naani kiskisan so olo ra, agda met paolian ya ontobo ya ondukey so saray buek da; puklisan da naani lambengat so buek ed olo ra.
Ag met ira naani oninom na angan anto ya alak so saray sacerdote, sano onloob ira ed akinloob a saban.
Ag ira met naani mangasawa na balo, odino say pinatainan; no ag ingen mangala ra naani na virgen ed ilalak na abung na Israel, odino sakey a balo a balo na sakey a sacerdote.
Et ibangat da naani so baley ko ed nandumaan na masanto tan karaklan, tan paibiig da naani ed sikara so marutak tan malinis.

Tan dia ed sangsangan onalagey ira naani a mangokom; unong ed saray pangoksoyan ko sikato naani oko men da: et onoren da naani so saray tunong ko tan saray panontonan ko dia ed saray amin a nigeter a liket ko; et pagalangan da naani so saray sabaton ko.

Et ag ira naani onla ed inatey a too a dutakan so inkasikara lanlamang; balet nipaakar ed ama, odino ina, odino ed anak a laki, odino ed anak a bii, ed agi a laki odino ed agi a bii ya ag akiasawa, sikara nadumsisan da so inkasikara lanlamang.
Et kayari kalinisan to, manbilang ira naani ed sikato na pitoy agew.
Et dia ed agew ya yakar to ed santuario, ed akindalem a saban pian mankatangbayan ed santuario, yapay to naani so bagat to a nipaakar ed kasalanan, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et wala naani tawir da: siak so tawir da; et angapo naani iter yo ed sikara a kayarian ed Israel; Siak so kayarian da.
Kanen da naani so bagat a tapong; tan say bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan, tan say bagat lapu ed inpakalokso; tan amin a bengatla a nisaklang dia ed Israel kayarian da naani.

Et say ununa ed saray amin ya ununa a bunga na amin a nengneng, tan amin a bagat ya amin a nengneng, ed saray amin a bagat yo, nipaakar ira naani ed saray sacerdote; iter yo met ed saray sacerdote so ununa a kinames yo, pian sakey a bendicion a panayamen to ed abung mo.
Saray sacerdote ag ira naani mangan na angan anto ya inatey lambengat ed inkasikato, odino abingkas, angan sikato so manok ed saray tawen odino ayep.

Ontan met, sano apagen yo ed panamegley na panpapalaran so dalin a tawiren yo, mangibagat kayo naani na sakey a bagat ed Katawan, sakey a masanto ya apag na dalin; say karukey sikato naani so karukey na duamplo tan lima a libo a kawayan, et say kaawang sikato naani samplo'n libo: sikato naani masanto ed amin a ketegan to ed liberliber.
Ed saya wala naani nipaakar ed masanto a pasen a limanlasus ed karukey tan limanlasus kaawang; kuadrado ed liberliber; tan limanplo a siko nipaakar ed saray kasombaliwan ed liberliber.
Tan ed saya a sukat sukaten mo naani so sakey a karukey na duamplo tan lima a libo, tan sakey a kaawang na samplo'n libo: tan ed sikato wala naani so santuario, a sikato so sankasantosan.

Sikato so masanto a gaton na dalin; sikato naani nipaakar ed saray sacerdote, saray mankatangbayan ed santuario, ya onasinger a mankatangbayan ed Katawan; et sikato naani sakey a pasen na saray abung da, tan sakey a masanto a pasen a nipaakar ed santuario.
Et duamplo tan lima a libo so karukey, tan samplo'n libo so kaawang, nipaakar naani ed saray Levita, saray mankatangbayan ed abung, a nipaakar a kayarian da lanlamang, a duamplo a silir.
Et itoro yo naani so pankayarian ed ciudad a lima a libo so kaawang, tan duamplo tan lima a libo so karukey, ed abay na bagat na masanto ya apag: sikato naani nipaakar ed amin ya abung na Israel.

Et say anto kaman a nipaakar ed principe wala naani ed sakey a diking tan ed sananey a diking na masanto a bagat tan say kayarian na ciudad, ed arap na masanto a bagat tan ed arap na kayarian na ciudad, ed bandad sagud a mamasagud, tan ed bandad bokig a mamabokig; et say karukey unong ed sakey ed saray apag, manlapu ed sagud a ketegan anga ed bokig a ketegan.
Dia ed dalin nipaakar naani ed sikato a kayarian dia ed Israel: et saray principe agda la naani aposan so baley ko; no ag ingen iter da naani so dalin ed abung na Israel unong ed saray kailalakan da.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: sikato komon so masarag ed sikayo, O principe na Israel: ekalen yo so panamasoot tan panagsamsam, et gawen yo so inkatunong tan kaptekan; ekalen yo so panamairap yo ed baley ko, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Sikayo walaan kayo naani maptek a simbangan, tan maptek ya efa tan maptek a bat.
Say efa tan bat saksakey naani a pansukatan, pian say bat nayan to komon so kakaplo na sakey ya homer, et say efa say kakaplo na sakey ya homer; say pansukatan to singa naani say homer.
Et say siclo maniyan naani na duamplo a gera; duamplo a siclo; duamplo tan lima a siclo, labinlima a siclo, sikato naani so minas yo.
Saya so bagat ya isaklang yo naani: say kakanem na sakey ya efa ed sakey ya homer a trigo; et iter yo naani so kakanem na sakey ya efa ed sakey ya homer a cebada;
Tan say nibiig ya apag a larak, ed bat na larak, say kakaplo na sakey a bat ed cor, a sikato so samplo a bat, sakey lanlamang ya homer (ta samplora a bat sikato so sakey ya homer);

Tan sakey a cordero ed polok, ed duanlasus, manlapu ed saray maong ya apadanuman a pastolan na Israel; a nipaakar a bagat a tapong, tan bagat a napoolan, tan bagat ed pipapakna, pian gawaen a pananumang nipaakar ed sikara, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Amin a baley ed dalin mangiter ira naani na saya a bagat a nipaakar ed principe ná Israel.

Et panagkaapag naani na principe so panangiter ed saray bagat a napoolan, tan saray bagat a tapong tan saray bagat a nainum, ed saray liket, tan ed saray balon bulan, tan ed saray sabaton, ed saray amin a nigeter a likeliket ed abung na Israel: itadia to naani so bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan, tan say bagat a tapong, tan say bagat a napoolan, tan saray bagat ed pipapakna pian gawaen a pakaparalusan nipaakar ed abung na Israel.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Dia ed ununa a bulan, ed ununa ya agew na bulan, mangala ka naani na kilaw a baka ya angapo so kabalawan to; et linisan mo naani so santuario.

Et say sacerdote mangala naani ed dala na bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan, tan yan to ed saray lusek na pinto na abung, tan ed saray apatiran suyok ed sangab na altar, tan ed saray lusek na wangalan na akandalem a saban.
Et onia naani gawaen mo ed komapito ya agew na bulan ed balang sakey a nalingo, tan nipaakar ed saray maksay: onia naani pangawa yo na pakaparalusan nipaakar ed abung.
Dia ed ununa a bulan, ed komalabinapat ya agew na bulan, wala naani ed sikayo so pasco, sakey a liket ed pitoran agew; say andi lebag a tinapay so nakan naani.
Ed satan ya agew say principe itadia to naani nipaakar ed sikato lanlamang tan nipaakar ed amin a totoo ed dalin so sakey a baka a kalakian a nipaakar a bagat lapu ed kasalanan.

Ed saray pitoran agew na liket mangitadia naani na sakey a bagat a napoolan ed Katawan, pitoran baka tan pitoran carnero a kalakian ya angapo so kabalawan da ed inagewagew ed pitoy agew; tan sakey a kanding a kalakian a nipaakar a bagat lapu ed kasalanan.
Et mangitadia naani na bagat a tapong, sakey ya efa ed sakey a baka, tan sakey ya efa ed sakey a carnero a kalakian, tan sakey a hin na larak ed sakey ya efa.

Dia ed komapito a bulan, ed komalabinlima ya agew na bulan, dia ed liket, gawaen to naani so singa say pitoy agew; unong ed bagat nipaakar ed kasalanan, unong ed bagat a napoolan, tan unong ed bagat a tapong, tan unong ed larak.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; Say wangalan na bandad dalem a saban ya arap ed bokig nakaputan naani ed anemira ya agew a panagkimey; balet dia ed agew na balo a bulan nalukasan naani.

Et say principe onloob naani ed dalan na olsoran na wangalan ed paway, et onalagey naani ed abay na lusek na wangalan; et saray sacerdote itadia ra naani so bagat to a napoolan tan saray bagat to a pipapakna, et sikato so manpikasi naani dia ed sasabien na wangalan: insan naani ompaway; balet say wangalan ag naani nikaput anga ed labi.
Et saray totoo ed dalin manpikasira naani dia ed pinto na satan a wangalan ed arap nen Katawan ed saray agew a sabaton tan saray balo a bulan.
Et say bagat a napoolan ya ibagat naani na principe ed Katawan ed agew a sabaton so anemira a cordero ya angapo so kabalawan da, tan sakey a carnero a kalakian ya angapo so kabalawan to;
Et say bagat a tapong sikato naani sakey efa a nipaakar ed carnero a kalakian, et say bagat a tapong a nipaakar ed saray cordero singa nayarian to ya iter, tan sakey ya hin a larak ed sakey ya efa.
Et dia ed agew na balo a bulan sikato naani sakey a kilaw a baka ya angapo so kabalawan to, tan anemira a cordero, tan sakey a carnero a kalakian; sikara naani andian na kabalawan:

Et itaria to naani sakey a bagat a tapong, sakey ya efa a nipaakar ed baca, tan sakey ya efa a nipaakar ed carnero a kalakian, tan nipaakar ed saray cordero unong ed nayarian to, tan sakey a hin a larak ed sakey ya efa.
Et sano onloob so principe, onloob naani ed dalan na balkon na wangalan, tan ompaway naani ed dalan to.

Balet no saray totoo ed dalin onla ra ed arap nen Katawan ed saray nigeter a liket, say onloob ed dalan ed amianen a wangalan manpikasi ompaway naani ed dalan ed abalaten a wangalan, et say onloob ed dalan ed abalaten ompaway naani ed dalan ed amianen a wangalan; ag naani ompawil ed dalan a nilooban to, no ag ingen ompaway naani a maptek ed arap to.
Et say principe, sano onloob ira, onloob naani ed pegley da; et no ompaway ira, ompaway ira naani a manoolop.

Tan dia ed saray liket tan saray nigeter a pantutuyaw say bagat a tapong sikato naani sakey ya efa a nipaakar ed sakey a baka, tan sakey ya efa sakey a carnero a kalakian, tan ed saray cordero singa nayarian to ya iter, tan sakey ya hin a larak ed sakey ya efa.

Et no say principe mangitaria naani na sakey a bagat ed bolos na linawa, sakey a bagat a napoolan odino bagbagat ed pipapakna a singa sakey a bagat ed bolos na linawa ed kinen Katawan, say sakey lukasan to naani ed sikato so wangalan ya arap ed bokig; et itaria to naani so bagat to a napoolan tan saray bagat to ed pipapakna, singa gawaen to ed agew na sabaton: insan naani ompaway; et kayari ipaway to say sakey ikaput to naani so wangalan.
Et mangitaria ka naani na sakey a cordero a sakey so taon to ya angapo so kabalawan to a nipaakar a bagat a napoolan ed Katawan ed inagew-agew: ed balang kabuasan sikato naani itariam.

Et mangitaria ka naani na sakey a bagat a tapong a niolop ed sikato ed balang kabuasan, sakey a kakanem na sakey ya efa, tan sakey a kakatlo na sakey ya hin a larak, pian na kamesan so fino ya harina; sakey a bagat a tapong ed kinen Katawan ya ag ontonda lapu ed maando a pangoksoyan.
Onia naani pangitaria ra na cordero, tan say bagat a tapong, tan say larak, ed balang kabuasan, a nipaakar ed ag ontonda a bagat a napoolan.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios; No say principe mangiter na sakey a tokdol ed angan siopa ed saray anak to a lalaki, sikato so tawirto, sikato naani kayarian na saray anak to a lalaki; sikato so kayarian da a tawir.

Balet no sikato mangiter ed tawir to na sakey a tokdol ed sakey ed saray aripen to, sikato naani kayarian to anga ed taon na kabolos to; saman la ompawil naani ed principe: balet no nipaakar ed tawir to, nipaakar naani ed saray anak to a lalaki.

Ontan met say principe ag naani mangala ed tawir na baley, a samsaman tora ed kayarian da; mangiter naani na tawir ed saray anak to a lalaki a manlapu ed dili a kayarian to, pian say baley ko ag komon nitayak so balang too a man lapu ed kayarian to.

Saman la inyakar to ak a indalan ed lolooban, a sikato so wala nen saman ed diking na wangalan, ya inloob ed saray masanto a silir a nipaakar ed saray sacerdote, sikara so inmarap ed amianen: et, nia, wala nen saman so pasen ed kaonoran a gaton ed mamasagud.

Et inkuan to ed siak, Saya so pasen a pangipalwagan naani na saray sacerdote ed bagat lapu ed inpakasumlang tan say bagat a nipaakar ed kasalanan, tan sikato a pangilotoan da naani ed bagat a tapong; pian agda ra ipaway ed bandad paway a saban, pian pasantosen to so baley.
Saman la impaway to ak ed bandad paway a saban, tan pinadalan to ak ed abay na saray apat a suyok na saban, et, nia ed balang suyok na saban wala nen saman so sakey a saban.
Dia ed apatira a suyok na saban wala nen saman so saray saban a binakor, apataplo a siko so karukey tan talomplo so kaawang; saraya ya apat ed saray suyok saksakey so sukat da.
Et wala nen saman so sakey a bakor ed liberliber da, manliberliber ed saray apatira, tan paspasen a. panangipalwagan agawa ra ed lepsag na saray bakor ed liberliber.
Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Saraya sikara so saray abung a panagpalwagan, dia saray mankatangbayan ed abung ipalwag da naani so bagat na baley.

Et inpawil to ak ed pinto na abung; et, nia, saray danum inmagus a nanlapu ed silong na sasabien na abung ed dapit bokig (tasay arap na abung sikato so arap ed bokig); et saray danum linmeksab ira a nanlapu ed silong, manlapu ed kawanan a diking na abung ed abalaten na altar.

Dia saman inpaway to ak ed dalan na wangalan ed dapit amianen tan inliber to ak ed dalan ed paway anga ed bandad paway ya wangalan, ed dalan na wangalan ya arap ed dapit bokig; et, nia, pinmaway so saray danum ed kawanan a diking.
Sanen say top pinmaway ed dapit bokig ya sankaegnaan to so lubir, nansukat na sanlibo a siko, tan pinadalan to ak ed saray danum, danudanum ya anga ed saray kalitkalit.
Nansukat lamet na sanlibo, tan pinadalan to ak ed saray danum, danudanum ya anga ed saray pueg. Nansukat lamet na sanlibo, tan pinadalan to ak ed saray danum, danudanum ya anga ed saray banel.
Kayari to nansukat na sanlibo; et sikato so ilog ya agko adalan: ta saray danum tinmageyira, danula num alangoyen, ilog ya ag nayari a dalanen.
Et inkuan to ed siak, Anak, na too, anengneng mo ya? Diad saman inyakar to ak tan pinapawil toak ed pangdel na ilog.
Bang nen akapawil ak, nia, ed tapew na pangdel na ilog wala so dakel a kakiewan ed sakey a gilig tan sananey a gilig.

Diad saman inkuan to ed siak, Saraya a danum onagus ira ya arap ed letaken a kasakopan, tan onleksab ira ed Araba: et onagus ira ya mamaarap ed dayat: ed dayat saray danum onagus naani a sikato so amaagusan ed sikara: et saray danum natambal ira.

Et nagawa, a balang mabilay a pinalsa ya onlangoy, dia ed balang pasen a sabien na ilog, nabilay; et wala naani sankabalgan a karaklan na sira: ta saraya a danum onsabirad'man, tan saray danum na dayat natambal ira, tan amin a bengatla nabilay angan iner a sabien na ilog.

Et nagawa, a saray sumisigay onalagey ira ed abay to: manlapu ed En-gadi anga ni ed En-eglaim sikato so pasen a panangipalegan ed saray iket, saray sira sikara so unong ed nengneng da, singa say sira ed baleg a dayat, mapalalo so karakel.
Balet saraya mapitek ya pasen a tiblakan to, tan saray kotlaong to, ag natambal; niiter ira ed asin.

Tan ed abay na ilog ed tapew na pangdel to, ed saya a gilig tan ed saman a gilig, ontobo so amin a kiew a nayari ya panbilay, a saray bulong da ag nalenes, ag met onkulang so bunga to: mangipaway na balo a bunga ed balang bulan, lapu ed saray danum to onagus ira a manlapu ed santuario; et say bunga to sikato nayari ya kanen, tan say bulong to nayari ya panambal.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Saya sikato naani so ketegan, a pangapagan yo na dalin a tawir unong ed saray labindua a kailalakan na Israel; si Jose duara naani so apag to.
Et sikato naani tawiren yo, say sakey unong ed sananey met; ta sinambaan ko a sikato so iter ed saray atateng yo; et saya a dalin napelag naani ed sikayo a tawir.
Et saya sikato naani so ketegan na dalin: Ed amianen a diking, manlapu ed baleg a dayat, ed dalan na Hetalon, anga ed lolooban na Sedad,
Emat, Beroto, Sabarim, a sikato so wala ed nanleetan na ketegan na Damasco tan say ketegan na Emat: Haseraticon, a sikato so wala ed abay na ketegan na Hauran.
Et say ketegan manlapu ed dayat sikato naani so Hazar-enan ed ketegan na Damasco: tan ed amianen a mamaamianen sikato so ketegan na Emat. Saya so amianen a diking.

Et say dapit bokig a diking, ed nanleetan na Hauran tan Damasco, tan Galaad tan say dalin na Israel, sikato naani so Jordan; manlapu ed dapit amianen a ketegan, anga ed dapit bokig a dayat sukaten mo naani. Saya sikato so dapit bokig a diking.

Et say dapit abalaten a diking a mamaabalaten sikato naani manlapu ed Tamar anga ed saray danum na Meribat-cades, anga ed colos na Egipto, anga ed baleg a dayat. Saya so dapit abalaten a diking a mamaabalaten.
Et say dapit sagud a diking sikato naani so baleg a dayat, manlapu ed dapit abalaten a ketegan anga ed petek na lolooban na Emat. Saya so dapit sagud a diking.
Dia ed onia so pangapag yo na saya a dalin ed sikayo unong ed saray kailalakan na Israel.

Et nagawa naani, a sikato so apag-apagen yo ed panamegley na panpapalaran a nipaakar a tawir ed sikayo tan saray sankaili a manaayam ed nanleleetan yo, a sikara naani so manilalak ed nanleleetan yo; et sikara naani ed sikayo so singa nianak ed dalin yo lanlamang ed nanleleetan na saray anak na Israel: Wala naani tawir da a niolop ed saray kailalakan na Israel.
Et nagawa naani, ya angan anto a kailalakan so panayaman na sankaili, diman iter yo naani ed sikato so tawir to, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Bang saraya sikara so kangaranan na saray kailalakan: Manlapu ed dapit, amianen a sampot, ed abay na dalan a Hetalon anga ed lolooban na Emat, Hazar-enan ed ketegan na Damasco, a mamaamianen ed abay na Emat (et wala naani so saray diking da ed bokig tan ed sagud), say Dan sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Dan, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagud a diking, say Aser, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Aser, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking, anga ed dapit sagud lanlamang a diking, say Neftali, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Neftali, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagud a diking, say Manases, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Manases, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagud a diking, say Efraim, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Efraim, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking, anga lanlamang ed dapit sagud a diking, say Ruben, sakev ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Ruben, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagud a diking say Juda, sakey ya gaton.

Tan ed abay na ketegan na Juda, manlapu ed dapit bokig a ketegan anga ed dapit sagur a diking, sikato naani so bagat ya yapay yo, duamplo tan lima a libo a kawayan so kaawang, et say karukey singa say sakey ed saray gaton manlapu ed bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagud a diking: et say santuario wala naani ed pegley to.
Say bagat a yapay yo naani ed Katawan sikato naani duamplo tan lima a libo a kawayan so karukey, tan samplo'n libo so kaawang.

Et nipaakar ed saraya, a nipaakar lanlamang ed saray sacerdote, wala naani so masanto a bagat; ed mamaamianen duamplo tan lima a libo so karukey tan ed mamasagur samplo'n libo so kaawang, tan ed mamabokig samplo a libo so kaawang, tan ed mamaabalaten duamplo tan lima a libo so karukey: et say santuario nen Katawan wala naani ed pegley da.

Sikato naani nipaakar ed saray sacerdote ya apasanto ed saray anak a lalaki nen Sadok, ya angonor ed panangimaton ko, ya ag abalang nen saman sanen saray anak na Israel abalang ira, a singa inkabalang na saray Levita.
Et sikato naani ed sikara so sakey a bagat a manlapu ed bagat na dalin, sakey a bengatla a sankasantosan, ed abay na ketegan na saray Levita.

Et nipaakar ed ketegan na saray sacerdote, saray Levita walaan ira naani duamplo tan lima a libo a karukey, tan samplo'n libo a kaawang; amin a karukey sikato naani duamplo tan lima a libo, et say kaawang samplo'n libo.
Et angapo naani so ilako ra ed sikato, odino isalat da, tan ag met naani nisian so saray ununa a bunga na dalin; ta sikato so masanto ed kinen Katawan.

Et saray limanlibo a nakeraan ed kaawang, ed arap na duamplo tan lima a libo, sikato naani naagamil ed karaklan a nipaakar a ciudad, nipaakar ed panagayaman tan ed saray panagpastolan; et say ciudad wala naani dia ed pegley to.

Et saraya sikara naani so sukat to; say dapit amianen a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus, et say dapit abalaten a diking apat a libo tan liman lasus, et say dapit bokig a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus, et say dapit sagud a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus.

Et say ciudad walaan naani na panagpastolan: ed mamaamianen duanlasus tan limamplo, tan ed mamaabalaten duanlasus tan limamplo, tan ed mamabokig duanlasus tan limamplo, tan ed mamasagud duanlasus tan limamplo.

Et say kera ed karukey, nipaakar ed masanto a bagat, sikato naani samplo a libo a mamabokig, tan samplo a libo a mamasagur; et sikato naani manlapu ed masanto a bagat; et say munat to nipaakar naani a tagano ed saray onkimey ed ciudad.
Et sikara a mankimey ed ciudad, ed saray amin a kailalakan na Israel, sikato naani dalusan da.
Amin a bagat sikato naani duamplo tan lima a libo a mamin duamplo tan lima a libo: yawat yo naani a cuadrado so masanto a bagat pati say pankayarian ed ciudad.

Et say kera nipaakar naani ed principe ed sakey a diking tan ed sananey ed masanto a bagat tan ed pankayarian ed ciudad; ed arap na duamplo tan lima a libo ed bagat ya onarap ed mamabokig a ketegan, tan mamasagur ed arap na duamplo tan lima a libo ya onarap ed dapit sagur a ketegan, unong ed saray gaton nipaakar naani ed principe: et say masanto a bagat tan say santuario na abung wala naani ed pegley to.

Ontan met manlapu ed kayarian na saray Levita, tan manlapu ed kayarian na ciudad, ya wala ed pegley na satan a kayarian na principe; ed nanleetan na ketegan na Juda tan say ketegan na Benjamin, nipaakar naani ed principe.
Et nipaakar ed kera ed saray kailalakan; manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagur a diking, say Benjamin, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Benjamin, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed sagur a diking, say Simeon, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan nen Simeon, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagud a diking, say Isacar, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Isacar, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagur a diking, say Zabulon, sakey ya gaton.
Tan ed abay na ketegan na Zabulon, manlapu ed dapit bokig a diking anga ed dapit sagur a diking, say Gad, sakey ya gaton.

Tan ed abay na ketegan na Gad, ed dapit abalaten a diking a mamaabalaten, say ketegan sikato naani manlapu ed Tamar anga ed saray danum na Meribat-cades, anga ed kolos na Egipto, anga ed baleg a dayat.
Sikato ya so dalin ya apagapagen yo naani ed panamegley na panpapalaran ed saray kailalakan na Israel a tawir, et saraya so saray nanduruma ya apag da, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Et saraya so saray papawayan na ciudad: Ed dapit amianen a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus a kawayan ed sukat;

Et saray wangalan na ciudad singa ra naani saray ngaran na saray kailalakan na Israel, talora a wangalan ed mamaamianen: say wangalan na Ruben, sakey; say wangalan na Juda, sakey; say wangalan na Levi, sakey.
Tan ed dapit bokig a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus a kawayan, tan talora a wangalan: say wangalan lanlamang nen Jose, sakey; say wangalan na Benjamin, sakey; say wangalan na Dan, sakey.
Tan ed dapit abalaten a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus a kawayan ed sukat, tan talora a wangalan: say wangalan na Simeon, sakey; say wangalan na Isacar, sakey, say wangalan na Zabulon, sakey.
Ed dapit sagur a diking apat a libo tan limanlasus a kawayan pati saray talora a wangalan da: say wangalan na Gad, sakey; say wangalan na Aser, sakey; say wangalan na Neftali, sakey.
Sikato naani labinwalo a kawayan ed liberliber: et say ngaran na ciudad manlapu ed satan ya agew sikato naani so, si Katawan wadtan.
Dia ed komatlo a taon na inpanari nen Joacim ya ari na Juda, sinmabi si Nabucodonosor ya ari na Babilonia ed Jerusalem, tan sikato so kinobkob to.

Et say Katawan initer to si Joacim ya ari na Juda ed lima to, pati arum ed saray ag-agamil na abung na Dios: et sikato inyakar to ra ed dalin na Senar ed abung na dios to, tan inloob to so saray ag-agamil ed abung a panagisimpenan na dios to.
Et inkuan na ari ed Aspenez, a katawan na saray eunuko, ya iloob to komon so arum ed saray anak na Israel, angan ed bini a maari tan saray ankabli,

Ugugaw a dia ed sikara angapo so dumsis, no ag ingen marakep, tan nibangat ira ed amin a nengneng na kakabatan, ya wala ed sikara so pikakabat tan karonongan ed aral, tan walaan ira nen saman na pakayari a manalagey ed palacio na ari; et ibangat to komon ed sikara so aral tan pansasalita na saray Caldeo.

Et say ari tinoro to nipaakar ed sikara so inagewagew a betang ed saray kanen na ari tan ed alak ya inumen to, tan sikara natagano ra komon ed talo'y taon; pian kayari na saraya, manalagey ira komon ed arap na ari.
Bang ta arum ed saraya sikara, so saray anak nen Juda, di Daniel, Ananias, Misael tan Azarias.
Et say manonaan na saray eunuko initdan to ra na saray kangaranan da: ed Daniel initer to so ngaran a Beltasasar: ed Ananias, Sidrac; ed Misael Misac; ed Azarias, Abdenago.
Balet si Daniel ingetma to ed puso to ya agto tilolan so inkasikato ed saray kanen na ari, ni ed alak ya inumen to: kanian kinerew to ed principe na saray eunuko ya agto komon tilolan so inkasikato.
Bang say Dios ginawa to si Daniel a makaromog na kaabigan tan panangisibeg ed pakanengneng na principe na saray eunuko.

Et say principe na saray eunuko inkuan to ed Daniel, Antakotak ed ari a katawan ko, ya angitoro na kanen yo tan inumen yo: ta akin et nanengneng to so saray lupa yo a maermen nen saray lupa na saray tobonbalo a kataonan yo? dia ed ontan ikaatapan yo so olok ed ari.
Diad saman inkuan nen Daniel ed Melsar a tinoro na principe na saray eunuko nipaakar ed Daniel, Ananias, Misael, tan Azarias:
Salien mo so saray ariripen mo, kerewen ko ed sika, a samploy agew; et itdan dakami komon na pising a kanen, tan danum ya inumen.
Insan saray kalupaan mi nanengneng komon ed arap mo, tan say lupa na saray tobonbalo a mangan ed saray kanen na ari; et unong ed nanengneng mo, agamilen mo ed saray ariripen mo.
Dia ed ontan dinmengel ed sikara dia ed saya a kanonotan, tan sinali to ra a samploy agew.
Et kayari na samploy agew saray kalupaan da pinmatnag a magmaong, tan sikara so matabataba ed laman, nen saray amin a tobonbalo ya angan ed saray kanen na ari.
Dia ed ontan say mayordomo inekal to so saray kanen da, tan say alak ya inumen da, tan initdan to ra na pising.

Et nipaakar ed saraya ya apat a tobonbalo, say Dios initdan to ra na pakatalos tan karonongan dia ed amin ya aral tan kakabatan: et si Daniel walaan na pakatalos dia ed saray amin a pasingawey tan saray kogkogip.
Et kayari na saray agew a tinandaan na ari a nipaakar ed pangyarap ed sikara, say principe na saray eunuko inyakar to ra ed arap nen Nabucodonosor.
Et say ari akisalita ed sikara; tan dia ed nanleleetan da ya amin angapo so aromog a singa si Daniel, si Ananias, si Misael, tan si Azarias: kanian nanalagey ira ed arap na ari.
Et dia ed amin a pamaakaran na kakabatan tan pakatalos, ya akibalitaan na ari ed sikara, aromog to ra a maminpolo a magmaong nen saray amin a mago tan mangkukulam ya wala ed amin a nanarian to.
Et si Daniel nansiansia anga ed inmuna a taon nen ari Ciro.
Et dia ed komadua a taon na inpan ari nen Nabucodonosor, nankogkogip si Nabucodonosor na saray kogkogip; et say espiritu to agonigon, tan say ugip to inmandi ed sikato.

Saman la say ari nanpatawag na saray mago, tan saray mangkukulam, saray ibawanen, tan saray Caldeo, pian ipatalos da komon ed ari so saray kogkogip to. Linmoob ari lanti tan nanalagey ira ed arap na ari.
Et say ari inkuan to ed sikara, Nankogip ak na sakey a kogip tan say espirituk agonigon a makapikabat na kugip.
Saman la nansalita so saray Caldeo ed ari ed pansasalita na Siria, O ari, manbilay ka komon a maando, ibagam so kogip ed saray ariripen mo, et ipatnag mi naani so kabaliksan to.

Inmebat so ari tan inkuan to ed saray Caldeo, Sikato so inmandi ed nonot ko; no agyo ipaamta ed siak so kogip tan say kabaliksan to nabingbingkas naani so saray laman yo tan saray abung yo nagawa ra naani a panbantakan na dutak.
Balet no ipanengneng yo so kogip tan say kabaliksan to, awaten yo naani ed siak so saray tokdol tan tumang tan baleg a galang, kanian ipanengneng yo ed siak so kogip tan say kabaliksan to.
Inmebat ira ed komadua a danay, tan inkuan da, Ibaga komon na ari so kogip ed saray aripen to ed ipatnag mi naani so kabaliksan to.
Say ari inmebat tan inkuan to, Siak amtak a maong a sikayo anamuten yo so panaon, lapu ed nanengneng a say bengatla sikato so inmandi ed siak.

Balet no agyo ipaamta ed siak so kogip wala so saksakey lambengat a tunong a nipaakar ed sikayo; tan angitaria kayo na saray matila tan mauges a salita a bitlaen ed arap ko, anga ed say panaon nauman; kanian ibaga yo ed siak so kogip, tan naamtaan ko naani a nayarian yo ya ipatnag ed siak so kabaliksan to.

Saray Caldeo inmebat ira ed arap na ari tan inkuan da, Angapo so too ed tapew na dalin a makayari a mangibaga na kanonotan na ari, nagkalalo ni angapo so ari, katawan odino managuley, ya anepet na ontan a bengatla ed siopaman a mago, odino mangkukulam, odino Caldeo.
Et matalag a bengatla so pankaokolan na ari, et angapo so arum a makapangipanengneng ed sikato ed arap na ari, nilikod so saray dirios, a say panagayaman da sikato so andian na laman.
Lapu ed saya say ari asanokan tan pinmetang a toloy, et inbilin to a napapatey ya amin so saray mangakabat na Babilonia.
Kanian say bilin nibawag, tan saray makabat napapatey ira; et inanap da si Daniel tan saray ibiba to a pateyen.
Saman la si Daniel inmebat a marondonong tan makalkalakal ed kinen Arioc a capitan na saray bantay na ari, a sikato so onla a mamatey ed saray makabat na Babilonia.
Inmebat tan inkuan to ed kinen Arioc a capitan na ari, Anto so sengeg na saya a bilin ya ingeter na ari a maganganat a toloy? Dia ed ontan si Arioc inpaliwawa to sg. sengegan na saya ed kinen Daniel.
Et si Daniel linmoob tan kinerew to ed ari pian igeter to komon so panaon, et ipatnag to naani ed ari so kabaliksan to.
Saman la si Daniel pinmawil ed abung to, et inpaliwawa to so saya a bengatla ed kindi Ananias, Misael tan Azarias, a sikara so iba to:
Pian kerewen da komon so saray panangasi na Dios ed tawen a nipaakar ed saya a maamot; pian si Daniel tan saray ibiba to ag ira komon nalanor a nabalang ed saray makabat na Babilonia.
Saman la say maamot nipuyan ed Daniel ed sakey a pasingawey ed labi: dia ed ontan si Daniel binendito to so Dios ed tawen.
Si Daniel inmebat tan inkuan to, Bendito komon so ngaran na Dios ed ando lan ando lawas; ta say kakabatan tan pakapanyari kayarian to ra.
Tan sikato pansalaten to so saray panaon tan saray kinenepeg; mangekal tan mangipasen na saray arari; mangiter na kabat ed saray makabat tan pakatalos ed saray makatalos.
Sikato ipatnag to so saray aralem tan maamot a bengatla; amta to so wala ed bilunget, tan say silew manayam ed sikato.

Misalamat ak ed sika tan igalang ta ka, O Dios na saray atateng ko, sika ya angiter ed siak na kakabatan tan pakapanyari, tan natan inpakabat mo ed siak so kinerew mi ed sika, tan inpakabat mo ed sikami so kanonotan na ari.

Kanian si Daniel linmoob ed Arioc, a sikato so tinoro na ari a mamatey ed saray makabat na Babilonia; linma tan inkuan to ed sikato so onia: Agmo komon pateyen so saray makabat na Babilonia; yakar mo ak ed arap na ari, et ipatnag ko naani ed sikato so kabaliksan.

Saman la si Arioc inyakar to a tampol si Daniel ed arap na ari, et inkuan to ed sikato so onia, Aromog ko so sakey a laki a too ed saray anak a dinakep ed Juda, a sikato naani so mangipakabat ed ari na kabaliksan.
Inmebat so ari, tan inkuan to ed Daniel, a sikato so inngaran da nen saman na Beltsasar, Nayarian mo ya ipaliwawa ed siak so kogip ya anengneng ko tan say kabaliksan to?

Si Daniel inmebat ed arap na ari, tan inkuan to, Say maamot a kinerew na ari, angan saray makabat, angan saray mangkukulam, angan saray mago tan pati saray pomaparles, agda nayarian ya ipatnag ed ari.

Balet wala so sakey a Dios ed tawen a mangipatnag ed saray maamot, et inpakabat to ed ari Nabucodonosor so nagawa naani ed saray kaonoran ya agew. Say kogkogip mo, tan saray pasingawey na olom ed tapew na dokolan mo, sikaraya:

No nipaakar ed sika, O ari, saray nonot mo sinmabi ra ed sika sanen mandokdokol ka, no anto naani so nagawa ed arapen; et say mangipatnag ed saratan a maamot inpakabat to ed sika no anto naani so nagawa.

Balet no nipaakar ed siak, saya a maamot ag nipuyan lapu ed kakabatan ya wala ed siak a nagkalalo nen saray amin a mabilay, no ag ingen pian nipakabat komon ed ari so kabaliksan, tan pian naamtaan mo komon so saray nonot na pusom.
Sika, O ari anengneng mo, et, nia, sakey a talintao a baleg. Saya a talintao a makapanyari tan say sinag to sankabalgan, inmalagey ed arap mo; et say nengneng to makapataktakot.
No nipaakar ed saya a talintao, say olo to pulos a balitok, say pagew tan taklay to pilak, say eges tan ololpo to gansa,
Saray bitking to balatyang, saray sali to arum balatyang tan saray arum langa.
Anengneng mo nen saman ya anga ed sakey a bato aputer, ya ag lapu ed lima, sikato so angabil ed talintao ed saray sali to a balatyang tan langa, et binuyak to ra.

Saman la a say balatyang, langa, gansa, pilak, tan balitok abuybuyak ira a bansag, et nagmaliw ira a singa taep na taltagan ed panaon na petang; et inpalir ira na dagem ya angapo so pasen ya akaromogan ed sikara: et say bato ya angabil ed talintao nagmaliw a sakey a baleg a palandey, et pinano to so amin a dalin.
Saya sikato so kogip: et ibaga mi naani ed arap na ari so kabaliksan to.
Sika, O ari, sika so ari na saray ar-ari: ya angiteran na Dios ed tawen na panarian, pakapanyari, tan biskeg tan gayaga;
Et angan iner a panayaman na saray anak na totoo, saray ayep ed uma tan saray manomanok ed saray tawen inyawat to ed saray limam, tan ginawa to ka a makauley ed sikara ya amin; sika so olo a balitok.
Et kayarim onalagey naani so sananey a panarian ya abeba nen sika; tan sananey a komatlo a panarian a gansa, a sikato so manuley naani ed amin a dalin.

Et say komapat a panarian mabiskeg naani a singa balatyang, singa say balatyang buyaken to tan patoloken to so saray amin a bengatla; et unong a say balatyang mekmeken to so saraya ya amin, sikato naani mamuyak tan mamekmek.

Et singa anengneng mo ed saray sali tan saray gamet na saray sali ya say arum langa tan say arum balatyang, sikato naani sakey a naapag a nanarian; balet wala naani ed sikato so biskeg na balatyang, singa anengneng mo ed balatyang ya alaokan na langa.
Et singa saray garnet na saray sali, say arum balatyang tan say arum langa, ontan met naani a say panarian arum mabiskeg naani, et say arum nabuyakbuyak naani.

Et singa anengneng mo ed balatyang ya alaokan na langa, ontan met sikara onlaok ira ed bini na totoo; balet ag ira naani manpepeketan ed sakey tan sakey, singa met say ag panlaok na balatyang tan langa.

Tan dia ed saray agew naani na saratan ya ar-ari, say Dios na tawen mamaalagey naani na sakey a panarian ya angan kapigan ag naani naderal tan say panaguley to ag naani niiter ed sananey a baley: balet buybuyaken to naani tan opoten to naani so saraya ya amin a panarian, et sikato so mansiansia lawas.

Ta unong a say anengneng mo a sakey a bato aputer ed palandey ya ag lapu ed saray lima, et binuybuyak to so balatyang, gansa, langa, pilak tan balitok; say baleg a Dios inpakabat to ed ari no anto naani so nagawa ed arapen. Et say kogkogip tua, tan maptek so kabaliksan to.
Saman la si ari Nabucodonosor tinmikleb, tan angigalang ed Daniel, tan inbilin to a mangyapay ira komon ed sikato na sakey a bagat tan balbalingit.

Say ari inmebat ed Daniel, tan inkuan to, Petepeteg a say Dios yo sikato so Dios na Saray dirios tan Katawan na saray ar-ari tan manangipatnag ed saray maamot, bangta ayarian mo ya inpatnag so saya a maamot.

Saman la say ari ginawa to a baleg si Daniel, tan initdan to na dakel ya angkabaleg a toktokdol, tan ginawa to a managuley ed amin a luyag na Babilonia, tan sikato so manonaan a makauley ed saray amin a makabat a lalaki na Babilonia.
Et si Daniel kinerew to ed ari, tan tinoro to di Sidrac, Misac tan Abdenago, a manonaan ed saray gawa ed luyag na Babilonia: balet si Daniel wala nen saman ed wangalan na ari.

Si ari Nabucodonosor nangawa na sakey a talintao a balitok a say katagey sikato so anemaplo a siko tan say lapar to anemira a siko; sikato so inpaalagey to ed patar na Dura, dia ed luyag na Babilonia.

Saman la si Nabucodonosor ya ari inpatipon to so saray manonaan, saray diputado, tan saray makauley, saray okookom, saray manangisimpen na kayamanan, saray mananimbawa, saray marunong ed gangan, tan saray amin a managuley na saray luyag, pian onla ra ed pangiparungtal ed talintao a si Nabucodonosor ya ari inpaalagey to.

Saman la saray manonaan, saray gobernador, tan saray makauley, saray okookom, saray manangisimpen na kayamanan, saray mananimbawa, saray marunong ed gangan, tan saray amin a managuley ed saray luyag, nandaragup ira ed panangiparongtal ed talintao a si ari Nabucodonosor inpaalagey to; et sikara nanalagey ira ed arap na talintao a si Nabucodonosor inpaalagey to.
Saman la say tomatawag inbeliao to a maksil, Dia ed sikayo nigangan, O balbaley, saray nacion, tan saray pansasalita,

Ya angan anto a panaon a narengel yo so tanol na tamboyog, tulali, arpa, sakabuche, salterio, sinfonia, tan amin a nengneng na togtog, sikayo ontikleb kayo tan panpikasian yo so balitok a talintao a si ari Nabucodonosor inpaalagey to;
Et angan siopa ya ag ontikleb tan ag manpikasi sikato ed satan lanlamang ya horas so nibantak ed pegley na mandarlang tan manliob a palbaan.

Kanian dia ed satan a panaon sanen saray amin a baley nadngel da so tanol na tamboyog, tulali, arpa, sakabuche, salterio, tan saray amin a nengneng na togtog, saray amin a baley, saray nacion, tan saray pansasalita, tinmikleb ira tan nanpikasi ra ed balitok a talintao ya impaalagey nen ari Nabucodonosor.
Kanian dia ed saman a panaon saray arum a Caldeo inmasinger ira, tan angyakar ira na pangidalem a sumpa ed saray Judio.
Sikara inmebat ira tan inkuan da ed ari Nabucodonosor, O ari, manbilay ka komon a maando.

Sika, O ari, nangawa ka na sakey a bilin, ya angan siopa a too a narengel to so tanol na tamboyog, tulali, arpa, sakabuche, salterio tan sinfonia, tan saray amin a nengneng na togtog, ontikleb tan manpikasi ed balitok a talintao;
Et angan siopa ya ag ontikleb tan ag manpikasi, nibantak naani ed pegley na mandarlang tan manliob a palbaan.

Wala ra so arum a Judio a sikara so tinorom a manonaan ed saray gawa na luyag na Babilonia: Sidrak, Misak tan Abdenago; saraya a lalaki, O ari, agda ka inngalngalep: agda panlingkoran so saray dirios mo, tan agda met panpikasian so balitok a talintao a sikato so inpaalagey mo.
Diad saman si Nabucodonosor dia ed sanok to tan petang ingangan to ya alaen da di Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago. Diad saman inyakar da so saraya a lalaki ed arap na ari.
Si Nabucodonosor inmebat tan inkuan to ed sikara, Sikato ta so talaga O Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago, ya agkayo manlingkor ed dios ko, agyo met panpikasian so balitok a talintao ya inpaalagey ko?

Bang no maparaan kayo ed angan anto a panaon a narengel yo so tanol na tamboyog, tulali, arpa sakabuche, salterio, tan gaita tan amin a nengneng na togtog, ontikleb kayo tan panpikasian yo so talintao a ginawak, maong; balet no agkayo manpikasi nibantak kayo ed satan, lanlamang ya horas ed pegley na palbaan a mandarlang ed apuy; et siopa tan a dios so mangilaban ed sikayo ed limak?
Di Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago, inmebat ira tan inkuan da ed ari, O Nabucodonosor, agmi kaokolan so onebat ed sika dia ed saya a kanonotan.
No sikato so ontan, say Dios mi a sikato so panlinkoran mi sikato so masarag a mangilaban ed sikami ed palbaan a mandarlang ed apuy; et ilaban to kami ed limam, O ari.
Balet no andi, nakabatan mo komon, O ari, ya agkami manlinkor ed saray dirios mo, agmi met igalang so balitok a talintao ya inpaalagey mo.

Diad saman si Nabucodonosor napno na sanok, tan say indengan na lupa to asalatan sumpa ed Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago: kanian nansalita, tan inganganto a papetangen da so palhaan a maminpito a nagkalalo nen say iloam da a pamapetang.
Et ingangan to ray makapanyari a lalaki ya wala ed inayuraan to a baloren da ra di Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago, tan ibantak da ra ed palbaan a mandarlang ed apuy.
Diad saman saraya a lalaki abalor ira ed sanoal da, saray aysing da, tan saray kolibenben da, tan saray arum a kawes da, tan nibantak ira ed pegley na palbaan a mandarlang ed apuy.
Kanian lapu'd no say gangan na ari sikato so magamat, tan say palbaan alablabas ed petang, say dalang na apuy pinatey to so saraman a lalaki ya angitagey ed Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago.
Et saraya a talora a lalaki, Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago, naplag ira a sibabalor ed pegley na palbaan a mandarlang ed apuy.

Diad saman si Nabucodonosor ya ari nikelawan, tan inmalagey a masiglat: nansalita tan inkuan to ed saray mananimbawa to, Ag itayo ta angibantak na taloran lalaki a sibabalor ed pegley na apuy? Inmebat ira tan inkuan da ed ari, Tua, O ari.
Inmebat tan inkuan to, Nia, nanengneng ko so apatiran lalaki a bolos, a manaakar ed pegley na apuy, tan ag ira naano; et say nengneng na komapat sikato so singa anak a laki na saray dirios.

Diad saman si Nabucodonosor inmasinger ed wangalan na palbaan a mandarlang ed apuy: nansalita tan inkuan to, Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago, sikayo ariripen na Sankatagyan a Dios, ompaway kayo, tan dago kayo dia. Nen saman di Sidrac, Misak, tan Abdenago pinmaway ira a nanlapu ed pegley na apuy.

Et saray katangbayan, saray panagkalaman, tan saray managuley, tan saray mananimbawa na ari, bangta atiptipon ira, anengneng da so saraya a lalaki, a say apuy andian na pakayari ed laman da, ni say buek ed olo ra ag asilaman, saray sanwal da ag met nauman, ni say wala so angob na apuy a linmabas ed sikara.

Si Nabucodonosor nansalita tan inkuan to, Bendito so Dios nen Sidrac, Misak, tan Abdenago, ya angibaki na angel to, tan inlaban to so saray ariripen to a nanmatalek ed sikato, tan inuman da so salita na ari, tan inyawat da so saray laman da, pian ag ira manlinkor ni say mangigalang ed arum a dios, nilikod so dili a Dios da.

Kanian gawaen ko so pangigeter, ya balang baley, nacion, tan pansasalita, a mansalita na angan anto a sumpa ed Dios di Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago, sikara naani so nabingbingkas, tan saray abung da nagawa ra naani a panagbantakan a dutak; lapu'd angapo so sananey a dios a makayari a mangilaban na unong ed saya.
Saman la say ari intandoro tora di Sidrac, Misac, tan Abdenago ed luyag na Babilonia.
Si ari Nabucodonosor, ya ari ed saray amin a baley, saray nacion, tan pansasalita, a manaayam ed amin a dalin: Deen komon so ondaak ed sikayo.
Anonotan ko a maong ed siak ya ipatnag so saray tanda tan pakpakelaw a ginawa ed siak na Sankatageyan a Dios.

Agay la kabaleg so saray tanda to! tan agay la so pakapanyari na saray makapakelaw a gawa to! Say panarian to sikato so panarian ya angapo so anga to, tan say panangoley to manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan.
Siak, si Nabucodonosor, manpapainawa ak nen saman ed abung ko tan mankanawnawa ak ed palaciok.
Anengneng ko so sakey a kogip ya anaktakot ed siak; et saray kanonotan ed tapew na dokolan ko tan saray pasingawey ed olok ginonigon da ak.
Kanian mangawa ak na sakey a gangan a niyakar ira dia ed arap ko so saray amin a mangakabat a lalaki na Babilonia, pian ipatnag da komon ed siak so kabaliksan na kogip.
Saman la linma so saray mago, saray baglan, saray Caldeo, tan saray pomaparles: et inbagak so kogip ed arap da; balet agda nipaliwawa ed siak so kabaliksan to.

Balet kaonoran linmoob si Daniel ed arap ko, a say ngaran to sikato so Beltsasar, unong ed ngaran na dios ko, tan ed sikato wala so espiritu na saray masanto a dirios: et inbagak so kogip ed arap to, ya inkuan ko,

O Beltsasar, katawan na saray mago, bangta amtak ya wala ed sika so espiritu na saray masanto a dirios, tan angapo so maamot a mangonigon ed sika, ibagam ed siak so saray pasingawey na kogip ko ya anengneng ko, tan say kabaliksan to.
Onia so saray pasingawey ed olok ed tapew na dokolan ko: Anengneng ko, et, nia, sakey a kiew ed pegley na dalin; et say kaatagey to sikato so baleg.
Binmaleg so saya a kiew, tan binmiskeg, et say kaatagey to sinmabi ya anga ed tawen, tan sikato so nanengneng ed sampot na amin a dalin.

Saray bulong to sikara so maong, tan say bunga to dakel, tan dia ed sikato wala so tagano a nipaakar ed amin: saray ayep ed uma wala so sirum da ed silong to, tan saray manok ed saray tawen nanayam ira ed saray sanga to, tan amin a laman atagano ed sikato.
Anengneng ko ed saray pasingawey ed olok ed dokolan ko, et, nia, sakey a manbabantay tan santo so linmasor a nanlapu ed tawen.

Sikato so inmingal a maksil, et onia so inkuan to, Batangen yo so kiew, tan lupisen yo ray sanga to, getel yo ray bulong to, tan ibantak yo ray bunga to: ontainan komon iray ayep ya wala ed silong to tan saray manok ed saray tawen ed saray sanga to.

Angan ontan itilak yo so panokor na sengeg to ed dalin, pati sakey a bedber a balatyang tan gansa ed saray malangwer a dika ed uma; et nabasa komon ed linaew na tawen; et say panbilay to wala komon ed saray ayep ed dika na dalin:
Say puso to nasalatan komon ed puso na too, tan naitdan komon na puso na ayep; tan ondalan ed sikato so saray pitoran panaon.

Say geter sikato so lapu ed pangangan na saray bantay, et say kere nanlapu ed salita na saray sasanto, pian naamtaan na saray mabilay a say Sankatagyan manuley ed panarian na saray totoo, tan sikato so iter to ed angan siopa a labay to, tan ipasen to ed tapew to so saray kaabebaan a totoo.

Siak, si Nabucodonosor, anengneng ko so saya a kogip; et sika, O Beltsasar, ipaliwawam ed siak so kabaliksan to, ta saray amin a makabat a lalaki na nanarian ko agda nayarian ya ipakabat so kabaliksan to, balet sika nayarian mo; ta wala ed sika so espiritu na saray masanto a dirios.

Saman la si Daniel, a say ngaran to so Beltsasar, amemet ed sakey a kabekta, tan sikato so ginonigon na saray kanonotan to. Say ari inmebat tan inkuanto, Beltsasar, say pasingawey tan say kabaliksan to agio ka komon gonigonen. Inmebat si Beltsasar tan inkuan to, Katawan ko, say pasingawey nipaakar komon ed saray mangula ed sika, tan say kabaliksan to ed saray kabosol mo.
Say kiew ya anengneng mo, a tinmobo, tan nagmaliw a mabiskeg, tan say kaatagey to sinmabi ed tawen, tan sikato so nanengneng ed sampot na amin a dalin;

Et saray bulong to sikara so maong, tan say bunga to dakel, tan wala so nayari a tagano na amin ed sikato; say silong to panagayaman na saray ayep ed uma, tan saray sanga to panagayaman na saray manok ed saray tawen:
Sika lanlamang, O ari, a binmaleg ka tan nagmaliw ka a mabiskeg; ta say katageyan mo tinmobo, tan sinmabi anga ed tawen, tan say uley mo sinmabi anga ed sampot na dalin.

Et no nipaakar ed anengneng na ari a sakey a manbabantay tan sakey a santo a linmasor a nanlapu ed tawen, tan inkuan to, Batangen yo so kiew, tan sikato so deralen yo; angan ontan paulian yo so panokor na sengeg to ed dalin, pati sakey a balatyang tan gansa, ed saray malangwer a dika na uma, tan paulian yo a nabasa ed linaew na tawen, tan say panbilay to wala a pati saray ayayep na uma anga ed onlabas ed sikato so saray pitoran panaon;
Saya so kabaliksan to, O ari, tan say panangigeter na Sankatagyan, a sikato so nagawa ed ari a katawan ko:

Ya patainanen da ka naani a manlapu ed saray totoo, tan say panayaman mo sikato naani ed saray ayep na uma, tan ipakabkab da ka naani ed saray dika a singa saray baka, tan say linaew na tawen naani so mamasa ed sika; et onlabas naani ed sika so saray pitoran panaon: anga ed naamtaan mo a say Sankatagyan manuley ed panarian na saray totoo, tan sikato so iterto ed angan siopa a labay to.
Et no nipaakar ed inbilin to a paolian da so panokor na sengeg na kiew; say panarian mo natilak naani ed sika ya ag naano, kayari na pakapikabat mo a saray tawen manuley ira.

Kanian, O ari, abobonan mo so saya a simbawak, tan tumangan mo so saray kasalanan mo ed inkatunong, tan saray inkauges mo ed pangipatnag mo na panangasi ed saray duruka; no wala so nayari a makatempey na kareenan mo.
Amin iraya sinmabi ed kinen ari Nabucodonosor.
Kayari na labindua a bulan sikato so manak-akar ya onsasarang ed maari a palacio na Babilonia.
Nansalita so ari tan inkuan to, Aliwa ta a saya so baleg a Babilonia a sikato so inpaalagey ko a nipaakar ed maari a palacio, ed biskeg na pakapanyarik tan nipaakar ed gayaga na kaatageyan ko?
Sanen wala ni so salita ed sangi na ari, naplag so sakey a voces a nanlapu ed tawen, ya inkuan to, O ari Nabucodonosor, dia ed sika nisalita, Say panarian nitainan ed sika:

Et napatainan ka naani a manlapu ed saray totoo; et say ayaman mo wala naani ed saray ayep ed uma: et ipakabkab da ka naani a singa saray baka, et saray pitoran panaon onlabas ira naani ed sika; anga ed nakabatan mo a say Sankatagyan manuley ed panarian na saray totoo, tan sikato so iter to ed angan siopa a labay to.

Dia ed satan lanlamang ya horas asumpal so bengatla ed Nabucodonosor: et apatainan a nanlapu ed saray totoo, tan nankabkab na dika a singa saray baka, tan say laman to abasa ed linaew na tawen, anga ed say buec to tinmobo a singa bago na agila, tan saray koko to singa koko na saray manok ed saray tawen.

Tan dia ed kayari na saray agew siak, si Nabucodonosor, intangay ko ray matak ed tawen, et say pakatalos ko pinmawil ed siak, et binenditok so Sankatagian, tan ingalgalang ko tan intandorok so saman a manbilay ed ando lan ando; lapu ed say panuley to lawas a panuley, tan say panarian to manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan;

Et saray amin a manaayam ed dalin nibilang ira a singa angapo; et gawaen to so unong ed labay to ed inayuraan na tawen, tan ed saray manaayam ed dalin; et angapo so makabaat ed lima to, odino mankuan ed sikato, Anto so gawaen mo?

Dia ed saman lanlamang a panaon say pakatalos ko pinmawil ed siak; et say gayaga na panarian ko, galang tan kaatageyan ko pinmawil ed siak; et saray mananimbawak tan saray katawan ko inanap da ak; et niletnegak ed nanarian ko, tan sankabalgan a kaatageyan so niarum ed siak.

Bang say siak, si Nabucodonosor, igalang ko tan itandorok tan idayew ko so Ari na tawen, lapu ed tua so amin a gawa to, tan saray dalan to matunong; et sikato nayarian to a paabebaen so saray manakar ed kapangtaan.
Si ari Belsasar nangawa na sakey a liket a baleg a nipaakar ed saray sanlibo a manonaan to, tan inminum na alak ed arap na sanlibo.

Si Belsasar sanen. atawayan to so alak, ingangan to a yakar da ray kagawaan a balitok tan pilak ya insempet nen Nabucodonosor ya ama to a nanlapu ed templo ya wala nen saman ed Jerusalem, pian say ari tan saray manonaan to, saray asawa to tan saray kalogoran to, sikara so'paninuman da.

Saman la niyakar iray balitok a kagawaan ya inala ra nen saman a nanlapu ed templo ya abung na Dios ya wala nen saman ed Jerusalem; et say ari tan saray manonaan to, saray asawa to tan saray kalogoran to, sikara so naninuman da.
Naniinum ira na alak, tan ingalgalang da ray dirios a balitok, tan pilak, tan gansa, tan balatyang, tan kiew, tan bato.

Dia ed saman lanlamang ya horas, pinmaway so saray tamoro na lima na sakey a laki, tan nansulat ira ed arap na panangiturekan na candela ed masa na bakor na palacio na ari: et say ari anengneng to so kabiangay lima a nansulat.
Saman la say lupa na ari nauman, tan agonigon ed saray kanonotan to; et saray langolangoan na saray banel to akabsiw ira, tan saray pueg to nanpatogan so sakey tan sakey.

Say ari inmingal na maksil a niakar komon iray mangkukulam, saray Caldeo, tan saray pomaparles. Say ari nansalita tan inkuan to ed saray makabat a lalaki na Babilonia, Angan siopa a makabasa na saya a sulat, tan ipakabat to ed siak so kabaliksan to, nakawesan naani na purpura, tan wala naani balitok a golonggolong a nibaklaw ed tenger to, tan dia ed panarian nitandoro naani a komatlo a manuley.
Saman la linmoob iray amin a makabat a lalaki na ari; balet agda ayarian a binasa so saman a sulat, tan agda met nipakabat ed ari so kabaliksan to.
Saman la si ari Belsasar agonigon a toloy, tan nauman ed sikato so ereng to, tan saray manonaan to asinagel ira.

Bang say reyna lapu ed saray salita na ari tan saray manonaan to linmoob ed panliliketan ya abung: say reyna nansalita tan inkuan to, O ari, manbilay ka komon a maando; saray kanonotan mo agda ka komon gonigonen, ag met komon nauman so ereng mo.

Wala so sakey a laki dia ed panarian mo, a sikato so panayaman na espiritu na saray masanto a dirios; et dia ed saray agew nen amam aromog ed sikato so silew tan pakatalos tan kakabatan, a singa say kakabatan na saray dirios; et si ari Nabucodonosor, ya amam, say ari, kuan ko, si amam sikato so ginawa to a katawan na saray mago, saray mankukulam, saray Caldeo, tan saray pomaparles;

Lapu ed sakey a nagnap ya espiritu, tan pikakabat, tan pakatalos, panangipaliwawa ed saray pasingawey, tan pangipatnag ed saray aralem, a kanonotan, tan panunaw ed saray panduaruwaan, so aromog lanlamang ed saya a Daniel a sikato so inngaran na ari a Beltsasar, Natan natawag komon si Daniel, et ipanengneng to naani so kabaliksan to.
Saman la si Daniel niakar ed arap na ari. Say ari nansalita tan inkuan to ed Daniel, Sika ta so satan a Daniel, a sakey ed saray anak ed inkadakep na Juda, a say ari ya amak inpaway to ed Juda?
Siak nadngelan ko so nipaakar ed sika, a say espiritu na saray dirios wala ed sika, tan naromog ed sika so silew, pakatalos, tan nagnap a kakabatan.

Et bang saray makabat, saray mangkukulam, niarap ira ed arap ko, pian basaen da komon so sayan sulat, tan ipakabat da ed siak met so kabaliksan to; balet agda ayarian ya inpatnag so kabaliksan na saya a bengatla.

Balet nadngelan ko so nipaakar ed sika, a nayarian mo ya iter so saray kabaliksan, tan tunawen mo so saray duaruwa: bang no nayarian mo a basaen so sulat, tan nipakabat mo ed siak so kabaliksan to, nakawesan ka naani na purpura, tan nibaklaw naani so sakey a golonggolong a balitok ed tenger mo, tan dia ed panarian sika naani komatlo a manuley.

Diad saman si Daniel inmebat tan inkuan to ed arap na ari, Paulian mo so saray tokdol mo a nipaakar ed sika lanlamang, tan iter mo so saray pananumang mo ed sananey; angan ontan basaen ko so sulat ed ari, tan ipakabat ko ed sikato so kabaliksan to.
O sika ari, say Sankatageyan a Dios initer to ed Nabucodonosor ya amam so panarian, tan kinabaleg, tan gayaga, tan katageyan:

Et lapu ed kinabaleg ya initer to ed sikato, amin iray baley, saray nacion, tan pansasalita ginmiwgiw tantinmakot ira ed arap to: say ginabay to pinatey to, tan say ginabay to binilay to; et say ginabay to intandoro to, tan say ginabay to pinaabeba to.
Balet sanen say puso to nipatagey, tan say espiritu to inmawet dia. ed ontan a nanagamil a mapaspasirayew, nakal a nanlapu ed maari a trono to tan inala ra so gayaga to a nanlapu ed sikato:

Et pinatainan a nanlapu ed saray anak na totoo, tan say puso to agawa a singa say puso na ay-ayep, tan say panagayaman to sikato so kawalaan na saray asno ed takel; sikato so tinaganoan na dikarika a singa saray baka, tan say laman to abasa ed linaew na tawen; anga ed naamtaan to a say Sankatagyan a Dios manuley ed panarian na saray totoo tan ipasen to ed tagey to so angan siopa a labay to.
Et sika ya anak to a lalaki, O Belsasar, agmo pinaabeba so pusom, angan naamtaan mo so sayan amin,

No ag ingen inpaatagey mo so inkasika a sumpa ed Katawan ed tawen; et inyakar da ray kagawaan na abung to ed arap mo, tan sika tan saray manonaan mo, saray asawam tan saray kalogoran mo, inminum kayo na alak ed sikara; et ingalang mo so saray dirios a pilak tan balitok, gansa, balatyang, kiew, tan bato, ya ag ira makanengneng, ag ira makadngel, ag makapikabat; et say Dios a dia ed lima to so kawalaan na Panlinawam, tan kawalaan na saray amin a dalan mo, agmo pinagloria.
Diad saman say kabiangan na lima nibaki a nanlapu ed arap to, tan saya a sulat so nikurit.
Et saya sikato so sulat a nikurit: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
Saya sikato so kabaliksan na bengatla MENE; Say Dios binilang to so nanarian mo, tan sikato so inyakar to ed pangangaan.
TEKEL; sika so asimbang ed saray simbangan, tan aromog ka a kulang.
PERES; say nanarian mo naapag, tan niiter ed saray Medo tan saray Persa.

Saman la nangangan si Belsasar, tan kinawesan da si Daniel na purpura, tan angyan ira na golonggolong a balitok ya inbaklaw ed tenger to, tan nangawa ra na inpangyabawag ed sikato, a sikato so komatlo a makauley ed panarian.
Dia ed saman a labi si Belsasar ya ari a Caldeo sikato so pinatey.
Et si Dario a Medo, inawat to so panarian, sanen mantaon na anemaplo tan dua'y taon.
Akapaliket ed Dario so pangipasen ed panarian na sanlasus tan duamplo a manonaan, a sikara komon so wala ed lapag na panarian;
Tan dia ed tagey da talora a pangolo, a sakey ed sikara si Daniel; pian saray a a pangolo so pangitdan na panangipakabat, pian say ari agkomon makapangawat na duksa.
Saman la saya a Daniel niduma ed tagey na saray pangolo, lapu ed wala ed sikato so nagnap ya espiritu; et say ari ninonot to so pangyan to ed sikato ed tagey na amin a panarian.

Saman la saray pangolo tan saray manonaan nananap ira na pangidaleman a sumpa ed Daniel nipaakar ed panarian; balet ag ira akaromog na sengeg na pangidaleman odino pamakasalanan, lapu ed sikato so mananumpal nen saman, angapo so angan anto a lingo odino pankulangan ya aromog ed sikato.
Saman la inkuan na saraya a lalaki, Ag itayo makaromog na bengatla a kibana a sumpa ed Daniel, nilikod a naromog tayo a sumpa ed sikato so nipaakar ed tunong na Dios to.
Saman la saraya a pangolo tan manonaan, nantitipon ira ed arap na ari, et onia so sinalita ra ed sikato, Ari Dario, manbilay ka komon a maando.

Saray amin a pangolo na panarian, saray panagkalaman, tan saray manonaan, saray mananimbawa tan saray managuley nansisingbatan da so mamaalagey na sakey a maari a panontonan, tan mangawa na sakey a mabiskeg a bilin, ya angan siopa a mankerew ed siopaman a dios odino too ed loob na talomploy agew, ya aliwan dia ed sika, O ari, sikato naani nibantak ed ongib na saray leon.
Natan, O ari, iletneg mo so bilin, tan firmaan mo so sulat, pian ag nayari ya omanen, unong ed tunong na saray Medo tan saray Persa, a sikato so ag naoman.
Finirmaan lanti nen ari Dario so sulat tan say bilin.

Et sanen si Daniel naamtaan to a say sulat afirmaan, linmoob ed abung to (bang saray dorongawen to nilukas ira ed silir to ya arap ed Jerusalem); et tinmalimokor ed saray pueg to ya amitlo ed sanagew, tan akikasi, tan akisalamat ed arap na Dios to, singa ginawa to nen inmuna a panaon.
Diad saman saraya a lalaki nantitipon ira, tan aromog da si Daniel a mangagawa na pankerew tan pikakasi ed arap na Dios to.

Diad saman inmasinger ira, tan nansalita ra ed arap na ari a nipaakar ed maari a bilin; Agmo ta finirmaan so bilin, a balang too a mangawa na pankerew ed arum a dios odino too ed loob na talomploy agew, ya aliwan dia ed sika, O ari, nibantak ed ongib na saray leon? Say ariinmebat tan inkuan to, Saray bengatla sikato so tua, unong ed tunong na saray Medo tan saray Persa, a sikato so ag nauman.

Nen saman inmebat ira tan inkuan da ed arap na ari, saman si Daniel a sikato so sakey ed saray anak ed inkadakep na Juda, agto ka ingalngalep, O ari, ontan met so bilin a finirmaan mo, no ag ingen gawaen to so pankerew to a mamitlo ed sanagew.

Diad saman say ari, sanen nadngel to so saraya a salita sikato so makapasinagem a naningongot, tan inpasen to so puso to ed Daniel a sikato so ilaban to; et nansagpot anga ed inselek na agew a manondon ed sikato.

Diad saman saraya a lalaki nantitipon ira ed ari; tan inkuan da ed ari, Amtaen mo, O ari, a sikato so tunong na saray Medo tan saray Persa, ya angapo so maari a bilin odino panontonan a say ari iletneg to a naoman.

Diad saman say ari ingangan to, tan inala ra si Daniel, tan sikato so inbantak da ed ongib na saray leon. Bang say ari nansalita tan inkuan to ed Daniel, Say Dios mo a sikato so panlinkoran mo a naynay, ilaban to ka.
Et niyakar so sakey a bato, tan ingaton ed wangalan na ongib; et say ari sikato so tinelpekan to ed dili a telpek to, tan ed telpek na saray manonaan to; pian angapo so naoman a nipaakar ed Daniel.
Diad saman say ari linma ed palacio to, tan nansanlabi a nanayunal, angapo so kagkagawaan na togtog a niyakar ed arap to: et say ugip to inmandi a nanlapu ed sikato.
Diad saman say ari binmangon ya asaksakbay a toloy ed kabuasan, tan linma a masigsiglat ed ongib na saray leon.

Et sanen akaasinger ed ongib ed Daniel, tinmawag ed makapasinagem a voces; say ari nansalita tan inkuan to ed Daniel, O Daniel, aripen na mabilay a Dios, Say Dios mo, a sikato so panlilingkoran mo a naynay, masarag a mangilaban ed sika ed saray leon?
Diad saman inkuan nen Daniel ed ari, O ari, manbilay ka komon a maando.

Say Dios ko inbaki to so angel to, tan pinepe'to so saray sangi na saray leon, tan agdaak inano; bangta dia ed arap to say kaalasan sikato so aromog ed siak; et ontan met ed arap mo, O ari, angapo so ginawak a dumsis.

Diad saman say ari nanliket a mapalpalalo, tan ingangan to ya agwaten da si Daniel ed ongib. Dia ed ontan si Daniel inagwat ed ongib, tan angapo so angan anto a dumsis ya aromog ed sikato, lapu ed nanmatalek ed Dios to.

Et say ari nangangan, et inyakar da so saray lalaki ya angidalem ed Daniel, tan inbantak da ra ed ongib na saray leon, sikara, saray anak da, tan saray asawa ra; et saray leon sikara so pinatulok da et pinuter da so baray amin a puke! da, sanen ag ni ra dinmapo ed longog na ongib.
Saman la si ari Dario nansulat ed amin a balbaley, saray nacion, tan pansasalita, a manaayam ed amin a dalin: Say deen so ondaak komon ed sikayo.

Mangawaak na bilin a dia ed amin a panuleyan na panarian ko, a saray totoo ongiwgiw tan ontakot ira komon ed arap na Dios nen Daniel; ta sikato so Dios a mabilay, tan mansiansia lawas, tan say panarian to satan ag naani nabagbag; tan say panuley to sikato naani anga ed angaan.
Sikato so mangilaban tan manondon, tan sikato so mangawa na saray tantanda tan makapakelaw ed tawen tan dia ed dalin, a sikato so angilaban ed Daniel ed pakapanyari na saray leon.
Dia ed ontan saya a Daniel inmaligwas ed panarian nen Dario, tan ed panarian nen Ciro a Persa.

Dia ed inmuna a taon nen Belsasar ya ari ed Babilonia si Daniel, walaan nen saman na sakey a kogip tan paspasingawey ed olo to ed dokolan to: saman la insulat to so kogkogip to tan inbaga to so atiponan na saray kanonotan.
Si Daniel nansalita tan inkuan to, Anengneng ko ed pasingawey ko ed labi, et, nia, saray apatiran dagem na tawen sinmabi a bigla ed baleg a dayat.
Et apatira ya ayep ya ankabaleg tan nanduruma so sakey tan sakey tinmatdang ira a nanlapu ed dayat.

Say inmuna singa leon tan wala so payak to a singa agila: siak ninengneng ko anga ed saray payak to abagut ira, tan nipaatagey a nanlapu ed dalin, tan apaalagey ed duaran sali a singa sakey a too; et sikato so naitdan na puso na too.

Et, nia, so sananey ya ayep, say komadua, a singa sakey ya oso; a sikato so nipaatagey ed sakey a diking, et wala so talora a taglang ed sangi to ed nanleetan na saray ngipen to: et onia so inkuan da ed siak, Ombangon ka, mangan ka na dakel a laman.

Kayari na saya siak ninmengnengak, et, nia, so sananey a singa sakey a leopardo, ya wala so apatira a payak na manok ed saray tawen ed beneg to; et say ayep wala met so apatira ya olo to; et say panuley niiter ed sikato.

Kayari na saya ninengneng ko so saray pasingawey ed labi, et, nia, say komapat ya ayep, makapataktakot tan mabayani tan mapalalo so biskeg to; et wala ra so ngipen to ya ankabaleg a balatyang; a sikato so angakmon tan amingbingkas, et say atilak ingatin-gatin to ed saray sali to: et sikato so niduma ed saray amin ya ayep ya inmuna nen sikato; et wala nen saman so samplora a saklor to.

Ninengneng ko so saray saklor, et, nia, pinmaway so sananey a saklor, sakey a melag a saklor, tan dia ed arap to talora ed saray onaan a saklor abagut ira ed saray lamut da: et, nia, dia ed saya a saklor wala nen saman so saray mata a singa saray mata na sakey a too, tan sakey a sangi a mansalita na saray ankabaleg a bengatla.

Ninengneng ko anga ed nipasen so saray yorongan, et sakey a masiken na saray ag-agew so imyorong: say kawes to amputi a singa nieve, et say buek na olo to, singa malinis a bago na carnero; say yorongan to mandarlang a liob, tan saray dalig to apuy a mandarlang.

Sakey a manliob ya agus so binmutay tan pinmaway ed arap to: libolibo so saray nanlinkor ed sikato, tan samplonlibo ed maminsamplon libo so inmalagey ed arap to: say pangokom nigeter, tan saray libro abuskag ira.

Ninengneng ko ed satan a panaon lapu ed voces na saray ankabaleg a salita a sinalita na saklor; ninengneng ko anga lanlamang ed inpatey na ayep, et say laman to alinglingkay, tan niyawat pian napoolan ed apuy.
Et no nipaakar ed arom ed saray ayep, say panuley da nakal; angan ontan saray bilay da apalobaan ed sakey a nigeter a panaon tan sakey a panaon.
Anengneng ko ed saray pasingawey ed labi, et, nia, linma ed saray lurem na tawen so sakey a singa sakey ya anak na too, tan sinmabi ed inkadaan na saray agagew, et sikato so insinger da ed arap to.

Et sikato so naitdan na panuley, tan gayaga, tan sakey a panarian, ya amin so saray baley, saray nacion, tan pansasalita manlinkor ira komon ed sikato: say panuley to sikato so lawas a panuley, a sikato so ag naani onlalabas, tan say panarian to ed satan sikato so ag nabagbag.
No nipaakar ed siak, si Daniel, say espirituk naermenan nen saman ed pegley na laman ko tan saray pasingawey ko ed labi ginonigon da ak.
Sinminger ak ed sakey ed saray inmalagey diman, tan tinepet ko so katuaan a kipaakaran na sayan amin. Dia ed ontan inbaga to ed siak tan inpakabat to ed siak so kabaliksan na saray bengatla.
Saraya so ankabaleg ya ayep, sikara ya apat, apatira ya arari ya onalagey naani ed dalin.
Balet saray sasanto na Sankatageyan awaten da naani so panarian, et kayarianen da naani so panarian ed ando lan ando, salanti ed ando lan ando lawas.

Saman nanpilalekan ko a nakabatan so katuaan a nipaakar ed komapat ya ayep, a sikato so niduma ed sikara ya amin, makapataktakot a mapalalo, a saray ngipen to balatyang ira, tan saray koko to gansa; a sikato so angakmon, amingbingkas, tan say atilak ingatin-gatin to ed saray sali to;

Ontan met nipaakar ed saray samploran saklor ya wala nen saman ed olo to, tan say sananey a saklor a tinmobo, tan ed arap to naplag so talora, et satan lanlamang a saklor ya walaan nen saman na saray mata, tan sakey a sangi a nansalita na saray angkabaleg a bengatla, tan say nengneng to mareregkel nen saray iba to.
Ninengneng ko, et saman lanlamang a saklor binakal to ray sasanto, tan nanpalabo sumpa ed sikara.
Anga ed indateng so inkadaan na saray panaon, tan say pangokom niiter ed saray sasanto na Sankatagyan; et sinmabi so panaon a saray sasanto kinayarian da so panarian.

Onia so inkuan to, say komapat ya ayep sikato naani komapat a panarian ed dalin, a sikato so niduma naani ed saray arum a panarian, et akmonen to naani so lapag a dalin, tan igatin-gatin to naani, tan buybuyaken to naani.

Et no nipaakar ed saray samploran saklor, manlapu ed saya a panarian onalagey naani so samplora ya arari; et kayari ra onalagey naani so sananey; sikato so niduma naani ed saray inmuna, et igeba to naani so talora ya arari.

Et sikato mansalita naani na saray salita a sumpa ed Sankatagyan, tan pakapuyen to naani so saray sasanto na Sankatagyan; et nonoten to naani ya umanen so saray panaon tan say tunong; et niyawat ira naani ed lima to anga ed sakey a panaon tan saray panaon tan kapaldua na sakey a panaon.
Balet say pangokom nigeter naani, et ekalen da naani so panuley to, pian sikato so uputen tan bagbagen anga ed angaan.
