Et say panarian tan panuley, tan say kabaleg na saray panarian ed lepsag na amin a tawen niiter naani ed saray baley na saray sasanto na Sankatagyan: say panarian to sikato so panarian lawas, tan amin a panuley manlingkor tan ononor ira naani ed sikato.
Dia so angaan na bengatla. No nipaakar ed siak, si Daniel, saray kanonotan ko ginonigon da ak a toloy, tan say lupak nauman: balet inyatol ko so bengatla ed pusok.
Dia ed komatlo a taon na inpanari nen ari Belsasar pinmatnag ed siak so sakey a pasingawey, ed siak lanlamang, si Daniel, kayari na saman a pinmatnag ed siak ya akauna.

Et anengneng ko so pasingawey; natan agawa a sanen anengneng ko, wala ak ed Susan a palacio, ya wala ed luyag na Elam: et anengneng ko dia ed pasingawey, tan wala ak nen saman ed abay na ilog ya Ulai.

Saman la intangay ko so saray matak, et anengneng ko, et, nia, sakey a carnero a kalakian a nanalagey ed arap na ilog, ya walaan na duaran saklor: et saray duaran saklor to atagey ira; balet say sakey atagtagey nen say sakey, et saman so atagtagey tinmobo a naonor.

Anengneng ko so carnero a mamobono a mamasagur, tan mamaamianen, tan mamaabalaten; et angapo so anto ya ayep ya akaalagey ed arap to, tan angapo met so angan siopa a makaokpos ed lima to; no ag ingen ginawa to so unong ed labay to, tan intandoro to so inkasikato lanlamang.

Et sanen nodnonoten ko, nia, sakey a kanding a kalakian so sinmabi a nanlapu ed sagur ed tagey na tapew na amin a dalin, tan agto dimwit so dalin et say kanding wala nen saman so saklor to a napatnagan ed nanleetan na saray mata to.
Et sikato so dinmago ed carnero a kalakian ya walaan nen saman na duara a saklor, a sikato so anengneng ko a manalalagey ed arap na ilog, et binmatik ya inmarap ed sikato ed petang na pakapanyari to.

Et sikato so anengneng ko a sinminger ed carnero a kalakian, et sikato so atenyeg ed sanok ya onsumpa ed sikato, et kinabil to so carnero a kalakian, et pinuter to so duara a saklor to; et angapo so pakayari ed carnero a kalakian ya onalagey ed arap to; balet inbalsak to ed dalin, tan ingatin-gatin to; et angapo so akayari ya angilaban ed carnero a kalakian ed lima to.

Et saman so kanding a kalakian intandoro to so laman to lanlamang ed mapalalo; et sanen sikato so mabiskeg, saman so baleg a saklor to aputer; et dia ed pasen to tinmobo so apatira a napatnagan a saklor ya arap ed apatira a dagem na tawen.
Et nanlapu ed sikara pinmaway so sakey a saklor a melag, a sikato so binmaleg a toloy, ya arap ed abalaten, tan arap ed bokig, tan arap ed magayaga a dalin.
Et sikato so binmaleg a toloy anga met lanlamang ed inayuraan na tawen, et say arum ed saray inayuraan tan ed saray bitewen inpelag to ed dalin, tan ingatin-gatin to ra.
On, intandoro to so inkasikato lanlamang, anga lanlamang ed manonaan na inayuraan; et inala to ed sikato so naynay a bagat a napoolan, tan say pasen na santuario to naplag ed dalin.
Et say inayuraan niyawat ed sikato a niolop ed naynay a bagat a napoolan lapu ed inpakasumlang; et inpelag to ed dalin so katauaan tan ginawa to so nankaliktan to et inmaligwas.

Saman la nadngel ko so sakey a santo a nansalita; et sakey a sananey a santo inkuan to ed saman so nansalita, Kaonongan kabayag na pasingawey a nipaakar ed naynay a bagat a napoolan, tan say inpakasumlang a mangawa na pankibalatar, a mangiter a nanpadpara ed santuario tan ed inayuraan pian nigatin-gatin ira?
Et inkuan to ed siak, Anga ed duanlibo tan talonlasus a ngarem tan kabuasan; saman la say santuario nalinisan naani.
Et agawa, a sanen siak, siak lanlamang si Daniel, anengneng ko so pasingawey, tan inanap ko so kabaliksan to, et, nia, sakey a singa nengneng na sakey a too so inmalagey ed arap ko.
Et nadngel ko so voces na sakey a too a nanlapu ed nanleetan na saray gilig na Ulai, ya tinmawag, tan inkuan to, Gabriel, ipatalos mo ed saya a too so pasingawey.
Kanian dinmago ed asinger a kawalaan ko; et sanen sinmabi, ataktakot ak, et tinmikleb ak: balet ta inkuan to ed siak, Talosan mo, O anak na too; ta say pasingawey nipaakar ed panaon na kasumpalan.
Bang nen akisalita ed siak, nipasag ak ya akaugip na maitlek ya ogip a sititikleb ak ed dalin: balet sikato diniwit toak, tan pinayorong toak.
Et inkuan to, Nia, ipatalos ko naani ed sika so nagawa ed kasumpalan na sanok; ta sikato so nipaakar ed nigeter a panaon a kasumpalan.
Saman so carnero a kalakian ya anengneng mo ya walaan nen saman na duara a saklor, sikara so saray arari na Media tan Persia.
Et say kabagobago a kanding a kalakian sikato so ari na Grecia; et say baleg a saklor ya wala ed nanleetan na saray mata to sikato so ununa ya ari.
Et no nipaakar ed saman so aputer a dia ed pasen to inmalagey so apatira, apatira a panarian so onalagey naani ed nacion, balet aliwa a pati pakapanyari to.
Et sano kaonoran a panaon na panarian da, sano saray masumpa nasumpal ira, sakey ya ari a masebeg ya inpan lupa, tan makatalos na saray ambilunget a kanonotan so onalagey naani.

Et say pakapanyari to mabiskeg naani, balet ta ag nisengeg ed dili a biskeg to; et bagbagen to naani a makapakelkelaw a toloy; et onaligwas naani, tan gawaen to naani so kaliktan to: bagbagen to naani so saray mabiskeg tan saray masantp a totoo.

Ed panamegley na kasiliban to paaligwasen to naani ed lima to so panamalingo et itandoro to naani so inkasikato ed puso to, tan dia ed katalkan to bagbagen to naani so dakel; onalagey met naani ya onsumpa ed principe na saray principe; balet sikato so naderal naani ya andi lima.
Et say pasingawey ed saray labi tan kabuasan a nibaga sikara so tua; balet yatol mo so pasingawey; ta nipaakar ed saray dakel ya agew ya onsabi naani.
Et siak, si Daniel, apunaw ak, tan nanbeblay ak ed pigara ya agew; saman la binmangon ak, tan ginawak so saray kanonotan na ari: et nankelawak ed pasingawey balet angapo so akatalos ed sikato.
Dia ed inmuna a taon nen Dario ya anak a laki nen Asuero, ed bini na saray Medo, a sikato so agawa ya ari ed panarian na saray Caldeo,

Dia ed inmuna a taon na inpanari to, siak, si Daniel, atalosan ko lapu ed saray libro so bilang na saray taon a nipaakar ed sikara nen say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed Jeremias a profeta, lapu ed inkasumpal a pankibalatar na Jerusalem, salanti pitomplo a taon.
Et inyarap ko so lupak ed Katawan a Dios, ya anapen ko ed panamegley na pikakasi tan pankerew, pati panayunal tan abel a magaspang tan saray dapol.

Et nanpikasi ak ed Katawan a Dios ko, tan nanpatua ak, tan inkuan ko, O Katawan, say baleg tan tatakotan a Dios, a mangawalo na sipan tan maaro ya abig na linawa ed saray mangaro ed sikato tan mangonor ed saray gangan to.
Nankasalanan kami, tan nanagamil kami a maugeuges, tan nangawa kami karelmengan, tan tinmunganga kami, salanti insipami a nanlapu ed saray panontonan mo tan nanlapu ed saray pangoksoyan mo;
Agmi met tinalineng so saray aripen mo a profeta, a nansalita lapu ed ngaran mo ed saray ar-arimi, ed saray manonaan mi, tan saray atateng mi, tan saray amin a totoo ed dalin.

O Katawan, say inkatunong kayarian mo, balet dia ed sikami kagolo na lupa a singa ed sayan agew; ed saray lalaki na Juda, tan ed saray manaayam ed Jerusalem, tan amin ya Israel ya wala ed asinger, tan wala ed arawi, ed saray amin a dalin a pamatainanan ed sikara lapu ed inpakasumlang da ya akasumlangan da a sumpa ed sika.
O Katawan, dia ed sikami so kawalaan na kagolo na lupa, ed saray ar-ari mi, ed saray manonaan mi, tan ed saray atateng mi, lapu ed nankasalanan kami a sumpa ed sika.
Ed Katawan a Dios mi a makankien na panangasi tan pamerdona: ta tinmunganga kami a sumpa ed sikato.
Agkami met inmonor ed voces nen Katawan a Dios mi, a manakar ed saray tunong to, a sikara so inletneg to ed arap mi ed panamegley na saray ariripen to a profeta.

On, amin ya Israel sinumpa to so tunong mo, salanti sinmian ira, pian agda onoren so voces mo: lapu ed saya naibung ed sikami so pangayew, tan say samba a nisulat ed tunong nen Moises, ya aripen na Dios; lapu ed nankasalanan kami a sumpa ed sikato.

Et sikato pinaletan to so saray salita to ya insalita to a sumpa ed sikami, tan sumpa ed saray okom mi a mangokom ed sikami, ed inpangyakar to ed sikami na baleg ya inkauges; ta angan kapigan ag agawa ed lepsag na amin a tawen so singa agawa ed Jerusalem.

Unong ya wala a nisulat ed tunong nen Moises, saya ya amin ya inkauges sinmabi ed sikami: balet agkami ni nankerew na pamalangkap nen Katawan a Dios mi, pian magbabawi kami komon ed saray inkauges mi, tan wala komon so panisip mi ed katuaan mo.
Kanian si Katawan nanbantay a nipaakar ed mauges, tan sikato so inyakar to ed sikami; lapu ed si Katawan a Dios mi sikato so matunong ed saray amin a gawa to a gawaen to, et agmi inonor so voces to.
Natan sirin, O Katawan a Dios mi, ya inagwat mo so baley mo ed dalin na Egipto ed makapanyari a limam, et akagamor ka na galang, a singa ed sayan agew; nankasalanan kami a mareldelmeng.

O Katawan, unong ed amin ya inkatunong mo, paulian mo komon so sanok mo tan petang mo, kerewen ko ed sika, ya ompaliis a manlapu ed ciudad mo a Jerusalem, a masanto a palandey mo; ta lapu ed saray kasalanan mi, tan lapu ed saray inkauges na saray atateng mi, say Jerusalem tan say baley mo nagmaliw ira a balaw ed amin ya wala ed liberliber mi.
Natan sirin, O Dios mi, talinengen mo so pikakasi na aripen mo tan saray pankerew to, tan pasnagen mo so lupam ed santuariom a sikato so mankibalatar, lapu ed kakanaan na Katawan.

O Dios ko, ikiling mo so layag mo, tan denglen mo; lukasan mo so saray matam, tan nengnengen mo ray pankibalatar mi, tan say ciudad ya atawag unong ed ngaran mo: ta agmi isaklang so saray pankerew mi ed arap mo lapu ed saray inkatunong mi, no ag ingen lapu ed kakanaan na baleg a panangasim.

O Katawan, ondengel ka; O Katawan, mamerdona ka; O Katawan, ontalineng ka tan gawaen mo; agmo ilaron, lapu ed dili a kakanaan mo, O Dios ko, lapu ed say ciudad mo tan say baley mo atawag ira unong ed ngaran mo.

Et leleg a mansasalita ak, tan manpipikasi, tan mangipapatua na kasalanan ko tan say kasalanan na baley ko ya Israel, tan ipapatnag ko so pankerew ko ed arap nen Katawan a Dios ko lapu ed masanto a palandey na Dios ko;
On, sanen mansasalita ak dia ed pikakasi, say laki a Gabriel, a sikato so anengneng ko ed pasingawey ed gapu, sanen apatikyab a masigsiglat, diniwit toak ed panaon na panangipatanir ed ngarem.
Et inbangat toak, tan nansalita ed siak, tan inkuan to, O Daniel, natan ompaway ak, pian itdan taka na kakabatan tan pakatalos.
Dia ed gapu na saray pankerew mo say gangan pinmaway, tan linma ak dia a mangibaga ed sika; ta sika so balbaleg ya inadaro; kanian isisipen mo so pegdat, tan talosan mo so pasingawey.

Pitomplo a simba so nigeter ed baley mo tan ed masanto a ciudad mo, pian nasumpal so inpakasumlang, tan pian nagawa so angaan na saray kasalanan, tan pian nagawa so pipopolangan lapu ed inkauges, tan pian niyakar so maando ya inkatunong, tan pian natatakan so pasingawey tan profecia, tan nalanaan so sankasantosan.

Amtaen mo sirin, tan talosan mo, a manlapu ed inpaway na gangan a mamasimbalo tan mangipaalagey na Jerusalem anga ed alanaan, say principe, wala naani pitora a simba to, tan anemaplo tan dua a simba to: nipaalagey lamet ya walaan na polong tan banawang, angan dia ed saray magolo a panaon.

Et kayari na saray anemaplo tan dua a simba to say alanaan naekal naani, et angapo naani so natilak ed sikato; et say baley na principe ya onsabi naani bagbagen to naani so ciudad tan say santuario; et say pangangaan to nagawa naani a pati sakey a delap, et angan dia ed kasampotan nagawa naani so bakal; nigeter so saray pankibalatar.

Et mangawa naani na sakey a malet a sipan ed saray dakel ed sakey a simba: et dia ed pegley na simba patondaen to naani so bagat tan panangyapay; tan ed tapew na payak na saray kadimlaan onsabi naani so sakey a mangawa na pankibalatar: et anga lanlamang ed ayadyari a kasampotan, tan satan ya inggeter, nikalbo naani so sanok ed tapew na mankibalatar.

Dia ed komatlo a taon nen Ciro ya ari na Persia sakey a bengatla so nipuyan ed Daniel, a say ngaran to atawag a Beltsasar; et say bengatla sikato so tua, a sakey a baleg a bakal; et sikato atalosan to so bengatla, tan atalosan to so pasingawey.
Dia ed saraman ya agew siak, si Daniel, nanermen ak ed leleg na talora a simba.
Agak angan na masamit a tinapay, tan angapo met so linmoob a laman odino alak ed sangik, tan agko met nilanaan a mogmo so inkasiak lanlamang, anga ed inkasumpal na amin a talora a simba.
Et dia ed komaduamplo tan apat ya agew na unona a bulan, sanen wala ak ed gilig na baleg ya ilog, a sikato so Jidekel,
Intangay ko so saray matak, tan ninmengneng ak, et, nia, sakey a. too a nankawts na lienzo, a saray banel to abalkesan ira ed pulos a balitok na Ufas:

Say laman to lanlamang, nialiling ed berilo, tan say lupa to singa nengneng na kirmat, tan saray mata to singa ra mandarlang a banoot, et saray taklay to tan saray sali to singa ra pinasileng a gansa, tan say voces na saray salita to singa voces na sakey a sankaraklan a totoo.

Et siak, si Daniel, bokor ko so akanengneng na pasingawey; ta saray totoo ya wala nen saman ya ibak agda anengneng so pasingawey; balet sakey a baleg a pangiwgiw so naplag ed sikara, et sikara tinmainan ira ya inmamot.
Kanian atilak ak a bokbokor, et anengneng ko so saya a baleg a pasingawey, ed angapo so biskeg ya atilak ed siak; ta say kaligsaan ko nagmaliw ed siak a kabolok, tan angapo so apokpokan ko a biskeg.
Angan ontan nadngel ko so voces na saray salita to: et sanen nadngel ko so voces na saray salita to, naplag ak la ed sakey ya ugip a maitlek, a say lupak osdong ed dalin.
Et, nia, sakey a lima diniwit toak, tan ingaton toak ed saray pueg ko tan saray dakulap na saray limak.

Et inkuan to ed siak, O Daniel, sika too ya inad-aro a maong, talosan mo so saray salita ya inbagak ed sika, et onalagey ka a maptek; ta dia ed sika nibaki ak natan. Et sanen asalita to so sayan salita, inmalagey ak a sigigiwgiw.

Saman la inkuan to ed siak, Agka antakot, Daniel, ta nanlapu nen inmuna ya agew ya inpasen mo so pusom a makatalos, tan inpaabebam so inkasika lanlamang ed arap na Dios mo, saray salitam atalineng ira: et linma ak dia lapu ed saray salitam.

Balet say principe na panarian na Persia sinmumpa ed siak ed duamplo tan sakey agew, balet nia, si Micael a sakey ed saray principe, sinmabi pian tulongan toak; et tinmilak ak diman ed saray ar-ari na Persia.
Natan linma ak dia a mangipatalos ed sika no anto naani so nagawa ed baley mo ed saray kaonoran ya agew; ta say pasingawey nipaakar lambengat ed saray dakel ya agew.
Et sanen nibaga to ed siak so unong na saraya a salita, intuek ko so lupak ed dalin, tan naemel ak.

Et, nia, sakey a kaulibay na saray anak na saray totoo diniwit to so saray bibil ko: saman la nilukasan ko so sangik, tan nansalita ak, ya inkuan ko ed sikato ya inmalagey ed arap ko, O katawan, lapu ed pasingawey saray ermen ko pinmawil ira ed siak, tan angapo so napokpokan ko a biskeg.
Ta panon so pisalita na aripen na saya a katawan ko ed saya a katawan ko? ta no nipaakar ed siak, agangano ya angapo so atilak a biskeg ed siak, angapo met so panlinawa ya atilak ed siak.
Saman la diniwit tak lamet na sakey a singa nengneng na sakey a too, et sikato pinabiskeg toak.

Et inkuan to, O too ya inad-aro a maong, agka antakot: wala komon ed sika so deen, onbiskeg ka, on, onbiskeg ka. Et sanen nansalita ed siak apabiskeg ak, et inkuan ko, Mansalita komon so katawan ko; lapu ed pinabiskeg mo ak.
Saman la inkuan to, Agmo ta amta no anto so sengeg to ya linma ak ed sika? et natan ompawil ak a mamakal ed principe na Persia: et sano onla ak, nia, say principe na Grecia onsabi naani.
Balet ibagak naani ed sika so satan a nilugan dia ed inkisulat na katuaan: et angapo so mabiskeg ed siak nipaakar ed saraya no ag si Micael lambengat a principe yo.
Et no nipaakar ed siak, sanen inmuna a taon nen Dario a Medo, inmalagey ak a mamalet tan mama biskeg ed sikato.

Et natan ipatnag ko naani ed sika so katuaan. Nia, onalagey ni naani so talora ya ar-ari na Persia, et say komapat sikato naani mayaman a lalo ya arawi nen sikara ya amin: et sano' onkasil a mabiskeg lapu ed inkayaman to lagyaten to naani so amin a sumpa ed Grecia.
Et sakey a mabiskeg ya ari so onalagey naani, a man-ari ed baleg a panuley, et gawaen to naani so unong ed kaliktan to.

Et sano onalagey, say panarian to nabuyak naani tan naapag-apag naani ya arap ed saray apatira a dagem na tawen, balet andi ed saray ilalak to, tan ag met unong ed panuleyan a sikato so nanuleyan to, ta say panarian to nabagut naani a nipaakar ed saray arum nilikod so saya.
Et say ari na abalaten mabiskeg naani; tan sakey ed saray principe to sikato naani mabiskeg ya ontalona ed sikato, tan wala naani panuleyan to; say panuleyan to sakey naani a baleg a panuleyan.

Et dia ed kasampotan na saray taon sikara naani mantipon; et say bii ya anak na ari na abalaten onla naani ed ari na amianen a mangawa na sipan: balet agto naani napokpokan so biskeg na taklay to; et say ari na abalaten ag met naani magnayon, angan say taklay to: no ag ingen say anak to a bii sikato naani niiter, tan saray angyakar ed sikato, tan say angianak ed sikato, tan say amabiskeg ed sikato ed saraman a panaon.

Balet manlapu ed sakey a simit na saray lamut to sakey so onalagey naani ed pasen to, a sikato so onla ed inayuraan, tan onloob ed saray salimbeng na ari na amianen, tan managamil naani a sumpa ed sikara tan sikato naani manpalabo.

Et ontan met saray dirios da, pati saray inbobo a talintao ra, tan pati saray marakep a kagawaan da a pilak, tan balitok, yakar to ra a dinakep diman ed Egipto; et sikato so manbayag naani ed saray pigaran taon nen say ari ed amianen.
Et sikato onloob naani ed panarian na ari na abalaten, balet ta ompawil ed dili lanlamang a dalin to.

Et saray anak to a lalaki mibakal ira naani, tan manipon ira naani nasakey a karaklan na baleg ya inayuraan, et sikato naani so onsabi, tan ondeiap, tan onlabas; et ompawil ira naani tan mibakal ira naani, anga ed saray salimbeng to.

Et say ari na abalaten naten yeg naani ed sanok, et ompaway na ani tan mibakal naani ed sikato, an gan say ari na amianen; et ipanat to naani so sakey a karakel na to too, et say karakel na totoo niiter naani ed lima to.
Et say karakel na too nipaata gey naani, ontagey met naani so puso to, tan mangigeba naani na pinolon nilibolibo balet ag naani manpalabo.

Et say ari na amianen ompawil naani, et mangipanat naani na sakey a karakel na totoo a dakdakel nen say inmuna, et sikato onsabi naani ed kasampotan na panaon, salanti saray taon, ya walaan na baleg ya inayuraan tan pati dakel a kayamanan.

Et dia ed saraman a panaon dakel naani ra so onalagey ya onsumpa ed ari na abalaten; ontan met so saray anak na masulit ed nanleleetan na baley mo onalagey ira naani a mangiletneg ed pasingawey; balet sikara nipasag ira naani.

Kanian say ari na amianen onsabi naani, tan mamaalagey naani na sakey a pokdol, et alaen to naani so sakey a ciudad a kinutaan a maong: et saray inayuraan na aba laten agda naani nayarian so onta lindeg, angan saray pinili a totoo to, tan angapo met so angan anto a biskeg a makasumpa.

Balet satan ya onsabi ya onsumpa ed sikato gawaen to naani so unong ed kaliktan to lanlamang, et angapo naani ontalindeg ed arap to; et sikato onlagey naani ed mamaliga a dalin, tan dia ed lima to wala naani so kabagbag.

Et yarap to naani so lupa to ya ipaaknuyot a pati say biskeg na amin a panarian to, tan gawaen to naani ed sikato so manepeg ira a kigagaton: tan iter to naani ed sikato so anak a bii na saray bibii, pian maneral ed sikato: balet say anak a bii ag naani makaalagey, tan ag met nipaakar ed sikato.

Kayari na saya ilingaw to naani so lupa to ed saray polpolo, et mangala naani na dakel; balet sakey a principe so mamatonda naani na kabalawan ya initer to: on et aliwa ni a satan lambengat, papawilen to naani so kabalawan ya yarap ed si kato.
Kayari to yarap to naani so lupa to ed saray salimbeng na dalin to lanlamang; balet sikato nigapol naani et nipasag tan ag la naani naromog.
Saman la onalagey naani ed pasen to so sakey a somisingil na buis a palabasen to so gayaga na panarian, balet dia ed loob na pigaran agew sikato so naderal naani, aliwa a lapu ed sanok, nisay bakal.

Et dia ed pasen to onalagey na ani so sakey a too ya angapo so ki nenepeg to, a sikato so agda angite ran na galang na panarian: balet sikato onla naani ed panaon na deen, et gamoran to naani so panarian lapu ed pasirayew.
Et saray manelap ya inayuraan nadelap ira naani ed arap to, tan nabuyak ira; on, ontan met so principe na sipan.
Et kayari na nonong ya agawa ed sikato, sikato so managamil naani na panamalingo; ta sikato onsegep naani tan magmaliw naani a mabis keg ed dagdaiset a too.

Dia ed panaon na katalkan onla naani anga ed saray katabaan a pasen na luyag; et gawaen to naani so ag ginawa na saray atateng to tan ag met ginawa na saray atateng na saray atateng to; sikato itayak to naani ed sikara so samsam, dinegke man, tan kayamanan; on, nonoten to naani so saray isisipen to a sumpa ed saray salimbeng, anga ed sakey a panaon.

Et tenyegen to naani so pakapanyari tan kakpelan to a sumpa ed ari na abalaten pati sakey a baleg ya inayuraan; et say ari ed abalaten mibakal naani ed bakal a pati sakey a sankabalgan tan mabiskeg ya inayuraan, balet sikato ag naani ontalindeg; ta nonoten da naani so saray pamalingo a sumpa ed sikato.
On, sikara a mangan na saray masamit a kanen sikato naani bagbagen da, et say inayuraan to onkayat naani a singa delap; et dakel so nipasag a napatey.

Et no nipaakar ed saray duaran ar-ari saray puso ra wala ra naani a mangawa na duksa, tan mansalita ra naani na saray tila ed sakey a dulang; balet ag naani onaligwas; ta say kasumpalan wala ni naani ed inggeted a panaon.
Saman la naani ompawil ed dalin to a pati dakel a kayamanan; et say pusoto sumpa naani ed masanto a sipan; et gawaen to naani so kaliktan to, et ompawil naani ed dili a dalin to.
Dia ed panaon ya inggeted ompawil naani tan onla naani ed abalaten; balet aliwa naani ed kaonoran a panaon a singa sanen inmuna.

Ta onla naani so saray sakayan na Kittim a sumpa ed sikato; kanian sikato so manermen naani, et ompawil naani, et, wala naani sanok to sumpa ed masanto a sipan et gawaen to naani so kaliktan to: et ompawil naani lanlamang, tan wala naani pangingalngalep to ed saray mangikaindan ed masanto a sipan.

Et saray inayuraan onalagey ira naani ya ontipon ed sikato, et muraen da naani so masanto ya abung angan say salimbeng, tan ipaway da naani so naynay a bagat a napoolan tan ipasen da naani so kadimlaan na mangawa na pankibalatar.
Et saray mangawa na karelmengan sumpa ed sipan deralen to ra naani ed panamegley na saray paspasirayew; balet saray totoo ya amta ra so Dios da mabiskeg ira naani tan mangawa ra na kabayanian.

Et saray makabat ed nanleleetan na saray totoo ibangat da naani so dakel; angan ontan nipasag ira naani lapu ed kampilan tan lapu ed dalang, lapu ed kadakep tan lapu ed samsam, ed saray dakel ya agew.
Bang sano nipasag ira, natulongan ira naani ed daiset a tulong: balet dakel naani so ontipon ed sikara a tekep na saray paspasirayew.
Et arum ed sikara a makabat nipasag ira naani pian nalinisan ira, tan pian nagogolan ira, tan pian napaputi ra, anga ed panaon na kasampotan; lapu'd no nipaakar lambengat ed tinandaan a panaon.

Et say ari mangawa naani unong ed labay to; et itandoro to naani so inkasika to lanlamang, tan pabalegen to so laman to lanlamang ed tagey na amin a dios, tan mansalita naani na saray makapakelaw a bengatla a sumpa ed Dios na saray dirios; et onaligwas naani anga ed nasumpal so sanok; et say nigeter nasumpal naani.

Et agto met naani ingalngalep so saray dirios na saray atateng to tan say pilalek na saray bibii, tan agto met ingalngalep so angan anto a dios; ta sikato pabalegen to so inkasikato lanlamang ed tagey da ya amin.

Balet dia ed pasen to pagalangan to naani so dios na saray salimbeng, tan sakey a dios ya ag kabkabat nen saman na saray atateng to pagalangan to naani ed balitok, tan pilak, tan ed saray mabli a bato, tan ed saray makapalikliket a bengatla.

Et mangawa naani na sumpa ed saray kabiskegan a salimbeng lapu ed tulong na sakey a sankaili a dios: angan siopa a mamirbir ed sikato ombaleg naani ed gayaga, et panuleyen to ra naani ed tagey na saray dakel, tan apag-apagen to naani so dalin nipaakar ed sakey a bili.

Tan dia ed panaon kasumpalan say ari na abalaten mibakal naani ed sikato; et say ari a amianen onla naani a sumpa ed sikato a singa sakey ya alimbosabos a pati saray luganan tan totoo ya akakabayo tan dakel a sasakayan; et on-loob naani ed saray dalin, et onkayat naani a singa delap, tan labasan to naani.
Sikato onloob met naani ed maliga a dalin, et dakel naani so dalin a napalis; balet saraya nilaban ira naani ed lima to: say Edom tan Moab tan saray manonaan na saray anak nen Ammon.
Yuna' to met naani so lima to ed saray dalin da; et say dalin ya Egipto ag naani nilikod.
Balet wala naani pakayari to ed tagey na saray kayamanan a balitok tan pilak, tan ed amin a mabli a bengabengatla na Egipto; et saray taga Libia tan taga Etiopia wala ra naani ed saray kurang to.
Balet sikato goloen to naani so saray balita a manlapu ed bokig tan ed amianen; et ompaway naani a sisasanok a maong a mamagbag tan mamalis a sigpot ed dakerakel.
Et ipaalagey to naani so saray tolda na palacio to ed nanleetan na dayat tan say maliga a masanto a palandey; angan ontan onsabi naani so kasumpalan, et angapo naani so ontulong ed sikato.

Tan dia ed satan a panaon ontalindeg naani si Micael, a baleg a principe, a sikato so ontalindeg nipaakar ed saray anak na baley mo; et wala naani sakey a panaon na gonigon, a sikato so angapo nen saman angan kapigan a nanlapu ed inkiwala na nacion anga lanlamang ed satan a panaon; tan dia ed satan a panaon say baley mo nilaban naani, balang sakey a naromog naani a nisulat ed libro.
Et dakel ed saray naugip ed dabok na dalin naliing ira naani, say arum nipaakar ed maando a bilay, tan say arum nipaakar ed kibabaing tan maando a kagonigon.
Et saray makabat onsinag ira naani a singa sinag na tawen; et saray mangipawit na dakerakel ed inkatunong singa ra naani saray bitewen ed ando lan ando lawas.
Balet sika, O Daniel, kaputan mo so saray salita, tan talakan mo so libro anga lanlamang ed panaon na kasumpalan: dakerakel naani so saray ombatik ya onla tan ompawil, tan say pikakabat ondaak naani.
Saman la siak, si Daniel, ninmengnengak, et nia, inmalagey so saray dua ra a sananey, say sakey ed gilig na ilog ed saya a diking, et say sananey ed gilig na ilog ed satan a diking.
Et say sakey inkuan to ed laki a nankawes na lienzo, a sikato so wala nen saman ed tagey na saray danum na ilog, Kaonongan naani kabayag to anga ed kasumpalan na saraya a pakpakelaw?

Et nadngel ko so too a nankawes na lienzo, a sikato so wala nen saman ed tagey na saray danum na ilog, sanen intagey to so kawanan a lima to tan say kawigi a lima to ya inpaatagey, tan insamba to ed saman so manbilay ed ando lan ando, a nipaakar naani ed sakey a panaon, saray panaon, tan sakey a kapaldua; et sano ginawa ra so kasumpalan na kabuybuyak na pakayari na masanto a baley, saray amin a bengabengatla nasumpal ira naani.
Et nadngel ko balet agko atalosan: saman la inkuan ko, O Katawan ko, anto naani so kasumpalan na saraya a bengatla?
Et sikato inkuan to, Onla ka ed dalan mo, Daniel: ta saray salita nakaputan ira tan natatakan ira anga ed panaon na kasumpalan.

Dakel naani so mangogol na inkasikara lanlamang, tan paputien da so inkasikara lanlamang, tan nalinisan ira; balet saray marelmeng mangawa ra naani a mareldelmeng; et angapo ed saray marelmeng so makatalos naani; balet saray makabat makatalos ira naani.
Et manlapu ed panaon a say naynay a bagat a napoolan naekal naani, tan say kadimlaan a mangawa na pankibalatar nipasen, wala naani sanlibo duanlasus tan siamaplo ya agew.
Mapalar so manalagar, tan onsabi ed sanlibo talonlasus tan talomplo tan lima ya agew.
Balet sika onla ka ed dalan mo anga ed kasumpalan; ta manpaina ed kapalaran mo, ed kasampotan na wa ka naani, tan onalagey ka naani saray agew.

Say salita nen Katawan a sinmabi ed Oseas, anak a laki nen Beeri, ed saray agew nen Ozias, Joatan, Acaz, tan Ezequias, ar-ari na Juda, tan ed saray agew nen Jeroboam, anak a laki nen Joas, ari na Israel.

Sanen si Katawan nansalita nen inmuna ed Oseas, si Katawan inkuan to ed Oseas, Onla ka, mangala ka na sakey ya asawa ed inkabalangkantis tan saray anak na inkabalangkantis ta say dalin mangawa na baleg a inkabalangkantis ya onarawi ed Katawan.
Dia ed ontan sikato so linma tan inala to si Gomer, anak a bii nen Diblaim; et sikato so nanlokon, tan angianak na sakey a laki.

Et si Katawan inkuan to ed sikato, Tawagen mo so ngaran to a Jezrael; ta dia ed magangano dalawen ko naani so dala nen Jezrael ed abung nen Jehu, tan gawaen ko naani panarian na abung na Israel ya onton da.
Et nagawa naani ed satan ya agew, a puteren ko naani so bekang na Israel ed lawak na Jezrael.

Et sikato nanlokon lamet, tan angianak na bii. Et si Katawan inkuan to ed sikato nen Oseas. Tawagen mo so ngaran to a Lo-ruhamah; ta andian ak la naani na panangasi ed abung na Israel, a dia ed angan anto a pamaakaran agko ra perdonaen.

Balet walaan ak naani panangasi ed abung na Juda, tan ilaban ko ra naani ed panamegley nen Katawan a Dios da, tan agko ra ilaban ed panamegley na bekang, odino panamegley na kampilan, odino panamegley na bakal, saray cabayo, odino ed panamegley na saray akakabayo a lalaki.
Bang nen pinakso to si Lo-ruhamah, sikato so nanlokon, tan angianak na sakey a laki.
Et si Katawan inkuan to, Tawagen mo so ngaran to a Lo-ammi: ta sikayo agta kayo baley, tan aliwaak naani a Dios yo.

Angan ontan say bilang na saray anak na Israel sikat naani singa buer na dayat, sikato: so ag nasukat odino nabilang; et nagawa ya, dia ed pasen ya angibagaan ed sikara, Sikayo aliwa kayo a baley ko, nibaga naani ed sikara, Sikayo so saray anak na Dios a mabilay.
Et saray anak na Juda tan saray anak na Israel mandaragup ira naani, tan mangitoro ra naani lanlamang na sakey ya pangulo, tan ontatdang ira a manlapu ed dalin; ta baleg naani so agew nen Jezrael.
Kuan yo ed saray agagi yo a lalaki Ammi, tan ed saray agagi yo a bibii, Ruhamah.

Mikolkol kayo ed ina yo, mikolkol kayo; ta sikato so agko asawa, siak met agtoak asawa; tan sikato iwaklit to komon so saray inkabalangkantis a manlapu ed lupa to, tan saray pikakalogoran to a manlapu ed nanleetan na saray pagew to;

Ompan lamang sikato so lakseban ko, tan sikato so ipasen ko a singa dia ed agew a sikato so nianak, tan sikato so gawaen ko a singa kalawakan, tan sikato so ipasen ko a singa sakey ya amaga a dalin, tan sikato so pateyen ko ed inkapgaan.
On, dia ed saray anak to andian ak naani na panangasi; ta anak ira na inpibalangkantis;

Ta say ina ra akibalangkantis; sikato ya angilokon ed sikara nangawa na makapabaing; ta inkuan to, Ontombok ak naani ed saray manangarok, a mangiter ed siak na tinapay ko tan danum ko, say bagok tan linok, say larak ko tan inumen ko.
Kanian, nia, alaren ko naani so dalan mo na sabisabit, tan mangipaalageyak naani na sakey a bakor a sumpa ed sikato, pian agto naromog so saray basbas to.

Et sikato ontombok naani ed saray manangaro to, balet agto ra naabotan naani; et sikara naani anapen to, balet agto ra naani naromog; saman la ikuan to, Onla ak tan ompawilak ed inmuna ya asawak; ta magmaong lanti nen saman ed siak nen say natan.
Ta sikato agto naamtaan ya angiterak ed sikato na bukel, tan say balo ya alak, tan say larak, tan pinarakel ko ed sikato so pilak tan balitok, a sikara so inagamil da a nipaakar ed Baal.
Kanian babawien ko so bukel ko ed panaon to, tan say balo ya alak ko dia ed kinepeg to, tan baguten ko naani so bagok tan say linok a sikara so nisakbong ed inkalakseb to.
Et natan lukasan ko naani so kaagapan to ed pakanengneng na saray manangaro to, tan angapo so mangilaban naani ed sikato a manlapu ed limak.
Patondaen ko met naani so amin a liga to, saray liket to, saray balo a bulan to, tan saray sabaton to, tan saray amin a makapaliket a tipon to.

Et palisen ko naani so saray uvas to tan saray higos to, a sikara so nankuanan to, Saraya sikara so upak a saray manangarok initer da ed siak; et gawaen ko ra naani a sakey a takel, tan saray ayep ed uma sikara so kanen da naani.

Et dalawen ko naani ed sikato so saray agew na saray Baal, a nanpasoban to na incienso, sanen inalongan to so inkasikato ed saray ikaw tan saray kagawaan to, tan tinmombok ed saray manangaro to, tan nilingoanan to ak, kuan nen Katawan.
Kanian, nia, sikato so tangoyoren ko naani, tan yakar ko ed kalawakan, tan mansalita ak ed sikato na makaligliwa.

Et iter ko naani ed sikato so saray uvasan to a manlapud'man, tan say lawak na Acor a nipaakar a pinto a ilalo; et sikato mangawa naani na ebat diman; singa dia ed saray agew na inkaugaw to, tan singa dia ed agew sanen tinmatdang a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto.
Et nagawa naani ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan, a tawagen mo ak naani na Ishi tan agmo ak la tawagen a Baali.
Ta ekalen ko naani so saray ngaran na saray Baal a manlapu ed sangi to, tan sikara ag ira la naolit lapu ed ngaran da.

Et dia ed satan ya agew mangawa ak naani na sipan a nipaakar ed sikara a pati saray ayep ed uma, tan pati saray manok ed saray tawen, tan pati saray korongkorong a bengabengatla ed dalin: tan puteren ko naani so bekang tan say kampilan tan say bakal a manlapu ed dalin, tan padokolen ko ra naani a maligeligen.
Et yasawa ta ka naani ed siak lawas; on, yasawa taka naani ed siak dia ed inkatunong, tan dia ed kaptekan, tan dia ed maaro ya abig na linawa, tan dia ed saray panangasi.
Yasawa taka naani ed siak, salanti dia ed katooran; et sika naamtaan mo naani si Katawan.
Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, ya onebat ak, kuan nen Katawan, onebat ak naani ed saray tawen, ta ebatan da naani so dalin;
Et say dalin ebatan to naani so bukel, tan say balo ya alak, tan say larak; et sikara ebatan da naani si Jezrael.

Et sikato naani itanem ko ed siak dia ed dalin; tan walaan ak naani na panangasi ed sikato ya ag akagamor na panangasi; et ikuan ko naani ed sikara ya aliwa ra a baley ko nen saman so, Sikayo so baley ko; et ikuan da naani, Sika so Dios ko.

Et si Katawan inkuan to ed siak Onla ka lamet, mangaro ka na sakey a bii ya inararo na kaaro to, tan sakey a mikakalogoran, singa lanlamang so pangaro nen Katawan ed saray anak na Israel, angan tinmombok ira ed saray dirios ya sananey tan inaro ra so saray bibingka na saray uvas ya inpamaga,
Dia ed ontan sikato so sinaliw ko na labinlima a tapi na pilak, tan sakey homer a cebada; tan kapaldua ya homer na cebada.

Et inkuan ko ed sikato, Sica mansiansia ka naani a nipaakar ed siak ed saray dakel ya agew; agka naani mibalangkantis, tan sika so ag asawa naani na angan siopa a laki: dia ed ontan siak met naani nipaakar ed sika.
Ta saray anak na Israel mansiansia ra ed saray dakel ya agew ya andian na ari tan andian na principe, tan andian na bagat, tan andian na seklang, tan andian na efod odino terafin:
Kayari to saray anak na Israel ompawil ira naani, tan anapen da si Katawan a Dios da, tan si David ya ari ra, tan onla ra naani a sitatakot ed Katawan tan ed kaabigan to ed saray kaonoran ya agew.

Dengelen yo so salita nen Katawan, sikayo anak na Israel; ta si Katawan walaan na pisangsangan ed saray manaayam ed dalin, lapu ed angapo so katuaan, odino kaabigan, odino pikakabat ed Dios dia ed dalin.
Angapo no ag lambengat say panagsamba, tan panamagbag na pananisia, tan panagpatey, tan pantakew, tan pikakalogoran; agda binenbenan so linawa ra, et say dala diniwit to so dala.
Kanian say dalin onermen naani, tan balang sakey a manaayam diman ombeleng naani, pati saray ayep ed uma tan saray manok ed saray tawen: on, saray sira ed dayat met onandi ra naani.
Angan ontan angapo komon so too a misiblangan, tan angapo met komon so too a mamaat; ta say baley mo sikara so singa saray misumpaan ed sacerdote.
Et sika nigapol ka naani dia ed agew, tan say profeta met nigapol a pati sika dia ed labi; et siak bagbagen ko naani si inam.

Say baley ko abagbag lapu ed kakulangan na pikakabat: lapu ed impolisay mo so pikakabat, siak met naani ipolisay taka, pian sika so ag naani sacerdote ed siak: bangta nilingoanan mo so tunong na Dios mo, siak met lingoanan ko naani so saray anak mo.
Unong ed indakel da, dia ed ontan nankasalanan ira a sumpa ed siak: salatan ko naani so gayaga ra ed kababaingan.
Mantagano ra ed kasalanan na baley ko, tan inpasen da so puso ra dia ed inkauges da.
Et sikato naani, singa say baley, singa sacerdote; et dusaen ko ra naani lapu ed saray dalan da, tan ¡bales ko naani ed sikara so saray gawa ra.
Et mangan ira naani, et ag ira napesel; mibalangkantis ira et ag ira ondakel; lapu ed agda tinalineng si Katawan.
Say pibabalangkantis tan alak tan balo ya alak ekalen da so pakatalos.

Say baley ko onkerew na simbawa ed kiew da, et say tayokorda mamaliwawa ed sikara; ta say espiritu na inkabalangkantis ginawato ra a nalingo, et akibalangkantis ira, a sinmian ira a nanlapu ed Dios da.

Sikara manbagat ira ed tapew na saray toktok na saray palandey, tan manpasob ira na incienso ed tapew na saray pokdol, ed silong na saray roble tan saray alamo tan saray terebin to, lapu ed say sirom da sikato so maong: kanian saray anak yo a bibii akibalangkantis ira, tan saray novia yo mikalogoran ira.

Agko dusaen naani so saray anak yo a bibii sano mibalangkantis ira, angan saray novia yo sano mikalogoran ira; ta saray lalaki lanlamang onsian ira pati saray balangkantis tan sikara manbagat ira pati saray balangkantis; et say baley ya ag makatalos nabual naani.
Angan sika, Israel, mibalangkantis ka angan ontan say Juda ag komon mankasalanan; et agkayo onla anga ed Galgal, agkayo met ontatdang ed Bet-aven, agkayo met mansamba, Unong a mabilay si Katawan.
Ta say Israel nagmaliw ya ag napaamo a singa sakey a masugnar a kilaw na baca; bang si Katawan taganoen to ra naani a singa sakey a cordero dia ed baleg a pasen.
Say Efraim nitipon ed saray talintao; paulian yo a bokbokod.
Say inumen da nagmaliw ya anapseng; sikara akibalangkantis ira a naynay; saray managuley to aroen da a pinabpabli so baing.
Sikato so binalkot na dagem ed saray payak to; et sikara so nipatnag naani ed kababaingan lapu ed saray bagat da.

Denglen yo so saya, O sikayo sacerdote, tan ontalineng ka, O abung na Israel, tan pakadenglen mo, abung na ari; ta nipaakar ed sikayo so pangokom; ta sikayo nen saman so kalot ed Mizpa, tan sakey ya iket a nipanat ed Tabor.
Et saray managgolo linma ra ed aralem dia ed panagpatey; balet siak so manamoot da ya amin.
Amtak so Efraim, tan say Israel ag niamot ed siak; ta natan, O Efraim, akibalangkantis ka, say Israel adutakan.
Saray gawa ra agda naani yaboloy so ipawil da ed Dios da; ta say espiritu na inkabalangkantis wala ed sikara, et agda amta si Katawan.
Et say kapangtaan na Israel tasian to: kanian say Israel tan Efraim nigapol ira naani ed inkauges da; et say Juda met nigapol naani a pati sikara,
Pati saray carnero tan saray baca ra onla ra naani a mananap ed Katawan, balet sikato naani so agda naromog; sikato so inmarawi ed sikara.
Nanagamil ira a sililiput sumpa ed Katawan, ta angianak ira na saray sankaili ya anak; natan say balo a bulan akmonen to ra naani pati saray uma ra.
Paknolen yo so corneta ed Gabaa, tan say tamboyog ed Rama: paknolen yo so panangibalap na ayura ed Bet-aven; ed beneg mo, O Benjamin.
Say Efraim magmaliw naani a kibalatar ed agew na kapoot: ed saray kailalakan na Israel inpakabat ko so wala naani a petepeteg.
Saray manonaan na Juda sikara so singa saray angyalis na ketegan, ikalbok naani ed sikara a singa danum so sanok ko.
Say Efraim sikato so naaposan, nabagbag ed kaokom; ta sikato so malikeliket a nanakar a tinmombok ed gangan na too.
Kanian siak ed Efraim so singa sakey a bokbok, tan ed abung na Juda singa kabolok.

Sanen anengneng na Efraim so sakit to, tan say Juda so sugat to, saman la say Efraim linma ed Asiria, tan nanbaki ed ari na Jareb: balet sikato agto kayo nayarian a paabigen, tan agto met naani natambal so sugat yo.
Ta siak singa ak naani sakey a leon ed Efraim, tan singa tobonbalo a leon ed abung na Juda: siak, siak lanlamang, bingkasen ko naani tan ontainan ak; sikato so yarawikj tan angapo naani mangilaban.
Onla ak naani tan ompawil ak ed pasen ko, anga ed nabidbir da so kasalanan da, tan anapen da so lupak: dia ed kairapan da anapen da ak naani a maseseg.
Dago kayo tan ompawil itayo ed Katawan: ta sikato biningkas to itayo, et tambalen to itayo, kinabil to itayo et bedberan to itayo naani.
Kayari duaran agew pabilayen to itayo naani: ed komatlo ya agew paulien to itayo naani, et manbilay itayo naani ed arap to.

Sikato komon so amtaen tayo, tan ontombok itayo komon a mangamta ed Katawan: say ipaway to ag onlaron a singa say kabuasan; et sikato onsabi naani ed sikatayo a singa say uran, a singa say kaonoran ya uran a salogen to so dalin.
Anto naani gawaen ko ed sika, O Efraim? Anto naani gawaen ko ed sika O Juda? Ta say kaabigan mo singa say lurem ed kabuasan, tan singa say lihaew ya ontainan a masakbay.
Kanian ginalpong ko ra ed panamegley na saray profeta, ed saray salita na sangik pinatey ko ra: et saray pangokom ko singara liwawa ya onkayat.
Ta say kaabigan so pilalek ko, ya aliwa a say bagat; tan say pikakabat ed Dios a magmaong nen saray bagat a napoolan.
Balet sikara singa si Adam sinmumlang ira ed sipan: diman nanagamil ira a sililiput a sumpa ed siak.
Say Galaad sikato so ciudad na saray mangagawa na inkauges; natilolan ed dala.
Tan singa saray olop na saray mamatakew manalagar ira a nipaakar ed sakey a too, ontan so olop na saray sacerdote mamatey ira ed dalan ya arap ed Sikem; on, nangawa ra na inkasabo na dala.
Dia ed abung na Israel anengneng ko so makapataktakot a bengatla: diman say inkabalangkantis aromog ed Efraim, say Israel nadutakan.
Ontan met, O Juda, wala so sakey a panagani a nigeter a nipaakar ed sika, sano ipawil ko so inkadakep na baley ko.

Sanen tambalen ko komon so Israel, nipatnag so inkauges na Efraim, tan say inkauges na Samaria; ta sikara nangawa ra na tila, et say matakew onloob, tan say olop na saray mamatakew mansamsam ira ed paway.
Et agda isipen ed saray puso ra a nanonotan ko so amin ya inkauges da: natan saray amin a gawa ra niliber ed sikara; wala ra ed arap na lupak.
Gawaen da a panliketen so ari ed inkauges da, tan saray principe ra ed saray tila ra.
Sikara ya amin mikakalogoran ira; sikara so singa sakey a palbaan a paparlangan na gomagawa na tinapay; sikato itonda to so pamarlang to, a manlapu ed inkakames na masa, anga ed sikato so nalebagan.
Dia ed agew na ari tayo saray principe inpansakit da so inkasikara lanlamang ed petang na alak; sikato inyunat to so lima to ed mabalaw.
Tan intadia ra so puso ra a singa sakey a palbaan, leleg na pansaneb da: say managtinapay mansanlabi a naugip; dia ed kabuasan say palbaan ondalang a singa sakey a mandarlang ya apuy.
Sikara ya amin ampetang ira a singa sakey a palbaan, et akmonen da so saray okookom da; saray amin ya ari nipasag ira: angapo so angan sakey ya ontawag ed siak.
Say Efraim onlaok ed saray baley; say Efraim sikato so sakey a bibingka ya ag inpigar.
Inakmon na saray sankaili so biskeg to; et sikato so agto amta; on, uban a buek so saray wala dia tan diman ed tapew to, et sikato so agto amta.
Et say inkapangta na Israel ompatnag ed lupa to: angan ontan ag ira pinmawil ed Katawan a Dios da, tan agda met inanap lapu ed saya ya amin.
Et say Efraim sikato so singa sakey a malapati ya kemeg, ya andian na pakatalos: ontawag ira ed Egipto, onla ra ed Asiria.
Sano onla ra, ipanat ko naani ed sikara so iket ko; ipaabebak ira naani a singa saray manok ed saray tawen; dusaen ko ra naani a singa say moyong da nadngel to.
Kasi lara! lapu ed sinmian ira ed siak; kabagbag ed sikara! ta sinmumlang ira a sumpa ed siak; angan dondonen ko ra komon, balet nansalita ra na saray tila a sumpa ed siak.
Et ag ira tinmawag ed siak ed puso ra, no ag ingen managlem ira ed saray dokolan da: mantitipon ira a nipaakar lambengat ed tagano tan balo ya alak; ontunganga ra a sumpa ed siak.
Angan inbangat ko tan pinabiskeg ko so saray taklay da, angan ontan isipen da so mauges a sumpa ed siak.

Ompawil ira, balet aliwan dia ed saman so wala ed tagey; sikara so singa sakey a manamalingo a bekang; saray principe ra napelag ira naani ed kampilan lapu ed petang na dila ra: saya naani so kaludlureyan da ed dalin na Egipto.
Yan mo so tamboyog ed sangim. Onsabi a singa agila ya onsumpa ed abung nen Katawan, lapu ed sinumlang da so sipan ko, tan tinmunganga ra a sumpa ed tunong ko.
Ontawag ira naani ed siak, Dios ko, sikami a Israel naamtaan mika la.
Saray Israel impolisay to so maong: sikato naani osilan na kabosol.
Sikara angiletneg ira na ar-ari balet agko linawa: angiletneg ira na saray principe, et agko amta nen saman: dia ed saray pilak da tan balitok da nangawa ra na saray taltalintao pian kabalangan da.
Inbantak to so kilaw a bakam; O Samaria; say sanok ko naparlang a sumpa ed sikara: kaonongan kabayag ya anga ed nagamoran da so kaalasan?
Ta nanlapu ed Israel angan saya wala, sikato so ginawa na komikimey, et aliwa a Dios; on nabuybuyak naani so kilaw a baka na Samaria.

Lapu ed nantanem ira na dagem manani ra naani na alimbosabos: angapo ed sikato so manalalagey a bukel, say bulong ag naani mangiter na tapong; no sikato so mangiter, sikato so kanen naani na saray sankaili.
Naakmon so Israel; natan walara ed saray nacion a singa sakey a kagawaan ya ag makapaliket ed angan siopa.
Ta sikara tinmatdang ira ed Asiria, singa asno ya atap ya angapo so iba to: say Efraim inupaan to ray manangaro.
On, angan upaan da ed saray nacion, natan pantitiponen kora naani; et ongapu ra a napamelag lapu ed awit na ari na saray principe.
Lapu ed pinarakel na Efraim so saray altar a pankasalananan, walaan nen saman na saray altar pian pankasalananan.
Insulat ko ed sikato so saray samplonlibo a bengabengatla na tunong ko; balet sikara so nibilang a singa pakapakelaw a bengatla.

No nipaakar ed pangyapay. ed saray bagat ko, manbabagat ira na laman tan sikato so kanen da; balet ag ira awaten nen Katawan: natan nanonotan to naani so inkauges da, et dalawen to naani ray kasalanan da; ompawil ira naani ed Egipto.

Ta say Israel alingoanan to so Nangawa ed sikato, et amaalagey na saray palacio; et say Juda pinarakel to so saray ciudad a kinutaan: balet ipawit ko naani so apuy ed saray ciudad to, et sikato naani mangakmon ed saray palacio ra.
Agca manliket, O Israel, lapu ed gayaga, a singa saray baley; ta sika akibalangkantis ka, ya inmarawi ka ed Dios mo; inarom so upa ed balang taltagan.
Say taltagan tan panagkamesan na alak sikara naani agda taganoan, tan say balo ya alak onkulang naani ed sikato.
Ag ira naani manayam ed dalin nen Katawan; no ag ingen ompawil naani si Efraim ed Egipto, et mangan ira naani na marutak a tagano ed Asiria.

Ag ira la naani mangikalbo na saray bagat ya alak ed Katawan, tan ag ira met naani makapaliket ed sikato, saray bagat da sikara naani singa tinapay na saray maneermen; saray amin a mangan ed sikato nadutakan ira; ta say tinapay da nipaakar naani ed liket da a mangan: ag naani onla ed abung nen Katawan.
Anto naani gawaen yo sano agew na tipon a mabinta, tan ed agew na liket nen Katawan?

Ta nia, tinmainan ira ed kabagbag; angan ontan say Egipto tiponen to ra naani, say Memfis itabon to ra naani: saray makapalikliket a bengabengatla a pilak da, saray kamiring so mankayarian ed sikara; saray sabitan wala ra naani ed saray tolda ra.

Sinmabi so agew na kadadalaw, sinmabi so saray agew na pananumang; sikato naani naamtaan na Israel; say profeta sakey a maatiw, say laki ya walaan na espiritu sikato so ambagel, lapu ed karakel na inkauges mo, tan lapu ed baleg so panbobosolan.
Say Efraim sikato nen saman so bantay a pati say Dios ko: no nipaakar ed profeta, kalot na umaanop so wala ed saray amin a dalan to, tan panbobosolan dia ed abung na Dios to.
Dinutakan da a toloy so saray inkasikara lanlamang, a singa ed saray agew na Gabaa: nanonotan to naani so inkauges da, dalawen to naani so saray kasalanan da.

Aromog ko so Israel a singa saray uvas ed kalawakan; anengneng ko so saray atateng yo a singa say inmuna ya alo to ed kiew na higos ed unona a nigeter a kinepeg to: balet linma ra ed Baalpehor, tan inconsagra ra so inkasikara lanlamang ed kababaingan, et nagmaliw ira a kadimlaan a singa satan so inaro ra.
No nipaakar ed Efraim, say gayaga ra ontikyab naani a singa sakey a manok ed tawen: angapo naani so pananak, tan angapo so panlokon, tan angapo so pannginew.
Angan napabaleg da so saray anak da, sikara naani ekalen ko, pian angapo so angan siopa a too a natilak: on, kasi lara sano ontainan ak ed sikara!
Say Efraim, singa inpakanengneng ko ed Tiro, inpaalagey ed pasen a makapalikliket: balet say Efraim yakar to naani so saray anak to ed managpatey.
Itdan mo ra, O Katawan anto so iter mo naani? itdan mo ra na panaganakan a naekalan tan amagaan ira a pagew.
Amin ya inkauges da wala ed Galaad; tan diman ginulak ira: lapu ed inkauges na saray gawa ra patainanen ko ra naani ed abung ko; agko ra naani aroen la, saray amin a principe ra managgolo ra.
Say Efraim nakabil, saray lamut da amagaan, ag lara naani manbunga; on, angan mankamuktil, siak pateyen ko naani so inaro a bunga na panaganakan da.
Sikara naani ibantak na Dios ko, lapu ed sikato so agda tinalineng; et sikara naani manteyengteyeng ed saray nacion.

Say Israel sikato so sakey a malambot ya uvas, a papawayen to so bunga to; no kaonongan karakel so bunga to ontan so pamarakel to ed saray altar to; no kaonongan karakel so kaabigan na dalin da ontan so pangawa ra na saray marakep a seklang.
Say puso ra naapag; natan naromog ira naani a nankasalanan: sikato deralen to naani ray altar da, igeba to naani ray seklang da.
Andi duarua natan kuan da naani: Angapo so ari mi: ta agkami antakot ed Katawan; et say ari anto so nayarian to a gawaen ed sikami?
Mansalita ra na kaapaan a salsalita, mansamba ra a sititila ed panaggawa na sipan: kanian say pangokom ompaway naani a singa ajenjo ed saray gulis na uma.

Saray manaayam ed Samaria wala ra naani ed kakebiewan lapu ed saray kilaw a baka na Bet-aven; ta saray totoo manermen ira naani lapu ed sikato, ontan met so saray sacerdote a manliket ed sikato lapu ed gayaga to lapu ed sikato so nisian ed sikato.
Et sikato niyakar ni ed Asiria, a panagkatokdol ed ari Jareb: say Efraim awaten to naani so kibabaing, tan say Israel nibabaing naani ed dili a simbawa to.
No nipaakar ed Samaria, say ari to napegpeg, a singa say bura ed tapew na danum.

Saray atagey met a pasen na Avan, say kasalanan na Israel, nabagbag ira naani say sabit tan tala ontobo ra naani ed tapew na saray altar da; et kuan da naani ed saray palandey, Tabonan yo kami; tan ed saray pokdol, Ompelag kayo ed sikami.
O Israel, nankasalanan ka a nanlapu ed saray agew na Gabaa: diman nanalagey ira; say bakal a sumpa ed saray anak na inkauges agto ra naabot ed Gabaa.
Et sano sikato so kaliktan ko dusaen ko ra naani; et saray baley natipon ira naani a sumpa ed sikara, sano nabalor ira ed saray duara ya inpakasumlang da.

Et say Efraim sikato so manmadmarikit a baka a nibangat, a malabay a manilik; balet siak dinmalan ak ed tapew na marakep a beklew to: mangyan ak naani na sakey ya mangabayo ed Efraim; say Juda manbaka naani, si Jacob buyaken to naani so saray bingkol to.

Mantanem kayo ed sikayo lanlamang na inkatunong, manani kayo na unong ed kaabigan; buyaken yo so uma a pinaulian yo; ta panaon na pananap yo ed Katawan, anga ed sikato so onsabi tan pauranen to so inkatunong ed sikayo.
Nanbaka kayo na inkauges, nanani kayo na karelmengan; kinan yo so saray bunga na tila; ta sika nanmatalek ka ed dalan mo, ed karakel na saray mabiskeg a totoom.

Kanian onalagey naani so sakey a golo ed saray baley mo, et saray amin a salimbeng mo nabagbag ira naani, singa si Salmana binagbag to so Betarbel ed agew na bakal: say ina nibasig ya abuybuyak a pati saray anak to.
Ontan met naani so gawaen ed sikayo na Betel lapu ed inkauges yo: ed manbalatabat so agew say ari na Israel napegpeg naani a sigpot.
Sanen say Israel sikato ni so ugaw, sikato so inarok, tan tinawag ko ya ana'ko ya laki a nanlapu ed Egipto.
No panon so pananawag na saray profeta ed sikara, ontan met so yaarawi ra ed sikara; nanbagbagat ira ed saray Baalim, tan nanpasob ira na incienso ed saray inbolik a talintao.
Angan ontan inbangat ko si Efraim a manakar, sinayakop ko ra ed saray taklay ko; balet agda naamtaan a tinambal ko ra.
Ginuyor ko ra ed saray lubir na sakey a too, ed saray singer na aro: ed siak nen saman ed sikara so singa saray mangawit na pako ed saray aping da: et inyan ko so kanen ed arap da.
Ag ira naani ompawil ed dalin na Egipto; no ag ingen say Asirio sikato naani so ari ra, lapu ed ag ira ompawil ed siak.
Et ondapo naani so kampilan ed saray ciudad da, et opoten to naani so saray balewet da, et sikara so akmonen to naani, lapu ed saray dili a pananimbawa ra.
Et say baley ko ipasakey da so ombeneg ed siak: angaman tawágen da ra ed saman so wala ed tagey, angapo a mogmo so mangitandoro ed sikato.

Panon a paulian taka naani, Efraim? panon ya ibantak taka naani, Israel? panon a gawaen taka naani a singa say Adma? panon ya iletneg taka naani a singa Zeboim? Say pusok nagonigon ed dalem ko, saray panangabagey ko mandarlang ira ya amin.
Agko naani gawaen so kasubegan na sanok ko, agak la naani ompawil a mamagbag ed Efraim: ta siak Dios ak, ya aliwa a too; say Santo ya wala ed pegley mo; et agak naani onloob a sisasanok.
Manakar ira naani ya ontombok ed Katawan, ta sikato so manongol naani a singa sakey a leon; ta sikato manongol naani et saray anak onla ra naani a sigigiwgiw a manlapu ed sagur.

Onla ra naani a sigigiwgiw a singa sakey a manok ed tawen a manlapu ed Egipto, tan singa sakey a malapati a manlapu ed dalin na Asiria; et panayamen ko ra naani ed saray kaabungan da, kuan nen Katawan.
Niliber toak nen Efraim ed tila, tan say abung na Israel ed panamalingo; balet say Juda miari ni ed Dios, tan sikato so matoor ed Santo.
Say Efraim mantagano ed dagem, tan ontombok ed dagem na bokig: tila tan kabagbag so naynay a parakelen to; tan gawaen da so sakey a sipan ed Asiria, et say larak niyakar ed Egipto.
Si Katawan wala met so pisasangsang to ed Juda, et dusaen to naani si Jacob unong ed saray dalan to; unong ed saray gawa to sikato naani tumangan to.
Dia ed panaganakan inegnaan to so mokor nen agi to; et dia ed inkatoo to walaan nen saman na pakayari ed Dios:
On, wala nen saman so pakayari to ed angel, tan tinmalona; nannangis, tan nangawa na pankerew ed sikato: sikato so aromog to ed Betel, et diman akisalita ed sikatayo,
Angan si Katawan, say Dios na saray ejercito; Katawan so nanonotan a ngaran to.
Kanian sika ompawil ka ed Dios mo: onoren mo so inkamapangasi tan kaptekan, tan manalagar ka ed Dios mo a naynay.
Sikato so sakey a manangili, wala ed lima to so saray simbangan a mamalingo; sikato aroen to so mangapos.
Et inkuan nen Efraim, petepeteg nagmaliw ak a mayaman, aromog ko so kayamanan: dia ed saray amin a kimey ko sikara ag ira makaromog naani ed siak na inkauges a sikato so kasalanan.
Balet siak si Katawan a Dios mo a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto; panayamen taka ni naani ed saray kobongkobong a singa ed saray agew na mabinta a liket.
Ontan met a sinalitak ed saray profeta, tan pinarakel ko so saray pasingawey; tan dia ed panamegley na pankatangbayan na saray profeta inagamil ko so saray aliling.
Say Galaad sikato ta so inkauges? sikara so matila ya amin; dia ed Galgal manbagat ira na saray baka; on, saray altar da sikara so singa losbo ed saray gulis na uma.
Et si Jacob tinmainan a linma ed uma na Aram, tan nanlingkor si Israel nipaakar ed sakey ya asawa ya bii tan nipaakar ed sakey ya asawa ya bii sikato nen saman so nanpastol.
Tan dia ed panamegley na sakey a profeta si Katawan inagwat to so Israel ed Egipto, et dia ed panamegley na sakey a profeta sikato so ag-aderal.
Si Efraim asagyat a manpasnok a mapalalo ya ampait a toloy: kanian say dala to nikera naani ed tapew to, tan say balaw to ipawil naani na Katawan to ed sikato
Sanen si Efraim nansalita, wala so pangiwgiw; intandoro to so inkasikato lanlamang ed Israel; balet sanen nankasalanan ed Baal, sikato so inatey.

Et natan mankasalanan ira a lalo lan lalo, tan nangawa ra na saray inbobo a talintao ed pilak da, angan dirios unong ed dili a pakatalos da, amin ira gawa na maronong a komikimey: kuan da nipaakar ed sikara, Saray lalaki a manbagat angoban da komon so saray kilaw a baka.
Kanian nipara ra naani komon a singa lurem ed kabwasan, tan singa linaew ya onandi a masakbay, singa taep ya yarawi na alimbosabos ed taltagan, tan singa asewek ya ompaway ed pasngawan.
Angan ontan siak si Katawan a Dios mo a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto; et angapo so bidbiren mo la naani a Dios no ag siak lambengat, tan angapo so arum a mangilaban la no ag bokor ko.
Siak naamtaan taka ed kalawakan, dia ed dalin na baleg a maga.
Unong ed panagpakabkaban da, ontan so inkapsel da; napsel ira et say puso ra tinmagey; kanian nilingoanan da ak.
Kanian siak singaak sakey a leon ed sikara; singa sakey a leopardo mansanebak naani ed dalan.

Sabaten kora naani a singa sakey ya oso ya abalang ed saray anak to, pilaten ko so supot na puso ra; et diman akmonen ko ra naani a singa sakey a leon a kabatyan; sikara naani bingkasen na ayep ya atap.
Sikato so kabagbag mo, O Israel, a sika sumpa ka ed siak, sumpa ed tulong mo.
Iner so kawalaan na arim natan, pian nayarian to ka ya ilaban ed saray amin a ciudad mo? tan saray oko-okom mo, a nipaakar ed sikara inkuan mo, Itdan mo ak na sakey ya ari tan saray principe?
Initdan taka na sakey ya ari ed sanok ko, tan sikato so inekal ko ed petang ko.
Say inkauges na Efraim sikato so apongos; say kasalanan to nisinop.
Saray ermen na sakey a bii a manpasakit onla ra naani ed sikato: sikato so sakey ya anak a laki ya marelmeng; ta panaon la a sikato komon so ag manabala ed pasen a kianakan na saray anak.

Dondonen ko ra naani a manlapu ed pakayari na Sheol; dondonen kora naani a manlapu ed patey: O patey, iner so kawalaan na saray bakbak mo? O Shoel, iner so kawalaan na pamagbag mo? pagbabawi so nisanib naani ed saray matak.

Angan sikato so mabunga ed saray agagi to, onsabi naani so dagem a manlapu ed bokig, say panlinawa nen Katawan a manlapu ed kalawakan; say sobol to namagaan naani, tan say sobosobol to naopot naani: sikato samsamen to naani so kayamanan a marakerakep ira a kagawaan.

Say Samaria awiten to naani so kasalanan to; lapu ed sinmumpa ed Dios to: nipasag ira naani ed kampilan; saray anak da ya ankekelag nibasig ira naani a nalinglingkay, tan saray malokon a bibii nabutiakan ira naani.
O Israel ompawil ka ed Katawan a Dios mo; ta naplag ka lapu ed inkauges mo.

Alaen yo ed sikayo so saray salita, et ompawil kayo ed Katawan: ikuan yo ed sikato, Ekalen mo ya amin so inkauges, tan awaten mo so maong; dia ed ontan yapay mi naani a singa saray baka a kalakian so bagat na saray bibil mi.

Ag kami naani nilaban na Asiria; agkami naani onkabayo ed saray kabayo; et agmi met la naani salitaen so saray gawa na saray lima mi, Sikayo so saray dirios mi: ta dia ed sika say ulila makaromog na panangasi.
Tambalen ko naani so inka manangibeneg da, aroen ko ra naani a mabolbolos; ta say sanok ko naekal la ed sikato.
Siak singaak naani linaew ed Israel; sikato manbolaklak naani a singa lirio, et ikayat to naani so saray lamut to a singa say Libano.
Saray sanga to mansalompapak ira naani, et say kalimgasan to singa
Saray manaayam ed silong na sirum to ompawil ira naani, sikara naani napabilay a singa say bukel, tan manbolaklak ira naani a singa say uvas; say balingit to naani singa say alak na Libano.
Say Efraim kuanto naani, Anto ta ni so pibiangan ko ed saray talintao? Inmebatak, et sikato naani nengnengen ko: singaak sakey a malangbot a kiew a saleng; manlapu ed siak naromog naani so bungam.

Siopa so makabat a makatalos na saraya a bengatla? makalakal, pian naamtaan to ra? ta saray dalan nen Katawan sikara so maptek, tan saray matunong manakar ira naani ed sikara; balet saray masusumpa napelag ira naani ed sikara.
Say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed Joel ya anak a laki nen Fatuel.
Denglen yo so saya, sikayo a mamasiken, tan talinengen yo, sikayo ya amin a manaayam ed dalin. Wala ta so saya nen saman ed saray agew yo, odino ed saray agew na saray atateng yo?
Ibaga yo ed saray anak yo, tan saray anak yo ibaga ra komon ed saray anak da, tan saray anak da ed sananey a kailalakan.
Say inkera na dangew kinan na duron; et say inkera na duron kinan na lukton; et say inkera na lukton kinan na antataro.
Liing kayo, sikayon managbuek, tan mannangis kayo; et managogol kayo, sikayo ya amin ya omiinum na alak, lapu ed masamit ya alak; ta sikato so nisian ed sangi yo.
Ta sakey a nacion so tinmatdang ed dalin ko, mabiskeg, tan ag ira nabilang; saray ngipen to sikara so ngipen na sakey a leon, tan wala ed sikato so saray pangal na sakey a leon a kabatyan.
Binuybuyak to so uvas ko, inobakan to so kiew ko ya higos: sikato so ginawa to ya inubakan a sigpot, tan inbantak to; saray sanga to agawa ra ya amputi.
Mannangis ka a singa sakey a virgen ya abalkesan na abel a magaspang a nipaakar ed asawa a laki na inkaugaw to.
Say bagat a tapong tan say bagat a nainum nisian ira ed abung nen Katawan; saray sacerdote, a mankatangbayan ed Katawan, manermen.
Say uma mankibalatar, say dalin maningel; ta say bukel nadederal, say balo ya alak namagaan, say larak ondaiset.
Nagolo kayo komon, O sikayo a domaralus; managogol kayo, O sikayo manbabantay na uvasan, lapu ed trigo tan cebada; ta say anien ed dalin nabalang.

Say sengeg na uvas amagaan, tan say kiew na higos ombeleng; say kiew na granada, say kiew na palma ontan met, tan say kiew na manzana, saray amin a kiew ni ed uma amagaan ira; ta say liket nalnes ed saray anak na saray totoo.

Manbalkes kayo na abel a magaspang, tan maney-ey kayo, sikayo a sacerdote; managogol kayo, sikayo a mankatangbayan ed altar; dagokayo, ondokol kayo a mansanlabi ed abel a magaspang, sikayo a mankatangbayan ed Dios ko; ta say bagat a tapong tan say bagat a nainum nisiblet ira ed abung na Dios yo.
Mamasantos kayo na sakey a panayunal, manawag kayo na sakey a mabinta a tipon, tiponen yo so saray mamasiken tan amin a manaayam ed dalin ed abung nen Katawan a Dios yo, et tawagan yo si Katawan.
Kawaen la so agew! ta asinger la so agew nen Katawan, et onsabi naani a singa kabagbag a manlapu ed Makapanyarin amin.
Aliwa ta a say tagano naekal ed arap na saray mata yo, on, say liket tan gayaga ed abung na Dios tayo?
Saray bukel nabolok ira ed lepsag na saray bingkol da; saray kamalir nageba, ra, saray selwagan naderal ira; ta say bokel amagaan.
Agay la ya engak na saray ayep! saray polok na baka nagolo ra, ta angapo so pankabkaban da; on, saray polok na saray carnero nataytayak ira.
O Katawan, dia ed sika mantagleeyak; ta say apuy kinan to so saray panpakabkaban ed kalawakan, tan say dalang pinoolan to so saray amin a kiew ed uma.
On, saray ayep ed uma manengak ira ed sika; ta saray kolos na danum nakatan ira, tan say apuy kinan to so saray panagpakabkaban ed kalawakan.

Paknolen yo so tamboyog dia ed Sion, paknolen yo so sakey a panning dia ed masanto a palandey ko; onmayegmeg komon so saray amin a manaayam ed dalin; ta say agew nen Katawan onsabi, ta wala ed asinger la;

Sakey ya agew na udiem tan kabilungtan, sakey ya agew na saray lurem tan makapal a bilunget, a singa say panbalatabat ya onkayat ed tapew na saray palandey; sakey a baley a baleg tan mabiskeg; angan kapigan angapo so mipara, angapo met la naani angan kayari ra, angan saray taon na dakerakel a kailalakan.

Sakey ya apuy so mangakmon ed arap da; tan dia ed beneg da sakey a dalang so mamool; say dalin singa say tanamanan na Eden ed arap da, tan ed beneg da sakey ya abagbag a kalawakan; on, et angapo so makatainan ed sikara.
Say nengneng da singa néngneng na saray kabayo; tan singa totoo a mangabkabayo, ontan so pambabtik da.

Singa say ongol na saray luganan ed saray tapew na palpalandey ontan so pankogtot da; singa say danoldol na sakey dalang na apuy a mangakmon na dayami, singa sakey a mabayani a baley a naoksoy nipaakar ed bakal.
Dia ed arap da, saray balbaley wala ra ed kairapan; saray amin a lupa omposisaw ira.
Ombatik ira a singa mabaybayani a lalaki; kalaben da so bakor a singa totoo a mibabakal; et manakar so balang sakey ed sikara ed dalan to; et agda deralen so dasig da.
Ag ira met mantotoldonan; manakar ira balang sakey ed basbas to; et napelag ira ed saray kampilan, et ag nabuyak so inkadasig da.
Onlokso ra ed tapew na ciudad; ombatik ira ed tapew na bakor; onsegep ira ed saray kaabungan; onloob ira ed saray dorongawen a singa matakew.
Onyegyeg so dalin ed arap da; saray tawen ongiwgiw ira; say banwa tan say bulan ombilunget ira, tan saray bitewen ikibot da so sinag da.

Et si Katawan ibesngaw to so voces to ed arap na inayuraan to; ta say pakalso to sankabalgan: ta sikato mabiskeg a manumpal na salita to; ta say agew nen Katawan sikato so baleg tan makapataktakot a toloy; et siopa so makakpel?
Angan natan ni, kuan nen Katawan, ómpawil kayo ed siak, ed simoon a puso yo, tan tekep na panayunal, tan pannangis, tan paningel:

Et Mesmesen yo so puso yo, ya aliwa a saray kawes yo, ompawil kayo ed Katawan a Dios yo; ta sikato mapalangkap tan mapangasi, matantan a manpasnok, tan daakan ed maaro ya abig na linawa, et sikato ibabawi to so mauges.
Siopa so mikabat no sikato ag naani ompawil tan magbabawi, tan mangitilak na sakey a bendicion ed beneg to, angan sakey ni a bagat tan sakey a bagat a nainum a nipaakar ed Katawan a Dios yo?
Paknolen yo so tamboyog dia ed Zion, pasantosen yo so panayunal, manawag kayo na sakey mabinta a tipon:
Tiponen yo so saray totoo, pasantosen yo so tipon yo so saray mamasiken, pandaragupen yo so saray ugugaw, tan saray mansoso; ompaway komon so novio ed silir to, tan say novia ed silir to.

Saray sacerdote, a mankatangbayan nen Katawan mannangis ira komon ed nanleetan na sasabien tan say altar, tan ikuan da komon, Ilegyas mo so baley mo, O Katawan, tan agmo yaboloy a nibabaing so tawir mo, pian saray nacion manuley ira ed sikara: akin ta no ikuan to komon ed saray balbaley, Iner so kawalaan na Dios da?
Saman la si Katawan maimon lapu ed dalin to, tan wala so panangasi to ed baley to.

Et si Katawan inmebat tan inkuan to ed baley to, Nia ipawit ko naani ed sikayo so bukel, tan balo ya alak, tan larak, et napera kayo naáni ed sikara; et agak la naani mangawa ed sikayo na sakey a kibabaingan ed saray nacion;

No ag ingen yarawik naani ed sikayo so akinamianen ya inayuraan, et sikato naani paarapen ko ed sakey a dalin ya amaga tan apalis, say kamanuna to anga ed dayat ya dapitbokig, et say kamanonor anga ed dayat ya dapitsagur: et say banget to onsengaw naani, et say ambanget ya angob to ontagey naani, ta nangawa na ankakabaleg a bengatla.
Agka antakot, O dalin, manliket tan mangayaga ka; ta si Katawan nangawa na ankakabaleg a bengatla.
Agkayo antakot, sikayo ay-ayep ed uma; ta saray panagkabkaban ed kalawakan onlambot ira, ta say kiew manbunga, say kiew na higos tan uvas papawayen da so biskeg da.

Manliket kayo sirin, sikayo anak na Sion, tan mangayaga kayo ed Katawan a Dios yo; ta sikato iter to ed sikayo so masakbay ya uran ed nagnap a sukat, tan papelagen to ed sikayo so uran, say masakbay tan onor ya uran, ed ununa a bulan.
Et saray panagisimpenan napano ra naani na trigo, tan saray samang manlepuas ira naani ed balo ya alak tan larak.
Et ipawil ko naani ed sikayo so saray taon a kinan na duron, lukton, tan say antataro tan say dangew, say baleg ya inayuraan ko ya inbakik ed sikayo.

Et mangan kayo naani na daakan tan napesel kayo naani, et igalgalang yo naani so ngaran nen Katawan a Dios yo, a sikato so nangawa na makapakelaw ed sikayo; et say baley ko ag la naani nibabaing angan kapigan.
Et naamtaan yo naani a siak walaak dia ed pegley na Israel, tan siak si Katawan a Dios yo, ya angapo la so arum; et say baley ko angan kapigan ag la nibabaing.

Et nagawa naani ed kayari to, ya ikalbok naani so Espirituk ed amin a laman; et saray anak yo a lalaki tan bibii manprofeta ra naani, saray mamasiken yo mankogkogip ira naani na saray kogkogip; saray tobonbalo yo a lalaki makanengneng ira naani na saray pasingawey:
Tan ontan met ed saray ariripen a lalaki tan bibii dia ed saratan ya agew ikalbok naani so Espirituk.
Et ipatnag ko naani so saray pankelkelawan ed saray tawen tan ed dalin; dala, tan apuy, tan sekseklang ya asewek.
Say banwa magmaliw naani ya ambilunget, tan say bulan dala, arapen na isabi na baleg tan makapataktakot ya agew nen Katawan.

Et nagawa naani, ya angan siopa ya ontawag ed ngaran nen Katawan; nilaban naani; ta dia ed palandey na Sion tan dia ed Jerusalem wala ra naani so saray makatainan, singa sinalita nen Katawan, et dia ed saray natilak wala naani so saray tawagen nen Katawan.
Ta, nia, dia ed saratan ya agew, tan dia ed satan a panaon, a pangipawil ko na inkadakep na Juda tan Jerusalem,

Pandaragupen ko naani so saray amin a nacion, et palasuren ko ra naani ed lawak na Josafat; et diman gawaen ko naani so pangokom ed sikara lapu ed baley ko tan pantawiren ko ya Israel, a sikara so intayak da ed saray nacion; et inapagapag da so dalin ko.
Tan nanpapalaranan da so baley ko, tan insalat da so sakey ya ugaw a laki ed sakey a balangkantis, tan inlako ra so sakey ya ugaw a bii ed alak, pian makainum ira.

On, et sikayo anto kayo ed siak, O Tiro, tan Sidon, tan amin a ketegan na Filistia? Labay yo so ombales ed siak? Et no ombales kayo ed siak, masigsiglat tan magangano ak a mangipawil ed sikayo na tumang yo ed tapew na saray olo yo lanlamang.
Lapu ed inala yo so pilak ko tan say balitok ko, tan inyakar yo ed saray templo yo so saray marakep a mablik a bengabengatla.
Tan inlako yo so saray anak na Juda tan saray anak na Jerusalem. ed saray anak na saray Griego, pian niyarawi yo ra ed saray ketegan da;
Nia, ipaalagey ko ra naani a papawayen ed pasen ya angilakoan yo ed sikara; et ipawil ko naani so tumang yo ed tapew na saray olo yo lanlamang;
Et ilakok naani so saray anak yo a lalaki tan bibii ed lima na saray anak na Juda, tan sikara naani ilako ra ed saray lalaki na Saba, ed sakey a nacion ya arawi; ta sikato so sinalita nen Katawan.
Ibawag yo so saya ed saray nacion; iparaan yo so bakal; liingen yo so saray mabayani a lalaki: amin so saray lalaki a mibabakal onasinger ira komon, ondago ra komon.
Pitpiten yo so tarem na saray lokoy yo a gawaen a kampilan, tan saray kalawit yo a gayagayang: saray makapuy ikuan da komon, Mabiskegak.
Manganat kayo, et dago kayo, sikayo ya amin a nacion ed liberliber, tan mandaragup kayo: diman palasoren mo so saray mabayanim, O Katawan.
Saray nacion onliing ira komon, tan ontatdang ira ed lawak na Josafat; ta diman onyorongak naani a mangokom ed saray amin a nacion ed liberliber.
Yan yo so kompay; ta say anien aloto la: dago kayo, ongatin-gatin kayo; ta say panagpespesan na alak napno, saray samang manlepwas ira; ta say inkauges da sikato so baleg.
Dakerakel, dakerakel a totoo dia ed lawak na panangigeter! ta say agew nen Katawan sikato so asinger ed lawak na panangigeter.
Say banwa tan say bulan onkuyep ira, tan saray bitewen isiblet da so pansinag da.

Et si Katawan manongol naani a manlapu ed Sion, tan ibesngaw to naani so voces to a manlapu ed Jerusalem; et saray tawen tan say dalin onyegyeg ira naani: balet si Katawan sikato naani so apireng na baley to, tan salimbeng ed, saray anak na Israel.

Dia ed ontan naamtaan yo naani a siak si Katawan a Dios yo, a manayamak dia ed Sion a masanto a palandey ko: diad ontan say Jerusalem masantos naani tan angapo la so saray sankaili ya onlabas ed sikato.

Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, a saray palandey mantedter ira naani na masamit ya alak, tan saray pokdol panagusen da naani so gatas, tan saray amin a kolos na Juda panagusan ira naani na danum: et ompaway naani so sakey a sobol ed abung nen Katawan, et salogen to naani so lawak na Sitim.
Say Egipto sakey naani a mankibalatar, tan say, Edom sakey naani a mankibalatar a kalawakan, lapu ed duksa ya agawa ed saray anak na Juda, ta amaterter, ira na maalas a dala ed dalin da.
Balet say Juda mansiansia naani lawas, tan say Jerusalem manlapu ed kailalakan anga ed kailalakan.
Et linisan ko naani so dala ra, ya agko ni nilinisan: ta si Katawan manayam dia ed Sion.

Saray salita nen Amos, a sikato so wala nen saman ed saray pastol ed Tekoa, a sikato so akanengneng nipaakar ed Israel dia ed saray agew nen Uzias ari ed Juda, tan dia ed saray agew nen Jeroboam ya anak a laki nen Joás ari ed Israel duara a taon ed arapen na yegyeg.

Et inkuan to, Si Katawan manongol naani a manlapu ed Sion, tan ibesngaw to naani so voces to a manlapu ed Jerusalem; et saray panagpakabkaban na saray pastol maningel ira naani, tan onmaga naani so toktok na Carmelo.
Qnia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Damasco, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naani ilegyas so dusa to; lapu ed inilik da so Galaad ed saray panilik a balatyang.
Balet payakar ko naani so sakey ya apuy ed abung nen Hazael, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio na Ben-adad.

Et puteren ko naani so balewet na Damasco, tan pegpegen ko naani so manaayam ed lawak na Aven, tan say manegna na cetro ed abung na Eden; tan say baley na Siria nadakep naani dia ed Kir, kuan nen Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Gaza, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naaai ilegyas so dusa to; ta dinakep da so amin ya ombaley a yawat ed Edom.
Balet payakar ko naani so sakey ya apuy ed bakor na Gaza, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio to.
Et pegpegen ko naani so manaayam ed Azoto, tan say manegna na cetro ed Ascalon; et sumpak naani so limak ed Ecron, et saray kera ed saray Filisteo nabalang ira naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Tiro, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naani ilegyas so dusa to; lapu ed inyawat da so amin ya ombaley ed Edom, et agda ninonot so sipan na inpanaagi.
Balet payakar ko naani so sakey ya apuy ed bakor na Tiro, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio to.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Edom, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naani ilegyas so dusa to; ta inosilan to so agi to ed kampilan; et inkaindan to so amin a panangasi, tan say sanok to amairap á naynay, tan inyatol to so petang to lawas.
Balet payakar to naani so sakey ya apuy ed Teman, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio na Bozra.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na saray anak nen Ammon, on, lapu ed saray apatira agko naani ilegyas so dusa to; ta binutiakan da so saray bibii a malokon a taga Galaad, pian onawang so sakopen da.
Balet mamarlangak naani na sakey ya apuy dia ed bakor na Rabba, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio to, pati paneyag dia ed agew na bakal, pati bagyo dia ed agew na alimbosabos;
Et say ari ra nadakep naani, sikato tan saray principe to ya amin, kuan nen Katawan.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Moab, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naani ilegyas so dusa to; ta pinoolan to so saray pukel na ari na Idumea anga ed dinmena ra.
Et payakar ko naani so sakey ya apuy ed Moab, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio na Criot; et ompatey naani so Moab ed gologolo, ed eyag, tan ed tanol na tamboyog.
Et ekalen ko naani so okom a manlapu ed pegley to, et pateyen ko naani pati ed sikato so saray principe to, kuan nen Katawan.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Juda, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naani ilegyas so dusa to; lapu ed inbeneg to so tunong nen Katawan, tan agto inonor so saray panontonan to, tan saray tila ra ginawa to ra a nalingo, a dia ed beneg da nanakar so saray atateng da.
Balet payakar ko naani so sakey ya apuy ed Juda, et akmonen to naani so saray palacio na Jerusalem.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Lapu ed talora ya inpakasumlang na Israel, on, lapu ed apatira, agko naani ilegyas so dusa to, lapu ed inlako ra ed pilak so too a matunong, tan say duka ed sankatupag a sapin.

Sikara a manpilalek ya wala komon so dabok na dalin ed tapew na olo na saray duruka, tan pikeweten da so dalan na saray maoyamo: tan sakey a laki pati si ama to nanpadpara ra a linmoob ed sakey lanlamang a marikit, pian dumsisan da so masanto á ngaran ko:
Et ondokol ira ed abay na balang sakey ya altar ed tapew na saray kawes a nisanla: tan oninum ira ed abung na Dios na alak na saray dinusa.

Balet binagbag ko so Amorreo ed arap da, a say katagey to singa say katagey na saray cedro, tan masekder a singa saray roble; angan ontan binagbag ko so bunga to ed tagey, tan saray lamut to ed lepsag.
Et ontan met siak inagwat takayo ed dalin na Egipto, tan inyakar takayo ed kalawakan ed apataplo a taon, pian kayarianen yo so dalin na Amorreo.
Et pinaalagey ko so saray atateng yo a lalaki a manprofeta, tan saray tobonbalo yo a lalaki pian magmaliw ira a Nazareo. Aliwa ta ya ontan lanlamang, sikayo anak ira na Israel? kuan nen Katawan.
Balet angiter kayo na alak ed saray Nasareo pian oninom ira, tan ingangan yo ed saray profeta, a kuan yo, Agkayo manprofeta.
Nengnengen yo, siak imegmeg takayo naani ed pasen yo, singa pangimegmeg na luganan a napno ed saray binedber.
Et say kababatik natawtaw naani a manlapu ed marlas: et say mabiskeg ag la naani makabiskeg, tan angan say mabayani agto naani nilaban so inkasikato lanlamang;
Et say mangegna na bekang ag naani makatalindeg, tan ag met makaokpos so marlas ya ombatik; angan say mangabkabayo ed kabayo agto naani nilaban so inkasikato lanlamang;
Et say makpel ed saray makapanyari ontainan naani a lakseb dia ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan.
Denglen yo so saya a salita a si Katawan sinalita to sumpa ed sikayo, O anak ira na Israel, sumpa ed amin a kabaley a sikato so inagwat ko a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto, ya inkuan to,
Sikayo lambengat so naamtaan ko ed saray amin a kabaley ed dalin: kanian dalawen ko naani ed sikayo so amin ya inkauges yo.
Manakar ta naani so duara a manbansag, no ag ira nannonong?
Manengak ta naani so leon ed takel no angapo so nasibar to? Manongol ta so kilaw a leon ed ongib to, no angapo so narel to?
Nakalotan ta so manok ed saray tawen no angapo so patit á niparaan ed sikato ed tapew na dalin? Nipaatagey ta ed dalin so kalot no angapo so nakalotan?
Napaknol ta so tamboyog ed ciudad et ag naani ontakot so baley? Wala ta naani kairapan ed ciudad ya ag ginawa nen Katawan?
Petepeteg angapo naani gawaen nen Katawan a Dios, ya ag naani nipuyan so inamot to ed saray aripen to a profeta.
Inmengak so leon; siopa so ag antakot? si Katawan a Dios nansalita; siopa naani so ag manprofeta.

Ibawag yo ed saray palacio dia ed Azoto, tan dia ed saray palacio ed dalin na Egipto, et kuan yo, Mantitipon kayo ed saray palandey na Samaria, tan nengnengen yo so saray ankabaleg a gologolo ya waladman, tan amin a kairapan ya wala ed pegley da.
Ta agda amta so mangawa na maong, kuan nen Katawan, sikara a mantipon na panamairap tan panagtakew ed saray palacio ra.
Kanian si Katawan a Dios onia so kuan to: Sakey a kabosol so wala naani, angan ed liberliber na dalin; et igeba to naani so biskeg mo tan saray palaciom nasamsaman ira naani.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Unong a say pastol samsamen to a manlapu ed sangi na leon so duara ya ulpo, odino sakey a kaaruman na sakey a layag, ontan naani so kilaban na saray anak na Israel a manyorong ed Samaria ed suyok na dokolan da, tan ed saray sutla a tandakan na dokolan.
Dengel kayo, tan mantasi kayo sumpa ed abung nen Jacob, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, say Dios na saray ejercito.
Ta dia ed agew a dalawen ko naani so saray inpakasumlang na Israel, dalawen ko met so saray altar na Betel; et saray saklor na altar naputer ira naani, tan napelag ira naani ed dalin.

Et kabilen ko naani so abung a panayaman da ed panaon na betel pati abung a panayaman da ed panaon na tiagew; et saray abung a garing natawtaw ira naani, tan saray ankabaleg ya abung walaan ira naani na kasumpalan, kuan nen Katawan.
