Denglen yo so saya a salita, sikayo ed bakbaka ed Basan, ya wala kayo ed palandey na Samaria, ya aposan yo so duka, pairapen yo so naokolan, a kuan yo ed saray kakatawan, Yakar yo dia, tan oninom itayo.
Si Katawan a Dios sinambaan to ed panamegley na inkasanto to, ya nia, saray agew onsabi ra naani ed sikayo, ya alaen da kayo naani ed saray kalawit, tan saray kera ed sikayo ed saray banwit.
Et ompaway kayo naani ed saray butaw, balang sakey a mapmaptek ed arap to; et ontaboy kayo naani ed atagey a pasen, kuan nen Katawan.
Onia kayo ed Betel, tan onsumlang kayo; ed Galgal, tan parakelen yo so kasosumlang yo; et yakar yo ray bagat yo a kinabuasan, tan saray kakaplo yo balang komatlo ya agew:

Et yapay yo so sakey a bagat a pisasalamat ed satan ya alebagan, tan ibawag yo ray bagat a mabolbolos a linawa tan ibawag yo ra: ta saya makapaliket ed sikayo, O sikayo anak ira na Israel, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.

Tan siak met initer ko ed sikayo so kalinis na saray ngipen yo dia ed saray amin a ciudad yo, tan kakulangan na tinapay dia ed saray amin a pasen yo; angan ontan agkayo pinmawil ed siak, kuan nen Katawan.

Tan siak met pinokpokan ko so uran ed sikayo, sanen wala ni taloy bulan anga ed panagani; tan pinauran ko ed sakey a ciudad, tan agko pinauran ed sananey a ciudad: sakey a gaton so nauran, tan dia ed gaton ya ag nauran minmaga.
Dia ed ontan duara odino talora a ciudad inmalis ira ed sakey a ciudad ya oninom na danum, et ag ira napda: angan ontan agkayo pinmawil ed siak, kuan nen Katawan.

Siak kinabil takayo na kebet tan boot: say karaklan na saray tanamanan yo tan saray uvasan yo tan saray higos yo tan saray kiew yo ya oliva kinan ira na doron: angan ontan agkayo pinmawil ed siak, kuan nen Katawan.

Impayakar ko ed sikayo so salot a singa nen saman ed Egipto; pinatey ko ed kampilan so saray tobonbalo a lalaki yo, tan dinakep ko so saray kabayo yo; et inkayat ko so banget ed pakalso yo anga ed abut na saray eleng yo; angan ontan agkayo pinmawil ed siak, kuan nen Katawan.

Dineral ko so saray ciudad ed sikayo, singa sanen dineral na Dios so Sodoma, tan Gomorra, et nagmaliw kayo a singa ngapus a nibantak ed panagpool: angan ontan agkayo pinmawil ed siak kuan nen Katawan.
Kanian onia so gawaen ko naani ed sikayo, O Israel; et lapu ed gawaen ko naani ed sika, manparaan ka ya onabet ed Dios mo, O Israel.

Ta, nia, say mangawa ed saray palandey, tan palsaen to so dagem, tan ipaliwawa to ed too no anto so nonot to: say mamabilunget na kabuasan, tan say ongatin ed atagey a pasen na dalin si Katawan a Dios na saray ejercito sikato so ngaran to.
Denglen yo so saya a salita a sikato so yakis ko a nipaakar a tagleey ed sikayo, O abung na Israel.
Say virgen na Israel naplag; ag la naani onalagey: nipasag ed dalin to; angapo so mamaalagey ed sikato.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios: Say ciudad a pinmaway a sanlibo walaan naani na sanlasus a nakeraan, say ciudad a pinmaway a sanlasus walaan naani na samplora a nakeraan, et abung na Israel.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan ed abung na Israel, Anap yoak, et manbilay kayo naani;
Balet agyo anapen so Betel, tan agkayo met onloob ed Galgal, tan agkayo met onla ed Beer-seba: ta say Galgal ag onlaron a napelag naani ed kadakep tan say Betel naandi naani.
Anap yo si Katawan, et manbilay kayo naani; ompan lamang sikato ontolapok a singa apuy ed abung nen Jose, et opoten to, tan angapo ed Betel so makaerep.
Sikayo a pagmaliwen yo ya ajenjo so kaptekan, tan ibantak yo ed dalin so inkatunong.

Sikato so anapen yo so mangawa na Pleyades tan say Orion, tan pagmaliwen to so anino na patey a kabuasan, tan pabilungeten to so agew a singa labi; manawag na saray danum ed dayat, insan to ikalbo ed tapew na dalin (Katawan so ngaran to);
A yakar to a bigla so kaderal ed saray mabiskeg, pian say kabagbag nagawa ed saray salimbeng.
Sikara gulaen da so mamaat ed wangalan, tan sikara busolen da so mansalita a situtunong.

Kanian sirin igatin-gatin yo so duka, tan pasooten yo ya alaen ed sikato so trigo: angipaalagey kayo na saray abung a binato, balet agyora naani panayaman; nantanem kayo na makapalikliket ya uvas, balet agkayo naani oninum na alak da.

Ta amtak so saray dakerakel ya inpakasumlang yo, tan saray ambelat a kasalanan yo sikayo a mamaermen ed saray maptek, ya alaen yo so panoksok, tan isipa yo so saray naokolan dia ed wangalan a manlapu ed matunong da.
Kanian say makalakal manmemet naani dia ed ontan a panaon; ta sikato so mauges a panaon.
Anap yo so maong, ya aliwa a say mauges, pian manbilay kayo; et dia ed ontan si Katawan, a Dios na saray ejercito, wala naani ed sikayo, unong na kuan yo.
Gulaen yo so mauges, tan aroen yo so maong, tan iletneg yo so inkatunong ed wangalan; si Katawan, a Dios na saray ejercito, lagi ta sikato naani manangasi ed nakeraan ed Jose.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan, a Dios na saray ejercito, say Katawan: Panagogol so wala naani dia ed saray amin a maawang a dalan; et ikuan da naani dia ed saray amin a polong. A! ay! tan tawagen da so dumaralos a maningel, tan saray marunong ed tagleey pian managogol ira.
Et dia ed saray amin ya uvasan wala naani panagogol; ta onlabasak naani ed pegley mo, kuan nen Katawan.
Abagey kayo la, sikayo a manpilalek na agew nen Katawan! Akin et panpilalekan yo so agew nen Katawan? Sikato so bilunget, et aliwan liwawa.
Singa no say sakey a too ombatik a manlapu ed sakey a leon, et naabet to so oso; odino linmoob ed abung et intapew to so lima to ed bakor, et kinalat na uleg.
Aliwa ta a bilunget so agew nen Katawan, et aliwa a liwawa? ya ambilunget a maomaong, ya angapo so sinag ed sikato?
Gulaen ko, modmoraen ko so saray liket yo, et aliwa ra naani a makapaliket ed siak so saray mabinta a tipon yo.
On, angan yapay yo ed siak so saray bagat yo a napoolan, tan saray bagat yo a tapong, agko ra naani awaten; et agko met naani lingawen so saray bagat yo ed pipapakna ed saray mataba ya ay-ayep yo.
Yarawim ed siak so voces na saray cantam; ta agko naani denglen so saray masasamit a tanol na saray gerager yo.
Balet onagus komon so inkatunong a singa saray danum, tan say kaptekan a singa mabiskeg' ya ilog.
Inyapay yo ta ed siak so saray bagat yo tan patanir dia ed kalawakan ed apataplo a taon, O abung na Israel?
On, inawit yo so tabernakulo na ari yo tan say melag a templo na saray talintao yo, say bitewen na dibs yo, a ginawa yo a nipaakar ed sika yo lanlamang.
Yakar takayo sirin naani ed kadakep ed biek na Damasco, kuan nen Katawan, a say ngaran to sikato so Dios na saray ejercito.
Kasi lara so saray manaayam a mankanawnawa ed Sion, tan saray maligeligen ed palandey na Samaria, saray angkabli a totoo ed manonaan na saray nacion, a sikato so laen na abung na Israel!

Onla kayo ed Calne, et nengnengen yo; et manlapud'man onla kayo ed Emat a baleg, insan onla kayo ed Get a panagayaman na saray Filisteo: magmaong tara nen saraya a panarian? odino say ketegan da magmaawang ta nen say ketegan yo?
Sikayo ya yarawi yo so agew a mauges, et yasinger yo so pasen na panamasoot;
Ya ondokol ira ed saray dokolan a garing, tan ononat ira ed tapew na saray tandakan, tan siraen da ray cordero na polok, tan saray kilaw na baka a manlapu ed pegley na panangipokokan;
A mankanta ra na saray tagaumen ed bansag na tanol na gerager; a mamapaway ira nipaakar ed sikara lanlamang na saray kagawaan ed togtog, singa si David;
Ya oninom ira na alak ed saray yaong, tan manpoyok ira lanlamang ed saray angkabli a larak; balet ag ira manermen lapu ed kairapan nen Jose.
Kanian niolop ira ed saray ununa a nadakep, tan naekal la naani so alabas a panliket na saray manuunat.

Si Katawan a Dios sinambaan to ed sikato lanlamang, kuan nen Katawan a Dios na saray ejercito: Gulaen ko so kaatageyan nen Jacob, tan kagulak so saray palacio to; kanian yawat ko naani so ciudad tan amin ya wala ed sikato.
Et nagawa naani, no wala so samploran totoo a natilac ed sakey ya abung, a sikara ompatey ira.

Et sano say pangamaen na sakey a too sikato so alaen to, salanti say mamool ed sikato, pian ipaway to so saray pukel to a manlapu ed abung, tan ikuan to ed kaaralman a pasen na abung, wala ni angan siopa ed sika? et inkuan to; Angapo. Diad ontan inkuan to, Manmemet ka; ta agtayo oliten so ngaran nen Katawan.
Ta, nia, si Katawan igangan to, et say baleg ya abung nakabil naani; ed saray aboabot, tan say melag ya abung ed saray betag.
Ombatik ta ra naani so saray kabayo ed tapew na bato? panbaka naani tad' man so saray baka? bangta inpagmaliw yo ya apgo so inkatunong, tan Say bunga na kaptekan impagmaliw yo ya ajenjo;
Sikayo a manliket ed andi kakanaan, a kuan yo, Ag mi ta inala so saray saklor ed dili a biskeg mi?

Ta nengnengen yo, Yacar ko naani so nacion a sumpa ed sikayo, O abung na Israel, kuan nen Katawan, a Dios na saray ejercito; et panermenen da kayo naani a manlapu ed lolooban na Emat anga ed kolos na Arabah.

Onia so inpatnag nen Katawan a Dios ed siak: et, nia, amalesa na saray duron dia ed gapu ya onsulming so kaonoran ya tobo; et, nia, sikato nen saman so kaonoran ya tobo kayari na saray panagani na ari.
Et agawa a sanen naopot da a kinan so dika na dalin, et inkuanko, O Katawan a Dios, perdonaen mo, kerewen ko ed sika: Panon naani so yaalagey nen Jacob? lapu ed sikato so melag.
Si Katawan nagbabawi a nipaakar ed saya: Sikato so aliwa naani, kuan nen Katawan.
Onia so inpatnag nen Katawan a Dios ed siak: et, nia, si Katawan a Dios tinmawag a misangsangan ed panamegley na apuy; say apuy inakmon to so baleg a kaaralman tan kinan to komon so dalin.
Saman la inkuan ko, O Katawan, ontonda ka, kerewen ko ed sika: panon so kakaalagey nen Jacob? ta sikato et melag.
Si Katawan nagbabawi nipaakar ed saya: Saya met aliwa naani, kuan nen Katawan a Dios.
Onia so inpatnag to ed siak: et, nia, say Katawan nanalagey ed abay na sakey a bakor a ginawa ed panamegley na ismay, pati sakey a bantawin ed lima to.

Et si Katawan inkuan to ed siak, Amos, anto so nanengneng mo? Et inkuan ko, Sakey a bantawin. Saman la inkuan na Katawan, Nia, mangyanak naani na sakey a bantawin ed pegley na baley ko ya Israel; agko lara naani labasan;
Et saray atagey a pasen nen Isaac nabagbag ira naani, et saray santuario na Israel nageba naani, et onalageyak naani ya akakampilan a sum pa ed abung nen Jeroboam.

Saman la si Amasias a sacerdote ed Betel, nanbaki ed Jeroboam ari na Israel, ya inkuan to, si Amos inmalagey ya ontunganga sumpa ed sika dia ed pegley na abung na Israel: say dalin agto nayarian ya itepel so saray amin a salita to.
Ta onia so kuan nen Amos, si Jeroboam ompatey naani ed kampilan, et say Israel ag onlaron nipaway naani ed baley to ya adakep.
Si Amasias inkuan to met ed Amos, O sika managnengneng, onla ka, ontainan ka ed dalin na Juda, tan kanenmod'man so tinapay, tan manprofetacad 'man
Balet agka la komon manprofeta ed Betel; ta sikato so kawalaan na santuario na ari, tan sikato so abung na maari.

Saman la inmebat si Amos, tan inkuan to ed Amasias, Siac aliwaak nen saman na profeta, tan aliwaak met ya anak na profeta, no ag ingen bantayak nen saman na polok, tan manaalila ed saray kiew a sikomoro.
Ed si Katawan insian toak ed katotombok ed polok, et si Katawan inkuan to ed siak, Onla ka, manprofeta ka ed baley ko ya Israel.
Natan sirin denglen mo so salita nen Katawan; Kuan mo, agka manprofeta na sumpa ed Israel, tan agka met mansalita na sumpa ed abung nen Isaac;

Kanian, onia so kuan nen Katawan: Say asawam balangkantis naani ed ciudad, et saray anak mo a lalaki tan bibii nipasag ira naani ed kampilan, tan say dalin mo panaapagan da naani ed panamegley na lubir, et sika lanlamang ompatey ka naani ed dalin ya ag malinis, tan say Israel ag onlaron a napatainan naani ed baley to a nadakep.
Onia so inpatnag nen Katawan a Dios ed siak: et, nia, sakey a belyag a bunga na panaon a tiagew.

Et inkuan to, Anto so nanengneng mo, Amos? Et inyebat ko, Sakey a belyag a bunga ed panaon a tiagew. Saman la inkuan ed siak nen Katawan, Say angaan sikato so onsabi ed baley ko ya Israel; agak la naani onlabas lamet ed sikara.
Et saray canta ed templo sikara naani panagogol dia ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan a Dios: dakel naani ray bangkay; ibantak dara naani ya andi eseesel ed amin a pasen.
Denglen yo so saya, O sikayo a nonoten yo yaakmonen so naokolan, tan pasegsegangen yo ray duruka ed dalin,

A kuan yo, Kapigan so kayari na balon bulan, pian makapanlako kami na bukel? tan say sabaton, pian makapangipaway kami na trigo, a pamelagen mi so efa, tan pabelaten mi so siclo, tan mangawa kami a sititila ya agamilen so saray simbangan a masaol;
Pian nasaliw mi so duka ed pilak, tan saray naokolan ed sankatopag a sapin, tan ilako mi so taep na trigo?
Si Katawan sinambaan to so kitandoro nen Jacob, Petepeteg agko naani nalingoanan angan kapigan so angan anto ed saray gawa to.

Ag ta naani onkeyer so dalin lapu ed saya, tan amin a manaayam ed sikato mannangis? on, tan ontagey naani so dalin a singa sakey ya Ilog; et napairap naani tan nipaldeg naani a singa dia ed Ilog na Egipto.
Et nagawa naani ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, a paseleken ko naani so banwa ed pegley agew, tan pabilungeten ko naani so dalin ed agew a maliwawa.

Pagmaliwen ko naani so saray liket yo ya ermen, tan saray canta yo, ya agogol; yan ko naani ed saray banel yo so saray abel a magaspang, tan say panyangyang ed saray amin ya olo yo; et gawaen ko naani a singa panermenan na bogbogtong ya anak, tan say angaan to singa sakey ya agew ya ampait.
Nia, onsabi ray agew, kuan nen Katawan a Dios, ya payakar ko naani so eras ed dalin, aliwa ya eras ed tinapay, odino pega ed danum, no ag ingen pandengel ed saray salita nen Katawan.
Manteyengteyeng ira naani a manlapu ed dayat anga ed sananey a dayat, tan manlapu ed amianen anga ed bokig; ombatic ira naani a pawilpawil a mananap na salita nen Katawan, balet agda naani naromog.
Dia ed satan ya agew saray malimgas a virgen tan saray tobonbalo a lalaki napunaw ira naani ed pega.
Saray mansamba lapu ed kasalanan na Samaria, tan kuan da, Unong a mabilay so Dios mo, O Dan; tan unong a mabilay so dalan na Beer-seba; napelag ira naani, tan angan kapigan ag ira naani la ombangon.

Anengneng ko so Katawan ya wala a manal-alagey ed abay na altar, et inkuan to, kabilen mo so saray palatok na saray lusek, pian natenyeg so saray sasabien; et boyaken mo ra ed saray olo ra ya amin; et say nakeraan naani ed sikara pateyen ko naani ed kampilan; angapo naani so angan sakey ed sikara a makaliktar, tan angan sakey ed sikara agmakatainan.
Angan mankotkot nira anga ed Sheol, diman say limak sikara naani alaen to, tan angan onkalab nira ed tawen, manlapud'man sikara naani so ilasor ko.
Et angan onamot nira ed toktok na Carmelo, diman anapen ko ra naani tan alaen ko ra; tan angan onsanib ni ra ed siak ed dalem na dayat, diman igangan ko naani so uleg, tan mangalat naani ed sikara.

Et angan onla nira a padakep ed arap na saray kabosol da, diman igangan ko naani so kampilan, et sikato naani mamatey ed sikara: et inengneng ko naani ray matak ed sikara a kaugsan da, tan aliwa a nipaakar ed kaabigan.

Ta say Katawan, si Katawan na saray ejercito, sikato so maniwit na dalin, et sikato so natunaw, et onnangis naani so amin a manaayam ed sikato; et ontagey naani so amin a singa sakey ya Ilog, tan onlereg lamet naani a singa say Ilog na Egipto;

Sikato ipaalagey to so saray silirto ed saray tawen, tan ginawa to so tawen to ed tapew na dalin; sikato tawagen to so saray danum na dayat, tan sikara so ikalbo to ed tapew na dalin; Katawan sikato so ngaran to.

Aliwa kayo ta a singa saray anak na saray Etiope ed siak, O anak ira na Israel? kuan nen Katawan. Agko ta inagwat so Israel a nanlapu ed dalin na Egipto, tan saray Filisteo a nanlapu ed Cafter, tan saray Sirio a nanlapu ed Kir?

Nia, saray mata nen Katawan a Dios wala ed panarian a managkasalanan tan sikato so bagbagen ko naani a manlapu ed tapew na dalin; balet agko naani bagbagen ya amin so abung nen Jacob, kuan nen Katawan.

Ta, nia, igangan ko naani, et say abung na Israel yakayaken ko naani ed pegley na saray amin a nacion, a singa saray bukel nayakayak ed sakey a yakayakan, angan ontan ag naani napelag so sankabukel ed dalin.
Saray amin a makasalanan ed baley ko ompatey ira naani ed kampilan, a sikara so mankuan, Say mauges agto kami naani naabot odino naromog.
Dia ed satan ya agew paalageyen ko naani so tabernakulo nen David a naplag, tan puletan ko naani ray butaw to; et apigden ko naani so saray aderal, tan ipaalagey ko naani a singa nen inmuna:
Pian nakayarian da so kera ed Edom, tan amin so saray nacion a natawag unong ed ngaran ko, kuan nen Katawan a sikato so mangawa na saya.

Nia, onsabi so saray agew, kuan nen Katawan, a say manbabaka naabot to naani so manani, say mankames na uvas so manpasedser; et saray palandey itedter da naani so masamit ya alak, tan saray amin a pokdol natunaw ira naani.

Et ipawil ko naani so inkadakep na baley ko ya Israel, et sikara ipaalagey da naani so saray ciudad ya aderal, et panayaman da ra naani; et mantanem ira naani na saray uvas, et inumen da naani so alak na saray tanaman da: mangawa ra met na saray panagtanamanan, tan kanen da naani so saray bunga ra.
Et itanem ko ra naani ed saray dalin da, et angan kapigan ag ira nabagut la ed dalin ya initerko ed sikara, kuan nen Katawan a Dios mo.

Say pasingawey nen Abdias. Onia so kuan nen Katawan a Dios nipaakar ed Edom: Nadngelan mi balita a nanlapu ed Katawan, et sakey ya igagangan so nibaki ed saray nacion, ya inkuan to, Onalagey kayo, tan onalagey itayo komon a sumpa ed sikato ed bakal.
Nia, ginawa taka a melag ed saray nacion: namodmora ka a toloy.
Say kapangtaan na pusom pinalingo to ka, O sika a manaayam ed saray letak na saray bato, a say panagayaman to sikato so atagey; a kuan to dia ed puso to, Siopa so makapangyepas ed siak anga ed dalin?
Angan onsalipato ka ed tagey a singa say agila, tan angan say obong mo nipasen ed saray bitewen, siak yepas taka a manlapud'man, kuan nen Katawan.

No saray matakew linma ra ed sika, na saray tulisan ed labi, (Abagey la so kapegpeg mo!) ag ira ta mantakew lambengat anga ed napenek ira? No saray managbodbor na uvas onla ra ed sika, ag ira kasi mangitilak na uvas á natudtur?
Agay la so inkaosisa na saray bengatla nen Esau: Agay la so inkaalmo na saray inyamot a kayamanan to:

Saray amin a totoo ya akisiglaotan mo inyakar da ka ed dalan mo, salanti ed ketegan: saray totoo ya wala ed kareenan ed sika pinalingo ra ka, tinmalona ra a sumpa ed sika; saray mangan na tinapay mo angipasen ira na kalot ed lepsag mo: angapo so pakatalos ed sikato.
Agko ta naani, ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan, bagbagen so saray makabat a totoo a manlapu ed Edom, tan say pakatalos a manlapu ed palandey nen Esau?
Et saray makapanyari a lalakim, O Teman, napunaw ira naani, ed kasampotan a balang sakey napegpeg a manlapu ed palandey nen Esau lapu ed panagpatey.
Lapu ed duksa ya agawa ed agim a Jacob, say baing so onsakbong naani ed sika, et sika napegpegka naani lawas.

Dia ed agew ya inpanalagey mo ed sakey a diking, dia ed agew a saray sankaili intarok da so kayamanan to, tan saray sankaili linmoob ira ed saray wangalan to, tan nanpapalaranan da so Jerusalem, sika met sakey ka nen saman a singa sikara.
Balet agmo nengnengen so agew nen agim ed agew na inkapalis to; et agka manliket ed saray anak nen Juda ed agew ya inkabagbag da; agka met manpasirayew ed agew na ermen.
Agka onloob ed wangalan na baley ko ed agew na kairapan da; on, agmo nengnengen so ermen da ed agew na kairapan da, agmo met igaton so saray limam ed kayarian da dia ed agew na kairapan da.
Agka onalagey ed nansasalipong-pongan na dalan, a mamatey ed totoo to ya ompaliis; tan agmo yawat so saray totoo to a natilak ed agew na ermen.
Ta say agew nen Katawan sikato so asinger la ed saray amin a nacion: unong na ginawam, sikato naani so nagawa met ed sika; say inagamil mo ed saray totoo ontan met naani so naagamil ed sika.
Ta unong ya inminum kayo ed masanto a palandey ko, ontan met so saray amin a nacion oninum ira a naynay; on, oninum ira naani, et akmonen da naani, et sikara naani so singa andi nen saman.
Balet dia ed palandey Sion wala ra naani so saray makalegyas, et, sikato naani masanto; et say abung nen Jacob kayarianen to naani so saray kayarian da.

Et say abung nen Jacob sikato naani sakey ya apuy, et say abung nen Jose sakey naani a dalang, et say abung nen Esau nipaakar naani a dayami, tan sikara napoolan ira ed nanleleetan da, tan akmonen tora: et angapo so angan siopa a natilak ed abung nen Esau; ta si Katawan sikato so sinalita to.

Et saray taga Abalaten kayarianen da naani so palandey nen Esau, et saray taga talogtog saray Filisteo; et kayarianen da naani so uma nen Efraim; tan say uma na Samaria: et si Benjamin kayarianen da naani so Galaad.

Et saray dinakep na saya ya ejercito na saray anak na Israel, ya wala ed nanleleetan na saray Cananeo, kayarianen da naani anga ni ed Sarepta; et saray dinakep na Jerusalem, ya wala ed Sefarad, kayarianen da naani so saray ciudad na Abalaten.
Et saray manangilaban ontatdang ira naani ed palandey Sion, a mangokom ed palandey nen Esau; et say panarian kayarian naani nen Katawan.
Bang say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed Jonas ya anak a laki nen Amati, ya inkuan to,
Onalagey ka, onla ka ed Ninive, ed ciudad a baleg, tan yakis mo so sumpa ed sikato; ta say karelmengan to sinmabi ed arap ko.

Balet si Jonas inmalagey ya ombatik ed Tarsis a nanlapu ed arap nen Katawan; et linmasor ed Joppe, et aromog to so sakey a sakayan ya onsipot ya onla ed Tarsis; dia ed ontan binayaran to so ilugan to, tan linma ed sikato, a miolop ed sikara ed Tarsis a nanlapu ed arap nen Katawan.
Balet si Katawan pinaragem to na mabiskeg ed tapew na dayat, et wala nen saman so sakey a mabiskeg a toloy a bagyo ed dayat, et inisip da a say sakayan nabagbag.

Saman la saray manangisakay tinmakot ira, et balang sakey tinawagan to so dios to; tan inbantak da ed dayat so nilugan a kagkagawaan ed sakayan pian napalemewan. Balet si Jonas linma ed kaloolooban a kabiangan na sakayan, et dinmokol, tan akaugip na maitlek.

Dia ed ontan say manonaan na sakayan inmasinger ed sikato tan inkuan to ed sikato, Anto so gagawaen mo, O naugip? Onbangon ka, et tawagen mo so Dios mo, ompan say Dios nanonotan to itayo pian ag itayo natawtaw.
Et inkuan da ed sakey tan sakey ed kapara to, Dago kayo, ta manpapalaran itayo comon pian nakabatan no siopa so nisengegan na saya a mauges, Dia ed ontan nanpapalaran ira, et apalaran si Jonas.

Saman inkuan da ed sikato, Ibagam ed sikami, pikasi mi ed sika, no siopa ed sikatayo so nisengegan na saya a mauges; anto so betang mo? tan iner so nanlapuan mo? iner so dalin mo? tan anto so inkatoom?
Et sikato inebatan to ra, Hebreo ak, tan antakot ak ed Katawan a Dios na tawen, a sikato so nagawa na dayat tan dalin.
Saman la saray totoo tinmakot ira na mapalalo tan inkuan da ed sikato, Anto ya a ginawam? Ta sikara amta ra ya ontainan ed arap nen Katawan, tan sikato so inpaliwawa to ed sikara.
Saman la inkuan da ed sikato, Anto so gawaen mi ed sika pian say dayat ondeen ed sikatayo? ta say dayat sinmebeg lan sinmebeg.
Et inmebat ed sikara, Alaen yo ak tan ibantak yo ak ed dayat; dia ed ontan say dayat ondeen naani ed sikayo; ta amtak a nisengeg ed siak sinmabi ed sikayo so saya a baleg a bagyo.
Angan ontan inkasil da so nanbegsay, ta ipawil da so sakayan ed sakbit; balet agda ayarian ta say dayat sinmebeg lan sinmebeg a sumpa ed sikara.

Kanian tinawagan da si Katawan, et inkuan da, Kerewen mi ed sika, O Katawan, kerewen mi ed sika, agkami komon natawtaw a lapu ed bilay na saya a too, tan ag mo kami met pankasalananen ed dala na maalas; ta sika, O Katawan, ginawam so unong na labay mo.
Dia ed ontan inala ra si Jonas, tan inbantak da ed dayat: et say dayat dinmeen ed sebeg to.
Saman la tinmakot so saray totoo ed kinen Katawan a mapalalo; et angyapay ira na sakey a bagat ed Katawan, tan nangawa ra na sipasipan.
Et si Katawan intadia to so sakey a baleg a sira a mangakmon ed Jonas; et si Jonas wala nen saman ed eges na sira ed leleg na taloy agew tan taloy labi.
Saman la si Jonas nanpikasi ed Katawan a Dios to nanlapu ed eges na sira.
Et inkuan to, Tinmawagak ed Katawan lapu ed kairapan ko, et sikato inmebat ed siak; Nanlapu ed eges na Sheol tinmawag ak, et dinengel mo so voces ko.
Ta inbantakmoak ed kaaralman, ed puso na saray dayat, et say agus niliber toak; saray amin a daloyon mo tan saray burakan mo linmabas ira ed tagey ko.
Et inkuan ko, Nibantak ak a nanlapu ed arap na saray matam; angan ontan nanengneng ko ni lamet so masanto a templom.
Saray danum niliber da ak pati say kamarerwak; say kaaralman wala nen saman ed liberliber ko; saray dika nibalkot ira ed olok.
Linmasorak ed saray sengeg na saray palandey, say dalin pati saray balewet to nikaput ira ed tapew ko lawas: angan ontan inagwat mo so bilay ko a nanlapu ed kalinsorong, O Katawan a Dios ko.
Sanen say kamarerwak nalmay ed dalem ko, anonotan ko si Katawan; et say pikakasik linmoob ed sika, ed dalem na masanto a templom.
Saray mamabli na saray matila a kaapaan ikaindan da so dili a panangasi ra.
Balet manbagatak naani ed sika a tekepay voces na pisasalamat; Bayaran ko naani so insipan ko. Say panangilaban manlapu ed kinen Katawan.
Et si Katawan nansalita ed sira, et sikato inyuta to ed paway si Jonas ed tapew na dalin ya amaga.
Et say salita nen Katawan sinmabi ed Jonas ed komadua a danay, ya inkuan to,
Onalagey ka, onla ka ed Ninive, saman so baleg a ciudad, et ipolong mo naani ed sikato so polong ya ibilin ko ed sika.
Dia ed ontan inmalagey si Jonas, tan linma ed Ninive unong na inbilin nen Katawan. Et say Ninive sikato nen saman so sakey a baleg a ciudad, ya akaren ed taloy agew.
Et ginmapo si Jonas a linmoob ed ciudad a nansanngarem a nanakar, et inyakis to, ya inkuan to, Apataplo ya agew a manlapu ed natan, et say Ninive nabagbag naani.
Et saray totoo a taga Ninive sinisiara so Dios; et inbawag da so panayunal, tan nankawes ira na magaspang ya abel a manlapu ed kaatageyan anga ed kaabebaan.
Et sinmabi so saya a balita ed ari na Ninive, et sikato so inmalagey ed trono to, tan inekal to so sokbong to, tan nankolibenben na magaspang ya abel, tan imyorong ed dapol.

Et nangawa na pakapikabatan tan inbawag to ed Ninive ed panamegley na bilin na ari tan saray angatagey a totoo to, ya inkuan to, Totoo tan ay-ayep, bakbaka tan karkarnero, ag ira komon mangan na angan anto; agda ra komon ipastol odino painumen na danum.

Et mansakbong ira komon na magaspang ya abel, nanpadpara so too tan ayep, tan oningal ira komon a makmaksil ed Dios: on, sikara magbabawi ra komon balang sakey a manlapu ed dalan to a mauges, tan ed panagduksa ya wala ed lima to.
Siopa ta so mikabat no say Dios ompawil naani tan magbabawi, et paulian to naani so masubeg a sanok to, pian ag itayo naani natawtaw?
Et anengneng na Dios so saray gawa ra, a nagbabawi ra ed saray mauges a dalan da; et say Dios inbabawi to so mauges ya inbaga to nen saman a gawaen komon ed sikara; et agto ginawa.
Balet si Jonas apatabang a mapalpalalo, tan apasnokan.

Et nanpikasi ed Katawan, et inkuan to, Pikasik ed sika, O Katawan, aliwa ta a saya man so inkuan ko sanen wala ak ni ed dalin ko: Kanian imparaan ko so yakar ko ed Tarsis; ta amtak nen saman a sika so Dios a manamalangkap, tan mapangasi, matantan a manpasnok, mayaman ed maaro ya abig na linawa, tan pagbabawiyan mo so mauges.
Natan sirin, O Katawan, kerewen ko ed sika ya ekalen mo komon so bilay ko, ta magmaong ed siak so ompatey nen say manbilay.
Et si Katawan inkuan to, Maong ta ed sika so panpasnok mo?
Saman la pinmaway si Jonas ed ciudad, et imyorong ed bokig na ciudad, et diman nangawa na alolong, et imyorong ed silong to ed sirum anga ed nanengneng to no anto naani so nagawa ed ciudad.

Et intadia nen Katawan a Dios so sakey a gebey, tan ginawa to a sikato so ontobo ed tagey nen Jonas, pian siruman to komon so olo to, ya ilaban to ed mauges a kipapasen to. Kanian si Jonas mapalalo so liket to lapu ed gebey.
Balet say Dios intaria to so sakey a bigis sanen kinmabuasan ed ontombok ya agew, et kinutiban to so gebey, pian namagaan.

Et agawa, a sanen binmutay so banwa, intaria na Dios so sakey a dagem ya ampetang a nanlapu ed bokig; et say banwa kinabil to so olo nen Jonas, a sikato so apunaw, et inkerewan to so inkasikato lanlamang ya ompatey komon, et inkuan to, Magmaong ed siak so ompatey nen say manbilay.
Et inkuan na Dios ed Jonas, Maong ta ed sika so manpasnok lapu ed gebey? Et sikato inkuan to, Maong ed siak so panpasnok ya angan ed ompatey ak.
Et inkuan nen Katawan, Kinawanan mo so gebey, a sikato so agmo nansagpotan, tan agmo met pinatobo, a dia ed leleg na sanlabi tinmubo, tan ed leleg na sanlabi abalang:

Et siak angapo lagi so panangasik ed Ninive, saman so ciudad a baleg, a sikato so kawalaan na masolok a sanlasus tan duamplo a libo kawanan tan lima ra a kawigi; et a totoo ya agda amta so lima ra a ontan met dakel a bakbaka?
Say salita nen Katawan a sinmabi ed Miqueas a Morasti ed saray agew di Joatam, Acaz, tan Ezequias, ya ar-ari na Juda, a sikato so anengneng to a nipaakar ed Samaria tan Jerusalem.
Dengel kayo, sikayo balbaley, amin yo; dengel ka, O dalin, tan amin ya wala ed sikato: et say Katawan a Dios sikato komon so tasi a sumpa ed sikayo, say Katawan a manlapu ed masanto a templo to.
Ta, nia, si Katawan ompaway a manlapu ed kawalaan to, et onlasor naani, tan ongatin naani ed saray atagey a pasen na dalin.
Et saray palandey natunaw ira naani ed lepsag to, et saray lawak onletak ira naani, a singa say lilin ed arap na apuy, singa saray danum a nikalbo ed sakey a pangdel.

Ta saya ya amin lapu ed inpakasumlang nen Jacob, tan lapu ed saray kasalanan na abung na Israel. Anto so inpasumlang nen Jacob? aliwa ta a say Samaria? tan anto ray atagey a pasen na Juda aliwata ra a Jerusalem?
Kanian gawaen ko naani so Samaria a singa sakey a losbo ed uma, tan singa paspasen a pantaneman ed saray uvas; et ikalbok naani ray bato to ed lawak, tan lukasan ko naani ray niletnegan to.

Et saray amin ya inbolik a talintao to nalinglingkay ira naani, et saray amin ya upa to napoolan ira naani ed apuy, et saray amin a talintao to bagbagen ko naani; ta dia ed upa na sakey a balangkantis tinipon to ra, tan ed upa na sakey a balangkantis ompawil ira naani.
Lapu ed saya mantagleey ak naani tan managogol ak; onla ak naani ya inekalan tan lakseb; gawaen ko naani so sakey a panaggogol a singa saray chakal, tan sakey a tagleey a singa saray avestruz.
Ta saray sugat to ag ira natambal; ta sikato so sinmabi ni anga ed Juda; sikato so onsabi anga ed wangalan na baley ko, salanti Jerusalem.
Agyo ibaga ed Get, agkayo onnangis a mogmo: dia ed Betafra tinmolin ak ed dabok.
Onandi ka, O manaayam ed Safir, ed inkalakseb tan baing: say manaayam ed Saanan ag pinmaway ed panagogol na Bet-haesel: alaen to naani ed sikayo so saralan.
Ta say manaayam ed Marot alagden to a mapilalek so maong, ta say mauges onlasor a manlapu ed Katawan anga ed wangalan na Jerusalem.
Isagurmo so luganan ed marlas a kabayo, O manaayam ed Lakis: sikato so nansengegan na kasalanan ed anak a bii na Sion; ta saray inpakasumlang na Israel aromog ira ed sika.
Kanian sika mangiter ka naani na sakey a pakanodnonotan a tokdol ed Mareset-get: saray abung nen Aczib sakey naani a bengatla a mamalingo ed saray ar-ari na Israel.
Yakar ko ni ed sika, O manaayam ed Maresa, so mangayarian ed sika: say gayaga na Israel onsabi ni anga ed Odollam.
Manyangyang ka tan manpoklis ka lapu ed saray anak na liket mo: paawangen mo so yangyang mo a singa say agila; ta linma ra ed inkadakep a manlapu ed sika.

Abagey lara so saray mannonot na inkauges tan mangawa na mauges ed tapew na saray dokolan da! sano say kabuasan sikato so manliwawa, sikato so gawaen da, lapu ed sikato so wala ed pakayari na lima ra.
Et managum ira na saray uma, tan samsamen da ra; tan saray abung, et ekalen da ra: et aposan da so too tan say abung to, say too tan say tawir to ni.

Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan: Nia, nonoten ko so sakey a mauges a sumpa ed saya a kabaley, a manlapu ed sikato agyo naani naekal so saray tenger yo, tan agkayo met naani makaakar a mapangpangta; ta sikato so panaon a mauges.

Dia ed satan ya agew agamilen da naani so sakey ya alimbawa a sumpa ed sikayo, tan mannangis ira na sakey a maakdo a tagleey, et kuan da, Abagbag itayo a sigpot: sikato salatan to so apag na baley ko: agay la so pangisian to ed siaki sikato apagen to so saray umami ed saray matunganga.
Kanian andian ka naani na mangibantak ed sika na lubir ed panamegley na panpapalaranan ed tipon nen Katawan.
Agkayo manprofeta, onia so iprofeta ra. Ag ira naani manprofeta ed saray a: saray pamalaw ag ira naani ontainan.
Nibaga ta naani, O abung nen Jacob, Say Espiritu nen Katawan minmelag? sikaraya ta so saray gawa to? Saray salitak ag ira ta mangawa na maong ed saman so manakar ed inkatunong?
Balet sanen agano ni say baley ko inmalagey a singa sakey a kabosol: sikayo okposen yo so sokbong a manlapu ed kawes ed saray onlabas lapu ed katalkan a singa too a kaingongot to so kabal.
Saray bibii na baley ko papawayen yo ra a manlapu ed saray makapaliket ya abung da; ed saray anak da ya ankekelag ekalen yo so gayagak ed ando Ian ando.
Onalagey kayo, tan ontainan kayo; ta saya aliwa a sikato so pasen a pampainawaan yo; lapu ed kadutakan a maneral, pati sakey ni a maakdo a kabagbag.
No sakey a too a manaakar ed sakey ya espiritu na tila mantila, a kuan to, Siak manprofeta ak naani ed sika na alak tan mabayani ya inumen; sikato lanlamang so profeta ed saya a baley.

Siak petepeteg naani, O Jacob, a tiponen ta ka ya amin; siak petepeteg pandaragupen ko naani so kera, ed Israel; yan kora naani a sankatipon a singa saray carnero na Bosra, singa sakey a polok ed pegley na pankabkaban da; sikara mangawa ra naani na baleg a tanol lapu ed karaklan na totoo.
Say managderal ontatdang ed onaan da: sikara nanderal ira tan linmabas ira ed wangalan, tan ompaway irad'man; et say ari ra linmabas ed arap da tan si Katawan ed onaan da.
Et inkuan ko, Denglen yo, kerewen ko ed sikayo, sikayo oloen ira na Jacob, tan managuley ira ed abung nen Israel: agyo ta nepeg ya amtaen so inkatunong?
Sikayo a kagula yo so maong, tan aroen yo so mauges; a samsamen yo so baog da a manlapu ed sikara, tan say laman da ed saray pukel da;
Kanen yo met so laman na baley ko, tan bingkasen yo so baog da ed sikara, tan puterenyo ray pukel da, tan tegtegen yo ra, a singa nipaakar ed banga, tan singa laman ed dalem na caldero.
Saman la ontawag ira ed Katawan, balet agto ra naani ebatan; on, isanib to naani so lupa to ed sikara dia ed satan a panaon, unong ed inpan gawa ra na mauges ed saray gawa ra.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan nipaakar ed saray profeta a mangawa ed baley ko a nalingo; a mangetket ira ed saray ngipen da, tan yakis da, Deen; tan say ag mangyan ed sangira, mangiparaan ira na bakal a sumpa ed sikato:

Kanian sikato naani labi ed sikayo, ya andian kayo naani na pasingawey: et sikato naani ambilunget ed sikayo, pian agkayo manparles; et say banwa onselek naani ed saray profeta, et say agew andeket naani ed sikara.
Et saray managnengneng nibabaing ira naani, tan saray pomaparles nagolo ra naani; on, sikara ya amin sakbongan da naani so bibil da; ta angapo so ebat na Dios.
Balet no nipaakar ed siak, napno ak na pakayari ed panamegley na Espiritu nen Katawan, tan pangokom, tan biskeg, a mangipaliwawa ed Jacob na inpakasumlang to, tan ed Israel na kasalanan to.
Denglen yo so saya, kerewen ko ed sikayo, sikayo oloen ira na abung nen Jacob, tan managuley ira ed abung na Israel, a kagula yo so inkatunong, tan deralen yo so amin a kanepegan.
Sikara ipaalagey da so Sion ed dala, tan say Jerusalem ed inkauges.

Saray oloen to mangokom, ira lapu ed tumang, tan saray sacerdote to mangibangat ira lapu ed upa, tan saray profeta ra lapu ed pilak; et angan ontan onsaral ira ed Katawan, tan kuan da, Si Katawan andi ta dia ed pegley tayo? angapo naani so mauges ya onsabi ed sikatayo.
Kanian say Sion naani lapu ed kakanaan yo nabaka naani a singa sakey ya uma, tan say Jerusalem magmaliw naani a loslosbo, tan say palandey na abung singa saray atagey a pasen na sakey a takel.

Balet dia ed saray kaonoran ya agew nagawa naani, a say palandey na abung nen Katawan niletneg naani ed toktok na saray palandey, tan sikato naani nipaatagey ed tagey na saray pokdol; et saray baley onagus ira naani ed sikato.

Et dakel a nacion onla ra naani a kuan da, Dago kayo, tan onsegep itayo ed palandey nen Katawan, tan ed abung na Dios nen Jacob; et ibangat to itayo ed saray dalan to, tan manakar itayo ed basbas to. Ta dia ed Sion ompaway naani so tunong, tan say salita nen Katawan manlapu ed Jerusalem;

Et sikato okomen to naani so saray dakel a baley, tan igeter to naani so nipaakar ed saray mabiskeg a nacion ed arawi: et pitpiten da naani so saray kampilan da a tarem na lokoy, tan saray gayang da a kalkalawit; say nacion agto naani yayag so kampilan a sumpa ed sananey a nacion, tan ag ira met la naani manaral na bakal.

Balet onyorong ira naani balang sakey ed silong na kiew to ya uvas tan ed silong na kiew to ya higos; et angapo naani manaktakot ed sikara: ta say sangi nen Katawan na saray ejercito sikato so sinalita to.
Ta saray amin a baley manakar ira balang sakey ed ngaran na dios to; et manakar itayo naani dia ed ngaran nen Katawan a Dios tayo ed ando lan ando lawas.
Dia ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan, tiponen ko naani so samay piley, tan pandaragupen ko naani so samay apatainan, tan saman so inpanermen ko.

Et pagmaliwen ko naani so samay piley nen saman a sakey a kera, tan samay nibantak ed arawi a sakey a mabiskeg a nacion; et si Katawan so manuley naani ed sikara dia ed palandey Sion manlapu ed natan anga ed ando Ian ando.
Et sika, O ilang na polok, pokdol na anak a bii na Sion, ed sika onsabi naani, on, say inmuna a panuleyan onsabi naani, say panarian na anak a bii na Jerusalem.
Natan akin et manakis ka a maksil? Angapo ta so ari ed sika, inatey ta so mananimbawam, a saray panpaotot linma ed sika a singa ed sakey a bii a manpasakit?

Manpaotot ka, tan manpasakit ka ed pananak, O anak a bii na Sion, a singa sakey a bii a manpasakit: ta natan ompaway ka naani ed ciudad, tan manayam ka naani ed uma, et onsabi ka naani anga ni ed Babilonia: diman nilaban ka naani; diman dondonen to ka naani nen Katawan ed lima na saray kabosol mo.
Et natan dakel a nacion nankakasakey ira a sumpa ed sika, a mankuan, Sikato so nadumsisan komon, tan say mata tayo nanengneng to komon so pilalek tayo ed Sion.
Balet agda amta so saray kanonotan nen Katawan, tan agda met natalosan so pananimbawa to; ta tinipon to ra a singa saray binedber ed taltagan.

Ombangon ka, tan manbayo ka, O anak a bii na Sion; ta gawaen ko so saklor mo a balatyang, tan gawaen ko so saray kokom a gansa; et gaygayen mo naani ray dakel a nacion; et ipabtang ko naani so nabang da ed Katawan, tan say kayamanan to ed Katawan na amin a dalin.

Bang sika tiponen mo so inkasika lanlamang ed saray inayuraan, O anak a bii na saray inayuraan: sikato angipasen na saneb a sumpa ed sikatayo; sikara kabilen da naani so okom na Israel ed sakey a pekpek ed aping.

Balet sika, Belen Efrata, sika a melag ka ed saray nilibo na Juda, dia ed sika ompaway naani so sakey ya onsabi ed siak a magmaliw a makauley ed Israel; a saray ipapaway to sikara so nanlapu nen inmuna, nanlapu ed ando lan ando.
Kanian yawattora naani, anga ed panaon a saman so manpapasakit nayari a mananak: saman la saray kera ed saray agagi to ompawil ira naani ed saray anak na Israel.

Et sikato onalagey naani, tan taganoen to naani so polok to ed biskeg nen Katawan ed kaatageyan na ngaran nen Katawan a Dios to: et mansiansia ra naani; ta natan sikato naani so baleg anga ed saray sampot na dalin.

Et saya a laki sikato naani so deen tayo. Sano say Asirio onsabi ed dalin tayo, tan sano ongatin ed saray palacio tayo, saman la paalageyen tayo sumpa ed sikato so pitora a pastol, tan walora a manonaan a lalaki.

Et deralen da naani so dalin na Asiria ed kampilan, tan say dalin na Nimrod ed saray lolooban to: et sikato ilaban to itayo naani ed Asirio, sano sikato so onsabi ed dalin tayo, tan sano ongatin ed sakop na ketegan tayo.

Et say kera ed Jacob sikato naani ed saray pegley na saray dakel a baley so singa linaew a manlapu ed Katawan, singa saray mayamaya ed tapew na dika, ya agda alagden so too, tan ag met manalagar ed saray anak na saray totoo.

Et say kera ed Jacob sikato naani ed saray nacion, dia ed pegley na saray dakel a baley, so singa sakey a leon ed saray ayep ed takel, singa sakey a kilaw a leon ed saray polok na carnero; sikato, a no onlabas, mangigatin tan mamingbingkas, et angapo so angan siopa a mangilaban.
Say limam nitagey komon ed tapew na saray kabosol mo, et saray amin a kabosol mo napegpeg ira komon.
Et nagawa naani dia ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan, a pegpegen ko naani ray kabayom a manlapu ed pegley mo, tan deralen ko naani so saray luganan mo.
Et pegpegen ko naani ray ciudad ed dalin mo, tan igebak so saray amin a salimbeng mo.
Et pegpegen ko naani ray inkamangkukulam ed limam; et angapo la naani ray pomaparles mo;
Et pegpegen ko naani ray inbolik a talintaom tan saray seklang mo a manlapu ed pegley mo; et agmo la naani panpikasian so gawa na saray limam;
Et baguten ko naani ray Asheram a manlapu ed pegley mo; et deralen ko naani ray ciudad mo.
Et gawaen ko naani so sakey a pamales dia ed sanok tan petang ed saray nacion ya ag dinmengel.
Denglen yo natan so kuan nen Katawan: Onalagey ka, misangsangan ka ed arap na saray palandey, tan saray pokdol denglen da komon so voces mo.

Denglen yo, O sikayo palpalandey, so pisangsangan nen Katawan, tan sikayo mabiskeg ira a panangiletnegan na dalin; ta si Katawan walaan na pisangsangan ed baley to, et sikato so misangsangan naani ed Israel.
O baley ko, anto so ginawak ed sika? tan iner so amasagpotan ko ed sika? paletan mo so sumpa ed siak.
Ta inagwat taka ed dalin na Egipto, tan dinondon taka ed abung na inkaaripen; et ingangan ko ed onaan mo di Moises, Aaron, tan Miriam.

O baley ko, nonoten mo no anto so ninonot nen Balac ya ari ed Moab, tan no anto so inyebat ed sikato nen Balaam ya anak nen Beor; nonoten mo so manlapu ed Setim anga ed Galgal, pian naamtaan mo ray matunong a gawgawa nen Katawan.
Ed anto so laen ko ed arap nen Katawan, tan pangidaktnomok na inkasiak ed arap na atagey a Dios? onla ak ta naani ed arap ta a pati saray bagat a napoolan, tan saray kilaw a baka a mantaon na sakey?

Napaliket ta si Katawan ed saray nilibo a carnero a kalakian, odino ed samplo'n libo ya il-ilog a larak? iter ko ta naani so pangoloan ya anak ko lapu ed inpakasumlang ko, say bunga na laman ko lapu ed kasalanan na kamarerwak?
Inpatnag to ed sika, O too, so maong: et anto ta so kaokolan nen Katawan ed sika, no ag say mangawa lambengat na inkatunong, tan mangaro na kaabigay, linawa, tan manakar a maoy-oyamo ed Dios mo?
Say voces nen Katawan mantawag ed ciudad, et say too ya walaan na kakabatan nanengneng to naani so ngaran mo: denglen yo so tayokod, tan say angitoro ed sikato.
Wala ta ni ray kayamanan na karelmengan ed abung na marelmeng, tan sakey a makulang a sukatan a sikato so makadimla?
Malinisak ta naani ed saray mauges a simbangan, tan ed sakey a supot na saray manamalingo a simbangan.
Ta saray mayaman a totoo to napno ra na panagduksa, et saray manaayam diman nansalita ra na saray tila, tan say dila ra mamalingo ed saray sangi ra.
Kanian siak met sinugatan taka ed makdo a sugat; sinawa taka a mankibalatar lapu ed saray kasalanan mo.
Mangan ka naani, balet agka napesel; et say pangabebam wala naani ed pegley mo; et mangala ka naani, balet agka makapangilaban; et saman so ilaban mo iter ko naani ed kampilan.
Manpasedser ka naani, balet agka naani manani; mangigatin-gatin ka naani na saray olivo, balet agto ka naani poyokan na larak, tan say uvas balet agka naani oninum na alak.

Ta saray panontonan nen Omri sikara so inonor, tan saray amin a gawa' na abung nen Ahab, tan sikayo manakar kayo ed saray pananimbawa ra; pian gawaen taka a sakey a mankibalatar, tan saray manaayam ed sikato sakey a ngisiw; et awiten yo naani so kibabaing na baley ko.

Abageyak la! ta singa ak sanen sikara tinipon da so saray bunga ed tiagew, singa saray tinudtur ya uvas, ed panagani: angapo so mognel a nakan; say kamarerwak panpilalekan to so saray inmuna ya alo to ya higos.
Say maomaong a too atawtaw ed dalin, tan angapo so maptek ed saray totoo: sikara ya amin mansaneb ira na dala; sikara anupen da balang sakey so agi to ed bateng.

Saray lima ra wala ra ed tapew na mauges a sikato so gawaen da a maseseg; say principe mankerew, et say okom nitadia lapu ed sakey a tumang; et say baleg a too, ibesngaw to so mauges a pilalek na kamarerwa to; onia so pangabel da ed sikato a sansankatipon.

Say kamaongan ed sikara sikato so singa sakey a sabitan; say lalo a matunong magmauges nen say alar a sabit: say agew na saray bantay mo, salanti kadalaw mo sinmabi la: natan sikato naani so kagonigon da.
Agkayo manmatalek ed sakey a kaabay; agyo yan so panmatalek yo ed sakey a kaaro; kawaloen mo so saray pinto na sangim a manlapu ed saman so ondokol ed akwalan mo.

Ta say anak a laki ekalen to so galang na ama, say anak a bii onalagey naani a sumpa ed ina to, say manugang a bii onsumpa ed katulangan to a bii; saray kabosol na sakey a too sikara so saray totoo ed abung to lanlamang.
Balet no nipaakar ed siak, onnengnengak naani ed Katawan; alagden ko naani so Dios na kilalaban ko: say Dios ko talinengen to ak naani.
Agka manliket a sumpa ed siak, O kabosol ko; no nipasagak, ombangonak naani; no onyorongak dia ed kabilungetan, si Katawan sakey naani a silew ed siak.

Itepel ko naani so sanok nen Katawan, ta siak nankasalananak na sumpa ed sikato anga ed salaysayen to so sengegan ko tan gawaen to so pangokom a nipaakar ed siak: ipaway toak naani ed liwawa, et nanengneng ko naani so kaptekan to.

Saman la say kabosol ko sikato naani nanengneng to, tan say baing sakbongan to naani so saman so angikuan ed siak, Iner so kawalaan nen Katawan a Dios mo? Saray matak nanengneng da naani so pilalek ko ed sikato; natan sikato naani nigatin a singa say pitek ed saray polong.
Sakey ya agew a panangipaalagey ed saray bakormo: dia ed satan ya agew say ketegan niyalis naani ed arawi.

Dia ed satan ya agew onla ra naani ed sika a manlapu ed Asiria tan ed saray ciudad na Egipto, tan manlapu ed Egipto anga lanlamang ed Ilog, tan manlapu ed dayat anga ed dayat, tan manlapu ed palandey anga ed palanday.
Angan ontan, say dalin mankibalatar naani lapu ed saray manaayam ed sikato, lapu ed bunga na saray gawa ra.

Taganoen mo so baley mo ed panamegley na tayokor mo, say polok na tawir mo, a sikara so manaayam a manbokbokor, ed takel ed pegeley na Carmelo: napaulian ira komon a mangan ed Basan tan Galaad, singa saray agew ya inmuna.
Singa saray agew ya inpaway mo ed dalin na Egipto ipanengneng ko naani ed sikara so saray makapakelaw a bengatla.
Saray nacion nanengneng da naani tan nabaingan ira naani ed saray amin a biskeg da; yan da naani so lima ra ed sangi ra; saray layag da natelek ira naani.

Dildilan da naani so dabok a singa sakey ya uleg; singa saray mankorongkorong ed dalin ompaway ira naani a sigigiwgiw ed saray mainget a pasen da; onla ra naani a sitatakot ed Katawan a Dios tayo et antakot ira naani lapu ed sika.

Siopa so sakey a Dios a singa sika, a mamerdona na inkauges, tan labsanan to so inpakasumlang na kera ed mananawir to? sikato agto pagnayonen so sanok to ed ando lan ando, ta manliket ed maaro ya abig na linawa.
Sikato kasian to itayo lamet; igatin to naani ray inkauges tayo ed lepsag na sali; et sika ibantak mo naani so saray amin a kasalanan da ed saray kaaralman na dayat.
Gawaen mo naani so katuaan ed Jacob, tan say maaro ya abig na linawa ed Abraham, a sikato so sinambaan mo ed saray atateng mi a nanlapu ed saray agew ya inmuna.
Say awit na Ninive. Say libro na pasingawey nen Nahum ya Elkosita.
Si Katawan sikato so maimon a Dios tan manangibales: si Katawan ombales tan sikato so napno na sanok; si Katawan ombales ed saray kasumpaan to, tan mangyatol na sanok a nipaakar ed saray kabosol to.

Si Katawan matantan a manpasnok, tan baleg ed pakayari, tan angan panon agto ipatnag ya andi kasalanan so nankasalanan: si Katawan wala so dalan to ed alimbosabos tan dia ed bagyo, tan saray lurem sikara so dabok na saray sali to.
Sikato baaten to so dayat, et paekaten to, tan paekaten to so saray amin ya ilog: say Basan nalenes, tan say Carmelo; et say bulaklak na Libano nalenes.
Saray palandey onyegyeg ira ed sikato, tan saray pokdol natunaw ira; et say dalin ontagey ed arap to, on, say talba, amin a manaayam ed sikato.
Siopa so makatalindeg ed arap na pasnok to? tan siopa ta so makapansiansia ed petang na pasnok to? say sanok to nikalbo a singa apuy, tan saray bato nabuyak ira a lapu ed sikato.
Si Katawan sikato so maong, sakey a sakurong ed agew na gonigon; et amta to ray onapireng ed sikato.
Balet dia ed panamegley na manleplepwas a delap gawaen to naani so nagnap ya angaan na pasen to, et osilan to naani ray kabosol to ed saray bilunget.
Anto so isipen yo a sumpa ed Katawan sikato gawaen to naani so nagnap ya angaan; say kairapan ag naani onalagey ed komadua a danay.
Ta nanlalaga a singa saray sabit, tan abuek a singa ed inumen da, sikara naopot ira a sigpot a singa say amaga a dayami.
Pinmaway ed sika so sakey a manisip na mauges a sumpa ed Katawan, a mangisimbawa na inkauges.

Onia so kuan nen Katawan: Angan wala ra ed nagnap a biskeg, tan ontan met a dakel ira, ontan lanlamang a nabatang ira, tan sikato so onlabas naani. Angan pinairap ta ka nen saman agtaka la pairapen lamet.
Et natan puteren ko naani so pako to a manlapu ed sika, tan poltoten ko naani ray taker mo.

Et si Katawan angiter na gangan nipaakar ed sika, ya angan kapigan angapo ed ngaran mo so nitanem: manlapu ed abung na saray dirios mo batangen ko naani so talintao ya inbolik tan say talintao ya inbobo; gawaen ko naani so lobok mo; ta sika paklap ka.

Nia, ed tapew na saray palandey so saray sali na mangyakar na saray maong a balita a mangibawag na deen! Onoren mo so saray liket mo, O Juda, sungpalen mo ray sipan mo; ta say marelmeng ag naani onlabas ed sika angan kapigan: sikato so nabatang a sigpot.
Saman so mamuyak tinmatdang a sumpa ed sika: apigden mo so saray salimbeng, bantayan mo so dalan, pabiskegan moy banel mo pakasilen mo a maomaong so pakapanyarim.
Ta si Katawan ipawil to so kaatageyan nen Jacob, a singa say kaatageyan na Israel, ta saray manangikalbo inkalbo da ra, tan dineral da so saray sanga na uvas da.

Say kinlong na saray makapanyari a lalaki to nagawa ya ambalanga, saray mabayani a lalaki to nakawesan ira ed eskarlata: saray luganan mankidiam et patarem ed agew na kitadia to, tan saray gayang a cipres napatlek ira.
Saray luganan mandarlas ira ed saray polong; ombatik ira dia tan diman ed maawang ira a dalan: say nengneng da singa saray ngapus a mandarlang; ombatik ira a singa kirmat.
Sikato nanonotan to ray angkabli to: sikara nigapol ira ed panakar da; mansiglat ira ya onla ed bakor to, tan say sakbong nitadia.
Saray sangaban na saray ilog nalukasan ira, tan say palacio natunaw.
Et sikato so nigeter: sikato so nalukasan, sikato so niyarawi; et saray ariripen to a bibii mansibek ira naani a singa say voces na saray malapati a dogalen da so saray pagew da.
Balet say Ninive sikato nen saman nanlapu nen inmuna so sakey a singa luak a danum: angan ontan ontainan ira. Ontonda kayo, ontonda kayo, yakis da, balet angapo so onlingaw.
Alaen yo so sinamsam a pilak, alaen yo so sinamsam a balitok; ta angapo so angaan na kayarian, say gayaga na amin a marakep a kagawaan.
Sikato so paoypaoy, tan naopotan, tan nageba; et say puso natunaw et saray pueg manpatogan ira, tan say kairapan wala ed saray amin a banel, tan saray kalupaanda ya amin amposisaw ira.
Iner so kawalaay ongib na saray leon, tan say panganan na saray leon a kilaw, a nanakaran na leon tan say leon a kabatyan, say kilaw na leon, et angapo so anaktakot ed sikara?

Say leon biningbingkas to so masarag a nipaakar ed saray kilaw to, tan amalekne na nipaakar ed saray kabatyan to a leon, tan pinano to so saray ongib to ed dinegkeman to, tan say panagayaman to ed sinamsam.

Nia, siak onsumpa ak ed sika, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, et poolan ko naani ed asewec so saray luganan to, et say kampilan akmonen to naani ray kilaw mo a leon; et pegpegen ko naani tinekmelan mo ed dalin, tan say voces na saray igagangan mo angan kapigan ag la narengel.
Abagey la so ciudad a marala! sikato so napno ed saray tila tan panagsamsam: say panagtekmel ag onarawi.
Say tanol na lewet, tan say ongol na dalagorog na saray dalig, tan saray kabayo a manbulangit, tan saray luganan a mansentek,

Say akakabayo ed kabayo ya ontatdang, tan say mankirlap a kampilan, tan say mankidiam a gayang, tan say karakel na pinatey, tan say baleg a losbo na saray bangkay, tan angapo so angaan na saray laman; sikara nagapol ira ed saray laman da;

Lapu ed karakel na inkabalangkantis na saray malimgas a balangkantis, say katawan a bii na saray mangkukulam, ya ilako to ray nacion lapu ed pipibabalangkantis tan saray kabaley ed panagmangkukulam to.

Nia, siak onsumpa ak ed sika, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, et lukasan ko naani so sapey mo ed arap na lupam; et ipatnag ko naani so inkalakseb mo ed saray nacion, tan ed saray panarian so kibabaing mo.
Et ibantak ko naani so makapagimgimlit a dutak ed tapew mo, tan gawaen ta ka ya andi galang, tan ipasen ta ka naani a singa sakey a nenengnengen.

Et nagawa naani ya amin ya onnengneng ed sika, arawian da ka naani, et kuanda, Say Ninive, nigaton a mankibalatar: siopa naani so managogol ed sikato? iner naani so pananapan ko na manligliwa ed sika?
Magmaong ka ta nen say Noamon a nipasen ed nanleetan na saray ilog, ya wala so danudanum ed liberliber to; a say salimbeng to sikato nen saman so dayat, tan say bakor to sikato nen saman so baybay?
Say Etiopia tan say Egipto sikara nen saman so biskeg to, tan sikato nen saman so andi angaan to: say Africa tan say Libia sikara nen saman so katulongan mo.

Angan ontan sikato so nitainan, linma ed inkadakep; saray ugugaw ya anak to met nibasileng ira ya alinglingkay ed wangalan na satay amin a dalan; et nanpapalaran ira nipaakar ed saray ankabli a lalaki to, et saray amin a baleg a lalaki to abalor ira ed saray golonggolong.
Sika met nabuek ka naani; sika met niyamot ka naani; sika met mananap ka naani na sakey a salimbeng lapu ed kabosol.
Saray amin a salimbeng mo singara naani saray kiew ya higos pati saray manonaan a bunga; a no nayegyeg ira, napelag ira ed sangi na manangan.
Nia, saray totoom dia ed pegley mo sikara so bibii; saray wangalan na dalin mo napaawang ira ed saray kabosol mo: say apuy inakmon to so saray balewet mo.
Alaen mo ed sika so danum a nipaakar ed kakobkob; pabiskegen mo so saray salimbeng mo; onla ka ed pitek, tan igatingatin mo so lunek; pabiskegen mo so palbaan na lario.
Diman say apuy akmonen to ka naani; say kampilan pegpegen to ka naani; sikato akmonen to ka naani a singa say lukton ondakel ka komon a singa say lukton; ondakel ka a singa say duron.
Sika pinarakel mo ray tomitindam a dakdakel ira nen saray bitewen na tawen: say lukton manderal, et ontainan.

Saray principem singa ra duron tan saray mariscal mo singa ra polok na dondonaron a manpakalso ed saray palitek ed agew ya ambetel, balet no say banua ombutay ontainan ira, ed saray pasen da ag amta no iner so kawalaan da.
Saray pastol mo mantumeg ira, O ari na Asiria; saray ankablim wala ra ed pampainawa; saray totoom nitayak ira ed saray palandey, et angapo so manipon ed sikara.
Angapo so tambal na pampaotot mo; say sugat mo sikato so maakdo: amin a makadngel na balita nipaakar ed sika pantipaken da so lima ra ed sika; ta siopa ta so ag nilabasan a naynay na inkauges mo?
Say awit a si Habacuc a profeta anengneng to nen saman.
Katawan, panon kabayag so itawag ko, et ag moak naani talinengen? Mantagleey ak ed sika lapu ed duksa, et agka mangilaban.
Akin et ipatnag mo ed siak so inkauges, tan onnengneng ka na ag onkanepegan? ta say kabagbag tan kaduksa wala ed arap ko; et wala so kokol, tan say siblangan onalagey.
Kanian say tunong sikato so napakapuy, et say inkatunong angan kapigan ag ompaway; ta say marelmeng kobkoben to so matunong; kanian say inkatunong ompaway a pikewet.
Onnengneng kayo ed saray nacion, tan imatonan yo, tan mankelaw kayo na makapakelkelaw; ta mankikimey ak na sakey a kimey ed saray agew yo, ya agyo naani sisiaen angan sikato so nibaga ed sikayo.
Ta, nia paalageyen ko so saray Caldeo, satan so ampait tan masiglat a nacion, a mangakar ed kaawangan na dalin, pian kayarianen to so saray panagayaman a pasen a sikara so agda kayarian.
Sikara so makapakebiew tan makapataktakot; say panangokom da tan say kakanaan da manlapu ed inkasikara lanlamang.

Saray kabayo ra met masisiglat ira nen saray leopardo, tan masebesebeg ira nen saray lobo ed mankapisdem; et saray lalaki ra ya akakabayo ompasen ira a mapangpangta: on, saray lalaki ra ya akakabayo onsabi ra a manlapu ed arawi; ontekyab ira a singa agila a masiglat a mangakmon.
Sikara onsabi ra ya amin da nipaakar ed duksa; say pasen na saray lupa ra sikato ed arap; et sikara mantipon ira na saray dinakep a singa buer.
On, sikato balawen to so saray ar-ari, et saray principe sakey ira a ludlurey ed sikato; et panelekan to so balang salimbeng; ta ilosbo to so dabok, tan sikato so alaen to.
Saman la nababwes a singa dagem, tan onlabas naani, et napakasalanan, angan sikato a say pakapanyari to sikato so dios to.

Aliwa ta a sika so nanlapu ed ando lan ando, O Katawan a Dios ko, so Santok, agkami naani ompatey. O Katawan, sikato so ingeter mo a nipaakar ed pangokom; et sika, O Batondampay, sikato so pinaalagey mo a nipaakar a pamatunong.

Sika ya walaan na malinlinis a mata nen say kanenengneng ed mauges, tan agmo nitepel a nengnengen so ag onkanepegan, akin et nengnengen mo ra so mangawa na sililiput, tan mandeen ka no say marelmeng akmonen to so too a matunong nen sikato:
Et gawaen mo so saray totoo a singa saray sira na dayat, a singa ra saray korongkorong, ya angapo so manuley ed sikara?
Sikato alaen to ra ed banwit to, erelen to ra ed iket to, tan tiponen to ra ed kalawit to; kanian sikato so manliket tan mangayaga.
Kanian manbagat ed iket to, tan manpasob na incienso ed kalawit to: ta lapu ed sikara say bilay to sikato so mataba, tan say tagano sikato so daakan.
Ekalan to ta sirin na nasamel na eket to, tan ag mangasi a mamatey ed saray nacion a naynay?

Onalagey ak naani ed tapew na panbantayan ko, tan onyorongak naani ed tapew na ilang, tan onimaton ak naani ya onnengneng no anto so salitaen to ed siak, tan no anto so yebat ko nipaakar ed pandalem ko.
Et si Katawan inmebat ed siak, et inkuan to, Isulat mo so pasingawey, tan sikato so gawaen mo a niosaosa ed tapew na saray tapi, pian makabatik so manbasa ed sikato.
Ta say pasingawey sikato ni nipaakar ed nigeter a panaon, tan mansiglat ya onarap ed angaan, et ag naani mantila: angan manabala, sikato so alagden mo; ta petepeteg ya onsabi, ya ag manbayag.
Nia, say kamarerwa to sikato so mapangta, aliwa a maptek ed sikato; balet say matunong manbilay naani a lapu ed pananisia to.

On, laot ni, say alak sikato so liputan, sakey a laki a mapasirayew ya ag mandeen ed abung to; a pabalegen to so pilalek to a singa Sheol, tan sikato so singa say patey, tan ag nayari a napenek, balet tiponen to ed sikato so saray amin a nacion, tan ilosbo to ed sikato so saray amin a baley.

Saraya ya amin ag ira ta mangyalagey na sakey ya alimbawa a sumpa ed sikato, tan panludlurey ya uliran a sumpa ed sikato, et kuan da, Kasi la so amarakel na agto kayarian! panon so kabayag? et ilosbo to ed sikato so saray sanla!
Ag ira ta naani onalagey a bigla ray mangetket ed sika, tan onliing ira naani so saray mamapairap ed sika, tan sika naani so nipaakar a samsam ed sikara?

Lapu'd no nansamsam ka ed saray dakel a nacion, saray amin a nakeraan ed saray baley samsamen da ka naani, lapu ed dala na saray totoo, tan lapu ed duksa a ginawa ed dalin, ed ciudad tan ed amin a manaayam ed sikato.
Abagay la so makarandan na mauges a nabang a nipaakar ed abung to, a mangipasen na obong to ed tagey, pian nilaban komon ed lima na mauges!
Sika nanisisip ka na baing ed abung mo, lapu ed inpamegpeg mo na dakel a baley, tan nankasalanan ka a sumpa ed kamarerwam.
Ta say bato onakis naani a manlapu ed bakor, tan say tapi a manlapu ed kiew onebat naani ed sikato.
Abagey la so mamaalagey na sakey a baley ed panamegley na dala, tan mangiletneg na sakey a ciudad ed panamegley na inkauges!
Nia, ag nanlapu ta ed Katawan na saray ejercito a saray totoo nankimey ira na nipaakar ed apuy, tan saray nacion mansagpot ira na nipaakar ed kaapaan?
Ta say dalin napano naani na pikakabat ed gayaga nen Katawan, singa saray danum sakbongan da so dayat.
Abagey la so mangiter ed kaabay to na inumen, ed sika a mangarom na samal mo, tan sikato met so bueken mo, pian nanengneng mo komon so inkalakseb da!

Sika napano ka na baing et aliwa a gayaga: oninum ka met, et singa ka sakey ya agginalsiman; say copa na lima a kawanan nen Katawan onsabi naani ed liberliber mo, tan say marutak a baing onla naani ed tapew na gayagam.

Ta say duksa ya agawa ed Libano sakbongan to ka naani, tan say kabagbag na saray ayayep, ya anaktakot ed sikara; lapu ed say dala na saray totoo tan lapu ed duksa ya agawa ed dalin, ed ciudad tan ed amin a manaayam ed sikato.

Anto ta so kakanaan na talintao ya inbolik, a say nangawa ed sikato sikato so inbolik to; say inbobo a talintao, angan say managbangat na tilatila, a say angereng ed sikato manmatalek ed sikato, pian mangawa na saray emel ya talintao?
Abagey la so mankuan ed kiew, Liing ka: ed emel a bato, Alagey ka! Saya so manbangat naani? Nia, sikato so inoklopan na balitok tan pilak, angapo a balot so panlinawa ed amin a pegley to.
Balet si Katawan wala ed masanto a templo to: manmemet komon so amin a dalin ed arap to.
Sakey a pikakasi nen Habacuc a profeta, a niyan ed Shigionoth.

O Katawan, nadngelan ko so balita a nipaakar ed sika, et antakotak: O Katawan, pabilay mo lamet so kimey mo ed pegley na saray taon; dia ed pegley na saray taon sikato so ipakabat mo; dia ed sanok nonoten mo so panangasi.
Say Dios onsabi a manlapu ed Teman, tan say Santo a nanlapu ed palandey na Paran. (Selah.) Say gloria to sakbongan to so saray tawen, et say dalin napno ed galang to.
Et say sinag to singa nen saman so silew; sikato walaan na saray liwawa ya ompaway a manlapu ed lima to; et diman nen saman so amotan na pakayari to.
Ed arap to pinmaway so salot, et saray mandarlang a ngalab pinmaway ed saray sali to.

Sikato nanalagey, et sinukat to so dalin; sikato ninmengneng, et pangiwgiwen to ray nacion; et saray andi anga a palandey nitayak ira; saray a pokdol dinmakmomo ra; saray dalan to sikara so singa sanen inmuna.
Anengneng ko so saray tolda na Cusan dia ed kairapan; saray bengbeng na dalin na Madian pinmalog ira.

Si Katawan pinmetang ta ed saray ilog? Saray sanok mo sikara ta so sumpa ed saray ilog, Odino say petang mo sumpa ed dayat, A sika kinmabayo ka ed saray kabayom, ed tapew na saray luganan mo a panangilaban?
Say bekang mo agawa ya alukasan a sigpot; say samba ed saray kailalakan sikara so tua a salita. (Selah.) Sika pinaletak mo so dalin ed saray ilog.
Saray palandey anengneng da ka, et tinmakot ira; say bagyo na saray danum linmabas: Say kalinsorong inbesngaw to so voces to, et intagey to so saray lima to ed tagey.
Say banwa tan say bulan wala ra nen saman a maligen dia ed panagayaman da, ed liwawa na saray panam linma ra, ed kidiam na masileng a gayang mo.
Sika inakar mo so dalin dia ed kasnokan; sika inilik mo ray nacion dia ed sanok.
Sika linma ka nipaakar ed kilalaban na baley mo, nipaakar ed kilalaban na nilanaan mo; sika sinugatan mo so olo na abung na marelmeng a too, pian nalukasan so angiletnegan anga ni ed tenger.
Sika tinalos mo ed tayokor to lanlamang so olo na saray mibabakal to; sikara sinmabi ra a singa alimbosabos a mangitayaktayak ed siak; say panagliket da sikato so singa pangakmon ed duka a maamoamot.
Sika ginmatin ka ed dayat pati saray kabayom, say losbo na saray makapanyari a danum.

Nadngel ko, et say laman ko ginmiwgiw, saray bibil ko ginmiwgiw ira ed voces; kabolok onloob ed saray pokel ko, tan onmayegmegak dia ed pasen ko; lapu ed kaokolan ya alagden ko a mareereen so agew na gonigon, lapu ed isasabi na baley ya onloob a sumpa ed sikatayo.

Ta angan say kiew ya higos ag naani onlambot, angan say bunga angapo naani ed saray uvas; say kimey na olivo onkulang naani. Et saray uma ag ira naani mamapaway na tagano; say polok na karkarnero napegpeg naani a manlapu ed panangipokokan, et angapo naani so polok na ayep dia ed saray panagiwiyan:
Angan ontan manliketak naani ed Katawan, manliketak naani dia ed Dios na kilalaban ko.

Si Katawan, a katawan, sikato so biskeg ko; et gawaen to ray salik a singa saray sali na ulsa a makbet, Tan gawaen toak a manakar ed tapew na saray atagey a pasen ko. Nipaakar ed Manonaan a musico, ed saray kagawaan a dinelesan.

Say salita nen Katawan a sinmabi ed Sofonias ya anak a laki nen Cusi, ya anak a laki nen Godolias, ya anak a laki nen Amarias, ya anak a laki nen Ezequias, dia ed saray agew nen Josias, ya anak a laki nen Amon, ya ari na Juda.
Siak uputen ko naani a sigpot so saray amin a bengatla ed lupa na dalin, kuan nen Katawan.

Opoten ko naani so too tan ayep; opoten ko naani so saray manok ed saray tawen, tan saray sira ed dayat, tan saray kagapolan pati say marelmeng; et pegpegen ko naani so too ed lupa na dalin, kuan nen Katawan.

Et unaten ko naani so limak ed tapew na Juda, tan ed tapew na saray amin a manaayam ed Jerusalem; et pegpegen ko naani so kera nen Baal ed saya a pasen, tan say ngaran na Chemarim pati saray sacerdote;
Tan saray manpipikasi ed ejercito na tawen ed toktok na saray abung; tan saray manpipikasi, a mansamba ed Katawan tan mansamba ed panamegley nen Malcam;
Tan saray ombeneg a manlapu ed katotombok ed Katawan; tan saray ag nananap ed Katawan, odino ag nananap a nipaakar ed sikato.
Mandeen ka ed arapan nen Katawan a Dios; ta say agew nen Katawan asinger la: ta si Katawan mangitadia na sakey a bagat, sikato pinasanto to so saray binagaan to.
Et nagawa naani dia ed agew na bagat nen Katawan, a dusaen ko naani ray principe, tan saray anak na ari, tan amin ya akakawes na kawes a sankaili.
Et dia ed satan ya agew dusaen ko ray amin ya onlokso ed sasabien, a mamano ed abung na katawan da ed panagduksa tan panamalingo.
Et dia ed satan ya agew, kuan nen Katawan, wala naani tanol na panakis a manlapu ed wangalan na sira, tan agogol a manlapu ed komadua a gaton, tan baleg ya ongol a manlapu ed saray pokdol.
Managogol kayo, sikayo manaayam ed Mactes; ta amin a baley na Canaan nabagbag; saray amin ya inoklopan na pilak napegpeg ira.

Et nagawa naani dia ed satan a panaon, ya osisaen ko naani so Jerusalem ed saray tinkaw; et dusaen ko naani so totoo ya akayorong ed saray bolirek to, a kuan da ed saray puso ra, Si Katawan ag naani mangawa na maong, ag met naani mangawa na mauges.

Et say kayamanan da magmaliw naani a samsam, tan saray abung da ed kabagbag; on, sikara mangipaalagey ira naani na saray abung, balet agda ra naani panayaman; tan mantanem ira naani na saray uvas, balet ag ira naani oninum na alak to.
Say baleg ya agew nen Katawan asinger, sikato so asinger tan masiglat a maomaong, salanti say voces na agew nen Katawan: say mabayani a laki onakis ya ampaipait a toloy diman.
Satan ya agew sikato so agew na sanok, agew na gonigon tan irap, agew na kabagbag tan pankibalatar, agew na bilunget tan udiem, agew a malurem tan makapal a bilunget,
Agew na tamboyog tan panangibalap na bakal, sumpa ed saray ciudad a kinutaan, tan sumpa ed saray atagey a bakor a pibakal.

Et yakar ko naani so irap ed saray totoo pian manakar ira a singa bulag a totoo, lapu ed nankasalanan ira a sumpa ed Katawan; et say dala ra nikalbo naani a singa dabok, tan say laman da a singa dutak.

Angan say pilak da angan say balitok da agda ra naani nayarian ya ilaban ed agew na sanok nen Katawan; balet say amin a dalin naakmon naani ed apuy na imon to: tan gawaen to naani so angaan, on, makapataktakot ya angaan, na saray amin a manaayam dia ed dalin.
Mandaragup kayo, on, mandaragup kayo, O nacion ya angapo so baing to;

Ed arapen a say pangigeter mamapaway, ed arapen a say agew onlabas a singa taep; et arapen a say masebeg a sanok nen Katawan onsabi ed sikayo, et arapen a say agew na sanok nen Katawan onsabi ed sikayo.

Anapen yo si Katawan, sikayo ya amin a maoyamo ed dalin, ya angonor na saray pangoksoyan to: anapen yo so inkatunong, anapen yo so kaoyamoan: nayari a sikato naani niyamot dia ed agew na sanok nen Katawan.
Ta say Gaza napaulian naani, tan say Ascalon sakey a kabagbag: patainanen da naani so Asoto ed pegley agew, tan say Ecron nabagut naani.

Abagey lara so saray manaayam ed gilig na dayat, say nacion na Queritim! Say salita nen Katawan sumpa ed sikayo. O Canaan, a dalin na saray Filisteo; deralen ta ka naani, pian angapo naani so manayam.
Et say gilig na dayat sikato naani so panagpakabkaban, pati saray alolong a nipaakar ed saray pastol tan pangipokokan ed saray carnero.

Et say gilig na dayat sikato naani so nipaakar ed kera ed abung na Juda; ipakabkab da naani so saray camero rad man; dia ed saray abung na Ascalon sikara naani ondokol ed labi; ta si Katawan a Dios da dalawen to ra naani, tan ipawil to naani so inkadakep da.
Nadngel ko so balaw na Moab, tan saray panmodmora na saray anak nen Ammon, ya inpamalaw da ed baley ko, et intandoro ra so saray inkasikara lanlamang a sumpa ed ketegan da.

Kanian unong a mabilayak, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito, a Dios na Israel, Petepeteg a say Moab singa naani Sodoma, et saray anak nen Ammon singa ra naani Gomorra, sakey a kayarian na saray sabitan tan kaskasan na asin, tan sakey a mankibalatar lawas: sav kera ed baley ko gawaen to naani so samsam ed sikara, tan say kera ed nacion ko tawiren to ra.
Saya wala naani ed sikara lapu ed pangta ra, lapu ed nanmodmora ra tan intandoro ra so inkasikara lanlamang a sumpa ed baley nen Katawan na saray ejercito.

Si Katawan makapataktakot naani ed sikara; ta paerasen to naani so saray amin a dirios ed dalin; et saray totoo manpikasi ra naani ed sikato, balang sakey manlapu ed pasen to, angan saray amin a polpolo na saray nacion.
Sikayo met taga Etiopia, ompatey kayo naani ed kampilan ko.
Et yunat to naani so lima to a sumpa ed amianen, et deralen to naani so Asiria, tan gawaen to naani so Ninive a sakey a kabagbag, tan amaga a singa say kalawakan.

Tan saray polok ondokol ira naani ed pegley to, saray amin ya ayayep na saray nacion; say pelicano tan say puerco ispin nanpadpara ra naani ya ondawes ed saray palatok to; saray voces da mananyeweng ira naani ed saray dorongawen; say kabagbag wala naani ed saray sasabiyen: ta lukasan to naani so nilalik a cedro.

Saya so ciudad a magayaga a nanayam ya andi likas, a nankuan ed puso to, Siak, et angapo so angan siopa nilikod ed siak agay la so inpagmaliw to a sakey kabagbag, sakey a pasen a dokolan na saray ayep angan siopa ya onlabas naani ed abay to mantangsik naani, tan ipayag to naani so lima to.
Abagey la so matunganga tan marutak! ed manangapos a ciudad!
Sikato so agto inmonor ed voces; sikato agto angawat na panangibangat; sikato so ag manmatalek ed Katawan; sikato so ag inmasinger ed Dios to.
Saray principe to dia ed pegley to sikara so manengak a leon; saray okookom to sikara so lobo ed mankapisdem; sikara ag ira mangikera anga ed kabuasan.
Saray profeta to sikara so anlemew tan liputan a totoo; saray sacerdote to minura ra so santuario, sikara nangawa ra na duksa ed tunong.
Si Katawan dia ed pegley to sikato so matunong: ag naani mangawa na mauges; ed kinabuasan yakar to so inkatunong to ed liwawa, sikato so ag onkulang; balet say ag matunong agto amta so baing.

Siak pinegpeg ko ray nacion; saray bakor da nabagbag ira; pinalis ko ray polong da, dia ed ontan ya angapo so onlabas; saray ciudad da nabagbag ira, dia ed ontan ya angapo so too, dia ed ontan ya angapo so manayam.

Inkuan ko, Salambengat ya ontakot kayo ed siak; awaten yo so panangibangat; dia ed ontan say panagayaman to ag napegpeg naani, unong ed amin ya ingetar nipaakar ed sikato: balet binmangon ira ya asaksakbay tan dineral da ray amin a gawa ra.

Kanian manalagar kayo a nipaakar ed siak, kuan nen Katawan, anga ed agew ya yaalagey ko a mansamsam; ta say panangigeter ko sikato so panipon ed saray nacion, pian ikalbok ed sikara so sanok ko, salanti say masebeg a sanok ko; ta say amin a dalin naakmon naani ed apuy na imon ko.
Ta samanla ipawil ko ed saray baley so malinis a pansasalita, pian sikara ya amin tawagan da komon so ngaran nen Katawan, pian manlingkor ira ed sikato a benebenek.
Manlapu ed nibaliw na saray ilog na Etiopia so saray manpikasi ed siak, salanti say anak a bii na saman so intayak ko, yakar to naani so bagat ko.

Dia ed satan ya agew agka naani nabaingan lapu ed saray amin a gawam, a sikara so inpakasumlang mo a sumpa ed siak; ta sikato naani pangekal ko ed pegley mo ed saray mapangta a manliket ed sika, et angan kapigan agka la mapangta ed masanto a palandey ko.
Balet paulian ko naani ed pegley mo so sakey a pinairap tan duka a baley et sikara onapireng ira naani ed ngaran nen Katawan.

Say kera ed Israel ag ira naani mangawa na inkauges, ag ira met naani mansalita na saray tila; say matila a dila ag met naani naromog ed sangi ra; ta sikara mantagano ra naani tan ondokol ira naani, tan angapo naani so antakot ed sikara.
Mankanta ka, O anak a bii na Sion, oneyag ka, O Israel; manliket ka tan mangayaga ka ed simoon a puso, O anak a bii na Jerusalem.
Si Katawan inekal to so saray pangokom mo, inbantak to so kabosol mo: say Ari na Israel, salanti si Katawan, wala ed pegley mo; agka naani antakot ed mauges angan kapigan.
Dia ed satan ya agew nikuan mo naani ed Jerusalem, Agka antakot; O Sion, agmo yaboloy ya onkapuy iray limam.
Si Katawan a Dios mo wala ed pegley mo, sakey a makapanyari a mangilaban naani; manliket naani a tekep na gayaga ed sika; manpainawa naani ed aro to; manliket naani ed sika ed panagkanta.
Tiponen ko naani so saray maneermen lapu ed matuyaw a tipon a sikara so kayarian mo nen saman; ya dia ed sikato say awit ed tapew to sikato nen saman so balaw.

Nia, ed satan a panaon tumangan ko naani so saray amin a mamaermen ed sika; et ilaban ko naani so samay piley, tan itipon ko naani so samay pinatainan; et gawaen kora naani a galang tan ngaran, a say baing da wala nen saman ed amin a dalin.

Dia ed satan a panaon iloobtakayo naani, tan dia ed satan a panaon tiponen takayo naani; ta gawaen takayo naani a sakey a ngaran tan sakey a galang ed saray amin a baley ed dalin, sano ipawil ko so inkadakep yo ed arap na saray mata yo, kuan nen Katawan.

Dia ed komadua a taon nen ari Dario, sanen komanem a bulan, ed ununa ya agew na bulan, sinmabi so salita nen Katawan ed panamegley nen Aggeo a profeta ed kinen Zorobabel ya anak a laki nen Salatiel, a makauley ed Juda, tan si Josue ya anak a laki nen Josedec, ya atagey a sacerdote, a kuan to,
Onia so salita nen Katawan na saray ejercito, kuan to, Saya a baley kuan to, Aliwa nin panaon ya onla itayo, say panaon nipaakar ed abung nen Katawan pian nipaalagey.
Saman la sinmabi so salita nen Katawan ed panamegley nen Aggeo a profeta, a kuan to,
Sikato ta so panaon a nipaakar ed sikayo lanlamang pian manayam kayo ed saray abobedaan ya abung yo ra, leleg a saya ya abung sikato so mankibalatar?
Kanian onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito: Isipen yo so saray dalan yo.

Sikayo nantanem kayo na dakel, et daiset so niloob yo; mangan kayo, balet agkayo napesel; oninum kayo, balet agkayo napenek na inumen; mankawes kayo, balet angapo so salimoot; et saman so makagamor na up-upa gamoran to so up-upa pian sikato so yan to ed supot a butbut.
Onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito: Isipen yo so saray dalan yo.
Ontatdang kayo ed palandey, tan mangala kayo na kiew, tan ipaalagey yo so abung; et napaliketak naani ed sikato, tan napagloriaak naani, kuan nen Katawan.

Inanap yo so dakel, et, nia, sikato so pinmaway a daiset; et sanen sikato so inyakar yo ed abung, sikato so sinibokan ko. Akin? kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito. Lapu ed say abung ko a mankibalatar, leleg a sikayo ombatik kayo a balang too ed dili ya abung to.
Kanian lapu ed sikayo saray tawen pinokpokan da so linaew tan say dalin pinokpokan to so bunga to.

Et tinawag ko so maga ed tapew na dalin, tan ed saray palandey, tan ed tapew na bukel, tan ed balo ya alak, tan ed larak, tan ed amin a papawayen na dalin, tan ed saray totoo, tan ed ay-ayep, tan ed amin a gawa na saray lima yo.

Saman la si Zorobabel ya anak a laki nen Salatiel, tan si Josue ya anak a laki nen Josedec ya atagey a sacerdote, pati amin a kera ed baley, inonor da so voces nen Katawan a Dios da, tan saray salita nen Aggeo a profeta, lapu ed sikato so inbaki nen Katawan a Dios da; et say baley tinmakot ed arap nen Katawan.
Saman la si Aggeo ya inbaki nen Katawan insalita to so pabano nen Katawan ed baley, a kuan to, Siak walaak ed sikayo, kuan nen Katawan.

Et si Katawan tinenyeg to so espiritu nen Zorobabel ya anak a laki nen Salatiel, a makauley a Juda tan say espiritu nen Josue ya anak a laki nen Josedec, ya atagey a sacerdote, tan say espiritu na kera ed baley; et linma ra tan nankimey ira ed abung nen Katawan na saray ejercito, a Dios da.
Sanen komalabinapat ya agew na bulan, sanen komanem a bulan, sanen komadua a taon nen ari Dario.
Dia ed komapito a bulan, ed komaduamplo tan sakey ya agew na bulan, sinmabi so salita nen Katawan ed panamegley nen profeta Aggeo, a kuan to.
Mansalita ka natan ed kinen Zorobabel ya anak a laki nen Salatiel, a makauley na Juda, tan si Josue ya anak a laki nen Josedec, ya atagey a sacerdote, tan ed kera ed baley, ya ikuan mo,
Siopa so atilak ed sikayo ya akanengneng ed saya ya abung sanen inmuna a gayaga to? tan panon so pakanengneng yo natan ed sikato? aliwa ta ed mata yo a singa sikato so angapo?

Angan ontan natan ombiskeg ka, O Zorobabel, kuan nen Katawan; et manpabiskeg ka, O Josue, ya anak a laki nen Josedec ya atagey a sacerdote; et manpabiskeg kayo, sikayo ya amin ya ombaley ed dalin, kuan nen Katawan, et mankimey kayo: ta walaak ed sikayo, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito,
Unong ed salita ya inpisipan ko ed sikayo sanen pinmaway kayo ed Egipto, et say Espirituk nanayam ed pegley yo: agkayo antakot.
Ta onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito: Maminsan ni, ed magangano, et panmayegmegen ko naani so saray tawen, tan say dalin, tan say dayat, tan say amagaan a dalin;
Et panmayegmegen ko naani so saray amin a nacion; et saray mabli a bengatla na saray amin a nacion onsabi ra naani; et panoen ko naani so sayan abung ed gayaga, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito.
Say pilak kayarian ko, say balitok kayarian ko, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito.
Say kaonoran a gayaga na saya ya abung babaleg naani nen say inmuna, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito; et dia ed saya a pasen mangiterak naani na deen, kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito.
Dia ed komaduamplo tan apat ya agew na komasiam a bulan, ed komadua a taon nen Dario sinmabi so salita nen Katawan ed panamegley nen Aggeo a profeta a kuan to,
Onia so kuan nen Katawan na saray ejercito: Tepeten yo natan ed saray sacerdote so nipaakar ed tunong, a kuan yo,

No say sakey manawit na masanto a laman ed saloy na kawes to, tan ed saloy na kawes to diwiten to so tinapay, odino sira, odino alak, odino larak, odino angan anto a kanen, magmaliw ta naani a santo? Et saray sacerdote inmebat ira tan inkuan da, Andi.

Saman la inkuan nen Aggeo, No say sakey a sikato so marutak lapu ed inatey a laman diwiten to so bengatla ed saraya, magmaliw ta naani a marutak? Et saray sacerdote inmebat ira tan inkuan da, Marutak naani.

Saman la inmebat si Aggeo tan inkuan to, Ontan so satan a baley, tan ontan so saya a nacion ed arap ko, kuan nen Katawan; et ontan so balang gawa na saray lima ra; et saman so yapaydad'man sikato so marutak.
